full:
PHARMACY - agn. Agnus castus. Chaste tree. Vitex agnus castus. Verbena verticillata. N. O. Verbenacae. Found on the shores of Mediterranean, Provence and Greece. Tincture of ripe berries. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abuse, sexual. Agalactia. Anus, excoriation. Ascites. Breast-milk. Chronic fatigue. Debility. Depression. Dislocations. Fatigue. Gonorrhea. Gouty, joints. Gums, ulcerated. Hormonal, disorders. Impotency. Infertility. Knees, coldness. Leucorrhea. Masturbation. Memory, weak. Mouth, ulcers. Neurotic. Photophobia. Premature, aging. Rheumatism. Spleen, swelling, induration. Sexual, melancholy. Sexual, weakness. Sprains. Strains. Tachycardia. Testicles, disorders. Toothache. Weakness.

HERBAL - The Vitex Agnus Castus of the Alchemists, the “chaste berry” from this tree is taken as a herbal tonic for the sexual organs and hormones. Agnus castus is for low sexual vitality with corresponding mental depression and loss of nervous energy. The Chaste Tree was used in ancient times by both men and women to suppress their sexual desire. It was used by the Greek monks centuries ago to lower their sex drive.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agnus produces its chief effect on sexual organs of both the sexes. General debility and depression of vital power are marked. Impotence and infertility in both sexes, but more pronounced in men. History of repeated gonorrhea or masturbation. Impotency and premature old age from loss of sexual power. Nervous debility in unmarried persons. Weakness from masturbation habit. Gnawing itching in all parts, especially eyes. Tachycardia caused by tobacco in neurotic young men. A remedy for sprains and strains. MIND - Absent-minded, and forgetful. Distraction of mind. Inability to fix attention when reading. Bad memory. Unable to recollect things has to read a sentence twice before he can comprehend. Forgetful of purchases, goes off and leaves them. Depression. Nervous depression and mental forebodings. Fear of death. Great sadness with a fixed idea of approaching death (Aeon.). Sad and despairing, repeats that he will soon die. Desires death. Doubts if anything had existence. Changeable, moods. Indifference to everything, alternating with cheerfulness. Lack of courage. Discouragement alternating with haughtiness. Lethargy alternating with frenzy. Exhilaration alternating with sadness. Neurotic. Peevish. Inclined to get angry. Premature old age with apathy and melancholy. Mental ailments from sexual excesses, masturbation. Sexual melancholy. Self-contempt from sexual abuse (Staph.). Aversion to sex. Sexual thrill absent from excessive masturbation. Illusion of smell, herring, musk. Starting during sleep.

Head - Headache before menses. Tearing pain with pressure in the temples and forehead, worse during motion. Pain in the temple, as from a blow. Heaviness in the head and pressure, as if the head would fall forward. Pain in the vertex. Tension and chilliness in the scalp, which is warm to the touch. Biting-itching on scalp, worse evenings and when falling asleep.

Eyes - Gnawing itching in eyes. Corrosive itching over and on eyebrows and lids, and below eyes. Sensation as if one had received a blow on eye. Burning pain when reading in evening. Pupils dilated (Bell.). Photophobia. Dim vision before menses.

Ears - Roaring in the ears. Hardness of hearing.

Nose - Hard ache on dorsum of nose, better pressure. Soreness and pain in left side of nose. Illusion of smell, herring, musk.

Face - Corrosive itching on the cheeks. Formication in cheeks. Tearing under right lower jaw. Long sharp pain followed by fine pricking itching. Rending, tearing pain under alveoli of right lower jaw. Erysipelas on left cheek, spreading from nose over face and head.

Mouth - Mouth very dry. Saliva viscid and tough, drawing out in strings. Ulcers in the mouth and on the gums. Metallic, coppery, bitter taste. Boils. Tongue coated white.

Throat - Corrosive itching in pit of throat. Voice as if passing through wool. Voice has no timbre. Vertigo - Vertigo before menses. Vertigo from loss of vital fluids. COMMENTS - Great sadness with a fixed idea of approaching death, especially after confinement when milk fails to appear. Deficiency of milk with despair of recovery. Absent-minded. Drowsiness. Illusion of smell, like herrings or musk. Ulcers in mouth and on gums. Tearing pain in lower jaw. Toothache from hot food or drink. Swelling and induration of spleen. Rumbling of flatus during sleep. Discharge of prostatic fluid while straining at stool. Suppressed menses with abdominal pain. Leucorrhea staining yellow. Infertility. Pain as if dislocated in joints. Joints easily twisted. Rheumatic and gouty nodosities on joints. Hahnemann became interested in this remedy when he read that the Chaste tree was used by the Greek monks centuries ago to stop their sex drive. They would take tincture doses and they took so much that their testicles and genitals would atrophy. In Boericke there are descriptions of shrinking and atrophying, “Testicles, cold, swollen, hard, and painful,” “lower sexual vitality,” and “corresponding depression.” Useful for people who have over exerted themselves sexually, a promiscuous period, and since have lost sex drive, very apathetic. Emaciated, pale, blue circles around their eyes with dilated pupils. Sexual neurasthenia. Sexual melancholy, depression about not having a lover, gloom, moroseness. All sexual desire is gone. Impotence. History of repeated gonorrhea or promiscuity. The genitals are cold and relaxed, can get no erection. History of cures of chronic spermatorrhea, chronic dribbling of semen and prostatic fluid because of the weakness in the whole area. Women's abhorrence or aversion to sexual intercourse and infertility (Nat-m., Ph- ac., Sep.). RELATIONS - Agnus is the only proved member of the Verbena family, though the Labiate or Mint family are closely allied. Teste groups it with Mur-ac. and Hyos.Antidotedby: Camphor, Nat-m. - headache, strong solutions of table-salt. Compare: (1) Sei., Con., Nat-m., Sep., Sabal., Ph-ac., Camph, Lyc. Olnd. (2) Leucorrhea staining yellow, Nux-v., Chel., Carb-an., Kseos. Followed well by: Ars.,Bry.. Ign„ Lyc., Puls., Sulph., Sei. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Only the most simple food agrees. Belchings, smell like urine. Pinching pain when sitting bent over. Nausea in pit of stomach after eating. Nausea in pit when standing. Nausea as from eating fat food. Stools - Stools soft, recede, difficult. Diarrhea of children. Chronic diarrhea of adults.

Abdomen - Ascites. Abdomen distended after meals. Incarcerated flatus. Abdomen sensitive to pressure. Rumbling in abdomen during sleep. Violent contracting pain coming suddenly in morning. Spleen swollen, sore. Swelling and induration of spleen, often with soreness, after intermittent fever. Nausea with sensation as if intestines were pressed downwards. Bowels as if sinking down, wants to support bowels with hands. Flatus smells like urine, remaining long on clothes.

Rectum - Anus excoriated. Deep fissures of the anus, often giving pain when walking. Flatus smells like urine, remaining long on clothes. Sensation as of subcutaneous ulceration near the anus, only while walking. Difficulty of passing soft stools. When pressing at stool, discharge of prostatic fluid. Corrosive itching of the perineum. Sensation as if diarrhea would set in, when standing.

Male - Itching of genitals. Testicles, cold, swollen, hard and painful. Penis small, flaccid. Drawing pain along spermatic cords. Loss of prostatic fluid on straining. Gleety discharge. Yellow discharge from urethra. Aversion to sex. Impotence with genitals cold and relaxed. Impotence, after frequent attacks of gonorrhea, syphilis. No erections. Penis so relaxed that voluptuous fancies excite no erection. Feeble erections without sexual desire. Impotence, with morning erections only. Spermatorrhea with impotence. Ailments Agnus castus due to masturbation, sexual excesses. Sexual desire almost lost. Sexual desire gone (Sei., Con., Sabal.). Scanty emission without ejaculation.

Female - Menses are suppressed with abdominal pains. Bearing down pains. Suppressed menses. Scanty menses. Infertility with suppressions of menses and no sexual desire (Sep.). Swelling of uterus. Leucorrhea staining yellow, transparent. Relaxation of genitals with leucorrhea. Transparent vaginal discharge passes imperceptibly from the very relaxed genital. Retained placenta. Ailments due to masturbation, sexual excesses. Sexual thrill absent from excessive masturbation. Aversion to sex. Food - Appetite lessened. Food makes him feel uneasy and replete. Only the most simple food agrees. Relishes food, but it doesn't agree with him. Warm food and drink cause teeth to ache. Thirst during heat. Thirstlessness, and aversion to all drink.

Chest - Sensation of dryness in chest. Hard pressure in the region of the sternum, especially during a deep inspiration. Pressure in xiphoid cartilage. Hard pressure in right axilla and upper arm, worse touch or motion. Constitutions - It corresponds to lymphatic, sycotic constitutions. Premature old age with apathy and melancholy. Nervous debility in unmarried persons. Impotence and gleet in old offenders.

Heart - Hysterical palpitations with nosebleed in women. Tachycardia caused by tobacco in neurotic young men. Slow and weak pulse, often imperceptible. Palpitations during cough.

Back - Creaking noise in vertebrae. Pain in sacrum, from flatus. Sharp, deep pain on and near coccyx. Sharp pain near sacrum. Breasts - Agalactia. Breast-milk absent, with sadness. Milk scanty or entirely suppressed. Deficient secretion of milk in lying-in women (Calc-p.).

Limbs - Inflammatory, rheumatic swelling of joints. Sprains and strains. Gouty nodosities. Hard pressure in right axilla and upper arm, worse from touch and motion. Strains from lifting a little too much. Swelling of the finger joints, with arthritic, tearing pains. Heaviness of right foot, as from a weight. Joints as if dislocated. Feels bruised all over. Cold hands, cold knees, even in bed. Joints easily twisted. Feet easily turn under when walking on stone pavement. Rheumatic and gouty nodosities on joints.

Sleep - Sleeplessness. Awaking often, as if alarmed, starting. Anxious dreams. Amorous dreams.

Skin - Corrosive itching on different parts of the body, better by scratching, but soon returns. Itching around the ulcers, in4he evening. Yellow tint of skin.

Modalities - Better scratching. Better pressure. Worse from over lifting, sprains. Worse from sexual excess. Worse from seminal losses. Worse from masturbation.

Teeth - Teeth are painful when touched by warm food or drink. Throbbing, tearing pain in left eyetooth. Small boil near tooth, very painful to touch.

Liver - Aching in region of liver worse touch. Lungs - Dyspnea worse evening. Dyspnea on going up stairs. Tough, hanging mucus like a rag in fauces.

Kidneys - Passes more urine, frequently. Pain in bladder. When urinating, pain in kidneys. Red, turbid urine with burning and pressure in urethra. Gets up twice at night and even once during siesta to urinate.

Cough - Coughs during the evening. Coughs in bed, before going to sleep. Coughs with raising of blood, followed by copious mucus. Coughs in paroxysms. Coughs with palpitations and epistaxis. Coughs when inhaling cold air.

Perspiration - Sweats, almost only on the hands, when walking in the open air. Sweats easily. Pungent smell, causes dullness and headache. Sweats followed by vomiting and trembling.

Temperature - Chilliness, internal with -trembling, the external skin is warm. Chill alternating with heat. Chilly all over, but only hands feel cold to touch. Much chilliness, with cold hands. Flushes of burning heat, principally in the face, with cold knees in the evening in bed.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agraphis is one of the remedies introduced by Dr. Cooper. The plant grows in sheltered places, and Dr. Cooper gave “better from shelter” as a leading indication. It partakes of the characters of the lilies and corresponds to catarrhal conditions. Clarke regarded it as one of the leading remedies in cases of adenoids. Dr. Cooper noted “Adenoids with enlarged tonsils, frequently accompanying dentition.” He cured with it mucus diarrhea following a suppressed cold. Obstruction of the nostrils, especially from adenoids and throat deafness. Enlarged tonsils, adenoids, throat deafness. The action of it is felt towards the root of the nose. Catarrhal conditions. Patient is prone to take cold on exposure to cold winds (Aeon.). Mutism of childhood unconnected with deafness. Chill from cold winds (Sil.). Mucus diarrhea from cold. Throat and ear troubles with tendency to free discharge from mucus membranes.

Throat - Adenoids with enlarged tonsils. Throat deafness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hydr., All-c, Calc-p., Sul-i., Calc-i. (2) All-s., Squil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Rectum - Mucus diarrhea following a suppressed cold.

full:
PHARMACY - agr-b. Agrimony. Agrimonia eupatoria. The flowering stalks are floated in a bowl of water and left in the sun for several hours. The water imbued with healing power is used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle (add brandy, or some other alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agrimony, along with Centaury, Walnut and Holly, belongs to the group of "Over sensitivity to Influences and Ideas," as classified by Bach. These fourremedies help those who are distressed or overly influenced by disturbing factors, powerful impressions in their environment. Agrimony has been used as an herbal remedy for liver troubles. Li ver disturbances may exist. Craving for stimulants is a frequent indication. Restlessness in mind and body. Anxieties and worries. Internal disquiet, nervousness and hurried. Agrimony will greatly ease pain in a patient who is smiling despite pain and internal torture. Suppression, over-compliance and denial of emotions. MIND - Desire to not let others down and burden them with their personal problems. Intend to spread cheer and uplift others. Tendency not to express strong emotions which could bring disharmony or strife to oneself or others. Resentment and antagonism nonetheless build up within and may find release unexpectedly in spiteful remarks or in masked, aggressive behavior. Unsettled and restless mind, prone to be distracted. Inner cares and worries. Anxieties build up, restlessness and a sense of dissatisfaction. Grief or other forms of disappointment. Resentment or guilt which are not being worked through. Unresolved conflicts or trauma. Inner restlessness, a sense of boredom. Often finds some relief in drugs, entertainment, or other forms of diversion. Quarrels distress and bring unhappiness. REFERENCES - Bach.

Head - Headache. Sensation of heat and burning rises into vertex from left lower jaw, almost makes her crazy. Vertigo.

Mouth - Dry and hot. Palate has ared margin. Burning on palate in a short time.

Back - Tearing along spine.

full:
PHARMACY - aids. AIDS nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - AIDS. Bites. Breast, tumors. Chills. Coryza. Cystitis. Emaciation. Fevers. Headaches. Heartburn. Hypertension. Memory, weakness. Nosebleeds. Ovaries, pain. Palpitations. Sinusitis. Toothaches. Trembling. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Sluggishness of the body. Coldness of affected parts, lack of vital heat. Heat sensation. Hypertension. Intoxication, after. Stitching pain. Relaxation of connective tissue. Restlessness. Stiffness. Trembling, quivering, tremulous weakness. Wavelike sensations. Bites and wounds. Headaches with nausea. Ovaries aching pain, worse evening, on the right. Cystitis. Low or diminished sexual desire. Palpitations with anxiety. Weakness during menses. Weakness with nausea. Rheumatic pain. MIND - Awkward. Mentaldullness. Slowness of mind. Forgetful, weak memory. Prostration of mind. Concentration is difficult, worse afternoon, studying. Mental confusion. Confusion as to his identity. Mistakes at work, when writing. Awkward. Timidity. Bashful, want of self-confidence. Pathetic, helpless feelings, self pity. Insecure. Weak character. Introspective. Anxiety. Fear of authority, death, failure, high places, of infection, of closed places, poverty. Aversion to company, yet fear of being alone. Desire for solitude alternating with desire for company. Consolation ameliorates. Discontented. Irritability alternating with cheerfulness, with discouragement. Irritability from difficult concentration. Offended easily, sensitive to reprimands. Ailments from anger. Anger towards husband. Desire to kill everyone he sees. Least provocation would enrage him. Indifference, apathy, particularly in the afternoon, evening. Indifference to loved ones. Want of sensitiveness. Hardhearted, inexorable. Suspicious. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Persistent thoughts. Pertinacity. Vanishing of thoughts. Calmness alternating with sadness. Seriousness. Wants to be quiet. Mildness. Laziness. Alternating moods. Crying, from many causes. Forsaken feeling. Sensation of isolation. Feels unloved, estranged from loved ones. Sympathetic. Causeless sadness. Dwells on the past. Exalted love for humanity. Lovesick. Excitement. Exhilaration. Optimistic. Extravagance. Desires activity. Playful, frivolous. Mischievous. Shameless. Loquacity. Wants to be naked, because it is natural. Industrious, mania for work. Restlessness. Hurry, haste. Automatic conduct. Unconsciousness. Time appears shorter or longer, passes too quickly or too slowly. Everything is strange, as if in a dream. Delusions that she has lost her shell and protection. Delusions of floating in air. All, barriers between him and others are removed. Beautiful delusions of youth, beauty, love and peace. Sees bubbles popping, rising to the surface. As if brain was moving, wavering, oras if a heavy lump in the left side of brain.

Head - Feeling of cotton wool in head, with slight vertigo. Constriction sensation. Enlarged sensation, head feels inflated. Formication, vertex. Heaviness sensation, smoking aggravates. Perspiration of scalp, forehead. Pulsating, temples, right, vertex, morningon waking. Swollen feeling, vertex. Headaches - Bursting pain, morning on waking. Cutting pain, above left eyes. Headaches with nausea. Forehead pain extending to occiput, neck, nose or teeth, in morning. Pain behind the eyes. Pain extending to neck region. Pain forenoon, morning on waking. Headaches preceded by disagreeable dreams. Pulsating pain. Stitching pain, forehead over left eye, sides, in morning on waking. Feels well especially before the headache attack.

Eyes - Discharges, morning, watery, yellow. Aching pain, left. Discoloration, red inner canthi. Dryness. Itching, left eye, inner canthi, eyelids. Lachrymation left eye. Sore pain with itching, left. Stitching pain about the eyes, left. Eye pain, touch aggravates. Eyes sensitive to touch. Swelling, left inner canthi, on waking.

Ears - Aching pain. Fetid, offensive, yellow discharges. Itching external ear. Noises in ear. Buzzing, ringing, night. Soreness ear, meatus, left ear. Pain on yawning, right ear.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ailanthus acts upon blood disorganizing it and producing conditions like low fevers, low types of eruptive diseases and hemorrhagic diathesis. Mucus membranes become hemorrhagic and ulcerative (Lach., Ars. ). Rapid prostration. Malignant and suppressed scarlatina. General stupor with sighing. Sepsis. Low types of eruptive diseases, diphtheria. Raynaud's disease. Lividity, stupor, fetor and malignancy. Thin, acrid discharges. The skin appears livid or purplish, face dark as mahogany. Hot, sordes, throat swollen, purple, livid. Purpled appearance of the skin. Rash coming out in patches. Eruptions which are slow in appearing. Rashes often return annually. Follicular tonsillitis, streptococcus infection. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Low adynamic forms of disease with extreme prostration torpor, vomiting. Prostration at the outset of a disease. The patient is stupid, dull, delirious, weak. Semi-conscious, delirious, weak pulse, general torpor and prostration. Diarrhea, dysentery and great weakness. MIND - Confused mind, mental depression. Stupor or stoic indifference, with sighing. Dullness, must read a subject several times or figures over and over again. All the antecedents are forgotten. Constant muttering delirium with sleeplessness and restlessness. Raging delirium with brilliant eyes.

Head - Frontal headache with drowsiness, dizziness and red-hot face, cannot sit up. Faint on rising up or vertigo worse lying. Passive congestion headaches. Suffused, dilated eyes, photophobia. Face dusky. Thin, copious, ichorous, bloody nasal discharge.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis, smarting, aching, lachrymation, purulent discharge. Suffused and congested, startled look when aroused. Photophobia. Pupils dilated and sluggish.

Ears - Pain in ear when swallowing. Parotid glands tender and enlarged.

Nose - Nostrils congested. Nose dry, secretion suppressed. Coryza, with rawness in nostrils, sneezing. Loss of smell. Thin copious bloody ichorous nasal discharge. Itching and uneasy feeling around the nose.

Face - Mahogany colored, dark and swollen. Chronic speckled spotted face, a kind of acne. Face sallow, jaundiced, blue circles around eyes. Face red and hot, covered with a rash. Purplish face. Lips are swollen, cracked, ulcers near commissures.

Mouth - Tongue dry and brown, parched and cracked. Tongue moist, furred white, tip and edges livid.

Throat - Diphtheria and tonsillitis. Streptococcus infections. Inflamed, edematous, dusky red. Throat dark and swollen. Tonsils studded with many deep ulcers (worse left), with loose pultaceous discharge. Much swelling internal and external. Dry, rough, scraping, choking feeling. Hoarse, croupy voice. Pain in swallowing extends to the ears. Dry, foul fauces. Irritation and itching of posterior pharynx. Vertigo - Dizzy when rising up. COMMENTS - With the low fever of Ail. there is stupor orindifference with sighing. Constant frontal headache of a neuralgic character. Paroxysmal headache with drowsiness during the day, confused mind, depression. A feeling of fullness everywhere. A sensation of electric current passing from head into limbs was prominent in the provings. The head is burning hot with piercing pains. The parotid glands are sensitive and enlarged. The attacks are characterized by fullness of head with heat, pains burning, darting in temples and occiput, vertigo and nausea. The throat is severely affected: thick, edematous, dry, choky feeling. Dry, rough, scrapy, worse morning. Livid, swollen with ulcers oozing a fetid discharge. The symptoms are better lying on right side (bronchial affections). Sitting up causes vomiting, dizziness. Motion causes staggering. Toothache is better walking. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Alcohol, Rhus-t., Nux-v. Compare: (1) Ptel., Xanthoxylae. (2) Am-c., Am., Arum- t. (3) Aloe, - dull frontal headache. Bapt., Bry., Gels., Hyos., Lac-c. Lach., Nit-ac., Nux-v., Phyt., Hydr-ac., Rhus-t., Stram., Echi. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Vomits food speedily during the chill, suddenly and violently when sitting up, with stupor. Peculiar feeling of emptiness in stomach.

Abdomen - Tenderness over liver region. Burning in the stomach and bowels. Tympanites.

Rectum - Diarrhea, dysentery with great weakness. Thin, watery, offensive stools. Passing of involuntary stools with urine. Tapeworms. Sense of insecurity with stool or urine.

Male - Sore on prepuce, looking like incipient chancre.

Female - Malignant puerperal fever. Vomiting of pregnancy. Food - No appetite, everything tastes insipid, sight of food makes her worse, disgust for food. Hunger and distressing sense of general emptiness during chill. Thirst for cold drinks, brandy.

Chest - Stitching and aching in chest. Burning in right lung, contracted feeling in left. Chest feels strapped, or as if air-cells stuck together. Constitutions - Suited to nervous, sensitive persons. Bilious temperament. Stout and robust. Hemorrhagic diathesis.

Heart - Rapid, small pulse, weak, frequent, and irregular. Dull pain and contracted feeling in region of base of heart and through center of left lung.

Neck - The neck is tender and swollen.

Eruptions in dark, sparse patches, appear slowly, disappear on pressure, but return slowly. Scarlatina maligna. Petechae. Skin mottled. Crawling all over the body.

Modalities - Better from hot drinks. Better when lying on right side. Worse from suppressions. Worse raising up or sitting up. Worse walking, motion. Worse sight of food.

HOMEOPATHIC - Plaster of Paris is so named because of the prevalence of gypsum in the Paris basin where it was originally produced. Plaster of Paris is generally the hemihydrate of Calcium Sulphate - CaSO4- 2H2O. Alabaster is a fine-grained, massive, opaque or translucent variety of gypsum. It tends to be white in coUr but can be streaked or tinted with brown, red, yellow, green, etc. Chemically, alabaster is hydrous Calcium Sulphate manifesting as a monoclinic crystal structure. Gypsum is formed by the evaporation of bedded deposits that are precipitated mainly from evaporating saline water. It has been used for centuries for making statues, carvings, ornaments and for decorations. The pyramids near Cairo were originally faced in alabaster, but it is now completely weathered away. Plaster of Paris (and gypsum plaster) is made by the partial (or complete) dehydration of gypsum by heating or burning. When mixed with water, it gives a plastic paste which can be cast or molded. It eventually sets and hardens due to the chemical recombination of the gypsum with water. MIND - Rocks violently. Muddled mind. Memory poor. Forgetful. Low self confidence. Indecisive. Feeling very impatient and irritable. Tired physically, bright mentally. Feels depleted. Want to be held, feels vulnerable. Anxious, fretful, worrying. Anxious on waking. Anxious about future. Anxiety about getting breast cancer. Panic attack, anxious and unable to breath. Fear of death. Fear of life. Fear of the dark. Fear of madness. Restless, but mind doesn't feel as though it wants to think about anything in particular. Hard to relax, feels vulnerable, stupid. Sensation as if smiling. Tired and restless having to do lots of things. Thinking about travelling. Depressed and hopeless. Sad, melancholic, blue. Very moody and impatient. Woke feeling very low. Sensation as if, too much to do, feel sorry for myself, teary. Craves some peace and quiet. Don't like crowds. Discontented. Intolerant, irritable. Ennui. Panicky and weepy. Irritable and angry with people at work. Anger towards former work colleagues. Feels irritable in the morning. Abdomen - Colic. Griping pain in both sides of lower abdomen. Sudden pains in right abdomen, extending to rectum and extending upwards. Abdominal pain .after eating. Achey and bloated feeling. Abdomen bloated and tender. Solar plexus feels heavy. Sharp stabbing pain, left side of abdomen. Nausea and pain abdomen after eating.

Head - Head feels hot. Pressure at back of head in a band running from ear to ear. Headache, back of neck very stiff. Dull ache in occiput extending to temples, worse bending forwards. Temples pounding. Headache all day not better for fresh air or drinking cold water. Head feels full, heavy. Woke with a headache. Pain in head, left side. Headache across forehead and temples. Frontal headache. Light headedness worse moving quickly. Pain in forehead, behind eyes, a nauseating pain. Pain as if brain being squeezed.

Boring sensation in both ears, better rubbing finger in ear. Left ear, shooting pain, at end of conversation. Sensitive hearing to ticking clock. Tinnitus. Ringing in ears. Sounds more acute on left side. Buzzing noise. Hissing noise.

Constant sneezing. Nasal catarrh and sneezing. Lots of mucus in back of throat, nose blocked. More sensitive to smells. Sinus conges- tion. Tickle on end of nose.

Vivid, intense dreams.

Pain in right breast. Chests - Sides of chest itch. Chest feels tight. Chest and solar plexus feels heavy. Sore pain.

HERBAL - The Mimosa tree, Albiziajulibrissin, was introduced to the United States in 1745 for use as an ornamental plant because of its unusual, attractive and fragrant pom-like flowers and interesting fem-like foliage. This deciduous tree is attractive to bees, butterflies, and birds. This is a traditional herb used for depression and irritability. The flower heads are carminative, digestive aid, sedative and tonic. Mimosa flowers are used internally in the treatment of insomnia, irritability, breathlessness and poor memory. The stem bark is anodyne, anthelmintic, carminative, discutient, diuretic, oxytocic, sedative, stimulant, tonic, vermifuge and vulnerary. It is used internally in the treatment of insomnia, irritability, boils and carbuncles. Externally, it is applied to injuries and swellings. A gummy extract obtained from the plant is used as a plaster for abscesses, boils, etc., and also as a retentive in fractures and sprains. The flower of the mimosa invigorates blood, calms the spirit. It's used for acute and chronic depression, insomnia, poormemory, and irritability. Problems due to constrained emotions, especially when accompanied by poor memory, epigastric pain and feelings of tightness and pressure in the chest. MIND - Depression. Anxiety. Poor memory. Feelings of grief and loss.

Sleep - Insomnia. COMMENTS - Called the “tree of collective happiness” by the Chinese, mimosa flowers are specifically used for individuals who are experiencing deep feelings of grief and loss. Micheal Tierra stated that he has used mimosa or albizia flower and bark extract alone or in formula for large numbers of people who might otherwise be given pharmaceutical anti-depressants. All experienced complete or significant benefit even after a day's use. He recommend taking one half to one teaspoon, three or four times daily. While its flavor leaves something to be desired, it has shown itself to be completely safe and after experiencing its positive effects, one quickly grows used to the flavor. REFERENCES - Buttimer. Murphy. Tierra.

Skin - Abscesses. Boils.

HERBAL - AlchemiUa means “Hail to the Alchemists.” The leaves of AlchemiUa fold in such a way as to catch the morning dewdrops likejewels. In Iceland this plant is sacred to the V irgin, called Mariastakker, which gives quiet sleep if placed under the pillow at night.

HOMEOPATHIC - AlchemiUa has been used for healing wounds and for women's problems. It is mildly astringent, diuretic and anti-inflammatory. Helps regulate the menses and eases the menopause. Gastritis and enteritis. Used as a douche for leucorrhea. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Alcoholus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse when lying down. Worse when quiet at night..
constitution: Alcoholism. Coma. Delirium. Dementia. Double vision. Hallucinations. Imbecility. Insanity. Mania. Stupidity.
keynote:
PHARMACY - aleo. Alcoholus. Ethyl alcohol. Aethanolum. Spirits of wine. Remedy made from commercial spirits of wine, by re-distillation. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Coma. Delirium. Dementia. Double vision. Hallucinations. Imbecility.…
full:
PHARMACY - aleo. Alcoholus. Ethyl alcohol. Aethanolum. Spirits of wine. Remedy made from commercial spirits of wine, by re-distillation. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Coma. Delirium. Dementia. Double vision. Hallucinations. Imbecility. Insanity. Mania. Stupidity.

HOMEOPATHIC - Amid the pleasures of the cup the soldier no longer complains of the campaign, the sailor forgets the dangers of the storm. The weak one grows strong and the despondent bold. The despairing lover leaves his solitude and forgets the indifference of his mistress. From acute alcohol intoxication all weaknesses are exposed and all secrets divulged without reserve, all hypocrisy ceases. Intoxicated persons beget alcoholics. General excitement of all the senses. Moral and physical exaltation. Transition from delirium tremens into permanent mania with hectic fever or dropsy. A feeling of vague and unaccountable dread. Sadness often constant through the whole disease (delirium tremens). Staggering, uncertain gait. Coma, that changes to paralysis of the brain in persons of an apoplectic habit. Sexual powers at first increased, then diminished. Impotence, want of sexual power. Irregular menstruation. Abortion in the first months. The children of alcoholics may grow up dull, indolent, stupid and become intemperate. Inclination to obesity. Diminished perspiration. MIND - Mind disturbed, difficulty fixing the attention. General intellectual enfeeblement. Impaired memory. Absence of the senses and of reason. Restlessness and anxiousness, tries to disguise. Solitude and repose in bed increase the anxiety. Mania with excessive irritability, excited by slightest causes. Mania with disposition to commit murder or start a fire. Impatience of contradiction. Unreasonable inclination to quarrel. Exhilaration. Increased self-esteem and importance. Feels insulted and abused by one's friends. Melancholy, weeping. Depression. Inclination to commit suicide. Delirium. Rapid and incoherent talk. Thinks himself pursued. Screaming, singing and immoderate merriment. Feeling unusually strong and rich. Various hallucinations of sight, hearing, smell and sensation. Abdomen - Sense of pressure in both hypochondria. Swelling of spleen. Recti muscles of abdomen become rigid and prominent. Ascites. Rumbling and growling in intestines. Inflammation of the intestines and stomach. Flatulence. Colic pains. Intestinal hemorrhage.

Head - Head dull, clouded and hazy. Effusion of water into the membranes and ventricles of the brain. Softening of the brain. Pressing headache, causing stupidity. Drawing in the head. Dull, diffused headache with a buzzing or rushing sound in the ears. Sensation of fullness at the crown and back of the head or at the temples.

Eyes - Eyes injected. Red and excited, watery eyes. Eyes fiery, brilliant, fixed and wild. Rigid, gleaming look. Bright and animated or suffused and soft. Spots in the eye and dimness of vision. Catarrhal inflammation of the eyes. Roughness of the margins of the lids. Contraction of the pupils, drooping lids and coma. Effusion and swelling below the eyes. Conjunctiva more or less jaundiced. Y ellow tinge of the sclerotica. Dilated and almost insensible pupils. Vision weak, cannot use eyes, objects flicker and become dim. Cannot read or write. Aversion to light. Black before eyes. Flashes of light before eyes. Muscae volitantes in clouds, before the eyes. Double vision. Visual hallucinations.

Ears - Dryness in external meatus. Acute sense on hearing. Hearing blunted, perception of sound lessened. Confusion on sounds. Roaring in ears, especially after spasms or with vertigo. Ringing, buzzing or rushing sound in the ears, frequently accompanied with dull, diffused headache. Illusions of hearing. Imaginary voices and sounds.

Nose - Redness of the nose and cheeks. Redness of the nose, especially at the tip. Vessels of the skin congested. Swelling and inflammation. Red pimples or tubercles. Lining membrane of the sinuses inflamed and ulcerated. Bleeding of the nose. Illusions of the sense of smell.

Face - Distorted face. Face bloated, without expression, stupid, silly. Redness of the cheeks and nose. Face red and swollen. Tetter in the face. Eruption in the face, bluish-red or white vesicles and pimples. Food - Mania for alcoholic drinks, pepper and other heating things. Longing for spirituous liquors and, if not speedily gratified, becomes raving or has convulsions. At first no desire to eat, afterwards, ravenous hunger. Loss of appetite. Aversion to food and alcoholic drinks. Thirst before breakfast and through the day, often excessive.

Mouth - Grinding the teeth. Tongue fissured from middle to the edges, furred or sometimes denuded of epithelium. Papillae at tip of tongue enlarged and red. Sore and dry condition of the tip of the tongue. Dry, red, glazed tongue. Tongue covered with yellow slime in the middle, the margins clean. Tongue smooth and red with tendency to stick to the teeth or roof of the mouth. Tongue moved with difficulty. Convulsive motions of the tongue with stammering and inarticulate speech. Dry state of the mouth. Offensive smell from the mouth. Froth in mouth. Sour, salty or bitter taste in the mouth in the morning. Bitter taste in the mouth. Illusions of the sense of taste. Stammering speech.

Throat - Throat red and feels stiff. Granulations on the posterior wall of the throat, also on the base of the tongue. Engorged appearance of the veins of the fauces. Redness, dryness and heat. Aphthous ulcers in the throat. Gangrenous ulcers. Throat full of tough mucus, difficult to hawk up. Paralysis of pharyngeal muscles. Paralysis of the muscles of swallowing. Sensation as if something lodged in the esophagus. Strong efforts to clear the throat or belch or vomit, bring up blood or bloody mucus. Painful swallowing.

Stomach - Belchings, sour or foul. Belchings of water. Eructation like rotten eggs. Nausea and vomiting mucus and water. Vomiting of sour and offensive smelling matters. Hematemesis. Fullness and distention after eating. Burning heat in stomach. Pressure in the stomach. Sense of oppression and weight. Weakness of the stomach. Constriction, uncomfortable tension and pressure in epigastrium.

Rectum - Hemorrhoids and varicose veins. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Paralysis of anus. Feces compact, knotty, black or light gray. Stool black, bilious, slimy and bloody, thin and clay colored. Diarrhea mucus or mealy. Diarrhea often alternating with constipation. Involuntary excretion of stool and urine.

Urine - Frequent need to urinate, finally incontinence. Involuntary excretion of urine and stool. Increased quantity of urine. Lessened secretion of urine. Retention of urine. Urine scanty at first, yellowish or deep red, then more copious with sediment. High-colored urine. Albuminous urine. Urine acid, contains serum and bile. Bloody urine. Vertigo - Attacks of vertigo with sudden faintness and reeling or falling down, but no twitchings. Violent vertigo, nearly changing to a stroke. He staggers while walking and standing. Momentary attacks of vertigo. COMMENTS - Frenzy, accompanied by violent convulsions. Drunkenness with various manias. Much inconsiderate, confused talking. Talkativeness, by which confessions are drawn from him. Ashamed of his intoxication. Sweet outpourings of friendship and tender confessions. Shamelessness. Moral degradation. Stubbornness. Quarrelsomeness. Grudges long since forgotten are renewed. Forgetfulness. All desires and inclinations become uncontrollable. Indescribable serenity of mind with cheerfulness, which the face expresses. Lively imagination. Rapid flow of thought, but he cannot keep his attention fixed continuously on one subject. Immoderate bursts of laughter. Cheerfulness. Mental inquietude. Dread arising from actual delusions. Believes he is falling, even when on solid ground. Apprehension of nearby evil. Religious ravings, they address confidential and irreverent discourses to the Deity. Absurd fancies. Confuses one person with another. Dancing, convulsive gestures, like chorea. Convulsions with a feeling as if something in the head is twisted and turned. Convulsions begin in one extremity, can be confined to one side, head can draw back, teeth clench, eyes distorted. Hysterical paroxysms. Epileptic attacks, generally coming on while standing. Epilepsy returns after every excess in drinking. Convulsive-like epileptic attacks. The w hole body trembles, commonly after exertion. Tottering and shaking. Trembling of the whole body. Twitchings or jerk- ings in muscles on sitting or lying, not in standing, especially on changing position. Persistent muscular tremor, first developed in the limbs. Muscular inquietude inability to keep the limbs or the body still without a special effort of attention. Drawings in muscles like electric shocks. Trembling and paralysis as usual consequences of a stroke. General paralysis after delirium tremens. Marked sensory paralysis. Power of directing and coordinating the muscles lessened. Musculartone and power greatly lessened. The body loses its mobility and becomes more and more destitute of muscular power. Emaciation, want of strength with continued want of appetite. Prostration of the whole body. Premature old age, face becomes pale and wrinkled, features relaxed, eyes dim, lips pale, the hands and the rest of the limbs tremble, gait unsteady. Indolence of body and mind. Frequent swoons. Hyperesthesia. This numbness is usually superficial, sensitive to deep pressure, sometimes sensitiveness of the whole body is blunted. Pain and neuralgic tearings, cuttings. Very marked, continuous buzzing or thrilling, passing from above downwards and through the whole system. Sensitiveness to the fresh air, shudder and frost. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hyos., Lach., Agar. REFERENCES - Allen.

Chest - Hydrothorax. Emphysema. Congestion of lungs. Sensation of warmth in chest. Tension of chest. Burning sensation back of the sternum. Constitutions - A sanguine, choleric temperament, sentimental and passionate. Weak-nerved person shows blunted senses and childish. The phlegmatic temperament remains passive and rather falls from his chair before giving loud evidences of his intoxication.

Heart - Valvular insufficiency. Organic difficulties of the heart and the large vessels. Hypertrophy of the left side of the heart. Increased activity of the heart and arteries. Pulsation of the heart and arteries violently increased, hard and full. Increased heat and rapidity of action in the heart. Very excited action, violent throbbing of the heart. Palpitations of the heart. Pulse nearly always accelerated, sometimes small and empty, sometimes full and even rather hard.

Back - Veins of neck swollen. Temporal and throat arteries throb, jugular veins turgescent or protruding. Weakness, finally in muscles of back, cannot even sit erect.

Limbs - Sudden startings of the limbs, as from electrical shocks. Trembling of limbs. Increased warmth, then coldness. Creeping sensation (formication) under the skin of the hands and feet. Weakness and relaxation of the muscles of locomotion, first in fingers and hands, especially in thumb and index-finger, extending all over both limbs. Limbs numb, as if paralyzed and extremely sensitive to touch and motion.

Sleep - Irresistible sleep. Deep sleep, frequently accompanied by rattling breath. Lethargic with snoring respiration, intermittent pulsation of the heart. Restless sleep. Starts from his sleep with anxiety and restlessness. Insomnia, the patient tosses from side to side during nearly the whole night, getting only broken snatches of sleep and often with frightful dreams.

Skin - Skin smutty or yellowish-gray. Jaundice. Skin soft and flabby. Skin becomes dry and hard. Sense of dryness, heat and evident fullness of swelling of the exposed parts of the skin, as the hands and face with general sensation of heat. Tormenting eruption, exceedingly itching, rough, scaly patches. Eczema and prurigo. Acne rosacea. Skin does not heal readily. Large indolent, blue-looking boils orcarbuncles. Varicose ulcers.

Modalities - Worse when lying down. Worse when quiet at night.

Liver - Heat, weight and soreness in the region of the liver. Inflammation of the liver. Cirrhosis. Lungs - Sensation of heat in the larynx. Catarrhal bronchitis. Accumulation of mucus in the air-passages. Disposition to clear the throat. Hoarseness. Sobbing. Hacking, dry cough. Coughing blood. Accelerated breathing. There was a sense of impediment to respiration. Heavy, labored breathing. Snoring respiration. Asthma. Asphyxia.

Kidneys - Sensitiveness, aching and pain in the region of the kidneys.

Temperature - Great inclination to sweat. Sweat easy at first. Sweat profuse, cool, sticky, sour smelling, sometimes warm. Increased perspiration moderates intoxication. Sensation of cold with paleness of the body. Fevers. Evening exacerbations. An agreeable warmth spreads over the body. General sensation of heat with increased action of the heart and dryness of the skin.

name: Alcoholus Sulphuris
author: Murphy
constitution: Homoeopathic Provings by James W. Metcalf, M. D. It may prove useful in some forms of sick headache, especially when the pain commences in the forehead, and extends to one or the other temples. Scrofulous affections of the eyes and lids. Twitching of the eyes and lids, such as occurs in scrofulous, nervous, and verminous children. Some rheumatic and neuralgic affections of the face. Chronic rheuma
keynote:
PHARMACY - alco-s. Alcoholus sulphuris. Liquor lampadii. Carburet of sulphur. Historical dose: All potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Homoeopathic Provings by James W. Metcalf, M. D. It may prove useful in some forms of sick headache, especially when the pain commences in the forehead,…
full:
PHARMACY - alco-s. Alcoholus sulphuris. Liquor lampadii. Carburet of sulphur. Historical dose: All potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Homoeopathic Provings by James W. Metcalf, M. D. It may prove useful in some forms of sick headache, especially when the pain commences in the forehead, and extends to one or the other temples. Scrofulous affections of the eyes and lids. Twitching of the eyes and lids, such as occurs in scrofulous, nervous, and verminous children. Some rheumatic and neuralgic affections of the face. Chronic rheumatism, prurigo, and impetigo. Chronic pharyngitis. Irritation of the pharynx, with much hawking and spitting. Gagging cough from the irritation of an elongated uvula, especially when these symptoms occur in bilious and dyspeptic subjects. Chronic irritation of the pharynx and larynx, with constant desire to hawk and spit, with hoarseness and short cough. May prove helpful in the first stage of tubercular disease of the lungs. It may prevent the tendency to irritation and congestion of the upper parts of the lungs which to readily lead to the fresh deposit of tubercles in consumptive patients. Pyrosis, heartburn, and various dyspeptic and bilious derangements. Flatulence, bilious and flatulent colic, and congestion of the liver. It is one of the few drugs which seem to exert a specific action upon the cecum. Cured a case of chronic diarrhea, appearing every four or six weeks, attended with colic, the evacuations were liquid, frothy, yellowish, sour, and attended with tenesmus.

Head - Pain in the forehead, which draws towards the left temple and remains there for two hours. Pressive frontal headache, lasting almost all day, and accompanied with transient pains in the temple. Drawing and tearing pain, stretching from the forehead to the temples, lasting all day, more severe in the room and during rest, relieved by walking in the open air. Dull pain in the frontal region, with nausea and heaviness’of the whole head. Thumping pain in both temples. Violent pressive pain in the right temple, with malaise, desire to vomit, and rumbling of wind in the bowels.

Eyes - Burning and itching of the lids. Pustules on the lids, lasting four days. Dilatation of the pupils, with quickness of the pulse. Abundant secretion of whitish yellow mucus in the eyes. Lachrymation of the eyes. Twitching and trembling of the muscles of the eyes and lids.

Ears - Pain in the ears as if some one were striking upon the tympanum with a dull instrument.

Face - Redness and puffiness of the face, heat of the face andhands. Lancinating and tearing pains in the cheeks, extending up to the temples and lasting two months.

Mouth - Dryness of the lips and mouth, irritation of the cavity and isthmus of the pharynx, followed by a sensation of contraction in the larynx, with gagging cough and quick breathing. Gum boils. Pasty, disagreeable taste in the mouth, with foul taste of the pharyngeal mucus. Bitter sharp taste in the mouth, or very repulsive acrid taste, or sweetish putrid taste. Great accumulation of saliva, with sweetish taste. Very frequent spitting. Pale red swelling of the uvula and vellum Burning and scraping in the pharynx and esophagus.

Stomach - Stomach. Very abundant eructation, sour burning, acrid regurgitations (pyrosis) occurring one or two hours after eating. Continual acid regurgitations. Regurgitations of air with nausea, discharge of flatulence upwards and downwards. Burning in the stomach and hepatic region. Heat in the epigastric region, which ascends and occupies the whole chest. Violent heat, ascending from the stomach to the head. Fullness in the stomach, with eructations, yawning, desire to vomit, and dizziness.

Abdomen - Great inflation of the abdomen, with rumbling of wind and tearing colic. Colic pains after eating. Slight wind-colic from time to time, with desire to urinate. Colic pains with loose stool and flatulence. Paroxysm of disagreeable pain in the left lobe of the liver. Soft stool, preceded by pain in the left lobe of the liver, and followed by pains in the cecal region.

Stool - Liquid stools. Slimy, watery diarrhea, with violent pain in epigastrium. Sudden diarrhea, after having dined with good appetite. Violent diarrhea, with tenesmus and sour evacuations. COMMENTS - Lampadius, in 1796, while distilling a mixture of pyrites and charcoal, procured a clear liquid in the receiver, which he named Alcoholus sulphuris, or the Alcohol of Sulphur. It consists of one equivalent of Carbon and two of Sulphur. REFERENCES - Jahr. Marcy.

Chest - Sensation of heat in the chest, congestion in the upper part of the lungs. Oppression, fullness in the chest. Slight stitches and pains about the chest.

Limbs - Pains in and eruption upon the arms and legs.

Sleep - Sleep. Sleeplessness from headache, dryness of the skin and general unpleasant heat, so that he is obliged to rise and bathe himself.

Skin - Sharp itching and stinging in different part of the skin, as if from nettles. Itching in various part of the skin, much aggravated by scratching. Bleeding and burning of eruptions when scratched (prurigo). Eruptions of impetigo on the back of the hands, the pustules are seated on the inflamed red base, contain a yellowish cloudy serum, and form thick yellowish scabs.

Fever - Great internal heat, with coldness of the hands and feet. General heat, headache, quick pulse, cramps in the calves of the legs and toes, without much thirst, and no perspiration.

Larynx - Heat and irritation of the larynx, hoarseness and irritation of the larynx. with continual desire to hawk. Cough provoked by a tickling at the bifurcation of the bronchi. Slight dry cough.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from passing flatus. Better bending backwards. Worse from loss of fluids..
constitution: Abortion. Anemia. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Emaciation. Endometritis. Fainting. Fatigue. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Hysteric colic. Indigestion. Labor-like, pains. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Pregnancy, vomiting. Infertility. Uterus, pain, prolapse.
keynote:
PHARMACY - alet. Aletris farinosa. Star grass. Blazing grass. Colic root. Unicom root. N. O. Hemodoracae. Melanthiaceae. North America. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abortion. Anemia. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Debility.…
full:
PHARMACY - alet. Aletris farinosa. Star grass. Blazing grass. Colic root. Unicom root. N. O. Hemodoracae. Melanthiaceae. North America. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abortion. Anemia. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Emaciation. Endometritis. Fainting. Fatigue. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Hysteric colic. Indigestion. Labor-like, pains. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Pregnancy, vomiting. Infertility. Uterus, pain, prolapse.

HOMEOPATHIC - Star grass is said to be the most bitter of all plants. Aletris farinosa particularly affects the female organs. Produces an anemic, relaxed condition, especially of the female organs. Useful for chlorotic girls and pregnant women. Many symptoms appear in the uterine sphere including uterine atony. Sensation of weight in uterine region and tendency to prolapse. Hemorrhages. Menorrhagia, black clots, fullness and weight. Menses are profuse and premature with labor-like pains or amenorrhea, debility from loss of fluids, protracted illness. Leucorrhea with debility. Obstinate vomiting of pregnancy. Habitual tendency to miscarriage. Infertility. Characterized by weariness of body and mind. The patient is fatigued and tired all the time, suffers from prolapse, leucorrhea, rectal distress, etc. Marked anemia. Fainting attacks with vertigo. Sensation of weight in occiput as if it would draw the head back. Parts feel heavy. Lack of appetite, in connection with uterine disorders. Disgust for food, nausea, constipation. The least food distends the stomach. Marked emaciation. MIND - Mental power and energy weakened. Cannot concentrate mind. Confused feelings. Fainting with vertigo.

Head - Weight in occiput, as if it would draw the head backwards. Vertigo with fainting, sleepiness, vomiting or purging.

Ears - Feel as if open through from one to the other.

Mouth - Much frothy saliva.

Stomach - Want of appetite, disgust for food. Least food causes distress. Flatulent colic. Nervous dyspepsia. Obstinate vomiting of pregnancy. Nausea better by coffee, by dinner with pressure in forehead. malnutrition, including neurasthenia, syphilis, insomnia, or nervous digestion. Anorexia nervosa. Cancer with emaciation. Failure to thrive in children. Deficient breast-milk, it increases the quality and quantity of milk in nursing mothers. If a baby has failure to thrive, give Alfalfa to the mother and child, the breast milk improves, the mother gets stronger and the baby gains weight. Pronounced urinary action. Diabetes insipidus and phosphaturia. Useful to allay the bladder irritability of prostatic hypertrophy. Rheumatic diathesis. Weakness, enervation, exhaustion, prostration, infirmity. Muscle weakness. Convulsive movements. Desires sweets. Sympathicotonia. Worse in the evening, from 6 to 9 p.m. A concentrated Alfalfa tincture should exercise an influence similarto that of Avena sativa. An herbal infusion used in three cases produced the same results as the alcoholic preparations. MIND - Alfalfa induces a mental exhilaration of buoyancy. Cheerfulness. Vivaciousness. A general feeling of well being, feels clear and bright, so that all blues are dissipated. Exhilaration. Mirth, hilarity, liveliness. Clearness of thoughts. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill humored, peevish. Sadness, despondency, melancholy. Depression from disappointed love. Hypochondriasis. Aversion to mental work. Bad dreams from emotional causes. Bulimia. Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag. Dull, drowsy, stupid (Gels.), gloomy and irritable, worse during evening. Slowness. Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty thinking and comprehending.

Abdomen - Distension. Flatulence with distention. Pain from passing flatus. Shifting, flatulent pain along colon several hours after meals. Frequent loose, yellow, painful stools with burning flatulence. Colitis. Chronic appendicitis. Inflammation, peritonitis, enteritis. Dropsy, ascites, with scanty urination. Cramping, griping pain. Passing flatus aggravates.

Rectum - Loads up with feces-paretic condition. Large, hard, difficult stool, with great pain. Fearful pain during passing stools, as if forcing a passage. Constipation, as from rectal atony.

Female - Premature and profuse menses with labor-like pains (Bell., Cham., Kali- c., Plat.). Menorrhagiaprofuse, black with clots. Retarded and scanty flow (Senec.). Copious menses followed by copious, watery oozing between periods. Leucorrhea white, stringy, due to weakness and anemia. Uterus seems heavy. Prolapse uterus with pain in right inguinal region. Habitual tendency to miscarriage. Mus- cular pains during pregnancy. Food - Want of appetite with weakness.

Back - Backache. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chin., Hydr., Sabin., Senec., Sep. Tril. (2) Helon. - False Unicorn, not to be confounded with Alet. (3) Dios. - colic worse bending forward. (4) Caust., Puls., Ferr., - discharge of urine during cough. (5) Alum. - constipation, grasps the seat tightly, despairs of having a stool. During stool terrible pains as if a passage were being forced, Alet. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Limbs - Chronic rheumatism. Dropsy. Leg (right) feels paralyzed below knee, numb, could not bear weight on it. Lungs - Cough before menses.

Modalities - Better from passing flatus. Better bending backwards. Worse from loss of fluids.

Kidneys - Involuntary urination on walking fast or sneezing.

author: Murphy
constitution: Anorexia. Appendicitis. Appetite, loss. Ascites. Breast-feeding. Bulimia. Cachexia. Cancer. Chemotherapy, effects. Colitis. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Emaciation. Exhaustion. Fatigue. Flatulence. Hypoglycemia. Insomnia. Malnutrition. Marasmus. Neurasthenia. Nutritional, disorders. Polyuria. Prostate, hypertrophy. Radiation, effects. Rheumatic, diathesis. Syphilis. Weakness. Weight, loss.

Flatulence. Hypoglycemia. Insomnia. Malnutrition. Marasmus. Neurasthenia. Nutritional, disorders. Polyuria. Prostate, hypertrophy. Radiation, effects. Rheumatic, diathesis. Syphilis. Weakness. Weight, loss.

HERBAL - This is a leguminous plant, cultivated from ancient times and highly prized as a pasture and forage plant. Those who have observed its influence when employed as a forage for stock must have been impressed with the favorable results. All of the provers, except one, noted three things in particular: an increased appetite so they could not wait for their regular meals, an increased amount of urine and urea, and a general sense of well-being. Causes mental exhilaration, increases energy and stamina. Alfalfa favorably influences nutrition, evidenced in "toning up" the appetite and digestion. Acts as a fat producer, corrects tissue waste. Improves appetite and digestion, mental and physical vigor returns with weight gain.

HOMEOPATHIC - Metabolic regulator. Lack of appetite or aversion to all food. Emaciation. Disorders characterized by

Head - Dull, heavy feeling in occiput in and above the eyes, worse toward evening. Violent headache. Pain in the left side of the head. Dull heavy feeling comes on about 2 p.m. and gradually increases until 6 p.m., starts at the occiput and becomes severe.

Eyes - Aching in and above the eyes.

Ears - Stuffed feeling in Eustachian tube (Kali-m.) at night, clear in morning.

Face - Flushed.

Stomach - Emptiness, weak feeling, faintness, goneness. Hungry feeling not ameliorated by eating. Nervous indigestion.

Rectum - Painless, yellow diarrhea, accompanied with flatus and attended with burning. Stools loose and more frequent than usual. Stools two or three times daily. Pasty, papescent stools.

Urine - Profuse urine, increased. Scanty. Sediment, increased indican, phosphates. Sugar in urine. COMMENTS - Dr. Houts gathered the fresh Alfalfa leaves, but obtained good results from the use of dried leaves which still retain a green color. Using these, he made an infusion which he gave to patients suffering from backaches. He found it especially indicated if they were passing small quantities of water while suffering from rheumatic symptoms or backache with muscular aching, with an excessive quantity of uric acid and urates secreted. Dr. Fearn of Oakland wrote that its action was very soothing upon the kidneys and urinary apparatus. He believed that it could be prepared for human food to as good, if not better, advantage than for animal food. Dr. Ben Bradley of Hamlet, Ohio, believed that alfalfa is one of our upcoming remedies. He reported a case where a woman had seven children born apparently strong and well, but when they reached the age of eighteen years they wasted away and died. When the last girl was taken with the symptoms of which the others had died. Dr. Bradley made a saturated tincture of Alfalfa seed concentrated, fully saturated and gave her ten drops four or five times a day. This is reported to have increased her weight from 99 to 133 pounds. She recovered good health. Mr. D. aged 41, a chief clerk in the general offices of one of our railroad companies, had complained for several months of losing flesh. His appetite was poor, he did not relish his food. There was present an abnormal thirst, a loss of flesh and polyuria. The quantity of urine for twenty-four hours was eighty ounces, specific gravity 1008. Nothing abnormal apart from an excess of indican. The prostate was enlarged and sensitive to pressure. He complained of some irritation upon urination. Five drops of the tincture was prescribed four times a day. After two weeks he sent a message for a supply stating it had greatly benefited him. He called at the end of two months having gained ten pounds, the urine at this time was practically normal in quantity. The appetite was fine and he considered himself in a normal condition. Mr. G, aged 29, complained of a loss of weight and appetite, excessive thirst, polyuria and mental depression. This syndrome had been gradually developing for the past year. Physical examination showed a man of medium size, emaciated. Heart action weakened. Prostatic portion of urethra hypersensitive. The urine was greatly increased in quantity and of low specific gravity, free from casts and albumin, phosphates were increased. Five drops of the tincture before each meal and on retiring gradually relieved the condition so that in three months he considered himself well. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Avena Sat., Hydr.. Dipodium punct. (2) Ars., Gels., Kali- p., Ph-ac., Zinc. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy

Male - Enlarged prostate gland. Prostatic hypertrophy.

Female - Increased desire. Menses coming earlier than usual. Food - Increased thirst. Appetite wanting with weight loss. Sensation of hunger at all times. Appetite is increased. Malnutrition. Desire for sweets. Sometimes ravenous appetite. Hypoglycemia, must stop and have something to eat in the middle of the morning. Hungry in forenoon (Sulph.).

Sleep - Slept better than usual, especially in early morning, it induces quiet, reposeful and refreshing sleep. Insomnia. Sleeplessness during convalescence.

Kidneys - Kidneys are weak, frequent urging to urinate. Polyuria (Ph-ac.). Increased elimination of urea indican and phosphates. Inactivity. Suppression of urine, anuria.

Bladder - Bladder irritability. Urging to urinate, morbid desire. Frequent urging to urinate. Breasts - Breast milk, absent or disappearing. Constitutions - Anorexic, emaciated, broken down constitutions. Cancer diathesis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allantoin is a botanical extract of the Comfrey plant and is used for its healing, soothing, and anti-irritating properties. Allantoin helps to heal wounds and skin irritations and stimulate growth of healthy tissue. This extract can be found in anti-acne products, sun care products, and clarifying lotions because of its ability to help heal minor wounds and promote healthy skin. Abate stretch marks naturally. Promotes wound healing, speeds up cell regeneration, and has a keratolytic (skin-softening) effect. Allantoin has been termed a cell proliferant, an epithelization stimulant, and a chemical debrider. It is said to clean away necrotic tissue, hastening the growth of new healthy tissue. Since Allantoin stimulates new and healthy tissue growth, healing epithelization may take place. Allantoin has been also termed a counter irritant that helps alleviate the untoward skin-irritation effects of certain cosmetic ingredients such as soap and detergent surfactants, oils, and acidic or alkaline materials. It produces its desirable effects by promoting and speeding up the healthy, natural processes of the body. It helps the skin to help itself. It has long been known to enhance the efficacy and desirability of cosmetic creams and lotions by its action as a skin protectant. Allantoin has also been incorporated into shampoos, lipsticks, shaving creams, suntan products, bath foams, hair gels, baby powders and various aerosol preparations. Most recently, Allantoin has been used in various dental preparations such as toothpaste and mouthwash. For the temporary protection of minor cuts, scrapes, burns and sunburn. Helps prevent and temporarily protects chafed, chapped, cracked, or wind-burned skin and lips. Relieves dryness and softens cold sores and fever blisters. Helps treat and prevent diaper rash. Protects chafed skin. Minor skin irritation associated with diaper rash and helps protect from and seal out wetness. REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Allium Cepa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air. Better cold room. Better bathing. Better motion. Worse in a warm room. Worse damp weather. Worse spring. Worse wet feet. Worse afternoon and evening. Worse lying down. Worse singing. Rest aggravates, feels better from motion..

PHARMACY - all-c. Allium cepa. Red onion. N. O. Liliaceae. Alliaceae. Tincture of the onion. Tincture of whole fresh plant gathered from July to August. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Anus, fissure. Ascites. Catarrh. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Diarrhea. Earache. Facial paralysis. Feet, easily galled. Hay fever. Hernia. Influenza. Itching. Laryngitis. Neuritis. Neuroma. Otitis. Panaritium. Pneumonia. Sinusitis. Sneezing. Traumatic, neuritis. Whitlow. Whooping cough. Worms. Yellow fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allium cepa covers more symptoms of common colds and hay fever than any other remedy. Anyone who has cut up raw onions for cooking knows the irritation upon the eyes and nose. Onions cause active sneezing andlachrymation. If the homeopathic principle of cure is true, it ought to be a good remedy for coryza, and it is. All-c. affects the mucus membranes of nose, eyes, larynx and bowels, causing increased secretions. Hay fever and coryza with acrid nasal discharges and laryngeal symptoms. Burning of the eyelids, nose, mouth, throat, bladder, skin. Acute colds from damp cold weather. Coughs, colds or headache, worse in warm room, better in open air, worse again on returning to warm room. Eye discharges may be bland. Cough caused by tickling in larynx, constant inclination to hack in order to relieve it. It has cured violent catarrhal laryngitis, hoarse cough with feeling as if it would split and tear the larynx, causing watering of eyes. Cough from inhaling cold air. Nasal secretion is acrid, secretion from eye is bland. Traumatic neuritis. Neuralgic pains like a fine thread, following amputations or injuries to nerves. Thread- like pains in the face. Left-side facial paralysis. Wounds do not heal. Singer's coryza. Neuroma. Senile gangrene. Sensation of glowing heat in different parts of the body. Symptoms go from left to right. The feet are aggravated by walking. The toothache is better by cold air or cold washing. Picking or sucking teeth improves the toothache. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Desires raw onions. Strangulated hernia has been known to follow the eating abundantly of cooked onions. A raw onion eaten just before going to bed is a popular remedy for sleeplessness. MIND - Anxious about their health. Despair of recovery. Fear that pain will become unbearable. Melancholy. Indefinable anxiety. Indolence in morning. Confusion of mind, after coffee, wine.

Head - Dull headache, with coryza. Catarrhal headache, in forehead, worse in warm room, towards evening. Headache ceases during menses, returns when flow disappears. Aching in forehead, extending to eyes and face, better free running coryza. Electric shock passes through head. Skull bones numb. Pain in occiput and down the neck.

Eyes - Itching, biting, burning in the eyes. Eyes red, sensitive to touch. Flow of tears. Much burning and smarting lachrymation. Sensitive to light. Eyes suffused and watery, profuse, bland lachrymation, better in open air. Burning in eyelids, worse coughing, wants to rub them. Sensation as if eye were hanging by a string or torn. Nearobjects seem distant, while yawning. Letters appear smaller. Swelling around the eyes.

Ears - Earache, shooting pain in Eustachian tube. Aching extending to throat. Itching in ears from allergies. Otitis media. Discharge of pus from the ear. Hardness of hearing.

Nose - Fluent coryza with headache, cough and hoarseness. Way/ever (Euphr., Sabad., Psor.). Allergies every August. Spring coryza. Nose drips. Acrid discharge, when singing. Sneezing, especially when entering a warm room. Constant sneezing with profuse acrid coryza. Burning and smarting in the nose. Burning pain in edges of nose and lips. Profuse watery discharge with sneezing. Acrid burning discharge. Nasal discharge excoriating the nose and upper lip. Feeling of a lump at root of nose. Coryza, headache, cough and hoarseness. Copious acrid watery discharge from nose, with bland watering of eyes. Polyps. Nosebleed. Sinusitis. Sensitive to odors of flowers and the skin of peaches. Nose stopped, nasal voice. Common colds becomes laryngitis.

Face - Thread-like pains in face. Paralysis of left half of face, also in limbs of same side. Facial neuritis. Food - Thirst. Canine hunger. Appetite, increased or diminished. Strong craving for raw onions, cannot take any other nourishment.

Mouth - Bad odor from the mouth and throat.

Throat - Hoarseness. Sensation as of a lump in the throat. Tickling in larynx. Expectoration of a lumpy mucus through the posterior sinuses. Sensation as if larynx is split and torn. Pain in throat extending to the ear. COMMENTS - Coryza with frequent sneezing and profuse acrid discharge, corroding upper lip and nose. Lachrymation, also profuse, but bland (Euphr. is the reverse). The action of All-c. seems to be primarily in the nose (Euphr., in the eyes). Allium Cepa is irritating discharge with burning and itching, from a cold, flu, allergies and hay fever. The nose, the back of the throat, the palate and the throat are itching and burning. A keynote is that the upper lip is red and irritated. Frequent sneezing (Ars.), with discharge. Strong symptoms from the nose, profuse sneezing (Nat-m.). Another keynote is itching in the back of the throat that drips into the larynx and causes hoarseness and change of voice. Burning in the larynx and voice box. Allergic asthma. A hay fever that was suppressed with antihistamines that went into the lungs (Ars., lod.). Nash found it particularly useful in children when the profuse coryza or cold extended to the bronchial s with much mucus coughing and rattling of mucus. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Am. - toothache. Cham. - abdominal pains. Roasted coffee will remove onion breath. Compare: (1) Euphr., Wye., Sabad., Arundo, All-s. (2) Aeon., Puls., Gels. (3) Nux-v. - coryza recurring in August. (4) Verat. - colic with despondency. (5) Thuj. - offensive breath and diarrhea after eating on. ions. (6) Lach. - left to right. (7) Calen.. Hyper.neuritis, amputation pain. Complementary: Phos., Puls., Sars., Ther., Thuj. Incompatible: All-s., Aloe, Scilla. Followed by: Calc, and Sil. in polyps. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Nash. Murphy.

Stomach - Sour belching. Nausea, coming from stomach up the throat into the fauces. Weak, empty feeling in stomach. Pressure in stomach. Pain in region of pylorus.

Abdomen - Rumbling offensive flatus. Pains in left hypogastrium. Colic sitting, moving about. Very offensive flatus. Belching with rumbling and puffing up of the abdomen. Violent cutting pain in the left lower abdomen, with frequent desire to urinate. Pains in liver region. Abdomen distended, rumbling, urging, and finally diarrhea.

Rectum - Diarrhea after midnight and in the morning. Flatus very offensive. Hemor rhoids, tearing, jerking pains in anus. Stitches in the rectum. Cracks at the anus. Itching at the anus. Worms.

Back - Intense pain in ñapé of neck. Pain under right shoulder blade. Chills run down the back with frequent urination, followed by heat and thirst. Causations - Damp cold wind, weather causes colds and toothache. Colds of spring, hay fever of August, epidemics of spasmodic cough in autumn. Wet feet. Eating spoiled fish, cucumbers, salads. Injuries. Shooting pains after surgical operations. Constitutions - Especially adapted to phlegmatic patients. Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Limbs - Joints feel lame. Panaritium. Painful disorders of the fingers about the nails, red streaks running up the arm. Limbs, especially arms feel sore and tired. Neuralgia of stump. Bad effects from getting feet wet. Ulcers when skin is rubbed off by the shoes especially on the heels. Sore feet from long walking. Lungs - Hacking cough on inhaling cold air. Acute bronchitis. Oppressed breathing from pressure in middle of chest. Constricted feeling in region of epiglottis. Violent catarrhal laryngitis, the hoarse cough seemed to split and tear the larynx. Much sneezing and coughing.

Sleep - Yawning in deep sleep or with headache and drowsiness and cramp in stomach. Wakes at 2 a.m. Gaping in deep sleep. Dreams of being near water, of battles, precipices, deep wells, of storms, high waves, Annoying dreams in convalescents.

Skin - Redness, nettle rash, measles, scarlatina, when the complaints are characterized by the coryza symptoms. Prickling as from pins. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Red streaks running up arm. Felon after childbirth.

Modalities - Better in open air. Better cold room. Better bathing. Better motion. Worse in a warm room. Worse damp weather. Worse spring. Worse wet feet. Worse afternoon and evening. Worse lying down. Worse singing. Rest aggravates, feels better from motion.

Kidneys - Sensation of weakness in bladder and urethra. Frequent and copious urination. Increased secretion of urine with coryza. Strangury after wet feet. Dribbling of urine in elderly people. Urine red, with much urging and burning in urethra.

Temperature - Fever with rumbling in the abdomen, coryza, and thirst. Flitting heat over whole body, and thirst. Coldness alternates with heat during catarrh. Sweats easily and copiously.

name: Allium Sativum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from sitting bent. Worse from change of temperature. Worse pressure. Worse drinking bad water. Worse gluttony. Walking aggravates pains in limbs. Every step causes excruciating pain in intestines. Worse in evening and night. Worse in morning on waking..
