PHARMACY - alum-p. Aluminum phos- phorica. Aluminum phosphate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Boils. Bronchitis. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Hair, loss. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hyperventilation. Ingrowing, toenails. Leucorrhea. Lung, disorders. Mental, prostration. Migraines. Osteoporosis. Paralysis. Petechia. Rickets. Shocks. Somnambulism. Strokes. Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Burning pains. Feeling of numbness and cobwebs. Constriction. Discharges watery, scanty, acrid. Dryness. Hemorrhages of bright red blood. Cerebral hemorrhage. Paralysis, ascending. Onesided paralysis from hemiplegia. Shocks. Weakness and nervousness. Diabetes. Strong desire for the open air which relieves. Sensitive to cold which aggravates. Sensitive to thunderstorms. Bruised, burning, pressing pains, worse morning and night. Electric shocks, worse after sleep. Boils on nates and thighs. Ingrowing toenails. Standing is extremely tiresome. Extreme thirst, except during fever. MIND - Mental prostration. Confusion of mind. Apathetic. Extreme weariness. Irritable. Suited to mental breakdown after overwork or overstudy. Mental exertion aggravates. Chronic effects of grief. Nervous and anxious. Worse from thinking of their symptoms. Easily frightened. Fear of being alone. Fearofdark. Fear of thunderstorms. Fearof twilight. Fear of future, disease. Fear of death of family and friends. Fear of knives, blood. Fearof insanity. Fearof own impulses. Fears comes and goes suddenly. Ailments from mental work. Anxiety and perspiration. Nervous, restless. Hurried. Discontented. Timid, yielding. Complaining, moaning and groaning. Slow to act and answer. Apathetic and depressed. Mental confusion. Lamenting over imaginary misfortune. Suicidal. Alternating moods. Excitement alternates with dullness. Abundant ideas, clearness of mind, alternates with deficiency of ideas. Indifference alternates with excitement. Ailments from sexual excesses. Weeping in morning on waking (Alum.). Frequent crying.

Head - Pain in sidesofhead. Migraines. Loss of hair. Headache after sleep. Headache, worse warm room. Pain in occiput. Pain in sides. One sided headaches. Pressing pain, worse pressure. Pressing pain in occiput at night (Sulph.). Pressing pain in temples at night.

Ears - Ears hot and red. Sensation of flapping in ears.

Nose - Nasal discharge, green. Pain, worse pressure. Lost of smell.

Face - Face sickly, bluish red. Sensation of white of egg dried on it.

Mouth - Mouth dry. Breath offensive, even putrid.

Stomach - Vomiting worse drinking. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning, on closing eyes. Vertigo, falling, worse closing eyes. Vertigo tendency to fall forwards. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Alum., Sil., Alum-sil. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Rectum - Diarrhea. Constipation, dry, hard stools, no urging or great urging. Stool has to be removed by artificial means. Green stools. Hard, tough and greasy stools (Caust.). Knotty stool.

Female - Excoriating leucorrhea. Menses too early, short. Menses profuse. Menses pale blood. Tiredness after menses. Food - Extreme thirst. Aversion to warm food. Aversion to meat, fish, oysters. Aversion to beer, salt. Aversion to cold drinks, cold food. Aversion to milk, potatoes, tobacco. Desires dry food, rice, starch. Desires coffee, spices. Desires fish, salt. Desires fruit, sour foods. Better warm drinks. Worse from potatoes, milk. Worse from artificial food. Worse warm food, warm drinks. Worse cold drinks, cold food. Worse from tobacco. Worse alcohol.

Chest - Pain after herpes zoster. Palpitations of heart after menses.

Limbs - Bone problems. Growing pains. Rickets. Osteoporosis. Tingling fingertips. Weakness of thighs. Weakness of knees. Lungs - Lung disorders. Hyperventilation. Bronchitis. Asthma. Tuberculosis.

Sleep - Sleeping on right side, amel. Short sleep. Somnambulism. Worse on waking. Dreams of death. Dreams of falling. Dreams of robbers.

Skin - Itching eruptions worse warm room (Sep.). Dry, peeling skin. Rough skin with cracks. Itching, scratching until it bleeds. Petechia. Loss of hair.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better pressure. Better lying on left side. Better damp weather. Worse from cold. Worse motion. Worse from jar, walking, stepping. Worse from lying. Worse standing. Worse from sexual excess. Worse from mental exertion. Worse from thinking of symptoms. Worse dry weather. Worse 9 a.m. and 9 p.m. Worse winter.

Bladder - Ineffectual, fruitless, urging at night. Frequent urination at night.

Perspiration - Perspiration little or none.

PHARMACY - alum-sil. Aluminum silicata. Alumina silicate. Kaolin. Chinese clay. Porcelain clay. Bolus alba. Andalusite rock. Alumina 63, Silica 37 parts. Kaolin is disintegrated Fei spar. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Brain, disorders. Chest, soreness. Convulsions. Croup. Diphtheria. Lead poisoning. Nose, soreness. Spinal disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to J. Landes- mann, Alum-sil. is a remedy for croup and bronchitis. Aegidi was the first to use Alum-sil. in cases of croup. In old-school practice it was used “as a completely inert powder" in the same way as fuller's earth and also as a basis for making pills. Alum-sil. is a deep acting remedy for chronic complaints of brain, spinal cord and nerves. Weakness, especially spinal. Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness, pain in all limbs. Constriction, of orifices. Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness and pain in all limbs. Epileptiform convulsions. Coldness during pains. Venous distention. Croup in the lower portion of the larynx or upper part of the trachea, which may be recognized by the much more laboring and sawing respiration.

Head - Congestion of brain. Constriction of scalp. Pain in head, better heat, perspires. Pain in forehead. Pain in eyes, flickering. Frequent coryza. Swelling and ulceration of nose.

Nose - Itching and burning. Yellow discharge. Sore, scabby, stopped up. Nostrils feel sore, scabs form in nose, scanty and blood-streaked secretion.

Throat - Membranous covering of left side of throat of right side. COMMENTS - Landesmann confirmed its efficacy and related a case as an example. After Aeon., Hep., Spong., Bor.. Phos. and lod. had failed to relieve, Alum-sil. 6c, four or five globules every half-hour, rapidly removed the laboring, sawing respiration and the child was out of danger. According to Farrington, a leading indication is internal soreness along trachea and the upper part of the chest, the child will not be touched. The use appears to be from the clinical side entirely. Alum-sil. 30c relieved symptoms of lead poisoning in a case of Clarke's. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Alum., Sil., Kali-bi., Spong., lod.. Hep., Aeon. (2) Fuller's Earth. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Chest - Excessive soreness along trachea and chest. Soreness, cannot stand percussion. Catarrh of chest, pain, raw feeling. Feeling of great weakness in chest. Stitching pains.

Limbs - Heaviness, jerking, numbness, aching and pains. Lungs - Spasmodic cough with purulent viscid expectoration. Gray sputa. Capillary bronchitis. Larynx and chest sore. Membranous croup, extends down trachea. Husky voice, metallic, rasping breathing and suffocative cough. Lungs - Croup dipping down into trachea, heavy, labored, sawing respiration.

Skin - Dryness of skin. Formication along course of nerves, veins feel full and distended. Sore to touch and pressure.

Modalities - Better warmth. Better fasting. Better resting in bed. Worse cold air. Worse after eating. Worse standing. Worse towards evening. Worse in the night.

author: Murphy

keynote: PHARMACY - succ. Amber. Fossil resin. Succinum purum. Amber oil. (A mineralized fossil resin not to be confused with Ambergris, Ambra). Trituration. Solution of the non-recti- fied oil prepared by dry distillation of Amber. Solution of Succinic acid. Historical dose: All…
full:
PHARMACY - succ. Amber. Fossil resin. Succinum purum. Amber oil. (A mineralized fossil resin not to be confused with Ambergris, Ambra). Trituration. Solution of the non-recti- fied oil prepared by dry distillation of Amber. Solution of Succinic acid. Historical dose: All potencies. Drop doses of the oil.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Fears. Globus. Hayfever. Hiccough. Hysteria. Leucocythemia splenica. Spleen disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - The fossil resin known as Amber has been used in folk medicine by many cultures. Dr. Morris Weiner tested Amber, which he prepared himself from Amber, by dry distillation. The fumes of the crude acid, he said, are inflammable and produce asthma, cough, sneezing, weeping, dropping of watery mucus from nostrils, pain in chest and headache. On this indication he treated thirty persons suffering from hay fever, and cured them all, saving them the necessity of making an annual exodus. He gave one or two grains of the 3x trituration of Amber diluted in twelve teaspoonfuls of water, a teaspoonful every two hours. Burnett wrote in Diseases of Spleen, that the Amber non-rectified oil is used as an organ remedy in spleen affections, especially when accompanied by nervous and hysterical phenomena. Burnett noted it for hysterical convulsions in women. The crude oil is a thick, brown liquid having a strong empyreumatic odor. It is a powerful local irritant and has been used with success as such in lumbago, rheumatism and sciatica. Amber produces many nervous and hysterical symptoms. Asthma. Fear of trains and closed places. Affections of spleen. Symptoms of collapse, the patient aborted, but recovered. Heaviness externally. Lassitude. Lie down, desire to. Pulse slow. Trembling externally. Twitching. Weakness, daytime afternoon. Weakness after walking. MIND- Absorbed mentally. Dullness of mind. Stupefaction. Concentration difficult. Forgetful. Feels constantly as if he had forgotten, something. Memory, weakness. Mistakes in time, confounds the present with past. Disoriented. Abstraction of mind. Confusion of mind. Confusion as to sexual identity. Confusion, knows not where he is. Confusion of past and present. Confusion, as if in a dream. Speech slow. Expressing oneself difficult. Mood, alternating. Anger. Offended easily. Averse to being disturbed. Aversion to company, yet fear of being alone. Irritability from conversation. Irritability from noise. Dictatorial. Contemptuous. Hatred of men. Wants to fight. Censorious. Attempts to escape. Suspicious. Fastidious. Sadness after midnight, amel. Desires to attack others. Loathing, of life. Grief. Unfortunate, feels. Sadness from disappointed love. Lovesick. Sentimental. Homesickness. Forsaken feeling. Helplessness. Estranged feelings. Sensation of being isolated. Despair of life. Weary of life. Suicidal thoughts. Pities herself. Weeping easily. Weeping from menopause. Weeping during menses, during regrets. Weeping from sickness. Weeping when telling of her. Answers in monosyllable. Aversion to answering. Indisposed to talk others. Anxiety in daytime, morning. Panic attacks with feelings of electricity. Starting startled. Frightened easily. Fear of conscience. Fear of color black. Fear of everything. Fear of dark. Fear of death. Fear from flying in airplane. Fear in insanity. Fear of narrow places. Fear of trains and closed places. Fear of shadows. Want of self-confidence. Excitement, excitable. Restlessness. Conviction of death. Desires death, Sensation as if dying. Aversion to the color black. Charmed by orange purple. Contented with himself. Impressionable. Senses acute. Sensitive to all mental impressions. Sensitive to external impressions. Sensitive to music. Sensitive to noise. Sensitive to reprimands and criticism. Sensitive to reproaches. Sensitive to rudeness. Desire to frighten others. Gossiping. Haughty. Desire to hide. Reproaches himself. Hysteria. Impatience. Indifference. Sensation as if she could easily injure herself. Intolerance. Introspection. Jesting. Desire for sunlight. Full of cares. Cautious. Remorse. Childish behavior. Coquettish. Aversion to men. Aversion to conversation. Thinking of complaints aggravates. Aversion to certain persons. Aversion to being touched. Aversion to washing. Serious. Ardent. Religious affections. Thoughts intrude of the past. Tormented thoughts. Time, appears slower. Clairvoyance. Affectionate. Amorous disposition. Veneration for the sun. Singing. Shuns the foolishness of men. Delusions, she is beautiful. Delusions, things look beautiful. Delusions, has lost affection of friends. Delusions, impression of division, between himself and others. Delusions, put him into a fury, rage. Delusions sees black objects. Delusions, everything seems unreal. Delusions, surrounded by enemies. Delusions, as if just waking from adream. Wrong, everything seems. Coma, unconsciousness. Delusions, she would fall if she did not hold onto something. Delusions, has neglected his duty.

Head - Headaches. Congestion of head. Constriction, forehead vertex. Formication, vertex. Heat in occiput, temples. Heaviness sensation of forehead. Numbness. Headache, better after eating. Headaches from fasting. Headache above the eyes. Headaches from cold air. Pulsating in temples. Headaches, worse light. Headaches better lying, pressure. Itching.

Eyes - Unable to keep the eyes fixed steadily. Granular. Heaviness sensation. Itching from cats, with lachrymation. Lachrymation, daytime. Lachrymation in cold air. Lachrymation when laughing. Opening the eyelids difficult. Burning pain when looking at the fire. Pressing pain left eye. Stinging pain. Sharp pain, left eye. Photophobia. Pupils, contracted. Desire to rub eyes. Styes. Swollen, lids. Twitching, around eyebrows left. Weak eyes.

Ears - Sensation of fullness. Heat, flushes. Itching. Pain, behind the ear, touch aggravates. Inside sore. Stopped up. Hearing. Acute.

Nose - Coryza. Nasal congestion. Discharge, copious watery. Dryness. Itching, inside. Own body odor agreeable. Nasal obstruction. Pressing, rawness pain. Sinusitis. Tingling, tip of nose. Sneezing, dropping of watery mucus from nostrils.

Face - Discoloration, red. Expression, old looking. Itching. Numbness. Pain, jaw left pulsating, jaw left. Tension, jaw left. Twitching eyes, below. Twitching corners of mouth. Wrinkled skin.

Mouth - Bleeding, gums when cleaning them. Dryness in mouth. Neuralgic pain in gums. Salivation. Taste, acrid.

Throat - Choking sensation. Burning pain, rawness sore, left side. Globus. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo on closing, eyes. Vertigo, tendency to fall. Vertigo, as if intoxicated. Vertigo, lying down, necessary. Vertigo, with nausea. Vertigo, on rising from seat. Vertigo from stooping. Vertigo as if rocking. Vertigo with swaying. Vertigo turning in bed. Vertigo on washing hair. Vision - Dim vision, alternating with bright. Blurred vision. Bright vision. Flickering vision, around outside range of vision. Foggy vision. Weak vision. COMMENTS - Amber enters into the composition of “Roche's Embrocation,” and “Haarlem Oil,” and has a popular reputation as a remedy for whooping cough when rubbed into the spine night and morning. A tablespoonful dose, said Murrell, caused persistent vomiting, diarrhea and symptoms of collapse and the patient aborted. These observations are of value in relation to Burnett's experience. He added half a scruple of Amber oil to six ounces of Acornwater. They do not mix chemically, but by shaking each time a dose is taken the required division and potency is attained. Burnett's keynote is “painful spleen disorders where there are convulsive attacks ■ such as the hysterical and hypochondriacal often have.” Burnett related in his book a most remarkable case of “chronic enlargement of the spleen with hyperesthesia, head pain, Dyspnea orthopnea, convulsions” in a young lady “towards the end of her teens.” After years of treatment, Burnett concluded from Rademacher's account of Amber oil. that it might provide the remedy. Amber oil was given in five-drop doses three times a day. In forty-eight hours the convulsive attacks ceased for good and all the phenomena slowly leucocythemia. A keynote of Burnett's is “Fear of trains and close places.” His dose is five drops of Amber oil three times a day. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Succinic acid. - Hay fever. Paroxysmal sneezing, dropping of watery mucus from nostrils, asthma. Inflammation through respiratory tract, causing asthma, chest pains, etc., itching of eyelids and canthi and nose worse drafts. (2) Ars-i., Arundo, Wye., Sabad, Sinapis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Cramping pain, eating amel. Dull pain. Persistent hiccough. Belching. Fullness after eating, ever so little hunger, during. Heartburn after sugar. Indigestion. Fasting, amel. Lying down, amel. Nausea on waking. Nausea on eating. Nausea, daytime, morning. Nausea after eating. Nausea after amel. Violent vomiting.

Abdomen - Flatulence. Gurgling. Rumbling. Cramping pain, must bend double. Cramping pain before menses. Hypochondria. dragging, bearing down pain. Eruptions, itching. Trembling.

Rectum - Diarrhea, daytime. Diarrhea after eating. Painless diarrhea. Brown stools, like chocolate. Light colored stools. Mushy stools. Orange stools. Thin stools. Watery stools.

Male - Formication of genitalia. Masturbation, disposition. Aching pain in testes. Sexual desire, increased in morning.

Female - Menses copious. Menopause, during lying amel. Frequent late menses. Menses painful protracted. Metrorrhagia during menopause. Aphthae, vagina. Heat, flushes during menopause. Sexual desire, increased. Weakness during menses. Food - Appetite, diminished easy satiety. Appetite, wanting with headache. Desires fruits. Desires sweets.

Chest - Pains in chest. Constriction in chest. Pain in sternum during cough. Sore bruised pain in ribs, left side.

Back - Itching. Backache, motion amel., stretching amel. Backache, turning head agg. Aching pain in cervical region. Lumbar region sore and bruised. Stiffness. Neck pain, sides. Neck stiffness. Back weakness after walking.

Limbs - Awkwardness, lower limbs. Coldness. Electrical current sensation. Formication of legs. Heaviness sensation. Itching of shoulder hand, back of legs, feet. Jerking. Numbness. Pain, Wandering, shifting pains in left shoulder, while walking. Aching pain. Cramping pain in shoulder. Sore bruised pains. Stiffness of joints, shoulders, arms, hands. Tension in shoulders. Trembling of limbs. Twitching. Weakness, limbs. Lungs - Asthma. Asthmatic from contact with cats. Congestion of lungs. Deep desire to breathe. Difficult breathing in daytime, morning. Difficult breathing, lying amel. Difficult breathing, after walking. Chronic bronchitis. Incipient tuberculosis. Whoop- ing cough.

Sleep - Disturbed. Sleepiness daytime lying, inclination to lying down. Sleeplessness, midnight, after. Waking night, midnight after, 4 a.m. Anxiety, as from early frequent.

Skin - Formication. Itching. Sensitive.

Modalities - Better open air. Desire for open air. Aversion to bathing. Worse air, draft. Worse food, alcohol. Worse fats. Worse spices. Worsesweets.Worsecloudy weather. Mental symptoms, worse before or during menses.

Teeth - Pain left side. Filled tooth, in a. Upper teeth, right molar. Left molar. Wisdom teeth. Neuralgic pain, left side. Pulsating. Sore.

Bladder - Frequent urination at night. Urine burning.

Cough - Dry cough. Hard cough. Tight cough. Cough, worse, from smoke, tobacco. Dreams - Nightmares. Frightful dreams. Dreams of monsters. Amorous dreams. Animal dreams. Awake while dreaming. Dreams of old friends. Dreams of being late. Dreams of being pursued. Dreams of being lost. Dreams of death and decay.

Temperature - Chilly. Lack of vital heat. Coldness of neck.

author: Murphy

Worse embarrassment, agitation, worry. Worse thinking of problems. Worse in morning. Worse from over lifting. Worse warmth, warm room, warm milk..

full:
PHARMACY - ambr. Ambra grísea. Ambergris. Morbid secretion of the whale. Trimration and tincture. Most probably a morbid product found in the Sperm Whale or floating in the sea. Not to be confounded with Amber Suc- cinum. Historical dose: Trimration, Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anus, irritation. Asthma. Bashfulness. Brain, softening. Cardiac asthma. Convulsions. Coughs. Deafness. Emaciation. Face, pimples. Forgetful. Hearing, impaired. Hypertension. Hysteria. Jaundice. Melancholy. Menstrual, irregularity. Music, intolerance. Nervousness. Nosebleed. Nymphomania. Prurims vulvae. Puerperal convulsions. Ranula. Reaction defective. Spleen, pain. Tympanites. Vertigo. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ambr. produces faintness (Mosch.), nervousness, jerks and twitches. Reflex action is increased. In old age, helpful for asthma and colds. Ambr. affects the nerves, causing nervousness, twitches and jerks. A great remedy for the elderly people with impairment of all functions. Weakness, coldness and numbness, usually of single parts, fingers, arms, etc. Also for patients weakened by age or overwork, who are anemic and sleepless. Emaciation. Weakness of upper parts of the body with trembling of lower part. There is defective reaction in nervous patients. Sensation of icy coldness in abdomen. Extreme nervous hypertension. Patients are worn out, yet over-impressionable. Music aggravates symptoms. External numbness of whole body in the morning and weakness. Symptoms suddenly change places. Onesided complaints call for it. Numbness and torpor of the whole body especially in the morning. Coldness of the body with twitching. Tearing in muscles and joints often on one side. Adapted to hysterical subjectsorthose suffering from spinal irritation with convulsive cough, belching, etc. Coughs are worse when many people are present. Slight or unusual things aggravates the breathing and the heart, start the menses etc. MIND - The patient has an embarrassed feelings. Bashful state is very characteristic. Intensely shy, blushes easily. Cannot do anything in presence of others. Embarrassed in company, cannot have others present during urination and stool (Nat-m.). The memory is impaired, slow comprehension. Forgetful. Awkward. Dread of people and desire to be alone. Dwells upon unpleasant things. Melancholy, sits for days weeping. Dreamy. Time passes slowly. Thinking difficult in the morning with old people. Cannot understand what one reads. Music causes weeping and trembling. Sad. Despair, loathing of life. Fantastic illusions. Bashful, blushes easily. Loss of love of life. Restless, excited, very loquacious. Hearing others talk or talking himself affects him. Aversion to laughter. As if in a dream. Flitting, flighty talker, modem society girls. Jumping from one subject to another, never waiting to have first question answered. Fixed disagreeable fancies. Imagines diabolic faces, sights.

Head - Pressure on front part of head with mental depression. Tearing pain in upper half of brain. Brain, feels loose, falls to side lain on. Softening of brain. Rush of blood to head, when listening to music. Hearing impaired. Profuse bleeding from teeth. Hair falls out. Confusion in occiput, also sprained feeling in. Headache worse blowing nose.

Eyes - Stitching in the eyelids as if a stye were being formed. Eyelids, heavy, cannot open them though awake. Spots float before the eyes after sewing.

Ears - Hardness of hearing with cold sensation in abdomen. Deaf in one, roaring and whistling in the other.

Nose - Nosebleed, while washing face in the morning, during menses. Stoppage mostly at night, must breathe through the mouth, with chronic coryza.

Face - Twitching of the facial muscles. Cramps in lips, lips hot. Left cheek red. Flushes of the face, jaundiced color. Embarrassed look. Tetanus, lockjaw in newborn.

Mouth - Profuse bleeding from the gums, offensive breath. Insipid or rancid taste. Sour mouth, worse after milk. Salivation with cough. Small growths under tongue. Ranula.

Throat - Sensation as if a plug in throat with difficulty swallowing. Sore, raw from exposure to air, worse motion of tongue. Vertigo - Senile vertigo with weakness in head and stomach. Senile dizziness. COMMENTS - The pelvic organs are painfully influenced. There is voluptuous itching on the scrotum and some rawness below the thighs in the male. In the female, there is a discharge of blood between the periods at every little accident, as straining at stool or extra work. Severe itching on pudenda. During urination, itching, tickling, burning of vulva and urethra.Nymphomania with discharge of bluish white mucus. After childbirth, obstinate constipation and tenesmus with bashfulness, cannot make the attempt to stool if any one is present, even the nurse. There is a tickling, spasmodic cough. Cough excited by speaking. Night cough. Cough followed by copious belching. Itching in chest. The limbs go to sleep easily. Fingernails are brittle. Sweat on slightest exertion. Sleepless from worry, retires tired, wakeful as soon as touches pillows. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Coff., Nux-v., Puls., Staph. Antidote to: Staph. - especially the voluptuous itching of scrotum, Nux-v. Follows well: Moschus frequently follows advantageously. Compare: ( 1 ) Ol-suc. - hiccough. (2) Sumb., Cast., Asaf., Croc., Lil- t. (3) Moschus (faintness, hysteric asthma), (4) Castor., Asaf., Psor. and Valer, (defective reaction), (5) Coca (bashfulness), (6) Kali- br.. Nux-v. (increased reflexes), (7) Nux-v. (thin, nervous persons), (8) Ars. - Asthma, Phos. - asthma, nervous excitability, “irritable weakness,’" slender build, (9) Bov. - flow of blood between the periods. (10) Lach, and Sep. - worse from over lifting. (11) Coff., Chin., Ign., Sulph., Puls., Staph., (12) Sec. - scrawny women. Related remedies: Bar-c, Ign. Do not confound with Amber succinum. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Distention of stomach and abdomen after midnight. Sensation of coldness in abdomen. After eating, cough and gasping, and a feeling as if food did not go down into the stomach. Belching with a violent, convulsive cough. Acid belching like heartburn. Heartburn from drinking milk.

Abdomen - Flatulence. Incarcerated flatus. Tension and inflation of the abdomen, principally after eating and drinking. Sensation of coldness in the abdomen. Sweat on abdomen and thighs. Pressive pain in the epigastrium. Heaviness in the belly. Cutting pains with diarrhea. Pain in the spleen, as if something were tom off. Flatulent colic in the night.

Rectum - Flatulence, cannot have others present during urination and stool, worse during pregnancy. Constipation during pregnancy and after delivery. Frequent ineffectual urging for stool. Large flow of blood with stools. Sensations - Sensation of coldness, numbness in spots or of single parts, fingers, arms etc. with twitching. Itching with trembling and flushing. General pulsation.

Male - Voluptuous excitement of and itching in genitals. Voluptuous itching of scrotum. Parts externally numb, burn internally. Violent erections without voluptuous sensations. Impotence.

Female - The sexual desire is increased. Nymphomania. Itching of pudendum with soreness and swelling. Menses too early and too profuse. Itching in labia. Profuse, bluish leucorrhea, worse at night. Discharge of blood between periods, at every little incident, worse after hard stools, walking a little longer etc. Lying down aggravates uterine symptoms. Food - Thirstlessness. Want of appetite.

Chest - Oppression felt in the chest and between the scapulae. Sensation of rawness in the chest. Itching in the chest and in the thyroid gland. Rheumatic pain, as from a bmise in the chest. Constitutions - Suited to excitable, nervous children. Young, modem society girls. Nervous persons. Lean persons. Elderly people with a nervous and bilious temperament. “Dried-up” nervous persons. “Thin, scrawny women.” Hysterical subjects who are weakened by age and overwork to the elderly with impairment of all functions.

Heart - Palpitation with pressure in chest as if from a lump lodged there or as if the chest were obstructed. Conscious of the pulse. Palpations in open air with pale face. Anxiety in heart.

Back - Pressive, drawing pain in the neck and back. Heaviness in the back, with pain in the belly, as if the intestines were compressed. Shooting pain in the loins. Stiffness in the loins after sitting long. Causations - Shock due to business failure or due to the deaths, one after another, in the family. Effects of domestic shock, business worry. Loss of near relatives. Imaginations.

Limbs - Cramps in hands and fingers, worse grasping anything. Arms, numbness. Left leg becomes quite blue during menses. Twitching of limbs with coldness of body during sleep. Cramps in legs and calves. Limbs go to sleep easily. Finger nails brittle. Drops what one is carrying. Coldness of hand (left) with headache. Sore and raw between thighs.

Sleep - Retires tired, wakeful as soon as touches the pillow. Cannot sleep from worry, must get up. Anxious dreams. Coldness of body and twitching of limbs during sleep.

Skin - Itching and soreness, especially around genitals. Numbness of skin.

Modalities - Better slow motion. Better in open air. Better lying on painful parts. Better cold drinks. Worse music. Worse presence of others. Worse from any unusual thing. Worse embarrassment, agitation, worry. Worse thinking of problems. Worse in morning. Worse from over lifting. Worse warmth, warm room, warm milk.

Liver - Aching in small spot in the region of the liver, better pressure. Liver pains, pressive. Lungs - Asthma of elderly people and of children. Asthma with eructation of gas. Asthma when attempting sex. Wheezing in the chest. Nervous spasmodic cough with hoarseness and eructation, on waking in morning. Worse in presence of people. Hollow, spasmodic and barking cough, coming from deep in chest, then eructation. Tickling in throat, larynx and trachea, chest oppressed, gets out of breath when coughing. Choking when hawking up phlegm. Bluish, white expectoration. Cough worse music, talking, reading aloud, lifting weight. Loss of breath from cough. Cough with emaciation.

Kidneys - Cannot pass urine in presence of others. Pain in bladder and rectum at the same time. Burning in orifice of urethra and anus. Feeling in urethra as if a few two drops passed out. Burning and itching in urethra while urinating. Urine turbid, even during emission, forming a brown sediment. Urinates more than drinks. Urine sour during whooping cough. Burning, smarting, itching in vulva during urination.

Temperature - Frequent flushes of heat at short intervals. Sweat on slightest exertion especially on abdomen and thighs.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Colds. Coryza. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Hay fever. Itching. Lachrymation. Nasal, congestion. Nosebleed. Sinus, congestion. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ambrosia is a remedy for lachrymation, hay fever and intolerable itching of the eyelids (Euphr.). Nosebleeds. Stuffed feeling in nose and head. Some forms of whooping cough. The respiratory tract in its entire length stopped up. Hay fever with itching, watery eyes. Sneezing to the point of nosebleeds. Hay fever with a tickling cough, can go into asthma. Allergic asthma. Severe allergies to ragweed. Reactions to allergy shots or drops for ragweed allergy. Also as a preventative, given before ragweed season, if person has a strong history. Good for children with nondescript stuffy noses and no symptoms or modalities (Aeon.). Manyforms of diarrhea, especially during summer months, also dysentery. Loose stool (Ars.).

Eyes - Redness. Smart and burn. Hay fever with itching, watery eyes. Lachrymation. Intolerable itching of eyelids. Lungs - Respiratory tract is congested. Irritation of trachea and bronchial tubes with asthmatic attacks (Aral., Eucal.). Wheezy cough. Whooping cough.

Nose - Nasal, congestion. Allergies. Coryza. Watery coryza, sneezing, watery discharge. Hay fever. Sinus, congestion. Nosebleed. Stuffed up feeling of nose and head.

Rectum - Loose stool (Ars.). Many forms of diarrhea. Summer diarrhea. Dysentery. COMMENTS - The fresh leaves and flowers are pounded to a pulp and macerated with two parts by weight of alcohol. In the 1889 Homeopathic Recorder, Dr. C. F. Millspaugh, wrote “Of late years much attention has been called to the species of the genus Ambrosia (the Rag Weeds) as being, through the agency of their pollen, the cause of hay fever.” Dr. E. T. Marsh and another experimenter suffered severely from symptoms of coryza and hay» fever while working with the pollen of this plant. Ambrosia should therefore be of service in similar disorders. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In hay fever: All-c., Euphr., Sabad. (2) Wye., Succ-ac.. Ars-i., Arund. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

full:
PHARMACY - ameth. Amethyst. Gemstone. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Ataxia. Backaches. Headaches. Insomnia. Migraines. Tinnitus. Trembling.

HOMEOPATHIC - Affects the nervous and endocrine systems, useful in states of nervous tension where the five senses (especially hearing) are overtaxed. Helpful when the hormonal system is affected by excessive adrenalin, creating mood swings and nervous excitation followed by exhaustion. Profoundly affects sleep patterns, can soothe troubled sleep or induce somnolence in the insomniac. Has been found effective in easing mental disorders where there is too much excitement of the senses. Nervous tension with an inability to relax. For damaged nerves in the spinal column, especially where the neural pathways are interrupted causing difficulties in relaying sensations or when nerve pains become all consuming, causing the patient to be unable to function normally. Internal trembling, especially felt in the legs. When exhaustion has set in and nerves no longer respond as efficiently as they should. In low potency, follows well after Mag. Carb. For those who feel the need of stimulants to revive them or to “steady their nerves,” bringing them to the point of addictiveness. Addiction rooted in nervous tension and psychic fears. Fear of addiction. Deeply syphilitic. Nervous diseases such as motor neuron disease, MS and ataxia. Likely to make an improvement on the quality of life in patients suffering these conditions. Arthritic conditions. MIND - Anxiety and tension. Fear of not being able to achieve all that one sets out to do. Lack of confidence in ability to complete allotted tasks, especially true in those who feel called to a spiritual or caring profession. Sense of thwarted mission where the difficulties seem to be self generated and self perpetuated. Sense of having “done all this before and now I'm getting it wrong again!” Too tired to be able to finish tasks or fulfill role properly due to excessive tension (Oak.). Negative outlook. Becomes withdrawn and intense when anxious or displeased. Apprehensive of his own position in a general state of difficulty where others are involved. Wonders what will become of him. Tries but finds it difficult not to betray his inner sense of preoccupation and unease. Deeply affected by sad news. Inexplicable fearfulness, held in the solar plexus. Fears of being overburdened, of becoming too anxious and fixated on one thing to the exclusion of everything else, and of the past and what may come back to influence the present. Deep sense of longing, particularly in connection with places which make one feel spiritually “at home.” In cases where one would expect to find despair but instead there is deep pathology. Difficulty relaxing. Tense and miserable from lack of sleep, nervous tics or tremors from night watching. Indecisive, forgetful, cannot hold many ideas in the mind at the same time so becomes limited to routine functioning. Feels cut off from the real world, floats off into a state of dreaminess. Reluctant to face reality, especially after great tension.

Abdomen - Trembling in the abdomen.

Back - Backaches. Pains in cervical area which extend down the spine, worse emotional turmoil. Tension in the lumbar region with sciatic type pains in either leg. Feels the top half of the spine (or body) is unconnected with the bottom half. Persistent symptoms after manipulative treatment on the spine. Patient enjoys massage and goes for a lot of it but it never holds for long.

Bladder - Tendency to frequent urination. Has to get up at night to pass water, especially worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Cannot drink late at night without having to rise. Must hurry to pass water once the urging is there. Needs to be advised to drink more water as this will ease the tension in the bladder and slow the frequency of urging.

HOMEOPATHIC - The heartbeats too strong, worse lying on left side. Great accumulations of mucus. There are many rheumatic pains in the limbs and loins. Marked sensitiveness to cold, worse in cold weather. Stitches were prominent in the provings. Stitches in the cecum at 7 p.m., alternating with pains elsewhere. Appendicitis. Diminished secretions from the mucus membranes, then increased. A remedy for the elderly and feeble, especially in chronic bronchitis. Stars and fiery points before the sight. Sees smoke in circles. Dim sight from a blow on the head, from excessive reading. Sensation of burning and scratching in neck and esophagus. Hydrocele. Hemorrhages that causes abundant serous discharges. Dropsical complaints. Gout not developing tn usual form of attacks, but disturbing general health. Scrofulous tumors or enlarged joints. MIND - Ill humor. Constitutions - Suited to bronchial disorders in old people brought on by cold weather.

Head - Catarrhal headache due to closure of frontal sinuses.

Eyes - Dim sight. Stars and fiery points float before eyes. Easily fatigued from reading. Food - Want of appetite.

Throat - Throat dry, worse inhaling fresh air. Full feeling, burning and scraping sensation. Immediately after eating, sensation as if something stuck in esophagus, causing swallowing. RELATIONS-Antidotes: Bry., Am. Compare: (1) Senega., Ant-t., Bals-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Heart - Heartbeats stronger, extends to pit of stomach. Lungs - Coarse rattling of chest in elderly people. Difficult breathing. Chronic bronchial catarrh. Large accumulation of pus and feeble expectoration, worse from cold weather. Mucus tough and hard.

Increased warmth in abdomen in the skin, especially of face. Heaviness in the head.” “Bathed in sweat” is a leading indication. It causes profuse flow of urine, said to contain sugar. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Face - Bloated, swollen eyelids. Swelling under tongue like granula.

HOMEOPATHIC - This salt has been well proved by A. M. Cushing. Nervous constitutions. Markedly affects the eyes and ovaries. In the morning, the eyes are red and sore with mucus in comers (worse left eye). Dull pain in left ovary, with hard swelling. Obesity. Indicated in laryngeal and pharyngeal catarrh. Chronic laryngeal catarrh of speakers. Sudden strangling, suffocating, cough. Suffocating sensation before epilepsy. Irritable feeling in fingernails, better by biting it. Constrictive pain in head, chest, legs.

Head - Cerebral congestion. Feeling of a band above ears. Sneezing, thick nasal discharge. Lungs - Sudden, short cough, strangling. Tickling in trachea and bronchial tubes. Wakes at 3 a.m. with cough. Feels suffocated, continuous cough, when lying down at night, sharp pain in lungs. Whooping cough. Dry, spasmodic cough on lying down.

Eyes - Edges of lids red and swollen, also Meibomian glands. Eyeballs feel large. Pain around eyes into head.

Throat - Smarting in mouth. Tickling in throat with inclination to dry, spasmodic cough, especially at night. Burning in fauces. White, sticky mucus. Chronic speakers' catarrh. COMMENTS - The mucus of Am-br. is apt to be stringy. A sudden desire to cough, so sudden it causes strangling. Sudden, short cough when rising in morning from accumulation of mucus in throat. Cough at 3 a.m. Indicated in epilepsy when the aura begins with a fainting or suffocating sensation at epigastrium, rising up both sides of sternum to throat. There is an irritable feeling under fingernails, better only by biting them. Must walk about for fear of suffocation. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hyos., Con., Arg-n., Kali-bi. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Modalities - Better from warmth and warm drinks. Worse in open air. Worse cold air. Many symptoms occur on waking. Worse 3 a.m.

full:
PHARMACY - am-c. Ammonium carbonicum. Ammonia carbonate. Sal volatile. Sesqui carbonate of Ammonia. Solution in distilled water. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphonia. Chills. Cyanosis. Esophagitis. Exhaustion. Hemorrhages. Fainting. Nephritis. Rheumatism. Sloughing of tissue. Snakebites. Thirst. Thrombosis. Timidity. Ulcerations. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of caustic ammonia closely resemble those of the carbonate. The caustic nature of the drug is exemplified in the burning sensations experienced, especially in the throat, gullet and rectum. Am-caust. is a powerful heart stimulant. In a case of poisoning in a man who took a mouthful of a strong solution of “household ammonia” by mistake, there was great swelling of mucus membrane of mouth and throat. Stertorous breathing, voice muffled and husky, later, cough with bloodstained expectoration. One night there was headache and delirium and at the same time the urine contained albumen and hyaline casts. Am-caust. is for fainting, thrombosis, hemorrhage, snakebites, chloroform narcosis, may be given by inhalation. The edema and ulceration of mucus membranes produced by this powerful drug have been utilized as guiding symptoms for its use, hence in membranous croup with burning in esophagus. A good remedy in aphonia, weak voice low. Speech broken. Aphonia with debility or with burning rawness in throat. Great oppression of breathing, the patient gasps for breath. Excessive exhaustion and muscular debility. Shivering with chills. Rheumatism of shoulders and thighs muscles, hemorrhages occur from mucus surfaces. White patches on tongue and inner side of cheeks. Intense thirst and violent ejection of stomach contents. MIND - Timidity, great tendency to take fright. Great excitement in evening. Food - Worse after eating or drinking.

Head - Obstinate headache. Headache with nausea. Pulsating forehead, better pressure and in a warm room. Shocks, through head, eyes, ears and nose, on biting. Violent headache. Full, bursting pain in forehead. Brain seems loose. Hammering, pressure, and beatings in the head. Headache, as if from carbonic acid gas. Soreness of the scalp and of the hair. Itching in the head. Falling off of the hair.

Eyes - Burning of eyes with aversion to light. Eye strain (Nat-m.). Burning and dry. Prolonged use of eyes cause asthenopia with appearance of yellow spots on looking at white objects. Flood of tears. Large black spots float after sewing. Pain in the eyes better afternoon sleep. Sore canthi.

Ears - Hardness of hearing. Shocks through ears, eyes and nose, when gnashing teeth. Itching above the ears, spreads over the whole body.

Nose - Nasal diphtheria with burning excoriating discharge.

Face - Boils and pustules during menses. Corners of the mouth are sore, cracked and burn. Cracks and burning in lip. Hard swelling of the cheek.

Mouth - Great dryness of mouth and throat. Vesicles on tongue. Taste sour, metallic. Cracking of jaws on chewing. Tender, bleeding gums. Mouth and throat dry. Vesicles on tongue. Burning, hindering eating and speech. Swelling inside cheek.

Throat - Loss of voice. Burning rawness in throat. Spasm of the glottis with suffocation, patient gasps for breath. Pain in esophagus on breathing deeply. Scraping and burning in throat and esophagus. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Am-c., Caust. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Pain at the pit of stomach with heartburn, nausea, water brash and chilliness. Flatulent dyspepsia. Great appetite, but easy satisfaction.

Abdomen - Flatulent, painful colic. Flatulent hernia. Colic with pain between the scapulae. Pain in the abdomen, with diarrhea. Spasmodic colic with nausea, and accumulation of water in the mouth. Noise and pain in abdomen.

Rectum - Constipation with hard, dry stools. Stools difficult, hard and knotty. Bleeding hemorrhoids, worse during menses. Itching at anus. Protruding hemorrhoids worse after stools or without stools, better lying, cannot walk. Discharge of blood before and after stools. Dark acrid diarrhea.

Male - Itching and pain of scrotum and spermatic cords. Persistent erections without desire or violent sexual desire without erection. Seminal emissions, frequent after sex.

Female - Itching, swelling and burning of pudendum. Copious leucorrhea, burning, acrid, watery. Aversion to the other sex. Irritation of clitoris. Menses toofrequent, profuse, early, copious, clotted, black, colicky pains and hard, difficult stool with fatigue, especially of thighs, yawning and chilliness. Cholera-like symptoms with menses. Menses flow more at night, then dyspnea or weakness. Food - Continual thirst, no appetite, excepting for bread and cold food. Great hunger and appetite, yet a small quantity satiates. Unconquerable appetite for sugar.

Chest - Shootings in the chest and in the sides. Feeling of fatigue in the chest. Congestion towards the chest. Heaviness in the chest, as from congestion of blood to the chest. Burning in the chest. Constitutions - Adapted to overweight patients with weak hearts, wheezing and a suffocated feeling. Suited to scrofulous children, stout and sedentary women. Women who are always having recourse to the smelling- bottle. Most of the carbonates are suited to states of obesity.

Heart - Heart weakness, collapse, wakes with difficult breathing and palpitations. Audible palpitation with fear, cold sweat, lachrymation inability to speak, loud breathing and trembling hands. Angina pectoris. Circulation becomes sluggish and under-oxygenation of blood produces lividity, weakness and drowsiness. Vitality becomes low, lack of reaction.

Back - Pains in the lumbar region and pains in the nape of the neck. Painful swelling of the glands of the neck and of the axillary glands. Goiter. Drawing tension in the back and in the loins.

Limbs - Rheumatism of shoulders. Skin hot and dry. Lungs - Difficult breathing. Accumulation of mucus with incessant coughing. Uvula covered with white mucus.

Sleep - Sleepiness during the day. Starts from sleep, strangling. The sooner one goes to bed the better one sleeps.

Skin - Red or mottled skin. Erysipelas in the elderly with brain symptoms. Malignant scarlatina. Violent itching and burning blisters. Scarlet rash. Miliary rash. Faintly developed eruptions from defective vitality. Eczema in the bends of limbs, between legs, about anus and genitals.

Modalities - Better from pressure. Better lying on painful side right side, abdomen, and on stomach. Better in dry weather. Better eating. Worse cold, cloudy days. Worse damp cold, wet weather. Worse open air. Worse evenings. Worse new moon. Worse from applications. Worse washing. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse during menses. Worse falling asleep. Worse motion. Worse chewing, pressing teeth. Worse bending down.

Teeth - Loose or blunt teeth. Toothache during menses. Pressing teeth together sends shocks through head, eyes and ears.

Liver - Pressure, pain as from excoriation and burning in the hepatic region. Piercing shootings in the liver, when seated in the evening. Lungs - Increasing difficulty in breathing, it wakes him, better cool air. Hoarseness. Chest feels tired. Emphysema. Much oppression in breathing, worse after any effort and entering warm room or ascending even a few steps. Asthenic pneumonia. Slow labored, stertorous breathing, bubbling sounds. Winter catarrh with slimy sputum and specks of blood. Pulmonary edema. Rattling in chest but gets up little. Cough every morning about three o'clock with dyspnea, palpitation, burning in chest, worse ascending. Cough after influ- enza. Congestion of lungs. Expectoration of pure blood after cough.

Kidneys - Frequent desire, involuntary at night. Involuntary urination towards morning. Tenesmus of bladder. Urine, white, bloody, sandy, copious, turbid and fetid.

Blood - Hemorrhages are dark and thin. Hemorrhagic diathesis from fluidity of blood and dissolution of red blood corpuscles, tendency to gangrenous ulcerations. Hemorrhages are dark from nose, gums and bowels. Causations - Ill effects of charcoal fumes. Nosebleed comes on when washing the face.

Temperature - Coldness. Burning heat with thirst.

name: Ammonium Iodatum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air. Better rapid motion. Better walking crooked. Head and chest worse morning. Abdominal symptoms worse afternoons. The skin, limbs and fever worse evenings. Worse walking erect. Worse periodically. Worse night. Worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m..

CLINICAL - Anosmia. Bronchitis. Colds. Constipation. Coryza. Cough. Diarrhea. Eyes, inflammation. Fatty tumors. Feet, pains.…
full:
PHARMACY - am-m. Ammonium muriaticum. Ammonium chloride. Sal ammoniac. Tritura- tion on aqueous solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anosmia. Bronchitis. Colds. Constipation. Coryza. Cough. Diarrhea. Eyes, inflammation. Fatty tumors. Feet, pains. Glands, enlarged. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Liver, disorders. Melancholy. Menstruation, disorders during. Obesity. Pneumonia. Sciatica. Scurvy. Spleen, pains. Sprains. Stumps, neuralgia. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, swelling. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Am-m. is less prominently a right-side medicine than Am-c., Guernsey regarded it as rather left-sided. Both cause paralytic weakness, both are worse in open air. Am-m. has better from warm bath. Am- c. has greater sensibility to cold and to damp weather than the muriate. Both have itching eruptions of all kinds, drowsiness by day with indolence, shivering in the evening. Am-m. affects mucus membranes increasing the secretion in the lungs and gallbladder ducts. Am-c. has fat all over. Fatty tumors. Large buttocks. Obesity. Body fat but the legs are thin. A state of prostration bordering on a typhoid state is produced by this remedy. Tendency to irregular circulation, blood seems to be in constant turmoil, pulsations. Many symptoms are accompanied by cough or profuse glairy mucus discharges with liver trouble. It causes ulceration and ulcerative pains, also dislocation-like pains and tension as if tendons were contracted. Boiling sensation. Many groups of symptoms are accompanied by cough, profuse glairy secretions. Am-m. causes ulceration and ulcerative or festering pain. Neuralgic pains in the stumps of amputated limbs. Hemorrhages. Boiling sensation. Tension and tightness, as if the muscles or tendons are too short in groins, hamstrings, lumbar region etc. MEND - The mental state is very similar to Am- c. The muriate has perhaps more melancholy and disposition to tears than the other and it has, peculiar to itself, “antipathy to certain persons.” Fear of darkness (Stram.), which is not noted under Am-c. Am-m. covers the consequences of grief. Desire to cry, but cannot (Nat-m.). Melancholy and apprehensive, as from internal grief. Involuntary, aversion to certain persons (Nat-c.).

Head - Brain paralysis. Hair falls out with itchiness and dandruff. Feels full, compressed, worse mornings. Heaviness in the forehead, pressive pain towards the root of the nose with a sensation, as if brain were torn.

Eyes - Mist before eyes in bright light. Optical illusions in incipient cataract, capsular cataract. Flying spots, yellow spots, before the eyes.

Nose - Sneezing. Loss of smell. Free acrid, hot watery discharge corroding the lip and closing one nostril. Obstructed, stuffy feeling, constant and unavailing efforts to blow it out. Nose sore to touch, ulcerative pain in nostrils. As of a rough body, obstructing upper sinuses. Sneezing aroused her from sleep with shooting pain in the nape of the neck as far as the shoulders. Coryza in children with bluish discharge. Itching.

Face - Inflammatory face ache. Mouth and lips sore and excoriated. Pale. Lips burning like fire. Lips dry, shriveled cracked, must moisten them with tongue. Burning eruptions, better cold application.

Mouth - Slimy. Burning blisters on tip of tongue.

Throat - Tonsillitis. Throbbing in and swelling of tonsils, can scarcely swallow. Sore spot behind uvula, relieved by eating. Internal and external swelling of throat with viscid phlegm. So tough, it cannot be hawked up. Slimy. COMMENTS - Am-m. acts specially also on the forehead. The muriate has fullness in head, weight in forehead. Burning in eyes in twilight or in morning with photophobia. Keratitis. Ulceration in corners of mouth. Sensation in stomach as if fasting, which nevertheless feels full, worse after breakfast. Intermittent pains in both hypochondria. Stitches and burning in liver region. Stitches in spleen, worse sitting. Tension in either groin. Shootings in scapula and ice-cold sensation between scapulae, unrelieved by external wraps. In the fever, chilliness predominates. Choudhury cured with it a case of intermittent fever characterized by absence of thirst in all stages. Constipation and hemorrhoids with bleeding at stool. Sore, smarting hem- orrhoids. Hard stool covered with mucus, mucus secretions generally increased. Menses too early and too copious (Am-c.), with pains in loins. Vomiting, diarrhea and neuralgic pains in feet during period. Coryza, acrid, watery, scalding hot with cold feeling between shoulders. Loss of smell. Cough and asthmatic symptom worse evening and at night and worse in open air. Pain as from ulceration at fingertips. Neuralgic pains in stumps of amputated limbs (All-c.). Ulcerative pains in heels (ulcers from friction All-c.). Sciatic pain as if tendons were too short. Worse sitting or walking. Tension in legs on lying. There is improvement when walking crooked, worse on walking erect. Most symptoms are worse at night and from two to four a.m. RELATIONS - Antidotes to: Bitter almonds, Coffea, Nux-v., Caust. A hot bath relieves aggravation caused by Am-m. Compare: I 1) Cale., Caust., Seneg. (2) Mag-m, Nat-m., Valer, and Mur-ac. - pains in feet and heels. (3) Rhus-t. - sprains, worse sitting. (4) Seneg. - fat people. (5) Sep., Sulph. - in “aversion to darkness.” (6) Calc., Carb-an., Stront., Valer., and Stram. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Regurgitation of food. Nausea with bitter water brash, worse eating with shuddering. Gnawing burning, stitching in stomach, extending to right axilla and upper arm. Empty sensation in, but no desire to eat anything. Epigastric pain immediately after eating. Cancer of stomach. Stricture of esophagus.

Abdomen - Stitches in spleen, while eating or in the morning, with difficult breathing. Pain around navel. Abdominal symptoms appear during pregnancy. Excessive fatty deposit around abdomen. Much flatus. Tense sprained feeling in groins, must walk bent. Groins feel swollen and sore.

Rectum - Burning, smarting in the rectum during and for hours after stools. Itching hemorrhoids, soreness with pustules. Stinging in perineum. Hemorrhoids after suppressed leucorrhea. Scanty, hard, crumbly stool or covered with glairy mucus, changing color and consistency. Green mucus stools alternate with constipation. Blood from anus or diarrhea during menses.

Female - Menses, too early, too free, dark, clotted. Menses flow more at night. Prolapsed uterus. Pain as if sprained in left side of abdomen during pregnancy. Diarrhea, greenish mucus stools and navel pain during menses. Diarrhea, vomiting with menses. Leucorrhea like white of an egg (Alum., Bor., Calc-p.), with pain about the navel. Brown, slimy leucorrhea after every urination. Food - Loss of appetite and thirstless- ness. Sometimes extreme thirst, mostly evenings. Thirsty for lemonade. Want of appetite alternating with canine hunger.

Chest - Oppression of chest. Pulsation, burning spots in chest. Constitutions - Adapted to obese and sluggish patients who have respiratory troubles. Adapted to patients who are overweight, puffy and tired with thin limbs, who always feel tired and sore.

Back - Swollen cervical glands. Sore sprain or icy coldness between scapulae, not relieved by warmth. Fatty swelling on nape, extending from ear to ear. Lumbago. Backache, as if in a vise when sitting. Bruise pain in coccyx when sitting. Causations - Grief.

Limbs - Chronic sprains. Pain as from ulceration in fingertips. Shooting and tearing in fingertips and toes. Ulcerative pain in heels, fingertips. Contraction of hamstring tendons. Hamstrings as if too short, pain on walking. Sciatica, worse left, sitting, better lying. Neuralgic pain in amputated limbs. Tense sprained feeling in the groins, must walk bent. Offensive sweaty feet. Pain in feet during menses. Large buttocks.

Sleep - Erotic dreams. Anxious, fearful dreams. Starts out of sleep.

Skin - Itching on various parts of the body, especially in the evening. Blisters on various parts. Intense burning better cold applications. Bleeding eruptions. Peeling of skin between fingers and wrists. Profuse night sweat. Sweats by every motion.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better rapid motion. Better walking crooked. Head and chest worse morning. Abdominal symptoms worse afternoons. The skin, limbs and fever worse evenings. Worse walking erect. Worse periodically. Worse night. Worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m.

Liver - Chronic congestion of liver. Cough with liver symptoms. Lungs - Hoarseness and burning in larynx. Dry, hacking, scraping cough, worse lying on back or right side. Stitches in chest. Cough with p rofuse salivation or with liver symptoms. Cough loose in afternoon with profuse expectoration and rattling of mucus. Lungs - Cannot breathe from coughing. Scanty secretions. Noisy, rattling tenacious mucus in chest. Cough worse lying on back or right side.

Kidneys - Profuse and frequent urination. Urging yet a few drops pass, until next stool when it flows freely. Profuse ammoniacal smelling urine.

Temperature - Chilly as often as he wakes. Chilliness in evenings after lying down and on waking, without thirst. Prevailing fever. Heat in palms and soles. Sub-acute, low fevers due to unhealthy climate.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allen said Am-p. has been used with success in some cases of facial paralysis. This salt has been used in cases of chronic gout with nodes of urate of soda on the joints. For chronic gouty patients, uric acid diathesis. Bronchitis. Nodosities of the joints of the fingers and backs of the hands. Facial paralysis. Pain in shoulder joint. Tightness around chest. Heaviness of limbs, unsteady tottering gait. Coldness from least draft of air.

Head - Sneezing with excessive running from nose and eyes, only in morning.

Kidneys - Rose-colored sediment. Lungs - Deep rough cough with greenish expectoration. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

PHARMACY - am-pic. Ammonium picricum. Ammonia picrate. Picric acid and its combinations are very powerful medicinal substances of the nitric acid group. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies, third trituration.

full:
PHARMACY - am-pic. Ammonium picricum. Ammonia picrate. Picric acid and its combinations are very powerful medicinal substances of the nitric acid group. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies, third trituration.

CLINICAL - Bilious headache. Periodical neuralgia. Vertigo. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Am-pic. is intensely bitter and, like Pic-ac. and other picrates, has a strong action on the liver. Hale commended Ammonium picricum in congestion of brain and spinal cord. Heavy, pressive pains in occiput and mastoid region, on sides of head to temples and eyes. Periodic bilious headache (Sang., Cimic.). Occipital headache (Am-pic.), proceeding down the spine and also a pain traveling the reverse way. Neuralgia. Face darkly flushed. Mind obtuse, disinclined to labor. Malarial fever. Whooping cough. Head - Periodical neuralgia in right side of occiput, boring extends to ear orbit and jaw. Periodic bilious headaches (Sang.). Vertigo - Vertigo on rising. COMMENTS - Hale noted a case he cured with Am-pic. It concerned a middle-aged woman, short, stout, florid, who, every six or eight days, would wake in the morning with violent pain in occipital region, heaviness of head, and vertigo on rising. Pain, worse on getting up, extended over sides of head to temples and eyes. In the afternoon, she had nausea and vomiting of sour bilious matter. Another case concerned a doctor who had been thrown from his carriage and injured about the back of his head. He seemed more frightened than hurt. In a few days, however, he noticed that on turning in bed or stooping or on any sudden motion he would be seized with a “wild feeling” in the occiput, trembling beating of heart with intermission and great alarm. Am-pic. completely relieved him after other medicines had been given in vain. Allen noted the indication “Periodical neuralgia in right side of occiput, boring extending to the ear orbit and jaw' vertigo on rising, especially in irregular menstruation.” Clarke gave great relief with Pic-ac. in a case of spinal paresis in which a pain rising up the spine into the head was complained. Clarke thought it was the Pic-ac. element in this ammonia salt that accounts for its action in these cases of Hale's. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hale.

HOMEOPATHIC - Amniotic fluid is a clear, or limpid, yellowish-white fluid with flocculates. Alkaline or neutral reaction. May contain lanugo, or epidermal cells. May contain pepsin, diatase, fibrinase and anti staphylolysin. Hypotonic. Composition is similar to blood serum, urea 18.25 mg%,uric acid 4.51 mg.%, chlorides 5.93 mg%, creatine 2.33 mg%, CO2,34.77 vol.%. Source of the organ of secretion is not known. Its role is supportive, and also probably nutritive, it surrounds the embryo. The provings, published by P. Schmidt in The Journal of the American Institute of Homeopathy, 20:236- 248,1927, consisted of 7 provers and used “one dose of liquor amnii 30c.” Schmidt noted that “This remedy seems to act essentially on the head, abdomen and the menstrual periods. It seems to suit better the feminine temperament.” MIND - Increased mental activity. Tends to overwork, industrious. Mania for work. Irritability. Restlessness, nervousness. Abdomen - Pain in abdomen.

Head - One-sided headaches. Pains in sides of head.

Female - Menstrual disorders.

Sleep - Disturbed sleep. Restless during sleep. Tossing about in the bed. COMMENTS - Hering related a case of a soldier who, while carrying a wounded comrade, was struck by a spent bullet in the epigastrium. He became pale and weak, “felt the wind knocked out of him” and laid down. A drop of Liquor ammon. in water relieved at once. REFERENCES - Schmidt.

PHARMACY - amor-r. Amorphophallus rivieri. Chinese umbel. N. O. Spaciflora order and the Araceae family. The tincture is made from the stem, the flower and the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cancer, uterine. Cholera morbus. Dysmenorrhea. Headaches. Infantile, cholera. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Metritis. Metrorrhagia. Typhoid fever.

HERBAL - Amor-r. is an herbaceous plant, growing from 30 to 60 cm high. The starchy rhizome is edible, dried or roasted. This plant flowers only once every seven years, although the cycle may vary in a greenhouse. The whole plant is regarded as medicinal.

HOMEOPATHIC - The proving was the work of Dr. Proceso Sanchez Ortega of Mexico. The provings report weight loss, morbid hunger, bodily swelling and puffiness, and loss of ability to copulate. Repulsive appear- ance, general puffiness and the stupefied look of enervation. Feeling of exhaustion, apathy. General discomfort with extreme exhaustion. General uneasiness, extreme weariness. Feels ill, needs to remain in bed. Feverish with intestinal colic. Burning sensation of the orifices and in the throat with numbness of the limbs. Gastric and intestinal complaints with tiring diarrhea. Female genital complaints with difficult, painful menses and purulent leucorrhea. Burning sensation in the female genitals. Acute or chronic salpingitis. MIND - Looks bewildered, dazed, exhausted. Total indifference and apathy. Semi-conscious state, does not react. Anxiety and fear.

Head - Persistent frontal headache, spreading at first to the right temple and then the left. Head pains by day in the morning and afternoon. Periodic head pains, every eight days and throughout the day until bed-time.

Eyes - Sight weak.

Stomach - Burning in the stomach, causing great discomfort. Heaviness of the stomach when eating, which disappears after three to four hours. Nausea, especially on waking, ameliorated by nourishment. Nausea at the sight of food. Acidity after introducing food to the stomach. Vertigo - Slight vertigo, especially while walking and the sensation of walking crookedly. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ars. - Prostration, violent vomiting after drinking, diarrhea with burning, black stools, excoriation around the anus. Painful menses with black blood and burning, putrid, corrosive leucorrhea. (2) Verat. - Prostration and feeling of coldness, vomiting and diarrhea, painful menses. (3) Camphora - State of collapse, feeling of general cracking, cannot bear to be covered, even though the body may be ice-cold. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Intestinal rumbling.

Rectum - Normal stools or diarrhea, coffee-colored, preceded by abdominal pains. Diarrhea every two hours with tenesmus, fatigue and weakness.

Female - Burning sensation in the vagina and cervix. Painful menstruation with pains in the sacrum and lumbar region, feeling of exhaustion and flow of dark blood. The menses is prolonged, with the blood decomposed, greenish and irritating. Fetid leucorrhea with a greenish, purulent appearance. Irritating leucorrhea with discharge of thick pus. Inflammation of the Bartholin glands. Metritis before menopause, with profuse menstruation and metrorrhagia. Uterine cancer. Food - Intense thirst. Discomfort during naps, although the food had settled. Cannot bear alcoholic drinks.

Modalities - Better from nourishment. Worse from alcoholic drinks.

name: Ampelopsis Quinquefolia
author: Murphy
constitution: Cholera. Dropsy. Hoarseness. Hydrocele. Kidney, dropsies. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - ampe-qu. Ampélopsis quinquefolia. Virginia creeper. American Ivy. Vitis quinquefolia. N. O. Vitacae.Tinctureofplant. Decoction of chopped inner bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

full:

CLINICAL - Cholera. Dropsy. Hoarseness. Hydrocele. Kidney, dropsies. Vomiting.

HERBAL - S. M. Worthington cured with it kidney dropsies that had resisted other treatment and a case of hydrocele. He found the decoction to be the best preparation.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ourknowledgeof Ampe- qu. is due to observations on two children poisoned by chewing the leaves. They were quickly seized with violent vomiting and purging with considerable tenesmus, then collapse, sweating and faint pulse, then deep sleep for two hours from which they were aroused by the return of the vomiting and purging. Pupils were dilated for hours after commencement of attack. Hansen gave as an indication: “Chronic hoarseness in patients who were scrofulous in their youth.” Kidney dropsies, hydrocele and chronic hoarseness in scrofulous patients have been benefited by this drug. Cholera symptoms. Generally worse about 6 p.m. Dilated pupils. Left coastal region sore and sensitive. Elbow joint pains, back sore. Soreness of all limbs. Vomiting, purging with tenesmus. Rumbling in abdomen. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - amph. Amphisbaena vermicularis. Lizard. N. O. Lacertilia. Snake-like lizard without limbs. The jaw containing the poison is removed and triturated. Historical dose: Trituration, Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Constipation. Cramps. Debility. Depression. Headache. Hernia. Jaw, pains. Toothache.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mure is the authority for its effects. It is prepared from the jaw as well as the poison of the animal and has symptoms indicating action on bone like that of Silica. Amph. acts markedly on the jaws, causing swelling and pain, especially in the right jaw, worse by air and dampness. Many kinds of severe headache, pains are frequent. Eruptions of vesicles and pimples. Right-sided action. Generally aggravated from motion. MIND - Boredom. Depression. Tender sadness, which disposes one to be gentle and meek. Sadness and lassitude in the morning. Impatience.

Head - Horrible headache with sensation as if the feet were in the brain. Weight in the forehead and parietal regions. Repeated beating at the right side of the forehead, as if hailstones fell upon it. Lancination and pain all through the right side of the head. Sweat about the head.

Eyes - Weariness of the eye in the evening, with pain and pricking when looking at the light. Constriction of the right eye, as if strung together with a cord. Sensation as of a grain of sand in the right eye. Constant twitching at the upper eyelids, especially the left. Pain at the inner canthus of the right eye, as if a stye would form. Shooting pain in the left eye. Lachrymation and constriction of the left eye.

Ears - Pain in the meatus, as if air were rushing in.

Face - Prickling and heat at the right malar eminence. Painful and large pimple on the left side of upper lip, suppurating. Pains in the right lower jaw and considerable swelling, aggravated by air and dampness. Dull pain in the right lower jawbone.

Mouth - The teeth feel elongated and set on edge, especially the right lower molars. Toothache is worse in the afternoon and evening. Chewing is painful, but not the contact of liquids.

Throat - Swelling of tonsils. Swallowing is difficult, cannot swallow saliva. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if one would fall towards one side and is then impelled towards the opposite side by a contrary oscillation. Dizziness when turning around. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hecla lava, Heloderma, Silica. REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

Stomach - Chilliness and pains at the epigastrium.

Abdomen - Protrusion of umbilical hernia. Tearing pain at the navel, all day. Lancination in the navel, as from a stiletto. Suppuration of inguinal hernia. The hernia is painful and air is felt in it.

Rectum - Constipation.

Back - Violent pain in the whole of the vertebral column, worse when walking, moving the arms or stooping.

Limbs - Breaking out of little pimples, especially on the forearm. Painful swelling of the arm. Painless drawing up of the legs. Cramp in the left leg, it remains behind in walking, as if paralyzed.

Sleep - Wakes at midnight for ten consecutive nights. Disturbed sleep.

Skin - Acute acne rosacea. Painful and large pimples on the left side of the upper lip, suppurating. The miliary acne rosacea spreads over the chest, neck and back with itching. Breaking out of little pimples, especially on the forearm. Gradually, a white vesicle forms on pimples. Pimples discharge a clear serum after which the eruption dries up.

Modalities - Better from evening. Better from itching the eruption. Worse in morning. Worse walking. Worse turning around. Worse itching the eruption. Worse toothache. Worse pains in lower jaw. Worse weariness of the eyes. Worse from sadness or lassitude.

name: Amygdalus Amara Aqua
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma, Coma, Diphtheria. Epilepsy. Headache. Syncope. Tetanus. Urticaria.
keynote: PHARMACY - amyg-am. Amygdalus amara aqua. Bitter almond. Amygdalus communis amara. N. O. Rosacae. An ounce of alcohol is added to a pound of bitter almonds, then six pounds of water are added and distilled down to three pounds. Hydrocyanic acid is formed by the action of water…
full:
PHARMACY - amyg-am. Amygdalus amara aqua. Bitter almond. Amygdalus communis amara. N. O. Rosacae. An ounce of alcohol is added to a pound of bitter almonds, then six pounds of water are added and distilled down to three pounds. Hydrocyanic acid is formed by the action of water on the amygdaloids. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma, Coma, Diphtheria. Epilepsy. Headache. Syncope. Tetanus. Urticaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Amyg- am. are not very distinguishable from those of Hydrocyanic acid. Jerking, hesitating, stuttering speech. Dark red palate and fauces. Swallowing impossible. Vomiting of undigested food and bile. Cough with soreness of chest extending down to stomach. Stitches under left nipple, going deep in, making exhalations more difficult. Convulsive and at intervals very short respiration with fear of suffocation. Heaviness in forehead (Laur.). Head drawn backward. Congestion of vessels of brain and general effusion on both hemispheres, dura matter gorged. Opisthotonos. Dullness of left half of the head (Hydr-ac., right). Venous system gorged with dark liquid blood. Blood, muscles and bile of a violet color. Snoring. Surface cold, clammy, pale or blue. Convulsions. Most violent convulsions, which last almost three-quarters of an hour. The convulsions returned after a quarter of an hour, but less violently. General tetanus. Complete opisthotonos. Excessive languor. General debility from seven bitter almonds. Feeling of weakness, as if the muscular vigor was deficient and he would fall down. Fainting. Syncope. Death in thirty minutes. General malaise. Weight on the eyes and in the limbs. MIND - Mild delirium. The patient stammers incoherently. Appearance of intoxication. She is so much affected that she can hardly utter a word (after four hours). The feelings were deeply affected, she began to weep. Extreme anxiety. Falls down unconscious. Loss of consciousness of voice and of motive power. Senseless. Coma with stertorous respiration and involuntary stool, but she revives suddenly and looks wildly her. Abdomen - Abdomen relaxed, soft, hardly of natural warmth. Pains in abdomen. Colicky pains, which increase, until the abdomen is distended like a balloon.

Head - Heaviness and confusion of head and of thought. Head drawn between shoulders. Violent headache. During the forenoon a sense of heaviness in the forehead. Slightpressure inforehead. Senseof weight and oppression on top of head.

Eyes - Sunken eyes. The eyes are turned upwards. Eyes glassy. Brilliancy of the eyes. Eyes wide open and motionless. Eyes are closed, cold. Spasmodic movements, especially of the eyelids. Upper eyelids convulsed. Eyeballs protruding from their sockets. Eyes open and rolling from side to side. Contracted pupils. Pupils widely dilated and insensible to light. Motionless pupils. Dimness of sight.

Ears - Ears white and cold. Humming in the ears.

Nose - Nose white and cold.

Face - Face becomes deadly pale. Face yellowish-gray and moist. Lips bluish, white and cold. Countenance is very flushed. Spasmodic distortion of the features. Frequent convulsive action of muscles of face and neck. Sardonic laughter, joyful countenance, sparkling eyes.

Mouth - Tongue dry and coated. Mouth tightly closed. Froth at the mouth. Breath smells of bitter almonds.

Throat - Increased discharge of mucus from the larynx. Hoarseness caused by scraping in the larynx. Swallowing is impossible. Burning sensation in throat. Excessive burning heat in laryngo-pharyngeal region. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if gradually passed off by noon. Vertigo in strong air. Vertigo, as if intoxicated, followed by sudden death (from taking many bitter a almonds). COMMENTS - Farrington noted “Very brilliant appearance of the eyes without corresponding mental expression. Eyes drawn to left side. Burning heat in laryngo-pharyngeal region. Sharp pains through tonsils.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Op. - convulsions., strong coffee, cold water poured over head. Compare: (1) Laurocerasus, Hydr-ac., Op. - spasms, stertor, slow pulse, stupor. (2) Stram., Tab., Ant-t. (3) Lach., Naja (heart). REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting of food. Vomiting of a bitter, viscid substance, bile smelling strongly of prussic acid.

Rectum - Copious, but especially watery evacuations. Stool seldom.

Male - Penis shriveled.

Chest - The chest heaved spasmodically and its movements were hurried. Oppression of chest. Several transient stitches and pains.

Heart - Heartbeats very feebly. Beat of heart feeble, sometimes intermittent.

Neck - Swelling and undulatory motion in the jugular veins, the carotids beat quickly and fully.

Limbs - Limbs were completely lax and fell lifeless when lifted. Unsteadiness on the limbs. Upper and lower limbs cold. Could not stand on legs. Formication in the legs with staggering gait. Knees flexed on the abdomen. Heaviness of limbs and whole right thigh. Lungs - Short, painting respiration, suffocative attacks. Breathing stertorous and at long intervals. Breathing slow and gentle. Respiration heavy. Difficult respiration.

Sleep - Yawning with irresistible tendency to sleep. Drowsiness. Inclined to sleep the afternoon. Depression in the afternoon and evening. Inclination to sleep soundly and deeply through the night, difficult to rouse. Deep, stertorous sleep.

Skin - Skin blue and bluish-red, especially on scrotum, where it was blue and almost greenish-yellow. Wheals over the whole skin. Urticaria with fever.

Kidneys - Scanty and painful urination.

Pulse - Pulse strong, frequent and wiry. Pulse at first small, frequent and intermittent, then slow and regular. Pulse slow, vibrating, small, flickering. Diminished pulse, scarcely perceptible.

Temperature - General coldness. Surface cold and clammy.

author: Murphy
