keynote:
PHARMACY - amyg-p. Amygdalus pérsica. Peach tree bark. Pérsica amygdalus. Pérsica vulgaris. N. O., Rosacea, Amygdalae. Fresh infusion or tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Gastric and intestinal irritation. Hemorrhage. Morning sickness. Nausea.…
full:
PHARMACY - amyg-p. Amygdalus pérsica. Peach tree bark. Pérsica amygdalus. Pérsica vulgaris. N. O., Rosacea, Amygdalae. Fresh infusion or tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Gastric and intestinal irritation. Hemorrhage. Morning sickness. Nausea. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Outside the old herbalists, the virtues of the bark and leaves of the peach tree have received little attention. The infusion is made by taking of the bark one part and of boiling distilled water ten parts. Infuse in a covered vessel for one hour and strain. The tincture is made by pounding the fresh bark of the twigs to a pulp and macerating in two parts by weight of alcohol.

HOMEOPATHIC - Amygdalus pérsica is a most valuable remedy in vomiting of various kinds including morning sickness. Constant nausea and vomiting. Irritation of eyes. Ischuria and hematuria. Hemorrhage from the bladder. Gastric irritation of children, no form of food tolerated. Loss of smell and taste. Gastric and intestinal irritation when the tongue is elongated and pointed, tip and edges red. COMMENTS - Dr. Oliver S. Haines of Philadelphia contributed his experience: “Apropos of the remarks made by Dr. C. C. Edson upon the efficacy of infusion of peach bark in the gastric irritability of children, we might mention the following authentic case: “For an adult the dose is five drops and in urgent cases repeat every five to ten minutes until the symptoms subside after which give it at intervals of one to four hours as indicated. “After ten years use I am thoroughly convinced that any physician once giving it a thorough trial will never again be without it Of course, it is not a specific for all “Upheavals of the inner man,” but will I think meet more indications than any other known remedy of its class. “An infant during its second summer, had been much reduced by acute dyspeptic diarrhea. A marked feature of this case was the persistent vomiting of all food. The stomach would tolerate no form of baby food with or without milk. The child's parents had consulted some eminent physicians of our city. The child had been given homeopathic remedies. None of the remedies chosen seemed to produce the desired effect. After a consultation it was deemed best to send the infant to the mountains. The change aggravated its condition. “While the parents hourly expected their baby would die, it was suggested that they send for an old practitioner living in the mountains near at hand. “This man had a local reputation as a saver of dying babies. His prescription was as follows: Two or three fresh peach leaves were to be put in a cup of boiling water, the infant to receive a “drink ” of this infusion at frequent intervals. “The effects of this were remedy as remarkable in this case as in the case narrated by Dr. Edson. Our child soon retained food and eventually recovered. It seems this ancient disciple of Aesculapius had long used peach leaves and regarded them as possessing specific virtues.” Anshutz noted “Dr. C. C. Edson wrote in the Chicago Medical Times. 1890: Some ten years ago I had a little patient whose principal difficulty seemed to be an inability to retain anything whatever upon its stomach. It would vomit up promptly everything I gave it and I had given it everything I had ever heard of and also had eminent council, but it was no go, 1 was literally at my rope's end. “At this juncture an elderly lady neighbor, one of “the good old mothers,” timidly suggested an infusion of peach bark. I started to find the coveted bark, which I was fortunate enough to procure. I prepared an infusion, gave the little patient a few swallows and presto ! the deed was done, the child cured. It tiffs aíítñe indications of the leaves and many more. It fills the indications of hydrocyanic acid, ipecac or any other anti-emetic. It will more frequently allay the vomiting of pregnancy than any remedy 1 have ever tried. And nearly every case of retching or vomiting (except it be reflex) will promptly yield under its use. “In recent cases I have very rarely had to give the second prescription to relieve morning sickness. I was visiting a doctor in Quincy, while there he told me he was afraid he would have either to make a lady abort of let her die from the fact that he had failed to stop her vomiting. I happened to have a sample of the medicine with me, I gave it to him, he took it to the lady and in a few days he reported her well. I may say like Dr. Edson, it is a standard remedy with me. I have found it very useful in hemorrhage from the bladder. “Some of my lady patients find it very good in nervous headache. I have used the tincture prepared from the leaves, but it is far inferior to that prepared from the bark of the young shoots. A medical friend was going to see a lady who had morning sickness, he told me he had thought of advising her to use popcorn, I handed him a small bottle of my Amygdalus and told him to take a couple of ears of corn in his pocket and try both. The next time I met him he said my medicine had done the work.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Amygd. - pains through tonsils, throat dark, difficult swallowing, vomiting, cough with sore chest. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke.

name: Amylenum Nitrosum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air. Better exercise. Better in open air. Better cold water. Worse from menopause. Worse slight causes, emotions. Worse fromheat. Worse closed or warm room..
constitution: Angina pectoris. Anxiety. Blushing. Chorea. Circulation. Convulsions. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Exophthalmos. Flushings. Headaches. Heart, attack. Heart, disorders. Hiccoughs. Hot, flushes. Hypertension. Hysteria. Menopausal, disorders. Palpitations. Seasickness. Sunstroke. Yawning.
keynote:
PHARMACY - aml-n. Amylenum nitrosum. Amyl nitrite. Iso amylnitrite. Dilution with alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anxiety. Blushing. Chorea. Circulation. Convulsions. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Exophthalmos. Flushings. Headaches. Heart, attack.…
full:
PHARMACY - aml-n. Amylenum nitrosum. Amyl nitrite. Iso amylnitrite. Dilution with alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anxiety. Blushing. Chorea. Circulation. Convulsions. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Exophthalmos. Flushings. Headaches. Heart, attack. Heart, disorders. Hiccoughs. Hot, flushes. Hypertension. Hysteria. Menopausal, disorders. Palpitations. Seasickness. Sunstroke. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Nitrite of Amyl was introduced into medicine by the old school as a remedy for angina pectoris and was supposed to act by lessening arterial tension. Vasomotor nerves are affected by Aml-n causing dilatation of all arterioles and capillaries, thereby flushing of face, heat and throbbing in the head are produced. Homeopathic provings have shown that, in some cases at any rate, Aml-n. has a specific action. Also in paroxysms of asthma, chloroform asphyxia inhalation of the Aml-n. will give immediate relief. For this non- homeo- pathic application, two to five minims (put up in pearls) dropped on a handkerchief and inhaled may be required. The most striking action of the drug is the deep facialflushing it causes and the pulsation all over the body. Superficial arterial hyperemia. Palpitations of the heart and similar conditions are readily cured by it. Amy 1- n. is for all conditions where the blood vessels are contracted, as in angina pectoris. Headaches accompanied by cold, pallor, etc. Hiccoughs and yawning. Seasickness. Often relieves temporarily epileptic convulsions. Weak and emaciated. The flushings and other discomforts at menopausal are helped. Hot flashes. Flushing heats, followed by drenching sweats are marked symptoms. Cerebral vessels dilate. Weak, emaciated, walking with tottering gait inclined to go to one side when walking. Rigid muscles of limbs. Child has convulsions. Worse since exposure to the sun, heat stroke, vascular headaches, severe palpitations, and the keynote is a sudden rush of blood to the head with palpitations (Glon.). MIND - Confused feeling after congestion to head. Anxiety, as if something bad might happen, must have fresh air. Anxiety can't sit still. Shrieking before convulsion. Melancholy. Mental confusion and a dreamlike state. Trancelike state, everything seems unreal. Increasing sense of stupefaction. Unconsciousness, inability to swallow.

Head - Bursting sensation in the head and ears. Throbbing in head. Surging of blood to head andface with fiery red face. Sensation as if blood would start through skin with heat and redness. Throbbing. Migraine with pallor, worse left side

Eyes - Exophthalmic goiter from grief. Protruding, starting eyes, conjunctiva injected. Ciliary neuralgia, eye injected, face or cheek suffused. Objects appear pea-green oryellow. Sight blurred, wavering. Aching eyes in sunlight, trembling and wavering of objects, lachrymation and sneezing.

Ears - Throbbing in the ears, bursting, burning. Ears hyperemic.

Face - Easy flushing or blushing of the face, on slightest emotion. Chewing motion of the lower jaw. Smacking of lips as if in act of tasting. Neuralgia of fifth pair of nerves.

Throat - Constriction, collar seems too tight. Choking feeling in the throat. Vertigo - Great confusion of the head, with vertigo and drowsiness. COMMENTS - The specific heart symptoms of Aml-n. are the sensation of swelling of the chest as if convex, with a feeling as if the lower end of the sternum made a deep depression bent in towards the spine. Precordial anxiety. Accelerated intensified beating of the heart. Oppression and tumultuous action. Constriction (relieved by Cact.) and aching pain. Strong, full pulse. Eyes protruding, staring. Exophthalmic goiter from grief. Flushing of face. Flushing on least emotion. Nash has cured “chronic blushing on least excitement mental or physical” with it. Heat, redness, turgidity. Choking feeling, collar feels tight. Tremor and weakness-of limbs. Better open-air exercise, cold water and cold air. Worse in a warm room. Other prominent symptoms include anxiety as if something might happen, and a desire for fresh air. Throbbing in head. Bursting-out feeling in ears. Smacking of lips as if in act of tasting. Munching movement of lowerj aw as if che Wing. Constriction of throat and heart from actual fright ran to window for air. Intense fullness in head, sensation of rushing to vertex. “Impending apoplexy.” Threatened apoplexy. Flushing of the face, heat and throbbing, palpitations. Boericke said, “Flushings followed by sweat at menopausal,” hot flashes with a red face during menopause (Lach). Boericke also notes “chloroform asphyxia,” antidote for chloroform. RELATIONS-Antidotes: Cactus, Stry., Ergot. Compare: (1) Bell., Glon., Lach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy

Stomach - Hot, burning sensation in stomach. Hiccough and yawning with stretching. Nausea with dryness of throat. Crampy pains in epigastrium. Fullness and pressure with belching.

Abdomen - Oppression near liver. Crampy, colicky pains, rumbling.

Female - Hemorrhages after-pains with facial flushing. Menopausal headache and flushes of heat with anxiety and palpitations. Neuralgia during menses. Convulsions immediately after delivery. Food - Loss of appetite.

Chest - Pain and constriction around the heart. Dyspnea and asthmatic feelings. Great oppression and fullness of chest, spasmodic, suffocative cough. Aching backward along the left floating rib. Feeling as if a weight on sternum. Sensation of swelling of front of chest. Constitutions - Nervous, sensitive women and men.

Heart - Aching pain and constriction around the heart. Angina pectoris with great anxiety. Tumultuous action of the heart. Pain and constriction around heart. Fluttering of heart on least excitement. Full, soft pulse. Violent beating of the heart and carotids with sense of constriction. The heart has an irregular, rumbling sort of sound. Precordial pain extending to right arm.

Limbs - Constant stretching for hours. Veins of hands dilated, pulsations felt in fingertips. Lungs - Constriction in throat extended to the chest, with dyspnea and asthmatic feeling in larynx and trachea. Asthma. Hastens and deepens the breathing. Suffocation and cough in paroxysms.

Sleep - Repeated yawning in coma. Yawns profoundly and repeatedly. Stretches almost constantly, it is almost impossible to satisfy the desire. Stretching and yawning with hiccough.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better exercise. Better in open air. Better cold water. Worse from menopause. Worse slight causes, emotions. Worse fromheat. Worse closed or warm room.

Kidneys - Increased quantity of urine increased, with sugar in it.

Blood - Intense surging of blood to face and head, later veins turgid (Bell.). Rapidly dilates arteries and quickens but weakens circulation. Venous and arterial blood are of same hue. Hypertension.

Temperature - Flushings, followed by sweat at menopause, sometimes followed by cold and clammy skin with profuse sweat. Abnormal sweat after influenza. Throbbing throughout whole body.

name: Anacardium Occidentale

keynote:
PHARMACY - anac-oc. Anacardium occidentale. Cashew nut. N. O. Anacardiacae. West Indies. Tincture of the black juice between outer and inner shell. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Blisters. Coms. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Hypochondriasis. Imbecility. Itching.…
full:
PHARMACY - anac-oc. Anacardium occidentale. Cashew nut. N. O. Anacardiacae. West Indies. Tincture of the black juice between outer and inner shell. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Blisters. Coms. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Hypochondriasis. Imbecility. Itching. Melancholy. Ophthalmia. Paralysis. Rhus poisoning. Ringworm. Smallpox. Warts.

HERBAL - The Anac-oc. nut is kidney-shaped, that of Anae, is heart-shaped. The juice has been used locally as an application for coms, warts, hard excrescences, ringworm and obstinate ulcers. Anac-oc. has been applied to the face to remove cuticle and produce a fresher and more youthful appearance. If hands are not washed carefully after handling nuts, they cause itching and painful, burning swellings wherever they touch skin. The effects of the cashew nut are known through instances of poisoning. It acts powerfully on the skin, causing erysipelas, blisters and swelling. It has been used as an antidote to Rhus poisoning. One woman received a swollen face from exposure to fumes when roasting nuts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Anac-oc. causes weakness of memory and mind like Anae. Scirrhus swellings. Hard excrescences. Proud flesh. Tearing pain in left side of head. Burning and itching of ears and face. General paralytic state. Paralysis and imbecility. Tongue painfully swollen. Erysipelas, vesicular facial emptions, anesthetic variety of leprosy, warts, coms, ulcers, cracking of the skin on soles of feet. Itching almost intolerable, umbilicated vesicles as in smallpox. The erysipelas spreads from left to right and it cures erysipelas spreading from right to left, Paralysis with imbecility. MIND - Difficulty with thinking. Did not know his surroundings. Weak memory. Melancholy. Hypochondriasis. Apathy. Loss of will, cannot control voluntary muscles. Paralysis with imbecility.

Head - Head falls forward, difficult to keep it up. Tearing headache on left side.

Eyes - Scrofulous ophthalmia.

Ears - Swelling of ears with burning and itching.

Face - Erysipelas over whole face from applying juice to destroy marks. Swelling of face with itching and burning, next night after handling nuts. Face swollen, features not discernible.

Mouth - Drinks run out of mouth. Aphthae. Cannot speak, only mutters unintelligible sounds. Painfully swollen tongue from handling nuts.

Male - Stimulates sexual desire. Testicles swollen when touched with hands after handling nuts.

Female - When juice is applied during menses, it causes erysipelas of the face. Uterine complaints and dropsy.

Limbs - Large blisters filled with a yellow fluid are raised on hands, followed by desquamation. Warts. Coms.

Skin - Corroding or dry tetters. Red itching spots like nettle rash (Rhus-t.), spreading from left to right. Used as a vesicant, it causes itching and burning, then gradual reddening and swelling, followed by vesicles which become pustular. These are large and flat at first and gradually become confluent and break, the epidermis peels off, but leaves the surface swollen, hyperemic and suppurating for days. Proud flesh. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Rhus-t., Iodine locally. Compare: (1) Anae, orien. (2) Similar to Canth., Mez. - as a vesicant. (3) Crot-t., Rhus-rad., Rhus-tox. (4) The tincture of Iodine was found useful as a local application to parts affected. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Increased urination.

name: Anacardium Orientale
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Symptoms disappear during dinner, but begin anew after two hours. Better from eating. Better lying on side. Better from rubbing. Better heat, hot bath. Better being in the sun. Worse from mental exertion. Worse emotions, anger, fright, care. Worse from abuse and mortification. Worse on application of hot water. Worse stepping hard. Worse motion. Worse drafts, open air. Worse cold. Worse hours after eating. Worse rubbing, scratching. Worse from talking. Worse morning. Worse evening to midnight. Worse from checked eruptions. Worse strong smells..

full:
PHARMACY - anac. Anacardium orientale. Marking nut. Malacca bean. Semecarpus anacardium. N. O. Anacardiacae. East Indies. Trituration of layer between shell and kernel of heart shaped nut. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abuse, effects. Alcoholism. Al- zheimer'sdisease. Amnesia. Anxiety. Bipolar. Brain, disorders. Brain, weakness. Constipation. Coughs. Debility .Delusions. Dementia. Dermatitis. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Elephantiasis. Fears. Hallucinations. Headache. Hearing, disorders. Heart disorders. Hemorrhoids. Humiliation. Hypochondriasis. Hypoglycemia. Hysteria. Insanity. Lichen planus. Manic depression. Memory, loss. Mental, disorders. Mental, weakness. Multiple,personalities. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Nervous. Palpitations. Paralysis. Pemphigus. Phobias. Poison, ivy. Religious, mania. Rheumatism./Wins, poisoning. Self-abuse. Senile, dementia. Schizophrenia. Skin, diseases. Smell, illusions. Spinal, disorders. Stiff neck. Strokes. Tendonititis. Urticaria. Vesicular eruptions. Vomiting, pregnancy. Whooping cough. Warts. Writer's cramp.

HERBAL - The nut is heart-shaped, hence its name Anacardium orientale, and perhaps this may be taken as the “signature ”of its courage impartingproperties. Found in Asia, native of East Indies and found in mountainous dry Anacardium orientale forests. Juice in the external rind of nut is used. Excellent ink made from this nut. Indians after depriving the nut of its external rind and juice roast and eat it with much relish. The juice which is in cells under the rind is of such acridity that it is used by natives to burn off warts, condylomata and other excrescences and keep down excessive granulation in ulcers. Ancient writers recommended it chiefly in mental diseases - loss of memory, nervous disorders. Abuse of this drug is harmful leading to madness. Poisonous, acrid, vesicant, purgative and narcotic properties prevail in varying degree throughout the order. Anacardium has many features in common with its botanical relatives, the different species of Rhus, especially in its action on the skin, muscles, and joints, but it has also very distinct features of its own.

HOMEOPATHIC - Anacardium acts on the mind, nerves, muscles and joints. Its skin symptoms are similar to Rhus-t. and it has proved a valuable antidote to poison oak and ivy. Syphilitic patients often suffer with these conditions. It is used for neurasthenics, such have a type of nervous dyspepsia, relieved by food. Physical and mental lack of power. Special senses are weakened. Sensation of a plug in various parts-eyes, rectum, bladder, etc., also of a band. Empty feeling in stomach. Intermittent symptoms. Gnawing hunger, desire to nibble, hypoglycemia. Great emptiness in the stomach with weakness and irritability. Worse from fasting or missing a meal. Better after eating. Indigestion, pain is worse when digestion is complete, lasts until the next meal, then better for some time (Nux-v.). Eating temporarily relieves all discomfort. Dypepsia. Constipation. Headache worse by mental exertion, better by eating. Stiffness of neck, worse beginning to move. The senses are either too weak or too acute and there are sense illusions, a light has a halo, optical illusions in dark colors, illusions of hearing, illusions of smell: burning tinder, pigeon's dung. Trembling, on slight exertion, worse knees or arms. Emaciation. Paresis of muscles subject to volition. Paralytic condition. Diseases of spinal cord. Heaviness and fullness of the whole body after piano playing. Cramp like pains in muscles. Contraction of joints. Injured or strained tendons. MIND - Anacardium has won for itself a reputation for the “fear of examinations” and allied conditions. Mental disorders. There is physical and mental lack of power. Brain fatigue. Aversion to work, wants to lie or sit continually. Nervous exhaustion from overstudy. Special senses are weakened, sight, hearing touch etc. Cowardly. Lack of confidence in himself or others. Lack of self-esteem. Absent-minded. Senile dementia. Bad memory. Impaired memory. Loss of memory from fright or mortification. Forgetfulness makes her low-spirited. Suddenly forgets names of those around her. Forgets what she has seen. Vanishing of thoughts, deficiency of ideas andloss of subject without knowing it. Alzheimer's disease. Phobias. Apprehends trouble from everything. Fear of impending misfortune. Anxiety about every trifle. Hypochondriasis. Anxiety when walking, as if pursued. Fear of examinations in students. Fear of the future. Fear of paralysis. Refuses to eat for fear of being poisoned. Fastidious, can't rest when things are not in proper place. Extremely irritable, passionate and contradictory. Angry and depressed. Very easily offended. Excessive anger at slight offence, breaking out in violent behaviour. Irresistible desire to swear and curse. Tendency to use foul, violent language. Malicious, seems bent on wickedness. Great propensity to curse, swear and blaspheme in persons not usually known to curse. Hard hearted, cruel. Unsociable. Absence of all moral restraint. Profound depression and hypochondriasis, with tendency to use violent language. Manic depression. Forsaken feeling. Estrangement from individuals and society. Shuns people. Victims of verbal, physical and sexual abuse. Despairs of getting well. Feeling of helplessness. Ailments from humiliation, punishments. Mental dullness and gloom after sexual indulgence. There is a tendency to suicide by shooting (Ant-c.). Schizophrenia (Lach.). Alcoholism. Suspicious andjealous (Hyos., Lach.). Religious mania. Senseless talk. Internal conflicts. Contradictory impulses. Conflicted over sexual desire, intense desire or aversion to sex. Sexual perversions. Clairaudient. Hears voices, of persons far away, spirits or dead people. Hears voices behind her. Hears voices saying he is going to die. Fixed ideas and delusions of various kinds. There is no reality in anything, all appears as in a dream. Hallucinations. Delusion he is under superhuman control. Delusion that a demon and an angel sit on his shoulders telling him offensive or good things. Delusion that he is double. Seems to have two wills, one good, one bad. Feels as if he had two wills, one commanding him to do what the otherforbids. Delusion that her husband is not her husband, her child is not hers. Delusion that the mind and body are separated. Sees everybody's face in mirror except his own.

Head - Gastric and nervous headaches. Hot head, with icy-cold hands and feet. Headache worse by mental exertion, better by eating. Headache from strong smells. Pressing pain, asfromaplug, in forehead, occiput, temples or vertex. Pressing pain worse coughing, deep breathing after mental exertion. Headaches, better after a meal. Headaches, better falling asleep. Vertex as if constricted. Violent pressure in right or left temple. Throbbing in occiput. Tearing pain during hard labor. Baldness. Itching and little boils on scalp.

Eyes - Eyes as if swollen, but without pain. Pressing pain like a plug on upper orbit. Lachrymation during coryza. Lids so swollen he can hardly see. Great sensitiveness to light. Dim vision as if looking through mist. Objects appear too far off. Optical illusions in dark colors. Threads and black spots before the eyes. Shortsighted. Pupils first contracted, then dilated.

Ears - Pressing in the ears as from a plug. Otorrhea. Itching in ears. Painful swelling of external ear. Catarrh of eustachian tubes. Hard of hearing. Imagines whispers in the ears. Humming. Roaring.

Nose - Chronic coryza, with loss of smell and discharge of purulent mucus. Frequent sneezing, followed by coryza and lachrymation. Violent coryza with palpitation especially in the aged. Soreness in nostrils. Red pustule in right nostril on septum. Sense of smell perverted. Smell lost or acute. Illusory smell of burning tinder.

Face - Redness of face, in mania. Blue rings around eyes. Face pale with sunken eyes. Expressionless, wild, childish. Eczema of face and neck. Violent burning pain. Tetters around mouth. Rough, scaly skin. White, scaly herpes. Twitching of mouth in sleep.

Mouth - Bad breath and taste. Taste lost. Flat offensive taste. Painful vesicles, fetid odor. Tongue feels swollen and stiff, impeding speech and motion with saliva in mouth. Tongue white, and rough like a grater. Ulcers in mouth. Burning around lips as from pepper. Painful vesicles.

Throat - Apt to Choke when eating or drinking. Firm tough mucus in fauces. Suppuration of tonsils. Sensation as if blunt plugs in throat. Sensation of scraping in throat. Sensation of rawness, during cough. Pressure pain oraching near larynx. Voice hoarse and deep. Rattling in trachea when lying on side. Vertigo - Vertigo worse walking, stooping and rising from stooping. Vertigo objects seem too distant. Vertigo as if turning in a circle. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo as if surroundings or self were tottering. COMMENTS - Characteristic pressing or penetrating pain as from a plug, which may occur in any locality in connection with neuralgias, ear disorders and hemorrhoids. Alzheimer’s disease (Staph., Hyos.), may be accompanied with personality changes. Brain fatigue. Marked loss of memory. Deafness with loss of memory. Fear of exams and failure. Cough better by eating. Whooping cough with a gasping and drowsiness after the cough. Morning sickness, better by eating, but returns soon after. Symptoms generally better by eating, recur two hours after. Intermittent symptoms. “The attacks ceased for one or two days and then continued again for a couple of days.” Guided by this indication alone, Custis cured a case of sleeplessness in a pregnant woman with Anacardium 200c. “Spells of sleeplessness lasting for several nights.” Disorders of the palms of the hands. There are warts even on the palms. Skin eruptions in general (Rhus-t.). Bayes' indications are “brain fatigue before examination,” “nerve-exhaustion from over-study.” “nervous prostration from seminal emissions,” or sexual excess. Conflicted over sexual desire, intense desire or aversion to sex. Paralyzed feeling in knees. Sensation as if knees were bandaged. Sensation of a hoop or band around the body or about any part is a leading symptom. Sensation of a blunt object anywhere. It has been used with success in diseases of the spinal cord with this sensation and the feeling of a plug in the spine, worse by any motion which causes a pain as if the plug were sticking still further in. Kent noted it for tendonititis. Paranoid schizophrenia, multiple personalities (Plat.), manic depression (Lach.), symptoms of Lyc. and Nux- v. combined and intensified. Keynote separation of the will, “delusion” that there's an angel on the right shoulder and a devil on the left shoulder. The moral consciousness becomes polarized. Keynote that they can hear voices telling them to do evil. Moral struggle to fight impulses to hurt people. Rubrics are “lack of moral feeling,” “godlessness,” not lack of religious feeling, but a feeling that they can’t be punished. Impulses so strong they shake and tremble. Misanthropy. Deep, suppressed anger and humiliation. History of hard-tempered and low confidence. Inner antagonism. Delusions of sight and smell, fears of spirits, demons, paranoia, hallucinations. Hears voices, keynote. Irresistible desire to curse and swear, can be used for Tourette's syndrome (close to Plat., but Plat, talks about sex.). Religious mania (Verat., Lach.). Feels that he is possessed. Become frightened of their anger, of their own hardness and uncompassionate nature, moral conflicts, turn to religion to restrain themselves. Fear of losing control. Dramatic alteration of moods, deep guilt and torment about their soul and salvation alternating with a mania, maliciousness and impulsiveness. Clarke cured with it a man who had a smell of burning wood in his nose, remaining after influenza. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Grind., Coffea, Jug-c., Rhus-t, Eucalyptus. Compare: (1) Anae, occidentale, Rhus- t., Cypr., Chel., Xero. (2) Cereus serpentina - swearing. (3) Com., Rhus-t., Rhus-v. (4) Ant-t„ Apis, Cori-r., Ferr., lod., Jug-c.,Lyc.,Nit-ac., Nux-v., Ph-ac.,Plat., Urt-u., Puls., Nat-m., Caust. (5) Thuj. - fixed ideas.Relatedremedies: Ign.. Lyc, Plat, Rhus-t. Platina follows well. It is an antidote to Rhus-t. if there are gastric symptoms, or symptoms going from right to left. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Gastric pain, better by eating, but worse again after 2 to 3 hours. Empty feeling in stomach. Spasmodic pain. Hiccough. Weak digestion with fullness and distention. Eating relieves dyspepsia. Rumbling and fermentation. Heartburn after eating soup. Swallows food and drinks hastily. Eructations, nausea, vomiting. Nausea in morning with empty feeling in stomach. Morning sickness. Nausea with retching. Vomiting of food during pregnancy, better eating. Better from vomiting.

Abdomen - Abdomen full and distended. Colic. Pain as if dull plug were pressed into intestines. Rumbling, pinching and griping, especially with flatulent colic. Pain as if a dull plug were pressed into intestine. Hardness of abdomen.

Rectum - Rectum seems powerless. Bowels inactive. Soft stool passes with difficulty. Ineffectual desire. Rectum as if plugged up. Spasmodic constriction of anal sphincter. Itching of anus. Painful hemorrhoids. Moisture from rectum. Hemorrhage during stool. Stools of very pale color. Stools mushy, bloody, brown, liver-like. Painless stools. Sensations - Sensation of a plug in various parts. Sensation as if a dull pressure, is repeated from time to time. Sensations of a band or hoop.

Male - Sensation of burning in the penis during and after urination. Cutting pain along penis. Prostatic discharge during the stool. Voluptuous itching of scrotum, exciting sexual desire. Seminal emissions without dreams. Enjoyment absent during sex. Sexual excesses and perversions.

Female - Frequent but scanty menses with spasmodic pain in abdomen. Pressing pain in uterus, with pain in abdomen. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea with itching and excoriation of the parts. Leucorrhea with soreness and itching. Much loss of blood after miscarriage. Melancholy after childbirth. Morning sickness. Nausea during pregnancy better eating. Food - Loss of appetite with fever and skin symptoms. Loss of appetite, alternating with violent hunger. Refuses to eat for fear of being poisoned. Food tastes flat and offensive. Bitter taste in mouth after smoking tobacco. Everything tastes like herring-brine. Thirst for milk with sweat all over. Thirst during fever. Constant thirst, yet drinking takes breath away.

Chest - Anxiety in region of sternum. Pressure in chest, as from a dull plug. Oppression of chest with internal heat and anxiety, driving him into open air. Rawness and scraping in chest. As if contracted, while walking, during headache. Itching on chest. Violent eczema on chest and throat. Redness of skin, with little vesicles itching intolerably. Constitutions - Anae, is suited to neurasthenic patients. Suited to manic-depressives. Ill-natured children. Elderly senile people. Frequently indicated in depressed, nervous and paranoid people. Hypochondriacs. Women during pregnancy, gastric and nervous disorders.

Heart - Restless feeling at heart. Double stitch at the heart, passing into lumbar region. Beating in bloodvessels. Palpitations with coryza in the aged. Sharp pains in heart during inspiration, at night. Rheumatic pericarditis with double stitches.

Back - Lumbago with painful stiffness. Dull pressure in the shoulders, as from a weight. Stiffness at nape of neck, down back and pain worse motion. As of a heavy weight on sides of neck and back. Tearing pain between scapulae. Causations - Abuse, verbal, physical and sexual. Checked eruptions. Examinations. Fright. Humiliation.

Limbs - Tired feeling. Paralytic weakness. Knees feel paralyzed or bandaged. Pressure as from a plug in the glutei. Pain in ankle, as if sprained worse stepping. Painful thumping on the middle upper arm (left). Cramps in the calves worse walking or rising from a seat. Cramps from toe to instep from heel up calf. Dry hands. Fingers swollen with vesicular eruption. Writer's cramp. Neuralgia in thumb. Warts on palms and hands. Lungs - Asthma, hysterical, ends in flow of tears. Breath stops, on coughing or swallowing. Dyspnea in children who have an uncontrollable temper. Attacks of suffocation. Sweetish, flat tasting mucus. Purulent, tenacious mucus. Greyish-yellow mucus. Expectoration only during day.

Sleep - Spells of sleeplessness lasting for several nights. Sleeplessness from restlessness, itching. Vivid dreams. Anxious dreams. Dreams of fire. Dreams of dead bodies, tombs.

Skin - Itching worse scratching. Intense itching. Eczema with mental irritability. Neurotic eczema. Skin insensible. Dermatitis. Lichen planus. Ulcer on forearm. Urticaria. Promotes expulsion of splinters. Eruption like that of poison-oak (Xero., Grind., Croto-t.). Weals, exuding a viscid, yellowish fluid. Vesicular eruption, swelling. Yellow vesicles. Blisters discharging a yellowish transparent liquid. White herpetic spots. Smallpox like eruptions. Warts on palms and hands.

Modalities - Symptoms disappear during dinner, but begin anew after two hours. Better from eating. Better lying on side. Better from rubbing. Better heat, hot bath. Better being in the sun. Worse from mental exertion. Worse emotions, anger, fright, care. Worse from abuse and mortification. Worse on application of hot water. Worse stepping hard. Worse motion. Worse drafts, open air. Worse cold. Worse hours after eating. Worse rubbing, scratching. Worse from talking. Worse morning. Worse evening to midnight. Worse from checked eruptions. Worse strong smells.

Teeth - Toothache on taking something warm in mouth. Tearing pain in lower incisor, worse contact with tongue and in open air. Teeth of lower jaw seem most affected. Bleeding of gums upon slight rubbing. Swelling of gums.

Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate. Frequent urging with but small discharge. Frequent urination at night. Frequent discharge of clear watery urine, deposits, turbid, clay colored sediment.

Cough - Cough excited by talking in children after fit of temper. Cough after eating with vomiting of food and pain in occiput. Cough then yawns and sleeps. Paroxysms of coughing every three or four hours. Cough more violent every other or every third day. Violent cough with loss of smell and taste.

Perspiration - Sweats better while eating. Clammy sweat on palms especially left. Sweats in evening, on head, abdomen and back, even when sitting quiet. Cold sweat with internal heat.

Temperature - Easily chilled, better sunshine. Chills even in a warm room. Chilliness internal with external heat. Chills over back, as if cold water were poured over it, with heat of face. Internal chills with hot breath. Heat from 4 p.m. until evening, passing off after supper. Heat of upper body with cold feet. Internal shiverings and hot breath. Heat of left side.

name: Anagallis Arvensis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from coffee, relieves headache. Burning in urethra before and during erection, ceases during sex. Worse by touch. Worse after eating..
constitution: Active mind. Amblyopia. Cataract. Constipation. Convulsions. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Gonorrhea. Gout, hemorrhoids. Headache. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Itching. Mania. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Skin, unhealthy. Snakebites. Syphilis. Tetters. Ulcers. Wounds.
keynote: PHARMACY - anag. Anagallis arvensis. Scarlet pimpernel. Weather-glass. Red'chickweed. N. O. Primulacae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. The fresh plant of the scarlet-flowered variety, gathered before the development of the flowers is pounded to a pulp and subjected to pressure.…
full:
PHARMACY - anag. Anagallis arvensis. Scarlet pimpernel. Weather-glass. Red'chickweed. N. O. Primulacae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. The fresh plant of the scarlet-flowered variety, gathered before the development of the flowers is pounded to a pulp and subjected to pressure. The expressed juice is mingled with an equal part by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Active mind. Amblyopia. Cataract. Constipation. Convulsions. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Gonorrhea. Gout, hemorrhoids. Headache. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Itching. Mania. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Skin, unhealthy. Snakebites. Syphilis. Tetters. Ulcers. Wounds.

HERBAL - The Greek name of the plant means to laugh out loud. It produces great exhilaration andoveractivity of mind. Great hilarity. An ancient medicine for hydrophobia and dropsy. It is a vulnerary of some importance. Like the Primula obconca, Anagallis has a marked action on the skin, characterized by great itching and tingling everywhere. Possesses power of softening flesh and destroying warts. Ill-conditioned ulcers. It favors expulsion of splinters. Anagallis has been used for snakebites and ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Skin itches all over, becomes dry and rough. Tetters. Vesicles in groups. Ulcers and swellings on joints. Bran-like, ring-shaped tetters on face. Eruption on chest. Skin of hands dry, stick and dirty- looking. Soreness on chest with pain. Pains in joints going from place to place. Rheumatic and gouty pains. Dropsy. Tensive drawing ascending from left shoulder to nape of neck (Eup-per.). Pain and tightness in bend of left knee. Tickling and itching in left ear. Dull pains in gums accompanied by very hard stools. Sensation on tongue as if something cold were placed on it. Dryness and scraping in throat. Scraping, scratching of larynx and trachea with hoarseness, worse after eating. Syphilis with nosebleed, deranged mind, pain in small of back and itching skin. Tickling prickling along urethra orifice agglutinated. Tearing in spermatic cord. MIND - Great hilarity, exhilarated feeling. Cannot collect his thoughts while listening on account of jovial feelings. Mind very active. Despondency. Great prostration after mental exertion.

Head - Headache over supra-orbital ridges with rumbling in bowels and belchings, better from coffee. Sick headache. Pain in facial muscles.

Eyes - Pain in right eyeball, worse from touching lids.

Nose - Nosebleed. Violent sneezing, expelling lumps of yellow phlegm. Running water from nose. Copious secretion of yellow phlegm. Pelvis - Violent pain in sacrum when lifting a slight load.

Mouth - Viscid saliva in mouth, raised by coughing, water in mouth with tearing pains in molars.

Abdomen - Distended with wind, weak feeling in abdomen. Causations - Mental work causes great prostration (Pic-ac.). Constitutions - Psoric, allergic constitutions.

Neck - Tensive drawing, ascending from left shoulder to nape of neck, worse from raising and extending arm.

Limbs - Rheumatic and gouty pains. Pain in shoulder and arm. Cramp in ball of thumbs and fingers.

Skin - Itching, dry, bran-like eruption, especially on hands and fingers. Palms especially affected. Ulcers and swellings on joints. Rough, dry, bran-like tetters in rings. Groups of small vesicles, smarting and itching, oozing a yellowish-brown lymph, which soon turns into a scurf, new vesicles appearing beneath. Promotes expulsion of splinters (Hep.). Stools - Hemorrhoids. Offensive flatus. Stools soft and pappy, watery diarrhea. Stools hard like stone, knotty.

Modalities - Better from coffee, relieves headache. Burning in urethra before and during erection, ceases during sex. Worse by touch. Worse after eating.

Teeth - Pain as from cold. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Primula obcon. Anagallis contains Saponin. (2) Similarto Cof- fea - joyous, excited. (3) Picric acid - prostration after mental exertion. (4) Cyclamen - sneezing. (5) Lith. - cough skin, ringworm. Sep., Tell. (6) Puls. - chilliness, catarrhs. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - More or less irritation in urethra inclining to sex. Burning pain on urinating with agglutination of orifice. Urine passes in several streams, must press before it passes. Urine is dark, straw-colored, urine escapes in divided stream (Thuj.).

name: Anantherum Muricatum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Coffee at first worse, then better. Wine and coffee aggravates the toothache..
constitution: Abscesses. Aphonia. Boils. Cancer. Chancre-like sores. Colic. Erysipelas. Glandular inflammation. Hair, loss. Herpes. Hydrophobia. Sycosis. Syphilis. Tic convulsive. Tic douloureux. Tumors. Ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - anan. Anantherum muricatum. Cuscus grass. Andropogon muricatus. Andro- pogon squarrosus. Vetiver. Viti-vayr. N. O. Gràmineae. India. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Aphonia. Boils. Cancer. Chancre-like sores.…
full:
PHARMACY - anan. Anantherum muricatum. Cuscus grass. Andropogon muricatus. Andro- pogon squarrosus. Vetiver. Viti-vayr. N. O. Gràmineae. India. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Aphonia. Boils. Cancer. Chancre-like sores. Colic. Erysipelas. Glandular inflammation. Hair, loss. Herpes. Hydrophobia. Sycosis. Syphilis. Tic convulsive. Tic douloureux. Tumors. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - A medicinal grass cultivated in the Markarentas Islands, East India. Anantherum has produced a state of drunkenness and intoxication. Farrington noted if for “Erysipelas with much swelling of arms and legs, darkred or bluish eruptions with tendency to suppurate.” Anantherum is a skin remedy of high order. Abscesses, boils. Abscesses, ulcers and fissures on arms and hands. Tumors of breast, ulcerated indurated. Herpes and ulcers or scabs on scalp. Tumors, wart-like growths on eyebrows. Falling off of eyebrows and beard. Chancre-like ulcers on penis. Eruptions like itch or lichen. Ulcers at labial commissures. Pustules like smallpox on vulva. Syphilis. Severe neuralgic headache, as if bells moved about in head, as of steel arrows from forehead to nape. Pains in facial bones as if crushed or ulcerated. Convulsive tic. Plugged sensation. Glandular swellings especially of sub-maxillary and cervical glands. Swelling of tonsils, constriction of throat, inability to swallow. Painful swelling of various parts extending to suppuration. MIND - Sadness and restlessness with fear of death and the future. Sheds tears easily. Dread of society. Seeks solitude and obscurity. Apathetic. Anger with desire to strike and destroy. Quarrelsome, but after being angry he often regrets what he has done. Jealousy. Foolish joy and absurd complacency. Changes in his mood and turn of thought. Ardent desire to travel. Blunted intellect and loss of memory. Haste in all his actions. Persistent fear of death during all his suffering. Monomania, as for rowing about in a boat, dressing or walking out in a grotesque manner, always frequenting the same places and doing the same things.

Head - Pains pierce brain like pointed arrows, worse in afternoon. Herpes, ulcers and tumors on scalp. Wart- like growth on eyebrows. Boils and tumors on tip of nose.

Eyes - Swelling and ulceration of the lachrymal glands. Weakness of the eyes.

Ears - Very copious secretion of cerumen. Heat and smarting in the lobes of the ears. Fissures in the lobes of the ears. Noises, murmurs and hissing in the ears.

Face - Face yellowish or red, enlarged inflamed and congested. Face pale, transparent and white as wax. Face gray, cold and frozen looking and paralyzed. Face emaciated, bluish, cyanotic, contracted, shrunken with hollow eyes.

Mouth - Tongue fissured, as if cut on edges, copious salivation. Constant inclination to clench the teeth. Sensation of cold in the teeth with heat in the gums and the whole mouth. Burning in the teeth, gums and lips, as if they were burned. Gum-boils. Very painful pimples on the tongue with itching and burning.

Vomiting of the food and of bile, with hunger even after eating. Vomiting of food and often of blood after meals. Vomiting of acrid, burning matter, followed by bile and blood. Pains in the stomach with cold sweats on the face and back.

Inflammation and swelling of the abdomen, very painful. Abdomen inflated, tense and hard, with tympanitic sound on percussion. Colic, cramps and tearing pains in the abdomen, sensation as if there were a red-hot iron in it. Breasts - Breasts swollen indurated, nipples excoriated. The breasts are atrophied and become soft. Heat and pain in the breasts, as if they had been gashed with a penknife. Inflammation and swelling. Congestions of the breasts as from accumulation of milk. Lancinating, pulsating and pressive pains. Excoriation of the nipples. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Rectum - Very long-lasting constipation, followed by dry, brown, bulky stools, then diarrhea. Obstinate constipation with fever, heat, thirst, sweat and debility. Stools difficult, large and hard, knotty like sheep-dung, passed with difficulty, even after the use of injections.

Male - Excoriations on the prepuce and urethral meatus. Secretion of a thick substance of very strong odor, between the glans and prepuce, which are swollen. Burning, stitching and pinching in the penis. Syphilitic-looking pimples on the penis with intense pains, traversing from one part of another.

Female - Scirrhus-like swelling of cervix. Prolapsed uterus. Sterility, as from atrophy of the ovaries. Swelling of the uterus. Menstruation very painful and copious, the blood generally bright or light-colored. Menstruation retarded, the blood dark, thick, followed by fetid leucorrhea. Suppression of menses. Menstruation frequent and painful. Great itching and burning in the vulva. Whitish and reddish eruptions on the vulva. Leucorrhea watery, clear or milky and of very bad odor. Thick, purulent, yellow or green leucorrhea. Food - Morbid hunger, wakes up in night to eat, as if he had a tapeworm. Burning, unquenchable thirst. Longing for aromatic drinks.

Heart - Burning and sensation of weight in the heart with sadness, anguish and fear of death. Stitches and formication in the heart with great anxiety.

Sleep - Restless sleep with cries, starting up, movements of the limbs and anxious dreams. Comatose sleep with disturbing dreams and snoring. Prolonged sleep in the morning with inclination to lie abed late. Sleep with frequent dreams, alternate coldness and heat and burning of the whole body, intense thirst and fright.

Skin - Itching. Offensive foot sweat. Diseased and deformed nails. Herpes. Abscesses, boils and ulcers. Erysipelas. Chancre-like sores. COMMENTS - Burning and stitches. Thirsty, but cannot drink. Burning heat alternating with icy coldness in gullet, as of something alive in gullet. Involuntary urination when walking and during sleep. Formication as from ants. Ulcers yellowish, violet, swollen, everted, syphilitic. Discharges from ulcers are foul, foul breath and belchings. Sexual desire increased by every attempt to satisfy it until driven to onanism and madness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Staph., Merc., Thuj. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Modalities - Coffee at first worse, then better. Wine and coffee aggravates the toothache.

Liver - Sensation of heat and of congestion of the liver. Cramps in the hepatic region with sensation as if it were full of painful tuberosities.

Kidneys - Turbid, thick urine, full of mucus. Bladder cannot hold smallest quantity. Involuntary. Cystitis. Constant urging to urinate with stitches and crushing pains in the kidneys. Frequent emission of urine, which is turbid or soon becomes so. Sensation of a numbness and obstruction in the kidneys and bladder were always full and swollen.

HERBAL - Rohitaka is a large tree and is generally found in many districts of Bengal. It also grows in Assam, Sylhet and Cachar and also in Western India. Burma, Malacca and some other places this plant can be found. Rohitaka has been named by Ayurvedic physicians as Plihaghati meaning thereby that it does away with all splenic disorders. The Ayurvedic physicians have found it to be alternative, astringent and tonic. They prize it as an excellent remedy in the enlargement of liver and spleen, in corpulence and enlarged glands and also in general debility. They have also recommended it in gonorrhea. Chakradatta. Charaka and other ayurvedic authorities have recommended it in the splenic affections, mucus gonorrhea, and leucorrhea. they have also found it efficacious in hepatic affections and derangements as well. They have recommended it for jaundice, dropsical swellings, chronic fevers and some other diseases.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Pramada Prasanna Biswas of Padna, Bengal, personally proved this drug. The following symptoms set in while it was proved: MIND - Easily angered. Mistakes in spelling take place. Memory become dull and disordered. Cannot fix mind on any subject or matter.

Head - Heat in the head, especially on the vertex. Giddiness of head. Feeling of warmth or heat in the head, specially on the frontal region. Sensation of pain in the temples associated with heat which is relieved by cold breeze or cold application. Burning sensation is felt in the eyes and face.

Eyes - Eyes, burn.

Face - Face, eyes, burn. Flushes of heat come out of the face.

Mouth - Heat comes out of the mouth. Insipid taste in the mouth. In the morning taste becomes bad and bitter.

Stomach - Burning sensation is felt in the stomach with urging for vomiting. Sensation of heat is felt in the stomach and spasmodic colic due to indigestion ensues. Nausea and vomiting. Also an attempt at vomiting. Water comes out of the mouth.

Abdomen - Heat is felt in the lower abdomen. Pains are felt in the right and left hypochondrium. Enlargement of both liver and spleen and burning sensation is felt here.

Limbs - Hands and feet burn. Burning sensation is felt there. The patient feels great relief if body coverings are thrown off.

Modalities - Open air, cold breeze or cold application generally mitigates or relieves all pains, specially burning of the body.

Temperature - There is feverishness with headache with frontal pains. During fever aching pains are felt. Body becomes hot. Face, eyes hands and feet burn. COMMENTS - It is alternative, astringent, and tonic, given in enlarged gland, as liver and spleen, in corpulence and in general debility. (R. N. Khory, Materia Medica of India, vol. II, p. 118) R. N. Chopra in his Indigenous Drugs of India, p. 461, says: “It is an aperient usedin enlarged glands, liver and spleen diseases and corpulence.” It is a splendid remedy in all disorders of the spleen, either enlarged or painful. It is also an excellent medicine in all hepatic derangement. In chronic slow malarial fevers associated with the enlargement of the spleen and liver its action is supreme. It is particularly useful for patients with bilious temperament. Fever with headache and burning temperature. Fever with headache and burning sensation of eyes, face, hands and feet, they desire to have cold breeze or cold application which ameliorates all burning sensations experienced by them. There is constipation which is a characteristic symptom of the drug. There is no desire for food. Taste of the mouth is insipid or bitter. The patient feels laziness while getting out of the bed in the morning. REFERENCES - Ghose.

HOMEOPATHIC - The scorpion was a major remedy in ancient Egyptian medicine. A proving of scorpion is written in the medical papyruses, which give a vivid description of Isis allowing herself to be stung to determine the effects of the medicine. A proving on a middle eastern scorpion was conducted by Jeremy Sherr. Most provers were between age 25 to 40 years old. The symptoms are from the provings and effects of the stings. Pain and swelling of the injured part are first experienced followed by sleepiness, prostration and possibly tetanus. Strabismus has been observed in some cases and the pupils are dilated. The bitten part is very swollen with violent pains lasting from one to three days. Heat and pain at bitten spot, sleepiness, sneezing, rest lessness, later, abundant saliva, meteorism, later, trismus or tetanus. Complete prostration. Always acute pains in and diminished temperature of the part bitten. Scorpion stings are attended with a certain amount of danger, especially for children. MIND - Forgetful. Absent-minded. Mind dull and foggy, better while moving and walking. Difficulty applying self. Lack of concentration with daydreaming and difficulty in mental exertion. Mind blank when concentrating. Unable to think of more than one thing at a time. Mistakes in writing and spelling. Speech slurred, answered with difficulty. Conversation difficult. Weariness. Tired and apathetic. Felt detached, very interested in little things. Dreamy and staring. Felt disconnected from the human race, as if everyone were another species. Depressed and destructive. Aversion to things she usually enjoyed. Averse to work. Very changeable moods, one moment extremely friendly, nice and amiable, then irritable. Incredible upsurge of energy, felt very high, then low, then high again. Great swings of mood, better from eating. Clumsy. Accident- prone. As if drunk, with increased sexual desire. Desire to be out in the country. Hurried, restless. Impatient watching others. Time seems to go slowly. Irritable, snappy, oversensitive to noise and bright lights, can't bear music. Argumentative, critical. Feels resentful and abused. Great hostility to those around him. Assertive, impatient, aggressive. Angry with her children and family. Terrible uncontrollable temper. Wanted to kill her husband and children. Panic-stricken. Fear, as if something terrible would happen. Overwhelmed by terror, panic and fear. Terrified of dogs, fearful while driving. Anguish and worry, anxiety for no reason. Anxiety about health. Anxiety for self, friends and the world, with continual sighing. Despairing, tearful mood, could see no way out. Sadness and confusion. Feels sorry for herself, better crying. Sympathetic, took on otherpeople's problems. Desires company and sympathy. Indisposed to talk and averse to company. Disappointed with people.

Head - Headache alternating with nausea. v Pain in the head with vomiting and shiver- ing hands. Migraine during menses with very dim- vision, vomiting and debility. .„ Dull headache. Limbs - Beaten sensation in bones and joints, especially large joints. Pains, better stretching, worse movement, worse lying still. Desire to move and stretch during fever. Had an urge to take deep breath, but couldn't. No pain, but felt as though muscles weren't working properly. Sensation mat air goes to head. Unproductive cough, little mucus. Tickling, dry cough.

Very tired, needed longer than usual afternoon nap. Tired, morning, rises late. Unrefreshed sleep, slept till late. Better af- terone half hour. Sleepy feeling, reluctant to get out of bed, exhausted. Very tiredafter evening meal, slept. Tired at night despite rest in day. Slept very deeply. Restless sleep. Slept on back during acute headache and vomiting episode (normally sleeps on side). Slept on abdomen without a pillow on left side of face With right arm curved around head.

Menopausal panic attacks, with sweats and palpitations, worse lying in bed, better sitting up or walking around. Desires cold drink, white wine, fruit, especially oranges. Desires fresh air, which ameliorates, or aversion to air. Must get fresh air with hot flushes. Permanent tiredness and fatigue. Less dryness of skin. Itch after bathing better. Sleeplessness. Severe pain, worse touch, worse pressure, could not wear shoes. Worse at 9:00 p.m. Palpitations on waking disappeared. Frequent urination. Stiffness in morning improved. Although usually short sighted and astigmatic, he had short spells of clear vision. Vision is acute, can see for miles. Things she would normally feel guilt about dont bother her. Felt unusually well all day. Woke more relaxed and calm than for months, slept late (throughout whole proving). Felt more energetic, self assertive and confident. She had lots of energy, worked hard and exercised. She was very bouncy and happy to be busy. Felt good, hapjïy, satisfied with life, happier and freer in her relationship. Felt expansive and good. Sense of being “centered.” Felt euphoric, relaxed, “spaced out.” Feeling extremely calm. Her patience surprised her. Extremely alert. Pretended to feel well, although sick. A feeling of great energy and confidence, a magnetic state, his emotions were more intense than ever before. In his love affair, he surrendered to his feelings for the first time, and his girlfriend commented that this was the most intense relationship she had ever had. Desired alcohol and drugs, a feeling of wanting to escape. It seemed as though he was a different person, very similar to the way he had been in adolescence, but in a much more powerful manner. . These emotions were so intense he wanted to rip his chest apart to let them out. He lost all control over his emotions, which seemed to come from a deep and distant part of himself, a darker side. He desired to continue the proving for the rest of his life. Although he experienced acute nausea, headache and dizziness, he felt calm and happy, not upset by his illness, detached. Felt fed up with all activities he normally enjoyed. Felt ddthched fromevery thing, as in a dream, reactions slowed down a lot. Feeling of separateness, usual sense of urgency gone. Felt detached from her stomach cramps. Felt she should be busy but couldn't. Felt despondent and directionless in the evening. In the evening, felt as if in a numbness, “thoughts, feelings, buzzing and confusing me. I feel entirely alone, that I am viewing the world through one hole, for it all seems just a picture, and the rest of the world share a different view finder together. I don't want to join theirs though.” Stomach pain ameliorated as headache starts. Headaches and mental state ameliorated with appearance of sexual symptoms. All colors seemed bright. Nose, discharge yellow-orange. Vomit, orange-red. Diarrhea, brick red. Urine, pink- orange. Stayed awake till early morning, brain racing, enjoyed himself tremendously. Felt as if he had taken drugs. His friends thought so too. Desired drugs. Warm drinks ameliorate throat. Warm milk ameliorates. Alcohol ameliorates headache. Beer ameliorates throat. Coffee ameliorates. Cold food and drink aggravates pain in teeth. Eating ameliorates lethargy. Eating ameliorates swings of mood. Eating aggravates pain in teeth. Orange juice aggravates. Hemorrhages on cutting herself, blood dark and clotted quickly. Heaviness feeling all over. Exhaustion, lethargy and fatigue. Exhausted, run down, better for fresh air. Lethargy worse during menses. Lethargy better shutting eyes. No strength, feels sagging all over, limp and weak. Feet seem to drag. Lassitude in evening, better lying down, better short sleep. Weakness with trembling. Constant change of position ameliorates back. Moving car aggravates nausea and vomiting. Riding in car ameliorates. Occupation ameliorates. Numbness, tingling and nausea throughout body, during fear. During fever the whole body bruised and sore as if beaten, unable to get comfortable in bed, had to change position frequently and slightly, else felt seized up. Restless. Extreme mental and physical anguish with restlessness, could not be still for a moment. Left to right, pain in knees. Left to right, ears ringing. Alternating sides, red, painful, itching eruptions on soles of feet and palms. Alternating sides, nasal discharge. Tiredness, sore throat, thirst, photophobia and headache. Abscess on small toe, pain stinging and burning, worse from heat and touch. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Vesp., Scol., Tarent., Apis. (2) Am., Bry., Hyper., Led. REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke. Sherr.

Passes drops after urinating, worse bending. Feeling of incontinence. Pink, orange urine. Bruised pain.

HERBAL - Common in India, specially in Bengal. It is an annual plant, 1 to 3 feet high, common in hedgerows throughout the plains of India from Lucknow to Assam. It is also cultivated in gardens in some parts of India. The shrub is well-known under the name of Kalmegh and forms the principal ingredient of household medicine called alui which is extensively used in Bengali. The macerated leaves and juice together with certain spices are made into little globules, which are prescribed for infants to relieve griping, irregular stools and loss of appetite. The roots and leaves have also reputation of being a febrifuge, tonic, alternative and anthelmintic. In general debility, dysentery and certain forms of dyspepsia associated with gaseous distension of the bowels, the decoction or infusion of the leaves have been used with satisfactory results. Ayurvedic physicians used it with success singly or as a principal ingredient with other medicines in worms of children, vomiting Of children. Infantile liver, enlargement of liver and spleen. Fever with the enlargement of liver and spleen. Fever with constipation. Fever in malaria. Fever in infantile liver. Fever in kala-azar of children, and also in boils, abscesses and septic wounds. The people of India prize it to be a highly efficacious remedy in all sorts of liver complaints from very early times. The Ayurvedic physicians of India use it in enlarged liver or any derangement of liver, especially in children wjth jaundiced skin or without it, in the first stage of cough and cold, in the general debility and in convalescence after a long - continued fever. They also employ it in cutaneous ailments. In intermittent fevers, the fever comes on daily between 8 and 9. a.m. or between 10 a.m. and 12 noon. During fever there is slight thirst. Loose stools, catarrh, cough and pain in the hepatic region are the accompanying symptoms. There may be constipation in place of diarrhea. Burning sensation in eyes, face hands andfeet, especially in the palms are keynote symptoms for its administration. During fever the patient is disinclined to move, desire to keep quiet, during fever there is intermingling of chilliness and burning sensation. Sometimes the patient likes cold applications. Sometimes he dislikes them, in this wáy contradictory and conflicting symptoms manifest themselves. It is generally used in an attack of remittent or intermittent fever where there is double accession of the seizure associated with predominance of bilious symptoms and headache. In some cases, headache may be absent. In show fevers of children with derangement or enlargement of liver, it is very useful. In infantile jaundice where eyes and urine have become yellow, it is used with efficacy. It is excellent remedy in chronic fever associated with the enlargement of liver and spleen along with burning of hands, feet, eyes and face, and headache. Its efficacy is found also in kala-azar of infants. The following are the principal guiding symptoms of Kalmegh: Sensation of heat and burning in hands and feet, mental depression and despondency, bad taste in the mouth, bitter and putrid taste over the tongue, constipation, scantiness of stools, changeableness of symptoms, heaviness of the whole body for which the patient walks slowly. The patient wants to wash the hands and the feet with cold water in order to be relieved of the burning sensation felt over the parts, he feels considerable relief from cold, he does not desire to move. . Kalmegh is a domestic medicine for flatulence and diarrhea of children and it is also used for worm symptoms as it is considered to be anthelmintic. It is used in torpidity of liver, neuralgia, dyspepsia, in general debility, in convalescence after fevers and in the fully developed stage of dysentery. In short, Kalmegh is a sovereign remedy for the above mentioned ailments.

HOMEOPATHIC - Thi effects of Ang. are closely allied to those of Nux-v., Ruta and Merc. Clarke has verified the power of Ang. over long bones in a case of acutè periostitis of the tibia in a scrofulous boy. The 5x trituration speedily arrested inflammation after the failure of Merc. Decay of bones, particularly if patient has longing for coffee and has a very touchy, sensitive mind. Principal action is on spinal motor nerves and mucus membranes. Over-sensitive and excitable. The slightest offense, a mere trifle, irritates (Nux-v.). Timidity and weakness (Sil.). Characteristic strong craving for coffee. Decay of tissue. Decay with crumbling off of pieces of bone. Decay of long bones. Ulcers very painful, penetrate to marrow. Tearing in the bones, worse at rest, better cold applications, better extension, worse exertion and pressure. Exostosis of lower jaw. Rheumatic and paralytic complaints with great difficulty in walking. Crackling in all joints. Drawing, tension, stiffness of muscles and joints, bruised, sore feeling as after a blow. Constricting sensation in varicose veins. Spinal marrow and extensor muscles are principally affected. Paralysis. Tetanus. Drawing of head of right side, later to left. Marked ill humor, everything vexes her. Lachrymose and irritable. Great gloom. Dis- fl heartened. Offended easily. Prone to anger, every trifle irritates. Filled with bitterness, will stand no joking, irritation at least of- Hi fence. Absence of mind, wants now this, then that thing.

Irresistible desire to drink coffee. Aversion to meat, especially pork. Thirst for cold water, could not drink enough during evening. Wants now one thing, now another, which are refused when offered. He cannot get satisfied without having much appetite.

Ears - Heat of the ears and both cheeks. Pinching in the external ear. Heat in the lobes. Sensation as if something were before the ear and as if something were inserted in it. Throbbing pain behind the ears, on the side of the neck, as if the carotid were beating.

Mouth - Great dryness of mouth and lips without any thirst. Much saliva flows from the mouth. Bitter taste in the mouth after the usual’smoking.

Dry, hacking cough from scratching in throat or irritation behind sternum. Irritation behind sternum through to back. Every evacuation followed by shivering, crawling sensation over face. Tenesmus with soft stool. Hemorrhoids protrude with hard, knotty stool. Seminal emissions. Itch-ing of tip of glans penis (when walking in open air). Violent itching on scrotum. HERBAL - The Anhalonium plant from which the mescal buttons are obtained grows in barren and rocky soil in the valley of the Rio Grande. It is used by some Native American tribes in their religious ceremonies. In the ceremonies the constant beating of tom-toms is an essential feature.

HOMEOPATHIC - Anhalonium has been recently tested and a notable proving was made by Dr. Wier Mitchell. It is a cardiac tonic and respiratory stimulant. It weakens the heart and produces insanity. The chief feature of the drug's action is the production of colorful visions of overpowering brilliancy, associated with moving shapes of fantastic design, the motion being regulated somewhat in time by music. It makes “each note upon- the piano a center of melody which seems to be surrounded by a halo of color pulsating to the rhythm of the music.’’’Hyperesthesia of all the senses. Acute sensitivity to changes of the weather. Feeling of cold over the body. General increase in muscular tone. Hypersecretion of the thyroid gland. Hysteria. Allergic persons with hypersensitivity. Loss of sex drive (Sep.). Insomnia. Anxiety and neurosis. Melancholy. Chronic hallucinatory state. Schizophrenia. Impression that the self is double. Suicidal tendencies. Basedow's disease (Goiter). MIND - Anhalonium is a remedy for brainweakness, audio-visual hallucinations with colored brilliant visions. It causes a form of intoxication accompanied by wonderful visions, remarkably beautiful and varied kaleidoscopic changes and a sensation of increased physical ability. V isions of monsters and various gtuesome forms. "Delirium. Loss of contact with the outside world and escape into a fantasy world. Loss of conception of time. Distrust and resentment. Lazy contentment. Gloomy, sad, dull. Irrational, sudden changes of mood. Egocentric introversion. Noises and touch are perceived through colored vision. Depersonalization, does not know his identity. Diminution of willpower, apathy and slow reactions. Passive state. Existential anguish. Impression that objects and his whole body are transparent, sees his own internal organs. Memories exalted.

Eyes - Pupils dilated. Ptosis. Accommodation impaired. Troubled vision, accommodation and perception. Visions in all colors. Fantastic visions of surpassing brilliance, moving in designs. Moving scenes, dances, affected by beating time. Natural objects seem more brilliant, shadows deepened, flickering of lights greatly exaggerated?

Ears - Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds. Impressions of sound and visions heightened by any marked stimulation of skin.

Nose - The air seemed filled with vague perfume. Smell blunted, could not tell whether or not tincture of asafetida was a perfume.

Face - Disinclined to make the slightest movement, eyelids droop, they scarcely move the lips and jaws in articulating. Head - Headaches with disturbed vision. Frontal headache with visual zigzags. Occipital headache, with disturbed vision. Persistent ache and tired feeling in occipital region.

Mouth - Great difficulty in talking, partly from paralysis of the tongue, partly from slowness of thought. Nerves - Motor incoordination. Extreme muscular depression increased patellar reflex. Paraplegia. Neuralgias, trigeminal of the ophthalmic nerve, the maxillary nerve, frontal nerve and naso-ciliary nerve.

Stomach - Nausea, worse on movement, entirely better on lying down. Vertigo - Faintness. Vertigo, brain tired. COMMENTS - One prover, Havelock Ellis said “I first cut up the Peyote buttons into small fragments and poured on boiling water twice, a single infusion is inactive.” He noted a distinct slowing of the pulse, slight faintness and shallow breathing, but there were none of the terrible heart symptoms of the other Cacti. Other symptoms are loss of conception of time, occipital headache, tired feeling in head, nausea. Tremor of muscles increased knee-jerk and loss of power of coordination. Extreme muscular depression, don't want to stir, whole body feels relaxed. Lazy contentment. Fine tremor in lower limbs before the visions, unable to walk without assistance, can with difficulty sit up. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i. - time sense disordered, fantastic visions. (2) Gels. - paralysisof accommodation. (3) Bell., Stram., Op., Pic-ac., Pip-m., Coff., Coca. (4) Plat. - objects seem small and distant. (5) Psor. - better lying down. (6) Agave. (7) The intoxication of Anhalonium is similar to that of Cannabis Ind. and Oenanthe. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Limbs - Burning sensation of the limbs. A fine tremor in lower limbs. Lungs - Breathing shallow.

Sleep - Insomnia and hysteria. Drowsiness, followed by consciousness of unusual energy.

Modalities - Better lying down. Worse on closing eyes. The nausea and faintness were worse on movement. There is great disinclination to move.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Anil, have been observed on working people poisoned by inhalation of the fumes and on persons who have worn an aniline-dyed article next the skin. The symptoms are in1 many respects like those of Arsenicum. There is vomiting, purging, bursting headache, and epileptiform attacks. Face has a purple hue. Marked cyanosis, swelling and irritation of the skin. Profound anemia with discoloration of the skin, blue lips, anorexia, gastric disturbances. Painin penis and scrotum with swelling. Cancerous growths. Tumors of urinary passages. Giddiness and pain in head. COMMENTS - In old-school practice, injections of aniline blue have been used with some success to destroy cancerous, growths, aniline having a marked affinity for cell nuclei, hence its use in staining microscopic specimens. In Anil, poisoning cases, évacuants, the inhalation of oxygen, and the free use of stimulants, including brandy, ammonia, chloric ether, cold infusions to the head, and mustard plasters on legs and thighs, have been used with success. HERBAL - Illicium is a genus of Magnoliaceous shrubs or low trees with smooth entire leaves, exhaling when bruised a strong odor of aniseed, owing to the volatile oil contained in minute pellucid dots, which may be seen by the aid of a lens. The star anise fruit is used throughout China, Japan and India as a condiment and is chewed in small quantities after a meal to sweeten the breath. Anis, has a local repute as a stomachic and carminative and should be remembered in the treatment of flatulent conditions. It has been used for the so-called three months colic, especially if it recurs at regular hours, with much rumbling in abdomen. Colic of babies.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Anis, provings were made by Franz and Mure. Both showed the action of the drug on the nose, mouth and stomach. Franz had many symptoms on the face, especially lips, skin and limbs. Characteristic pain in region of third rib. about an inch or two from the sternum, generally on right side, but occasionally on left. Frequent cough with this pain. Purulent tracheal and gastric catarrh of old alcoholics. Old asthmatics. Vomiting, epileptiform convulsions with biting of tongue.

Head - Pains in head, better evenings, worse mornings.

Ears - Buzzing in ears. Ringing in ears followed by sleep. Itching over left ear, going off when touching the place.

Nose - Acute catarrh. Water discharge from nostrils. Warm, smarting sensation in nose, succeeded by sneezing. Sharp stitches in tip of nose, beneath lip. Acute catarrh. Burning and numbness of inner lower lip.

Face - Stinging sensation in upper lip, as if blood would press out, better from touch. Dryness of upper lip, which is drawn closer to teeth. Burning in inner surface of lower lip with sensation as if it had gone to sleep. Food - All food, except rye brea’d. tastes too salty or bitter, yet appetite is good. Rye bread tastes good, its odor is refreshing. Satiety after eating but little.

Mouth - Tongue covered with aphthae, most on edges. Edges of tongue folded like little bags.

Throat - Touch, viscid phlegm from stomach with old alcoholics. COMMENTS - A very remarkable symptom of Franz' has been confirmed by Flora A. Waddell. A man suffering from rheumatism of two years' duration came limping into Dr. Waddell's office, asking if she could do anything for his limb. He complained that when he sat down he couldn't rest in that position at all. Asked why, he replied: “Whenever I sit down my limb feels as if broken off right here,” pointing to the middle of his thigh. He said he often got up to straighten himself in order to make sure. He also had some pain in his arm and severe “sore pain” in his back. Anis. 30x cured all the symptoms. Mure's Anis, symptoms were noted on head, abdomen, chest and back. Tough white expectoration appears to be a characteristic and there is pain in region of third rib. about one or two inches from sternum (junction of rib with its cartilage), generally on right side, but occasionally on the left. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In chest pains, Pix, Menth-pu. (2) lA&gn-g. Compatible after: Aeon, and Bry. in hemoptysis. REFERENCES-Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea in stomach, extends to chest, then ceases. Nausea with gagging and inclination to vomit. Bloating of stomach, acidity.

Abdomen - Three months colic, especially if it recurs at regular hours, bowels disturbed. Violent wind colic. Rumbling in abdomen. Pain in spleen region.

Rectum - Stools bilious, compact and dark-colored.

Chest - Pain in region of third rib, about one or two inches from sternum, generally on right side, but occasionally left. Pain about junction of third rib with cartilages, hemorrhage, coughs, congestion and enlarged liver.

Heart - Palpitations with aphthae and weakness.

Back - Pain in back and chest. Cramp-like drawing, as from a cold in left side of dorsal vertebra.

Limbs - Jerking and têaring in bend of left elbow and at same time in palm, a feeling as if an arter^had been injured by a blow. Pressure back °f right hand, between the two middle metacarpal bones, as though something fiard lying between them, worse pressing hand against anything hard, not by touch. Left thigh feels as if broken in the middle while sitting, it disappears on standing. Lungs - Dyspnea in old asthmatics. Feeling of emptiness after coughing. Frequent cough with pain. Spitting blood in small quantities and with pus-like phlegm, pain in right chest. Whitish expectoration. Tough and viscous phlegm with old alcoholics. Dyspnea. Pain near third intercostal cartilage. Cough with pus-like phlegm. Palpitation with aphthae. Hemoptysis.

Sleep - Sleepless at nightfall. Disturbed sleep.

Skin - Stitches as with pins in left palm, between first and second fingers, better by scratching, but afterwards return with burning. Dull, painful stitches in skin of lower forearm. Crawling, itching stitches in right palm. Itching in front and above left ear, better by touch.

Modalities - The pain in thigh is worse sitting, better rising. Pains in the head are worse in morning, better in evening.

Temperature - Heat from abdomen to stomach and chest, running over different places and abating during day.

Papular-like éruptions with a vesicular tendency, especially on scrotum, also on hands, tibia, shoulders and bottoms of the feet. Eruptions decrease with the full of the moon. Ears - Ringing in ears. Swelling of ears.

Nose - Chronic cracks and ulcerations of nostrils.

Swelling, face glands, lymphatic tissue. Erysipelas. Indurations. Sycosis barbae. Food - Appetite wanting. Diminished appetite with fever. Loss of appetite with chills and gastralgia. Aversion to eggs, odor of eggs. Excessive thirst, but can hardly swallow. Thirst with fever.

Mouth - Flabby taste. Dark red, bloody ecchymoses of mouth. Hemorrhage, oozing of blood. Abscess, lips. Pustules, lips. Black, lips. Erysipelas, lips. Offensive odor from mouth.
