full:
PHARMACY - arg-n. Argentum nitricum. Silver nitrate. Lunar caustic. Trituration and solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Addison's disease. Anemia. Anticipation. Anxiety, attacks. Chancre. Chemosis. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Belchings. Erysipelas. Eyes disorders. Flatulence. Fears. Fright. Gastric ulcer. Gonorrhea. Hands, swelling. Headache. Heartburn. Herpes zoster. Impetigo. Incoordination. Locomotor ataxia. Melancholy. Neuralgia. Ophthalmia, neonatorum. Panic, attacks. Paralysis. Prostate, enlargement. Scarlatina. Smallpox. Spinal irritation. Syphilis. Taste, altered. Throat disorders. Tongue ulcerated. 'Trembling. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - It was the use of Argentum nitricum in ancient times in the treatment of epilepsy which led to the production of the lamentable cases of lead-colored pigmentation of the skin called Argyria. Arg-n. has irresistible desir e for sugar, which at the same time aggravates. Kent related a case illustrating this. A nursing infant had a grass-green diarrhea which failed to yield to Merc., Ars., and Cham. At last Kent discovered that the mother ate a pound of candy a day. Arg-n. was given and the candy stopped and the child soon got well. Grimmer used it for Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are important indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears and restlessness with trembling hands, skin cancers. In Arg-n. the neurotic effects are very marked, many brain and spinal symptoms presenting themselves which give certain indications forits homeopathic employment. Symptoms of incoordination, loss ofcontrol and want of balance everywhere, mentally and physically, trembling in affected parts. Emaciation is progressive. Paraplegia. Ascending paralysis. Parts seem enlarged or bound up. Pains increase and decrease gradually. The cases of epilepsy calling for this drug are those caused by fright or occurring at the menstrual period. For days or hours before the attack the pupils are dilated and after the attack the patient is very restless and has trembling of the hands. Impulse to walk very fast (Lil-t.). Suitable to businessmen, students. Very characteristic is the great desire for sweets, the splinter-like pains and free muco-purulent discharge in inflamed and ulcerated mucus membranes. Sensation as if a part were expanding and other errors of perception are characteristic. Pains increase and decrease gradually. Muco-purulent discharges and splinter like pains. Faint and tremulous. Flatulent state and prematurely aged look. Explosive belching, especially in neurotics. Upper abdominal disorders brought on by undue mental exertion. Paraplegia, myelitis .and disseminated sclerosis of brain and cord. Intolerance of heat. Sensation of a sudden pinch (Dudgeon). Destroys red blood corpuscles, producing anemia. MIND - Nervous impulsive and hurried, yet timid and anxious. Panic and anxiety attacks. Dreads ordeals. Anticipation, apprehension and fear, when ready to go to doctor, dentist, church, etc. Diarrhea from anticipating upcoming events. Performance, anxiety. Examinations, fear of taking tests. Thinks that all his undertakings will and must fail. Fears, phobias and anxieties. Fears projecting corners of buildings and high buildings. Fear of heights. Fearsome. Fear °f flying in airplanes. Fear of impending evil. Fear of crowds. Fear of dark. Claustrophobia. Fear of fainting. Fear of being too late. Fear of failing. Fear of having a panic attack. Fear of losing self- control. Peculiar mental impulses. Impulse to jump when crossing a bridge or from a window. Impulsive, wants to do things in a hurry (Lil-t.). Walks rapidly from anxiety. Fear of passing a certain point of high buildings. Imagines he cannot pass a certain point (Kali-br.). The sight of high buildings makes him giddy and causes him to stagger, it seems as if houses on both sides of street would approach and crush him. Tormented by strange ideas and emotions. Irrational, does strange things and comes to strange conclusions, does foolish things. Hidden irrational motives for actions. Delusion he is despised. Thinks about killing himself. Obstinate, against whatever was proposed, he had the queerest objection. Errors ofperception. Time passes slowly (Cann-i.). Time seems short, wants to do things in a hurry, must walk fast, etc. Brain fag. Memory weak. Perversion of senses. Indifference while in company. Loss of ambition. Melancholic, apprehensive of serious disease. Fear of some incurable disease. Forsaken feeling. Sensation of isolation. Desire to talk. Hesitates, falters in speech in gait, etc. Childish talk. Talks about his sufferings. Talks of one subject. Believes that all his undertakings will fail. Weeps, says he is lost beyond hope.

Head - Nervous headache with coldness and trembling. Headaches, worse mental exertion, dancing, better tight bandaging. Head as if in a vise. Sensation of expansion. Brain fatigue with general debility and trembling. Aching in frontal eminence with enlarged feeling in corresponding eye. Boring pain, better on tight bandaging and pressure. Itching of scalp. Hemicrania, bones of head feel as if separated. As if skull bones were separated. Headache ends in vomiting. Headaches of hysterical young women, delicate literary persons. Itching, crawling sensation on the scalp.

Eyes - Acute conjunctivitis. Great swelling of conjunctiva, discharge abundant and purulent. Eyestrain from sewing, worse in warm room. Aching, tired feeling in eyes, better closing or pressing upon them. Useful in restoring power to the weakened ciliary muscles. Inner canthi swollen and red. Photophobia in warm room. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Painful purulent ophthalmia. Chronic ulceration of margin of lids, sore, thick, swollen. Unable to keep eyes fixed steadily. Opacity of cornea. Ulcer in cornea. Pterygium of pink color. Blepharitis, thick crusts on eyelids. Pupils dilated. Chemosis. Eye symptoms worse with abdominal symptoms.

Ears - Tearing pain in ears. Sharp pain from right to left ear, with congestion to head. Buzzing in ears with vertigo. Ringing with deafness. Whizzing in left ear, with feeling of obstruction and hard hearing. Fullness and ringing.

Nose - Nasal bones painful as if bruised. Nasal discharge like boiled starch. Discharge of whitish pus, with clots of blood. Nosebleed during menopause. Loss of smell. Violent itching. Coryza with chilliness, lachrymation andheadache. Violent itching, rubs it. Ulcers in septum.

Face - Sunken, old, pale and bluish. Face yellow, dirty looking. Old man's look, tight drawing of skin over bones. Sickly, sunken, grayish of muddy color. Infraorbital neuralgia, left side. Prosopalgia, almost taking away eyesight. Drops of sweat on face.

Mouth - Fetor from mouth. Taste coppery like ink. Canker sores. Stringent, sour or bitter-sour taste. Food escapes from mouth during chewing. Cannot talk, spasms of muscles of tongue and throat. Stammers. Tough mucus in mouth. Ptyalism. Lips dry and viscid, without thirst. Lips tremble while speaking. Lips blue.

Throat - Burning and dryness in fauces and pharynx. Much thick mucus in throat and mouth causes hawking. Raw, rough and sore. Uvula and fauces dark red. Sensation as if a splinter in throat, when swallowing, breathing or moving the neck better cool drinks. Dark redness of throat catarrh of smokers with tickling as of hair in throat. Strangulated feeling. Swallowing difficult. Chronic induration of tonsils. Food lodges in pharynx. Smoker's catarrh with sensation as of a hair in throat. Loss of voice. Chronic laryngitis of singers. Raising the voice causes cough, high notes cause cough. Chronic hoarseness.

Stomach - Alcoholic gastritis. Belching with most gastric ailments. Ineffectual effort at eructation. Gastroenteritis. Flatulence, painful swelling of stomach. Enormous distension. Painful spot over stomach that radiates to all parts of the abdomen. Gnawing ulcerating pain. burning and constriction. Trembling and throbbing in stomach. Enormous distention. Ulcerative pain in left side under ribs. Ulceration with radiating pain. Deathly nausea during headache, not better after vomiting. Nausea, retching, vomiting of glairy mucus. Astringent sour or bitter vomiting. Vomiting with diarrhea and violent colicky pains.

Abdomen - Rumbling, gurgling. Flatulence causing distention and bursting of abdomen. Loud, explosive belchings discharged upwards and downwards. Shivering through bowels, extending up the back. Colic with much gas and distention. Constriction in bowels, as if tightly tied with a band. Sharp ulcerative pain on left side, below short ribs. Cutting pain with loud rumbling. Spasms of diaphragm.

Rectum - Diarrhea from emotions, worse immediately after eating and drinking. Diarrhea from anticipation. Diarrhea after any emotion with flatulence. Nervous diarrhea after sugar candy. Diarrhea of children after weaning. Fluids go right through him after sweets. Constipation, alternates with diarrhea. Hemorrhoidal pain in morning. Itching of anus. Tenia or threadworms.

Stool - Stools, shreddy, mucus, turning green like chopped spinach. Watery, noisy, flatulent stools. Stools, green like chopped spinach with shreddy mucus and enormous distention of abdomen, very offensive.

Male - Chancre like ulcers, on the prepuce. Testes drawn up high. Genitals shrivel. Desire waning. Cutting in urethra with painful erection. Sex painful, urethra as if put on stretch or sensitive at orifice. Impotency. Erection fails when sex is attempted. Cancer-like ulcers. Ulcers on prepuce.

Female - Pain in stomach and spasmodic contraction in chest before menses. Menses scanty with dyspnea. Menses, irregular too soon too late or last one day only. Menses with headache. Metrorrhagia with nervous weakness at menopause, also of young widows and childless women. Leucorrhea profuse with erosion of cervix, bleeding easily. Leucorrhea mucus, bloody, corroding, yellow and profuse. Prolapsed uterus. Uterine hemorrhage, two weeks after menses, painful disorders of left ovary. Ovaries painful with pains radiating to sacrum and thighs. Itching of skin and flushes of heat during menopause. Disposition to miscarriage. Infertility. Puerperal convulsions. Orgasms at night. Sex painful, followed by bleeding. Food - Desire for cheese and salt. Loss of appetite. Appetite good, but every kind of food disagrees. Hypoglycemia. Eating relives nausea but aggravates stomach pain. Better after warm drinks. Better sourthings, smoking. Better after alcohol. Great craving for sweets. Craves sugar, which disagrees. Desires for cheese and salt. Desires ice cream, fat and sweets. Craves plum sauce. Worse from coffee. Worse cold drinks

Chest - Angina pectoris with nightly aggravation. Intense spasm of chest muscles. Feels as if a bar were around chest. Painful spots in chest. Pain in the chest on putting boots. As if weight of stone in middle of the sternum. Constitutions - Withered up and dried constitutions, especially when associated with unusual or long continued mental exertion. It corresponds to Grauvogl's carbo-nitrogenoid constitution (Sulph., Cupr.) in higher to the hydrogenoid or sycotic constitution. Hysteric nervous persons, headaches from mental causes characterized by dullness of head. Women with menstrual disturbances. Cachetic state. Scrawny, feeble, dried-up-looking women. Guernsey put it, “withered and dried up by disease. A child looks like a withered old man.”

Heart - Angina pectoris. Organic heart troubles of business men, students and brain workers. Burning feeling in region of heart. Anxiety with palpitations and throbbing throughout the whole body. Palpitations with nausea. Palpitations, worse lying on right side (Alumn.). Palpitations, worse riding in car, better pressing by hand. Unpleasant sensation of fullness about the heart better fresh open air. Sensation as if heart would stop beating, when sitting quietly. Pulse is irregular intermittent.

Back - Much pain. Spine sensitive with nocturnal pains (Ox-ac.). Paraplegia. Posterior spinal sclerosis. Pain in the small of the back worse rising from sitting better standing or walking. Throbbing in spine or weak spine. Glands of the neck indurated. Weakness in sacro-iliac symphysis as if bones were loose. Heaviness in sacrum, as before menses. Glands of neck indurated. Breasts - Sore nipples from nursing. Causations - Anticipation. Apprehension, fear or fright. Eating ices. Mental strain and worry. Masturbation and sexual excesses. Intemperate habits. Sugar. Tobacco.

Limbs - Lassitude and weariness of forearm and legs with trembling. Cannot walk with eyes closed. Trembling with general debility. Trembling of hands, cannot write. Numbness of arms. Numbness of fingertips, ring and little fingers. Fingers half Argentum nitricum clenched, cannot be separated. Paralysis with mental and abdominal symptoms. Weakness, rigidity or twisting in calves. Walks and stands unsteadily, especially when unobserved. Post- diphtheria paralysis (Gels.). Chorea-like convulsions, with the legs drawn up, arms jerked outwards and upwards. Peripheral neuralgias. Edema of legs. Legs feel as if made of wood or padded. Paraplegia after debilitating causes. As if a weight hanging to coccyx. Lungs - Asthma, worse summer, cold weather or taking cold. Asthmatic attacks from going up stairs or bodily exertion. Suffocative cough, as if from a hair in throat. Dyspnea. Craves fresh air. Many people in a room seem to take away his breath. Panting, quick, sibilant breathing. Rawness, soreness, high up in trachea worse coughing. Crowded rooms takes away his breath. Desire to take deep breath which aggravates the dyspnea. Craves fresh air. Asthma, worse in summer in cold weather or taking cold.

Sleep - Drowsy stupor. Sleepless from fancies before his imagination. Ailments from long, wearisome, fatiguing night watching. Restless sleep, awakes almost every hour, disturbed with many dreams. Horrible dreams of snakes, wakes in fright. Dreams he is hungry. Dreams of sexual gratification.

Skin - Brown, tense and hard. Drawing in skin, as from a spider-web or dried albuminous substance withered and dried up. Irregular blotches. Ulcers, angry, deep with hard edges. Warty granulations. Adherent crusts. Bedsores. Bluish-black eruption. Scarlet fever.

Modalities - Better from open air, fresh air. Better cool air, cold, cold bath. Better from hard pressure. Better motion. Better belching. Better from bending double, pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse anxiety, apprehension. Worse fear or fright. Worse from suspense. Worse from mental strain and worry. Worse warmth in any form. Worse at night. Worse from cold food, cold drinks. Worse ice cream. Worse sugar, sweets. Worse after eating. Worse leftside. Worse in aroom in closed, small places. Worse lying on right side. Worse looking down. Worse from drinking, crowds. Worse from warmth in any form. Worse before and during menses. Worse from riding. Worse thinking intently.

Teeth - Gums tender and bleed easily. Pain in healthy teeth. Teeth pain worse chewing, cold things, sour things.

Tongue - Red streak down middle of tongue. Tongue has prominent papilla. Tongue tip is red and painful. Tongue furred with clean edges. Aphthae on edges of the tongue. Tongue coated white. ,Vertigo - Vertigo with buzzing in ears and with nervous disorders. Vertigo before epilepsy. Vertigo looking down from heights. Vertigo with transient blindness. Vertigo worse closing eyes. Vertigo with cerebral congestion. Vertigo - Vertigo at sight of high buildings. Vision - Spots before the vision. Blurred vision. Distorted vision. Misty vision. Diplopia, from rush of blood to head. Sight worse by candlelight, than by daylight. Black motes, before right eye. Dim vision on thinking intently, with headache. Grey spots and serpent-like bodies moving before eyes. Vanishing vision must constantly wipe away mucus. Farsighted. Paralysis of accommodation from errors of refraction. COMMENTS - Among the key symptoms of Arg-n. are great tremor, nervous feeling, and sensation as if being squeezed in a vice. Feeling of constriction in various parts as if a band of iron around chest or waist. A feeling as if the body or some part of the body was expanding. Migraine with feeling as if head were enormously enlarged, better tightly bound. Defective coordination. Paralysis of motion and sensation, a peculiar numbness accompanied with hyperesthesia. Sensation of a splinter sticking in various parts. Burning sensations. In allopathic practice the dyspepsia for which it is given is worse before food, when the stomach is empty. The opposite condition is the leading indication in homeopathic practice. Gowers recorded a case in which the use of Arg-n. for stomach trouble caused (like lead), drop-wrist, gout and albuminuria. E. P. Brewer recorded a proving in which the prover, a young man, took on three consecutive days one grain a day of Arg-n. triturated with sugar of milk. A number of motor and sensory symptoms were elicited, reminding Brewer of locomotor ataxia for which it has been used with success by old- school practitioners. This use also has led to many cases of ar- gyria. Among the symptoms of this proving were “Mental operations sluggish, continued thought required special effort, but exertion of mind did not aggravate the heaviness and fullness of head. Lower limbs fatigued, as if they would suddenly fail him. Loss of ambition. Building air castles by day: monstrous dreams by night.” Other symptoms were sore throat with white patches, rheumatic pains in (left) wrist and finger joints with external tenderness of bony prominences, pain on rising in right sacroiliac notch. Sore muscles of neck and back. Urticaria spots in various parts. In poisoning cases complete loss of consciousness insensibility and convulsions have occurred. Some of the notable digestive symptoms are: “Irresistible desire for sugar. Fluids go right through him.” Belching ac- companies most gastric disorders. Green stools are remarkable. Green mucus like chopped spinach in flakes. Stool turning green after remaining on diaper. Stool expelled with much spluttering. Stool shreddy, red, green muco-lymph orepithelial substance. There is a pain in the small of the back, better on standing or walking, but severe when rising from a seat (Sulph., Caust.). Mucus membranes affected, purulent and bloody discharges, membranous diarrhea with agonizing pains. Epithelium affected (cancers). Intestinal catarrh with shreddy membranous discharges is often cured by Arg-n. Most symptoms are worse night, very nervous at night. Worse at night or in morning on rising (epileptic attacks). Day half more cough, night half more diarrhea. Worse on awaking. At 11 a.m. nervous attacks better by stimulants. Chill down back every day at noon. A large number of symptoms appear on the left side. Grimmer notes that it's used along with Natrum Mur to antidote the effects of silver nitrate cauterization. For example, of the nose, and sometimes they do the uterus, the cervix, to stop bleeding, any place. Parkinson's paralysis, or disorders after stroke, loss of motor control, especially on left. Good for multiple sclerosis. Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are important indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears anirestlessness with trembling hands, skin cancers. Severe blood sugar problems, acute or chronic sugar poisoning, hypoglycemia, diabetes. Consider Arg-n., a left-sided Lycopodium. Voracious, canine desire for sweets. Bingeing on sweets. Can become angry or irritable after sugar. Also craves salt. Another keynote is gas and bloating, then low blood sugar. They can have a splinter-like sensation in the throat. It's specific for laryngitis. Hoarseness, sore throat. Epilepsy from frights. Diarrhea from anxiety. Headache from over studying, eye strain. Conjunctivitis, looks like raw meat, pus green and yellow in color. Majorphobiaremedy. Panic attacks when low blood sugar. They have a lot of fears of fainting, fears of having a fit in public, fears of epilepsy, the general idea is fears of losing control. Fear of something bad happening, “impending doom.” Superstitions, rituals, conspiracy paranoia. “Fear of being poisoned,” anxiety over health. Fear of death, may predict their own death (Agn.). In late stages, fear of their own thoughts. Tormenting thoughts and impulses, repeating thoughts. Over-active mental plane, anticipation leading to worry. For anticipation, stage fright to the point here they get diarrhea (Gels., Aeon.). Gastrointestinal symptoms with anxiety. Vertigo due to anxiety. Concentration problems, brain degeneration, early senility with strong imaginations. Symptoms worse at night. Hasty walk, keynote, they walk so fast that the upper body is leaned forward. Neurological deficiencies and incoordination of walking, staggering gaits. Keynote craving of sugar, which aggravates. The aggravation of the sugar is as strong as their craving. Sugar causes headaches, anxiety, irritability, and low blood sugar. Severe gas and bloating. Craves salt and strong cheese (Puls, Ign, Rhus-t.). Worse heat, skin may be cool, but they think they are hot (Sec.). Desires company, open, forward with a lot of vitality. Strong emotional nature. Impulsive, instinctive expression of emotions. Happy, easy-going high sexual power. High sex drive, loss of erection or premature ejaculation due to overexcitement and anticipation. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Am-caust., effects of tobacco. Nat-m., Ars.. Milk. Antidotes to: Puls., Calc., Sep., next in importance, Lyc., Sil., Rhus-t., Phos., Sulph. Compare: (1) Ars., Merc., Phos., Puls. (2) Arg-cy. - angina pectoris, asthma, spasm of esophagus. (3) Argent, iodat. - throat disorders, hoarseness, gland affected. (4) Argent, phos. - an excellent diuretic in dropsy. (5) Arg-oxyd. - chlorosis with menorrhagia and diarrhea. (6) Arg-m. - acts on cartilages, Arg-n. more on mucus membranes, skin, bone and periosteum and is suited to herpetic patients. (7) to Aur., Cupr., Kali-bi„ Lach., Merc., Merc-c., Merc-i., Nairn., Nit-ac..Thuj. (8) In complaints from pressure of clothes like Calc.. Bry., Caust., Lyc., Sars., Stann. (9) In congestive headaches like Glon. and other Nit-ac„ Hep., worse by cold, Arg-n. worse in warm room. (10) Puls, is its nearest analog. Inimical: Coff. ( it increases the nervous headache). Follows well: Bry., Spig. (dyspepsia). Spongia (goiter), Caust. (urethral affections), Verat-a. (flatus). Is followed well by: Lyc. (flatus). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Violent pain from kidney to bladder, worse touch, motion and deep inspiration. Touching region of kidneys increases pain. Urethra inflamed with pain, burning, itching, pain as from a splinter. Emission of a few drops after having finished. Urethritis with pain, increased gonorrhea, priapism, dysuria, bloody urine andfever. Early stage of gonorrhea, profuse discharge and terrible cutting pains, bloody urine. Urging to urinate, urine passes less easily and freely. Retention of urine. Sugar in urine. Divided stream. Urine passes unconsciously, day and night. Yellow bloody urine. Urine is highly colored, dark red with albumin. Urine scanty and dark.

Cough - Cough is worse laughing, stooping, smoking, ascending stairs before menses. High notes causes cough. Suffocative cough, at noon. Cough when angered.

Perspiration - Sweats in morning or at night. Profuse sweat on the face in beads. Sweat and chilliness as soon as he gets warm in bed.

Temperature - Chills with nausea. Chilly- when uncovered, yet feels smothered if wrapped up. Chilly with many complaints. Chills with cold hands and feet. Constant chilliness up back and over shoulders. Intermittent fever, with hemorrhage from lungs. Fever with no thirst.

name: Aristolochia Clematitis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better during menses. Better from elimination of secretion. Worse from suppression. Worse before and after menses..

Insomnia. Laryngitis. Mastitis. Menopause. Metritis. Nephritis. Premenstrual syndrome. Rheumatism. Spasmodic colitis. Sinusitis. Vaginitis. Varicose veins. Vertigo.

full:
PHARMACY - arist-cl. Aristolochiaclematitis. Common biithwort. Aristolochia infesta. N. O. Aristolochiaceae. Europe, South America, Asia. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Anorexia. Arthritis. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chills. Colic. Cystic mastitis. Cystitis. Depression. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Enteritis. Hormonal, imbalances. Insomnia. Laryngitis. Mastitis. Menopause. Metritis. Nephritis. Premenstrual syndrome. Rheumatism. Spasmodic colitis. Sinusitis. Vaginitis. Varicose veins. Vertigo.

HERBAL - Aristolochia Clematitis, of the Aristolochiaceae family, grows in Southern Europe and South America. Its active principle is clematine, which is identical to the Aristolochia or the Serpentarin as well as to non-purified Aristolochic acid. Aristolochic acid causes menorrhagia, tends towards miscarriage, and has a toxic action on the kidneys and liver parenchyma as well as intestinal mucus membranes. “Aristos” means better, “locheia” means giving birth. Used in popular medicine to induce birth or stimulant the menses. Also as a diuretic, and against rheumatism. In high doses it is an emetic and cathartic. In South America, some Aristolochia are used for blindness.

HOMEOPATHIC - The proving by Mezger made use of the spring rhizome. The experiment was carried out by eighteen provers, of whom thirteen were women. The potencies 5x, 2x, 12x and the mother tincture were used in the proving. The experiment lasted for twelve weeks. It produced excess of estrogen hormones. Marked affect on the urinary passages, kidneys, venous system, skin. Irregular menses. Premenstrual insomnia with agitation and congestion of the pelvis. Joint pains improved by movement. State of fatigue, or the opposite. Worn out with vertigo, chilliness, slightly improved by heat. Hunger pangs and need to eat despite feeling nausea. Tendency to plumpness. MIND - Sensation of solitude. Fearforthe future. Rejects company. Psychosomatic complaints tending towards depression, especially in women who are going through the menopause (Sep.). Depression, ameliorated by fresh air and menses. Mental condition aggravated before and after periods, clearly ameliorated during menstrual flow.

Head - Diffuse headaches, improved in the fresh air and by cold, damp compresses. Congestive headache (Bell.).

Eyes - Watering aggravated by light, reading. Burning and itching.

Nose - Sinusitis. Coryza in the morning, improved by getting up, by fresh air. Watery flow, improved between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m.

Mouth - Mouth painful, with cracked corners of the lips. Teeth painful, aggravated by cold food, ameliorated by hot food.

Throat - Throat discolored, yellow, dry. Tonsils inflamed, swallowing painful. Laryngitis. Vertigo - Vertigo with headache in the morning, worse when learning forwards. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls. - close therapeutic relationship, acting on the same type of patient. (2) Calen. - which is also an excellent healing plant. (3) Rhus-t. - also shows amelioration from movement. REFERENCES - Julian.

Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia.

Abdomen - Colic. Spasmodic colitis. Enteritis. Abdomen distended, painful, before and during menses. Breasts - Pain and feeling of hardening of the left breast. Pain in the breast. Cystic mastitis.

Rectum - Rectum prolapsed after eating. Rectal weakness. Mucus diarrhea, hemorrhoid bleeding between stools, which contain mucus.

Female - Brown discharge, watery flow. Eczema of the vulva. Sensual itching, aggravated before menses, ameliorated during menses, aggravated after menses. Menses absent, late or short, Blood black, withclotting. Varicocele. Dysmenorrhea. Infrequent menses. Amenorrhea. Metritis. After-pains with laryngitis. Vaginitis. Food - Anorexia, nausea with vertigo and cold sensations.

Chest - Chest feels hard, like a breastplate. Constitutions - Hormonal imbalances. Subjects of a nervous constitution, with extreme sensitivity, and who cry easily. Tubercular conditions of the “worn-out” type.

Limbs - Arthritis in women, with menopause. Rheumatism of the knee. Limbs cold, with chilblains, skin discolored or red. Legs heavy before menses. Joint pains improved by movement, aggravated in the sitting position. Fingers and toes swollen before menses. Swollen, distended varicosities before menses. Varicose veins. Lungs - Bronchitis. Angina, laryngitis with hoarseness. Morning cough, thorax painful on left side.

Skin - Varicose eczema. Acrocyanosis in young girls. Burns, also for external use in compresses of liquid extract at 15%, diluted 1:50 in water.

Modalities - Better during menses. Better from elimination of secretion. Worse from suppression. Worse before and after menses.

Kidneys - Pain in the kidneys and bladder with a frequent urination. Bedwetting, especially in older women. Incontinence and compelling need to urinate. Pyelitis. Cystitis. Albuminuria with white discharge.

Temperature - Chilliness.

CLINICAL - Achilles tendon. Diabetes. Extravasations. Heart, pain.

HOMEOPATHIC - In a proving by Mure, prominent among the key symptoms were sharp and pricking pains in various parts. Pain at apex of heart stopping breath. Excoriations of lips and gums. Cramp-like pains in left Achilles tendon. Stitching pains in various parts. Pain in heels, burning in anus and frequent irritation. The whole leg is covered with large irregular patches formed by extravasated blood. Pain in back and limbs. Stiffness of legs. Itching and swelling around the malleoli. The mouth is pasty in the morning. Anorexia. Flatulence in stomach and abdomen. Colic followed by diarrhea. Burning at anus. Disturbed rest. Disgusting dreams. Head burning hot. Great thirst and bitter mouth, makes water more frequently than usual. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aristolochia Serpentaria. REFERENCES Clarke.

PHARMACY - arist-s. Aristolochia serpentaria. Virginia snake-root. Serpentary. N. O. Aris- tolochiacae.Triturationofdried roots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Poison oak.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aristolochia serpentaria was proved by Jorg's provers and others. Chief effects were noticed in the gastro-enteric organs, nausea, vomiting, abdominal distention, flatulence and urging to stool. Increased, and afterwards lost, appetite. Symptoms of intestinal tract, diarrhea, meteorism. Flatulent dyspepsia. Distention and cutting pains in abdomen. Irritation of the urinary and genital organs with frequent desire to urinate. Disturbed rest, also heat of the head (Arist-m.). Brain congestion. Symptoms like those of poison oak. MIND - Peevish mood. Disinclination for work.

Head - Sticking in forehead extending to base of brain. Increased warmth of head.

Mouth - Copious salivation with frequent spitting.

Stomach - Increased appetite, yet able to eat little, since the first morsels satisfy. Loss of appetite. Nausea and vomiting, vomiting did not cease until the stomach was entirely emptied. Distended feeling as if too full. Heaviness better by emission of much flatus.

Abdomen - Colic in umbilical region. Distention, rumbling, uneasiness, cutting pains, with emission of flatus, belchings which relieve. •

Stool - Distressing itching about anus. Frequent desire with evacuation of more gas than feces. Frequent desire for stool with evacuation of scanty, hard, tenacious feces with much flatulence. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Back - Pressive pain in nape of neck.

Kidneys - General irritation of urinary and genital organs. Violent desire to urinate with great increase in quantity of urine. Frequent desire but only a little brownish urine passed.

name: Arnica Montana
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from lying down. Better lying outstretched. Better with head low. Better motion. Better clear, cold, stimulating weather. Worse evening and night. Worse from injuries. Worse from falls, blows, bruises, shock. Worse jarring, noise. Worse after labor, over-exertion, sprains. Worse least touch. Worse motion. Worse rest. Worse alcohol, wine. Worse damp cold. Worse after sleep. Worse coal gas. Worse lying on left side..
constitution: Abscess. Aching, pains. Back, pains. Baldness. Bedsores. Black eye. Blows. Boils. Brain disorders. Breath, fetid. Bronchitis. Bruises. Carbuncle. Chest, disorders. Chorea. Concussions. Contusions. Coms. Cramp. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ec- chymosis. Exhaustion. Eyes, disorders. Falls. Fatigue. Gout. Head, injury. Hematemesis, Hematoma. Hematuria. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Impotence. Influe

full:
PHARMACY - am. Arnica montana. Leopard's bane. Brusiewort. Fallkraut. Fall herb. N. O. Composite. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tmctureofroot.Historicaldose: All potencies. Arnica should not be used externally where there is broken skin. For tom and lacerated wounds, Calendula can be used locally.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Aching, pains. Back, pains. Baldness. Bedsores. Black eye. Blows. Boils. Brain disorders. Breath, fetid. Bronchitis. Bruises. Carbuncle. Chest, disorders. Chorea. Concussions. Contusions. Coms. Cramp. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ec- chymosis. Exhaustion. Eyes, disorders. Falls. Fatigue. Gout. Head, injury. Hematemesis, Hematoma. Hematuria. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Impotence. Influenza. Injuries. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Mastitis. Meningitis. Mental shock. Miscarriage. Over- lifting. Over-working. Paralysis. Pleurodynia. Purpura. Pyemia. Rheumatism. Shock. Spleen, pain. Sore, pains. Sprains. Stings. Strains. Strokes. Suppuration. Swellings. Taste, disorders. Thirst. Trauma. Traumatic, fever. Tumors. Typhoid. Voicedisorders. Whooping cough. Wounds. Yawning.

HERBAL - Growing on the mountains, Arnica may be said to possess a native affinity to the effects of falls. As its German name. Fallkraut, attests, its value as a vulnerary has been known from remote times. It may be said to be the traumatic par excellence. Ussher noted that the local use of Arnica produced an extraordinary growth of hair on a limb. This suggested the use of an oil mixed with Am. lx in a case of baldness, which was followed with marked success. Clarke once ran a piece of wire into the tip of one of his fingers, causing paralyzing pain. He applied Am., 1 x at once and the pain was better instantly seeming to be wiped out from the point of injury up the arm.

HOMEOPATHIC - Trauma and its effects, recent or remote is met by Arnica as by no other single dmg and the provings bring out the appropriateness of the remedy in the symptoms it causes. Tumors in many parts, following injury, have been cured by Arnica including scirrhus tumors of the breast. Nervous disorders as chorea after falls. Trauma in all its forms, and the recent or remote effects injuries are covered by this remedy. It produces conditions upon the system quite similar to those resulting from injuries, falls, blows, contusions. Compound fractures. Mental or physical shocks. After traumatic injuries, overuse of any organ, strains. Tinnitus aurium. It affects blood, causing putrid and septic conditions. Putrid phenomena. Septic conditions, prophylactic of pus infection. Strokes with a red, full face. It is especially suited to cases when any injury, however remote, seems to have caused the present trouble. Trauma of grief, remorse or sudden realization of financial loss. Arnica is disposed to cerebral congestion. Marked effect on the blood. Acts best in plethoric, feebly in debilitated with impoverished blood, cardiac dropsy with dyspnea. A muscular tonic. Thrombosis. Hematocele. Influenza with sore bruised muscles. Limbs and body ache as if beaten, joints as if sprained. Bed feels too hard or full of lumps. Great prostration, with a tired feeling. Discharges are foul, breath, taste, flatus, stools etc. Tendency to tissue degeneration, low septic conditions. Abscesses that do not mature. Typhoid, septic fevers. Recurring boils. Thrombosis. Sore, lame, bruisedfeeling. Rheumatism of muscles and tendons, especially of back and shoulders. Aversion to tobacco. Vaginitis in females and impotence in males from excessive sexual indulgence. MIND - Arnica is used after severe mental stress orshock.Mentaloremotionalshocks.Never well since a trauma, fright or grief. History of severe physical trauma with chronic men- tal or emotional effects. Accident, trauma victims. Nervous, can't bear pain, whole body oversensitive. Fear of being touched or injured. Feels like a wounded animal. Fear of the approach of anyone. Fear of sickness. Fear of instant death with heart distress. Fear at night. Fear on awakening. Agoraphobia. Fear of open spaces. Fear of crowds, public places. Violent attacks of anguish, anxiety with angina pectoris (Aeon.). Easily frightened, unexpected trifles cause him to start. Hypochondriacal anxiety. Fear remains at night after fright (Op.). A sudden fear that rouses one from sleep at night especially after an accident (Op.). Head injury or strokes that effect mental functions. Morose, repentant mood. Overworked and exhausted. Indifference to work. Depression from injuries to the head (Nat-s.). Forgetful, what he reads quickly escapes his mind. Absent-minded. Forgets the word he is about to say. Unconscious. When spoken to answers correctly, but relapses. Coma. Muttering delirium. Delirium tremens. Morose, delirious. Nervous and mental shock. Sits as if in thought. Says there is nothing the matter with him. Feels well in serious cases, because of shock. Sends the doctor home. Wants to be left alone. Prays quietly for her soul. Stupor, with involuntary discharge of feces, typhoid. Stupefaction, loss of sight and hearing, from concussion of brain.

Head - Hematoma. Head injury. Headaches from injury to head. Meningitis from injury to head. Periodical attacks of migraine. Hot head with a cold body. Brain feels tired. Burning in brain. Confused, sensitivity of brain with sharp, pinching pains. Stroke victims, with loss of consciousness, involuntary evacuations from bowels and bladder, paralysis. Head as if too large. Headache as from a nail. Headaches from strong emotions. Cold spot on the forehead. Burning or hot spots on vertex. Head throws backwards while walking. Baldness. Recurring boils on scalp. Scalp feels contracted.

Eyes - Bloodshot. Eyes sunken. Black eye from injury. Traumatic ulceration with much hemorrhage into anterior chamber. Expedites absorption of clots, in retinal hemorrhage. Bruised iris after cataract operations. Bruised, sore feeling in eyes after close work. Eyesfeel tired and weary after sightseeing, moving pictures. Lachrymationburning. Photophobia. Righteye protrudes, looks larger than left. Must keep eyes open, dizzy on closing them. Photophobia. Pupils contracted, dilated.

Ears - Shooting in and around ears. Blood from ears. Suppurating otitis with stupor. Cartilages of ears as if bruised. Bruised pain in external ears. Sensitive to shrill noise. Sensitivity to loud sounds. Hearing impaired from injury to the head. Dull hearing, after concussion. Hardness of hearing. Deafness after typhus. Noises in ear caused by rush of blood to the head. Humming.

Nose - Bruised, from above downward. Swelling of nose. Nosebleeds after injury. Nosebleeds after every fit of coughing after washing face, dark fluid blood. Nose feels sore, cold. Violent sneezing from overlifting. Nose feels sore, cold. Post-nasal drip. Catarrh of antrum. Burning pain in typhoid fever. Nosebleeds during typhoid fever. Ulcerated nostrils. Empyema of maxillary sinus.

Face - Face hot and red, with cold legs. Sunken, very red, pale. Acne sore and painful. Bruised pains. Chilliness during headache. Herpes in face. Ruddy, congested, bluish red in strokes, fevers. Lower jaw hangs down, paralysis. Redness and burning of one cheek. Cheeks puffed, red. Swelling of parotid gland during measles. Throbbing and stinging pain, in swollen cheeks.

Mouth - Soreness of gums after teeth extraction (Sep.). Dry and thirsty. Bitter taste (Coloc.). Taste as from bad eggs. Fetid breath. Taste disgusting, putrid, slimy. Bad taste after operation. Empyema of maxillary sinus. Bright red, puffy fauces. Saliva diminished. Swallowing is prevented by sort of nausea as if food would not go down. Heat in lips. Lips burn, swollen and cracked. Lower lip trembles, while eating.

Throat - Acute tonsillitis, swelling of soft palate and uvula. Bright red, puffy fauces. Burning, when swallowing. Stinging in back of throat. Raw, sore feeling. Crackling in trachea, when lying down. Hoarseness from overuse of voice. Hoarseness, worse exertion, colds or getting wet. Hoarseness early in morning. Voice deep or low, muttering.

Stomach - Belchings, tasting of bad eggs after coughing. Eructations of bitter mucus. Oppressive gases pass upward and downward. Stomach distended with wind. Pain in stomach during eating. Pinching, spasmodic griping pain in stomach. Pressure as from a stone. Feeling as if stomach were pressing against spine. As if a lump in stomach. Hiccough. Motion sickness. Nausea with burning and scratching in throat. Retching at night. Fetid vomiting. Vomiting of dark, red coagulated blood. Vomiting of blood after injuries. V omiting of food, mixed with blood. Stools - Dysenteric stools with muscular pains. Brown or white diarrhea. Offensive, brown, bloody,putrid involuntary stools. Stools look like brown yeast. Must lie down after every stool. Stools are bloody, foamy, purulent, acrid involuntary during sleep. Ribbon-like stools, from enlarged prostrate or retroverted uterus. Stools consisting of bloody, slimy mucus, with urging and violent bellyache. Undigested stools.

Abdomen - Colic, with retention of urine. Colic, resembling dysentery. Cramps from epigastrium down over the bowels, then foul stools. Tympanitic distension. Distended with offensive flatus. Flatus smelling of rotten eggs. Bruised pain, in sides of abdomen. Sharp pains from side to side. Sharp thrusts through abdomen. Sharp pain in region of spleen, taking away breath. Swashing in abdomen as from water.

Rectum - Flatus smelling of rotten eggs. Sensation of rumbling in rectum, without stools. Obstinate constipation after a blow on epigastrium. Straining of tenesmus in diarrhea. Dysentery with dysuria, in summer and autumn. Diarrhea at night, with cutting in intestines. Diarrhea of tuberculosis, worse lying on left side. Prolapsed anus, worse after walking for few minutes only better washing the whole body. Cramps in rectum, while standing. Anus as if bruised. Burning along perineum during urination.

Male - Genitals bruised and much swollen. Swelling of penis and scrotum, bluish-red. Hot swelling of scrotum after injury. Spermatic cords painfully swollen. Relaxed testicles. Hematocele. Phimosis from friction. Hydrocele caused by a bruise. Violent continued erections often waking. Seminal emission during caress. Impotence from sexual excess or abuse. Erysipelas of scrotum.

Female - Menses, early, hot, profuse. Uterine hemorrhage from mechanical injury after sex. Hemorrhages bright red or mixed with clots. Bloody discharge between menses. Ulcers of uterus with a tendency to bleed. Labia painfully swollen. Prolapsus caused by concussion. Ovarian region feels as if sprained, obliging her to walk bent. Threatened miscarriage from falls etc. Soreness of the whole body during pregnancy. Feeling as if fetus were lying crosswise. Cannot bear fetal movements, cause nausea and vomiting. Labor pains, weak orceasing. Bruised parts after labor. Soreness and lameness of parts after delivery. Puerperal fever. Violent after-pains, worse breast-feeding. Food - Loss of appetite. Loathing very sight of food. Canine hunger. Loss of appetite and sourness of stomach of brandy drinkers, creates a disgust for brandy. Aversion to milk and meat. Aversion to broth, smoking tobacco. Longing for vinegar. Desires sour, alcoholic drinks. Constant desire to drink, but knows not what for, as all drinks are offensive. Thirst with dry mouth.

Chest - Burning or rawness in chest. Sharp pains under false ribs. Bruised, aching sensation in chest on walking. Sensation as if all ribs were bruised, when coughing. Bones and cartilages of chest are painful, worse motion, breathing or coughing. Heavy sensation lower chest. Sharp pains in chest, taking the breath away, better pressure. Pain in intercostal muscles. Pleurodynia (Ran-b.. Bry., Cimic.). Constitutions - Adapted to sanguine, plethoric persons, disposed to cerebral congestion. Persons easily made train-sick or seasick. It is suited to persons who are sensitive to mechanical injuries and who feel the effects of them long after. Teste noted it for plethoric red-faced persons.

Heart - Sudden pain as if heart is squeezed or had got a shock. Strain of heart from violent running. Weakened heart muscles. Palpitations after any exertion. Palpitations after any shock or injury. Palpitations shake the whole body. Angina pectoris, with severe pain in elbow of left arm. Sharp pain in heart. Heart pains, left to right. Horror of constant death with cardiac distress at night. Cardiac dropsy with distressing dyspnea. Fatty heart and hypertrophy. Pulse feeble and irregular. Weak fluttering of pulse. Pulse hurried. Pulse quicker than beat of heart.

Back - Backache from muscle strain, overuse. Great soreness and pain in back, as if bruised or beaten. Back sore and aches, worse overlifting. Agonizing pain in back and hips before urination. Bruises on back from injuries, blows. Violent pain, in spine, as after sudden rising up after long stooping. Cervical vertebrae tender. Muscles of neck weak, head falls backwards or any side. Sacrum as if beaten.

Limbs - Sore and bruised limbs. Soreness after overexertion. Sprained and dislo- cated feeling. Lame feeling. Great fear of being touched or approached. Pain in back and limbs, as if bruised or beaten. Limbs ache as if beaten. Everything on which he lies seems too hard. Bed feels too hard. Heaviness in all limbs. Deathly coldness of forearm. Joint, muscle pain from injury. Cannot walk erect, on account of bruised pain in pelvic region. Sore, aching muscles with influenza. Gout. Rheumatism begins low down and works up (Led.). Rheumatism, from exposure to dampness, cold. Rheumatism from excessive muscular strain. Cramps in the fingers, writer's cramp. Pain in arms better hanging down. Want of strength in the hands on grasping. Veins of hands distended. Knee joints suddenly bend when standing. Feet numb.

Sleep - Unrefreshing sleep. Involuntary stools during sleep. Sleepless and restless when overtired. Can't fall asleep, fantastical illusions while lying awake. Frequent yawning in evening, without sleepiness. Yawning before chill. Comatose drowsiness, awakens with hot head, drops to sleep as he answers. Nightmares. Horrors in the night. When dreaming sees black forms of spectres, ghosts, spirits. Dreams of death. Dreams of being buried alive, suffocation. Dreams of mutilated bodies. Anxious and terrible dreams, awakes in terror, then sleepless. Awful dreams, of robbers and murderers.

Skin - Ecchymosis. Bruises from injury. Every little injury makes bruises. Black and blue spots. Eruptions after trauma. Red, hot, edematous. Hot, hard, shining swelling, from insect stings. Dusky, mottled. Acne indurata, characterized by symmetry in distribution. Very sore acne. Itching, burning, eruption of small pimples. After scratching, itching begins somewhere else. Tingling and itching which moves from pk"e to place. Crops of small boils (Ichthy., Sil.). Carbuncles. Bedsores. Petechiae. Erysipelas. Scarlet fever when the eruption doesn't come out. Erythema nodosum. Corns. Varicose ulcers.

Modalities - Better from lying down. Better lying outstretched. Better with head low. Better motion. Better clear, cold, stimulating weather. Worse evening and night. Worse from injuries. Worse from falls, blows, bruises, shock. Worse jarring, noise. Worse after labor, over-exertion, sprains. Worse least touch. Worse motion. Worse rest. Worse alcohol, wine. Worse damp cold. Worse after sleep. Worse coal gas. Worse lying on left side.

Teeth - Swollenjaw after dental work. Pains after dental work, injuries. Soreness of gums after teeth extraction (Sep.). Gums sore, swollen during dentition. Sore and aching after trauma. Beating and tingling in gums, during toothache. Throbbing, toothache. Excruciating, cutting, tearing, in teeth.

Tongue - Tongue dry, almost black. Biting, burning and scraping at root of tongue. Tongue, dry, almost black. Red stripe down centre of tongue. Tongue coated white. Tongue coated yellow. Tongue dry with brown streak down middle. Vertigo - Chronic vertigo, objects whirl about especially when walking. Vertigo of the elderly. Vertigo with nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Vertigo worse walking, sitting erect, closing eyes. Vertigo worse, head injury. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo on rising and on moving. Vision - Diplopia from trauma, muscular paralysis, retinal hemorrhage. Diplopia, with vertigo, on looking downward. High objects appear to lean forward and about to fall. Flickering, worse reading or writing, with headache. Lost vision, after a violent blow. On reading, print seems to dance in a fog and vanish, must rub eyes. Muscae volitantes. Obscured, lost vision, during headache. COMMENTS - Arnica is allied to wounds and cures hemorrhages of many kinds including strokes, dilatation and rupture of small bloodvessels. Vomiting, coughing, purging, accompanied by streaks of blood in vomit. Extravasation of blood into the conjunctiva as in whooping cough. Hemorrhages into the tissues of internal organs or the skin. An odd symptom of Arnica is “coldness of the nose.” A case of facial (left) neuralgia, face swollen, dark red, very painful to touch, was cured with Arnica (radix), the guiding symptom being “cold nose.” Patient had bitter taste, was very excitable and worse at night. Effects of violent cough or sneezing, the child cries before cough comes on (or with the cough) in whooping cough. Chronic bronchitis when patients have bruised, weak aching in the chest or great sensitiveness of the chest on exertion or walking. Arn. affects the left upper extremity and the right chest. Putrid excretions (Bapt.), putrid breath, fetid sweat. Incessant passing of stool and urine in putrid states. Nash gave “Stupor with involuntary discharge of feces and urine.” “Fears being touched or struck by those coming near him.” “Putrid smell from mouth.” “Bruised, sore feeling in uterine region, cannot walk erect.” “While answering falls into a deep stupor before finishing.” “Head alone or face alone, hot, rest of body cool.” “Many small boils, painful, one after another, extremely sore.” “Suddenness” is a feature of Arn. pains and action. P. P. Wells related a cure of double pleuro-pneumonia in a child with sudden stabbing pains on both sides of the chest almost preventing breathing. Arnica instantly caused a violent aggravation, the next instant relief was perfect and the child fell asleep breathing naturally. Keynote sore, bruised feeling. Bluish discoloration, bruising, better cold applications. The bed feels too hard. Fatigue, “fear of being approached,” an animal-like fear of guarding a wounded area. Can believe nothing is wrong when severely injured, sign of shock (Op.). Patient may be irritable and want to be left alone. Can have amnesia, or nightmares after injury or loss of confidence since injury. Intermittent fear of death. A major goutremedy, afraid of joints being touched. Good for flus and mono when there is a sore, achy feeling all over. Also acute muscle fatigue in athletes. Superficial tissue trauma. Boils that feel sore and bruised. Comas from trauma and injury. Any fever with a sore, bruised feeling. For chronic weak joints after repeated injuries. Shock due to trauma or shock from the injury itself. For grief and financial shock. Good for overexertion. It's also used for trauma from blows from blunt instruments, sprains. For post-stroke victims, for injuries and hematomas. For heart attacks from overexertion. For internal bleeding. Achi- ness and weakness from the weight of the baby in pregnant women. For people who have a tendency to bruise easily. Vertigo, worse head injuries and strokes. Also for severe illness when the patient goes into the stupor stage. Good after dental work. For vomiting of blood after injury to the abdominal region or injury to the uterus. Sensitive to cold damp weather, and hot sun. Worse from touch. Alcohol will aggravate the condition, but may crave alcohol to relieve pain. Also worse tobacco. Sensation worse after an adjustment to spine (Ruta., Rhus- t.). RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph. Vitex trifolia. Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon., Bapt., Bell-p., Ham., Led., Rhus-t.. Hyper., Symph.. (2) Abrot., Absin., Calen., Cham., Cina, Gnaph. (3 ) other Composites. (4) Am-c., Crot-t. - swashing in abdomen. (5) Ars., Bapt. - typhoid states, Bapt. “feels ill,” Arn. “feels well.”Bry.,Rhod.,Ruta., Sul- ac. Complementary: Aeon., Ip. Follows well: Aeon., Ip., Verat., Apis. Followed well by: Aeon., Ars., Bry., Ip., Rhus-t. Antidote to: Am-c., Chin., Cie., Ferr., Ign., Ip., Seneg. Antidoted by: Camph., Ip. (to massive doses), Coffee (headache), Aeon., Ars., Chin., Ign., Ip. (to potencies). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Liver - Sharp pain in region of liver; painful when turning in bed. Pressure in region of liver. Pain from liver through left chest and down left arm. Lungs - Asthma with inclination to move about. Asthma with sleeplessness before midnight. Asphyxia neonatorum. Dyspnea with hemoptysis. Short, panting breathing. Children lose their breath when angry. Raw, sore feeling in morning. Pneumonia, approaching paralysis. Can't expectorate, but must swallow whatever is loosened by coughing. Bloody expectoration. Hemorrhage after mechanical injuries. Offensive, green, purulent, blood-streaked expectoration. Spitting up of black, thick, viscid blood, or bright red, frothy blood, mixed with mucus and coagula. Pneumothorax from external injuries. Pleurisy after mechanical injuries. Pleurodynia (Bry., Ran-b., Cimic.).

Kidneys - Cutting pain in kidneys. Piercing pain, as from knives plunged into kidneys, with chilliness and inclination to vomit. Involuntary dribbling with constant urging. Has to wait a long time for urine to pass. Urine has dark brick-red sediment. Bloody urine from mechanical causes. Urine in small quantity, staining napkin yellow-brown. Red urine in liver complaint. Scanty, red urine, very offensive. Brown clear urine which immediately becomes whitish and turbid.

Bladder - Retention of urine in bladder from over exertion after labor. Urine retained, with aching and pressing in bladder. Bladderaffections after mechanical injuries. Bladder tenesmus with very painful urination. Tenesmus of bladder with diarrhea. Bladder feels full and sore, the pressure of urine hurts him. Cutting pain in orifice of urethra at end of urination. Infants scream from pain in bladder. Constant dribbling of urine after labor. Breasts - Sore nipples. Mastitis from injury. Tumors of breast from injury (Bell-p., Con.). Violent after-pains, worse nursing. Causations - Mechanical injuries. Fright, financial loss, anger. Overuse of any organ. Surgical operations. Insect stings. Splinters.

Cough - Cough produced by weeping and lamenting. Dry cough from tickling low down in trachea. Cough causes bloodshot eyes or nosebleed. Violent, spasmodic cough with facial herpes. Cardiac cough, paroxysmal, at night during sleep, worse exercise. Whooping cough, child cries before coughing. Cough after measles. Cough in sleep without waking.

Perspiration - Sour sweat at night. Sour or offensive sweat, sometimes cold. Several transitory sweats all over at night, with anguish. Worse when sweating. Sweat partial on front of body. Sweat followed by faintness.

Temperature - Chilly with heat and redness of one cheek. Coldness of part lain on. Thirst during chill. Must uncover but it chills him. Shivering over whole body. Shivering, as if dashed with cold water. Internal chills with external heat. Heat and redness of head with coolness of rest of body. Internal heat, feet and hands cold. Head or face alone hot, body cold. Heat flushes, with thirst. Influenza fever. Intermittent fever. Typhoid fever. Septic and traumatic fevers.

name: Arsenicum Album
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from company. Better heat, warm drinks and food, warm wraps. Better hot dry applications. Better from motion, walking about. Better lying with head elevated. Better sitting erect. Better sweating. Better open air. Worse periodically. Worse by the seashore. Worse wet weather, cold damp. Worse from cold air. Worse ices, cold drinks or food. Worse right side. Worse lying on affected part. Worse exertion. Worse around midnight. Worse after midnight. Worse 11 p.m. to 2 a.m. Worse every 14 days, yearly. Worse quinine, alcohol, tobacco. Worse eruptions undeveloped or suppressed..

Diarrhea. Diphtheria.

full:
PHARMACY - ars. Arsenicum album. White oxide of arsenic. Arsenic trioxide. Solution and trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Acne rosacea. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Allergies. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Angina pectoris. Anorexia. Antrax. Anxiety. Aphonia. Aphthae. Ascites. Asthma. Atrophy. Bronchitis. Burning, pains. Cachexia. Cancer. Cancrum, oris. Carbuncle. Cecum, disorders. Chills. Cholera asiatica. Colds. Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Croup. Cyanosis. Dandruff. Delirium tremens. Despair. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Ears disorders. Eczema. Emaciation. Endometritis. Enteric fever. Epithelioma. Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Face, eruptions. Fainting. Fatigue. Fears. Fevers. Food, poisoning. Gangrene. Gastric, ulcers. Gastritis. Gastroenteritis. Glandular, swellings. Gout. Hay asthma. Hay fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hepatitis. Herpes zoster. Hodgkin's disease. Hydrothorax. Ichthyosis. Influenza. Intermittent fever. Jaundice. Kala- azar. Kidney, diseases. Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Lichen. Lips, epithelioma. Locomotor ataxia. Lung disorders. Lupus. Malaria. Malignant, pustules. Measles. Menstruation, disorders. Miliary, eruptions. Myelitis. Nausea. Nettle rash. Nephritis. Nervousness. Neuralgias. Numbness. Paralysis. Peritonitis. Pityriasis. Plethora. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Pneumonia. Prostration. Psoriasis. Purpura. Remittent, fever. Restlessness. Rheumatism. Rickets. Ringworm. Scarlatina. Sciatica. Scrofulous, disorders. Sea-bathing. Seasickness. Septic, fever. Sneezing. Stomach, disorders. Strains. Suppuration. Throat, sore. Tobacco habit. Tongue, disorders. Traumatic, fever. Typhlitis. Typhus. Ulcers. Uremia. Vomiting. Weakness. Whooping cough. Worms. Wounds. Yellow fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Grimmer stated that Ars. helped cancer, epithelioma, lupus, pernicious anemia have yielded to the power of this potent medicine. Typhus and pernicious types of malaria present a fair picture of the range and character of the sickness this remedy has cured. Arsenicum album is a very deep acting remedy, affecting every organ and tissue. Ars. acts on the nerves producing inveterate neuralgias and multiple neuritis better heat. All-prevailing anxiety, exhaustion and restlessness with nightly aggravation, are most important. Great exhaustion after the slightest exertion. Burning pains. Burning relieved by heat. Seaside complaints (Nat-m., Aq-mar.). Pains are maddening, burning likefire, hot needles or wires, better warmth. Acute and chronic bums. Sudden intense effects. Sudden great weakness from trivial causes. Very restless, restless even in affected part, even stupor is interrupted by fits of restlessness with anxious moaning. Fear, fright and worry. Dying patients, Ars. gives quiet and ease to the last moments of life when given in high potency. Cancer pains. The prostration seems to be out of proportion to the rest of his illness. Anemia and chlorosis. Low vitality. Putrid cadaveric odors. Emaciation. Gradual loss of weight. Asthma, worse after getting colds in midsummer. Asthma, worse around midnight. Unable to lie down, fears suffocation. Anxious, must sit up, worse from odors, laughing, ascending, turning in bedorreced- ing eruptions, better coffee or sweet water. Hay fever. Air-passages constricted from allergies. Shortness of breath. Suffocative catarrh. Whistling, wheezing breathing. Ars. should be thought of in ailments from alcoholism, Ptomaine poisoning, stings, dissecting wounds, chewing tobacco. Food poisoning. Ill effects from decayed food or animal matter, odor of discharges is putrid in complaints that return annually. Injurious effects of fruits, especially more watery ones. Discharges of mucus membranes are acrid, thin and scanty, coryza, saliva, sweat etc. Weakness and emaciation is rapid. Degenerative changes. Gradual loss of weight from impaired nutrition. Reduces the refractive index of blood serum (also Chin, and Ferr-p.). Malarial cachexia. Septic infections and low vitality. Green discharges. Unquenchable thirst. Infantile Kala-azar. Infections. Alcoholism. Frequent fainting. Destructive process, carbuncles, gangrene, cancer, malignancy. Dropsy, pale, baggy, swellings. Restlessness, then becomes drowsy. Eruptions undeveloped or sup- pressed. MIND-Clinging, anxious and desperate. Begs for help. Extremely nervous and anxious. Deep insecurities and fears. Desires company, fears to be left alone. Restlessness, changes place continually. Inclined to complain and whine to those about her. Indecisive. Weeps and whines, but speaks little. Full of worries about trifles. Anxiety about the future. Anxiety about health. Anxiety about others. Anguish and restlessness. Anxiety on waking from frightful dreams. Anxiety during headache. Anxiety, better motion. Anxiety about trifles. Fear of death, yet tired of living, worse night. Fear of starvation. Fear of financial loss, poverty. Fear of diseases. Fear of getting cancer. Fear of catching an infection. Fear of germs, viruses. Fear of being poisoned. Fear of being left alone (Phos., Puls.). Fear of violence. Great fear with cold sweats. Fears something may have happened to relatives. Children are capricious, want to be carried, want to go from father to mother to nurse (Cham.). Lacks courage. Frighten easily. Desires to be carried fast. Desires company, fears to be left alone. Clings to parents. Obsessive compulsive disorder. Fastidious, upset about disorder, dirt, germs. Obsessed with order and tidiness. Sensitive to disorder and confusion. Suspicious. Miserly. Selfish and her desires exceeds her needs. Inclined to malice and satire. Clinging to a doctor, needing reassurance. Exaggerating symptoms to assure attention. Domineering and demanding. Angry with himself and others. Faultfinding and reproaches others. Irritability alternating with despondency. Irritability and restlessness during headache. Melancholy. Despair of recovery. Despair drives him from place to place. Thinks it useless to take medicine. Consolation aggravates. Moaning and groaning, walks about wringing hands. Groans, moans and weeps during menses. Insanity. Delirium tremens, cursing and raving, vicious. Mania, wants to be held. Fixed ideas. Tormenting thoughts. Suicidal impulses, mania, determined to commit suicide, he suffers so. Fear of being left alone, lest he do himself bodily harm (Nat-s.). Has no rest anywhere, rolls about on floor and despairs for his life. Hallucinations of smell and sight. Delusions, body will putrefy. Sees ghosts day and night. Sees vermin, throws away bugs by handfuls. Carphologia. Imagines house full of thieves, jumps and hides. Fears he has murdered somebody. Self-torture, pulls her hair, bites her nails, tears at own body. Abdomen - Peritonitis. Ascites and ana sarca. Gastroenteritis. Coldness and chilliness in abdomen. Abdomen swollen and painful. Rumbling in bowels. Periodical colic. Burning pains. Crampy pains in bowels. Cutting pains. Violent pains in abdomen with anguish. Violent squeezing and constricting, in umbilical region. Intussusception with pain in abdomen. Liver and spleen enlarged and painful. Spleen is enlarged in malarial fever, kala- azar. Pain as from a wound in abdomen on coughing. Gnawing, burning pains like coals of fire, relieved by heat. Epigastrium sore, tender. Ulcer above navel. Peritonitis. Swelling of inguinal glands.

Head - Headaches relieved by cold, other symptoms worse. Periodical headaches, with burning pains with restlessness. Hemicrania with icy feeling of scalp and great weakness. Pain over left eye. Throbbing, stupefying, burning pains. Pulsating in forehead, with nausea. Aching in occiput. Pain alternates between head or stomach. Headache, alternating with colic or liver complaint. Headache with vomiting of bile. Sensitive head in open air. Restless head, it is in constant motion. Walks with head thrown backwards. Scalp itches intolerably. Circular patches of bare spots, rough, dirty and covered with dry scales, nightly burning and itching. Dandruff. Scalp very sensitive cannot brush hair. Hair becomes gray early. Falling out of hair. Scabs on hairy scalp. Chronic eruptions filled with pus. Tinea.

Eyes - Sunken or protruding. Burning in eyes with hot, acrid lachrymation. Edema around eyes. Corrosive tears, making cheeks and eyelids sore. Agglutination of lids. Eyelids red. ulcerated, scabby, scaly, granulated. Spasms of the eyelids. Stinging pain, when trying to open lids. Corneal ulceration. Intense photophobia, better external warmth. Sensitive to sunlight. Ciliary neuralgia with fine burning pain. Left-sided infraorbital pain. Blue spots in white of eye. Bluish circle around cornea. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Conjunctiva is injected, yellow. Conjunctiva looks like a piece of raw beef. Falling of eyelashes. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Ophthalmia of children. Pterygium, with dryness of lids. Pupils contracted or dilated.

Ears - Rash and heat about ears. Skin within, raw and burning. Roaring in ears during a paroxysm of pain. Ringing. Buzzing and singing, during attacks of intermittent and during apyrexia. Thin, excoriating, offensive otorrhea. Discharges of cadaverous odour, profuse, ichorous. Yellow discharge from right ear, with dryness of nose; hearing not weakened. Difficult hearing, for the human voice only. Unusual sensitiveness to sound. Impaired hearing, with humming in ears. Sensation as if ears were stopped up.

Nose - Acne of nose. Allergies. Hay fever and coryza, worse in open air, better indoors. Thin, watery, excoriating discharge. Nose feels stopped up with fluent coryza. Coryza with hoarseness and sleeplessness. Burning and itching. Sneezing with biting watery coryza. Sneezing with- out relief. Nose colds descend to chest. Dryness of nasal cavity. Cold sores in nose. Knotty swelling of the nose. Scabs in nostrils. Nosebleed after fit of passion or vomiting. Dyspnea felt in nose. Lupus. Offensive smell before nose. Smells of pitch and sulphur alternately. Cannot bear the sight or smell of food.

Face - Expression of agony. Edematous swelling of face. Swollen, pale, yellow, cachetic, sunken (Acet-ac.). Haggard or distorted, hippocratic. Old look in children. Face is covered with cold sweat. Tearing, needle-like pains, burning. Angry, circumscribed flush of cheeks. Burning, stinging pains as from red-hot needles. Twitching of facial muscles. Black dots, acne. Pimples and vesicles, with acrid discharge. Pimples and vesicles, itching, burning, worse at night, in cold air, better warmth. Swelling of glands of lower jaw, with bruised pain. Cancerous ulcers on face.

Mouth - Swollen bleeding gums, painful to touch. Ulceration of mouth with dryness and burning heat. Bloody saliva. Metallic taste. Gulping up burning water. Bites tumbler while drinking. Dryness of mouth. Aphthae in mouth. Fetor oris. Bitter taste, water after eating and drinking. Mouth tastes, sour, foul, salty, sweet in morning. Speech rapid, lisping. Eruptions on lips. Sore lips and ulcers in mouth. Lips covered with brown slime. Constant licking of dry, cracked lips. Cancer of lips. Epithelioma of lips. Lips black, livid. Formication on lips. Nerves - Paralysis. Trembling, jerking, convulsions and chorea twitchings. Epilepsy, suddenly becomes unconscious with convulsions.

Throat - Sore throat, better warm drinks. Dryness with soreness, scraping and burning. Swollen, edematous, constricted, burning, unable to sv/al\ow. Burning pain in throat. Everything swallowed seems to lodge in esophagus. Nausea in throat. Malignant sore throat. Blueness of external throat from distension of veins. Diphtheria membrane, looks dry and wrinkled. Ulceration with swollen submaxillary glands. Constriction of larynx during cough. Burning in larynx and trachea. Aphonia. Voice weak, trembling, uneven, hoarse. Voice rough, hollow. Spasm of glottis. Sudden catarrh, threatening suffocation at night. Gangrenous croup.

Stomach - Anxiety in pit of stomach. Sick from of bad meat, water, vegetables, melons and watery fruits. Dyspepsia from vinegar, acids, ice cream, ice water, tobacco. Heartburn. Belching, gulping up of acid and bitter substances which seem to excoriate the throat. Hiccough, frequent. Burning pain. Burning as from red- hot coals in stomach. Qualmishness. Gastritis. Burning pain in stomach better by sweet milk. Stomach extremely irritable, seems raw, as if tom. Stomach cancer (Hydr.). Induration in stomach. Stomach pain from slightest food or drink. Food poisoning with nausea, vomiting. Nausea with sweetish taste in mouth. Nausea with heat. Vomiting with diarrhea. Nausea, retching and vomiting after eating and drinking. Cannot bear the sight or smell of food. Vomiting of clear water. Vomiting of blood, bile, green mucus. Vomiting brown-black mucus mixed with blood. Ice cold water distresses the stomach and is vomited immediately. Vomit, first water, then thick, glairy, or grass-green mucus, lastly blood. looking skin” in human beings are keynote indications for the remedy. In this connection, the effects on the crew of the ship named Zion may be mentioned, which carried arsenic as a portion of its cargo. This was exposed somewhat to the sun's rays and the crew noticed a peculiar smell. Soon they all began to notice themselves growing stout and on reaching Philadelphia from England they had all gained much, one to the extent of two stones in weight. Characteristic great fear of death, extreme restlessness, marked weakness, rapid loss of weight, coldness and lack of vital heat, nightly aggravations, especially after midnight, 2 a. m. to 4 a. m., extreme burning pains, marked tendency to ulcerations and destruction of tissues, low types of disease, malignant fevers, such as typhoid. Restlessness, even the stupor is interrupted by fits of restlessness with anxious moaning. Patients are anxious, full of the fear of death, restlessness compelling them to frequently change their position. Nervous affections, notably chorea. Jerks and starts on falling asleep. Irritability, desperately angry, almost furious. Despair, hopelessness, unutterable misery. The irritability and sadness of malarial cachexias of the cachexias of quinine, mercury and syphilis. Low types of disease, typhoid states. Inflammations of great intensity with tendency to destruction of tissue. Burning, sharp pains. Burning is another leading characteristic of Arsenic. The peculiarity of the “burning pains” is that they are better by heat (herein comparing with Caps.). Ars. affects the entire digestive tract. The lips are so dry and parched and cracked that the patient often licks them to moisten them. The mouth is aphthous, ulcerated or gangrenous. The burning in the throat is better by eating or drinking hot things. On the other hand, cold food and cold drinks, worse stomach irritations, hence Ars. is of signal use for effects of eating ice and drinking ice water. According to Teste, Ars. is suited to the effects of excess of vegetable diet, melons, strawberries and fruits in general, especially watery fruits. The stomach is so irritable that the least food or drink causes distress or vomiting or stool or both together. Abdominal pains are intense, causing the patient to turn and twist. Hemorrhoids are exceedingly painful as if burning needles plunged in. States of lowered vitality. The prostration of Ars. is remarkable. With it there is the desire to move or to be moved constantly. The patient is exhausted from the slightest exertion. Exhaustion is not felt while lying still, but as soon as he moves he is surprised to find himself so weak. The prostration seems out of proportion to the rest of his illness. Must lie down. Exhaustion from hill climbing, breathless, sleepless. Thirst for little and often (Ant-t., Lyc.), wants it very cold and immediately rejects it (Phos. as soon as it becomes warm). Before and after the cough of Arsenic there is an attack of asthma (Phos.). Acute coryza and hay fever. The fluent coryza is corrosive, reddening the upper lip and has more burning than either Merc, or All-c. Worse out of doors and better in warmth (compared to All-c.). Predominantly rightsided. The neuralgias affect the right side most. The right lung has acute, sharp, fixed or darting pain in apex and through upper third of right lung. Right lung is more affected than the left, also the right side of the abdomen, hence typhlitis. Good for controlling dropsical conditions, especially in cases of hydrothorax. It has been called the “liquid trochar,” on account of the expeditious way in which it will remove a watery effusion. The patient cannot lie down, must sit up to breathe, anxious, restless, worse about 1 a.m. Puffiness is one of its characteristics and from this to dropsy. All mucus membranes are irritated. The skin is cold and clammy. Scurfy eruptions. Bran-colored scales on head coming down to forehead. Epithelioma of the lips and closely corresponds to the cancerous diathesis. Many cures of cancer have been reported under its use, both in crude and in potencies. When the subjective symptoms of Ars. are present, it will cure in the potencies. When the similarity is more crude, the lower potencies will be required. In cancer cases the Ars. appears to act directly on the cancerous tissue and cancerous elements in the system. Hemorrhagic, it acts on both blood and blood vessels. Varicose veins burn like fire. Anemia, chlorosis, pyemia. Weakened states resulting from blood loss, as venesection, metrorrhagia, hemoptysis. Intermittent fevers and chills. Clarke once treated some members of a family who all had attacks of fever of short duration, recurring regularly every six weeks from living in rooms papered with arsenical papers. Its periodicity comes every day, every third or fourth day, every fortnight, every six weeks, every year. There is pronounced night aggravation, pains with restlessness. Worse near midnight and after midnight, worse 3 a.m. There is worse from cold and damp, better warmth. Ars. loves warmth like Nux-v., Psor., Hep., Sil., Mag-m. and other hydrogenoid remedies. It is differentiated from Sulph., Ant-c., lod., Apis and Puls. Ars. hugs the fire and likes warm wraps. Good for food poisoning, pesticide and chemical poisoning, bad water, acute or chronic. The first symptom is diarrhea. Grimmer noted its use for cancer, epithelioma, lupus, and pernicious anemia. Typhus and pernicious types of malaria present a fair picture of the range and character of the sickness this remedy has cured. A major asthma remedy. Good for the flu when they despair over their recovery. Good for cancer, pains of cancer, and the reaction to the diagnosis of cancer. Effective for palliative care of dying patient. Minor diabetes remedy. Good for emaciation, periodic fevers and sweating, especially for AIDS patients. Malaria, yellow fever, dysentery. Burning pains, the chest, the colon, the rectum burn. Better hot drinks and better warmth. Worse 11:00 at night until 2:00 a.m. They get a lot of asthma attacks and anxiety then. They're very chilly in general. Fastidiousness, concerned with cleanliness and order, particularly the elderly. Fear of death and dying. Agonizing, tormenting fear of dying. Fear of cancer and AIDS. Obsessive, tormenting fears of getting infections. Despair, fear of being incurable. Fear of suffocation, the dark, being alone, poisoned. Worse right side, better heat and warm drinks. Better company. Sips, drinks often. Restless because of anxiety. Etiology can be from suppressed skin rash. Serious disease, near death experience can make them feel vulnerable. Emotional deprivation, lack of love, shock of abandonment, sense of intense loss. Can be material loss, sense of being in a dangerous situation, poverty, war.
