Severe drawing pains in the calf of the right leg, in the morning, on waking and on extending the limb, cramps in both calves. Lungs - Great oppression in breathing. Frequent sneezing, hawking with irresistible inclination to cough, but without any power to detach mucus, paroxysms of coughing, which compel the patient to rise from his seat, abating after breakfast, violent cough, attended by oppression of the chest and copious expectoration of mucus. Violent cough inducing retching.

Nose - Nosebleed, sneezing and coryza in the morning on waking. Sneezing and coryza in morning on awaking. Pimples on sides of nose and chin.

Face - Red, flushed face. Redness of face, precursor of apoplexy. Acne. Pimples on side of nose, chin and mouth. Disposition to pimples atadolescence. Pimples, black tips with small red bases. Neuralgia. Livid discoloration of face, during epileptic attack with falling.

Mouth - Acute and pressing stitches in the upper teeth. Swelling of the tongue. Pulling pains in the tongue. Heaviness of speech. Profuse flow of saliva. Dry, hard, exceedingly painful pimples on lower lip. Loss of taste. Shooting pain in tongue. Difficulty to move tongue, aversion to speak. Talking difficult with profuse salivation. Nerves - Gait unsteady, muscles refuse to obey the will. Epilepsy, preceded by twitching over whole body.

Throat - Rough sensation in larynx causes cough. Vertigo - Vertigo, transient, when walking. Vertigo with insensibility of lower limbs. Sudden attacks, like shocks in head. Vertigo, precursor of apoplexy. COMMENTS - Asterias powerfully affects the mind and head, producing symptoms strongly suggesting a stroke. The face is red and there is strong congestion to the head, which is hot and feels as if surrounded by hot air. Certain forms of cerebral congestion with obstinate constipation. Electric shocks in the head. Nightly sharp pains in the breasts have led to its successful use in cases of breast cancer. Teste noted that the malaise is worse by heat. Great desire for cold drinks. Coffee worsens all the symptoms and excites them anew several days after they have disappeared. Breast cancer in the upper-left quadrant, which is the most frequent place to get breast cancer. Cancer of the left breast that has metastasized to the axillary glands of the armpit. Tumors of the nipple. Characteristic severe lancinating pains which are worse at night. Sharp, darting pains. Bearing down pains. May complain of a sensation of the breast being drawn inward. Sharp pains that extend to the scapula. Severe, dull, aching pains in the breast. Pains can be related to hormones, can be worse premenstrually. Substernal pains. Cancer pains, inflamed and swollen glands (Con.). Axillary glands are swollen, indurated and knotted. Knotted in the left side of the neck. Pain extends down the left arm. Swollen breast, can have ulcerations. The affected breast may develop a red spot that suppurates premenstrually. At times it will become inflamed and discharge with an offensive odor coming out. For stroke patients, or threatened stroke or epilepsy (Bell., Glon.). They get a red, congested face and are excitable, apprehensive with fears. Weeping ameliorates the mental state. Worse at night, cold, and motion. Desire cold drinks. Aggravated by coffee. They are very excitable, weepy, and fear something bad will happen, fear of getting bad ne ws or misfortune (common symptoms of cancer patients). RELATIONS-Antidotes: Plb., Zinc. Antidoted by: Plum., Zinc. Compare: (1) Care., Con., Carb-an., Ars., Cund., Murex. Sep., Astac., Homarus, Eryth., Crot., Grat., Gamb., Jatr., Thuj., Bell..Lil-t./’b/fows we//: Bell..Carb-an.. Alternate swelling and sinking of the abdomen during the twenty- four hours. Sensation of pressure on lower abdominal organs. Tearing, drawing pain in abdominal walls.

Rectum - Severe constipation. Ineffectual urging. Obstinate constipation. Stool like olives. Stool hard, round balls. Diarrhea preceded by colic. Diarrhea, watery brown stools gushing out with force. Heat in the rectum. Bleeding hemorrhoids.

Male - Sexual desire increased, erotic thoughts. Frequent erections during sleep or in the morning.

Female - Jerking or distress in uterus. Colic and other sufferings cease with appearance of flow. As if something were passing out of uterus. As if something protruded behind uterus. Pushing sensation in uterus. Twitching of uterus. V agina moist with feeling of ease. Violent and constant sexual desire, not better by sex, with nervous agitation with disposition to weep. Sexual desire increased, worse mornings in bed. Food - Loss of appetite. Uncertain appetite. Dullness of taste. Aversion to meat. Desires cold drinks. Desires highly seasoned food, strong cheese. Desires liquors, tea. Great desire for cold drinks. Worse from coffee.

Chest - Enlarged axillary glands, worse at night and in damp weather. Axillary glands swollen hard and knotted. Ulceration with sharp pains, piercing to scapulae. Pain under sternum and in muscles of precordial region. Full feeling in chest with fear of fainting. Violent itching spot upon chest. Itching in right axilla. Pain under sternum. Lancinating pain. Constitutions - A remedy for the sycotic diathesis, flabby with red face. Flabby lymphatic constitution.

Heart - Palpitations, pulse hard and frequent. Strong and frequent beating of the heart, jerking palpitations. As if heart had ceased to beat, with dull, prolonged heartbeats. Anxiety at the heart. Violent beating in right carotid artery. Pulse hard, full, frequent.

Back - Scrofulous ulcer left neck. Pulling, drawing in the back and sacrum. Breasts - Breast cancer even in ulcerative stage. Neuralgia of left breast and arm (Brom.). Acute, lancinating, or smarting pains in breast tumor, entirely depriving her of rest at night. Nodes and induration of breast gland. Dull aching, neuralgic pain in breast region (Con.'). Nipples retracted. Breasts swell and painful, worse left. Left breast feels as if pulled inward. Pain from breasts extends over inner arm to end of little finger. Slight eruption between breasts. Axillary glands swollen hard and knotted. Rash or furfuraceous eruption between breasts.

Limbs - Gait unsteady muscles refuse to obey the will. Numbness of hand and fingers of left side. Numbness of hands, with coldness of the arm. Lassitude and great weakness of the lower limbs. Pain in the left hip. Pain in the joints of the . foot. Feeling in all limbs as if beaten, most in arms, when walking in open air. Restlessness in limbs worse covered or in warm room. Lungs - Short breath with pain in chest when inhaling. Cough with expectoration, morning in bed. Easy hawking of greyish- black mucus during forenoon.

Sleep - Sleeplessnes from nightly, pains. Insomnia. Disposition to sleep after reading a moment. Late falling asleep and late getting up. Agitated sleep, tossing about. Sleep quiet but not refreshing. Many dreams. Dreams about persons and events. Dreams, images vivid and lifelike. Dreams, sees and hears people as if she was awake.

Skin - Acne with black tipped puncta, small red base. Dry, harsh skin, earthy appearance. Destitute of pliability and elasticity. Itching spots. Psoriasis and herpes zoster worse left arm and chest. Eruption on thighs and insteps of small itching vesicles which tear easily and form superficial ulcers. Ulcers with sensitive edges, fetid discharge. Scabies. Tetters.

Modalities - Better appearance of menses. Worse from coffee. Worse at night. Worse cold damp weather. Worse left side. Worse from heat, motion. Worse during menses. Worse from contradiction. Malaise is worse heat.

Kidneys - Heat in the urethra while the urinating. Frequent urination with copious, clear urine. Thick, viscid urine. Urine profuse. Urine thick and slimy.

Temperature - Shivering with sleepiness, followed by hot skin and restless night. Fever followed by coldness. Violent heat, in head, then over whole body. Increased general heat. Heat alternating with cold.

HOMEOPATHIC - There is no homeopathic symptomatology for this remedy. The symptoms which follow are from O. A. Julian's toxicology and clinical experimentation. Alternation of mental and pulmonary complaints. Dyspnea and respiratory spasm. Falls easily and has tension disorders of the organs. Giddiness. Pressing pains in the temples, in the maxillary sinuses. Shoot- ing pains above the right eyebrow. Painful sensation of fullness in the left temporal and maxillary regions. General paralysis. Cerebral softening. Paretic weakness of the lower limbs. Incoordination of movements, walking difficult of an ataxic type. Paretic walk and pressing temple and maxillary pains. Neuritis of syphilitic type. Tertiary syphilis. MIND - Unstable moods, excites quickly and loses his dash and assurances easily. Mental confusion in nervous subjects. Psychological state, sees as through a fog. Bewilderment, worse in the morning.

Nose - Permanent head cold with watery, abundant flow, sometimes burning and excoriating. Sinusitis.

Stomach - Burning all along the esophagus. Empty feeling in the stomach with failing and debility. Crises of gastric tabes. Hiatus hernia. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arg-m. - Paretic type with cramps, chronic laryngitis and pharyngitis. (2) Ars-i. - Chronic coryza inflammation of lymphatic glands and bronchitis, weakness and rapid emaciation. (3) Tuberculinum - Gradual emaciation, headache as though restricted by a headband, nasal and pharyngeal congestion, cough with thick, yellow sputum, sweating. (4) Syphilium - Obsessions, loss of memory, nightly aggravation, especially of the pains in the bones, coughing. REFERENCES - Julian.

Chest - Weakness of the chest. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Tubercular types. Nervous, uneasy types with depressive or obsessive tendencies. Food - Anorexia. Emaciation.

Limbs - Sensation of formication on the right foot from the heel towards the toes. Icy coldness in the left calf. Tumors on the maxillary bones and jaw. Juvenile dystrophy and the bones. Multiple myelomata of the bones. Raynaud's syndrome. Arteritis. Lungs - Difficulty in breathing, choking sensation, groping for breath. Asthma. Emphysema. Slow, difficult respiration and small or thick plugs of sputum. Rhon- chi and bronchial wheezing.

HOMEOPATHIC - Atra-r. is a venomous spider, a spinner mygale from Australia. Its bite produces a serious toxic syndrome, atraxism, which is characterized by a phase of excitement followed by a period of stupor and sleepiness with hypothermia. Death comes after a phase of intense agitation with salivary and lachrymal secretions. Sankaran undertook the proving in 1969, at the suggestion of D. W. Everitt of London. There were four pro vers, of whom one acted as control. The potency used was 30c, at the rate of one daily dose for a month. Gets up in the morning with a feeling of fatigue which then gradually disappears. Feeling of general exhaustion. Sensation of protrusion of the throat and eyes. Asthenia of the body. Drawing pain in the ears. Weakness of the lower limbs, predominantly on the left. MIND - Mental exhaustion in the evening. Incapable of doing the least physical or intellectual exercise.

Eyes - Eyelids stuck together in the morning. Pain below the left orbit when lying down. Heavy, yellowish-white secretion during the night. Eyeballs painful with feeling of protrusion, especially on the left side.

Ears - Drawing sensation in the outer ear as if pulled by a string. Impression of tugging behind the ears, passing from left to right.

Nose - Nasal discharge of thick, yellowish liquid, sometimes black and sticky.

Face - Neuralgia of the face and under the orbits.

Throat - Feeling of obstruction in the throat, worse when lying on the back. Throat red, dry, painful, especially on the left side and when swallowing. Dryness of the throat not improved by drinking water, worse from drinking cold drinks. Feeling of protrusion of the thyroid cartilage. Vertigo - Feeling of vertigo, lasting only a short while in the evening, around 7 p.m. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aranea Di adema - Exhaustion with strong desire to go to bed. Icy cold feeling in the bones. Drilling pains in the heels. (2) Spigelia - Pains in the eyeballs, as if the eyes were too big forthe sockets. Neuralgic pain starting at the back of the head, spreading to the frontal region and ending above the eye, especially the left side. REFERENCES Julian.

Limbs - Sudden sensation of weakness in the limbs, especially the legs. Need to lie down and condition improved by continual pressure. Joint pains in the knees. Lungs - Cough with thick, greenish sputum which comes up easily.

Sleep - Insomnia until 1 a.m.

Modalities - Better from pressure, lying on the stomach. Worse from walking. Worse standing still. Worse leaning backwards.

Kidneys - Urine slightly irritating. Frequent urination at night. Feeling in the bladder of not being empty after urination. Last drop hot and irritating.

HOMEOPATHIC - Atropine, as the most active principle in Belladonna, produces most of the characteristic effects of that drug, but at the same time the two are not identical. Atropine has shown an affinity for the pancreas, which relates it to lod., Kali-i. and Iris. It can produce a hypersensitivity of the sensory nerves. Numerous eye symptoms. AU kinds of illusions of vision. Motes seen over every thing. All kinds of illusions of sight. Everything appears large (Plat, opposite). On reading, words run together, double vision, all objects seem to be elongated. Clarke once cured with Atro. a woman who had an appearance of shadows passing over whatever she looked at. Difficulty of speech. Frequent stuttering. especially at difficult to pronounce words. Indistinct articulation, rapid and chattering. Great dryness of throat, almost impossible to swallow. Chronic stomach disorders with great pain and vomiting of all food. Peritonitis. Hypochlorhydria, heartburn. Eustachian tube and tympanic congestion. Affinity for the pancreas. Hyperacidity of stomach. Paroxysm of gastric pain, ovarian neuralgia. Mind - Sad and morose, prefering solitude and a dark room to society of friends. Fear of her condition being observed. Meddlesome. Mistakes in localities, in time. Rambling speech. Speech embarrassed, loud, slow, unintelligible in sleep. Wandering thoughts. Mirthful. Frightful delirium. Delusions, sees frightful images. Delusions sees people in room at bedside. Delusions familiar things seem strange. Answers to imaginary questions. Refuses obstinately to swallow anything or to answer questions in any way than by a grunt.

Head - Periodical headache, coming on suddenly, increasing rapidly, until intensely severe. Dull pain in temples. Sticking pain in back of skull and over eyes, worse every motion, stepping. Severe headache beginning in occiput, passing over right side, locating over eyes. Headache with flushing of face and head. Headache with rush of blood to head. Sensation as if head were screwed up. Headache of epileptics. Headache with great weakness.

Eyes - Sharp neuralgic pains in and about eyes. Neuralgic pain. Eyelids heavy and difficult to keep open. Corneal ulcers with spasmodic winking. Irritability of eye. Conjunctivitis with lachrymation. Dim vision with dilated pupils. Vertical diplopia, apparent object below real one.

Ears - Morbid sensitiveness to sounds and objects.

Face - Deep red distorted face. Deathly pallor.

Mouth - Pappy taste. Dryness of mouth and throat. Unability to speak from dryness of mouth, tongue nearly adherent to roof of mouth. Dryness of mouth after two hours suddenly gave way to a viscid, acrid secretion, very highly offensive odor.

Throat - Burning from coughing. Dark red, husky hue. Difficult swallowing from great dryness. Voice husky. Dryness of larynx causes dry cough and difficult swallowing.

Stomach - Constant burning under stomach. Constant retching and empty eructations, immediately after eating. Nausea with pressure at stomach. Vomiting of food. Fluttering in stomach. Vomiting seldom with nausea. Vomiting at times extremely violent. Stomach very sensitive to pressure.

Rectum - Diarrhea with constipation. During stool, felt badly weak, terribly nervous, with general sweat.

Female - Severe cutting or drawing pains, in left ovary, extorting screams, must bend double. Left ovary swollen and tender during menses. Puerperal convulsions. Food - Appetite often considerable, sometimes absent. Thirst after vomiting.

Chest - Burning under sternum.

Back - Constant burning in back. Large portion of spine so sensitive that she cried out on pressure. Painful affections from spinal irritation.

Limbs - Throwing about limbs. Spasms worse when disturbed. Gouty affection of right wrist, with stiffness. Clenching of thumbs. Involuntary movements of hands towards head. Locomotor ataxia. Edema of legs.

Sleep - Drowsiness with tendency to quiet dreams and delirium. Somnolence with nervous startings. Prolonged yawning. Restless sleep, sleeps only towards morning. Sleep much disturbed by gastric pains. Starting as if frightened on falling asleep.

Teeth - Grinding of teeth.

Tongue - Tongue seems partially paralyzed, speech indistinct, rapid and chattering. Tongue hard, parched and cracked. Tongue coated white. Vertigo - Vertigo on rising in morning. Vertigo on turning head suddenly. RELATIONS - It antidotes: Muscarine and Op. It is Antidoted by: Op. and Phys. Compare: Like Bell., it is a right-side medicine. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarice.

Kidneys - Congestive states of kidneys. Chronic albuminuria. Involuntary urination, but scanty discharge of urine.

Later it has been used by others in syphilis, especially chronic syphilitic headaches, chlorosis, anemia, cancer, chlorosis, lupus. Blood, glands and bones are centers frequently involved. MIND - The depression of Aurum metallicum and the anxiety of Arsenic are often present in cases needing this remedy. Weary of life, wants to jump out of window. Averse to being spoken to. Always in a hurry and excited. Impatient and restless. Neglects his family and children. Fault-finding and critical. Inca “vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.

HOMEOPATHIC - Selective action on brain and nervous system, favorably influencing their nutritive function. Leading indications are nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, and general weakness. Sleeplessness with nervous exhaustion and weakness. Chronic insomnia. Delirium tremens. Drug addictions. Bad effects of morphine or heroin addiction. Addicted to cocaine, marijuana, nervines, tranquilizers or sedatives. Alcoholism. Insomnia due to drugs or alcohol. Post-diphtheria paralysis. Rheumatism of heart. Colds and coryza. Nervous palpitations. It is useful in nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, debility after exhausting diseases. Weakness of the mind when due to masturbation or sexual irregularities. Nervous states of the female and male sexual systems. Nervous tremors of the aged. Parkinson's disease, chorea and epilepsy. MIND - Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag, with sleeplessness. Symptoms from mental or physical overwork. Mental exertion aggravates. Dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty of thinking and comprehending. Inability to keep mind on any one subject. Nervous exhaustion in brain workers, or from worry and anxiety. Difficult concentration from masturbation. Brain fatigue with sleeplessness. Morphine or heroin addiction. Alcoholism, dipsomania to help withdrawal. Hypochondriasis. Constitutions - Nervous constitution.

Head - Nervous headache at menstrual period with burning at top of head. Occipital headache with phosphatic urine. Aching deep in brain. Vertex headache during menses.

Urine - Sediment, phosphates increased. COMMENTS - Aven, is pre-eminently an anti-neurotic, quieting the nervous system to a remarkable degree. Its special sphere of action seems to be upon the male sexual organs, regulating the functional irregularities of these parts perhaps as much as any remedy can. Aven, is indicated in the sleeplessness of the weak and elderly. Also for children who are nervous and weak. It is a most useful remedy in all cases of nervous exhaustion, general debility, nervous palpitation of the heart insomnia inability to keep the mind fixed upon any one subject. More especially when any or all of these troubles is apparently due to nocturnal emissions, masturbation, or sexual over activity. This is a specific remedy for drug addiction, mainly heroin and morphine, but also tobacco, cocaine, marijuana and valium. Boericke noted it for alcohol addiction. It is one of the most valuable means for overcoming morphine addiction. In most cases in which the habit has not used more than four grains daily the opiate may be abruptly discontinued and even substituted without any serious results. If a larger quantity than this amount has been taken for some time, it is better to gradually reduce the daily dose of morphine in the usual manner, simply prescribing the Avena in addition. The latter should be given in the same dose, as a rule, regardless of the amount of morphine taken. In other words, it is not necessary to increase the Avena as the opiate is withdrawn. When the quantity of morphine has not exceeded four grains daily it should be stopped at once, as stated above and Avena given in its stead in fifteen-drop doses, four times a day in wine glassful of hot water. By this method the disagreeable aftereffects will be much less than though the dose of morphine is gradually reduced and the patient will find life quite bearable, as a rule, at the end of a week. Avena sativa should always be given in appreciable doses of the tincture. Fifteen drops three or four times a day, well diluted, will usually meet the case. It may be given in doses of from five to sixty drops in rare instances. It should, however, never be given in larger quantities than twenty minims unless the patient is thoroughly accustomed to the remedy and has found the usual dose insufficient. Otherwise, there is danger of getting the physiological effect of the drug, which is pain at the base of the brain. When this symptom makes its appearance the medicine should be discontinued for a day or two and then given in reduced doses. There seems to be no danger whatever of forming the habit of taking this remedy, as it can be suddenly abandoned at any time without evil consequences, even when given in large quantities. In one case it was prescribed in sixty drop doses, night and morning, for one year and then abruptly stopped. Nothing was substituted, without bad effects. Whenever a quick action is desired and in all cases where Avena is given to overcome the morphine habit, it should be prepared in hot water. It is also a good plan to prescribe it in this fashion wherever indigestion complicates the case. Anshutz employed this drug in his private practice for a number of years with the most gratifying results. He has very rarely found it to fail when indicated and on account of his high opinioii of the remedy he has taken great pleasure in thus bringing it prominently to the attention of the medical profession. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Alfalfa - general tonic similar to Avena sativa. Alfalfa, also for scanty and suppressed urine. (2) Passiflora, Valerian. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

HERBAL - Azadirachta Indica is a large tree. The leaves, bark, wood, roots, fruits and every part of this tree, are intensely bitter. The vast range of its action is chiefly due to azaserine, margocine and catechin, the three active principles found in this tree. This is an Indian remedy from very ancient times. The bark, known as Margosa bark, is the best-known medicinal portion. The tincture for the provings were made from the bark by Dr. P. C. Majumdar of Calcutta, India. Majumdar contributed a synopsis of Aza. According to Ayurveda, the different parts of this tree possess different medicinal properties. Sanskrit authors agree that Azadirachta Indica bark, though very disagreeable in taste, is generally used with success. The Neem tree is used for treatment of bacterial, viral, fungal infections and for the treatment and prevention of malaria. Its action on fevers is well-known in India, the native physicians use Neem as the principal substance in their febrifuge medicines. It is especially useful in cases previously maltreated with quinine. In Kenya the tincture of Neem in the 2x dilution has been used as a treatment for three weeks to neutralize the malaria organism from the body. A decoction of fresh leaves is used as a favorite wash to cure old ulcers of long standing. It remo ves within a short time the sloughs and promotes the healing. The fruit is purgative, demulcent and is used in some forms of skin disorders. A kind of oil is produced from the seed of ripe fruits and this oil is said to cure leprosy, eczema and some other obstinate skin diseases. Neem is also praised by some of the allopathic physicians for its tonic, anti-septic, astringent and anti-periodic properties.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aza. has been used in cases of lassitude, thirst, cough, fever. Loss of appetite, helminthiasis, boils, bilious derangements. Catarrh, vomiting, skin diseases, hiccough, gonorrhea. Its leaves are used in some forms of ophthalmic diseases, parasites, worms and disorders brought on by deranged bile or from the use of poisonous things. Aza. is used in a variety of complaints, especially of the eyes, digestive derangements and skin disorders. An afternoon fever and rheumatic pains in various parts are caused by this remedy. Pain in sternum and ribs in back and shoulders and limbs. Giddy on rising, headaches, scalp sensitive, eyes burn, pain in right eyeball. Heat, pricking and aching in hands. Loss of memory. Thirsty for large quanti ties of water at long intervals. Tendency to miscarriage. Copious leucorrhea. MIND - Mind, weak and dull, full of anxiety inactive. No desire to go out of walk out. Depressed. Mistakes in writing and spelling words. Senile dementia. Hypochondriasis. Amnesia. Loss of memory. Forgetful. Abdomen - Great uneasiness in the abdomen, with flatulent rumbling in the bowels, twisting pain in the epigastric region, no tenderness in the abdomen, clutching pain in the umbilical region, obliging to bend forwards, which affords some relief. Abdomen a little distended, passing of offensive flatus. Painful tension in the hypochondria region.

Head - Right-sided headache with throbbing of the temporal artery and pain in the right eyeball, worse in the open air. Scalp and hair painful and sensitive to the touch.

Eyes - Burning, dull and heavy. Pain in the eye, from slightest pressure. Red, sunken, congested, with slight coryza. Sense of pressure in the right eye.

Ears - Buzzing in the ears. A peculiar cracking sound is heard in the ear like tickling with a feather, which is increased on opening the mouth.

Nose - Running of watery fluid from the nose.

Face - Flushing and heat in the face. Pale. Alternating heat and pallor of the face.

Mouth - No thirst, but mouth is clammy, water has relish, good taste. Mouth is bitter. A painful burning sensation, as if scalded, is felt on the sides and surface of the tongue, papillae seem to be enlarged and prominent. Putrid taste in the mouth. Saliva coming out which tastes salty. Slight difficulty in deglutition, especially water and meat.

Throat - Bitter taste in the throat. Slight hoarseness. Left-sided sore throat. Vertigo - Sensation of drunkenness, especially on lifting the head and around 10 a.m. COMMENTS - The most peculiarfeature of the proving is the fever, which commences with a very slight chill or none at all, at about 3 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. and abates around 7:30 p.m. Glowing heat and burning, especially in face, eyes, palms of hands and soles of feet in open air. Sweat copious, commencing on forehead, gradually extending towards trunk, no sweat on lower part of body. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cedrón, Chin., Ars., Nat-m. (2) Guarea. (3) Ars. - Prostration, anxiety, restlessness. Cadaverous odor of secretions. Aggravation from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m. (4) Chin. - General weakness from loss of liquid. Thirst for large quantities of water. Hemorrhaging from the mucus membranes. Sensitive scalp. (5) Sulph. - Quarrelsome with grandiose ideas. Burning pains, weakness in the morning. Need for fresh air and fear of water. Morbid alternations. (6) Med.- Forgets names and recent events. Restlessness, precipitation, desire fordrinks. Irritating leucorrhea. Breasts cold. Heels sensitive. Sleeps in knee-chest position. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - No thirst, appetite very acute and keen. Very great thirst for large quantity of cold water, at long intervals. Heartburn and water brash. Uneasy sensation in the thorax.

Rectum - Diarrhea, no satisfaction after stool. Feeling after stool, that the rectum is not empty. Constipation with ball-like stools which are hard and small, alternating with diarrhea. Insufficient, constipated, stools hard, small and knotty, stools hard. Copious, soft, semi-solid stools.

Male - Great excitement of sexual organs. Sexual desire a little diminished.

Female - Copious leucorrhea. Metritis of the cervix. Metrorrhagia. Recuning miscarriages.

Chest - Pain in sternum and ribs. Aching in the lower part of the right chest below the nipple. Stitches in the chest. Crampy pains in the lower part of chest. Transitory stitches in the chest, especially in the right side. Cramping pains at the base of the lungs. Constitutions - Nervous or rheumatic constitutions.

Heart - Pulse rapid and strong, or rapid and weak. Pulse is quick and hard, feeble.

Back - Itching of the body, especially the back, worse in the open air and in the afternoon. Pain and aching at the nape of the neck.

Neck - Pain and debility in the nape of the neck.

Limbs - Numbness of the limbs, as if the limbs are paralyzed. Rheumatic pains in the lower limbs. Gnawing in the legs. Strength of the hand diminished. Burning of the hands and soles of the feet. Numbness of the hands only, especially the right hand. Lungs - Sighing, breathing at intervals. Hot breath, rapid respiration. Short dry cough in the afternoon. Violent cough with thick, white, jelly-like sputum, which is difficult to expel. Cough after bathing. Cough with grayish expectoration, thick sputa. Cough with tasteless white sputa.

Sleep - Insomnia and agitation in bed. Wakes frequently. Dreams of fights and quarrels in the second half of the night. Sleeplessness and tossing in the bed, dreamy and interrupted sleep at night.

Skin - Itching of various parts of the body without the appearance of any eruption. Sudamina on the back.

Fever - Fever commences with very slight chill or without chill at 4:30 p.m. and abates at 7:30 p.m. Afternoon fever. Glowing heat and burning, especially in the face, eyes, palms of the hands and soles of the feet, in open air. Food - Thirsty for large quantities of water at long intervals. Keen appetite. Desires cold drinks and sweets.

Modalities - Worse in the open air. Worse in the afternoon.

Kidneys - Urine purple in color. Urine scanty and high colored and scalding, urine white, clear and copious, urine of strong odor.

Perspiration - Copious sweat, especially on the forehead, neck and upper part of the body. Sweating commences on the forehead, gradually extending towards the trunk, no sweat in lower part of the body.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bacillinum is a nosode of tuberculosis named and first described by Dr. Burnett, for whom it was prepared from tuberculosis sputum by Dr. Heath. As this preparation has been experimented with separately, its symptoms are given apart from the other nosodes of tuberculosis. Useful as an intercurrent remedy. Bacillinum has been used for the treatment of tuberculosis, generally causing the sputum to decrease and less become less purulent. Tubercular meningitis. It has a disposition to catch colds and sore throats. Respiratory and lung weakness. Chronic reoccurring sore throats and coughs. Glands of the neck are enlarged and tender. Night-sweats. Bacillinum is indicated for the weak lungs of elderly people and for children with chronic catarrhal conditions and attacks of suffocation at night with difficult cough. Suffocative catarrh. The patient expectorates very little. Chronic catarrhal conditions of the lungs when bronchial mucus and dyspnea are present. Tubercular meningitis. Ringworm. Dr. Burnett has shown that ringworm of the scalp and pityriasis versicolor on the body are indications of tubercular diathesis and they respond to this remedy. He cured a case of insanity and ringworm. Tuberculosis patients are better in dry sunny climates in mountains areas and in the pine forests. Sunlight helps to prevent tuberculosis, also there has been many cures of tuberculosis via sunbathing and the milk diet, which these patients crave. Dr. Cartier has found it particularly useful in cases where there was excessive mucopurulent bronchial secretion threatening to occlude the lungs. It should be compared with Bacillinum testium, Tuber. Bovinum, Tuber. Aviaire and Tuber. Koch. MIND - Taciturn, sulky, snappish, and irritable. Does not want to be disturbed. Fretful ailing, whines and complains. Great weakness. Morose. Depressed and melancholic, even to insanity. Tendency to be frightened, fear of dogs.

Head - Severe headache, deep in, recurring from time to time, worse shaking head. Terrible pain in the head as if he had a tight hoop of iron around it. Meningitis. Ringworm. Alopecia areata.

Eyes - Eczema of the eyelids.

Ears - Otitis after sore throats.

Nose - Nasal congestion. Coryza.

Face - Indolent, pimple on left cheek, breaking out from time to time and persisting for many weeks. Food - Poor appetite.

Throat - Tickling in fauces, compelling cough. Pricking in larynx with sudden cough. COMMENTS - In the provings, a constant symptom was a severe headache, deep in, worse by motion. Also a slight cough with easy expectoration of phlegm. Tends to do better in chronic cases of tuberculosis, as compared to acute cases. There are leading indications for it when present in combination with other disorders. An inter-current course of Bacillinum will often make a wonderful change in patients who have a personal or family history of chest disorders. Bacillinum is an acute miasm remedy for Phosphorus and Calcarea constitutions in particular. Grimmer used it for cases stemming from a tubercular inheritance with extreme soreness of affected parts, patients of rheumatic tendencies with syphilitic taints in the bloodstream, general muscular soreness. Dr. Young recorded the cure of several cases of cretinism. A case of insanity with pityriasis yielded rapidly to the remedy. Pityriasis has been cured by it when all attempts to kill the body lice by chemicals were useless. Clarke has found an eczematous condition of the margins of the eyelids a strong indication for it. Bacillinum is made from tuberculosis bacilli, and Tuberculinum is from bovine tuberculosis. Tuberculinum is a deeper and more chronic remedy. Bacillinum tends to be more for acutes, but there's a lot of overlap. If a Bacillinum case keeps relapsing, follow with Tuberculinum. Miasmatic remedy, history of tuberculosis in family. Good for children or adults with a tendency to get colds and sore throats frequently, particularly if they react well to acute remedies, but keep coming back. For children who get a cold at every change in the weather. Often swollen glands in the throat. Weight on the chest (Phos.). Mucus in the lungs, bronchitis. Good for the elderly with a tendency to colds and bronchitis. Lingering colds. The majority of the symptoms are gone, but a lingering cough or sore throat. Nondescript coughs. Ringworm (Sep., Thuj., Tell.), and the tendency to ringworm. Diarrhea, especially with a cold, sore throat (Ars.). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Phos., Dros., Mercury. Its effects seem to be identical to that of Koch's Tuberculinum. Both are useful in the tubercular diathesis before tuberculosis has developed. In the early stages of tubercular disease of glands, joints, skin and bones. (2) Psor. (3) Bac-t. (4) Ant-t., lod., Lach., Ars-i., Myosotis. Complementary: Kali-c., Calc-p., Lach., goes with this remedy very well. Follows well: Levico, 5-10 drops, follows as an intercurrent where much debility is present (Burnett). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur-

Stomach - Windy dyspepsia, with pinching pains under ribs of right side in breast line.

Abdomen - Abdominal pains, enlarged glands in groin. Tabes mesenterica, grinds teeth, indurated and swollen glands. Spleen region bulging out. Inguinal glands indurated and visible, excessive sweats, chronic diarrhea.

Rectum - Sudden diarrhea before breakfast, with nausea. Obstinate constipation with offensive flatus. Severe hemorrhages from bowels. Stitching pain through hemorrhoids. Passes much ill-smelling flatus.

Chest - Sharp pain in precordial region arresting breathing. Constitutions - Tubercular constitutions. For cases stemming from a tubercular inheritance with extreme soreness of affected parts, patients of rheumatic tendencies with syphilitic taints in the bloodstream, general muscular soreness.

Back - Glands of neck enlarged and tender. Sensation of damp clothes on spine. Very sharp pain in left scapula, worse lying down in bed at night, better by warmth.

Limbs - Trembling of hands. Hands blue. Pain in left knee while walking. Tubercular inflammation of knee. Lungs - Weak lungs. Humid asthma. Colds with sore throats. Hacking cough. Hard cough, shaking patient. Coughing, more during sleep, but it did not waken him. Catarrhal dyspnea. Muco-purulent expectoration of bronchitis. Congestion of the lung. Tuberculosis. Bubbling rales and muco-purulent expectoration. Coughing, that wakes him in night, easy expectoration. Expectoration of non-vis- cid easily detached, thick phlegm from air passages.

Sleep - Absolute sleeplessness. Talks in sleep. Drowsy during day, restless at night. Many dreams.

Skin - Ringworm. Pityriasis. Eczema. Glands enlarged and tender.

Modalities - Worse night and early morning. Worse from cold air.

Teeth - Pyorrhea. Aching in teeth, especially lower incisors, very sensitive to air. Grinds teeth in sleep. Imperfectly developed teeth. Favors falling off of tartar of teeth.

Kidneys - Increased quantity of urine, pale with white sediment. Rises several times in the night to urinate.

Perspiration - Night-sweats.

Temperature - Flush of heat, some perspiration, severe headache. Fever, with emaciation, abdominal pains and discomfort. Restless at night, glands of both groins enlarged and indurated, cries out in sleep, strawberry tongue.

HERBAL - Bacopa monnieri is a perennial, creeping herb whose habitat includes wetlands and muddy shores. It commonly grows in marshy areas throughout India. Bacopa monnieri is an herb used in India for memory, epilepsy, and as a mild sedative. It has been used for centuries to treat epilepsy, improve memory capacity, increase concentration, and reduce stress- induced anxiety. Traditionally, it was used as a brain tonic to enhance memory development, learning, and concentration, and to provide relief to patients with anxiety or epileptic disorders. Patients taking Bacopa say that they can better handle difficult mental tasks and stress. It improves the memory. Increased learning abilites. Protects the brain from the effects of aging. Alleviate anxiety. Mental and brain fatigue. Attention-deficit disorders. The plant has also been used in India and Pakistan as a cardiac tonic. Digestive aid. Improves respiratory function in cases of broncho-constriction. According to Unani medicine, it is bitter, aphrodisiac, good in scabies, leucoderma, syphilis etc. It is a blood purifier and useful in diarrhea and fevers. Bacopa is bitter, pungent, heating, emetic, laxative and useful in bad ulcers. Also used to treat anemia, ascites, enlargement of spleen, biliousness, indigestion, inflammations, leprosy, tumors, etc. COMMENTS - In India, this herb has also been used traditionally to consecrate new born babies in the belief that it will stimulate the intelligence. Studies suggest bacopamay improve intellectual activity in children. Recent research has focused primarily on Bacopa's cognitive-enhancing effects, specifically memory, learning, and concentration, and results support the traditional Ayurvedic herbal claims. Also, research on anxiety, epilepsy, bronchitis and asthma, irritable bowel syndrome, and gastric ulcers also supports the traditional uses of Bacopa. RELATIONS - Compare: Ginko, Kali-p. Gotu kola. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Female - Metrorrhagia, worse at night with feeling of enlargement of head (Arg-n.). Food - Much thirst.

Heart - Tremulous palpitations. Heartbeats are felt from chest to neck, worse lying on right side. Indescribable bad feeling about the heart with soreness and pain, flying stitches all over. Lungs - Cough, worse in afternoon, better in warm room. Cough excited by sweets, candies etc. Ths mucus flies out of mouth and nostrils. Whooping cough with thick yellow expectoration, flies out. Hay fever with asthmatic breathing.

Back - Stitches in nape of neck, scapula. Pain in small of back, hips and lower limbs. Very stiff neck. Muscles and skin sore, as if beaten. Breasts - Indurations. Breast cancer (Aster., Care., Con., Carb-an., Plum-i.).

Skin - Sore to touch. Freckles. Cracks. Raised and discolored scars.

Modalities - Better by heat, warm room. Worse from cold air. Worse stormy weather. Worse afternoon. Worse pressure and touch.

HOMEOPATHIC - Peruvian Balsam has been proved by Lembke. It has been chiefly used empirically in catarrhal tuberculosis or bronchial catarrh with copious purulent expectoration. Sputa thick, creamy, yellowish white, loud rales, night sweats, hectic. Bals-p. is useful in bronchial catarrh with copious, purulent expectoration. Debility and hectic fever. Cracks of nipples and fingers.

Nose - Profuse, thick discharge. Chronic, fetid, nasal catarrh. Bleeding from right nostril. Ozaena with ulceration. Eczema with ulceration.

Throat - Scraping in larynx in forenoon, dry cough. Continued scraping of fauces. COMMENTS - Hale used it with success in “chronic, purulent, fetid anterior or posterior nasal catarrh with or without ulceration.” He said that a cerate of the Balsam is the best application next to Glycerol of Aloes for indolent ulcers, cracked nipples, cracks in fingers and palmar surfaces of hands or fissured and chapped lips. Bals-p. is used locally as a stimulant to raw surfaces in indolent ulcers, scabies, cracked nipples. Promotes granulation, removes the fetid odor. A one percent solution in alcohol or ether may be used with the atomizer in respiratory disorders. Internally, it is used as an expectorant in chronic bronchitis. Used externally for killing scabies. All parts affected are gently rubbed with it at night and a bath taken in the morning. A single application is sufficient. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Balsamum Tolutanum. (2) Oleum Caryophyllum - oil of cloves in profuse expectoration, 3 to 5 minims in milk or capsules. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Vomiting of food and mucus. Catarrh of stomach.

Stool - Mucus diarrhea. Copious liquid stool, painless. Passage of blood with normal stool.

Chest - Cough, mucus and purulent expectoration. Tuberculosis of mucus type, vomit in lungs. Loud rales in chest (Kali-s., Ant-t.).

Limbs - Oppressive pain in right wrist. Severe pain in left tibia. Boring in right tibia. Lungs - Bronchitis and tuberculosis with muco-purulent, thick, creamy expectoration. Tuberculosis of mucus type, vomit in lungs. Very loose cough, mucus and purulent expectoration.

Kidneys - Scanty urine, with much mucus sediment. Urination more frequent and copious. Catarrh of bladder (Chim.). Sticking and cutting in urethra.

Perspiration - Night-sweats.

Temperature - Hectic fever and nightsweats with irritating, short cough and scanty expectoration.

full:
PHARMACY - bamb-a. Bambusaarundinacea. Barpboo. N. O. Gramineae. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Ankylosing spondylitis. Arthritis. Backache. Belching. Colds. Constipation. Cystitis. Depression. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Gingivitis. Headaches. Heartbum. Indigestion. Influenza. Insomnia. Joint, pains. Leucorrhea. Motion sickness. Nausea. Neck, pain. Neuralgic, pains. Nightmares. Post-partum, depression. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Sciatica. Spinal, injuries. Stiffness. Tendonitis. Torticollis. Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - In folk medicine, the leaves have been used to treat blood diseases and inflammation. The hardened material inside bamboo has been used for tuberculosis, asthma and leprosy. The shoots are said to be an appetite stimulant and digestion aid. The root has been used for ringworm. The juice from the flowers has been used for earache and deafness. Some modem studies confirm its anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor effects and its action on the utems.

HOMEOPATHIC - Arthritis and rheumatism. Back pain and sciatica. Spinal injuries. Tension and stiffness ofjoints, worse from damp, cold weather. Clumsiness and awkwardness. Radiating pains. Wandering and wave-like pains. Numbness and tingling. Post-partum depression (Sep.). Generally chilly, better from warmth and worse cold and damp. MIND - Everything seems uncertain. Emotionally sensitive, vulnerable. Yielding disposition. Sadness with weeping. Crying over trivial things. Conscientious about trifles. Capricious. Restless, tosses about in bed. Startled as from a fright. Cannot handle things anymore, overwhelmed by stress. Mental exhaustion, brain fag. Anxiety, felt in chest. Anxiety during vertigo. Anxiety of conscious. Bites nails. Anxiety about the future, finances. Worries about money. Depression with a strong fear of poverty. Overpowering panic attacks. Fear of losing self-control, of misfortune, of failure. Fear during pregnancy. Fear of impending disease. Fear of something wrong in her head. Fear of brain tumor, epileptic convulsions. Fear of lumps in breast. Fear of something wrong in head, Fear of being observed. Fear of saying something wrong. Fear of vertigo. Hypochondriasis. Moods changeable, variable. Jealous. Brooding. Domineering. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill-humor, peevish. Anger from noises. Cursing, swearing. Quarrelsome, scolding. Averse to being disturbed. Irritable towards husband, children, better in the evening. Irritable, when spoken to. Easily offended. Sensitive to reprimands, criticism. Post-partum depression. Depression with a feeling that they would never get well again. General feeling of betrayal and desertion. Forsaken feeling. New mother feels stressed, drained, overwhelmed, and trapped. Feelings of helplessness. Pities herself. Feels inferior, poor self confidence. Timidity about appearing in public. Discontented, dissatisfied with himself, everything. Desire for change. Ennui, boredom. Feels cut off from life. Indifference, apathy to everything. Sadness alternating with indifference. Depression before menses, in morning on waking, afternoon, worse 4 pm. Desire for solitude. Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty thinking and comprehending. Concentration difficult while driving, studying, reading, writing. Confusion of mind in morning, as if in a dream. Mistakes about time. Confounds the days of the week. Mistakes in writing, omitting letters. Absent-mindedness. Memory weakness, from mental exertion. Forgetful. Delusions, imagines that she is alone in the world. Blames her partner for her bad mood. Imagines he is deceived, deserted, forsaken. Delusions everything will fail. Imagines he has ruined his health. Delusions, that left and right side are not the same. Delusions that body parts are distorted. Foolish behavior. Attempts to escape.

Head - Headaches are worse from physical exertion, cold wind, and bending the head forward. Pressing pain.

Eyes - Blinking. Itching, swelling of eyelids.

Nose - Colds. Nasal congestion. Dryness and numb. Sensitive to odors.

Face - Acne. Painful pimples. Numbness. Pain in facial bones.

Mouth - Profuse salivation. Gingivitis.

Throat - Sore throat. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, suppuration. Coldness sensation. Redness. Lump, plug sensation. Mucus, tenacious, difficult to hawk up. Difficult swallowing. Hoarseness. Roughness sensation. Ulcerative pain.

Stomach - Belching. Heartburn, worse from excitement, beer. Indigestion. Dyspepsia. Empty, weak, hungry feeling. Nausea from odors. Nausea with headaches. Motion sickness. Lump sensation. Vomiting after nuts. Vomiting, evening.

Abdomen - Gas and bloating. Obstructed flatulence. Rumbling noises. Bilious complaints. Tenderness in the gallbladder region.

Rectum - Anal, itching. Constipation, with soft stool. Diarrhea, like gushing water. Greasy and fatty stools. Involuntary stool.

Urine - Dark color, frothy, foamy urine. Profuse, increases amounts urine. Scanty urine. Strong, putrid odor, like rotten eggs, sulphur. Vertigo - Vertigo with staggering. As if intoxicated. Worse from looking downward. Motion sickness. Vision - Double vision. Foggy, dim vision. Blurred vision with lachrymation. COMMENTS - Bernd Schuster related several cases of his experiences with Bamb-a. The first concerned Karen, a 29-year-old mother, who could not look after her 12-week-old baby because of severe headaches. The baby was delivered by caesarian and her headaches started shortly afterwards. Initially, the pain was felt only when she shook her head or cleaned her teeth, but by the time the baby was three weeks old she could only lie down. She could not bear the sound of her child crying. Pain was better if she lay down or supported her head. There was a feeling of heaviness or enlargement of her head. Menstruated immediately after childbirth. Irritable. She said she wished her little boy would get lost. Then she laughed and said she didn't mean it and then cried and said, I feel guilty enough about not looking after him properly. After being given Bamb-a., her head and neck pain did not return and her mood improved markedly The second case concerned Lisa, a 35- year-old new mother, who reported “The stress of the birth completely changed me. It was difficult. I am nervous and a wreck. Breastfeeding makes me feel weaker while nursing I have a terrible feeling. My mood is the same as when my mother died. I always weep when I am nursing. I feel empty, miserable, depressed, drained of all my energy.” She was completely stressed and almost felt persecuted by her crying baby. She lay in bed all day. She was afraid to be solely responsible for the child. “I imagined the relationship with the child to be closer, but I need someone to help me I need more support.” After being given Bamb-a., Lisa was more at ease with her baby; the weakness, emptiness and depression have gone and she had more energy. She found it easier to tell friends how she really felt and to accept help. The third case concerned Judy, a 38- year-old mother of two, who suffered from headaches, backaches, sciatica and a feeling of stiffness in the morning, all of which were worse for three days before her period. She had been diagnosed with postnatal depression in the past. She described it as “feeling down.” “My children are not babies any more, but still everything to do with them depends very much on me. My husband is never there. My parents have now moved here and they are always wanting something. And I have to do a lot of jobs physically which women don't usually do. They all come to me when they want something but no one ever asks if they can help me. It bothers me for the future if I get ill, no one will be there for me.” She has had other homeopathic remedies and chiropractic, which both worked well, but it was not until she was given Bamb-a. that her mood improved profoundly, she changed the dynamics in her relationships and her pain and stiffness disappeared. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sep., Puls., Placenta. (2) Rhus-t., Dulc., Cimic., Eup-per. REFERENCES - Schuster.

Male - Atrophy, shriveled genitals. Troublesome erections. Priapism.

Female - Dysmenorrhea. Profuse menses. Suppressed menses. Offensive leucorrhea. Post-partum depression, accompanied by a stiff neck, back pain or sciatica (Cimic.). Prolonged lochia. Menstrual problems after childbirth. Excoriation of cervix. Tearing pain in ovaries.

Chest - Sensation of a lump near sternum. Ears - Hissing noises in ear. Stopped sensation. Pulsation during headache.

Heart - Stitching, burning pain and stiffness. Dragging sensation in heart region.

Back - Backaches. Spinal injuries. Ankylosing spondylitis. Burning along the spine. Stiffness and tension. Cramping, aching and dragging pains. A knotted feeling in the back. Heat waves, flushes. Numbness and tingling. Sacroiliac pains. Coccyx pain, after injuries, stiffness. Stiffness, shoulders. Neuralgic and rheumatic pains, shoulders.

Neck - Stiffness, worse from damp, cold weather. Tension in neck. Very difficult to turn the neck. Torticollis.

Limbs - Weak ankles. Burning in the soles of the feet. Icy cold feet. Weakness of the hand, difficulty in writing. Contractions and spasms.

Sleep - Insomnia. Sleeplessness, from an overactive mind. Constantly turning ideas over in the mind. Wakes 3:30 a.m. to 4:30 a.m. Confused dreams. Nightmares. Dreams of accidents, misfortune, disease, deaths. Dreams of animals, water. Dreams children, old friends. Dreams of teeth falling out. Amorous dreams.

Skin - Excoriation. Itching during sleep. Painful scars. Sensitive to hot water. Stings, from insects.

Fever - Influenza (Rhus-t.). Food - Strong aversion to fat and to beer. Desires wine, cheese spicy foods. Desires stimulants, like coffee. Worse from fats, beer and wine.

Modalities - Pains are better from rest, heat, hot drinks. Worse in the morning on waking, Worse from cold and damp.

Teeth - Toothaches, pain worse from sweets.

Tongue - Burning, raw pains. As if tongue was burnt. Formication. Tingling and prickling sensations. Metallic, offensive, sour, putrid taste.

Liver - Pressing pain.

Bladder - Cystitis, from taking cold. Dragging pains. Pain comes in waves. Causations - Ailments from anger, vexation, suppressed anger, anticipation, foreboding, excitement, wounded pride, honor.

Perspiration - Profuse night-sweats. Odor of sweat, like fresh coffee. Offensive, sweetish sweats. Sticky, viscid sweats.

Temperature - Alternating fever and chills. Chilliness, worse at night. Shaking, shivering with chills.

PHARMACY - bani-c. Banisteriopsis caapi. Ayahuasca. Spirit Vine. Yagé. Psycho- tria viridis. N. O. Malpighiaceae. South America. Amazon. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - AIDS. Allergies. Asthma. Autism. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Clairvoyance. Delusions. Digestive, problems. Drug, abuse. Emphysema. Hallucinations. Insomnia. Kyphosis. Malnutrition. Nausea. Numbness. Parkinson's, disease. Scoliosis. Sexual, abuse. Vomiting. Worms.

HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colombia. Ayahuasca in Ecuador and Peru. Inca “vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.

HOMEOPATHIC - Tiredness, exhaustion, debility. Unable to move from tiredness. Shakiness and disorientation. Unable to recover one's energy with rest. Feelings of detachment, poor memory and vagueness with the exhaustion. Rushes of energy which are associated with raised heartbeat and that cause some anxiety. Heightened sensitivity of all senses, mostly vision and hearing. Muscular soreness and weakness from tiredness. Limbs go to sleep, pins and needles sensations. Tightness, tingling, aching, and drawing in the spine. Numbness and general malaise. Anesthesia. Muscle wastage. Tissue necrosis. Easy dislocation of joints. Crumbling of bone tissue. Digestive tract malfunction. Poor assimilation and metabolism. Imbalance of bowel flora causing psychological symptoms such as depression. Pains can be sharp, sudden on appearance and quick to go, tend to be worse night. Autism. Ailments from injuries, worse spine or the head. AIDS. Cancer. Chronic fatigue. Parkinson's disease. Strong history of drug abuse. Multiple allergy syndrome. MIND - Confusion of mind. Cannot think straight. Difficult concentration, compre hension. Dullness, sluggishness. Mistakes about time. Memory weakness. Forgetfulness. Thoughts intrude and crowd around each other. Tormenting, persisting thoughts. Amorous thoughts. Clear-sighted, increased precision of mind. Sensitive to all external impressions. Senses are acute. Oversensitive to light, noise, shrill sounds, sad stories. Charmedby colors, especially red. Easily startled. Moods are changeable, variable, swings between extremes of rage and well being. Impulsive. Restless, nervous. Impatient, hurried, everybody moves too slow. Stressed mentally and emotionally. Full of worries, forebodings. Insecure. Anxious, desperate. Anxiety from palpitations, on waking. Anxiety about salvation. Overpowering panic attacks. Prolonged anguish and fear which has heightened every sense. Irritability from any disturbance, when questioned. Fastidious. Obstinate, headstrong. Rage, fury. Impulse to kill. Anger during meetings. Jealousy associated with sexual excitement. Suspicious, mistrustful. Weeping, causeless. Pessimistic. Dwells on past disagreeable events. Homesick, nostalgic. Sadness, depression, crying difficult. Ailments from grief, sorrow. Grief of the deepest kind. Forsaken feeling. Worse from consolation, company. Aversion to company. Indifference, apathy towards friends. Despair of life. Unmitigated misery. Suicidal thoughts. Loquacity alternating with sadness. Loss of self-control. Feelings of being disconnected, worse fatigue, stress, anxiety or fear. Inability to feel connected to the mother. Desire for sympathy. Inability to remember childhood. Loss of purpose. Sense of uselessness and frustration at not being able to find one's path. Sense of having been derailed. Work fatigues easily. Sympathetic, compassionate. Fear that something bad will happen. Fear of insanity, of losing self-control. Fear of crossing a bridge, of falling. Fear of ghosts, evil. Fear of impending death, feels as if soul were escaping from body. Fear of terrible dreams. Disoriented. Sense of unreality. Feels as if intoxicated, drugged. Blissful. Cheerfulness. Euphoria. Tranquility, serenity, calmness. Thoughtless. Out-of-body states. Feeling of lightness. Fearlessness. No conception of time. Incorrect judge of sizes. Trance. Clairvoyant and clairaudient. Telepathic phenomena. Psychic abilities that may be illusory. Hears voices or receives psychic messages. False messages. Pride about psychic abilities, may be deluding themselves. Delusions, visions and hallucinations on closing eyes. Floating in air, that he is a bird, of flying, that he has no weight. Delusions that body parts are immaterial, that the head is separated from body, that the mind and body are separated. Religious delusions, that he lost his salvation, of gods, goddesses, angels, devils, ghosts, spirits. Frightful images, phantoms. Delusions of dangerous animals, crocodiles, tigers. Delusions of leopards, reptiles, snakes. Delusions of seeing monsters. Visions of suffering, cruelty, torture, of being at war. Delusions of danger, of being surrounded by the enemy, of being watched, that another person is in the room. Delusions -of events long past. Delusions that death is approaching, about the death of others.

Head - Sensation of being stuffed up with cotton wool. Heat in the vertex or cold as ice.

Eyes - Acute vision or blurred. Sees images superimposed on whatever is being looked at. Doubts what is seen, has to look again.

Ears - Hears acutely. Hears as if from a distance.

Stomach - Sensitive stomach, reacts to many foods. Nausea and vomiting after stimulant food and drink. Feels relieved from vomiting. Nausea and vomiting with anxiety and dread. COMMENTS - Ayahuasca has been noted to produce lethargy, immobility, a desire to close the eyes and a sense of withdrawal from the environment. Visions or dreams, most commonly of snakes which portend either good or evil: they appear either with an open mouth that threatens to swallow, or in motion. Results are different among non-native users. Extreme spiritual fear, often followed by giddiness, nervousness, nausea and sometimes vomiting accompanied by profuse sweating. Flashes of light, which can be followed by a bluish haze on closing the eyes. General lassitude and a heightened aware- . ness and appreciation of colors. Deep and dream filled sleep. On waking there is a common urgency to pass diarrhea. The net result of the whole experience is one of peace of mind and a physical purging.

Abdomen - Flatuence. Malabsorption and malnutrition from defective gut.

Rectum - Constipation, ineffectual urging and straining.

Male - Prostate trouble relating to impo- tency. Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened libido, which can lead to excessive masturbation. Excessive libido as if it were a spiritual experience. Sexual abuse followed by a crippled sex-life.

Female - Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened libido, which can lead to excessive masturbation. Excessive libido in those who enjoy it as if it were only a spiritual experience. Sex with detached feelings. Sexual abuse followed by a crippled sex-life. Difficult, prolonged or late periods. Food - Craves alcohol, stimulants such as coffee and tea. No appetite, would prefer to do without food.

Heart - Congenital heart disease. Real or phantom pains. Raised heart rate. Palpitations.

Back - Injuries to the spine and coccyx. Tension in the neck. Scoliosis and kyphosis. Dreams - Exhausting, frightful or joyful dreams. Unremembered dreams. Dreams of animals, reptiles. Dreams of crossing bridges, flying, musical instruments, music, food. Amorous, lewd, lascivious, sexual dreams. Dreams of previous events, old friends, people not seen for years. Dreams of anger of cruelty, enemies, death, dying, war, being taken prisoner, strife, being wounded.

Limbs - Muscle wasting. Poor extension and abduction of limbs due to inelasticity of tendons and ligaments. Poor circulation, coldness and numbness of extremities. Possible remedy for gangrenous states. Lungs - Restricted breathing from emotional disturbances. Emphysema. Asthma, chronic constricted airways.

Sleep - like trance, in which the person would want to keep the eyes closed, but in which there would be a sense of alertness with greatly increased intensity of awareness and insight into metaphysics or into personal problems of the moment. Users described various themes, including the separation of sour and body separate, often with a sense of flight, sometimes at high speed. Visions of jungle animals. Mystical visions of angels, Christ or the Devil. Clairvoyance, vision of a future event. Visual experience of an event from the past that in some way illuminates the present. RELATIONS - Compare: Anae., Ahal. Op. REFERENCES - Murphy. Wansbrough.

Kidneys - Weak kidneys. Frequent urinary infections or pains in the kidneys.

Perspiration - Offensive, strong, sweetish odor.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pain in the right jaw and oppression in left hypochondrium, producing dyspnea and a necessity to assume an erect position. COMMENTS - J. Meredith notedhisexperience with this shrub. He showed symptoms including congestion of the forepart of head. Weak vision. Hectic flush after tea. Right molar felt too long, worse by pressure intermittent, right jaw (later both jaws) stiff and painful at joint. Sciatica left side. Appetite increased, more energy for mental work. Improved sleep. He was also relieved of a distressing symptom, that has troubled him for many months, and for which the ordinary Bapt. tincture in any preparation had failed to relieve. He described it as “areally distressing left hypochondrium oppression, fullness and actual dyspnea, impelling me to assume an erect position." This oppression would continue half the night. The distress was located either in the spleen or splenic curve of the colon. It was uninfluenced by eating. Bapt-c. seemed to relieve the symptom very rapidly, causing something to move to the left and downwards, after which he went to sleep. A case simulating typhoid was rapidly relieved by the remedy, showing its relation to Bapt. tinct. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
