Mucus or bloody expectoration, or pure blood, raised most in morning and evening, with sensation of cold in chest.

Temperature - Coldness and shivering, with moist skin, nervousness and trembling, worse going into open air. Fever with apathy or delirium, and cold feet. Burning heat in various parts. Limbs burning hot during fever.

HERBAL - Buniasis abiennial plant, measuring up to 120 cm. It flowers in May and June, and grows near lucerne fields and along the roads all over Europe. Prinzing used the seeds of the Norwegian stock of the plant in homeopathic potencies. His attention was drawn towards this plant after learning that a doctor in the North was using Bunias to treat cancerous subjects with interesting results.

HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic clinical proving involved one hundred and three patients during a period of two years, and a series of forty patients observed for ten years. The remedy as found to be suitable for tubercular and sycotic types with arthritic neurotic tendencies, for women with syphilitic afflictions, and especially for cancerous subjects. Allergic, psoric or syphilitic conditions, pre-cancerous conditions. Hodgkin's disease. Intermittent attacks of fever, beginning with a fit of shivering at around 11 p.m. chattering teeth, heat and ending in the morning. Brachial neuralgia. Pains go around in circles, quickly change place, burning, stinging or cramping. Diffuse nerve pains, behind the mastoid process, the top of the radius top of the fibula the end of the 12th rib. Neuralgia of the left sciatic nerve. The sudden appearance and disappearance of all symptoms. Rapid emaciation of no apparent reason, (pre- cancerous condition). Tiredness, weakness, loss of vitality. Every difficult previously overcome with ease is now arduous and faced with gritting of the teeth. Need to lie down after a few hours work. Cannot stay awake in the evening. Sensory complaints decreased vision and hearing. Feeling of stabbing the chest. Sensation that the head is increased in size of swelling in the upper part of the body in the hand. Feeling of coldness in the head, stomach, fingers and back. Sensation of lightness and of hovering in the air, then of falling violently into a bottomless pit. Itching eruption followed by adenitis. Subacute infections of rheumatic or of the female genital organs. Neuritis and neuralgia. Irregular menses, nauseating leucorrhea. Abnormal pregnancy. Children weak puny, premature, syphilitic types. Babies born with congenital malformations. Profuse bleeding after birth with large placenta. Scars. Bloodstained lochia continuing for three to four months. Vulvar varicosity during pregnancy. Metrorrhagia during menopause. MIND - Neurotic condition with anguish and unrest. Irrational anxiety, can lead to suicide. Depressive psychosis in the pre-cancerous subject. Psychological exhaustion. Depressed. Depressive psychosis, which can end in suicide.

Eyes - Visual complaints. Sees clouds or black circles before the eye. Temporary amaurosis.

Ears - Tinnitus-like bells ringing, or water boiling.

Abdomen - Copies flatulence during the day. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Cancerous, syphilitic conditions.

Rectum - Stools suddenly turn to diarrhea in attacks lasting 2-3 days, then reverting to normal. Attacks of constipation with hard stools, difficult with nausea. Tendency to sudden appearance of hemorrhoids.

Female - Menses painful, irregular, abundant or scanty flow with purplish blood and clotting. Infrequent menses. Headaches and dyspnea before menses. Vulvar congestion with red-brown coloring. Vulvar eczema. Irritating leucorrhea, yellow or brownish, foul-smelling, nauseating. Menorrhagia in young girls. Pre-menopausal menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia through premature placenta or hematoma behind the placenta. Abnormal pregnancy.

Limbs - Bouts of rheumatoid arthritis with swollen joints. Localized edema, coming and disappearing suddenly, on the back of the hand, collarbones and axillae. Coccydynia. Lungs - Sharp, sudden hoarseness. Dyspnea. Asthma, appearing suddenly at the age of 40. Wheezy respiration, dyspnea, sensation of restriction in the chest, pain on the left side of the sternum.

Sleep - Sleep light, disturbed, frequently woken. Tosses and turns constantly from one side to the other to fall asleep exhausted when the morning comes.

Skin - Eruption of red spots or vesicles, redbrick or pale purple in color, located on the nose, cheeks, palms, forearms, thighs, legs. Vesicles on the tip of the tongue, the periphery of the mouth and around the anus. Itching eruption, aggravated by scratching. Pruritus premonitory to malignant adenitis.

Modalities - Better from walking. Better changing position. Better open air. Worse at night. Worse on the side of the body compressed for a long time. Worse on left side. Worse from over-exertion. Worse from heavy, fatty foods.

Kidneys - Urine irritating of a strong odor, albuminous or streaked with blood. Proteinuria. Indol in urine. Bacteria in urine.

Temperature - Fever every 21 days in short attacks, coming between 11 p.m. and 12 p.m. with shivering, thoracic pains on the left side, weakness and vomiting. Two to four hours after the shivering comes sweating, which soothes. Vertigo - Vertigo with a feeling of uncertainty, coming suddenly, lasting only a short while in the early morning. RELATIONS - Compare: (1 ) Bapt. - Considerable nervous depression, face red, bewildered, extreme agitation, putrid-smelling breath, fetid diarrhea, lived marks on the body and limbs. (2) Syph. - Pains in the bones, at night, appearing and disappearing slowly. Breath fetidand painless constipation or diarrhea in the morning. Profuse, acrid, yellowish leucorrhea. (3) Syph. - Changing moods, difficulty in assembling thoughts, loss of memory, especially forproper nouns. (4) Ars. - Rapid prostration, anxiety, agitation, cadaverous odor of the secretions, aggravation at night between 1 a.m. and 3 a.m. (5) Sec. - Post-partum hemorrhage. Hemorrhage of black blood in exhausted women. REFERENCES Julian.

HOMEOPATHIC - Buthus Australis is a scorpion belonging to the arthropod order of the arachnid class. The scorpions are insects distinguished by the division of their bodies into three sections: the head and thorax, the pre-abdomen (seven segments) of the same form as the head and thorax, and the post-abdomen (six segments), mistakenly called the tail, which is very mobile and ends with a venomous, curved sting. The chelicerae have three joints, the last sections forming the pincers. The leg-jaws are very long and end in fat pincers. These animals are viviparous, carnivorous, feed on insects and spiders, which they catch with their pincers and have a defense organ. Azam first carried out a proving on himself by taking one drop of pure venom orally. A second proving was undertaken by Azam and carried out with the help of eight pro vers (three women and five men), using the 6x potency for thirty days. Only four provers continued to the end of the thirty days. Symptoms included an inhibition of will power and reduced activity. Head heavy, frontal headache. Vertigo on walking. Excessive salivation. Attacks of fever with shivering. Limbs are cold with burning pain in the skin. Upset by climatic changes with mental depression and shivering. Anguish, thoracic constriction. Sensation of a piece of wood nailed between the heart and lungs. Hypotension in infectious conditions. Infectious conditions with fever, shivering, prostration, aggravated at night. Respiratory difficulty during pulmonary or cardiac illnesses. MIND - Intellectual work arduous or trying. Alternating moods, at times loquacious, at times taciturn, sometimes prostrate, sometimes restless. Irresistible need to speak. Anguish. Indecision and worry. Weepy. Fear of the future, especially after 7 p.m. Sensation of being in a dream.

Head - Throbbing headaches, wandering, very intense.

Eyes - Red, weeping with photophobia. Eyeballs sunken. Strabismus.

Nose - Sneezing.

Mouth - Profuse salivation. Difficult swallowing.

Throat - Constriction in the throat. Vertigo - Vertigo on walking. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lach. - Aggravated by lying down. Spontaneous hematoma. (2) Merc. - Excessive salivation and tongue has a yellowish coating, which retains the imprint of the teeth. (3) Apis - Sensation of being pierced by red hot needles, but with a predominance coldness at the limbs and sensation of icy needles. (4) Verat. - Sensation of icy coldness. (5) Sil. - Throbbing headache, weeping, sneezing, difficulty in swallowing, chilliness, shivering and sweating, but without the feeling of a piece of wood nailed between the heart and lungs. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Pain and chill.

Rectum - Diarrhea.

Heart - Feeling of heat in heart of a piece of wood nailed between heart and lungs.

Back - Cervical muscular pains and stiffness of the nape of the neck.

PHARMACY - but-ac. Butyricum acidum. Butyric acid. A volatile acid obtained chiefly from butter, being found there in the form of an ester, a triglyceride, and as such constitutes thechieffatofbutterandmilk. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Butyric acid occurs in the animal organism undera variety of conditions. It constitutes the chief fat of butter and milk. Butyric acid set free by fermentation causes a rancid taste and the odor of contaminated butter. When milk sours, milk sugar is converted into lactic acid by the lactic ferment of various bacteria. The lactic acid is then acted upon by butyric acid ferment contained in the air. It may be present in the gastric contents under abnormal conditions, with a markedly diminished hydrochloric acid secretion. In excessive fermentation in the enteric tract, butyric acid may be formed in significant amounts. Abdominal flatulence. Tremendous formation of gas in the whole belly, much belching of gas, a great deal of gas is passed at the call to stool, which in many cases fails to come. Marked straining at stool. Stools are small like lumps. Intermittent belly cramps which are below the umbilicus. Pain in the ileocecal region. Complete loss of appetite. Fetid leucorrhea. Offensive sweating of the soles of feet. MIND - Anxiety and fear. Worries over trifles. Constant fear and nervousness. Impulsive thoughts of suicide, brooding.

Head - Headache makes him apprehensive about trifles, worse going upstairs or rapid motion. Dull, hazy ache of head.

Mouth - Fetid odor in the mouth. Profuse salivation. Gingivitis. Gums tinged with blood. Gingival secretions, which are offensive smelling and more profuse during menses. Painful gums, worse during menses.

Stomach - Much gas in stomach and bowels. Cramps in pit of stomach, worse at night. Stomach feels heavy and overloaded. COMMENTS - The following provings were conducted at the Hahnemann Hospital of Philadelphia, upon students at that institution. The students took the 3 c potency of the remedy every two hours; in all, the proving was carried on for approximately seven weeks. The remedy induces a peculiar effect on the superficial part of the body. Pronounced and awfully malodorous foot sweat. Students at the Hahnemann College often had to constantly change their socks, a thing quite foreign to the provers under normal conditions. Crumbling away of the fingernails. Aggravated backache. All the symptoms are decidedly worse at night. Pronounced sleeplessness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bapt. - Putrid smelling breath. Fetid diarrhea and putrid stools. Mental confusion, illusion that the body is double. (2) Verat. - Prostration intense delirium, feeling of chill running over the whole body and cold sweating on forehead, hands and fee . Abdominal colic with copious diarrhea, followed by extreme weakness. (3) Nux-m. - Dryness of the mucus membranes, thirst, gastric and abdominal distention. Constipation with difficulty in expelling stools. Amenorrhea with leucorrhea. REFERENCES - Anshutz.

Abdomen - Gastric and abdominal flatulence. Cramp in abdomen below umbilicus. Bowels irregular. Atony of the liver and stomach. Epigastric and peri-umbilical pains, awaking at about 2 a.m. Pain in the ileocecal region with feeling of cramp, relieved by expulsion of gas.

Rectum - Sudden nocturnal cramps with an urgent need to go to stool. Offensive smelling stools, chestnut or light yellow in color. Feeling of heaviness in rectum with pain in the anus. Stool accompanied by pain and straining.

Female - Foul-smelling leucorrhea, like horses urine. Purulent cervicitis. Dysuria. Food - Anorexia. Poor appetite.

Heart - Palpitations, aggravated by eating, with a feeling of abdominal plethora.

Back - Tired feeling and dull pain in small of back, worse walking. Pain in ankles and up back of leg. Pain low down in back and limbs. Ankylosing spondylitis. Morbus coxae senilis.

Limbs - Dull aching of lumbar and sacral regions, worse standing, spreading towards the hip. Dull aching of arms, legs and calves. Cold feet, with abundant, fetid perspiration. Edema of the feet during menses.

Sleep - Sleep disturbed, owing to digestive complaints. Pronounced sleeplessness, dreams of serious nature while asleep.

Skin - The fingernails crumble away. Su- damina. Dysidrosis of the palms and soles. Onychomycosis.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse fast walking. Worse going upstairs. Worse during menses.

Kidneys - Urgent and pressing need to urinate, especially for women. Urine malodorous, smelling like asparagus. Amorphous urate deposits.

Perspiration - Perspiration on slight exertion. Profuse, offensive foot sweat.

Pretty frequent desire to urinate, but no increase in amount of urine emitted. Slight increase in frequency of pulse. Slight degree of nausea on one or two occasions. Senseless and unconscious, with ice-cold hands and feet, half-closed eyes, dilated pupils, respiration very slow, almost imperceptible, action of the heart intermitting, scarcely perceptible, anus relaxed, wide open, limbs relaxed. He fell to the ground unconscious, with loud cries and convulsions. MIND - Mental and physical prostration. Emotional. At times, painful weeping, with grinding of the teeth. Sadness. Wakes in bad humor. She seemed to have some consciousness, as was shown by the look of her eye when her name was called aloud.

Head - Giddiness of the head. Weight in the head, especially the top of the forehead, at 4 p.m.

Mouth - Clammy mouth, with bad breath. Bitter mouth.

Stomach - Violent vomiting and purging. Heaviness in the stomach all night, relieved by applying the hands. Borborygmi. Vague and transient, but very acute, pains in the stomach.

Abdomen - Labor like pains in lower abdomen.

PHARMACY - cac. Cacao. Cocoa. Theobroma cacao. N. O. Sterculiaceae. Tribe, Buettnerieae. Trituration of the seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aneurism. Angina pectoris. Apoplexy. Atheroma. Asthma. Bladder, paralysis. Brain, congestion. Bronchitis. Diaphragm, rheumatism. Dropsy. Exophthalmic goitre. Fistula. Hematuria. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhage. Headaches. Heart, affections. Heart, hypertrophy. Intermittent fever. Lungs, hemorrhage. Melancholy. Menstruation, painful. Malaria. Neuralgia. Otitis. Ovaries, inflammation. Ovaritis. Pneumonia. Prostate, affections. Rheumatism. Sunstroke. Traumatic fever. Vaginismus.

HERBAL - Theobroma is Greek for “Food of the Gods”. Mayan Indian legend has it that the cocoa tree was a gift from the gods. The Mayas believed the drink made from the cocoa seeds would nourish them after death. The Aztecs believed cocoa would relieve their fatigue and stimulate their mental and psychic abilities. The Spanish invaders were surprised to find that the cocoa beans were valued more than any other substance, even more than gold. The Aztecs used a chocolate drink as a base in many of their medicinal formulas. The Aztec nobility used the chocolate drink favored with vanilla and spices as a pleasurable drink.

HOMEOPATHIC - The main ingredients of chocolate are caffeine, phenylethylamine, theobromine and theophylline. Feeding with waste Chocolate led to fatal poisoning in calves. The animals showed excitement, stared about in all directions, walked with exaggerated strides and had convulsions. One calf died, possibly from heart failure. Allen noted, “In explaining the nutritive value of Cacao, we must take into account the presence in this substance of a special alkaloid, theobromin, whose physiological effects are identical with those of caffeine and thein. “Which, retarding the organic waste in the same way as the active principles of coffee and tea, place Cacao high up among the preservative substances or those that check tissue-waste.” “By placing ourselves under the influence of a decoction highly charged with aromatic principles and made from powdered Cacao well roasted, we ascertained that this beverage produces an excitement of the nervous system similar to that caused by a strong infusion of black coffee. “Since these effects are insignificant if a decoction of the raw bean is employed. It is natural to attribute them to the aromatic essences that are developed in the Cacao by the process of roasting. A still wider difference is observed when we compare the effects on the circulation respectively produced by a decoction of powdered Cacao roasted and one of the same substance in a crude state. “The former case indicated an excitement of the circulation, as shown by an accelerated pulse, with an increased fullness and diminished arterial pressure. “When, on the other hand, an infusion of the raw bean is made use of, the action of the theobromin predominates and an entirely different character of pulse is the result, as may be placed beyond doubt by examining the results, obtained from a single individual.” Causation - Damp. Disappointed love. Sun. Sensations - Finger were enlarged on waking. Grain of sand under skin. Worm under skin which ran away when touched. COMMENTS - Allen stated “In order to ascertain the effect of the active ingredients, contained in Cacao, (aromatic essences and theobromin) upon the nervous system. It was necessary to separate those ingredients, as far as possible from the fatty substances (cacao butter) of which the beans are so largely composed. With this view, we prepared a decoction of powdered Cacao in boiling water and conducted our experiments with this liquid. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chocolate, Coffea, Thea. REFERENCES - Allen. Desai.

PHARMACY - cact. Cactus grandiflorus. Night-blooming Cereus. Cereus grandiflorus. Cactus selenicereus. N. O. Cactaceae. Mexico. West Indies. Tincture of youngest, tender stems and flowers collected in summer. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Atheroma. Asthma. Bladder, paralysis. Brain, congestion. Bronchitis. Colic. Diaphragmitis. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, inflammation. Exophthalmic, goiter. Fevers. Fistulas. Goiter. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Headache. Heart, attack. Heart, disorders. Indigestion. Intermittent, fevers. Lungs, hemorrhage. Melancholy. Menstruation, painful. Malaria. Neuralgias. Otitis media. Ovaritis. Pneumonia. Prostate, disorders. Rheumatism. Spasmodic, pains. Stroke. Sunstroke. Traumatic fever. Vaginismus.

HERBAL - Given as a heart tonic, it will benefit a large number of cases of weakened and painful heart. Atheromatous arteries and weak heart. General weakness and prostration. Irregular circulation, causing violent congestion or localized pulsations. Congestion in the esophagus, bladder, etc. Used as an herbal tonic for heart patients with a history of constricting pains.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cactus affects the entire organism powerfully. but its internal operation is on the heart and circulation. In congestive violence it rivals Aeon., which is one of its antidotes. The pains are unendurable, they extort screams. Sadness, apprehension, fearof death and a tendency to be easily frightened characterize the mental state, as they do many conditions of heart disease. Constriction, periodicity and spasmodic pains. “As if an iron band had prevented its normal movements,” or “heart as if compressed, and as violently struggled to burst its bonds.” Whole body feels as if caged, each wire being twisted tighter. It affects the circular muscles, thereby producing constricting pains in the heart, throat, chest, bladder, rectum, vagina, and neck. “Fluttering and palpitation of heart, worse when walking or lying on left side.” Pain and numbness in left arm accompanying heart disease. “Heart disease with swelling of left hand only.” “Numbness of left arm.” Hemorrhagic remedy, favors formation of clots speedily. Hemorrhages (nose, lungs, rectum, stomach). Bloody congestions, which are in a way a counterpart of the constrictive sensations. “Periodical attacks of suffocation with fainting, cold sweat on face and loss of pulse.” Pulseless, panting and prostration. Low blood pressure from weakness of heart. Congestions, irregular distribution of blood. Sharp pains in diaphragm and girdle pain around its attachment, with indigestion. Hot gushing into chest. Toxic goiter with cardiac symptoms. Dropsical disorders. Weakness and coldness of limbs. Twitching of muscles and sensation of constriction produced by touching the affected part. “Rheumatism of all joints, beginning in upper limbs.” The pains are very sharp, causing the patient to cry out. “Heavy pain in vertex like a weight.” Great periodicity, neuralgic pains occur periodically. Chill at same hour every day, 11 a.m. or 11 p.m. Many symptoms are worse at night. Menses cease at night. MIND - Melancholic, taciturn, sad, ill-humored. Sadness and melancholy. Cries, knows not why, worse from consolation. Screams with pain. Love of solitude. Weeping, without knowing why, worse consolation. Fear that something bad will happen. Easily frightened. Fear of death. Fear of heart disease. Screams with pain. Anxiety on waking. Irresistible inclination to weep. Believes that his disease is incurable. Fears some organic lesion of heart which will cause sudden death. Easily frightened on waking. Wishes to be alone and not to speak to anyone. Slowness, always behind hand. Impulse to do strange things. Irritability, worse consolation. Sadness during menses. Sensitive to music, noise. Talk of others aggravates. Weeping before menses. Difficulty in expressing ideas when writing. Delirium at night, ceases on awaking, but returning in sleep. Feels she is dying and thinks she will not live till morning, but has no fear of death. Unwilling to answer. Easily frightened, often awakes in a fright. Felt much alarmed on waking, but could not tell cause of alarm.

Head - Headache if misses a meal (Ars., Lach., Lyc.). Sensation as of a weight on vertex. Right-sided pulsating pain. Headache worse by seeing opera, noise, light. Periodic pains, compressive and pulsating. Congestive headaches, threatening a stroke. Blood vessels to the head distended. Feels as if head were compressed in a vice.

Eyes - Bloodshot eyes. Exophthalmic goiter. Dimness of sight, cannot see at a distance, objects seem obscured.

Ears - Pulsation in ears. Hearing diminished by the buzzing in the ears. Singing, ringing in ears.

Nose - Profuse nosebleed, but soon ceases. Fluent coryza.

Face - Face, red bloated, emaciated. Pale. Right-sidedfacialpain, constricting pains, returns at same hour daily (Cedr.).

Mouth - Loss of taste for food, with nausea. Tongue purple, thick, brown sordes on teeth. Prickling on point of tongue. Very offensive breath. Dryness of tongue, as if burnt.

Throat - Suffocative constriction at throat with full, throbbing carotids in angina pectoris. Constriction of esophagus, must drink to swallow. Needs much liquid to get food down. Feeling of warmth about throat and chest. Scraping sensation at soft palate. Vertigo - Vertigo, worse deep breathing or exertion. Vertigo from blood congestions to head. COMMENTS - Snader considered Cact. especially indicated where the heart is weak and the arteries atheromatous. This was confirmed by a correspondent of the Hom. World (July, 1898), who, finding his temporal arteries swollen and hard to the touch took several doses of Cact. lx with the result that in a few days they became normal. Snader used the lower potencies in this condition. A case of angina pectoris was cured by the 30c with a sensation as though a swarm of hornets were going from pectoral region to heart. Choudhury reported a case cured, the characteristics included “Chill severe, 11 a.m., thirst, headache, body hot, no separate heat.” Heat with thirst and short breath. At times there is entire absence of sweat. Keynote constricting pain. The chest feels tight, and keeps getting tighter as their breath goes away. Feels like a hand has reached into the chest and grabbed the heart and is squeezing (Spig., as if a hot burning knife is being stabbed into the heart and pulled out repeatedly, with a pain shooting down the arm). Heart attack (Lat-m.). Tendency to a heart attack with high blood pressure, chest pain, shortness of breath, with constriction. After a heart attack, w ith shortness of breath and tightness in the chest. Tendency to get out of breath and get tightness in the chest (acute or chronic). In some cases, even the throat goes tight. Heart symptoms tend tq the left side. Heart pathologies, regurgitation and failure of the valves, tightness and shprtness of the breath, suffocated feeling, heart murmurs, palpitation, high or low blood pressure. Neuralgia around the ribs and heart, feels as if the rib cage or the heart is wrapped with wire and someone is twisting the end of the wire and tightening the wires around the heart. Oppression of the chest (Phos.). Constriction anywhere in the body. Constriction in the ovaries. Uterine cramps where the uterus feels constricted as if a band is wrapped around it, or as if a hand is grabbing the uterus, squeezing and letting go repeatedly. Facial neuralgias where the face feels squeezed in together and painful, more often right (Spig., more often left). They constantly look in the mirror to see if they can actually see their face being constricted. Headaches with constricting pain, as if there's a band being tightened: Sunstroke. Many fears (Ars.), fear of death and dying. Used as an herbal tonic for heart patients with a history of constricting pains. Used in a 30c or 200c for a person with an active heart attack. Low potencies can help to strengthen the heart. -ELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon., Camph., Chin., Eup-per. Compare: (1) Dig., Spig., Conv., Kalm., Naja, Magn-gr. (2) Cer-b., Cer-s., Opun-v. (3) Coc-c. (4) In mental symptoms - Dig., Lach. (5) In congestions to head - Bell., Glon. (6) In pain and pressure in head - Arn., Carb-v., Cor-r., lod., Nux-v., Op., Spig. (7) Weight in vertex - Aloe., Alum. (8) In heart affections - Aeon., Cimic., Amyl-n., Arn., Bell., Bov., Crot- h., Dig., Eup-per., Kalm., Lach., Lil-t., Naja, Puls., Spig., Zinc, (as if a cap over heart). (9) Constrictions of chest - Zinc., Kali-chl., Cadm-s., Alum., Bell., Bov., Am., Kali-n., Lach. (10) Constrictions - Stram., Murx., (uterus), Kali-c., (vagina) . ( 11 ) In menses ceasing at night - Caust. ( 12) In leucorrhea - Am-m. (13) In intermittents - Ars., Bry., Calc., Eup-per., Nat-m., Rhus-t, Sulph. (14) In dropsies - Dig., Kalm. Compatible: (1) Dig. - Tumultuous action of heart, slow, irregular pulse, scanty urine, dropsy. (2) Eup- per., Lach., Nux-v„ Sulph. - Pleurisy. Follows well: Aeon.. Am., Ars., Bell., Bry., Cham., Gels., Ip., Kali-br. - diaphragmitis. Lach., Nux-v., Rhus-t. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - After eating, weight and distress in stomach. Gastro-enteritis. Constriction, burning pulsation or heaviness in stomach. Vomiting of blood. Pulsation in celiac artery behind the stomach. Nausea in the morning, lasting all day. Acrid, sour fluid in stomach, which rises in throat and mouth.

Abdomen - Colic with loose stool. Intense burning in abdomen. Sharp pain, shooting through diaphragm and up into chest. As if a cord was tied tighter and tighter around attachment of diaphragm, taking his breath away. Pain and bearing-down in lower abdomen.

Rectum - Constipation, hard and black stool. Diarrhea, watery, mucous, bilious. Hemorrhoids, swollen and painful. Sensation of great weight in anus. Itching in the anus. Pricking as from a pin in anus, better slight friction. Fistula in anus with violentpalpitationsofheart. Hemorrhages from bowels in malarial fevers and with heart symptoms.

Male - Prostatic affections, weight in anus.

Female - Constriction of vagina preventing sex, vaginismus. Constriction in uterine region and ovaries. Pulsation in ovarian region. Dysmenorrhea, pulsating pain in Cactus grandiflorus uterus and ovaries. Vaginismus. Menses early, dark, pitch-like (Cocc., Mag-c.), cease on lying down, with heart symptoms. Menses lumpy, black, too soon. Painful menses, extorting loud cries. Menstrual disorders with heart symptoms. Food - Appetite good, digestion weak. Complete loss of appetite, stomach rejects everything. Aversion to meat, of which he was fond.

Chest - Constriction, acute pains and stitches in chest. Constriction as if bound, hindering respiration. Oppressed breathing as from a weight on chest. Angina pectoris with suffocation, cold sweat and an iron-band feeling. Palpitation, pain shooting down left arm. Diaphragmitis with great difficulty of breathing. Continuous rattling of mucus in chest. Constitutions - Sanguine constitutions.

Heart - Feels clutched and released alternately by an iron band or feels it expand and contract, seems to turn over. Constriction, very acute pains and stitches in heart. Pain in apex, shooting down left arm. Palpitations, worse lying on left side, at the approach of menses, during the day, while walking, from disappointed love. Palpitations with vertigo, dyspnea, flatulence. Pulsations increase on holding the breath. Endocarditis with mitral insufficiency together with violent and rapid action. Murmurs, excessive pulse rate, increased precordial dullness, enlarged ventricle. Pulse feeble, irregular, quick without strength. Low blood pressure. Heart disease with edema of left hand. As if heart would fly to pieces on holding the breath. Hypertrophy. Aneurysm of large arteries and heart. Heart weakness and arteriosclerosis. Tobacco heart.

Back - Exophthalmic goiter. Cold in back and icy cold hands. Rheumatism of the shoulder. Pain under left shoulder blade with palpitations. Lumbar muscles tender on pressure and stiff, especially on first moving after repose. Breasts - Inflammation of breasts. Mastitis. Breast tumor. Causations - Ill effects of sun, dampness, disappointment in love, or grief.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains, in shoulders, upper and lower arms, in hips down to feet, worse in rest and in motion, and in all positions. Left arm numb. Pain in left arm down to fingers. Fingers tingle. Icy cold hands. Edema of left hand in heart disease and of feet, extending to knees. Hands soft, feet enlarged. Restless legs.

Sleep - Sleeplessness, on account of strong pulsations in different places. Frightful dreams, lascivious, of falling. Awakes in fright.

Skin - Dry, scaly herpes on the outside of the elbow and on the right internal malleolus.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better pressure on vertex. Worse from lying down on left side, on occiput. Worse exertion. Worse walking, and going upstairs. Worse from 11 a.m. or 11 p.m. Worse night. Worse noise, light. Worse heat, sun's rays, and damp. Worse from fasting. Worse after eating, as a weight in stomach.

Liver - Engorgement of liver due to heart disease. Lungs - Difficulty breathing. Oppression of breathing, going up stairs. Periodical attacks of suffocation with fainting, sweat on face and loss of pulse. Inflammation of diaphragm with difficulty in breathing. Chronic bronchitis with rattling of mucus. Hemoptysis with convulsive, spasmodic cough. Cough from heart disorders. Catarrhal cough with much viscid expectoration. Cyanotic infants.

Kidneys - Constriction of neck of bladder, causing retention of urine. Urine suppressed in fevers. Hemorrhage from bladder. Clots of blood in urethra. Irritation in urethra. Constant urination. Hematuria, urination prevented by clots in vagina in females. Urine passes by drops, with much burning. Profuse urine of a straw color. Urine has deposits of red sand.

Pulse - Pulse, irritable intermittent, feeble. Irregular and intermittent action after forceps delivery.

Temperature - Coldness predominates, cold sweat with great anguish. Chilly, not worse by covering. Persistent subnormal temperature. Fever every day at same hour. Coldness in back and icy cold hands. Intermittent paroxysms about midday (11 a.m.), incomplete in their stages, accompanied by hemorrhages.

PHARMACY - cadm-br. Cadmium bromatum. Cadmium bromide. Trituration or solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cancer. Diarrhea. Heartbum. Indigestion. Strokes. Throat pain. Tumors. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cadm-br. should be compared to Cadm-s. Three persons experimented with Cadm-br., it produced a burning sensation in mouth, gullet and stomach. Goose flesh. Diarrhea. Clinically Cadm-br. has been used for apoplexy, threatening stroke and predisposition for strokes. Cerebral hemorrhage. Pulse, imperceptible. Throat pain. Sore throat, pain worse after swallowing. Stomach pain after lifting. Burning pain in stomach. Burning pain as from an ulcer. Vomiting of blood. Bloody vomit. Sudden vomiting. Cancer of the bowels. Tumors. COMMENTS - Allen stated: “I found both ladies vomiting severely and complaining of extreme pain and burning sensation in the stomach. “Mrs. R. who also purging freely, though her daughter was not. The vomiting and purging lasted fully five hours and during a part of the time the pulse was imperceptible in either patient. After this period the symptoms ameliorated and they both fell asleep. “For several days they were both confined to their beds and were obliged to be extremely careful as to what they took into their stomachs. Mrs. R. has since suffered with some cerebral symptoms which betoken a tendency to strokes. A severe burning sensation in the mouth, esophagus and stomach, which lasted perhaps and hour.” REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - cadm-f. Cadmium flourata. Cadmium flouride. Cadmium fluoricum. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Adenoma. Bowel, cancer. Cancer. Prostate, cancer. Rectal, cancer. Tumors.

HOMEOPATHIC - Grimmer wrote: “Cadmium fluorata is a remedy that helped one case very much, a late case of cancer of the prostate. There was no question about the diagnosis, which was made by an eminent pathologist in Chicago. The patient was at the point of death. “I sent my assistant out to see him and get a blood sample. Every test showed the presence of cancer. I never saw this patient, so I didn't report the case, but the doctor informed me there was a big pulsating mass. He could feel it through the patient's rectum and said it was undoubtedly cancer, very far advanced. He didn't think the man would live more than a few days. Nevertheless, we gave him cadmium flour. “This man lived for a year and part of the time the function of the bladder was restored. He gave up his catheter for quite a while and subsequently used it only occasionally. He left us because he was dissatisfied with his progress. He was an old man and had been put in much more comfort. I lost track of him after a year, but at the end of that year he was better in every way.” REFERENCES - Grimmer. Murphy.

CLINICAL - Anal, itching. Bowel cancer. Cachexia. Cancer. Constipation. Gland, cancer. Gland, disorders. Goiter. Emaciation. Ileus. Necrosis. Pancreatic cancer. Palpitations. Pruritis ani. Radiation, poisoning. Rectal, prolapse. Spleen, cancer. Thyroid, cancer. Thyroid, disorders. Tumors. Ulcerative colitis. Ulcers. Uterine, cancer.

HOMEOPATHIC - Grimmer said this remedy is a powerful anti-syphilitic as well as anti- psoric and anti-sycotic. All the Cadmiums cover the three miasms of Hahnemann. A great remedy tor the glands, the cervical glands of the neck, the tonsils, the thyroid, the mammary glands. The entire lymphatic system, the testicles, and the ovaries. Cancer of the glands with emaciation. Thyroid, cancer. Bowel cancer. Pancreatic cancer. Spleen, cancer. Tumors of glands. The liver, the spleen, and the pancreas are sooner or later involved under the influence of this remedy. Constipation. Frequent desire to stool, tenesmus. Abdomen bloated. Anal itching with constipation. Itching of anus and rectum felt during the day only. Characteristic hatred, hates everybody and everything. Atheistic and hateful with a high degree of self-pity. Aggravated from extreme heat, as well as from extreme cold. As a rule, the patient becomes less chilled than when under the influence of other Cadmiums due to the iodine component of the remedy. COMMENTS - Grimmer had a patient with some of the above symptoms, together with an ulceration of the transverse colon, which cleared up, under Cadm-i. He lost his hatred, became quite human and kind, and gained greatly in weight. REFERENCES - Grimmer.

PHARMACY - cadm-met. Cadmium metallicum. Cadmium metal (At. Wt. 48). Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aluminum, poisoning. Anemia. Bacillary, dysentery. Backache. Blood, poisoning. Cancers. Chemotherapy, effects. Chlorosis. Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coughs. Depression. Diaphragmatic, hernia. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Dysentery. Emaciation. Enterocolitis. Fatigue, chronic. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Indigestion. Influenza. Liver, weakness. Lupus, erythematous. Migraines. Nausea. Pharyngitis. Radiation, poisoning. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cadmium met. comes between zinc and mercury with an atomic weight of 48. The toxicology indicates vomiting, loss of appetite, emaciation. Sneezing and coughing with profuse secretion from the respiratory and ocular mucus membranes. Cadmium met. and other chemical combinations of cadmium have proved curative in many cases of stomach and intestinal cancer. Many of these cases were caused were caused by irritative actions of alumina toxin resulting from aluminum cooking utensils. The water supply of many cities and towns has been treated with aluminum fluoride, exposing the public to a potent carcinogenic agent that has the potential to activate the disease in all those with inherited tendencies to it. Cadm-met. and Cadm-o. are the most effective antidotes against the alumina toxins. The blood changes, anemia and the gastrointestinal tracts are especially affected by the alumina poison. When absorbed by the lungs and intestines, cadmium causes lesions on the pulmonary and digestive epithelium. Fatigue, with lassitude like influenza, dull aching all over. State of indifference, desire to be alone, improved by appearance of a skin eruption. Anemia. Nausea and vomiting. Diarrhea with soft stools and the sensation of a foreign body in the rectum. Sneezing, coughing, muco-purulent sputum. Sneezing with influenza and tickling at the back of the throat. Influenza-type rhino-pharyngitis. MIND - Hypersensitive. Nervous and restlessness. Irritable. Impulsive irritability, on the verge of insanity in its violence, alternating with deep depression. Depressive psychosis with fear of cancer (Care.). Loathing of life. Despair. Hopeless and apathetic, all joy is gone. Averse to people. Averse to certain kinds of music. Averse to noise. Concentration difficult. Mental exertion aggravates. Mistakes, saying and doing the wrong things. Makes simple mistakes. Weak memory. Indifference, does not want to see anyone. Apathy after influenza. Indifference to work.

Head - Extreme, neuralgic headaches with maddening pressing pains throughout the head, extending to eyes and ears. Occipital headaches with vertigo, buzzing in ears, visual and psychosomatic complaints. Headaches, the pains come and go sud- denly. Headaches accompanied by nausea. Headache worse by shaking the head, movement. Headache worse reading, sustained intellectual activity, and in the morning on waking. Headaches, better by cold compresses, holding the head, and eating.

Eyes - Sensitive to light. Eyelids painfully sensitive and burning, worse when reading and in a hot room. Food - Insatiable hunger, with nausea aggravated by jarring. Loss of appetite.

Ears - Buzzing and painfully sensitive. Old ear discharge with pain.

Nose - Sneezing.

Mouth - Teeth yellow. Mouth dry, lips itching.

Throat - Throat dry in the morning, improved by eating. Vertigo - Vertigo while looking at moving pictures. Vertigo with a sensation of something taking the breath away. Objects recede and return. COMMENTS - The first proving was carried out by Burdach in 1827 with a half grain, and later by Petroz. The proving was undertaken again at the instigation of the International League of Homeopathy in 1947 and a report was created by Gutman in 1951. The proving was made on thirty-eight provers, using the 2c, 3c, 6x, 12x and 30c potencies. In another connection, MacFarland made a proving on four female provers using the Skinner potencies, 10m and 50m. Templeton experimented on nine provers with 2c, Pahud on sixteen provers with 2c, 3c, 6x, 12x and 30x. Violent vomiting attack with headache, alternating of heat and coldness. Some pressing pains in the liver and spleen. Vomiting of bile and acid. More frequent urination, discoloring the toilet bowl brownish or a deep lemon color, very difficult to wash from the bowl. Hemorrhage of the bladder and rectum was cured many times by Dr. Grimmer, especially when dark-colored blood with small clots was present. Bright red hemorrhages have also been observed. Grimmer had a case: “Severe neuralgic pains in the face with plugged sinus, followed by facial paralysis, after large doses of quinine and aspirin, cured with one dose of Cadm-met. 10,000c.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Cadm-s. (2) Bry. - Also aggravated by movement, constipated intensely thirsty. (3) Ars. - Agitation with anxiety, burning ameliorated by heat. REFERENCES - Grimmer. Julian. Murphy.

Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia. Indigestion. Odors and other unpleasant stimuli induce nausea, even thinking of them.

Abdomen - Diaphragmatic hernia. Colitis and enterocolitis. Bacillary dysentery. Abdominal distention with pain in the region of the umbilicus and epigastrium, betted by eating, bending double.

Rectum - Constipation with hemorrhoids, aggravated by passing stool. Soft diarrhea with sensation of a foreign body in the rectum. Diarrhea of black, musty stools with intestinal pains. Constipation with clay-colored stools.

Chest - Constrictive pain behind the sternum, especially when coughing. Constitutions - Pre-cancerous. Chronic infection of the reticuloendothelial system. State of psychosomatic, post-influenza exhaustion.

Heart - Intense squeezing pain in the region of the heart, with a sense of weakness.

Back - Backache, pain in the scapula.

Limbs - Numbness of the feet and hands when sitting. Paraesthesia at the limbs. Weakness. Heaviness of the limbs. Trembling of the feet and hands. Feet burning, formication. Lungs - Difficult respiration, especially with the slightest movement. Cough with muco-purulent, sometimes blood-streaked sputum. Acute bronchial and pulmonary diseases.

Sleep - Dreams of sickness, causing worry after waking. Dreams of running without reaching anywhere.

Skin - Sensation of heat or burning in small areas of the skin. Localized itching. Erythema, dry eruption, papules, vesicles. General fatigue, diminishes with the appearance of eruption on the skin. Lupus erythematous. Tuberculosis with papules, nodules, vesicles and purpura. Sclerous lichen (isolated or grouped papules, sclerodermic in appearance). Chronic pustular dermatitis, spreading away from the center.

Modalities - Better from eating. Better pressure. Better bending double. Better cold application, and with the appearance of an eruption. Worse in the morning. Worse from waking. Worse left side. Worse movement. Worse mental effort.

Kidneys - Frequent urination.

Blood - Acquired hemolytic jaundice. Anemia. Anemia and chlorosis in young girls. Infantile hereditary anemia. Breasts - Breasts feel enlarged and sore. Causations - Aluminum or radiation poisoning.

Temperature - Goose bumps. Shivering without fever. Cold even when near a fire. Glandular fever. Mononucleosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cadm-o. is the most active of the cadmiums and has a wide range of action in chronic and intractable conditions of cancer. Useful for degenerative diseases of heart and kidneys and many forms of arthritic and nerve inflammations. Indispensable and unequalled as an antidote to the alumina toxins which stem from the use of aluminum cooking utensils, as well as from the toxins resulting from water softeners in which aluminum chloride is used. Those who use the water treated with aluminum chloride for cooking and drinking purposes are sure to suffer from the ill effects of aluminum poisoning, and when so affected will not respond to curative remedies until this toxin is antidoted and eradicated completely from the system. This poison acts like one of the basic miasms of Hahnemann as the patient will not get well until it is entirely removed. COMMENTS - Grimmer noted a case in which the patient suffered from chronic asthma, despite having excellent homeopathic treatment over a long period of time with only short acting palliation of the asthmatic attacks, which gradually became more intense and wearing. The patient was greatly reduced in weight and strength with an ever-increasing dyspnea, which made him very depressed with despair of recovery. Then it was discovered that he was poisoned with chronic aluminum from using aluminum cooking ware for a long time. A dose of Cadm-o. 30c, and later a 200c, brought quick relief which was superseded by an attack of what appeared to be the symptoms of a viral influenza. In this condition a perfect picture of Hep. was presented. Chill, fever and copious sweat, must be covered in all stages, no relief from sweat. Hep. 30c brought complete relief of the asthma for several weeks without a break andthe patient rapidly regained weight and strength. REFERENCES - Grimmer. Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - The major use of Cadm-s. has been as an antidote to the severe side effects of toxic cancer therapy, especially, chemotherapy and radiation treatments, which can cause weakness, emaciation, nausea, vomiting, liver damage, hair loss, anorexia and which speeds up the time of death. Cadm-s. chief action centers on the stomach and respiration. Important gastric symptoms. Symptoms corresponding to very low forms of disease. Useful for the last stage of diseases which runs death ward. A notable anti-psoric. Side effects of chemotherapy and radiation treatments. Stomach cancer with persistent nausea and vomiting. Cholera andyellow fever, when there is emaciation, vomiting and extreme prostration. Burning and cutting pain in the stomach. Intense nausea, retching, gagging, vomiting, bringing up tough mucus. Extreme exhaustion and prostration with vomiting. Black vomit. Thé least thing touching the lips will excite vomiting. Pitchy taste, food tastes likç salt. Acts well in alcoholics. Facial paralysis from the cold winds. Chilliness and coldness even when near the fire. Patient must keep quiet. Lies with the head low and the hands under it. Restlessness. Skin blue, yellow, scaly, cracking, damp, suppurating herpes, and chilblains. Formication between the skin and deep tissue. Itching of skin, at night in bed, when touched when cold, better scratching, which causes a voluptuous feeling. Cutting pains in the joints. Starting of the limbs. Numbness of parts, nose, head etc. Paralyzed parts painful or crawling in. Weakness remaining after epileptic attacks of one arm and one leg. Weakness of affected parts with goose bumps. MIND - Dullness of mind, unconscious. Horror of solitude and work. Apprehension at the approach of anybody. Excessive irritability. Anxiety, before stool. Effects of anxiety or fits of passion. Restlessness worse sunlight. Fear of others approaching him. Smiling in sleep. Moaning during sleep. Nervousness during headache. Anxiety. Vexation. Fits of passion aggravates symptoms in general. Unconsciousness between attacks of cough.

Head - Inflammation of the brain. Strokes. Heat in head. Lancinations, hammering, digging pains. Drawing pains in head. Tingling in head. Heat in head. Pulsation in the temples. Pain in the vertex. Congestion to head, with pains cutting like knives. Rolling of head, with open eyes, in cholera infantum. Inflammation of brain. Apoplexy. Herpes on temples.

Eyes - Hollow eyes. Opacity of cornea from injuries or inflammation. Blue circle around eyes. Lachrymation, hot ' tears. Blenorrhea. One pupil dilated the other contracted. Swelling of conjunctiva. Scrofulous inflammation of eyes. Idiopathic chronic conjunctivitis. Night blindness. Cannot read small type.

Ears - Pressure behind the ears. Lacerating pain. Lancinating pain in ears. Abnormal hearing, alternating with abnormal vision. Sounds echo in the head. Clucking noises in the ears.

Nose - Tightness at the root of the nose. Obstruction of the nose by swelling. Numbness of the nose. Ozaena. Nosebleed. Polyps, boils. Caries of the nose. Lacerating pain in the nose. Nostrils ulcerated. Decay of nasal bones. Ulcerative, cancerous smell.

Face - Gloomy countenance. Vexed look. Grayish complexion. Drawing pain in face. Facialparalysis, left side, worse cold air, cannot close the eyes, difficult talking and swallowing, distortion of the mouth. Crawling sensation in the face. Trembling of lower jaw. Spasmodic motion of the upper lip. Swelling of the lips. Yellow spots on the cheeks and nose. Food - Thirst, with heat in bed at night. Craves little drinks of cold water that are vomited at once. Nausea and vomiting after eating.

Mouth - Difficult swallowing. Salty, pitchy taste. Salivation. Aphthae on the lips. Stringy and offensive exudation on mucus membrane. Tongue, dirty brown orblack. The symptoms of the mouth are aggravated during deglutition. Salty belching.

Throat - Chilliness and aching. Sore throat, constant tickling, gagging and nausea, worse from deep breathing. Dysphagia. Esophagus is constricted (Bapt.). Vertigo - Faintness on rising. Vertigo, room and bed seem to spin around. COMMENTS - Cadmium sulphuratum is found in nature in intimate association with Zinc, which it resembles in action, but it acts more powerfully. Cadm-s. is a cross between Bry. and Ars. It has the desire to keep quiet of Bry. with the exhaustion and stomach irritability of Ars. A major cancer remedy. Affinity for cancers of the GI tract, cancers of the esophagus, the stomach, the liver, and the colon (Cadm-met. for bone cancers, Cadm-i. for glandular cancers). Nausea and vomiting in cancer cases. For the ill effects of radiation and chemotherapy. Extreme prostration and fatigue after chemotherapy or radiation, emaciation, sunken features, cachexia. Nausea, intensified by motion. Vomiting of acid or yellow substances. Black vomit, occurs in severe zymotic diseases. Vomit like coffee grounds. Vomiting during pregnancy, when other remedies fail. Pernicious forms of vomiting, of black blood from chronic ulcers or cancer of the Cadmium sulphuratum stomach. Nausea and vomiting with cold perspiration bathing the face and cutting pains in the abdomen. Ulceration of the stomach in alcoholics (Ars.). Beer aggravates the gastric complaints. Salivation, with bitter burning in the mouth and throat, fetid breath, ulcers with dryness, and burning constriction of the throat. Characteristic coldness, all complaints are made worse from becoming cold, or from cold changes in the weather. Icy coldness even whennearafire. Goose bumps, with hot hands, or after drinking. Sweat in axilla. Effect of a drought or cold air in checking sweat. Weakness and tiredness, accompanied by a cachectic state that stimulates the cachexia of advanced cancer cases or pernicious anemia. Increased irritability. Horror of solitude and of work. Ozaena and polyps. Cutting, sharp pains, sense of constriction. Opacity of the cornea, loss of vision. Protracted sleeplessness, insomnia. Sleeps with eyes open, stops breathing on going to sleep. Awakens suffocating after sleep. RELATIONS - Followed well by: Care., Bell. - rolling of head with open eyes in cholera infantum, Carb-v., Lob. inf. In cancer - Hydr., Ars. In yellow fever - Nit-ac. In nausea of pregnancy - Alet. Compare: (1) Cadm- ox., Cadm-br. - pain and burning in stomach and vomiting. (2) Cadm-i. - Itching of anus and rectum felt during the day only, constipation, frequent desire, tenesmus, abdomen bloated. (3) Zinc., Ars., Carb-v., Verat. (3) Zinc, but in Zinc, the action is primarily on brain in Cadm. primarily on stomach. (4) in constriction across chest with palpitations, Kali-chl. (5) weakness, nausea, vomit and burning, Ars. (6) black vomit, disorders of alcoholism, Ars., Lach, in nausea and retching. Asar., Bry., Crot-t., Cupr., Nux-v„ Podo., Ant-t. in deathly nausea, Ip., Tab., greenish gelatinous vomit. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.

Stomach - Intense nausea with pain and cold. Burning and cutting pain with retching and gagging. Violent nausea, retching. Black vomit, like coffee grounds. Vomiting of mucus, green slime, blood, with great prostration and tenderness over the stomach. Least thing touching lips will excite nausea and vomiting. Stomach symptoms worse carrying burden, better quiet. Stomach cancer, with persistent vomiting.

Abdomen - Sore, tender, tympanitic. Pain in abdomen with vomiting. Coldness. Stretching in the sides. Compressed feeling, pressure, bruised pain. Pulsation. Lancinations in the left hypochondria. Griping in the lower bowels.

Rectum - Clots of blood from bowels. Bloody, black and offensive stools, gelatinous, yellowish green, semi- fluid with urinary suppression.

Chest - Chest contracted with asthma. Drawing. Feeling of dilatation or contraction. Feeling as if the lungs adhered to the chest. Swelling of the external chest. Weakness of the chest. Rheumatic pain. Painful blows. Tingling in the chest. Beating near the heart. Chest symptoms. worse squatting. Constitutions - Cancer miasm and toxic constitution. Broken down constitution from cancer, chemotherapy or radiation treatments.

Heart - Palpitation with constriction of chest.

Back - Pain in muscles of neck. Back pain as from the efforts to vomit. Breasts - Inflamed nipples. Erysipelas of the breasts. Causations - Chemotherapy, radiation poisoning. Vaccinations. Lead or other toxic poisoning. Grief.

Limbs - Rheumatism. Boring and digging. Suppuration of the axillary glands. Stretching of the arms. Swelling of the arm-bones. Tension in the forearm. Gnawing in the hands. Tearing pain in the metacarpal joints. Jerking of the fingers. Lancinations in the joints and in the toes. Numbness of the thighs. Trembling in the knee. Pressure in the knee. Tearing pain in the legs. Cramp of the calf. Pain, as if sprained. Heaviness of the feet. Chilblains.

Sleep - Sleeps with open eyes. Somnolence with broken dreams. Moaning and smiling during sleep. Nightmares. W'hile asleep, the feet are agitated by shocks. Stops breathing on going to sleep, wakes up suffocating. Fears to go to sleep again. Protracted sleeplessness (Care., Cocc.). Sleepiness in the forenoon. Drowsiness when sitting.

Skin - Blue, yellow, sallow, scaly, cracking. Chloasma, yellowish stains on nose and cheeks, worse exposure to sun and wind. Itching when touched and during cold, ameliorated by scratching, which excites a voluptuous feeling. Chilblains. Goose bumps after drinking, with hot hands, heartburn.

Modalities - Better eating and rest. Worse fromraising up. Worse least motion. Worse carrying burdens. Worse ascending stairs. Worse walking. Worse swallowing. Worse after sleep. Worse in morning. Worse from stimulants. Worse after intoxication. Worse from vexation. Worse in sunshine. Worseopenair. Worsecold,coldair. Worse itching of skin when cold.

Liver - Region of liver sore. Lungs - Suffocation on dropping to sleep. Cough with loss of consciousness. Cough with agitation, red face, pain in the stomach or vomiting of bile. Interrupted breathing during sleep On waking, want of air.

Kidneys - Rawness and soreness in urethra. Urine mixed with pus and blood. Griping in the region of the kidneys.

Temperature - Icy coldness (Camph., Verat., Helo.), Goose bumps after drinking or with hot hands. Coldness, even when near the fire, with heat in the hands. Coldness after sleeping and after walking. Fever, before midnight. Yellow fever (Crot-h., Carb-v.). Sweat in the axilla and the palms.

PHARMACY - caesal. Caesalpinia bonducella. Nata. Fever nut. Bondue nut. N. O. Leguminosae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Hemorrhage. Leprosy. Tuberculosis.

HERBAL - Nata'is a well-known wild shrub of India. It grows near the sea-coast in all hot countries, the extensive distribution being due probably to the transport of the seeds by oceanic currents. It is pregnant with climbing prickly points and the shrub is commonly found all over Bengali, Bombay and practically the whole of southern India. The plant has been known for a long time to the Hindu and Mohammedan physicians to contain excellent medicinal properties. The seeds are considered in India and Persia to be “very hot and dry” and they are found to be very useful in dispersing swellings, arresting hemorrhage and warding off infectious maladies. The seeds, roasted and powdered, are employed for hydrocele internally and externally. They are also used internally in curing leprosy. The powdered seeds mixed with black pepper are found to be febrifuge and anti- periodic and are used in chronic fevers. The fixed oil expressed from the seeds is emollient and is employed as an embrocation for the purpose of removing freckles from the face, also as a cosmetic and used also to arrest discharges from the ear. A decoction of the roasted seeds is employed against consumption and asthma.

HOMEOPATHIC - Extreme weakness is felt after the remission of fever, so much so that the patient is averse even to have any talk. There is no inclination to do any work. Always likes to sleep. Lies quit with closed eyes. No desire to leave bed. After the remission of fever the patient feels extreme weakness, is disinclined to do any work. There is no desire to talk even. The patient likes to lie down quietly in bed with closed eyes. The fever appears between 8 a.m. and 10 a.m. or between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. In the afternoon fever there is no thirst, but in the morning fever there is thirst in hot stage. The above symptoms are generally observed in intermittent fevers, but in remittent fevers of malarial origin it is also used with benefit. MIND - Mental depression. Lack of enthusiasm.

Head - During fever terrible pains are felt over both the temples of head, relieved by wrapping them up or by pressure.

Eyes - Before the appearance of fever and during its invasion terrible pains are felt in the eyes as if they are burnt; they are relieved by the application of cold water; eyes are sunken and bloodless.

Nose - Hot breath; during fever frequent and hurried respiration takes place.

Mouth - During hot stage of the fever thirst is felt; thirst for cold water; face is flushed during fever.

Abdomen - there is gurgling in the lower abdomen, sometimes liquid, slimy stools are passed by the patient.

Stool - Hard, saffron colored stools. Stools are sometimes liquid and yellow coloured.

Back - Drawing pains are felt in the back after cold bath.

Skin - Dry, dirty, blackish coloured. Small eruptions like mosquito bite appear on the skin, which disappear generally.

Fever - It is very irregular in appearance. It may come on any time; fever appears with chilliness and shivering one day and again on another day it appears in the afternoon with slight chilliness. The character of fever is changeable. It's is generally felt with chilliness and shivering. Thirst is generally felt in the stage of heat; the stage of sweat lasts for a short time only, sweat breaks out over face, chest, neck, shoulder, the fever does not last more than 6 hours. Food - Desire to take boiled rice and other hard substance and meat. Aversion to take any liquid food. No desire to take bath.

Tongue - Slight white coating on the tongue appears; bloodless white tongue; tongue is moist, but there is thirst. REFERENCES - Ghose.

Liver - The lower lobe is enlarged; before fever sometimes uneasiness in the hepatic region is felt or sometimes slight pain is felt there.

Spleen - Enlargement and hardness of spleen exist and it is painful to touch.

HOMEOPATHIC - A crystalline alkaloid, it is a direct heart stimulant and diuretic. One of the best stimulants of the vaso-motor centers. Dropsy depending on cardiac insufficiency. Cardiac insufficiency in pneumonia and other infectious diseases. Myocardial degeneration. Caffeine raises the blood pressure, increases pulse rate and stimulates the heart muscle, hence a support in extreme feebleness or threatened failure. Stimulates the respiratory center, nerve centers and increases diuresis. Acute pulmonary edema. Brachialgia and other neuralgias characterized by nightly aggravations. COMMENTS - A proving has been made with this alkaloid, but has brought out no symptoms not included in the pathogenesis of Coff. Marked pulsation of the arteries on the head and temples. Sparks before eyes, roaring in the ears. Vomiting with relief of all symptoms. The Citrate of caffeine, which is used in allopathic practice, has occasioned dangerous poisonous symptoms in a number of cases. The most characteristic include restlessness and dizziness, inability to keep erect. Palpitations. Violent precordial anxiety. Very rapid pulse. Abdominal pulsation. Violenttremblingof all the limbs. Grating of the teeth. Features expressive of great anxiety. Constriction of the neck and throat, recurring periodically every fifteen minutes. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aeon., Cham., Coffea, Nux-v, Cypr. (2) Caffeine and plants containing it, as Cacao, Kola, Thea, etc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cainca is related botani- cally to Chin., Ip., andCoff. Clinically, it is very like Apoc. Marked urinary symptoms. It has been given with success in dropsies, especially when associated with dry skin. General fatigue and weakness. It removes fatigue from riding on horseback too long. Much weakness after dinner, so as to make him lie down. Abdomen sensitive to the touch. Albuminuria with dyspnea on lying down at night. Ascites and anasarca with dry skin. Polyuria while traveling. Slight uneasiness. MIND - Feeling of anxiety with increased warmth of the lower abdomen.

Head - Very violent headache. Severe headache, particularly in the occiput, forbidding reading and every intellectual exertion. Heaviness of the head. Heaviness, pressure and uneasiness of front of head. Piercing pain in right temple. Pressure in the sinciput. Darting pains in right half of sinciput. Feeling of weight and pressure in occiput.

Eyes - Burning in the eyes. Increased sensibility of the eyes. Photophobia. Edema of left upper or right lower eyelid. Pressure in the eyeballs from above downwards and from below upwards. Sensation as if the eyeballs were pressed upwards, with troubled vision for five minutes, returning after half an hour.

Ears - Intolerable hissing in the ears. Roaring and buzzing, as if from a swarm of insects in the air.

Nose - Violent catarrh of thin mucus, excoriating the nose, especially in the daytime.

Face - Heat of the face. Food - Appetite good in the evening. Absence of appetite. Less appetite than usual for dinner. Thirst.

Mouth - Offensive smelling breath. Considerable salivation, or saliva no longer seemed to be secreted. Perverted taste, the whole mouth bitter. Mucous, insipid taste. Drug tasted like apple-wine, first sweetish, then bitter and burning. In the evening, tearing pains in the teeth of the upper jaw.

Throat - Voice hoarse and hollow. Ulcers in the throat to the Eustachian tube. Distressing dryness in throat. Obliged to hawk often from irritation of the throat. Burning and grating pain in throat. Scraping in throat, forcing him to cough. Rawness of throat, with taste like that of pepper. Dry, burning heat in the pharynx, at first with sensation as if from pepper. Feeling of itchiness and scraping. Dysphagia. Cold feeling down the esophagus.

Stomach - Dryness of the throat, trembling of the hands. Belchings, as after small doses of tartar emetic. Much tasteless belching. Nausea and vomiting. Violent vomiting from three spoonfuls. Vomiting and slight shivering, for half an hour. Feeling of cold in the epigastric region.

Abdomen - Stitches in and through the ; spleen. Warmth about the umbilicus. Fullness, inflation and uncomfortable feeling in the abdomen. After eating, perceptible pulsation of abdominal aorta during rest. Gurgling and rumbling in the abdomen and bowels. Slight colic with borboryg- mus. Cutting pains in abdomen before evacuation of the bowels. Pain under the umbilicus with desire to go to stool.

Rectum - Frequent calls to stool with escape of nothing but air. Burning at the anus. Tickling in the anus, obliging him to scratch frequently.

Male - Drawing in of testicles and spermatic cord. Pain worse during passage of pungent-smelling urine. Horridly excited sexual impulses. Fearful, lascivious dreams with erections, restlessness, awakened by an emission.

Chest - Constriction and pressure on chest. Peculiar shooting and beating pain over the trunk. Dartings in the right side of thorax. Piercing pain in the middle part of the right side of the chest. Pricking pain in the lower third of the right side of the chest, with feeling of weight.

Back - Pain in region of kidneys, better lying bent backward.

Limbs - Pricking pain in left hand. Stretching of lower limbs. Heaviness of the lower limbs. Feeling of lassitude in soles of feet. Constant pressure in the lower third of the under part of right foot. Acute pricking under nail of great toe. Lungs - Tickling cough with tough, greenish-gray expectoration, waking him at 3 a.m.

Sleep - Yawning with stretching of limbs. Sleepiness in morning. Desire to sleep. Sleepless during the whole night. Restless sleep, with lascivious dreams. Somnolence.

Modalities - Better in evening. Better rest. Better after diarrhea. Worse frommotion. Worse ascending stairs. Worse from waking. Worse in the morning. Worse siesta. Worse from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.

Tongue - Tongue coated with mucus. Tongue exceedingly dry with a white and very dark coating. Tongue furred white. Vertigo - Symptoms of giddiness and sickness. Giddiness, with vomiting, or on going up stairs. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Colch., Rhus- t. (gastralgia), Verat. Cainca follows well: Ars. Compare: (1) Apocynum, Ars., Bry. (2) Similar to Coffea in relieving effects of fatigue, also Am. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate. Polyuria while traveling. Urine fiery. Burning pain in urethra, especially glandular portion.

Temperature - Heightened temperature of the body. Warmth all over. Moist skin, sweating even when at rest. Perspiring more easily than usual, particularly in the evening.

HERBAL - Cajuput oil distilled in water from the leaves of Melaleuca leucadendron. Cajuput Oil acts like Cloves Oil, it has a reputation as a local application in rheumatism and also in cases of dysmenorrhea. Cajuput has cured obstinate hiccoughs from the slightest provocation, talking, laughing, eating or any motion. Symptoms appear and then disappear suddenly, come at 5 a.m., disappear on eating. Many symptoms are worse at night. Smoking causes desire to vomit.

HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic proving of Caj. showed a characteristic sensation of enlargement. A feeling of being too large all over, as if head as large as half a bushel. Feeling as though could not get himself together (Bapt.), could not get his clothes for a time, though they were quite near. Nervous symptoms, some reflected from the female sexual organs. Persistent choking sensation of hysteria, nervous dyspnea, nervous distention of the bowels. Earache and face ache, the lobe of the ear is red, alae nasal turn red, nose appears swollen. Neuralgic affections, not inflammatory. Flatulence and disorders of the tongue. Gout. Nervous dyspnea. Copious perspiration. A measles-like eruption with intense itching. Sensations as if poisoned. As if the arms were tied to the body, heavy, useless. Numb feeling all over. MIND - Feeling as if he did not want any one to speak. Feel sad and downhearted, as if could cry. Want to walk in a slow and very dignified manner and prefer to walk alone. Can't think of anything, ideas come slow. Can't bear to do any work or study. Feels stupefied and completely intoxicated all the afternoon.

Head - Feels much enlarged. As if he could not get himself together (Bapt.).

Ears - The lobes of the ears are red and the upper portion remains natural.

Nose - Nose is most prominent.

Face - Sensation of burning in the face. Yellow appearance, feels puffy, rough to the touch. Can't hurt the skin of the face by pinching it. Pain through the left malar bone. Stiff, dry feeling in the jaws, with neuralgic pains in the malar bones and severe headache all over the head, on waking at 5 a.m. Prosopalgia with the severe headache. Food - No appetite or thirst. Good appetite, can eat anything, but feels unnatural when eating, the eating seems to be performed mechanically

Mouth - Spasmodic stricture of esophagus. Persistent sensation of choking. Constricted sensation on swallowing solid food. Much water in the mouth, wants to spit a great deal. Profuse flow of saliva. Constant inclination to spit and hawk up large quantities of tough white mucus, can feel drawn through the sinuses. Cool and not unpleasant sensation in the mouth and pharynx. Taste in the mouth of lye. Salty taste after intense thirst. Acrid taste in the pharynx and esophagus for a few minutes. Speech thick and slow.

Throat - Burning in the throat down to the stomach. Burning in the lower part of the pharynx. Burning in the esophagus, as if there was lye in it. Can hardly swallow. Esophagus feels sore. Voice hoarse, as if taken cold.

Stomach - Hiccough, on slightest provocation.

Abdomen - Flatulent colic, tympanites (Tereb.). Nervous distention of the bowels. Griping pain in the bowels on riding. Spasmodic cholera.

Rectum - Diarrhea, watery, yellowish. Diarrhea by day. and worse by night, bowels moved often.

Male - Erections with great desire for an embrace. Erections all night, in the morning, without the least sexual desire. Penis shriveled and shrunk. Loss of sexual Cajuputum oleum desire (Sep.).

Chest - Sharp, steady pain. Soreness. Pain across the chest, in the right lung.

Limbs - Joints feel enlarged with some pain. Sensation in the arms as if they were tied to the body. Arms feel tired and heavy. Weakness and aching pain in both knees. Lungs - Severe coughing and strangulation. Coughing almost makes one vomit.

Sleep - Tired and sleepy. Amorous dreams without emissions. In dreams, felt disposed to swear and act rowdy.

Skin - An eruption as thick as measles, all over the arms and body. Intense itching, aggravated by scratching.

Modalities - Better in open air. Better from pressure. Better lying down. Worse at night. Worse about 5 a.m. Worse from bending forward. Worse riding. Worse itching, and scratching.

Tongue - Tongue moist, looks white and rough, like a calfs tongue, feels as if it were scalded and as if the skin would peel off. Tongue feels swollen, fills whole mouth. COMMENTS - The pro vers of Caj. experienced a “Feeling as if I did not want any one to speak to me” (after twenty-four hours). Did not want to be spoken to, particularly from men. Felt better in the society of ladies, “can laugh and make free with the women (am naturally bashful)," (after two hours). “Feel sad and down-hearted, as if I could cry (after two hours). I do not want any one to speak to me, nevertheless I like to be where I can see persons and hear their talk. Can't bear to look inside the books I usually study, can think of a thousand things in a minute (one hour after first dose, second day). “Want to walk in a slow and very dignified manner and prefer to walk alone (one hour second dose, second day). Can't think of anything, ideas come slow, can't bear to do any work or study (one hour after second dose, second day). Can't think of study (eight day). Felt stupefied and completely intoxicated all the afternoon (after second dose, fifth day).” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bov. - swollen sensations. Plantago - earache toothache. Colch. - gout and rheumatism. (2) Aeon, and Bell. - effects of checked sweat. (3) Bapt.. Nux-m., Asaf., Ign., Eucal.. (4)Eugeniacaryo- phyllacea (cloves), Eugenia jambos and the Brazil-nut tree belong to the same order. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Urine smells badly, like cat's urine. Urine diminished in quantity and has a milky, light-colored appearance.

Temperature - Feels cold, cold sweat all over the body. Profuse and weakening sweat.

HOMEOPATHIC - Like the other Arums, Caladium has an intensely irritating effect on the mucus membranes and skin and produces many burning sensations. Caladium seems to lessen ihecravingfortobacco. Mosquito bites that itch and burn intensely. Marked action on the genital organs and itching of this region. Itching of the vagina. Pruritus vulvae in females, which may sometimes be due to thread worms finding their way into vagina inducing masturbation and sometimes nymphomania. Lascivious thoughts in men, but impotent. Masturbation and its results. Nocturnal emissions occurring either without dreams or with non-sexual dreams. Spermatorrhea. The glans penis is flabby from masturbation. Prepuce, if drawn back, remains so from loss of contractility. Dryness of parts, which are usually moist. Coldness of single parts and inclination to lie down, with aggravation on lying on left side. Great desire to lie down and aversion to motion, but if he makes the effort he is strong enough. Asthma, alternating with itching rash. Asthmatic complaints. Catarrhal asthma, mucus not readily raised, but giving relief when it comes up. Tobacco heart. Fever with drowsiness. Sweet odor of sweat. Attacks like fainting after writing and thinking, when lying down or when rising. Unable to walk with closed eyes. Dreadfrom motion. Slightest noise startles from sleep. MIND - Refuses to take medicine. Very careful about health. Fear of catching disease. Afraid of his own shadow. Forgetfulness. Foolish boldness. Nervous excitation. Restless, cannot control himself after smoking. Nervous and craves tobacco.

Head - Headaches and mental states of smokers. Very forgetful, does not know about the occurrence of things. Confused headache with pain in shoulder, pressure in eyes and forehead, extremely sensitive to noise, throbbing in ear. Numbness in side of head.

Eyes - Eyes are closed, even while walking in open air.

Ears - Sensitive to noise. Slightest noise starts from sleep.

Nose - Discharge of bloody mucus on blowing nose.

Face - Sensation as of a cobweb or crawling.

Mouth - Food eaten seems too dry, must drink to swallow. Milk tastes sour. Red, dry stripe down center of tongue, widening towards tip. Saliva like egg white.

Stomach - Belchings. Stomach feels full °f dry food with asthma. Fluttering sensation. Burning in the stomach, worse deep breathing, taking tea or chocolate. Gnawing in orifice of stomach, which prevents deep breathing and belchings. Acrid vomiting. Thirstless, tolerates only warm drinks.

Abdomen - Sensation as of a long worm writhing in transverse colon. Causations - Gonorrhea. Masturbation. Tobacco habit, poisoning. Constitutions - Suited to persons of lax, phlegmatic temperament.

Male - Erections when half-asleep, cease when fully awake. Impotency, relaxation of penis during excitement. Impotency after gonorrhea, with mental depression. Spermatorrhea. No emission and no orgasm during embrace. Atonic pollution. Prepuce retracted after sex. Pruritus. Organs seem larger, puffed, relaxed, flaccid, sweaty. Genitals cold (Agn.). Thick skin of scrotum. Glans very red, like a rag.

Female - Itching of vulva and vagina (Ambr., Kreos.). Itching from pinworms or with pregnancy. Voluptuousness. Itching leading to masturbation, with burning. Cramp pains in uterus at night. Sexual weakness or neurasthenia. Food - Eats without hunger and drinks without thirst. Thirstless for days. Craving for tobacco.

Heart - Tobacco heart. Heart weakness.

Limbs - Weak, cannot get out of bed. Hands numb. Cannot walk or stand with closed eyes. Lungs - Catarrhal asthma, mucus not readily raised, but better expectoration. Hard cough with asthma. Impeded breathing. Sighing respiration. Larynx seems constricted. Fear of going to sleep. Lung cancer.

Sleep - Groans and moans anxiously, loudly in sleep. Vivid dreams.

Skin - Itching rash alternates with asthma. Burning sensation. Erysipelatous inflammation. Sweet sweat that attracts flies. Insect bites burn and itch intensely. Feels rough and dry. Burning in spots, must touch the part, but cannot scratch them.

Modalities - Better after sweat. Better after sleeping in the daytime, short nap. Better cold air. Worse from sudden noises. Worse sexual excess. Worse tobacco smoking. Worse motion. Worse falling asleep. Worse lying on left side. Worse warmth. Aversion to cold water, but bathing with cold water improves itching.

Kidneys - Urine offensive, scanty.

Temperature - Cold single parts, feet. Sweat of sweetish odor, attracting flies. Low fevers. Falls asleep during fever, wakes up when it stops. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if rocked, worse closing eyes and lying down. COMMENTS - Tobacco heart, tobacco craving, tobacco addiction. Some results for lessening addiction, but often difficult case management. Caladium will lessen the cravings and help with the withdrawal (Lob., Nicot., Fumeris Tabacum). Treatment can cause nausea when smoking, or the patient can develop an allergy to tobacco smoke. Asthma and emphysema from cigarette smoking. Lung cancer with a history of cigarette smoking. Constriction of the peripheral blood vessels causes coldness of the limbs, weakness of the heart, blood pressure problems. Motion sickness. H. N. Martin gave a picture: “Caladium is similar to Lycopodium, the patient wants to lie down always. Better from sweat, opposite of Merc., and better after short sleep, opposite of Lach. Perspiration attracts flies. Genitals relaxed and perspire. Patient afraid to go to sleep and doesn't know why. Itching of vulva with burning.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Caps., Phos., Caust., Sei., Lyc. (2) Ikshugandha - sexual weakness, emissions, prostatic enlargement. Incompatible: Arum triph. Complementary: Nit-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.
