HOMEOPATHIC - Calcarea acética was one the first…
full:
PHARMACY - calc-acet. Calcarea acética. Calcium acetate. Tincture. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anus, itching. Bronchitis. Cancer, pains. Coughs. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Headaches. Migraine. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calcarea acética was one the first of the lime preparations proved by Hahnemann. The symptoms of Calc-acet. are generally identical with those of Calc., both are prepared from oyster shells and are included in the pathogenesis of that medicine. Calc-acet. has had brilliant clinical results in inflammations of mucus membranes characterized by membranous exudation, otherwise its action and application is like the carbonate. Cancer pains. Stupefying, pressive pains in the forehead with compression of the whole head. Dulling of the senses while reading, obliged to stop reading. Ml.ND - Anxieties and worries. Confusion of the mind.

Head - Migraine with great coldness in head and sour taste. Frontal headache, stupefying, pressing pain. Head feels compressed. Lungs - Violent spasmodic cough. Rattling expiration. Loose cough with expectoration of large pieces like casts of bronchial tubes. Difficult breathing, better bending shoulders backward.

Eyes - Senses obscure while reading.

Stomach - Sour, offensive belchings. Vertigo - Vertigo when walking in the open air. COMMENTS - Allen's Handbook mentions that Calc-acet. cured some cases of membranous dysmenorrhea and also cases of violent spasmodic cough ending in the expulsion of casts of bronchial tubes (Calc.). It has been used in the excruciating pains of open cancer (Calc-ox.). Clotar Muller cured many cases of megrim with Calc-acet. The indications he relied on were “Sour taste in mouth, sour belchings, sensation of coldness in the head and of emptiness. Head pain one-sided, affecting the right eye, which was red, causing lachrymation.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc., Brom., Bor. (2) also Calc-oxal. in excruciating pains of open cancer. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Rectum - Severe itching of the anus. Profuse, painless, not exhausting diarrhea.

Female - Membranous dysmenorrhea (Bor.).

Chest - Constrictive, anxious sensation in chest.

full:
PHARMACY - calc-ar. Calcarea arsenicosa. Calcium arsenite. Tricalcic arsenite of lime. Diarsenite. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Anemia. Anger. Ascarides. Asthma. Belching. Cancer. Chilliness. Cholera. Cirrhosis. Colic. Constipation. Delusions. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Embolus. Epilepsy. Gastric, ulcer. Headaches. Heart, disease. Heartbum. Indigestion. Intermittent fever. Kidneys, disorders. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Malaria. Nephritis. Obesity. Palpitations. Pancreas, cancer. Pancreas, disorders. Proteinuria. Spleen, disorders. Stroke. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Typhoid. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calcarea Arsenicosa was prepared and proved by Hering in the 4c dilution in 1848. According to P. C. Majumdar, it is the most efficient remedy in the infantile enlarged liver and spleen of India. In albuminuria cases, there is great sensitiveness of the kidney region. Cholera with impeded respiration from heart embolism. Epilepsy with rush of blood to the head before attack, aura felt in region of heart, flying sensation. Epilepsy with heart disease. Flying sensation or swimming sensation, as if feet did not touch the ground. Affections of spleen and mesenteric glands. Nephritis with great sensitiveness in kidney region. Dyspnea with feeble heart. Hemoglobin and red corpuscles are low. Chronic malaria. Fleshy women at menopause with slightest emotion causing palpitations. Children with enlarged liver and spleen. Complaints of alcoholics after abstaining (Carbn-s.). Chilliness. MIND - Great mental depression. Depression and anger. Anxiety about future. Desire for company. Confusion of mind. Dullness of mind, unable to digest any subject. Unable to attend any business on account of headache. Restlessness after midnight, 3 a.m. Delirium in evening in the dark. Delusions and illusions. Wonderful visions passing before eyes, often an indescribable feeling of health, “as if in heaven.” It seems to be a great many different things but lasts only a second, it passes like lightning, but is infinitely much.

Head - Headache causes feeling of lameness in whole body. Congestion to head before epileptic attack. Dull, stupefying pain. Rush of blood to the head with vertigo. Weekly headaches. Headaches better lying on painful side. Headache, goes to side not lain upon. Headache with palpitations, increase and decrease together. Headache worse after slightest error in diet. Benumbing headache, mostly around ears. Sharp pain in forehead. Burning pain in head, first left then right side. Swelling of temples. Head hot, in albuminuria.

Eyes - Blue rings around eyes. Violent pain in right eye and above it. Letters seem to run together.

Nose - Sneezing with fluent coryza in morning. Running catarrh at 3 a.m. with restlessness, sweat and sleeplessness. Catarrh in head before breakfast with spitting of mucus, which falls down from choanae. No phlegm through nose, only from choanae. Crusts in choanae.

Face - Face swollen, especially about eyes with albuminuria. Paleface and blue rings under eyes with palpitations. Tearing pain in upper and lower jaw. Face hot during palpitations.

Mouth - Copious saliva. Salivation with tasteless belching. Garlicky taste in mouth when swallowing. Flat unpleasant taste, sometimes metallic, sometimes alkaline. Sour taste. Itching on upper lip. Lips dry with albuminuria. Burning on tip of tongue. Tongue dry with albuminuria. Pains in decayed molars, extending to ears, recurring weekly.

Stomach - Anxiety in stomach. Acidity of stomach. Burning heat in stomach. Belching with saliva and beating of heart. Pressing pain as if to belch, ending with a sudden beat of heart. Food seems to lie in stomach without digesting. Sensation as if stomach was expanded, during fever. Digging pain in pit. Nausea when sitting down. Waterbrash with sour taste.

Abdomen - Colic with looseness of bowels. Very painful shooting, cutting pains across abdomen going from right to left. Pancreatic diseases, with albuminuria. Relieves burning pain in cancer. Burning pain in cancer of pancreas. Sensation as if diarrhea would appear, soon after colicky pain around navel with pressure downward. Sensation as if a hernia would be forced out. Swollen inguinal glands with tearing pain in legs.

Rectum - Burning during stool. Urging to stool with palpitations and oppression of chest. Diarrhea after midnight. Diarrhea, worse sweet potatoes or yams. Infantile diarrhea. Loose stools and colic. Loose stools during pregnancy. Stool with ascarides. Stool with itching at anus from evening until midnight. Stool tardy, but not hard. Hard and difficult stool for months.

Male - After drinking wine, pain in groins and in spermatic cords.

Female - Amenorrhea. Scanty menses. Bearing dov/n pain and uterine prolapse. Bearing down pain during pregnancy. Prolapsed vagina during pregnancy. Albuminuria during pregnancy. Offensive, bloody leucorrhea. Cancer of uterus. Burning pain in uterus and vagina. Food - No appetite, can only enjoy soup. Thirst for cold water. Desire for soup. Desirefor wine or other spirituous drinks. Worse after slightest error in diet. Worse eating which often causes eructations and vomiting. Worse after drinking wine. Worse after sweet potatoes.

Chest - Burning heat in chest. Chest feels as if beaten. Sneezing with jerking, shooting pain near left side of sternum, region of 4th and 5th ribs. Dull pressure on chest with roughness of throat. Constitutions - Suited to lymphatic, scrofulous and tuberculosis constitutions. Overweight women, approaching menopause. Obese persons. Complaints of alcoholics after leaving off alcohol.

Heart - Attacks of pains in heart, and fear of suffocating. Constriction of heart like a rush of blood to left chest, with palpitations and urging to stool. Constriction of heart before an epileptic attack. Constriction and pain in region of heart, suffocating feeling. Palpitations and heart pains before epileptic attack. Palpitations with oppression of chest, disturbing sleep. Palpitations, oppression, throbbing and pain in back extending to arms. Pains in region of heart and fearful palpitations. Beat of heart very strong in albuminuria. Pulse intermittent, every fourth beat regularly.

Back - Pain and stiffness near nape of neck. Stiffness of neck with headache, on waking in morning. Violent backache, throbbing, drives out of bed. Violent pain between shoulders and sacrum. Frequent shooting pain in lumbar region. Backache during pregnancy. Backache extends to lower limbs.

Limbs - Edema of lower limbs with albuminuria. Inflammation of veins of lower limbs. Weariness and lameness of lower limbs. Pains in upper limbs before epileptic attack. Pain in left hand and arm before epileptic fit. Cold hands and fainting after pain in spermatic cords. Heat of hands before palpitations. Back of hands edematous with albuminuria. Feet feel as if heavy. Neuralgic pain in left knee. Tearing pain in legs, with swelling in groin.

Sleep - Drowsy and weary, with sensation of fullness under short ribs. Desire to sleep in middle of day, with heavy legs. Very restless sleep at night, disturbed by headache and palpitations. Turns from one side to another. Rolls about all night, sleeps and wakes, with asthma. After 3 a.m., sleepless, restless and perspiring. Dreams of people he had not seen for years.

Modalities - Better rest. Better open air. Better mental exertion but worse after. Worse from slight exertion. Worse errors in diet. Worse cold air. Worse menopause. It is a chilly medicine, the symptoms being worse in cold weather, worse when out of doors.

Liver - Enlarged liver and spleen in chronic malaria in children. Lungs - Dyspnea and feeble heart. Burning heat in lungs. Feeling as if he would suffocate with palpitations. Asthma. Every night an attack of difficult breathing. Shaking cough of whole chest, caused by a tickling in upper part of throat. Copious hawking of tough white phlegm.

Kidneys - Burning pain with scanty urine. Nephritis. Albuminuria and dropsy. Passes urine every hour. Kidney region sensitive to pressure. Soreness in region of kidneys from drinking wine, with scanty, burning, albuminous urine. Urine containing very much protein.

Perspiration - Sweats at night, worse after 3 a.m.

Temperature - Marked malaria. Chilly. Chills crawl over back towards arm and chest. Fever in afternoon, with sensation as if abdomen was puffed up. Fever with much thirst for cold water and loss of appetite in evening. Heat in chest during palpitations. Tliroat - Sore throat with sour taste in mouth. Dryness in pit of throat with roughness of voice. Scratchy sensation in throat. Sensation as if a scab was in upper part of throat. Burning in esophagus as from pepper. Burning in throat after belching, with garlicky taste when swallowing. Pressing pain in throat with sour taste and waterbrash. Loses voice and afterwards consciousness, before an epileptic attack. Drawing as with a thread from larynx backwards. Vertigo - Vertigo before epilepsy. Vertigo when moving head. Violent rush of blood to head with vertigo. Flying sensation or swimming sensation, as if feet didn't touch ground. COMMENTS - Calc-ar. is a synthetic remedy that combines a Calcarea person with Arsenicum mentals and burning pains. Great affinity for the pancreas. Pancreatitis and pancreatic cancer (Hydr., Con., Phos.). Burning in the solar plexus. Liver and spleen somewhat enlarged. Nephritis. Alcoholism. Vertigo when moving the head. Flying or swimming sensation, as if feet did not touch the ground. Sudden, fleeting visions. Rush of blood to head before an epileptic attack. Epilepsy with heart disease. Headaches move from front of head to back, worse mornings, going out of doors. Worse on aspect opposite to the one lain on, whether front or back or either side. Weight on vertex, later on occiput. Well-marked fever symptoms, intermittent, remittent. Hectic fever and masked malaria. Marked chilliness, originates inwardly with a sensation as if skin and adjoining parts were hot. Chilly cramps over back towards arms and chest. Night sweat after 3 a.m. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Carb-v. (palpitations), Glon. (headache), Puls. - headache, tearing pains in the face. Compare: (1) Lith. - mental symptoms, palpitations. (2) Graph. - obesity. (3) Glon., Puls., Sep. (4) Sulph. - headache. (5) Ars. - alcohol drinking., Nux- v. - desire for wine. (6) Kali-i., Phos. - gastric ulcer. (7) Ars., Ip. - asthma. (8) Carb-v., Dig., Glon. and Lith-c. - heart. Compatible: Con., Glon., Op.. Puls. Acts well in: Cases which have been heavily dosed with Quinine. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Calc-br. is for children that are nervous and irritable with gastric and cerebral irritation. Tendency to brain diseases. Insomnia and cerebral congestion. Vomiting and diarrhea. Fretfulness. It removes inflammatory products from uterus. Constitutions - Both Bromine and Calcarea are suited to fair-haired and fat children, the combination appears to intensify the effect. RELATIONS - Compare: (l)Bell., Aeth., Calc., Care., Brom., Kali-br. REFERENCES-Clarke.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from dry climate and weather. Better inspiring fresh air. Better uncovers during fever. Better after breakfast. Better from lying on painful side, on back. Better sneezing, rubbing, scratching. Better wiping or soothing with hands. Worse from bathing. Worse working in water, cooling off. Worse walking in open, cold, raw air. Worse wet weather, change of weather. Worse from exertion, mental or physical. Worse ascending. Worse standing. Worse lifting, or stooping. Worse from pressure of clothes. Worse puberty, menopause. Worse at full moon or new moon. Worse at solstice. Worse after midnight. Worse in early morning, on waking..

Ear, disorders. Epilepsy. Epulis. Eye, disorders. Fever, intermittent. Fistula. Gallstones. Glandular swellings. Gleet. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Gout. Headaches. Hernia. Herpes. Hydrocephalus. Hysteria. Impotence. Insomnia. Joints disorders. Kidney, colic. Leucocythemia. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Malnutrition. Melancholy. Menstrual, disorders. Milk-fever. Miscarriages. Muscles, pain. Neuralgias. Nightmares. Obesity. Osteomyelitis. Osteoporosis. Paralysis. Parotiditis. Peritonitis. Perspiration. Plethora. Polyps. Prosopalgia. Psoriasis. Ranuh. Rheumatism. Rickets. Ringworm. Stones. Teeth, decayed. Toothaches. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Typhoid. Urticaria. Uterus, disorders. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Walking, late. Warts. Whitlow. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calcarea carb, is the chief remedy of Calcium compounds. This constitutional remedy is one of the polycrest remedies and ranks with Sulph. and Lyc. at the head of the anti-psorics. It is essential to a correct appreciation of the Homeopathic Materia Medica that these three medicines should be thoroughly known, as these are. in a sense, the standards around which the rest are grouped. All three have a very wide range and deep action. They have many symptoms in common, but Calc, is somewhat sharply distinguished form Sulphur in that it is a chilly remedy, the patient seeking warmth, while the Sulph. patient is worse by heat and better by cold. Cold, clammy feet, “as if there wet damp stockings on,” (Sulph. has hot, sweaty feet). The “sinking sensation” common to all three is most marked with Sulph. at 11 a.m., with Lyc. at 4 p.m., and with Calc, at any time. Calc, is closely allied to Bell., Nux-v., Puls, and Rhus-t. in its action. Like many of the other carbonates. Calc, corresponds to persons of soft tissue with tendency to be fat. Hydrogenoid and sycotic constitution Sensitive to cold and damp, and early morning aggravation. Warts and polyps. The chief action of Calc, is centered in the vegetative sphere, the keynote being impaired nutrition, the glands, skin and bone, being instrumental in the changes wrought. It alters the blood, causing anemia. The calcium metabolism is active during childhood and becomes defective after middle age. Improper assimilation of calcium gives rise to defective nutrition of glands, bones and skin. Calc, is a definite stimulant to the periosteum. Calc, patients are generally fat, fair, flabby, perspiring, cold, damp and sour. Great sensitiveness to cold weather, patients are susceptible to cold. Cold, moist air chills through and through, takes cold easily es- pecially in chest. Chilliness is aggravated from contact with water. Out of breath easily. Sweating is easy, partial, on head, chest during sleep. Muscles and skin become fat or flabby, patient grows heavier, but not strong. Great weakness on ascending stairs, on walking, from talking (chest feels weak), or excitement. A jaded state, mental or physical, due to overwork. In epilepsy the aura spreads up from solar plexus, or as of a mouse running up the arm or down epigastrium to uterus or limbs. Tendency to strain the muscles and joints easily. Parts lain on become numb. Cramps in muscles which draw limbs. Muscular atrophy. Abscesses in deep muscles. Polyps and exostoses. Polyps, nasal, uterine etc. cysts. Osteomyelitis. Osteoporosis. Malnutrition. Improper nutrition and indigestion. Glandular swelling below the jaw and in the neck. Pituitary and thyroid dysfunction. Discharges are profuse often sour, stools, sweat, odor of the body, saliva etc. Tendency to the formation of gallstones and kidney stones. Early stage of tuberculosis of lungs with tickling cough, fleeting chest pains, nausea, acidity and dislike for fats. Varicóse veins, burning in veins. Raised blood clotting factors (Stront.). Diarrhea, tremors after burns. Generally feels better when constipated. The diarrhea is generally worse in afternoon. Painless hoarseness, worse in morning. Swelling and pain in the breasts before the menstrual flow begins (Con.). Menses are scanty or absent with chilliness and cold, clammy feet. Suppression of menses in women after working in water. Bearingdown pains. Fibroids and cysts. Ovarian or uterine pains, right side, extending down thighs, worse on reading or writing (left side, Lil-t.). Children crave eggs, eat dirt and other indigestible things. Prone to diarrhea. Emaciated children with a big head and belly. Slow in teething, walk late. Complaints of teething children, convulsions, sour diarrhea. Children do not put their feet down on the ground. Dull, lethargic children, do not want to play. Nightmares, dreams of monsters. MIND - Rumination «ad worry. Overworked and exhausted. Sits and thinks about little affairs that amount to nothing. Worries about all their responsibilities and duties. Apprehensive, worse towards evening. Anxiety with palpitations. Desire to weep, to go home. Suspicious. Cautious. Low-spirited. Apathetic. Depressed. Melancholic or doubting moods. Hopeless of ever getting well. Forgetful, confused, misplaces words and expresses himself wrongly. Averse to work or exertion. Inability to apply himself. Leams poorly. Easily frightened or offended. Fears of being observed. Fears of misery, misfor- tune, disaster, contagious disease, insanity. Fear excited by reports of cruelties. Fears loss of reason. Children are self willed, obstinate. Child is afraid of everything it sees. Nightmares and poor sleep. Imagines someone in their room. Fear of monsters. Irritable, cries about trifles, borrows trouble. Visions of fire, murder, rats and mice in delirium. Feels as if she would run up and down, and scream. Sits and breaks sticks etc. all day long.

Head - Head hot with pale face, with mental exertion. Icy coldness in and on the head, especially right side. Cold spots on head. Vertex icy cold. Burning in vertex after grief. Sense of weight on top of head. Headache with cold hands and feet. Headache from over lifting, from mental exertion, with nausea. Chronic hydrocephalus. Big head with large hard abdomen. Open fontanelles, head enlarged. Much perspiration, wets the pillow. Sweat with palpitations. Itching of the scalp. Scratches head on waking. Falling of hair.

Eyes - Lachrymation in open air and early in morning. Lachrymal ducts closed from exposure to cold. Itching of lids, swollen, scurfy. Suppurating fistula. Spots and ulcers on cornea. Cataract. Dilatation of pupils. Sensitive to light. Cannot read in gas light, feels as if she squinted. Dimness of vision, as if looking through a mist, by constant reading, writing etc. Far-sighted. Sees visions on closing eyes, besides field of vision. Easy fatigue of eyes. Ophthalmia in newborn after taking cold.

Ears - Throbbing, cracking in ears, stitches, pulsating pain as if something would press out. Scrofulous inflammation with muco-purulent otorrhea and enlarged glands. Purulent offensive discharge and enlarged glands. Eruption on and behind ear (Graph., Petr.). Polyps which bleed easily. Aching, when blowing the nose and coughing. Perversionsofhearing. Illusory noises, on swallowing, chewing. Cracking noises in ear. Deafness from working in water or quinine. Sensitive to cold about ears and neck.

Nose - Nosebleed, in children inclined to be fat. Nostrils, dry, sore, ulcerated. Polyps with loss of smell. Swelling at root of nose. Offensive odor in nose, offensive yellow discharge. Coryza with polyuria. Sneezes, frequently without a cold. Takes cold at every change of weather. Catarrhal symptoms with hunger, coryza alternates with colic. Senile catarrh. Swelling of the nose and upper lip in children.

Face - Pale, puffy, pasty, with deep-seated eyes, surrounded by dark rings. Old, wrinkled. Swelling of upper lip in the morning with cracks and bleeding. Submaxillary glands swollen. Crusta lactea, itching, burning after washing. Goiter. Itching eruptions on chin. Itching of pimples in whiskers. Pain from right mental foramen along lower jaw to ear. Chewing and swallowing in sleep in children.

Mouth - Bleeding of gums. Persistent sour taste. Mouth fills with sour water. Offensive smell. Ranula under the tongue. Epulis, soft, painless. Tongue dry at night, does not like to talk. Burning pain at tip of tongue, worse anything warm taken into stomach.

Throat - Swelling of the tonsils and submaxillary glands, with stitches on swallowing. Difficult swallowing. Hawks salty mucous. Small ulcers spreading up to palate. Uvula, swollen, edematous. Goiter. Parotid fistula. Vertigo - Vertigo on ascending (especially running) and when turning head, worse looking upward. Vertigo with many conditions, worse scratching head, after epilepsy. Tendency to fall to left, to either side, backward. COMMENTS - Calcium carbonate is the foundation of the structure of our body. One of the dominant constitutions today, it has a profound influence, particularly on growing children. There's a strong complementary relationship between Calc, and Bell. Calc, has a tendency to go toward Bell, acutes, especially tonsillitis and fevers. It's also closely related to Puls. Calc acutes can become Puls, cases, particularly in children. Adults have a tendency to become Rhus-t., especially the elderly. Calc, can deal with residue from many of these complaints. Helpful for teething problems, bone problems, spinal problems, and flabby muscles. Children with slow development, a tendency to be sluggish. Tendency to sore throats, swollen glands, and earaches. Colic. Constipation in babies (Alum.). When constipated, the child cries, moans, does a lot of body movements, and then they pass a large stool. Babies sweat on the back of their head, and they smell sour. Their stool and sweat smell sour, their pillow smells sour. Insomnia in babies. Nightmares, especially about monsters. Fears, particularly vulnerable and susceptible to watching frightening movies or news (Phos.). Apprehensive state of mind. Fear of losing reason, that people will notice her mental confusion. Fears she has some fatal disease, especially heart disease. Great desire for order and structure, fear of losing control. Great sense of responsibility, happy when working. Shuddering and dread as evening draws near. Sees visions on closing eyes (useful in delirium tremens). Cries out, twitches, grasps at flocks, restless and anxious though unconscious (nervous and typhoid fever), beside herself with anguish, on the borders of acute mania. Evil foreboding, talks of mice, rats, murders. Forgetful. Abnormally sleepy or sleepless. Wakes at 3 a.m. and cannot get to sleep again, tosses about. Horrible phantasms. The child wakes in the night screaming and cannot be pacified, in the morning remembers nothing of it. Chews and swallows in sleep. Frightful dreams of sickness, death and smell of corpses. Insomnia, especially in the elderly. Aversion to darkness. Slow in movements (Sulph., quick and active). Exhaustion on exertion or excitement, though he may feel well before. Exhaustion in the morning. Cramp in legs at 3 a.m. Tendency toward arthritis. Disposition to strain a part by lifting heavy things. Scrofulous diseases of bones, spinal curvature, rickets. Swellings. Sciatica, after working in water. Rheumatic and gouty conditions from wetting. Joints crack and crepitate as if dry. Inclination to stretch and put the shoulders back, but straightening aggravates the rheumatism. Neuralgias and paralyzes. Twitching. Internal trembling sensation on awaking. Fainting, coming on in the street with sensation of something rising from stomach to head. Talking causes a feeling of weakness that compels him to desist. Epilepsy has an aura spreading up from the solar plexus in which case the convulsion comes on immediately. It may be like a mouse running on the arm, or it may run down from epigastrium into uterus or limbs. Epilepsy from fright, suppressed eruptions and discharges, sexual excesses. Characteristic rush of blood to head, a sensation of something rising up from epigastrium to head. Sensations of heat and burning. Heat in and on the vertex. Head sweats profusely, wetting the pillow. Sweat chiefly on occiput and forehead (Sil. sweats all over). Better uncovered during the heats (Lyc., opp. of Sil.). Hot breath with heat in mouth. Sweats relieve. Bloody sweats. Sweats may be sour or odorless. Sour body smell. Burning in soles of feet at night, burning in back of hands. Sour or odorless foot sweat. Soft, cold and moist hands, a boneless hand, inclined to chap. All the symptoms are made worse by taking cold. Great sensitiveness to cold, damp air. Dread of open air. Cannot bear sun. The slightest change of weather aggravates. Dread of bathing and water. When a cold wind strikes the body it immediately runs to the teeth, causing them to ache. Rough, scaly skin, inclined to chap. Cracks. Chilblains from wetting. Eruptions, behind right ear. Pricking corns, polyps, cysts, in the leuco-phlegmatic constitutions. Scrofulous glands. Enlarged and hard lymphatic glands. Swelling of cervical and bronchial glands. Hypothyroidism (Sep.). Related to the pre-tubercular stage of tuberculosis, especially suited to disorders of the right apex. Stitching in chest and sides of chest when moving and when lying on affected side. Cough when going into a cold room, from chilliness. Tickling cough, sensation of feather in throat. Rattling in the chest, miller's and stone-cutter's tuberculosis, old suppurating cavities. Sinking sensation. Icy coldness in abdomen. Malnutrition. Ravenous hunger and feeling of emptiness immediately after a meal and in the early morning. Headache from hunger. Nausea after drinking water, even ever so little, but not if iced. Nausea when fasting. Craving for eggs, starchy grains, sweets. Craving for indigestible things like chalk, coal, etc. Children with pica. Milk disagrees, sour vomiting of large curds. Inability to swallow solids. Chronic disease of left tonsil, feeling of lump in left side of throat, pain from left tonsil to ear. Semi-lateral swelling of tongue. Ranula. Sourbelchings. Sour diarrhea. Crawling in rectum as from worms. Burning in rectum. Weight in lower rectum. Ardor urine, offensive urine. Stools hard and pasty, like chalk or clay, offensive, undigested. Flatulence or gurgling in right hypochondrium. Impotence, penis cold and relaxed. Good for weight gain after pregnancy and menopause. Milk leg, better by elevating the limb, worse hanging it down. Sensation as if in a dream. Sensation of levitation. Vertigo, especially in the elderly. Dr. Van den Neucker cured a baker of paralysis of both arms with Calc, and also a case of paralysis with many symptoms of locomotor ataxia in a lymphatic blonde girl of nineteen. Cooper cured psoriasis of the palms with it. Guernsey said “this remedy is particularly adapted to the real leuco-phlegmatic constitution. Where we find a large head, large features, pale skin with a chalky look and (in infants) open fontanelles, we may think strongly of Calc.” According to Guernsey, Calc, is in general a right-side remedy, particularly the right external head, right eye, right face, right abdominal ring, sexual organs on the right side, right back, right upper limbs. Left side neck and nape of neck, left chest, left lower limbs. Alexander Villers cured with Calc. 200c a case combining many of the features of the remedy. The patient, a woman, age 20, was very despondent through long-continued depressing circumstances, became very nervous. She was companion to an exceedingly deaf lady, whose voice was high-pitched. This, with the strain on her voice to make herself heard, caused headache throughher temples, better from rapid motion of head. Outdoor exercise was accompanied by hard pressure on chest, which only belchings seemed to relieve. Constipated bowels. Menses every fortnight with backache and great prostration. Under the remedy, repeated at rare intervals, the menses came on monthly, headache and pressure on the chest disappeared. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Ip., Nit-ac., Nit-s-d., Nux-v., Sulph. Antidote to: Bism., Chin., Chin-s., Dig., Mez. (headache), Nit-ac., Phos. Compare: ( 1 ) Calc-o-t., Calc-ar., Calc-p., and other Calcareas., Lye., Sulph. - differs in being worse by heat, hot feet. (2) Sil., Calc-f., Calc-p., Calc-br. (3) Lime-water and Calc- caust.(4)Calc-calcin.-calcinatedoyster- shell a remedy for warts. (5) Calcarea ovorum - Toasted egg-shells., Calc, lactic. (6) Calc, lacto-phosph. (7) Calc-mur. (8) Arn. (strains, etc.), Ars. (swollen mesenteric glands). (9) In ardor, urine Sep., burning and cutting, Canth., cutting. (10) loss of fluids Chin., Sulph. (11) Leucorrhea, acrid or bland - Graph., Sulph. (12) Acid stomach - Chin., Lyc., Sulph., Puls., Rob. (13) Waking at 3 a.m. - Bellis, Nux-v., Kali-c., Ars., Sep. (14) swelling and painfulness of breasts before menses- Kali-c., Lac-c., Con. (15) Dread of losing senses - Lyc., Med., Nux-v., Sulph. (16) Ravenous hunger - Ars., Calc., Ciña., lod., Sil., Staph. (17) Rhus-t. is a very close analogue of Calc., Bell.. Dulc., Nux-v., Puls., and Rhus may be regarded as the acute satellites of Calc. Complementary: Bell., Rhus-t., Lyc., Sil. Calc, is useful after Sulph. where the pupils remain dilated. When Puls, failed in school girls. Incompatible: Bry. Follows well: Cham., Chin., Con., Cupr., Nit-ac., Nux-v., Puls., Sulph. (especially if the pupils dilate). Followed well by: Lyc., Nux-v., Phos., Plat., Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Heartburn and loud belching. Frequent sour belchings, sour vomiting of curdled milk. Cramps in stomach, worse pressure, cold water. Swelling over pit of stomach like a saucer turned bottom up. Pain in epigastric region to touch. Hyper- chlorhydria (Phos.). Aggravation while eating. Drinking water, if ever so little, causes nausea, but not if iced. Sensation as if rising something to head. Stools - Chalky, gray or green, watery stools. Stools at first hard, then pasty, then liquid. Stools, worse eating and drinking. Undigested stools.

Abdomen - Increase of fat in abdomen. Large and hard abdomen. Sensitive to slightest pressure, cannot bear tight clothing around the waist. Distention with hardness, better slightest pressure. Cutting pain in swollen abdomen. Colic with coldness of thighs after stopped coryza or with cold feeling in abdomen. Incarcerated flatulence. Peritonitis when pain better by cold application. Twisting or cramps about umbilical region. Umbilical hernia. The navel is sore, excrescences like proud flesh in infants. Inguinal and mesenteric glands swollen and painful.

Rectum - Feels best when constipated. Stool large and hard, whitish, watery, sour. Diarrhea of fetid, undigested food with ravenous appetite, particularly in children. Diarrhea, chronic after burns. Persistent tenesmus after dysentery. Prolapse of anus and burning, stinging hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids, painful when walking better sitting. Crawling and constriction in rectum. Worms, tapeworms, pinworms, roundworms. Sensations - Pain as if the parts would burst, were pressed or pushed asunder. As if cold, damp stockings were on the feet. Creeping on the limbs like a mouse. Pain as if sprained in outer parts. Sensation of dust in inner parts as the eye, bronchial tubes. Pricking, darting, jerking, trembling, itching better by scratching.

Male - Increased sexual desire with retarded erections. Frequent emissions. Burning with seminal emission. Seminal discharge premature. Sex followed by profound weakness, vertigo, irritability, lameness of back and knees, headache and sweat. Itching and burning in genitals. Impotence from sexual abuse or from overindulgence. Hydrocele of children.

Female - Before menses, headache, colic, chilliness and leucorrhea. Cutting pains in uterus during menstruation. Menses too early, too profuse, too long, with vertigo toothache and cold, damp feet. Menses late in fat, flabby girls with palpitation, dyspnea and headache. Absence of menses in plethoric women from fright. Infertility with copious menses. Mental excitement brings on dysmenorrhea or causes menses to rectum. Burning and itching before and after menstruation. Thick, milky, gushing or yellow leucorrhea, worse during urination with itching and burning. Uterine polyps. Uterus easily displaced. Sex followed by sweat and prostration. Itching and burning in genitals. Much sweat about genitals. Increased sexual desire, easy conception. Clumsy, awkward and tired during pregnancy. Cramps in toes or soles during pregnancy. Food - Poor diet and nutrition. Loss of appetite, but when he begins to eat, he relishes it. Loss of appetite when overworked. Repugnance to hot food. Raven- oushunger. Cravings for eggs, ice-creams, salt and sweets. Craving for indigestible things, dirt, chalk, coal, pencils. Aversion to meat, milk, boiled things, fat. Worse after eating, smoked meats, milk, orwhen fasting. Thirst for cold drinks.

Chest - Sharp pains in chest, going backwards. Chest very sensitive to touch, percussion or pressure. Weak feeling in chest, cannot even speak. Constitutions - Anti-psoric constitutional remedy. Persons of scrofulous type, who take cold easily, with increased mucus secretions, children who grow fat, are large-bellied with large head, pale skin, chalky look. Fat, flabby children rather bloated than solid, pale but flushing easily. Leuco-phlegmatic temperament, disor- ders caused by working in water.

Heart - Weakness. Palpitation at night, after eating. Palpitations with a feeling of coldness, with restless oppression of chest, after suppressed eruption.

Back - Pain as if sprained, can scarcely rise, from over lifting. Cannot sit upright in the chair from weakness of back. Neck pains, worse lifting. Neck stiff and rigid. Pain between shoulder blades, impeding breathing. Rheumatism in lumbar region, weakness in small of back. Vertebrae, feel loose, painful on pressure. Curvature of dorsal vertebrae. Breasts - Breast tender and swollen, before menses. Hot, swelling breasts. Severe stitches in breasts, when nursing. Milk too abundant, disagreeable to child. Deficient breast-feeding with distended breasts in lymphatic women. Nipples, cracked, ulcerated, very tender. Bones - Faulty development of bones. Open fontanelles. Curvatures, bone growths, rickets. Osteoporosis. Growing pains (Calc-p.). Causations - Ill effects of overwork, worry, fright. Poor nutrition, alcohol. Aging. Loss of vital fluids. Suppressed sweat, eruptions, or menses. Strains, over lifting. Affections of stonecutters.

Limbs - Trembling, weakness. Creeping on the limbs like a mouse. Tearing in muscles. Clumsy, awkward, easily falls. Joints as if sprained. Old sprains. Tired from short walk. Rheumatoid pains, as after exposure to wet. Arthritic deformans, nodosities. Arms, weak, lame. Hands numb, when grasping. Want of mobility of fingers. Sweat of hands. Chapped hands. Cold, clammy hands, knees. Swelling of joints, especially knee. Cramps in calves when stretching out leg at night. Feet turn inward, while walking. Soles of feet raw, burning. Cold, damp feet, feel as if damp stockings were worn. Sour foot-sweat. Feet feel cold and dead at night. Weakness of ankles in children. Children are late in learning to walk.

Sleep - Drowsy in early part of evening. Frequent waking at night. Insomnia due to worry. Same disagreeable ideas arouses from light sleep. Night terrors (Kali-p.). Starts at every noise, fears that she will go crazy. Nightmares in children, scream after midnight and cannot be pacified. Dreams of the dead, of monsters.

Skin - Cold, like a snake, flaccid, unhealthy. Visible quivering ofskht from head to foot, followed by giddiness. Psoriasis. Glands swollen. Unhealthy, ulcerating, flaccid. Small wounds do not heal readily. Nettle rash, better in cold air. Warts on face and hands. Milk white spots. Petechial eruptions. Recurring blood boils. Boils. Chilblains.

Modalities - Better from dry climate and weather. Better inspiring fresh air. Better uncovers during fever. Better after breakfast. Better from lying on painful side, on back. Better sneezing, rubbing, scratching. Better wiping or soothing with hands. Worse from bathing. Worse working in water, cooling off. Worse walking in open, cold, raw air. Worse wet weather, change of weather. Worse from exertion, mental or physical. Worse ascending. Worse standing. Worse lifting, or stooping. Worse from pressure of clothes. Worse letting limbs hang down. Worse eyestrain. Worse light. Worse looking fixedly at any object. Worse looking upward. Worse turning the head. Worse from dentition. Worse milk. Worse worry. Worse puberty, menopause. Worse at full moon or new moon. Worse at solstice. Worse after midnight. Worse in early morning, on waking.

Teeth - Difficult and delayed dentition. Toothache, worse cold air or hot things.

Liver - Liver region painful when stooping. Gallstone colic. Lungs - Painless hoarseness, worse in the morning. Short of breath. Emphysema. Habitual cough. Tickling cough as from dust or feather in throat. Cough, worse inspiration, playing on piano, eating. Suffocating spells, tightness, burning and soreness in chest, worse climbing upstairs or slightest ascent, must sit down. Ulcers or abscesses in the lungs. Expectoration only during the day, thick, yellow, sour mucus. Purulent, loose, sweet, expectoration. Bloody expectoration with sour sensation in chest. Scanty, salty expectoration. Longing for fresh air (Puls.).

Kidneys - Kidney colic. Irritable bladder. Bedwetting, incontinence when walking. Urine, dark, brown, bloody, sour, foul or of strong odor. White urinary sediment with milky urine. Polyps.

Temperature - Chill with thirst. Chill at 2 p.m., begins internally in stomach region. Coldness, icy in different parts of the body, of affected part. Internal heat with external coldness and sweat. Fever with sweat. Hectic fever. Sweat cold, partial. Night sweats, especially on head, neck and chest. Heat, at night during menses. Sweat over head in children, so that pillow becomes wet. Pulse full and frequent.

full:
PHARMACY - calc-caust. Calcarea caustica. Lime-water. Aquacalcis. Quicklime is slaked in distilled water. Afterwards alcohol is added and the clear liquid decanted. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Back, pains. Coccyx, pain. Corns. Heel, pain. Hoarseness. Jaw, disorders. Malar bones, pain. Neuralgia. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Spleen, disorders. Stiff-neck. Tapeworm. Toothaches.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lime-water has an ancient repute in allaying inflammation of many kinds. Extensively proved, it rapidly dispelled all inflammatory action in cases of appendicitis and removed all suffering in an aggravated case of hemorrhoids. Marked difficult thinking. Confusion in the head. Vertigo, as if room turning in a circle. Sticking, tearing, throbbing pains in various parts. Pain in right eye as if a foreign body were in it. Burning and tearing in eyes. Tearing in right cheekbone and in right articulation of jaw. Mucus in throat, burning, sensation as if a bone were sticking in it. Burning in stomach. Tapeworm passes. Hoarseness with pain in throat, rawness in trachea and cough. Stitches in chest. Stiffness and tearing in all regions of back and in coccyx. Tearing in either shoulder down arms. Tearing in left Achilles tendon, left heel. Sticking in corns. Worse from working in water, “pains in hands and feet after a foot-bath.” Worse from hanging down limb. Toothache every night, 2 a.m. Fuzzy sensation in the teeth and other parts. MIND - Very difficult thought. Weary and peevish on waking, as if he had been intoxicated.

Head - Confusion of the head, especially left side. Throbbing in frontal sinus, better by contracting skin of forehead.

Eyes - Burning in eyes, in evening by candlelight. Pain in right eye as if foreign body under upper lid in eye, on rising in morning.

Face - Tearing in right cheekbone. Violent pain, swelling, stiffness of right joint of jaw. Lips unusually red.

Mouth - Mouth offensive, palate feels as if mucus was upon it, but none is expectorated.

Throat - Stitches in larynx, left half. Hoarseness with pain in throat. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if room turning in a circle, thinks she will fall from chair. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Besides the Calcareas, Rhus-t. - pain in joint of jaw. (2) Mez. and Mag-c. - pain in malar bones. (3) Valer. - pain in heel. (4) Pic-ac. and Sep., (loins). (5) Hep. and Nit-ac. - bone sensation in throat. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Abdomen - Sticking in both hypochondria, especially severe in left. Pain in left side of region of spleen, as if a ball were turning on its axis. Constrictive pain in abdomen, griping, stitches. Violent stitches in small intestines when bending forward.

Rectum - Three thin stools before breakfast and one immediately after. Thin, pasty stool with much mucus. Painful stool, as if a nail were scratching in anus. Passed many pieces of tapeworm. Hemorrhoids. Sticking, tearing motions in rectum ex- Calcarea caustica tending towards anus. Crawling in rectum and anus.

Female - Menses eight days too early.

Chest - Sternum feels oppressed, pressive sticking under, stitches across. Stitches in left chest.

Back - Violent pains in scapulae, extending into small of back when sitting, worse on inspiration. Tearing between the shoulders. Tearing in both scapulae, between shoulders, then through neck and occiput as far as forehead. Sensation in both shoulder blades as if they were fuzzy and had gone to sleep (8 p.m.). Pain in small of back, on waking better by moving about. Pressive, drawing pains, sticking, tearing in small of back. Tearing in coccyx.

Neck - Tearing in nape. Stiffness of neck of back of neck of all neck muscles.

Limbs - Trembling in limbs, could not continue work, better by eating a piece of bread. Rheumatic pain alternating in all the joints. Wandering pains. Tearing in shoulders, arms and axilla. Paralyzed condition of right hand. Stitches and tearing in left wrist. Severe tension in lower limbs. Stitches in hip joints. Tearing in knees in right side of right tibia down to toes in left Achilles tendon in left heel. Sticking in a corn. Pains in hands and feet after a foot bath. Lungs - Feeling of rawness in trachea, cough. Cough with stitches in chest, expectoration of mucus and blood.

Sleep - Restless, many dreams, nightmare. Stomach - Severe hunger three hours after eating. Nausea followed by vomiting of some fluid.

Skin - Rash-like eruption on forehead. Biting, itching vesicles, on neck and back extending later to occiput and behind ears.

Teeth - Severe toothache every night, 2 a.m., as if tooth was fuzzy and too large with tensive pain in left ear as if something was sticking in it. Teeth feel too large, fuzzy.

Temperature - A violent chill with chattering teeth 7 to 7. 30 p.m.

PHARMACY - calc-f. Calcarea fluorata. Calcium fluoride. Calcareafluorica. Fluorspar. Flourideof Lime.Trituration.Histórica/dizve: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Adenoids. Aneurysm. Blood, tumors. Bone, disorders. Bone, deformities. Bone, spurs. Breast, indurations. Bums. Cancer. Cataract. Catarrh. Childbirth. Cold, sores. Comeal, opacities. Cough. Croup. Dental, problems. Exostosis. Flatulence. Glands, enlarged. Goiter. Hemoptysis. Herpes. Hodgkin's, disease. Hydrocele. Induration. Joints, cracking. Keratitis. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Nodes. Ozaena. Periosteitis. Post-nasal, catarrh. Rickets. Sarcoma. Scoliosis. Spavin (horses). Strains. Syphilis. Teeth, deformed. Toothache. Tumors. Ulcers. Varicose, veins.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calc-f. is Schiissler's “bone salt. ” It is found in the surface of bones, the enamel of teeth, in elastic tissues, and in the cells of the epidermis. A powerful tissue remedy for hard, stony glands, varicose veins and malnutrition of bones. Calc-f. has cured lumbago after the failure of Rhus-t. Lumbago from strains, worse after rest, better after moving a little and from warmth. Tendon and joint disorders, especially weakness after injury (Ruta.). Joints give way easily. Tendons have nodules and growths after injury or overuse. Disperses bony growths. Bone spurs and tumors. Ulcerations of the bone, fistula. Periosteitis of lower jaw, ribs etc. Deficient enamel of teeth (Sil.). Nails hypertrophied. General stiffness. Weakness in the morning. Feeling of fatigue all day. Numbness in different parts. Tendency to adhesions after operations (Calen.). Indurations of stony hardness, tonsils, tumors, neck after injury, margins of ulcers. Hard knots in breast. Induration threatening suppuration. Grass green discharges. Stinking pus. Arteriosclerosis, threatened stroke. Veins dilate and become varicose, inflamed. Tuberculosis. Glands enlarge and become stony hard. Goiter. X-ray, radiation bums. Cataract. Congenital hereditary syphilis manifesting itself in ulceration of mouth and throat, decay and necrosis with boring pains and heat in parts. MIND - Depression, anxiety, indecision. Groundless fear of financial loss, fear of poverty.

Head - Cracking noise in head, disturbing sleep. Cephalhematoma of newborn infants (Sil.). Blood tumors of newborn infants. Hard excrescences on the scalp. Ulcers on the scalp with callous, hard edges.

Eyes - Cataract. Cornea opaque in spots. Keratitis. Flickering and sparks before the eyes, conjunctivitis. Subcutaneous palpebral cysts. Aching in eyes, better closing and pressure.

Ears - Chronic suppuration of middle ear. Chronic otorrhea (Sil.). Calcareous deposits on eardmm, sclerosis of temporal bone with deafness, ringing and roaring.

Nose - Cold in the head, stuffy cold, dry coryza. Copious, offensive, thick, greenish, lumpy, yellow nasal catarrh. Ozaena. Atrophic rhinitis, especially if crusts are prominent.

Face - Hard swelling on jawbone. Hard swelling on the cheek with pain or toothache. Small, hard, cold sores on lips.

Mouth - Periosteitis of lower jaw.

Throat - Tonsils rough and irritated, forming plugs of mucus. Hypertrophy of Luschka's tonsil. Follicular sore throat. Pain and burning in throat, better by warm drinks, worse cold drinks. Relaxed uvula, tickling referred to larynx.

Stomach - Weakness and daintiness of appetite. Acute indigestion from fatigue and brain-fag. Flatulence. Hiccoughs (Caj., Sul-ac.), when one hawks of mucus. Nausea and distress after eating in young children who are overtaxed by studies. Vomiting of infants of undigested food.

Abdomen - Flatulence, during pregnancy. Sharp pain in hepatic region. Dull weight and discomfort in right hypochondrium.

Rectum - Itching of anus, as from pinworms. Fissure of the anus and intensely sore crack near the lower end of the bowel. Fistula. Bleeding hemorrhoids with pain in sacrum. Internal or blind hemorrhoids frequently with pain in back, generally far down on the sacrum and constipation. Much wind in lower bowels, worse with pregnancy. Diarrhea in gouty subjects. Stools, gushing, watery of fetid odor.

Male - Induration of testes. Hydrocele. Syphilis, chancre.

Female - Excessive menses. Prolapsed uterus. Bearing-down, dragging pains in uterus and thighs. Flatulence in pregnant women. After-pains from feeble contractions.

Heart - Arteriosclerosis. Aneurysm. Valvular disease. Fibroid deposits about the endocardium. When the tuberculosis toxins attack the heart and blood vessels.

Back - Scoliosis. Chronic lumbago from strain, better motion and warmth. Lumbago, worse on beginning to move and ameliorated on continued motion. Tired aching, as from a long ride, with restlessness. Pain in lower part of back with burning. Bone tumors. Exostoses.

Neck - Goiter. Indurated cervical glands of stony hardness.

Limbs - Cracking in the joints. Easy joint dislocations. Exostoses. Bone spurs. Synovial sv/Mings. Swellings and indurated enlargements, having their seat in the tissue and ligaments, tendons of joints. Bursitis. Chronic synovitis of knee joint. Recurrent fibroids in the hollow of the knee. Hip joint disease. Cold wrists and ankles. Ganglia or encysted tumors at the back of the wrist. Gouty enlargements of the joints of the fingers. Enlargement of femur in infants. Rickets. Lungs - Difficulty in breathing, as if epiglottis is nearly closed. Hoarseness after laughing or reading aloud. Croup. Spasmodic cough. Cough with expectoration of tiny lumps of yellow mucus with tickling sensation and irritation on lying down.

Sleep - Vivid dreams with sense of impending danger and weeping. Jumps out of bed in a dream. Unrefreshing sleep.

Skin - Cracked, dry, hard, alabaster white. Scar tissue, adhesions after operations. Indurations are stony hard. Suppurations with callous, hard edges. Indolent, fistulous ulcers, secreting thick, yellow pus. Hard, elevated edges of ulcer, surrounding skin is purple and swollen. Fissures or cracks in the palms of the hands or hard skin. Whitlow. Warty growths. Birthmarks.

Modalities - Better by rubbing. Better continued motion. Better warm applications. Better heat, and warm drinks. Worse from beginning of motion. Worse during rest. Worse sprains. Worse cold, wet. Worse changes of weather. Worse from damp weather, but better from fomentations.

Teeth - Deficient enamel of teeth (Sil.). Gum-boils with hard swelling on the jaw. Looseness of the teeth in their sockets, with or without pain. Toothache with pain if any food touches the tooth.

Tongue - Cracked appearance of the tongue, with or without pain. Induration of the tongue, hardening after inflammation. COMMENTS - Bone deformities and bone tumors, bony growths, bone spurs. Tendency for the vertebrae to slip, curvatures of the spine. Bone cancer, cysts, spinal weakness, joint weaknesses. Bone and ligament disturbances. Tendency toward weak ligaments. Diseases where the ligaments are very weak, where the hands, anns, or feet don't function. Marfan's disease. Calcium deposits in tissues. Tendonitis with calcification, calcified pituitary glands, calcifications in eardrums. Deposits in arthritic joints, fingers deformed with calcium deposits. Dental and enamel problems. Senile cataract. Spots on cornea. Glandular problems, indurated tonsils and adenoids. Cephalhematoma (Sil.). Ozaena. Herpes, hard and small on lips. Prickly, burning, suffocating sensation in throat. Hemoptysis, causing contraction of the blood vessels. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Local pains and symptoms can be ameliorated with heat and warm application, but hot weather aggravates. Generally warm-blooded. Worse change of weather with arthritis, stiffness that's better motion (Rhus-t.). Vivid dreams of death. Fear of poverty, indecisiveness. A giant-celled sarcoma of upper maxilla causing the deformity known as “frog-face” was very greatly relieved by Calc-f. in a short space of time after Silica failed to make much impression. Dr. Seine had several cases where the child’s teeth were turning yellow and the enamel was falling off. Using the Calc-f. cell salt, he had the child's parents rub it into the teeth, and the enamel grew back. One prover. Dr. Sarah N. Smith, had among other symptoms a peculiar and constant one in the head: a sort of creaking, straining and drawing like the noise of a cornstalk fiddle, greatly interfering with sleep. Dr. Sarah Hogan gave Calc-f. with complete success in a case of flatulency in a pregnant woman. The patient passed through the labor quite easily, whereas the previous labor had been very difficult. In many other cases Dr. Hogan found the remedy facilitate labor. She found flatulency a marked indication for the remedy independent of pregnancy. G. P. Hale with the 3x, removed induration after typhlitis, also encysted tumor of eyelids. He regarded induration threatening suppuration as a marked indication. Induration in the epigastric region after a kick from a horse was cured, also indurated glands of stony hardness. W. P. Wesselheft cured two cases of syphilitic periosteal swelling, one on the right radius, one on the left ulna, one sensitive, one not, one patient was male, dark, the other was blonde, female. Each case received a dose of Calc-f. 100,00c. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Con., Lap-a., Bar-m., Hecla, Rhus-t. (2)Calc.sulph-stibiata- acts as an hemostatic and absorptive in uterine myoma. (3) Mangifera indica - varicose veins. (4) Calc-p. - ozaena, suppuration of bones. (5) Nat-m. - cold sores. (6) Sil. - Swellings on skulls of infants, suppuration of bones, Ph-ac. (7) Cacodylate of Soda - tumors. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Blood - Vascular tumors with dilated blood vessels. Varicose or enlarged veins. Bones - Bony growths, bone spurs. Bone deformities. Osteo-sarcoma. Exostosis after injury. Breasts - Hard knots in breasts. Hard glands in the female breast. Breast nodes, tumors. Constitutions - Sluggish temperament. Congenital syphilis manifesting itself in ulceration of mouth and throat.

full:
PHARMACY - calc-hp. Calcarea hypophos- phorosa. Calcium hypophosphite. Hypophosphite of lime. Trituration and solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Arteries, disorders. Asthma. Congestion. Debility. Dyspnea. Emaciation. Headache. Paralysis. Sweating. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - This salt was proved by A. R. Barrett and a friend, who each took one grain of 2x trituration. Calc-hp. is to be preferred when it seems necessary to furnish the organism with liberal doses of phosphorus in consequence of continued abscesses having reduced the vitality. Indicated in those persons who become pale, weak with violent drenching sweat, rapidly emaciate with extreme debility, on account of vital losses or continued abscesses. Emaciation of children. Loss of appetite, rapid debility, night sweats. Great fullness and oppression around heart, fullness throughout thorax and head, veins of upper parts and upper limbs stand out like whipcords. Dyspnea, must have air. Tuberculosis, diarrhea and cough, acute pains in chest. Mesenteric tuberculosis. Bleeding from lungs, angina pectoris, asthma, affection of arteries. Veins stand out like whipcords. Dull, heavy pressure from top of head between frontal and occipital bones, pain generally increased with increasing depression. Pallor of skin. Habitually cold limbs. Acne with pustules. Profuse sweat all over. Complete loss of muscular power with loss of desire to move. MIND - Excitable nervous and sleepless. Talks rapidly and easily angered.

Stomach - Ravenous hunger, worse two hours after meals better when stomach is full. Loss of appetite. COMMENTS - Has cured attacks of pain occurring two hours after meals, relieved by a cup of milk or light food. With the first trituration, Nash cured a boy of eight who had several abscesses in and around the knee joint. The tibia was ulcerated and the ragged edge of the bone protruded through the surface. There was emaciation, loss of appetite and he was as pale as a corpse. The appetite returned at once in great force. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc-p., Calc-i., Glon., Bar-c. (2) Kali-c. - excessive sweating, weakness, pallor, Cact. - heart and arteries. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Sore throbbing in spleen. Mesenteric tuberculosis.

Rectum - Diarrhea of tuberculosis.

Chest - Veins stand out like whip-cord. Ears - Frying or sizzling in ears.

Heart - Angina pectoris.

Limbs - Habitually cold limbs. Lungs - Acute pain in chest. Tuberculosis cough. Bleeding from the lungs. Asthma. Bronchitis.

Sleep - Starts in sleep.

Skin - Exhausting night sweat (Merc.). Acne with pustules all over the body.

Modalities - Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calcarea iodata has a short proving, it has been used on the indications suggested by its two components in the diseases named. It is similar to Bar-i. in its action on enlarged glands. Indicated for enlarged tonsils honeycombed with little crypts. Induration of glands. Thyroid tumors and cysts. Thyroid gland enlargements about time of puberty. For the treatment of scrofulous disorders. Weariness of the whole body. Secretions inclined to be profuse and yellow. Croup. Adenoids. Uterine fibroids. Polyps of nose and ear. Indolent ulcers accompanying varicose veins. Headache while riding against a cold wind. Profuse sweat. MIND - Indifference and indolence.

Head - Headache while riding against cold wind. Light-headed. Catarrh, worse at root of nose, sneezing, very little sensation. Constant, severe and dull headache, forehead and temples, worse stooping. Sharp, piercing pain in right temple. Falling out of hair.

Eyes - Pain over the eyes.

Ears - Numbness and ringing in the ears.

Mouth - Dry, furred feeling on lips and tongue. Mouth and gums burn like fire. Bitter taste in the mouth, but not disagreeable, like myrrh. Astringent taste in mouth, like alum. Taste at first sweetish, afterwards slightly astringent and metallic.

Throat - Enlarged tonsils filled with little crypts. Thyroid enlargement about the time of puberty. Adenoids. Vertigo - Light-headed. Sensation as if the head wasn 't there. Giddy headache. COMMENTARY - The main use for this is tonsil and thyroid problems. Thyroid cysts (Thuj.), goiters, and thyroid tumors, especially since a treatment of radioactive iodine. Hyperthyroidism. Large tonsils and adenoids. Thyroids enlarge at puberty. Indurated glands. Generally warm-blooded. Kent named Calc-i. and Calc-sil. as the remedies for delusions of seeing dead people or dreaming of dead people. C. L. Nicholls cured a number of cases of breast tumors with the 3x, nodular tumors, movable, tender to touch, painful on moving arm. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Agraphis - adenoids with enlarged tonsils. (2) Sulph-i. follows both Agraphis and Calc-i. (3) Acon- 1. - swelling of glands, Hodgkin's disease. (4) also Calc-f., Sil., Merc., lod. (5) Calc., Bar-c., Calc-p., Carb-v. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Inclined to belch wind. Slight hiccough. Slight nausea.

Abdomen - Rumbling in the bowels with discharge of wind. Constant evacuation of large quantities of wind downward. Slight pain in the abdomen. Breasts - Indurated growth in breasts, movable, painful on pressure and on movement on arm. Constitutions - Flabby children subject to colds.

Neck - Stiffness of the back of the neck.

Limbs - Dull, heavy lameness in the external portion of the right arm, with numbness of the hands and fingers. Tired feeling in the lower limbs, especially in the calves of the legs. Pain across the anterior surface of the upper third of both thighs, as if he had been beaten. Lungs - Chronic cough. Pneumonia. Pain in chest, difficulty breathing after syphilis and mercury. Croup. Hectic fever with green, purulent expectoration.

Skin - Indolentulcers, with varicose veins. Easy perspiration. Copper colored and papular eruption. Tinea, favus, crusta lactea. Swelling of the glands. Skin is cracked.

PHARMACY - calc-m. Calcarea muriatica. Calcium chloride. Chloride of lime. Rademacher’s Liquor is 1 part to 2 of distilled water of which take 15 drops in half a cup of water, five times didiy. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Belchings. Boils. Convulsions. Diarrhea. Eczema. Edema. Faintness. Gastritis. Glandular, swellings. Impetigo. Iritis. Nausea. Paralysis. Pleurisy. Ringworm. Scrofula. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - In scrofulous cases, Calc- m. promotes the action of mercury. Under its use, glandular swellings and indurations soften and disappear, hence its use in swollen glands and boils. Calc-m.intheformoftheliquor(lpartof2 of distilled water), was one of Rademacher's “Stomach Remedies" and was used with great success by him in cases of obstinate vomiting. He gave 15 drops of the liquor in half a cup of water five times a day. Rademacher's indications were vomiting of all food and drink, vomiting when no food had been taken, jaundice, and pain in the left hypochondrium. He also found it indicated in gastric pain, bloating and belchings. Faintness, anxiety and weakness. Trembling and giddiness. Respiration quick and snoring. Increased secretion of mucus, perspiration and urine. Nausea and vomiting. Vomiting of all food and drink with gastric pain. Diarrhea. Tender precordium. Accelerated pulse. Cold sweats, convulsions, paralysis. Glandular swellings. Angio-neurotic edema. Pleurisy with effusion. Boils. Eczema. Eczema in infants. Ringworm of the scalp. Impetigo. COMMENTS - C. W. recorded a remarkable instance of the action of this remedy. A scrofulous and rheumatic woman had suffered from abscess of cornea, followed by rheumatic iritis and a dense opacity was left. An old- school practitioner had treated her with mercury during two years in a vain endeavor to “touch her mouth.” C. W. put one grain of Calc-m. in an 8-oz. bottle and directed the patient to take a tablespoonful three times a day. The medicine had not been taken ten minutes before she felt it at her fingers' ends. The mercurial action was evoked and she was in bed a fortnight, terribly salivated. The condition of the eye was unchanged. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc-i., Calc- chln., Nat-h. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calc-o-t. has the general properties of Calc., but it has been little used clinically. This preparation of Calcium has been used in preference to others in cases of simple bland leucorrhea and warts. Backache, as if broken in two. Leucorrhea. Backache with leucorrhea. Tired feeling. Effective in controlling suffering from cancer. Warts. COMMENTS - Water in which eggs have been boiled is popularly supposed to have the property of causing warts if brought in contact with the hands. This suggests Calc- o-t. as possibly the best Calcarea preparation to prescribe in cases of warts. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
