HERBAL - Cascarilla has a family similarity to the other Euphorbian plants. Case, acts prominently on the digestive tract, constipation.

HOMEOPATHIC - The leading symptoms include a sensation of swelling deep down in throat. Accumulation of mucus in throat. Hunger after meals and a feeling of emptiness. Aversion to the smell of tobacco smoke. Abdominal symptoms are better by warm drinks. Feeling of movement in abdomen as if hot water undulating there. The concussion of every step is felt painfully in the stomach. Marked inclination to vomit. Griping preceding morning stool. Boils in inguinal region. Constipation. Diarrhea with backache and lassitude.

Ears - Buzzing in the ears. Internal and external heat of the ears. Food - Desire for hot drinks. Aversion to tobacco smoke. Hunger after meals.

Mouth - Roughness of the tongue. Bitter taste in the mouth. Aversion to tobacco smoke.

Throat - Sore throat on swallowing, as if from an internal swelling. COMMENTS - Marked lassitude and muscular weakness. Backache and weakness. Inclination to lie down. Sleep with clear consciousness. Heat with thirst from warm drinks (intermittents). Short, dry cough from tickling in trachea, hemoptysis. Stitch upward in left side of chest. Constant slight urging with gnawing pain high up in rectum. Constipation, stools hard in pieces, covered with mucus. Passes bright blood with or without stool in large quantities, causing weakness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crot-t. - better from warm drinks. (2) Chin. - effects of loss of blood intermittents. (3) Graph. - mucus with stools. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Heat in the stomach and burning pain in the epigastrium. Pressure on the stomach, as if from fullness. Pain in the stomach as from concussion. Pain in stomach as from a shock. Nausea and vomiting. Pressing colic.

Abdomen - Tension and pressure on the hypochondria. Movement in the abdomen as if hot water were undulating there. Flatulent, aching colic.

Rectum - Constipation, stools hard, covered with mucus (Graph.). Bright blood with stool. Diarrhea alternating with hard, lumpy stool, with backache and lassitude, preceded by griping. Gnawing pain high up in rectum .

Chest - Hemoptysis. Stitch upwards on left side.

Back - Backache and weakness, muscles pained violently.

full:
PHARMACY - cassi-s.Cassiasophera. Senna sophera. Senna esculenta. N. O. Legumino- sae, Caesalpinioideae.

CLINICAL - Dyspnea. Knee, pain. Osteoarthritis.

HERBAL - Cassia sophera is indigenous to India and has been frequently used by ancient Indian physicians for its efficacy in respiratory disorders. Its Sanskrit name ‘Kasamarda' which means ‘Destroyer of Cough.' An effective herbal laxative is made from the senna pods, and leaves. The purgative constituents are closely allied to those of Aloes and Rhubarb. The active substances are glycosides called sennosides. Senna pods have a milder effect and have fewer side-effects than Senna leaves. The main effect is an increase in intestinal peristalsis and a reduction in the water absorption of the intestinal wall, which leads to accelerated stools. Side effects, especially from fresh senna leaves, are intense cramp, excessive abdominal cramps, and irritation of bladder and uterus. Senna should not be administered to people who suffer from hemorrhoids or enteritis. Their use during pregnancy or the lactation period is not recommended because of their excretion via the mother's milk.

HOMEOPATHIC - Two provings were undertaken by the Indian Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy. The first proving (1972-74) included 21 males and 9 females, the second (1974-76) 24 males and 13 females. Both provings were carried out with the mother tincture, 30th and 200th centesimal potencies. MIND - Anxiety about future. Causeless anxiety. Anxiety and restlessness. Fear to go to sleep lest heart would stop beating. Anxiety and fear of losing his way home. Forgetful of duties and of facts. Forgets to lock his room. Changeable moods. Intolerant of contradiction. Angry when contradicted. Desire to be alone. Desire to lie down quietly. Aversion to talk to others.

Head - Dull pain in temporal and frontal regions. Headaches, worse heat, daytime. Headaches, better cold applications, tight bandaging. Bursting pain in forehead, worse motion, exertion, stooping, Bursting pain in forehead, better pressure, tight bandage, open air, lying down. Hammering pain in forehead, worse heat, better gentle pressure. Sensation of heat in forehead, worse sun, better cold bath. Heaviness sensation, worse talking, better keeping quiet. Heaviness in forehead, worse evening, exertion, stooping. Heaviness in forehead, better morning, lying down, pressure. Heaviness in occiput, worse exertion, warmth. Heaviness in occiput, better washing head with cold water, better lying down, pressure.

Eyes - Itching of upper lids, worse sunlight, better cold applications. Heaviness of eyelids, better cold open air. Burning pain in eyes, worse motion, pressure, warmth. Burning pain in eyes, better lying down, after sleep, cold applications. Pain in eyes, worse bending head forward, better closing eyes. Food - Diminished appetite. Excessive hunger. Thirstlessness. Thirst for large quantities of water at frequent and long intervals. Thirst for small quantities of water at frequent intervals. Aversion to bread. Desires curd, eggs, pickles. Desires salty things, sweets. Desires warm drinks, warm food. Better milk. Better hot tea. Better cold drinks. Worse fatty foods.

Ears - Aching pain in ears, worse eating. Heat flushes in ears during vertigo.

Nose - Nasal obstruction at night, worse cold. Nasal obstruction, better daytime, warmth. Followed by watery nasal discharge. Profuse, thin, watery, bland discharge. Dryness of nose in morning, followed by watery discharge during daytime.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth and increased thirst. Excessive salivation and impaired taste.

Throat - Dryness better sipping cold water. Sensation of heat spreading over whole body, better cold drinks. Burning pain, worse cold air, cold applications, swallowing, better hot tea. Vertigo - Vertigo better lying down. Vertigo with a tendency to fall forward or backward. Heat flushes in ears during vertigo. Dim vision during vertigo. Nausea preceded by vertigo. Vision - Blurred vision during menses. Dim vision during vertigo, better cold applications. COMMENTS - Clarke mentions for Senna: “a nasty unclean smell from the body.” “Of 16 patients presenting unspecific pain in the knee joints, with the modalities mentioned above, 15 were relieved after taking Cassia. This indicates its possible use in osteoarthritis.” (Central Council). "Although dyspnea was observed in a prover during the course of proving, the modalities have only been obtained and confirmed during the clinical studies.” (Central Council). “While proving the vertigo symptom was accompanied by a tendency to fall forward, the clinically confirmed symptom was accompanied by a tendency to fall backward.” (Central Council). RELATIONS - Antidotes: Nux-v., Cham. Compare: (V)Bry. Kali-c., Nux-v. (2)Senn., (Cassia acutifolia.. Cassia angustifolia., Cassia obovata). REFERENCES - Central Council. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Excessive hunger and gnawing sensation in epigastrium, better eating, milk. Nausea preceded by vertigo.

Abdomen - Fldtulence and distension of abdomen, worse morning, evening, better after eating, drinking water. Intense abdominal cramps. Squeezing, crampy, colicky pain in right hypochondrium, worse after eating, worse fatty foods. Colicky pain worse changing position, bending forward. Colicky pain better fasting, gentle pressure and rest. Colicky pain worse lying on right side, better lying on left side.

Chest - Chest pain with coughs. In the proving the chest pain was confined to the left side.

Back - Backache in dorsal region, scapula, worse cold air, better heat of sun, pressure. Pain in lumbar region, worse bending forward, better pressure. Sensation of heaviness in cervical region, worse bending forward, better pressure. Perspiration at cervical region during fever.

Limbs - Pain in knee joints, worse first movement, rising from seat, better continued motion, pressure. Lungs - Difficult breathing, worse dust, smoke. Dyspnea, worse winter, change of weather. Dyspnea, worse cold drinks, walking. Thick, yellow expectoration.

Sleep - Disturbed sleep. Sleeplessness before midnight.

Skin - Eruptions, like ringworm on thighs. Itching, worse night, better scratching.

Modalities - Better rest and pressure. Better lying quietly. Better cold, cold applications. Better cold air. Better cold drinks. Worse warmth. Worse motion (pains).

Teeth - Pain in teeth and gums with earache, worse eating, pressing teeth together.

Bladder - Irritation of bladder.

Cough - Dry cough worse lying on right side. Cough with pain in chest. Cough and thick, yellow expectoration. Cough worse in morning and evening. Cough better from warmth.

Perspiration - Profuse perspiration, face and axilla. Unclean smell from the body. Rectum - Ineffectual urge to pass stool. Constipation, no urge for 3 to 4 days. Stool passed after great straining.

Soft stools of short, small pieces like chopped tape, accompanied with severe pain and rumbling, pain better by stool. Diarrhea. Thickurine. Lumbago, weak back, can hardly straighten up. name: Castor Equi
author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - cast-eq. Castor equi. Rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Triturations are made from the scales of rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Breasts, swollen. Coccyx, pain. Fainting. Epilepsy. Nails, disorders. Nipples, cracked. Nipples, ulcerated. Psoriasis. Skin, disorders. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - This is a very ancient remedy and was proved and introduced into homeopathy by Hering. The clinical experience of Hering and his fellow-provers has shown this to be highly useful remedy in cracked and ulcerated nipples. Cast-eq. especially acts on the nipples, the nails and bones, causing pains in right tibia and coccyx. General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Nails become brittle and fall off. Chapped hands. Affects principally female organs, especially the nipples. Cracked and ulcerated nipples of nursing women, excessively tender, cannot bear the touch of clothing. Warts on forehead, breasts. Psoriasis of the tongue. Bones, especially tibia and coccyx are painful. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco. MIND - Unusual laughter about things not funny.

Head - Sensation as if occiput had gone to sleep. Scalp goes to sleep, numb. As if something crawling in hair. Pressure in forehead. Pressive pain in temples. Deep pressure in occiput. Headache with vertigo and nausea, sour stomach and lack of appetite.

Eyes - Frequent twitching in right eyelid. Itching in canthi.

Ears - Sensation of dryness in left ear, compelling to scratch. Twitching, internally in left ear.

Nose - Pressive pain in nasal bones. Coryza, fluent, with constant sensation of hunger, even after eating

Face - Sensation as if trismus. Transitory, burning, prickling pain in face and also on body. Prickling and heat on both cheeks. Dry lips with thirst in evening. Food - Sense of hunger, even after eating, during coryza. Lack of appetite during headache. Desire to smoke tobacco. Great accumulation of saliva, immediately after eating. Soon after pains in teeth, loud rumbling in abdomen.

Mouth - Burning, on front of tongue. Psoriasis of the tongue. Pain in hollow teeth of left side, must pick them.

Throat - Disagreeable, sick feeling in larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo, headache and nausea in mornings, sour stomach and lack of appetite. COMMENTS - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Principally affects the female organs. Cracked and ulcerated nipples (Sars., Sil., Petr., Calen.), especially of nursing women. Nipples excessively tender, cannot bear touch of clothing. Chapped hands. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco. Psoriasis of tongue. Warts on forehead and breasts. Burnett cured with it a case of wart on forehead. RELATIONS - Compare: (I) Calc-ox., Hipp., Cast., Mosch. Graph. (2) Hep. relieves the sore nipples. (3) Thuj. has removed warts caused by Cast-eq. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak. Murphy.

Stomach - Repeated empty eructations.

Abdomen - Colic with urging wakes him in the morning, followed by a very thin, watery, somewhat burning stool, with passage of offensive flatus. Pain in left inguinal region.

Rectum - Urgent stool, preceded by colic and passage of flatus.

Chest - Burning pains on chest.

Heart - Peculiar sensation about heart as of something alive struggling.

Back - Weakness of spine. Pain in coccyx, worse every evening, while sitting. Breasts - Breasts swollen, sensitive, worse descending stairs. Nipples almost hanging. Cracked, sore nipples in nursing women, excessively tender, cannot bear touch of clothing, even in neglected cases, ragged. Swelling of breasts. Violent itching in breasts. Reddened areola.

Limbs - Repeated pain in right tibia. Arms and legs sore as if beaten. Pain in left elbow and right knee. Right wrist-joint as if sprained. Very brittle nails. Crumbling of fingernails from slightest knock against them.

Sleep - Restless sleep with numbness of right arm. Sleepiness in early evening. Stretches arms up over head and cracks fingers during sleep. Restless sleep, with many dreams. In winter dreams of fresh fruit hanging on trees.

Skin - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Warts. Psoriasis. Nails drop off. Brittle nails.

full:
PHARMACY - cast. Castoreum canadense. Beaver secretion. N. O. Rodentia. Tincture of secretion, found in preputial sacs of beaver. Castoreum when fresh is yellow and of the consistence of syrup, when dry it is dark red or brown and of the consistence of hard wax. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chorea. Colic. Convulsions. Day-blindness. Digestion, disordered. Dysmenorrhea. Eclampsia. Epilepsy. Flatulence. Hernia.Hysteria. Ileus. Menstrual colic. Paralysis. Pregnancy, vomiting. Prostration. Reaction, deficient. Sexual, disorders. Sycosis. Tetanus. Typhoid. Typhus. Warts. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caspari proved Russian Cast., Nenning, that of Southern Europe. Teste remarked that Cast, has been regarded as a resinous substance and he observed, moreover, that the beaver feeds almost entirely on the resinous bark of pine trees. In Siberia, beavers feed on the bark of the birch, which may make a difference in the effects of Cast, from different countries. Cast, is a great remedy for hysteria. Weakness and lack of reaction. Marked prostration. Nervous palpitations. Nervous women who do not recover fully, but are continually irritable and suffer from debilitating sweats. Constant yawning. Restless sleep with frightful dreams and starts. Day blindness, cannot endure the light. Spasmodic disorders after debilitating diseases. Creeping, tingling sensation, worse sleep. Chorea. Epilepsy. Fibrillar twitch- ings. Heaviness of the whole body. Pains are better by pressure, rubbing. Reflex uterine effects, are nervous and spasmodic. Menstrual colic with pallor and cold sweat. Feeling of fullness in the stomach as if too much had been eaten. MIND - Irritability. Easily sheds tears. Melancholic and full of anxious longings.

Eyes - Day blindness. Cannot endure the light.

Ears - Acute dragging in the ears. Tinkling, buzzing, and gurgling in the ears, dispersed by boring the ear with the finger.

Nose - Obstruction of the nose. Flow of aqueous, acrid, corrosive mucus from the nose.

Mouth - Tongue, swollen, twitching. Round pea-like elevation in center of tongue with redness around. Tongue sensitive to touch or food, with drawing pain towards hyoid bone.

Throat - Hoarseness, with disposition to clear throat. Dryness of esophagus. Burning pain in the throat, as from heartburn. COMMENTS - Cast, resembles Ambr., Mosch., Ign. and Valer. Teste placed Cast, in the Thuj. group with Plat, and Bism. Teste concluded from analogy that Cast, would be an anti- sycotic, and he proved his point by initiating with it the cure of a case of pedunculated vegetations around the anus in a hysterical young woman. Thuj. completed the cure. Teste quoted from Trousseau and Pi- deux the following indications, which he confirmed: ( 1 ) Amenorrhea, accompanied with painful and tympanitic swelling of the abdomen. We mean the cases where only a few drops of blood escape from the uterus with a sort of uterine tenesmus. (2) The cases of colic to which Castoreum seems to be principally adapted are of the nervous kind, that seem to be particularly seated in the small intestine. They are accompanied with paleness and cold sweats, a sudden sinking of strength, as if the very principle of life had been struck down. They are without any alvine evacuations, come suddenly after lively emotions, a cold on the bowels or by the feet, as after long exposure to a cold rain. Cast, causes jerking in small groups of muscular tissues, a sensation of heaviness of whole body, trembling of limbs. RELATIONS -Antidote: Colch. Compare: (Ï) Ambra, Mosch., Mur-ac., Valer. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Regurgitation of a bitter acidity. Vomiting of white, bitter mucus. Sensation of contraction and pain of ulceration.

Abdomen - Colic or other abdominal complaints, accompanied with yawning. Colic with weakness, better pressure.

Rectum - Summer diarrhea with green, mucus stools.

Male - Seminal emissions with great excitability.

Female - Pain commences in middle of thighs. Violent, cutting dysmenorrheal colic with a few drops of blood, then cold sweat. Amenorrhea with a painful tympanites. Food - Repugnance to food and constant nausea. Violent thirst, could not drink enough.

Chest - Stitches in chest, heat as if fire were burning in it. Constitutions - Suited to nervous women with pains, cramps, and weakness after severe illness. Hysterical individuals. Abdominal soreness. Nervous attacks when the aura starts from abdomen.

Back - Pain as from excoriation, in the sacral region and back. Drawing pains in nape of the neck.

Limbs - Nocturnal dragging in shoulders and arms. Spasms of hands and feet. Hands hot with swelling of veins. Weakness of the lower limbs. Lungs - Breathing is short, difficult. Short breath when ascending. Slow, deep inspiration with short expiration.

Sleep - Constant yawning as accompanied symptom. Yawns in sleep. Restless sleep with frightful dreams and starts.

Modalities - Better from pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse cold. Worse during menses. Worse debilitating diseases.

Teeth - Toothache when eating, provoked by cold and mitigated by hot things. Toothache with acute drawing pains. Swelling of the gums at night, with acute pulling in the temples.

Kidneys - Frequent emission of urine, with burning thirst, day and night. After the emission of urine, desire to vomit with disgust.

Temperature - Predominant chilliness. Chilliness with icy coldness in back. Exhausting sweats after fevers.

name: Caulophyllum Thalictroides
author: Murphy
constitution: After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera, morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ovarian, neuralgia. Paraplegia. Pityriasis. Pregnancy, Caulophyllum thalictroides disorders. Premature, labor. Rheumati
keynote:
PHARMACY - caul. Caulophyllum thalic- troides. Blue cohosh. Squaw root. Leontice thalictroides. N. O. Berberidacae. Tincture or trituration of mol. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains.…
full:
PHARMACY - caul. Caulophyllum thalic- troides. Blue cohosh. Squaw root. Leontice thalictroides. N. O. Berberidacae. Tincture or trituration of mol. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera, morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ovarian, neuralgia. Paraplegia. Pityriasis. Pregnancy, Caulophyllum thalictroides disorders. Premature, labor. Rheumatic, gout. Rheumatism. Thrush. Trembling. Uterine, spasm. Uterine atony. Weakness.

HERBAL - Caul., the Blue Cohosh, is closely related in action to Cimic., the Black Cohosh, though they belong to different families of plants.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caul, has only had one proving, by Dr. Burt, the majority of the indications were derived from tradition and clinical experience. Caul, acts most markedly on the female generative organs and on rheumatic states. Lack of tone of the uterus. Left ovarian and left infra-breast pains. Leucorrhea in young girls or during pregnancy. Complaints due to uterine disorders. Bearing-down pains. Uterine spasms (Sep.). False labor pains. During labor, when the pains are deficient and the patient is exhausted and fretful. Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or they are too painful. Internal trembling with weakness. Exhaustion and general debility. Reflex symptoms having a uterine origin, like headaches, hoarseness, rheumatism, vomiting, cramps and spasms. Hysterical or epileptiform spasms at puberty, during dysmenorrhea. Chorea at puberty. A rheumatic remedy, especially acting on small joints. Erratic pains flying about from place to place, drawing, cramping, shooting, rheumatic in character, ending in neck which gets stiff. Thrush, locally and internally. Paraplegia from disorders of the uterus. Paraplegia after childbirth. MIND - Nervous. Excitable. Fretful, irritable and apprehensive. Easily displeased.

Head - Headaches from uterine or spinal troubles. Headaches over left eye, pressure behind eye, severe by spells, worse stooping, from light, from noon until night.

Eyes - Drawing pains over the left eye. Eyes aching, with a feeling of something under the lids. Profuse secretion of tears. Face - Moth spots on forehead, with leucor- rhea. Heavy upper lid, has to raise them with fingers, with leucorrhea.

Mouth - Aphthae. Thrush. Tongue coated white. Teeth feel sore and elongated.

Throat - Pain in the fauces. Frequent inclination to swallow. COMMENTS - Threatened miscarriage due to uterine atony, with a history of habitual abortion or miscarriage. Weak, atonic uterus (Sep.). Inertia of the uterus. False conception or pregnancy. Sterility with a history of uterine atony or a prolapsed or weak uterus. Can be used for tendency to miscarriage, long ineffectual labor, weakness after childbirth, postpartum depression, but not in general during pregnancy because it can stimulate labor. Labor with a full feeling, bearing down with a rigid os, severe labor pains accompanied by severe exhaustion. Exhausting labor, weak pains. Ineffectual labor (Puls.), false labor, premature labor. Rigid os, will not dilate further during labor, with thirst (Gels, is not thirsty, Bell., Verat-v.). 1 Lack of expulsive power where the placenta is retained, internal trembling. White, milk-like vaginal discharge after childbirth that persists for weeks with exhaustion. Postpartum hemorrhage with passive oozing coupled with exhaustion, venous hemorrhage. Cervical erosion with a milky white discharge and chorine fatigue. Cervicitis (yellow-green discharge. Thuj.), indurated cervix (Con.). Extreme fatigue and uterine weakness (Helon., keynote is they have a consciousness of the womb). Antispasmodic. Menstrual cramps with severe fatigue and exhaustion, labor-like pains. Drawing pain in the thigh, feels heavy and tired. Vaginitis with bearing down pains in the uterus, acrid and burning leucorrhea. Exhausted with vaginitis, thirsty. Menopause and hot flashes with weakness (Sep.). Chorea at puberty. Problems at puberty, including weakness, menstrual cramps that come since first menses (Puls.). Was given, with some success, for chloasma and pityriasis versicolor, curing dysmenorrhea at the same time. Great nervous excitement, tremulous weakness over whole body. Sleepless and restless, but exhausted. Can scarcely speak. Sleepless, restless, nervous, recalling the effects of coffee, which is incompatible with it. Generally chilly and wants warm clothing. Arthritis in the smalljoints, fingers, wrists, toes and ankles, especially if since childbirth or menopause, or since some problem with the uterus. Painful, swollen joints during pregnancy. Drawing pains in the joints with the menstrual cramps, as though the tendons had contracted. Rheumatic disorders of the small joints and muscles. Pains are intermittent and paroxysmal and fly about from place to place, generally worse at night. Erratic, wandering pains from joint to joint, stiffness in the fingers. Joints are swollen and painful. Stiff neck. Nash regarded “internal trembling” as a strong characteristic when associated with the weakness, he cured long-continued passive hemorrhage associated with these symptoms. Nash prescribed Caul. 3c for a woman of forty, seven months pregnant, who was attacked with severe pain and swelling of all the finger joints, wrapping them in mustard was the only thing that relieved her sufficiently to allow her to get sleep. Caul, relieved the finger pains, but caused such severe labor-like pains that it had to be discontinued for fear of causing miscarriage. The bearing-down then ceased and the finger pains returned and continued until delivery, when they ceased for a few days. Then the lochia increased to a flooding, a passive, dark, liquid with great weakness and internal trembling. Now the terrible finger pains returned. Afraid to give Caul., other remedies were tried, but in vain. At last Nash gave Caul. 200c, which rapidly cleared up the whole case. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Viol-o. - rheumatic carpal and metacarpal joints. (2) Cimic., Sep. (3) Gels, in dysmenorrhea, it is like Gels, and follows it well. (4) Puls, in labor-pains, but the mental condition is opposite, Cimic. (5) Bell, in intermittent and paroxysmal pains, Calc. - leucorrhea in little girls. (6) Lil-t., Lach., Sulph., Ust. and Vib-od. in left ovarian and infrabreast pains. (7) Mag-m. in uterine spasms, Bry. in rheumatism. (8) Sec., Sep., Goss. Incompatible: Coffea. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Cardialgía, spasms of the stomach. Dyspepsia with spasmodic symptoms. Frequent gulping of sour, bitter fluid, with vertigo. Vomiting of uterine origin.

Abdomen - Drawing pains in the right side over the liver. Severe colic. Pain in the umbilicus.

Rectum - Stool, soft white. Watery stools, great quantity.

Male - Sharp, stinging pains in glans penis. Modalities - Worse from pregnancy. Worse suppressed menses. Worse open air. Worse coffee.

Female - Habitual or threaten miscarriage from uterine atony (Helon., Puls., Sep.). False labor pains. Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or they are too painful. Revives labor pains and furthers progress of labor. Spasmodic and severe pains, which fly in all directions, shivering without prog- ress. Extraordinary rigidity of os (Bell., Gels., Verat-v.). After-pains. Profuse and prolonged lochia. Menorrhagia after hasty labor, flow very profuse. Profuse menses, late. Violent, intermittent cramping pains with little flow. Dysmenorrhea. Uterus retroverted. Irritable vagina, spasmodic intense pains. Leucorrhea with moth-spots on forehead. Profuse acrid leucorrhea, often in little girls. Needle-like pains in cervix. Placenta is retained.

Back - Rheumatic stiffness of neck. Severe drawing in sternocleidomastoid, drawing head to left. Dull pains in lumbar region. Causations - Childbirth. Miscarriages. Constitutions - Rheumatic constitutions.

Neck - Stiff, with head drawn to left. Nose - Drawing pains in the nose.

Limbs - Rheumatism of small joints. Severe drawing, erratic pain and stiffness in small joints, fingers, toes, ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Sore nodes on finger joints. Cutting pain in fingers joints on closing hands. Erratic pains, changing place every few minutes. Aching, sore lower limbs, before menses. Paraplegia after childbirth. Lungs - Hoarseness and loss of voice. Panting breathing.

Skin - Chloasma, on neck. Discoloration of skin in women with menstrual and uterine disorder. Hot and dry skin.

Temperature - As if too full of blood. High fever.

name: Causticum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cold drinks (even chill). Better damp wet weather. Better washing. Better warmth of bed. Better gentle motion. Worse in clear fine weather. Worse dry cold air. Worse winds, drafts. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse change of weather. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evenings at 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. Worse twilight. Worse darkness. Worse exertion. Worse stooping. Worse motion of carriage. Worse taking hold of anything. Worse bathing in the river in summer. Worse after stool. Worse from suppressed eruptions. Worse coffee, fats, sour things..
constitution: Acne rosacea. Amaurosis. Arthritis. Bell's palsy. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Bronchitis. Bums. Cataract. Chorea. Coccyx, pain. Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Deafness. Dentition. Diphtheria. Ears, otorrhea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders. Facial, paralysis. Fistula. Goiter. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heel, blistered. Herpes, zoster. Hip, disease. Impotence. Influenza.
keynote: PHARMACY - caust. Causticum. Caustic potash. Causticum Hahnemanni. Hahnemann's tincture of acris sine kali. Potassium hydrate. Obtained by distilling a mixture of slaked lime and a solution of potassium sulphate. Tincture with spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - caust. Causticum. Caustic potash. Causticum Hahnemanni. Hahnemann's tincture of acris sine kali. Potassium hydrate. Obtained by distilling a mixture of slaked lime and a solution of potassium sulphate. Tincture with spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Amaurosis. Arthritis. Bell's palsy. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Bronchitis. Bums. Cataract. Chorea. Coccyx, pain. Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Deafness. Dentition. Diphtheria. Ears, otorrhea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders. Facial, paralysis. Fistula. Goiter. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heel, blistered. Herpes, zoster. Hip, disease. Impotence. Influenza. Intermittent, fever. Intertrigo. Laryngitis. Lead, poisoning. Leucorrhea. Locomotor, ataxia. Meniere's, disease. Menstruation, disorders. Muscle,pains. Nails, crippled. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Pemphigus. Pregnancy. Prostatitis. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Scabies. Scrofula. Skin, eruptions. Smallpox. Stammering. Strokes. Syphilis. Tendons, contracted. Throat disorders. Tongue, paralysis. Ulcers. Urethritis. Urine, disordered. Varicose, veins. Voice, lost. Warts. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caust. is one of the great polycrest medicines for chronic diseases. The chemical composition is still uncertain though it is considered to be potassium hydrate or caustic potash. Caust. acts upon the nerves, motor and sensory and on muscles voluntary and involuntary of bladder, larynx and limbs. Chronic rheumatic, arthritic and paralytic disorders. Characteristic burning, rawness and soreness. Indicated in tearing, drawing pains in the muscular and fibrous tissues with deformities about the joints. Chronic rheumatic disorders cause contraction of tendons and deformities about the joints. Stiff joints. Restlessness at night with tearing pains in joints and bones and faint-like sinking of strength. Progressive loss of muscular strength, tendinous contractures. Weakness, loss of muscular strength, causing increasing uncertainty of control over the muscles, finally ending in paralysis of single organs or parts. Local paralysis, vocal cords, muscles of swallowing of tongue, eyelids, face, bladder and limbs. Paralysis from exposure to cold. Post-diphtheria paralysis. Paralysis from lead poisoning. Cold water tones the paralysis. Trembling. Convulsions. Chorea in nervous girls, worse during menses. Cramps here and there. Epilepsy, runs in circle, then falls down, at puberty. Restlessness at night, especially the legs are constantly on the go. Catarrhal disorders of the air passages. Seems to prefer dark-complexioned and rigid-fibered persons. The skin is of a dirty white sallow with warts, especially on the face. Fissures from least provocation, about wings of nose, lips, anus etc. Emaciation, due to disease, fright, worry, grief and of long lasting illness. Children are slow in learning to talk and walk. Awkward at talking, chewing, walking. Broken down seniles. Patient is susceptible to both cold and heat. MIND - Timid, nervous, anxious. Reticent. Anxiety of conscience as if she had committed a crime. Night watching, nursing loved ones, keeping late hours and missing sleep from taking care of someone (Phos. and Cocc.). Over sympathetic. Lacks control, balance. Melancholy. Sadness. Taciturn and distrustful inclined to fits of anger with scolding. Hopeless, despondent, wants to die. Whining mood. Looks on the dark side. Suspicious, mistrustful. Weeps. Laughs before, with or after spasms. Convulsions from suppressed eruptions. Grief, feels betrayed (Ign.). Bitter, emotionally caustic. Holds grudges. Weakness, ailments from long-lasting grief, sudden emotions. Foreboding. Fear of impending doom, that something bad is going to happen (Calc.). Full of fearful fancies, worse at twilight. Sees fearful images when closing eyes. Fear of the dark and fear of being alone (Phos.). Vexed with business worries. Cannot tolerate to seeing injustice (Staph.). Affected by bad news, makes them angry and motivated. Obsessive motivation for a cause, politics and injustice. Idealistic, more focused than Nat-m. Disappointed easily and argumentative (Ign.). Ambitionless. Absent-minded. Memory fails. Confounds letters and syllables. Mental fatigue and paralysis. Mental exertion causes symptoms, such as stitches in temples, tension in head and scalp, especially forehead to temples. Thinking of complaints aggravates them, especially hemorrhoids. Children are overly concerned about other people and oversensitive. Inquisitive and intelligent. Can get frustrated and feel powerless. Child does not want to go to bed alone, least thing makes him cry. Insanity with mental confusion. Very sensitive to light and noises, also better cold drinks (Phos.).

Head - Painless commotion in the whole head. Pain in right frontal eminence. Sensation as of an empty space between the forehead and brain, better hot application. To and fro or nodding motions or turning to right. Tight scalp. Stitches in temples on mental exertion. Nausea and vomiting or blindness during headache, then paralysis. Small, soft, round nodes on scalp or glabella.

Eyes - Paralysis of ocular muscles after exposure to cold. Paralysis of one eyelid (right). Heavy drooping eyelids. Ptosis (Gels.). Weakness of recti muscles. Diplopia, better looking to right. Continuous eye pain with inclination to touch and rub the eyes, which seems to relieve the pressure in it. Profuse acrid tears. Vision obscured as from gauze, on blowing nose. Sparks and dark spots before the eyes. Objects look large. Cataract with motor disturbances. Rolling of eyes, epilepsy. Eyes remain open without winking, paralysis. Eyelids quiver. Inflammation of eyelids, ulceration. Warts on eyebrows. Fissures in canthi.

Ears - Ringing, roaring, pulsating, with deafness. Meniere's disease. Words and steps re-echo. Chronic middle-ear catarrh and great accumulation of earwax. Thick gluey purulent discharge. Burning in ears, they become red.

Nose - Coryza with hoarseness. Sneezing in the morning. Thick yellow or greenish- yellow discharge. Nostrils ulcerated. Nosebleed during spasms. Pimples on tip of nose. Scaly nose. Old warts.

Face - Face yellow, sickly looking. Feels furry. Eruptions. Warts. Cramps in lips. Pain in facial bones. Pain in jaws with difficulty in opening mouth. Prosopalgia better cold water. Facial paralysis (right) worse opening mouth. Dental fistula.

Mouth - Bites inside of cheek fromchewing. Fatty taste. Recurrent abscess in gums, dental fistula. Teeth, feel loose, elongated, ache, worse from cold or warmth. Swelling in side of cheek or induration. Swelling at root of tongue. Paralysis of tongue with indistinct speech, words seem to jerk out. Tongue, red in middle, sides coated. Painful vesicles on tip. Rheumatism of joint of lower jaw.

Throat - Urging to swallow continuously as if the throat were too narrow. Swallows the wrong way or comes through nose. Difficulty in swallowing from paralysis of throat, unable to hawk out mucus, swallows it. Scraping, burning, rawness in throat. Throat symptoms worse stooping. Vertigo - Vertigo during sleep, at night in the morning, while lying down, on stooping, from looking up, during menstruation. COMMENTS - The weakening effect of potassium in allopathic overdosing is well known and was strongly brought out in the Causticum provings. Caust. is good for neurological problems with the neck, degeneration of the nerves, vertebrae, with brachial neuralgia, stiffness, and muscle weakness in the neck. Bell's palsy. Facial paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Weakness resulting from long standing grief or disease. Paralytic weakness. Paralysis of single nerves or single parts. Paralysis of both the voluntary and involuntary muscles. Ptosis, facial paralysis, paralysis of tongue of limbs of vocal cords of bladder of rectum, lead paralysis. Facial paralysis from cold drought, neuralgia of right cheekbones to mastoid process, worse at night. Convulsions, cramps, starting, restlessness, twitching. Contraction of flexor tendons. Trembling. Torticollis, spasm of the neck (Lachn.). Dupuytren’s contracture. Epilepsy, when fit occurs in sleep and urine escapes. Chorea, the right side is more affected than left, words seem to be jerked out. Restless legs at night. Arthritis with burning and stiffness. Jaw joints affected with rheumatism. Carpal tunnel syndrome. Rheumatism tends to stiffen joints and contract limbs. Neuralgic and rheumatic affections, tearing, drawing pains. Tendons can be indurated and thicken. Stiffness of the joints and neck (Rhus-t.) Keynote pains are raw, burning, sore, and tender. Headache that draws and tears through the body. Sensation as if there was an empty space between the bone of the skull and the brain, better by warmth. Headache, cannot keep upper eyelids up. Ptosis of the eyelids. Eyelids droop, weakness of the muscles (Gels., Sep.). Vertigo, excitement of brain and spine incapable, tends to fall forward or sideways (locomotor ataxia) with anxiety, weakness in head, sight as if through a fog, skin dry and hot, constipation. Intermittent fevers, “sweat coming after the chill without intervening heat.” Marked periodicity. Periodic, paroxysmal attacks, twice a day to every two, three or four weeks an attack, at new moon. Sickly, sallow, low-spirited expression. Skin is dirty-white. Eruptions on scalp behind ears. Weakened and emaciated appearance, especially about the face, the abdomen is large. Glandular indurations. Scrofulous children. Scrofulous inflammations about eyes, ears and scalp. Nails are crippled. Old, large inflamed and indurated warts, on hands, close to the fingernails, face, and margins of eyelids. Burning itching on face, discharging acrid fluid which forms crusts. Burns due to caustic chemicals, chemical burns (Canth., Urt-u.). Eustachian tubes with tinnitus and reverberation. Sounds re-echo unpleasantly, an ordinary voice sounds loud. Hoarseness with dry cough and redness of fauces, the result of weather or catching cold, worse in morning. Dry, hollow cough with mucus on chest, patient cannot expectorate, must swallow the phlegm raised. Cannot cough deep enough for relief. Accumulations of mucus in larynx and fauces, catarrh of throat. Rawness and burning down throat and trachea. Laryngitis, hoarseness and speech problems, especially stammering and stuttering in children (Nat-m.). Semi-paralysis of the tongue where the child stutters and stammers and cannot talk right (Merc.). Aphonia, paralysis of vocal cords. Difficult swallowing of liquids. Constant sensation as if lime was burning in stomach with water brash. Pressure and fullness in abdomen as if it would burst, much worse by food. Griping, cutting, better by bending double, worse after least food or tightening clothes, menstrual colic (Coloc.). Spasm of rectum prevents walking. “Passes stool best standing.” Obstinate constipation (paralysis of rectum), stools covered with shiny coating of mucus. Hemorrhoids, unbearable by walking, thinking of them, touch. Well-marked aggravations of anal symptoms. Painful pustules near anus discharging pus, blood, serum. Paralysis of bladder. Itching at orifice of urethra. Itching scrotum, cannot retain urine. Difficult, frequent urination with spasm of bladder. Tendency for urine to escape during the day from any extra exertion, laughing, walking. Bedwetting, especially during first sleep, worse winter, better in summer. Coughing expels urine. Dribbling of the urine. Urine is irritating and burning (Canth.) Prostatitis and urethritis. Blood with semen. Sexual appetite in women is abolished (Sep.). Constant indifference, except after the period. Sadness during period. Menses too early, too abundant. After menses, a little blood passes oc- casionally, smelling badly. Nursing women lose their milk after exertion or loss of sleep. Slow learning to talk and walk and stumbling on attempting to walk. Nash cured a severe case of prosopalgia with Caust. The patient was emaciated and debilitated by long suffering, pains came in paroxysms and were of a drawing nature. She had suffered from eczema at times before the neuralgia appeared. Sulph. had been given in vain. Caust. 200c rapidly cured. Guernsey commended Caust. in the aftereffects of burns and scalds. Patients say, “I have never been well since that burn.” Its caustic properties may be its “signature” here. Guernsey gave “sensation as if lime were being slaked in the stomach.” Macfarlan confirmed: “Sudden severe pains commence in the left hip joint, lasts a short time, feels as if it had been injured, legs very sore or rather the lower limbs ache and feel tired.” “Forearms in front very sore to touch and pressure, muscles of limbs sore generally.” Kraft cured cases of incontinence following over-distention of the bladder owing to want of opportunity to attend to the call to urinate at the time, such as occurs in shop Causticum girls and schoolgirls, who cannot leave their tasks. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Asaf., Coff., Coloc., Dulc., Guai. - in rheumatic contractions, Nit-s-d., Nux-v. Antidote to: Asaf., Chin., Coloc., Euphr., Plumb. (Lead poisoning), type-poisoning, abuse of Merc., and Sulph. In scabies. Compare: ( 1) Rhus-t., Ars., Am-p. - facial paralysis. (2) Calc. - images on closing eyes. (3) Nat- m. and Sep. - Spurting of urine with cough. (4) Rhus-t. - rheumatism from damp and cold, but with Rhus-t. there is restlessness andbetterfrommotion. Caust. has restlessness at night only. (5) Eup-per. - hoarseness worse in morning, influenza with aching all over body, has more soreness on chest than, Caust. (6) Sal-ac., Chin., Carb-s. - Meniere's disease. (7) Staph., Coloc. - anger and colic. (8) Bar-c. - mental weakness, paralysis, worse damp weather. (9) Sep. - Enuresis in first sleep, in deep sleep, Bell., Sulph. (10) Sars. - Urine, especially in women, is passed without patient's knowledge. (11) Bell., Hyos., Ign., Lach., Lyc. and Phos. - difficult swallowing of liquids. (12) Calc., Carb-an., Phos., Stroph. and Stram. - Fear of darkness. (13) Gels. - Ptosis, paralysis, faint-like weakness and trembling, blindness. (14) Aeon. - paralysis from cold. (15) Kali-bi. - blindness with headache, Kali- bi. has blindness better, as headache worse. Complementary: Carb-v., Staph., Coloc., Petros. Merc, assists the action of Caust. and vice versa in smallpox, (Teste).Incompatible: Acids, Coff., Phos. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Greasy, taste, belchings. Water brash, salty. Acid dyspepsia. Feels as if lime were burning in stomach. Pain in stomach from ice water. Sensation of a ball rising in the throat. Sour vomiting followed by sour belchings. Vomiting of blood at night. Fresh meat causes nausea, smoked meat agrees.

Abdomen - Enlarged abdomen in children. Colic, spasmodic. Pain radiates to back and chest, better bending double, worse least food. Painful swelling of the navel. Back - Back pain goes forwards or to the thighs. Pain in spine, worse swallowing. Stiffness between shoulders. Pain in hips, worse coughing. Bruised, darting pains around coccyx. Cramps in lumbar region and buttock. Dull pain in nape of neck. Stiffness of neck or back on rising from a chair, could scarcely move the head. Torticollis. Breasts - Disappearance of milk from fatigue, night-watching or anxiety. Nipples, sore, cracked, surrounded with herpes. Sticking pain below left breasts, dysmenorrhea. Violent itching about breasts in nursing women. Causations - Ill effects of burns and scalds, fright, grief, worry, sorrow, night watching.

Rectum - Sore and burns. Small hard pustules around anus. Large hemorrhoids impeding the stools worse walking, standing and when thinking of them. Fistula with pulsation and pain in perineum. Anus prolapses on coughing. Itching in anus better cold water. Partial paralysis of rectum. Cramps in rectum on stooping, with desire for urination. Rectum insensible to solid stool. Stools, hard tough, covered with mucous, shines like grease, soft and small, size of goose quill (Phos.). Stool passes easily when standing. Constipation with frequent ineffectual urging. Diarrhea from cold.

Male - Increase of smegma about the glans. Semen bloody during sex. Red spots on penis. Bruised soreness in testes.

Female - Menses cease at night, flow only during day (Cycl., Puls.). Menses late and profuse. Anxiety, sadness and weakness during menses. Dreams during menses. Dysmenorrhea with tearing pains in back and thighs. Leucorrhea, smelling like menses. Leucorrhea. profuse, flow during night with great weakness. Aversion to sex. Uterine inertia during labor. Smarting in the pudendum after urination. Food - Feels hunger, but appetite vanishes at the sight of food, or with thought or smell during pregnancy. Aversion to sweets. Worse after eating fresh meat, smoked meat agrees.

Chest - Chest tight sore, vest seems tight. Mucus under sternum, which he cannot reach. Pain in chest with palpitations. Constitutions - Anti-psoric, anti-sycotic and anti-syphilitic. It is one of Grauvogl's hydrogenoid remedies, hence is a chilly medicine. Suited to dark-haired persons with rigid tissue, delicate skins. Adapted to broken down, worn out senile persons. Lymphatic torpid temperament.

Heart - Palpitation with pain in chest, burning and languor.

Limbs - Twisting and jerking in limbs, chorea. Paralysis of single parts. Paralysis of deltoid, cannot raise hand to head. Paralytic feeling in the right hand with paralysis of tongue. Heaviness and weakness. Dull, tearing pain in hands and arms. Unsteadiness of muscles of forearm and hand. Numbness of hands. Trembling of hands. Contracted tendons. Cracking and tension in knees, stiffness in hollow oiknee. Burning injoints. Tearing joints. Arthritis deformans. Rheumatic tearing in limbs, better from the warmth, especially heat of bed. Disposition to stretch, bend or crack the joints. Cannot walk without suffering. Left-sided sciatica with numb- ness. Unsteady walking and easily falling. Weak ankles. Restless legs at night. Pain like electric shocks in legs. Itching on dorsum of feet. Cannot stand on heels. Cramps in calves, feet toes and Achilles tendon. Writer's cramp. Whitlow of great toes. Slow learning to walk. Lungs - Wandering chest pains, better pressure, worse sneezing. Oppressive breathing while talking and walking. Tightness or scraping in chest. Cannot lie down at night. Purring in chest. Sore streak in larynx. Pain in the larynx, worse blowing nose. Aphonia or hoarseness with pain in chest, worse morning, stooping, better talking. Difficulty of voice of singers and public speakers (Royal). Short breath, before coughing. Cough, hollow, hard, dry, incessant. Cough from tickling in throat pit of larynx. Cough at night, morning, worse stooping, heat of bed, cold air, better sips of cold water. Cough during pregnancy. Cannot cough deep enough, expectoration, slips back again, scanty, greasy, ropy like soapsuds, must be swallowed.

Sleep - Yawning, when listening or paying attention to others. Yawning and stretching. Very drowsy, can hardly keep awake. Sleeplessness with dry heat. Frequent movements of arms and legs during sleep. Laughs and cries during sleep. Wakes with slightest noise.

Skin - Old burns that do not get well. Ill effects from burns. Pain of burns. Cracks, ulcers. Soreness in folds of skin, back of ears, between thighs. Skin prone to intertrigo during dentition. Warts, seedy, large, jagged, bleeding easily, ulcerating, on fingertips, nose, lids, brows. Itching. Scars freshen up, old injuries reopen.

Modalities - Better from cold drinks (even chill). Better damp wet weather. Better washing. Better warmth of bed. Better gentle motion. Worse in clear fine weather. Worse dry cold air. Worse winds, drafts. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse change of weather. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evenings at 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. Worse twilight. Worse darkness. Worse exertion. Worse stooping. Worse motion of carriage. Worse taking hold of anything. Worse bathing in the river in summer. Worse after stool. Worse from suppressed eruptions. Worse coffee, fats, sour things.

Kidneys - Paralysis of bladder from long retention of urine and consequent incontinence. Retention of urine after labor after surgical operations. Involuntary passage of urine, on coughing, walking, blowing nose, sneezing. Involuntary during first sleep at night, or from slightest excitement. Insensibility of urethra while passing urine. Burning in urethra when urinating, worse after sex. Urine dribbles or passes slowly. Urine is passed better sitting. Urine, black, cloudy, white. Itching of meatus.

Temperature - Coldness, not better by warmth. Coldness, left sided of diseased part with pain. Flushes of heat. Sweat about 4 a.m., profuse, on slight exertion, open air. Heat from 6 to 8 p.m.

name: Ceanothus Americanus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Great weakness on walking or standing. Aversion to move, feels too weak. Worse from cold weather. Worse lying on left side. Worse motion..
constitution: Anemia. Bronchitis. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Heart, disorders. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Menses, suppressed. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgia. Side, pains. Spleen, disorders. Splenitis.

full:
PHARMACY - cean. Ceanothus americanus. Red root. New Jersey Tea. N. O. Rhamnacae. Tincture of fresh leaves. The fresh leaves are pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally as hair tonic.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Bronchitis. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Heart, disorders. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Menses, suppressed. Metrorrhagia. Neuralgia. Side, pains. Spleen, disorders. Splenitis.

HERBAL - This remedy has a special affinity to the spleen, which enlarges enormously.

HOMEOPATHIC - Enlargement of spleen and liver (Chin.). Deep-seated or cutting pains and fullness in region of spleen. Painful inflammation, enlargement of spleen, either alone or with other disorders. Low spirits with splenic affection. Headache on the right side with spleen pain. Pain in left hypochondrium with dyspnea, diarrhea. Ague cake of malaria. Marked blood pressure reducing powers. Active hemostatic, materially reducing the time for blood clotting. Anemic patients where liver and spleen are at fault. Leukemia. Periodical neuralgia. Chilliness, principally down back, shivering, rigors, must sit over fire, worse in cold weather. Chronic bronchitis with profuse secretion. Weight loss. A left-sided remedy generally. MIND - Apathy. Low-spirited, fears he will become unfit for work. Great nervous excitement with chilliness and loss of appetite. Felt as if nerves were shaken, at dinner could scarcely hold knife and fork. Don't care feeling all the time, cannot work.

Head - Headache, right side with pain in region of spleen. Head seems to move with every beat of the heart. Head feels as if the brain were too large. Dull frontal headache, better lying down. Crackling sensation.

Eyes - Eyes feel too large, lids swollen. Dry sensation of cornea, with a dull pain in orbital region.

Face - Cheeks and ears feel hot with cold fingers.

Mouth - Aphthous disorders of mouth and fauces. Mouth dry. Tongue, white coat down center. Tongue looks dirty. Food tasteless, unless highly seasoned.

Throat - Throat dry, raw sensation on swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo on turning in bed. COMMENTS - Burnett, following Hale, is our chief authority for Cean. Great affinity for the spleen in tincture or in potency. Good for trauma to the spleen, enlarged spleen, painful spleen in any blood disease or dying patient. Stitching pains, sharp pains in the spleen. Large and painful spleen. Diarrhea and dysentery (compare Cas-s. and other Rhamnee) have frequently been observed in patients taking Cean. for spleen disorders. Leucorrhea, profuse, thick, yellow, with pain in left side. Malaria, intermittent fevers and chills, and for severe cases where the spleen will swell. Peripheral edema with swollen spleen. Leukemia with enlarged spleen. Blood diseases including anemia and platelet problems. Pain generally on the left. Cean. was proved by I. C. Fahnestock, but its place had already been made clear by clinical use and definite clinical symptoms have been observed. Fahnestock's two provers took repeated doses of the tincture and both had severe symptoms. One had malaria five years before, treated with quinine. This prover suffered more acutely than the other and in the end had to be treated. Nat-m. 30c soon put an end to his symptoms. The other prover had practically identical, but less severe, symptoms. Commonly used during the American Civil War. Dr. Hale, a homeopathic surgeon, gave Cean. in tincture and potency for his many cases of ruptured spleens from bayonet wounds and gunshots. Dr. Hale said, “During the late Civil War I used this plant for splenitis, and was so well satisfied that I've been using it for six years on every case. I do not remember using anything else for an enlarged spleen. I have used it in the worst cases I ever saw from infancy to old age. I've yet to hear of its failure. However serious, it will help the swollen, enlarged, infected spleen.” P. C. Majumdar cured with Cean. 3x a case which had been diagnosed as heart disease, there were palpitations and dyspnea on exertion. Majumdar found the spleen enormously large. R. K. Ghosh cured many cases of suppression of menses and leucorrhea in patients from malarial districts. Menses too profuse and too early with pain in left side. Cannot lie down for pain in left side. RELATIONS - Antidote: Nat-m. Compare: (1 ) Cedr., Myric., Bell-p., Agar., Berb., Chin., Nat-m. (2) Ox-ac. - pain in left side. (3) Case. - diarrhea, syphilis. (4)Tinosporacordifolia- a Hindu medicine for chronic cases of fever with enlarged spleen. (5) Polymniauvedalia, Bears- foot - acute splenitis with tenderness over left hypochondriac region, spleen enlarged, ague cake. Vascular atony, tissues sodden, flabby and non-elastic. Enlarged glands influences all ductless glands. (6) Ceanothus thrysiflorus, California Lilac - pharyngitis tonsillitis, nasal catarrh, diphtheria. Tincture internally and as a gargle. Follows well: Cean. is followed well by: Berb., Con., Myric., Querc. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Wanted to drink water, but it made him sick.

Abdomen - Deep-seated pain in left hypochondrium. Unable to lie on left side. Pain in liver and back. Pain in left side, with leucorrhea and chilliness. Sensitiveness in umbilical region with desire to relax abdominal muscles. Whole abdomen moves with beat of heat. Bearing-down in abdomen, worse after eating.

Rectum - Continual bearing-down in rectum with constricting sensation, particularly with diarrhea. Dysentery. Light brown stool with loud flatus.

Male - Syphilitic complaints.

Female - Profuse, thick,yellow leucorrhea, with pain under left ribs. Weakening leucorrhea. Menses, ten days too early and very profuse. Menses every two weeks. Metrorrhagia with spleen pain. Food - Loss of appetite. Craving for something sour. Cannot eat pastry. Thirst for water, but it made him sick.

Chest - Soreness behind the sternum. Constricted feeling in chest. Constitutions - Sanguine constitutions.

Heart - Palpitations and dyspnea with enlarged spleen. Pulse full and very strong, heart's pulsations visible through the clothes. Heartbeat so hard it shook him all over. Chest feels too small for heart.

Back - Carotids throbbing in neck. Pain under right scapula. Dull pain in lumbar region. Constant dull pain in kidneys and up back. Chilliness down back. Weakness in small of back and legs.

Limbs - Pains down forearms and fingers. Weakness of knees, must lie down. Dull pains in anterior part of thighs.

Sleep - Awake all night. Sleeplessness. Dreamed of snakes, robbers.

Modalities - Great weakness on walking or standing. Aversion to move, feels too weak. Worse from cold weather. Worse lying on left side. Worse motion.

Liver - Full feeling in region of liver. Pain in liver, worse lying on right side, beginning immediately after dinner. Lungs - Congested feelings in lungs. Chest sore internally, worse deep inspiration. Violent dyspnea.

Spleen - Chronic hypertrophy of spleen. Enormous enlargement of the spleen. Deep-seated or cutting pains and full- ness in region of spleen. Splenitis, pain all up the left side. Severe pain in region of spleen with low spirits. Dull pain in region of spleen.

Kidneys - Sharp pain above pubes in region of bladder, before urination. Constant urging to urinate. Urine is quite green, contains bile, strong odor, frothy. Urine is alkaline with increased phosphates, high specific gravity, trace of sugar. After urinating, feeling as if all had not passed. Pain in back and irritation of urethra.

Temperature - Shivering, loss of appetite and nervous excitement. Rigors at frequent intervals. Intermittents with splenic enlargements. Cheeks and ears hot with cold fingers. At 4 p.m., six chills in succession with constant chilliness up and down back after chill very hot, fever, pulse 120, throbbing carotids.

name: Cedron
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from standing erect. Worse periodically. Worse at the same hour. Worse open air. Worse before a storm. Worse lying down. Worse after sleep..
constitution: Ague. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Ciliary, neuralgia. Chorea. Convulsions. Epilepsy, menstrual. Glaucoma. Gout. Hydrophobia. Hysteria. Intermittent, fever. Malaria. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Rheumatism. Snakebites. Stings. Toothaches.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cedr. Cedrón. Rattlesnake bean. Simaruba ferroginea. Simaba cedrón. N. O. Simarubacae. Tincture of seeds. Tincture of pure bean scraped on wound. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ague. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Ciliary, neuralgia. Chorea.…
full:
PHARMACY - cedr. Cedrón. Rattlesnake bean. Simaruba ferroginea. Simaba cedrón. N. O. Simarubacae. Tincture of seeds. Tincture of pure bean scraped on wound. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ague. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Ciliary, neuralgia. Chorea. Convulsions. Epilepsy, menstrual. Glaucoma. Gout. Hydrophobia. Hysteria. Intermittent, fever. Malaria. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Rheumatism. Snakebites. Stings. Toothaches.

HERBAL - Cedr. is particularly useful in tropical or in damp, warm, marshy countries. Malarial disorders of damp, warm, marshy countries. The seeds from Panama has accounts of antidoting snakebites when chewed immediately after being bitten. It also heals snakebites and the stings of insects, with tincture of pure bean being scraped on the wound.

HOMEOPATHIC - Petroz and Teste introduced Cedr. into homeopathic practice, because of its powers of antidoting snakebites and also of its traditional reputation in intermittent fevers. Clock-like periodicity is the most marked characteristic of this remedy. It has been found curative in malarial affections, especially neuralgias. Neuralgias occurring at exact periodicity. Hysterical spasms regularly night and morning. Chills in persons returned from tropical climates. Mania. Complaints after sex, chorea ' in women, neuralgia in men. Trembling. Numbness of the whole body. Convulsions during menses. Chorea after menses. Lec- tophobia. Bluish-red face, forearm to elbow and hands and feet cold, sweat beneath axilla and on chest. MIND - Nervous excitement, followed by depression. Restlessness, as driven from place to place. Lectophobia. Body heavy, mind depressed. Mental symptoms are worse at night. Abdomen - Abdomen hard and distended. Stitches in spleen and liver. Flatulence, colic and cramp. Borborygmi (left side).

Head - Orbital neuralgia. Roaring in ears produced by quinine. Stammers after sex. Crazy feeling from pain across forehead, worse working on black. Pain from temple to temple across eyes. Whole body feels numb during headache. Head feels as if swollen. Pain over whole right side of face, coming on about 9 a.m.

Eyes - Eyes red. Burn like fire. Shooting over left eye. Severe pain in eyeballs with radiating pains around the eye, scalding lachrymation. Periodic supra-orbital neuralgia. Pain over the eye, worse sex. Iritis, choroiditis. Objects appear red at night and yellow by day.

Ears - Tinnitus. Hardness of hearing at night.

Nose - Point of nose cold with chilliness and yawning, 9 a.m. Profuse secretion. Glassy-looking mucus or thin, clear, acrid.

Face - Animated red face. Flying heat of face alternating with chills. Tumid face, pupils much dilated. Prosopalgia (right). Wandering pains, spasmodic distortion of muscles. Lips cold, bluish, dry during menses.

Mouth - Prickling itching of tongue. Painful pricking of tongue with sensation of heat. Feels paralyzed. Difficulty of speech. Stammering after sex. Mouth and tongue dry, breath fetid during menses. Profuse ptyalism after menses.

Throat - Larynx constricted and tender. Intermittent laryngitis. Burning and constriction, difficult swallowing. Prickling and tingling in throat and fauces, extending some way down esophagus. Pain on small spot next root of tongue, as of a foreign body, worse from pressure. COMMENTS - Characteristic clock-like periodicity in the recurrence of the symptoms. Rapidity of action (Bell.). Fevers of low, marshy regions in warm seasons and tropical countries. Chills in persons returned from tropical climates. Intermittent fever commencing the same hour every day or every other day. During the fever, there is a red face in the hot stage, thirst with desire for warm drinks. Profuse perspiration. Excitement before chill. General debility, languor and fainting. Malaise. Predominance of nervous symptoms. Trembling. Accurately periodic neuralgias. Swollen sensations, numbness of the whole body. Enlarged sensation. Sensation as if paralyzed. Strong sexual excitement. Epileptiform convulsions during menses. Complaints after sex (chorea in women, neuralgia in men). A large number of symptoms appear on left side, but right side of head, face, right elbow and right deltoid are affected. Worse after sleep, lying down, night, open air, before a storm. Better standing erect. Objects appear red at night, yellow by day. Teste reported a case in which Hellert was bitten by a coral snake. “During the few seconds which it took him to take the antidote out of the little bag which he wore suspended around his neck, he was seized with violent pains at the heart and throat, but he had scarcely chewed and swallowed a small portion of Cedrón of the size of a small bean, when the pain ceased as by magic. An oppression and general prostration remained. “He chewed another portion of the same fruit and applied it to the wound externally and in another quarter of an hour all he felt was a slight colic, which disappeared Cedrón after eating a little. This colic was followed immediately by a copious evacuation of a substance that looked like curdled milk, white with a slightly yellowish tint.” Other cases were also reported. Halbert related a case of malarial fever in a soldier. Chills and fever were clock-like in regularity of recurrence. Liver and spleen were much enlarged. Anemia was extreme and there was this additional peculiarity: intermittent stomach pain occurring with the febrile crises. In conjunction with these conditions there was a manifestation of chorea symptoms involving face and shoulders mostly, the twitchings being troublesome in the inter febrile state. Often there were debilitating hysterical spasms, the heart became irritable and sometimes irregular. After other remedies had failed to make any impression, Cedr. cured in only three weeks, the improvement setting in immediately. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Lach., Bell. Antidote to: Lach. Compare: (1) Ars., Aran., Bell., (2)Cedr.removes roaringin ears of Chin. Bell, removes “Objects appear red at night, and yellowish by day” of Cedr., (3) Ars. and Sabad. - complaints return same hour every day. (4) Aran. - ague when chills predominates. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Nausea with distention of the stomach. Sensation as of a stone on stomach.

Rectum - Involuntary stool during chorea attack. Ineffectual urging.

Male - After sex, pain over left eye. Gonorrhea-like discharge, lasting three days. Gleet with formication over whole body. Desire with firm erections, all night, on waking.

Female - Many symptoms appear after sex and during the menses. Epilepsy during menses. Leucorrhea in place of menses. Ptyalism and leucorrhea after menses. Genital excitement at daybreak with discharge like leucorrhea and swollen breasts with pain. Puerperal eclampsia. Food - Longing for cold drinks in some, for warm in others. Great thirst during menses. Loss of appetite.

Chest - Oppression. Sharp, darting-cutting pains under floating ribs and scapula. Constitutions - Adapted to persons of an excitable nervous temperament, especially to females.

Heart - Palpitations and hurried breathing with headache. Irregular action. Pulse quick and full with animated, red face. Pulse uncountable.

Back - Stiff neck, pains all along spine. Pain in neck and loins on rising in morning. Pain under scapuli and in pelvis. Causations - Antidotes the effect of snakebites and stings of insects.

Limbs - Acute, sudden pain in ball of right thumb up arm to shoulder, same in right foot to knee, causing her to drop to the floor. Dropsy of knee joint. Sharp pain in joints, worse feet and hands. Pain in ball of right foot, extending to knee. Shingles with radiating pain. Lungs - Difficult respiration with partial loss of voice, recurring at different intervals. Suffocative fits recurring regularly every day 10 to 12 o'clock. Suffocating fits, worse after sex, sleep, better by eating. Troublesome cough every morning at six, lasting two hours. Respiration much affected after sex. Breath cold.

Sleep - Yawning and stretching. Drowsy, sometimes very profound sleep. Restless, frequent waking. Worse after sleep. Dreamed of pleasant social interviews with female acquaintances. Dreamed of quarreling with a dead sister and other dead friends, cried about it and awoke with sensation of a stone in the stomach.

Modalities - Better from standing erect. Worse periodically. Worse at the same hour. Worse open air. Worse before a storm. Worse lying down. Worse after sleep.

Teeth - Toothache every night during menses with bleeding gums. Sudden toothache in left upper molars. Sensation as if cold air touched the teeth on inspiration.

Kidneys - Pain in kidneys. Burning along ureter and in urethra. Feeling as if a drop of urine in urethra or a constant dripping from it.

Temperature - Malaria. Quotidian or tertian fever with marked regularity. Regular paroxysms of fever, coming at same hour, commencing every day 6 p.m. by chills in back and limbs or cold feet and hands. Excitement before chill. Chill with congestion to head, hands, feet and nose remain icy cold. Shivering and chill, followed by profuse perspiration every evening. During sweat, coldness and heat irregularly intermingle. Hot stage, dryness, heaviness of head, redness of face, burning heat in hands, pulse full and accelerated, thirst with desire for warm drinks.

PHARMACY - cem. Cement. Cement rock. The preparation for possible use is made by triturating a good cement withsugarofmilkon the decimal scale. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Eczema. Cement maker's itch. Itching.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cement maker's itch is an occupational disease, entirely distinct from ordinary itch, being neither parasitic nor contagious, but produced by the chemical or mechanical action of the cement upon the skin. Some physicians have attributed the corrosive action to calcium carbonate and to sulphuric acid. Fresh cement, however, does not contain carbonate. It is questioned whether slaked lime or even partly slaked lime will produce this effect. Masons working with lime mortar are seldom, if ever, attacked with cement maker's itch. The quantity of sulphuric acid in cement is very small. Cement maker's itch and ordinary itch have one symptom in common: intense itching, especially at night. The itching appears to be increased by the heat of the bed and also is more annoying in summer than in winter. Scratching may produce infected wounds and swelling. It is likely to be followed by eczema and other complications. The managers of cement works should always require their workmen to wear cotton gloves and garments tightly fastened at the neck and at the wrists. Cement workers on arches or ceilings should wear masks. Both gloves and masks should frequently be washed. REFERENCES - Anshutz.

HERBAL - The Centaurea are allied to the thistles. Dr. Chagon, Duc de Sorentino, experimented with the root of Cent.

HOMEOPATHIC - Marked symptoms of congestion. Blood surges painfully at every movement. The symptoms are worse at night, in the morning on waking, by movement, during and after urinating. Better by eating. COMMENTS - Allen reported a case in which a bright servant-girl who took it seemed stupefied for several days. The earliest symptoms appeared a quarter of an hour after taking the medicine, viz., those of the arms together with dull pains in the hypogastrium, shiverings and general heat, especially on forehead, which was covered with sweat. These were followed by a stupefying pain in temples, frontal protuberances orbital arches and eyes. Next came dimness of sight, appetite alternating with nausea, increase of salvia and vomiting, running of the nose, lachrymation, belchings, rapid sinking of strength, general uneasiness, confusion of mind, weariness, dull sunken eyes, spasmodic sweating, itching and pricking in the skin, drowsiness and thirst. A state of reaction after four or six hours brought some quiet. Next day, in the forenoon or towards evening, the above symptoms reappeared but with less violence and some of them assumed a periodic form. Then ensued coryza, colic, diarrhea, fevers of various types, pains in the arms, dry cough, etc. The action ended with the symptoms of catarrh of angina and of fever in the forenoon and with confusion and pain in the forehead. This gives a general idea of the action of this remedy. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bell., Cedr., Card-b., Card-m., Glon., Chin. REFERENCES - Clarke.

As needs of others seem predominant, one's own needs assume less importance and one's health and strength may be undermined slowly. Serving others may be a refuge for some, a binding up of one's identity with a positive attitude, a way to build self-esteem and find approval by others. CLINICAL - Abscesses. Biliousness. Boils. Carbuncles. Cough. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dysentery. Fever. Glands, enlarged. Glycosuria. Headache. Hemorrhage. Jaundice. Skin, diseases.

HERBAL - Telakucha is a perennial creeping herb with long tapering tuberous roots and deep green leaves. It is found to grow abundantly in a wild state in Bengal and in other parts of India. It possesses a smooth green fleshy fruit whose taste is very bitter. When the fruit becomes ripe its color becomes scarlet and its taste becomes sweet and it is sometimes eaten as a vegetable. It possesses the reputation of being an excellent remedy in reducing the amount of sugar in the urine of patients suffering from diabetes mellitus and mitigating their other sufferings. According to Dhanvantariya Nirghanta, it is a good medicine for fever, dropsy, hemorrhage of the stomach. Jaundice and flatulence. It suppresses urine. According to Rajnirghanta, it is bitter, cures cough and vomiting, excellent remedy for blood poisoning, arrests hemorrhage of the stomach. The Ayurvedic physicians of India use the extracted juice of the leaves to allay the burning pains of poisonous boils and carbuncles, and for general burning pains. It is also used by them in bloody dysentery and in biliousness. They also use it in diabetes mellitus.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Sarat Chandra Ghose, introduced this remedy to homeopathy and he conducted the first provings. He found Cephalandra indica an effective remedy for diabetes mellitus and insipidus. Over-sensitivity to noise and external impressions. Biliousness, bilious complaints. Septic boils, abscesses, and carbuncles. Burning pains all over the body, better cold applications. Profuse urination. Giddiness. Dysentery with white and bloody stools. Headache from excessive exposure under sun’s rays. Chronic fever associated with burning of eyes, face and other parts of body. Dropsy, jaundice, flatulence. Hemorrhage from the stomach. Blood poisoning. MIND - Moroseness. Fretfulness. Disinclination to do any work. Gloomy disposition. Could not remember all events, memory partially gone.

Head - Headache from excessive exposure under sun’s rays.

Eyes - Burning of eyes.

Face - Redness of face with burning. Food - Loss of appetite.

Mouth - Excessive dryness of mouth with great thirst for large quantities of water at a time, worse after urination. Lips dry and parched.

Throat - Dryness of throat. Vertigo - Giddiness, worse after urination. COMMENTS - Dr. Ghose reports the following case: Babu Satish Roy fell a victim of diabetes mellitus and suffered from this disease for two years. November 12,1928. Ghose was called in to see the patient this day in the morning. The following symptoms were present: Gloomy, morose and fretful. Lost weight steadily. Passed large quantities of urine every now and then which exhausted him greatly. Urine was examined and the tests show that there was sugar in the urine, quantity being 20 grains per ounce. Great thirst was present. Burning sensation was present all over the body. Dryness of mouth and throat was present. Ghose prescribed Cephalandra indica lx to be taken thrice daily. Now 18, 1928. He saw the patient again this morning, and heard from him that he was faring much better than before. Passed urine not so often as before, burning sensation and thirst were considerably less than before; cheerfulness returned and he was feeling stronger than before. Prescribed the same medicine in the same potency twice daily. Asked him to get his urine examined again. Nov. 28,1928. Ghose saw him this morning, The urine examination report indicated that sugar had lessened, quantity being 4 grains per ounce. Burning sensation and thirst practically disappeared. The same prescription was repeated. Dec. 10,1928. The report of urine examination indicated that there was no sugar in the urine. In other respects the patient was all right. Ghose advised him to take occasional doses of Cephalandra indica in 3x potency. The patient made an eventful recovery and no sugar could be found in his urine later on. RELATIONS - Compare: Uran-n., Phos. REFERENCES - Ghose.

Rectum - Greenish, mucus stools mixed or tinged with blood. Pain before and during stool. White and bloody stools. Sensations - Burning sensation exists all over the body, ameliorated by anything cold or cold applications.

Skin - Sickly, yellow skin was marked.

Kidneys - Passage of copious quantity of urine at a time, clear urine, exhaustion and weakness after urination. Glycosuria. Presence of sugar in urine. Modalites - Better by cold or cold applications. Worse after urination.
