HOMEOPATHIC - Cicuta virosa is one of the most active of the poisonous umbelliferae. Chiefly acts on the brain, medulla oblongata, nervous system, the gastro-intestinal tract, and the skin. The action producing spasmodic affections including hiccough, trismus, tetanus and convulsions, and locked jaws. Violent general action with frightful distortions. Bending of the head, neck and spine backwards. Strange desires. Moaning and howling. Does absurd things. Sensation of internal chill. Dilated pupils. Shocks from head down body. Face bluish. Froths at mouth. Bites the tongue. Violent spasmodic effects. Great agitation. Frightful contortions. Epilepsy. Gesticulations, odd motions. “Jerking of the left arm all day.” Tremor when touched. Trembling palpitations. Spasms of diaphragm, hic- cough of gullet. Spasms move downwards with terrific violence with sudden shocks through body or head. “Head turned or twisted to one side”in convulsions. Convulsions followed by sudden rigidity, shrieks, then jerks and violent distortions, then prolonged unconsciousness. Utter prostration follows the convulsive attacks. Opisthotonos and frightful facial distortions. Bloody foam from the mouth. Muscles become rigid. Catalepsy. Tearing, jerking in coccyx. Spasms are renewed by touch, by noise, loud talking. . Falls and the effects of concussions. Convergent strabismus from fall or blow. Concussion of brain. Cerebro-spinal meningitis. Sleeps and weeps on being aroused, distorts facial muscles and stares vacantly. Troubles arising from shaving. Marked action on the skin. Hungry immediately after a meal. MIND - Dullness after injuries of head. Anxiety about future. Excitement and apprehension about future. Excessively affected by sad stories. Horrible things, sad stories affect her profoundly. Sad when seeing others happy. Worse from fright (Op., Ig.). Fright can cause epilepsy. Suspicious. Mistrustful, shuns men. Aversion to presence of strangers. Despises others. Aversion to company. Desires to be alone during menses. Contemptuous. Melancholy with indifference. Sadness after concussion of brain. Does notremember what has happened, does not recognize anybody but answers well. Feels as if he was in a strange place. Everything appears strange and terrible. Avoids the sight of people. Confounds present with the past, feels like a child. Memory blank, for hours or days. Thinking of complaints helps. Falls to ground and rolls about with or without convulsions. Moaning, howling and weeping. Epilepsy with moaning and whining. Stupefaction between convulsions. Shrieking before convulsions. Delirium with gestures. Mania with dancing, laughing and ridiculous gestures. Sings, dances, shouts. Violent. Impulsive. Rash behavior. Childish behavior. Hallucinations and convulsions after typhoid.

Head - Headache on waking in morning. Convulsions from concussion of brain. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Head turned or twisted to one side. Congestion of head with vomiting and purging. Head retracted, spine rigid. Neck muscles are contracted. Headache alternating with pain in abdomen. Head symptoms relieved by emission of flatus. Cerebrospinal meningitis. One-sided headache, stupefying, as from a rush of blood, better sitting erect. Cerebral diseases following suppressed eruptions. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Jerks the head. Thick, yellow scabs on head. Sweat during sleep.

Eyes - Pupils dilated in concussion of the brain, contracted in spasms. Strabismus, periodic, spasmodic after a fall or blow. Eyelids twitch. Spasmodic disorders of eyes. Eyes roll, jerk and stare. Stares persistently at objects. Objects recede, approach and seem double, black. Letters go up and down or disappear, when reading. Effects of exposure to snow.

Ears - Ears hot or cold. Earache caused by filling teeth with gold. Hemorrhage from ears. Sore behind ear as after a blow. Suppurating, burning eruption on and about ears. Oversensitiveness of hearing. Difficult hearing. Doesn't hear well unless one speaks loudly to her, and she pays attention. Sudden detonation, especially on swallowing. Roaring noises in ears.

Nose - Slight touch causes it to bleed. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Nostrils seem stopped. Nostrils ulcerated, with yellow, purulent discharge from nose.

Face - Ashy paleness of face, during convulsions. Flushed face, with headache and restless sleep. Red or pale face and drawn, sweaty. Face is distorted horrible or ridiculously. Trismus, disposition to grind teeth. Lockjaw. Twitching of facial muscles. Faceache caused by filling teeth with gold. Pustules which run together forming thick, yellow scabs on face and head. Dark red pimples on face. Epithelioma of lips. Painful ulcers on lips.

Mouth - Foam in and around mouth. Swelling of the tongue, speech difficult. Bites the tongue. Grinding of the teeth with lockjaw. Water brash, saliva flows from mouth with heat all over. Thirst, burning pressure. White, painful, burning ulcers on edges of tongue, painful to touch. Tongue coated, dry. Speech difficul. Stuttering. Couldn't speak from having no control over movements of tongue and mouth. Speechlessness from wounded esophagus. Speechlessness in cerebrospinal meningitis.

Throat - Effects of swallowing sharp fish bones. Dry. Feels as if grown together. Spasms of esophagus, cannot swallow from injury of fish bone etc. Stricture of esophagus. Strangling on attempting to swallow. Danger of suffocation from swallowing sharp pieces of bone. Choking on attempting to examine the throat. Constriction of esophagus from intestinal irritation. Constriction with spasmodic contraction of muscles of neck, almost like tetanus. Vertigo - Vertigo with stomach pain and muscular spasms. Objects move from side to side or approach and recede. Vertigo with desire to hold on to something when standing still. Vertigo with reeling, falling to the ground. Vertigo on stooping. Vertigo after injuries to head. Vertigo on rising from bed. Vision - Momentary loss of vision. Frequent vanishing of sight. Letters disappear or go up and down. Colors of rainbow around letters. Letters seem to turn when reading. Objects appear black. Objects vacillate. Diplopia. Iris-like circles around candle. Can scarcely see in sunlight. COMMENTS - Characteristic twitching and spasmodic jerks. “Bending the head back- wrd.”Useful forresidue from a trauma that included convulsions, or if current treatment masks residue symptoms. Convulsions, epilepsy, severe neck and spinal trauma, head injuries. Keynote arching of the back. Epilepsy, spasms, trauma cases, or spinal diseases with severe back spasms. Contortions of the body. The body takes on strange postures and contortions of the limbs. Chorea (Caust.), involuntary contractions, jerking, and rigidity of the limbs. Mania, dancing, singing, grotesque postures (Hyos.). Moans and howls with great agitation, makes gesticulations, odd motions, head turned or twisted to one side. Cataleptic after contortions, no recall of the attack, tranquil feeling (Op.). Utter prostration after the convulsions. Drug overdoses with convulsions, paralysis, respiratory failure, twitching and jerking of the limbs. Cerebrospinal meningitis, the opisthotonos being the leading indication. Meningitis, where the neck goes back, eyes are glassy and body is twitching and jerking with spasms and a high fever (Bell, without the flushed face). Delirium in meningitis, pupils are fixed and staring. Tetanus (Hyper., Led.), with violent spasms and severe lockjaw. Usually later stages of clinical tetanus. Head injuries that cause visual disturbances, twitchings of the eyes, double vision. Lazy eye, strabismus. Eclampsia, toxemia. Convulsions during pregnancy. Convulsions due to uremia, too much uric acid in the blood or kidney failure. Strange desires, such as to eat coal. Marked action on the skin, including the eruption of pustules which run together with yellowish honey-colored scabs, especially about mouth and matting the whiskers. Epithelioma, growths covered with honeycolored scabs. Nash cured eczema capitis in a young woman with Cic. Her whole scalp was covered as with a solid cap. Grimmer used it for cancers of the skin, epithelioma, convulsive violence as in cerebrospinal meningitis. Also in opisthotonos, strabismus, violent spasmodic jerks, paralysis, especially of the bladder, stricture of the esophagus. Teste mentioned the case of a woman of 58 who ceased to menstruate at 30 in consequence of a fright, and who was of “robust constitution, irritable, nervous and excessively fanciful and odd.” She had a chronic swelling of the left ovary. Cic. had a remarkably quieting effect for several weeks, and during that time the swelling diminished considerably. The patient had to leave Paris, so the treatment could not be followed up. Dr. H. Von Musits treated a case of acute meningitis in J. N. R., 43, male, married, a user of alcohol and tobacco, bookkeeper. After the intense summer heat, symptoms developed including convulsions, distortion of limbs, head turned backward. Trismus. Froth from mouth. Biting of the tongue. Oppression of breathing. Entire loss of consciousness and of power of swallowing. Convulsions, followed by complete exhaustion. Stupor. Swelling of face. Inability to move the tongue. The whole body seems to be of enormous size. The patient had three convulsions during twenty-four hours, followed by the swelling of the tongue and body. Extreme trembling of the hands. Articulation difficult. Next day, profuse watery diarrhea stools, worse by any noise, sudden entrance of any person into the room or loud talking. Better by rest and in a dark room. Several times previously he had symptoms of nervous exhaustion. His brother, a physician, died the previous spring from paresis in consequence of excessive use of alcohol and drugging. After two doses of Cic. 200c there were no more convulsions and the patient was perfectly cured in two weeks. There was no relapse. Banerjee recorded the case of “A lad, aged five years, had an attack of cholera three days before my visit. Had been treated by a homeopath from beginning of attack. The patient was suffering from convulsions, when I first saw him on the fourth day. The convulsive fits were very severe since the third day of the attack of cholera. “The symptoms were: eyes half turned, head drawn toward the left side and the hands and feet of the same side were contracted. He was given Bell., Hyos., Cina and Bryonia without effect. Cicuta virosa was then given. The first dose mitigated the severity of the fits, the second dose put the child to sleep and thus he was saved from imminent death.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Am., Op., for massive doses tobacco. Antidote to: Opium. Compare: (1) Cicuta maculata. (2) Con., En- anth., Stry., Bell. (3) Con., Aeth., Oena. Croc., Hyper. - spinal concussion, Hyos. - twitchings. Hell, Hydr-ac. - body thrown back, cramps in neck. (4) Nux-v. and Stry. - tetanus, but with Nux-v. there is not the utter prostration and great oppression of breathing of Cie., Nux-v. is less epileptiform and has more excitability. Compatible after: Lach after Ars. and Con. (Cancer of lip), Cupr. (Aphasia in chorea). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Burning heat in stomach. Hiccoughs. Loud hiccough with crying, alternating with thoracic spasms. Indigestion, with insensibility, frothing at mouth. Vomiting of bile of blood on stooping, on rising in pregnancy. Throbbing in pit of the stomach with distention. Pains with vomiting, painful distension of abdomen and spasm of pectoral muscles. Vomiting during convulsions. Vomit yellow, like mucus. Vomiting during headache.

Abdomen - Distended and painful. Rumbling in abdomen. Flatulence with anxiety and crossness. Colic with convulsions with vomiting. Heat and burning in abdomen. Sudden, sharp, pains from navel extending to neck of bladder. Tearing pain deep in abdomen. Observed: Flatulence with anxiety and crossness. Rumbling in abdomen. Distended and painful. Chronic painful hernia. Back - Spasms and cramps in muscles of neck. The head drawn backwards. Opisthotonos. Back bent backward like an arch. Muscles of neck contract and become hard as wood. Weakness in muscles of back after standing only a short time. Jerking, tearing in coccyx, especially during menses. Right scapula as if bruised. Neuralgia at nape with dull occipital headache. Causations - Bad effects from falls, blows and concussions. Tetanus. Splinters in flesh.

Rectum - Diarrhea in morning with irresistible desire to urinate. Itching in rectum with burning pain after rubbing. Diarrheic stool followed by constipation. Prolapsed rectum. Frequent liquid stools. Cholera when purging ceases, and congestion to brain and chest. Desire to urinate after stool. Stools thin, slimy. Stools expelled suddenly, sudden urging. Scarcely able to retain stool.

Male - Testes drawn up towards external abdominal rings. Sharp pains in fossa navicularis, with nightly emissions. Sore, drawing pains in urethra, as far as glans, obliging one to urinate. Pollutions without lascivious dreams.

Female - Spasmodic states when menses do not appear. Coccyx painful during menses. Puerperal convulsions. Eclampsia during childbirth. Convulsions during pregnancy, delivery. Food - Inability to distinguish between edible and inedible. Stomachache, sleepiness, feel satisfied immediately after eating. Great hunger soon after a meal. Craves coal, chalk and many other strange articles. Longing for wine. Thirst, extreme, with convulsions.

Chest - Chest feels tight, can hardly breathe. Heat or cold sensation in chest. Tonic spasm in pectoral muscles. Sensations as if something the size of a fist was lodged in chest and throat. Lower end of sternum as if sore or bruised, when walking. Constitutions - Suited to nervous elderly people and children.

Heart - Trembling palpitations of the heart. Feels as if the heart stopped beating with faint feeling. Heart's action weak. Rapid pulse. Pulse weak, slow, at times imperceptible.

Limbs - Curved limbs which cannot be straightened, nor straight ones bent. Jerking and twitching in the arms and fingers. Jerking in left arm all day. Cramps and spasms. Trembling of left leg. Feet turned inward and toes turned upwards in spasms, while walking. Swings feet in half circle while walking. Forearms and legs as if bruised. Complete powerlessness of limbs after sudden jerks. Great weakness in arms and legs, after slight exertion. Rigid limbs. Trembling in upper and lower limbs. Cold limbs. Lungs - Oppressed, can scarcely breathe, may arise from tonic spasm of pectoral muscles. Snoring. Interrupted, in spells. Want of breath the whole day. Difficult, chest feels too tight. Suspended, at times gasping.

Sleep - Complete sleeplessness in hysterical spasms. Frequent waking, with sweat all over, from which he feels refreshed. Bites the tongue in sleep. Starting during sleep. Deep sleep. Dreams vivid, but not remembered. Vivid dreams about events of previous day. Nightmares after movies and sad stories. Nightmares of people being mutilated, attacked, tortured.

Skin - Eczema, no itching, exudation forms into a/¡art/, lemon-colored crust. Pustules coalesce into thick, yellow massive scabs, worse head and face. Suppressed eruption causes brain disease. Elevated eruptions, as large as peas. Barber's, baker's itch. Red vesicles on right scapula, painful to touch. Burning, itching of skin over whole body. Impetigo, honeycomb-like crusts, which fall off and leave a bright red smooth surface.

Modalities - Better from thinking of pain. Better warmth. Worse from concussions. Worse from injury to brain and spine. Worse turning the head. Worse from cold, drafts. Worse tobacco smoke. Worse jar. Worse noise. Worse slightest touch. Worse dentition. Worse suppressed eruptions. Worse from worms. Worse from splinters in flesh. Worse turning the head.

Teeth - Toothache caused by filling teeth with gold. Grinding of teeth with pressing of jaws together like lockjaw.

Kidneys - Involuntary urination in old men. Urine is passed with great force. Stricture of urethra after inflammation, gonorrhea. Paralysis of bladder with great anxiety about it. Passes large quantities of urine or else none at all.

Perspiration - Sweats at night and in morning. Sweats on abdomen. Profuse sweats at night, without being able to sleep.

Temperature - Chilliness, constant desire to be near a warm stove. Chill starts in chest and runs down legs and into arms with staring look. Cold internally and externally. Typhoid fever. Nervous fever, characterized by great stupidity. Worm fevers in children, with colic and convulsions.

name: Cimex Lectularius
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse motion. Worse stretching or extending the part. Worse in morning. Worse from drinking. Weariness compels to lie down. Pain in small of back worse sitting. Sweat on nose during rest in morning..
constitution: Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain. Muscle, contractions. Seminal, emissions. Skin, disorders. Tendons, disorders. Yawning.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cimx. Cimex lectularius. Bedbug. Acanthia lectularia. N. O. Hemiptera. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain.…
full:
PHARMACY - cimx. Cimex lectularius. Bedbug. Acanthia lectularia. N. O. Hemiptera. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain. Muscle, contractions. Seminal, emissions. Skin, disorders. Tendons, disorders. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cimex is an ancient remedy for intermittent fever. Nash recorded the following cure by Dr. BrewsterofSyracuse. After driving a fractious horse that tried to run away over a very rough road, a man was so bruised and sprained about the buttocks and legs that he was confined to the house for a long time. It settled finally into what appeared likely to be permanent contraction of the lower limbs. No remedy relieved until Dr. Brewster remembered a case of intermittent fever that he had cured twenty years before, being guided by this symptom. Cimex 600c (Jenichen) promptly cured. Characteristic weariness and inclination to stretch. The flexors are most affected, pains in all joints as if tendons were contracted and too short, every motion or stretching of arms or legs causes tightening pain in them. Hamstrings feel too short (Am-m.). Sensation of retraction of arm tendons. The whole right side is especially affected. MIND - Anxiety, after chill. Clenching of hands with violent rage at beginning of chill. Sensation as if he could creep into himself and on that account could not sufficiently crouch together. His own sweat is disgusting to him. Abdomen - Pain in the liver, as if it had been strained by bending the right side inward, the spot is painful when touching it or coughing. Colic, followed by emissions of flatulence or liquid stools.

Head - Confusion of head as if headache would ensue. Pain like needle stitches in vertex with cough. Pain under right frontal bone. Violent headache, caused by drinking. Great rage, vehement at beginning of chilly stage. Would like to tear everything to pieces. Sweating on head, nose and chest.

Nose - Annoying dryness of nostrils. Fluent coryza with pressure in frontal sinuses. Constant sneezing in forenoon. Sweat on nose, morning during rest.

Mouth - Tongue coated white. Swollen feeling of the tongue. Feeling as if burnt on the tongue in the region of the palate and the upper anterior gums.

Throat - Dryness, causing him to drink all day. Esophagus becomes constricted during the hot stage. COMMENTS - Tertian and quartan intermittents. Musty smelling sweats. Night-sweats. Heat with gagging, esophagus feels constricted. Before chill, thirst and heaviness in legs, less thirst with chill, still less with dry heat, none with sweat. Chill commences with clenching of hands and violent raging. Pains in all joints as if tendons contracted during chill. Sensation as of a cold wind blowing on knees. After the chill, thirst, but drinking causes violent headache, tickling in larynx causing dry, continuous cough. Gagging and belching at end of cough. Urging to stool. Hard stool, in small balls. Discharges of a small piece of white stool, then rectum closes firmly. Stools with hemorrhoidal sufferings. Incontinence of urine. Hot urine, brown or red sediment. Urticarious eruption. Irresistible sleepiness. Frequent yawning. Frequent erections in morning, seminal emissions. A. W. K. Choudhury related a case of intermittent (quotidian) cured with Cimex 30c, the chiefindicationsbeing: “Chill slight, thirst some days, none other days, shiverings, passed water twice during chill, chill worse by lying down increase of cough if he drinks water during chill.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 )Nat-m. - headache lessens in the sweating stage. (2) Ars. - headache remains or increases in the sweating stage. (3) Bell. - throbbing of the head in intermittents. (4) Ars. and Bry. - gagging at end of cough. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Sour belchings.

Rectum - Constipation, feces dry, hard, and in small balls (Op., Plum., Thuj.). Rectal ulcer.

Stool - Stools hard, in small balls. After the discharge of a small piece of white stool, the rectum closes firmly. Stools with hemorrhoidal sufferings.

Female - Shooting pain from vagina up towards left ovary.

Chest - Chest feels oppressed during chill. After chill, heaviness in chest, anxiety.

Heart - Pulse feeble, intermitting.

Back - Pain in the small of the back, extending over the abdomen with distention of the abdomen, worse when sitting. Weariness in loins, must sit down.

Limbs - Hamstrings feel too short, knees flexed, attempting to stretch them causes pain in thighs. Pains in all joints, as if tendons were too short, especially knee joints. Knees feel cold, as from a cold wind. Pain in right shoulder and the anterior muscles of the chest, extending through the whole arm down to the nails, the fingers feel as if they had gone to sleep. Lungs - Dry cough with gagging, as if he would vomit with perspiration. Breathing oppressed after chill.

Sleep - Great drowsiness, falls asleep when sitting in the morning. Irresistible sleepiness during chill. Frequent yawning with cold feeling on skin.

Modalities - Worse motion. Worse stretching or extending the part. Worse in morning. Worse from drinking. Weariness compels to lie down. Pain in small of back worse sitting. Sweat on nose during rest in morning.

Kidneys - Urine brown with a deposit of sediment (during the fever, when he drinks).

Temperature - Chilliness of whole body, worse lying down. Thirst during apyrexia, but little during chilly stage, still less during hot stage and none during sweating. Before the cold stage, thirst, heaviness in the lower limbs. At the beginning of the chill, clenching of the hands and violent rage. The perspiration after the hot stage is accompanied by hunger. Perspiration mostly on the head and chest. Musty offensive sweat. During the intermittent fever, constipation, stools dry.

name: Cimicifuga Racemosa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from warm wraps. Better open air. Better continued motion. Better pressure. Better grasping things. Better rest, and eating. Worse from damp, cold air. Worse change of weather. Worse heat and cold, draft. Worse alcohol, especially wine. Worse from motion. Worse sitting. Worse puberty. Worse during menses, labor, menopause. Worse emotions. Worse in the morning, and at night (malar neuralgia better at night). Pains in arms and Achilles tendon worse as evening approaches..
constitution: Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Faintness. Fevers. Gout. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hot, flashes. Hysteria. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Melancholy. Meningitis. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Neura
keynote: PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Faintness. Fevers. Gout. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hot, flashes. Hysteria. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Melancholy. Meningitis. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Neuralgia. Ovaries, disorders. Perichondritis. Pleurodynia. Pregnancy, disorders. Puerperal, fever. Puerperal, mania. Rheumatism. Sciatica, pains. Sleeplessness. Spinal irritation. Stiff-neck. Tinnitus. Tremors. Uterus, disorders. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Wide action upon the cerebrospinal and muscular system, as well as upon the uterus and ovaries. The generative organs in the female are particularly affected. Uterine and ovarian pains are very marked. Infra-breast pains. Tenderness of the uterine region. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Left ovarian pains. Leucorrhea with feeling of weight in uterus. Painful and irregular menses. Menses with backache, nervousness, irregular in time and amount, more flow, more pain. Labor-like pains. Displaced labor pains to hips, thighs or back. Pains are violent, aching, shooting, wander here and there. Compressive pains. Pains like electric shocks, with cries, faints etc. Pains go upwards or side to side, up the neck, about the throat from ovary to ovary. Belly of the muscles feel bruised, sore, heavy aching. Muscular andcrampypains, primarily of neurotic origin, occurring in nearly every part of the body. Sore and tender along the tract of pain. Trembling, twitching in various organs or of part lain on. Alternating clonic and tonic spasms. Nervous shuddering. Spasms of cerebro-spinal fever. Chorea, at puberty with delayed menses, cardiac. Hysterical and epileptic convulsions at the time of menses. Agitation. General sick feeling with exhaustion. Many of the symptoms are irregular, changeful or they alternate in groups, alternation of physical and mental effects. Alternate mental and rheumatic symptoms. Symptoms referable to the pelvic organs prominent. Lumbago. Muscle pain. Useful in rheumatic, nervous subjects with ovarian irritation, uterine cramps and heavy limbs. Children during dentition. Influenza. Cold air seems to penetrate the system, very sensitive to it. Headache is better in open air, worse in warm room. Migraine. MIND - Melanchol y. Depression with low spirits and exhaustion. Gloom and dejection, as if there was a black cloud over everything. Forebodings of death, insanity, impending evil etc. Fear of death. Fear of riding in a closed carriage. Fear that those in house will kill him. Fear of rats. Thinks she is going crazy. Vision of rats, mice, various colors and forms. Nervous, fidgety, excitable and jerky. Incessant talking, changing from one subject to another, as in delirium tremens (Lach.). Desire to wander from place to place. Hysteria. Mania, before menses. Mania, alcoholic, tries to injure himself. Puerperal mania, following disappearance of neuralgias. Weak will. Indifferent. Suspicious. Oversensitive, especially for pain. Hypochondriasis. Sits and mopes in great sadness, when questioned breaks into tears. Mental symptoms are better by diarrhea or menses, worse after rheumatism.

Head - Waving or wild sensation in brain. Head retracted (meningitis). Opening and shutting sensation in brain. Brain feels too large. Shooting, throbbing pains, headache after mental worry, over-study or from reflex uterine disease, better open air. Pressing outward pain. Feeling as of a blow or as if a bolt has been driven from occiput to vertex up to the eyes (left).

Eyes - Eyes feel big, wild look. Asthenopia associated with pelvic trouble. Deep- seated throbbing and shooting pains in eyes. Intense aching in eyeballs or behind them, better pressure, worse slightest motion. Pain from eyes to vertex. Ciliary neuralgia. As if a needle were run into the eyeballs, worse closing eyes. Photophobia from artificial light. Sees red flashes with dark borders.

Ears - Tinnitus. Sensitive to least noise with spasmodic labor pains. Violent noises in ear with deafness.

Nose - Sensitive to cold air, every inhalation seems to bring the cold air in contact with the brain.

Face - Pale, hot. Wild, fearful expression. Neuralgia affecting malar bones, better night, reappears the next day. Facial blemishes in young women. Forehead feels cold.

Mouth - Saliva thick. Coppery taste. Hawks up viscid coppery tasting mucus. Thick mucus on teeth. Cannot speak a word though she tries. Tongue and mouth feel warm. Tongue pointed and trembling, swollen.

Throat - Burning. Thyroid aches before menses. COMMENTS - Frontal, vertical or occipital headache, accompanied by great pain in the eyeballs, better pressure, worse slightest motion. Headache with a feeling as if going crazy. Headaches reflected from pelvic organs. Depression as if a black cloud has settled over them. Rheumatism affecting the vertebral joints and especially in the neck. Cerebrospinal meningitis, head and neck retracted. Clarke found a pain at the nape of the neck very characteristic. Sciatica with sharp, shooting pains down the limbs with back spasms. Hip and lum- . bosacral problems that affect uterus and other organs (Aesc.). Back spasms from injury to the spine (Mag-p.). Arthritis that came on with menopause, large joints (small joints, Caul.). Pains in the joints and limbs. Pains like electric shocks, here and there, sharp in various parts, chest and uterine pains shoot Cimicifuga racemosa from side to side. A general bruised feeling all over as if sore, worse by touch. Malar neuralgia, ceasing at night. Bad taste and breath. Coated tongue, sticky saliva, viscid mucus in throat. Disordered digestion. Marked sinking at epigastrium. Dry, teasing cough, worse at night and from every attempt to speak. Sharp pains in the heart and chest. Pains down left arm, which is numb (Aeon., Puls., Rhus-t.), as if bound to the side. Palpitation from the least motion. Heartbeat ceases suddenly. Premenstrual syndrome with cramps. Backache with painful menses, muscle spasms in the back with the period. Pain in the hip with menstrual cramps, hip can lock up. Symptoms worse during the period. Depression with menses. Menopausal depression. Painful prolapse of the uterus with cramps, spasms, backaches and hip aches, because pelvis is out of alignment (Sep. has prolapse due to weakness and lack of tone). Labor pains felt in the back or thighs. Muscle contractions in their thighs with labor pains, or they feel as if their back will break (Kali-c., Cham.). Puerperal mania. According to Lippe a characteristic indication is: “The recently delivered uterus becomes actually jammed in the pelvis with great pain.” Cimic. should be given in daily doses in low lx potency two months before term, when indicated. It ensures living births in women who have previously borne only dead children without any discoverable cause. If given before the term, it renders labor easier, cures sickness of pregnancy, and prevents the after pains. In cases of tinnitus aurium it has proved curative in old-school practice in 15 to 30 drops of the tincture, whether due to direct or reflex irritation. Clarke greatly relieved an inveterate case of epilepsy in which the aura was a “waving sensation in the brain,” which is a leading symptom of the remedy. A patient who was taking 6-drop doses of the tincture complained of a feeling as if his heart had stopped. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rham-cal. - muscular pains, lumbago, pleurodynia, acute rheumatism. (2) Derris pinnata - neuralgic headachesof rheumatic origin. (3) Aristolochia milhom. - pain in achilles tendon, diabetes. Caul., Puls., Lil-t., Agar. (4) Macrotin - especially for lumbago. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sinking in the epigastrium (Sep., Sulph. ). Gnawing pain .Nausea and vomiting from pressure on spine and cervical region, pregnancy, alcohol. Vomits green substance, groans, raves and presses the head with both the hands for relief. Belch- ings with nausea, vomiting and headache.

Abdomen - Colic better bending double and after stools. Sharp pains across hy- pogastrium.

Rectum - Frequent thin, dark offensive stools. Alternate diarrhea and constipation. Morning diarrhea of children. Sensations - As of lifting up of skull, as if top of head would fly off, as of a bolt through from base of skull to vertex. Inspired air seems to penetrate skull and into brain, causing a cold sensation. Intense pain in and around the eyes (lancinating), worse moving head or eyes.

Female - Menses are profuse, dark, coagulated, scanty with backache, nervousness, irregular in time and amount, more flow, more pain. Menses suppressed from emotions, cold. Hysteric or epileptic spasms at the time of menses. Great debility between menses. Amenorrhea. Leucorrhea with a sensation of weight in the uterus. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Ovarian neuralgia, pain across pelvis from ovary to ovary or goes upwards or downwards along the thighs. Uterine atony. Mania. Slow labor pains with nervous shivers. Puerperal fever. After-pains with great sensitiveness and intolerance to pain. worse in groins. Lochia suppressed by cold or emotions. Food - No thirst, slight feeling of hunger in stomach, rumbling in abdomen. Great thirst. Appetite variable. No appetite for dinner, wants to drink cold water, little at a time suffices.

Chest - Intercostal rheumatism. Sharp stitches in left chest, motion exhorting cries. Left-sided infra-breast pain. Pleurodynia. Constitutions - Suited to the menopausal period, to nervous persons, to children during dentition, diarrhea. Nervousness from anxiety or overexertion. Rheumatic persons. Plump, delicate, sensitive, nervous, chilly women who coinplain of aching pain in back, neck, here and there. Many of the complaints are dependent upon uterine or ovarian irritation.

Heart - Heart's action ceases suddenly, impending suffocation. Sore, as if swollen or enlarged. Pulse weak, irregular, trembling, drops every third or fourth beat. Tremulous action. Numbness of left arm. feels as if bound to side. Needle-like pains at heart. Angina pectoris, pain spreads all over the chest to the back and down the left arm which feels numb and as if bound to the side. Cardiac neuralgia in childbirth.

Back - Rheumatic pains in muscles of back and neck. Stiffness and contraction in neckandback. Stiff neck, sensitive, worse pain or pressure, causes nausea and retching. Neck aches, throws the head back. Pain in the angle of left scapula. Spine very sensitive, especially upper part. Pain in lumbar and sacral region, down thighs and through hips. Crick in back. Breasts - Burning in breasts. Infra-breast pains, worse left side. Presses breasts as though in pain. Causations - Ill effects of anxiety, fright, disappointed love, overexertion, business failures, or childbirth.

Limbs - Alternation of rheumatic and mental symptoms. Uneasy and restless feeling in the limbs. Chorea movements, accompanied by rheumatism. Rheumatism affecting the belly of muscles, especially large muscles. Aching in limbs and muscular soreness. Jerking of limbs. Numbness of limbs. Cramps. Left arm feels as if bound to the side, constant irregular motion of left arm (chorea). Hands tremble while writing. Cold sweat on hands and feet. Soles itching. Cramps in calves. Stiffness and contracted Achilles tendon. Trembling of legs, can scarcely walk. Lungs - Tickling, short, dry, constant cough worse at night, speaking. Cough when secretion is scanty- spasmodic, dry, with muscular soreness and nervous irritation. Nervous cough.

Sleep - Sleeplessness. Sleeps with arms overhead or yawning. Comatose, as if drunk. Brain irritation of children during dentition.

Skin - Locally and internally for ivy poisoning.

Modalities - Better from warm wraps. Better open air. Better continued motion. Better pressure. Better grasping things. Better rest, and eating. Worse from damp, cold air. Worse change of weather. Worse heat and cold, draft. Worse alcohol, especially wine. Worse from motion. Worse sitting. Worse puberty. Worse during menses, labor, menopause. Worse emotions. Worse in the morning, and at night (malar neuralgia better at night). Pains in arms and Achilles tendon worse as evening approaches.

Kidneys - Profuse clear urine, causing weakness, with yellow sand. Nervous urination.

name: Cina Maritima
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind..
constitution: Abdomen, distended. Anemia. Anal, itching. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Borborygmi. Cachexia. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Eyes, disorders. Grinding, teeth. Headaches. Hiccough. Hydrocephaloid. Hypoglycemia. Indigestion. Intermittent, fever. Itching. Leucorrhea. Malassimilation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Paraplegia. Parasites
keynote:
PHARMACY - ciña. Cina maritima. Wormseed. Cinaartemisia. Artemisia maritima. Artemisia cintra. Semen cine. Flores cine. Tartarian southernwood. N. O. Composite. Tincture. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL -…
full:
PHARMACY - ciña. Cina maritima. Wormseed. Cinaartemisia. Artemisia maritima. Artemisia cintra. Semen cine. Flores cine. Tartarian southernwood. N. O. Composite. Tincture. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, distended. Anemia. Anal, itching. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Borborygmi. Cachexia. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Eyes, disorders. Grinding, teeth. Headaches. Hiccough. Hydrocephaloid. Hypoglycemia. Indigestion. Intermittent, fever. Itching. Leucorrhea. Malassimilation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Paraplegia. Parasites. Pinworms. Remittent, fever. Roundworms. Scarlatina. Spasms. Strabismus. Threadworms. Twitch- ings. Urine, milky. Vision, disorders. Vomiting. Whooping cough. Worms.

HERBAL - This remedy is a preparation of Artemisia cintra, Tartarian southernwood or wormseed. The Artemisiae held a prominent place among the drugs of the ancient physicians from Hippocrates to Serapion. They were recommended as febrifuge, stomachic and anthelmintic. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin which has a very strong anti-helminthic action. Cina is a powerful remedy for the elimination of round worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cina is preeminently a worm remedy, as it causes all the symptoms which characterize worm infestation, both mental, nervous and bodily. It corresponds more to the effects of lumbrici then to those of other worms. Reflex symptoms from abdominal irritation. Extreme sensitiveness of mind and body : offended by the slightest thing, peevish and obstinate, aversion to be caressed. Child cannot bear to have hair combed or brushed. Irritation of the nose, causing constant desire to rub, prick or press into it. Grinding teeth during sleep. Restless sleep, tossing all about the bed. Child lies on belly or on hands and knees during sleep. Nocturnal bedwetting, urine white, turbid, at times fetid. Over-sensitiveness of skin, cannot endure to be approached touched or pressed upon. Whole body is painfully sore to motion and touch, bruised soreness. Hair is sensitive to touch. Touch induces or aggravates spasms. Twitching, spasms. Convulsions with screams and violent jerkings of the hands and feet. Convulsions with consciousness. Chorea. Unilateral. Children throw arms from side to side during spasms. Paraplegia with unnatural hunger. Variable appetite. Greater the hunger, greater the emaciation. Scrofulous. Sour smell of body especially children. Children during dentition. Pain comes in shocks. Jumps suddenly as though he felt pain. Trembling with shivering, when yawning. Complaints concomitant to yawning, which comes on whenever someone yawns. MIND - Extreme ill-humor and naughtiness in children. Wants to be carried, but carrying gives no relief. Wants to be rocked. Irritability better rocking fast. Very touchy, irritable, petulant and dissatisfied. Child is very cross, does not want to be touched or carried. WardZop/ease. Desires many things, but rejects everything offered. Nervous. Child can't be quieted. Irritability of temper. Irritability during dentition. Violent screaming attacks at night. Child lying on the back and striking and kicking with hands and feet. Screaming, striking and biting. Nothing pleases them for any length of time. Crying out as if in delirium. Morose in daytime. Indisposition to play, in children. Convulsions in children when they are scolded or punished. Dislike of strangers (Bar-c.). Indifference to caresses. Worse if being looked at (Ant-t.). Unreal feeling of having done something wrong, abnormal consciousness. Unconscious with frothing at mouth. Sensitive, nervous women who get pain in head and eyes from sewing (Ruta). Irritability during menses. Earnest and sensitive, offended at the slightest joke. Fear of evil while walking in open air, in evening. Throws things away. Causeless weeping. Starting from sleep. Complaining on waking. Frightened easily on waking. Hallucinations of sight, smell and taste. As if frightened, jumps out of bed, sees imaginary objects, screams, trembles, talks hurriedly, anxious in evening and before midnight. Abdomen - Bloated and hard abdomen. Abdomen as if empty. Twisting pain about the navel, better pressure (Spig.). Pressing outward in belly. Pain on pressing upon navel. Colic with cutting, pinching pains from worms. Unpleasant, warm feeling. Pinching or cramplike pressure transversely across epigastric region after a meal.

Head - Headache, alternating with pain in abdomen, relieved by stooping (Mez.). Headache from straining eyes. Headache from sewing. Pain in head when reading or staring. Headache, before and after epileptic attack. Turning the head from one side to other. Child leans his head sideways all the time. Women must let hair down during headache. Children cannot tolerate to have their hair combed. Anemic headache, better stooping, worse mental exertion. Weak, hollow, empty sensation in head with inclination to vomit. Stupefying headache. Meningeal irritability, from worms.

Eyes - Dark rings around the eyes. Dilated pupils. Photophobia. Pulsation of ciliary muscle. Eyestrain, especially when presbyopia sets in. Strabismus from abdominal irritation, from worms. Eyebrows twitch when staring at any object. Drooping and heaviness of lids. Fatigue of eyes from sewing. Eyestrain with headache. Pain in eyes when reading or staring. Sensations as if sand had got into eyes, worse when reading. Lachrymation during cough. Spots on cornea. Itching of inner canthus.

Ears - Cramplike jerking in external ear, like earache. Digging and scratching in ears. Dull stitches below mastoid process. Hearing impaired.

Nose - Itching of nose all the time. Picks and bores at nose, until it bleeds. Wants to rub nose and pick at it. Child picks its nose and cries out in sleep. Sneezing with whooping cough. Nostrils drawn in. Violent sneezing with stitches in temples. Slimy discharge from nose. Bleeding from nose and mouth, with burning in nose. Nosebleed, dark blood, with pain in forehead. Stoppage of nose in evening.

Face - Face alternately pale and cold, or red and hot. Face puffy. Bluish white about the mouth. Pale with dark rings around eyes. Pale with sickly look during cough. Pale streak down centre of face. Cold perspiration. Grinds teeth during sleep. Chorea movements of face and hands. Tearing pain, in malar bones, worse touch and pressure. One cheek red, the other pale. Twitching of muscles about eyes and face, with disordered stomach and bowels.

Mouth - Sensitiveness of teeth to cold air and to cold drinks. Grinds teeth at night during sleep. Chews and swallows in sleep. Much frothy saliva with rattling mucus on chest. Foul breath. Bitter taste before chill. Dryness and rawness of mouth, palate. Clean tongue. Whitish sore place on margin of tongue, very painful to touch. Tongue coated brownish-yellow.

Stomach - Ravenous hunger, worse two hours after meals better when stomach is full. Loss of appetite. COMMENTS - Has cured attacks of pain occurring two hours after meals, relieved by a cup of milk or light food. With the first trituration, Nash cured a boy of eight who had several abscesses in and around the knee joint. The tibia was ulcerated and the ragged edge of the bone protruded through the surface. There was emaciation, loss of appetite and he was as pale as a corpse. The appetite returned at once in great force. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc-p., Calc-i., Glon., Bar-c. (2) Kali-c. - excessive sweating, weakness, pallor, Cact. - heart and arteries. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Sore throbbing in spleen. Mesenteric tuberculosis.

Rectum - Diarrhea of tuberculosis.

Male - Bad effects on masturbation, weakness of sight. Itching of genitals.

Female - Child refuses breast. Aversion to mother's milk. Uterine hemorrhage before puberty. Menses too early and profuse. Labor-like pains frequently recurring, as if menses would appear. Labor-like pains during pregnancy. Spasmodic yawning in amenorrhea. Food - Hunger voracious after eating. Gets hungry soon after a meal with feeling of emptiness. Indigestion. Canine hunger. Hunger during or before intermittent fever. Aversion to mother's milk. Bread tastes bitter. Desires many and different things. Craving for sweets, bread. Refuses ordinary food and desires dainties. Eats alot but doesn't gain weight. Malassimilation. Children are hungry, the greater the hunger the greater the emaciation. Hypoglycemia. Thirst for cold drinks. Difficult swallowing of liquids.

Chest - Veins stand out like whip-cord. Ears - Frying or sizzling in ears.

Heart - Angina pectoris.

Back - Drawing, tearing pains down along whole spine. Tearing, jerking pain in middle of spine. Paralytic feeling in nape. Bruised pain in lumbar region, not worse motion. Lancinating pain in upper part of spinal column extendind to right scapula. Causations - Ill effects of parasites, worms. Chest - Sternum as if lying too close to back. Cramplike, contracted sensation. Constriction of right side, with difficult breathing. Chest as if pressed together from both sides. As if chest was full of mucus. Sharp pain in left side. Burning and soreness in chest. Two dull piercing pains in quick succession near sternum. Constitutions - Generally hungry, cross, ugly and wants to be rocked. Children who are big, fat, rosy and scrofulous, they stiffen out, when looked at, during cough or when they become cross.

Limbs - Habitually cold limbs. Lungs - Acute pain in chest. Tuberculosis cough. Bleeding from the lungs. Asthma. Bronchitis.

Sleep - Starts in sleep.

Skin - Exhausting night sweat (Merc.). Acne with pustules all over the body.

Modalities - Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind.

Kidneys - Urine, turbid, white, milky. Urine, turns milky on standing. Involuntary at night. Bedwetting, worse every full moon. Frequent urging with passage of much urine, all day. Involuntary urination. Urine becomes turbid immediately.

Cough - Gagging cough in the morning. Whooping cough. Violent cough recurring paroxysms, as of down in throat. Cough ends in spasm. Cough so violent as to bring tears and sternum pains, feels as if something had been torn off. Child is afraid to speak of move for fear of bringing on paroxysm of coughing. Periodic cough, returning spring and fall. Swallows after coughing. After coughing, moaning, anxious, gasps for air and turns pale.

Perspiration - Cold sweat on forehead, nose and hands. Sour smell of body especially children. After the sweat or before the chill, vomiting of food, with canine hunger at the same time.

author: Murphy
constitution: Cataract. Corneal, opacity. Eye, injuries.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cine. Cineraria marítima. Dusty miller. Senecio cineraria. N. 0. Composite. Corybiferae. Tincture or succus of the fresh plant, growing wild, gathered just before the flower-buds open. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Corneal,…
full:
PHARMACY - cine. Cineraria marítima. Dusty miller. Senecio cineraria. N. 0. Composite. Corybiferae. Tincture or succus of the fresh plant, growing wild, gathered just before the flower-buds open. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Corneal, opacity. Eye, injuries.

HERBAL - This is an unproved drug, but it has been used with a good deal of success in cases of cataract as an external application. The method adopted is to instill one drop four or five times a day into the affected eye, for several months.

HOMEOPATHIC - Most effective in traumatic eye cases. Traumatic cataract and corneal opacities, as well as senile cataract. No reports of cures by internal use of the remedy alone, but in some cases it was given internally as well as used externally. Generally, the patients have received specific homeopathic treatment internally at the same time. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) In cataract, Calc-f. Phos., Platanus, Cann-i., Caust., Naph., Led., Nat-m., Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

name: Cinnabaris
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from rest. Better open air. Better sunshine. Better after dinner. Worse from light. Worse summer. Worse dampness. Worse walking. Worse night. Worse touch. Worse lying on right side, feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side. Sweat worse at noon. Headache worse after sleep..

full:
PHARMACY - cinnb. Cinnabaris. Red mercuric sulphide. Mercuric sulphide. Mercurius sulphuratus ruber. Hydrargyrum sulphuratum rubrum. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Bubo. Catarrh. Chancre. Cystitis. Dysentery. Eye, infections. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gout. Leucorrhea. Nose, sensitive. Priapism. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scrofula. Sleep, abnormal. Sycosis. Syphilis. Tapeworm. Ulcers. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cinnb. corresponds to sycosis as well as to syphilis and to combinations of the two. Warts on the prepuce (Thuj.), especially for fan-shaped warts. General ner- vous, uneasy sensation. Weariness, languor. Tired and prostrated, worse before eating, better when riding in the open air. General sensitiveness to touch, bones of skull, scalp, roots of hair, bridge of nose, warts bleed when touched. Sensation on bridge of nose as if touched with metallic substance. Uneasy creeping and pressing sensation about nasal bones as from wearing spectacles when not used to them. Headache with nosebleed. Frequent jerkings and pullings. Certain forms of ciliary neuralgia and ulceration upon a syphilitic base. Cold and chilly in warm room. Symptoms intermit in severity. MIND - Indolence and indisposition to mental labor. Forgetful. Fretful, easily provoked. Sleepless during night. Sensation of fullness in the head from mental application. Desire to be alone.

Head - Congestion to head, face purple red. Congestion of blood to the head, worse after eating. Violent and frightful attack of headaches, better by compression of the head. Intense headache, he cannot raise his head from the pillow, relieved by external pressure. Dull pain in the forehead, which is cold, relieved by heat. Shooting pain in the left side of the head. Painful sensitiveness of the cranium and of the hair on being touched. Stupefying buzzing in the head.

Eyes - Redness of whole eye. Eye infections. Lids granulated, canthi and lids red. Severe shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running from inner to outer canthus in the bone. Pains from lachrymal duct around eye to temple from inner canthus across brows to ear.

Ears - Roaring in the ears with swelling of the face, after eating. Scurfy eruption in right external ear. Itching in right ear.

Nose - Nasal catarrh. Hawks stringy mucus from throat or lumpy mucus drops from the posterior sinuses. Discharge from the nose is acrid, foul, burning, watery or dark lumps. Coryza with lumps of dirty, yellow mucus are discharged from the posterior sinuses. Violent, fluent, burning coryza. Itching of the nose, with bleeding after blowing it. Pain about root, extending into bones on each side (Aur.).

Face - Heat and swelling, mostly about the eyes.

Mouth - Dry mouth and throat, wakes from sleep, must rinse the mouth Both corners of the mouth are chapped. Tongue coated white with a putrid, bitter taste in the morning. Burning, constrictive sensation in the palate. Salivation and increased flow of urine.

Throat - Stringy mucus passed through posterior sinuses into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat, must rinse the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and throat. Vertigo - Giddiness in the morning after rising, when stooping with nausea. COMMENTS - The skin is much affected. Redness predominates (the color of the drug). Red spots. Heat, redness and swelling of face, especially about eyes. Eruption on posterior cervical region, on inner and lower part of thigh with itching. Warts, pimples, pustules, ulcers, violent itching and pricking, especially about joints. Glands enlarged. The back of the neck is affected. Pain extending to occiput when head is thrown back. Pain right side of neck on turning head. Muscles seem contracted. Leucorrhea, discharge causes a pressure in the vagina. Jerking in penis, occurring during sleep. Tearing stitches in glans. Burning, stinging, itching of corona glandis. Frequent hemorrhages, nosebleed, bleeding hemorrhoids. Dysenteric symptoms. Obstinate constipation, stools hard and too large. Protrusion of anus during stool. Formication as from a large worm. Little pimples around anus with burning and itching. Berridge reported this symptom cured: “Left leg feels shorter than right while walking.” . Guernsey said “We are led to use this for very red and very fiery-looking ulcers, which may occur in the throat or on any other part of the body. Ulcers in the mouth, on the legs, particularly if there be nodes on the shin- bones. In very angry looking chancres.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Hep., Nit-ac., Opium and Sulphur.

Stomach - Soreness in the stomach, with dizziness and lightness in the head and tightness in the temples. Nausea, alleviated by belchings. Nausea with water brash, in the evening.

Abdomen - Flashes of heat confined to the abdomen with great flatulence, worse in the forenoon.

Rectum - Formication in the anus, as from a large worm. Little pimples around the anus with burning and itching. Bloody dysentery. Tenesmus. Evacuations, soft and frequent. Thin, white stools. Green mucus diarrhea, which stains the skin about anus and scrotum a copper color.

Male - Jerking in penis during sleep. Foul acrid sweat between scrotum and thighs. Warts on prepuce, fan- shaped and bleed easily. Small red pimples on glans. Itching of corona glandis. Redness and swelling of prepuce, testicles enlarged, buboes, angry looking chancres. Syphilis, squamous and vesicular. Old hard chancres.

Female - Leucorrhea, discharge with a feeling of pressure in vagina.

Chest - Chest oppressed, feels contracted, relieved by stretching. Pain running over the ensiform cartilage from the seventh rib on the right side diagonally through the chest. Pulsating and shooting pains in the chest, especially when walking. Constitutions - Anti-sycotic and antisyphilitic.

Heart - Heart flutters, then rushes of blood to the head.

Back - Pain in back part of neck when head is thrown back, extending to occiput. Wrenching pains in the vertebrae of the neck. The muscles of the neck seem as if contracted. Tearing in the side of the back. Aching in the small of the back, as if bruised. Pain all over the back down to the loins.

Limbs - Sensation of lameness in all the limbs. Pulling and shuddering in the arms and legs. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers. Cold knees or joints. Left leg feels shorter than the right, while walking. Cramp in calves after walking. Pain in Achilles tendon and os calcis when walking. Nodes on shin bones. Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Lungs - Dyspnea with heat. Cough from tickling in the throat. Dry cough in single shocks, when lying down, better by sitting up. Hoarseness in the evening.

Sleep - Sleepiness in the daytime and sleeplessness at night, unconquerable desire to sleep after dinner, early in the evening. Restlessness and sleeplessness at night from a constant flow of ideas changing from one thing to another. Restless sleep with vivid dreams and much talking. Nightmares after midnight.

Skin - Red eruptions. Violent itching and pricking. Honeycombed ulcers. Very fiery-red looking ulcers. Condyloma, easily bleeding. Buboes. Nodes on the shin bones. Sweat on nose.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better open air. Better sunshine. Better after dinner. Worse from light. Worse summer. Worse dampness. Worse walking. Worse night. Worse touch. Worse lying on right side, feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side. Sweat worse at noon. Headache worse after sleep.

Compare - (1) Hep., Camph. (red spots), Lach., Merc., Nit-ac. (2) Thuj. - Cinnb. is better than Thuj in warts on prepuce. (3) Sep. - warts on margin of prepuce, Ant-t. - warts at back of glans. (4) Seneg. has better bending head backward, Clem, has headache worse from same, Clem, also has vertigo on lifting head up or moving head, Cinnb. has pain in back of neck when head is thrown back. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Frequent and increasing emission of watery urine, also during the night. Pain, as if from a sore in the urethra, when urinating, this pain wakes him up at night.

Temperature - Pulse slower in the forepart of the day, accelerated in the evening. Coldness and chilliness in the warm room. Heat of the body during the whole night. Profuse perspiration between the thighs. Perspiration most at noon.

name: Cinnamonum Ceylanicum
author: Murphy
constitution: Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness. Hemorrhages. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Post- partum, hemorrhage. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cinnam. Cinnamonum ceylanicum. Cinnamon tree. Cinnamomum zeylanicum. Cinnamomum cassia. N. O. Lauracae. Tincture. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness.…
full:
PHARMACY - cinnam. Cinnamonum ceylanicum. Cinnamon tree. Cinnamomum zeylanicum. Cinnamomum cassia. N. O. Lauracae. Tincture. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness. Hemorrhages. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Post- partum, hemorrhage. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Cinnam. has been used in large doses by the old school in cases of uterine cancer and some success has been claimed for it. Cancer where pain and fetor are present. For cancer, use a strong decoction, one-half pint a day. Oil of cinnamon in water solution is the best local disinfectant. 3-4 drops in two quarts of water as a douche, wherever a germicide and disinfectant is needed. Three drops on sugar for hiccough.

HOMEOPATHIC - A leading feature of Cinnamon is hemorrhage, and has had abundant clinical verification. Hemorrhage is bright red and clear, worse by any physical exertion. Nosebleeds. Hemorrhage during the pregnancy, threatening miscarriage. A strain in loins or false step brings on a profuse flow of bright blood. Post-partum hemorrhage. Hemorrhages from bowels, hemoptysis, etc. Great weakness as after loss of fluids. Hysterical attacks, going off with belchings with nausea or vomiting. Talking causes hysterical attacks. Feeble patients with languid circulation. Gastric disturbances. Flatulency and diarrhea. Pains in bones and muscles. Symptoms are worse while riding, exertion, talking, afternoon, and evening up to midnight. MIND - Forgetfulness. Anxiety. Child screams and weeps until midnight. Delusion left side of body is diminished, smaller. Hysteria. Great stupor in hysteria. Hysteria when nothing brings on the attacks more surely than talking.

Eyes - Pain from left eye up to vertex in a line along the middle. Itching of the eyes. Improves weakness of vision.

Ears - Heat around left ear.

Nose - Frequent attacks of nosebleed. Tough mucus from nose.

Face - Whole face turned red.

Mouth - Toothache. Offensive taste in mouth. Ptyalism, particularly with pain in back.

Throat - Sore throat. Hoarseness with cough. Clears the voice when muffled by secretions, scatters the phlegm and is useful for tickling in larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness and oppression of breathing. Fainting. COMMENTS - Particularly useful for hemorrhage. Uterine hemorrhage, bleeding fibroids, any emergency hemorrhage. Profuse diarrhea. Can be used easily as a home remedy, either in potency or as a tea in an emergency. Boericke said “a profuse flow of bright blood.” One case documented a woman who had a uterine hemorrhage after childbirth and she craved cinnamon, Cinnam. helped. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon. It antidotes: Opium. Compare: (1) Ip., Phos., Sil., Trill. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Tonic effect on stomach. Pressure and cramps in stomach. Hiccough jyjfh diarrhea, want of appetite and acidity Cinnamonum ceylanicum of stomach. Belching with colic. Nausea while riding with gagging and vomiting of mucus. Nausea and retching every day at same hour for four days. Chronic vomiting. Paroxysms subside as soon as vomiting sets in. Vomiting of pregnancy. Stool - Long continued constipation, stool in hard balls. Diarrhea, worse after drinking with acidity. Hemorrhage from bowels, bright red and clear blood, occurring especially after any physical exertion.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cipro is a very toxic antibiotic drug used for the treatment of antrax and other infections. As many as 20% of people taking Cipro have reported severe side effects. The most common side-effects reported are gastrointestinal in nature such as nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Ciprofloxacin administration results in elevated serum fluoride levels. Cipro can cause musculo-skeletal disorders such as rhabdomyolysis. Tendonitis and tendon rupture. Achilles tendon rupture was shown to even after withdrawal of the drug. Other fluoroquinolones are now withdrawn from the market because they had caused severe liver and kidney damage and even deaths. Fatal liver failure associated with ciprofloxacin has been reported. Ciprofloxacin has been implicated in several cases of acute kidney failure and dysfunc- - tion. Respiratory distress is a side- effect of ciprofloxacin. Photosensitivity can result when light interacts with chemical agents in the skin and eyes. This process can produce undesirable clinical consequences, such as phototoxicity, exaggerated sunburn, sun allergy or sun-carcinogenicity. People receiving Patients taking Cipro are warned not to expose themselves to direct sunlight. Rashes develop on the areas exposed. This medication may stimulate the central nervous system, which may lead to tremors, restlessness, light- headedness, confusion, depression, and hallucinations. Other central nervous system reactions include nervousness, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, nightmares, and paranoia. Cipro can cause increased pressure within the brain. Convulsions have been reported in people receiving the drug. Seizures. Slug gishness. Tingling sensation. Vague feeling of illness. Weakness. Swelling of the face, lips, neck, eyes, or hands. Agranulocytosis, potentially fatal condition where the white blood cell count goes extremely low. Blood and albumin in the urine, elevated serum potassium, glucose, and albumin. Elevation of triglycerides and cholesterol. MIND - Abnormal dread or fear. Anxiety. Nervousness. Agitation and restlessness. Mental confusion. Depersonalization. Loss of sense of identity. Trembling with the fever. Sensation as if ants were running through the whole body (in evening with anxious, difficult breathing). Prominent stitches. Characteristic soft or spongy feeling. In the provings, the external head (left), eyes, teeth (left), skin, urinary and male sexual organs show the greatest number of symptoms. Herpes, stricture of the urethra, cancer of the breast and testes. Inflammation of eyes, worse left, smarting, burning, stitches, redness, lachrymation, photophobia. Sensation as if fire were streaming from eyes. Neuralgic pains in various parts. Pains relieved by perspiration. Burning, itching, stinging, crawling. Muscles flaccid or twitch. MIND - Confused feeling, better in open air. Peevish, dissatisfied without any cause. Melancholy, preoccupied with sad thoughts. General sadness and dread of misfortune. Sadness better after eating. Cheerful alternating with sadness, followed by irritability and prostration. Homesick (Caps.). Ailments from homesickness. Memory weak. Indifference. Aversion to talking. Indolence in morning, better evening. Aversion to reading, desires to be read to. Irritable, taciturn, doesn't want to go out. Low sex drive. HOMEOPATHIC - Cobalt has been known since ancient times and it was introduced for used in the manufacture of blue china, Dutch delftware, Moutier and Gien’s crockery and Sévre porcelain. A great deal of research is carried out on it in industry and agriculture, including experiments concerning the toxicity of cobalt and its salts. In 1899, Pettini and Messina, by administering cobalt chloride in the food of dogs, cats and rabbits, noticed an increase in the level of hemoglobin. More recently, Polonowski, Sutter and Briska, showed an increase of red corpuscles due to cobalt. Canjolle pointed to the complaints of pulmonary ventilation with a fall in arterial tension. According to Zarone, this hypotension is linked to a toxic attack on the myocardium. In occupational medicine, Desoille, Merk- len and Cotteril reported cases of poisoning of workers in which the clinical symptoms noted respiratory complaints and an increase in the level of red corpuscles. A lack of fertility and miscarriage due to bleeding under the placenta. Emaciation, bluish-red coloring of the muscles and viscera, serous effusion. The thyroid gland is the location for pseudo-carcinomatous changes. The homeopathic proving was re-evaluat- edby G. Maring in 1955 with fifteen provers, seven men and eight women. He used the 3x, 6x, 12x, and 30x potencies. Symptoms included general fatigue in the morning, immediately on waking, lasting through the day with the feeling of being sleepy and heavy.
