full:
PHARMACY - hydr. Hydrastis canadensis. Golden seal. Orange-root. Yellow Puccoon. N. O. Ranunculacee. Tincture of the fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Asthma. Backaches. Breast, cancer. Cachexia. Cancer. Catarrh. Chancroids. Colon, cancer. Constipation. Coms. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Ears, disorders. Emaciation. Fainting. Fistula. Gastric, catarrh. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhoids. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Liver, cancer. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Lupus. Malnutrition. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Mouth, sore. Nails, disorders. Nipples, sore. Nursing, women. Placenta, adherent. Post-nasal, catarrh. Pruritus, vul vae. Rectal, cancer. Rectum, disorders. Sciatica. Seborrhea. Sinusitis. Smallpox. Stomach, cancer. Stomach, disorders. Syphilis. Taste, disordered. Throat, deafness. Throat, sore. Tongue, disorders. Typhus. Ulcers. Uterus, disorders.

HERBAL - Hydrastis, the Golden Seal plant, is the only specimen of its genus among the Ranunculacee. It grows in shady woods in rich soil and damp meadows. The fruit is like a raspberry and the plant is sometimes called ground raspberry in consequence. The root, from which the tincture is made, is really a perennial underground stem, thick, knotty and yellow. The yellow color is very intense and has been used as a dye by Native Americans. The first mention of it in medical literature is by Rafinesque. Hale quoted him as saying that it is “tonic, ophthalmic, detergent,” and that “it is said to enter into compound remedies for cancer, acting as a detergent tonic and the Cherokees are supposed to use it in that disease.”

HOMEOPATHIC - Later experience agreed with this reputation and Hydr. won its chief fame through its use in cancer cases. Clarke thought it may fairly be said that more cases of cancer have been cured with Hydrastis than with any other single remedy. Cancer andpre-cancerous states, before ulceration with pain. Shallow ulcers. Small wounds bleed and suppurate. Tendency to hemorrhage and ulcerations. Modifies the course of smallpox internally and topically. Garth Wilkinson noted the modification of smallpox, abolishing its distressing symptoms, shortening its course, lessening its danger and greatly mitigating its consequences. Catarrh characterized by thick, yellow, acrid, ropy discharge. Mucus is found in the stools and in the urine. Hawks up mucus. Sense of raw burning. Poor digestion and obstinate constipation. Marked action on the liver. Goiter of puberty and pregnancy. Clothing feels uncomfortable about groins. Lumbago. Weak muscular power. Emaciation and prostration. Frequent fainting spells with profuse perspiration. Prominent cerebral effects, feels his wits sharpened, head cleared, facile expression. MIND - Absent-mindedness, forgetful. Dullness of memory. Forgetful. Weakness of memory. Can’t remember what he is reading or talking about. Disturbed by least noise. So nervous that to hear any one speak is unbearable. Averse to conversation. Apathetic. Indifference to everything. Moody. High-spirited. Extreme restlessness. Cheerful on rising in morning. Nervous and sensitive. Gloomy, taciturn and disagreeable. Hopelessness. Depression and gloom, sure of death and desires it. Discouragement incidental to long suffering and weakness. Irritability after dinner. Irritable, disposed to be spiteful. Malicious. Desire to strike. Moaning with occasional outcries from pain.

Head - Frontal headache arising from catarrh. Headache from gastric difficulties. Sinusitis after coryza (Kali-bi.). Neuralgia of the scalp and neck. Dull, pressing frontal pain, especially connected with constipa- Hydrastis canadensis tion. Eczema on forehead along the line of hair, worse after washing. Eczema of scalp with thick crusts.

Eyes - Chronic inflammation of eyes. Dark greenish-yellow conjunctiva. Yellow eyes. Opacity of the cornea. Ophthalmia with thick mucus discharge. Scrofulous ophthalmia, with or without ulceration. Profuse secretion of tears, smarting and burning of eyes and lids. Lids agglutinated. Lids greatly swollen and excoriated. Large painful stye on left lid. Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis without discharge. Conjunctivitis with sensation of dryness and scratching.

Ears - Ears red, thickened and covered with scales. Pain in right ear. Otorrhea, thick mucus discharge (fetid). Fissures behind ears, where ears connect with head. Membrana tympani purplish and bulging. Perforation of eardrum. Eustachian catarrh with high-pitched voice. Roaring in the ears like machinery. Tinnitus from catarrh of inner ear. Deafness from eustachian catarrh. Deafness after scarlet fever. Throat deafness. Thick, offensive, irritating, catarrhal and purulent discharges from external auditory meatus.

Nose - Burning pain in nose. Thick, tenacious yellow-green mucus. Coryza watery, excoriating, burning, smarting and rawness. Sneezing, with fullness over eyes. Sinusitis after coryza (Kali-bi.). Post-nasal dripping. Constant discharge of thick white mucus, sinus headache. Thick, white or yellow, tenacious nasal discharge. Secretions so profuse as to be removed in long tenacious shreds or pieces. Ozaena, with bloody, purulent discharge. Ozaena, with ulceration of septum. Blows nose all the time. Tickling, like a hair in right nostril. Air feels cold in nose. Nosebleed with burning rawness, followed by itching. Nosebleed before menses.

Face - Thin, yellow, sunken face. Expression weary, dull, skin pale, or yellow-white. Erysipelatous eruption following flushes of heat. Tenacious mucus hangs in shreds from mouth. Epithelioma of face, nose and lips. Aphthae on lips with swelling of tongue. Comedones.

Mouth - Aphthae. Stomatitis during course of eruptive fevers. Stomatitis of nursing mothers or weakly children. Bitter taste. Peppery, flat taste in mouth. Excessive secretion of thick, tenacious mucus. Bleeding, painful cancerous growth or tumor on hard palate. Aphthae on the lips. Cancer of lips. Epithelial cancer of lip. Bleeding painful cancerous growths on hard palate.

Throat - Throat dry, raw, sore, smarting. Throat as if excoriated, on swallowing. Scraping in larynx. Uvula sore and relaxed. Hawking of yellow, thick mucus from posterior sinuses (Kali-bi.). Follicular pharyngitis. Ulcers in the throat, especially after mercury. Post-nasal dripping, waking from sleep. Cancerous ulcers. Goiter of puberty and pregnancy. Roughness in throat in morning on waking. Smarting and tingling in throat. Sore throat from gastric derangement. Sore throat, with increased mucus, with burning and rawness.

Stomach - Belchings of sour fluid. Sore feeling in stomach more or less constant. Faintness at the stomach, sinking, gone feeling in stomach with loathing of food or as of a sharp lump in stomach. Atonic dyspepsia. Chronic gastritis. Weak digestion with debility. Acute, distressing cutting pains. Chronic gastric catarrh, ulceration. Painful epigastric tumors with pulsations. Stomach ulcers with emaciation. Marasmus. Ulcers and cancer. Stomach cancer with emaciation. Regurgitation of food by mouthful, without nausea. Vomits all she eats, except milk and water mixed. Stools - Feces in form of hard balls coated over with yellowish, tough mucus. Slimy, tenacious discharges with tenesmus. Stools hard and knotty, of a gray or brown color. Scanty stools alternating with discharge of membranous casts. Stool light colored, soft, acrid, greenish. Stool lumpy, covered with yellow mucus. Greenish stools.

Abdomen - Burning pain in umbilical region with goneness, faintness in epigastrium. Gastro-duodenal catarrh. Colon cancer. Flatulent colic with faintness. Loud rumbling with dull aching, worse moving. Abdominal walls painful on pressure, during flatulent colic. Cutting, colicky pains, better after passing flatus. Sharp pain in the cecal region. Sharp pain spleen region. Pains in the groin as if he had strained himself. Griping pains with the stools. Groins as if sprained. Severe pain in bowels from getting feet wet during menses. Gurgling in ileocaecal region, with bloated abdomen. Intestinal catarrh, followed by ulceration.

Rectum - Contraction and spasms. Constipation alternating with diarrhea. No desire for stool. Obstinate constipation of pregnancy. Constipation after purgatives. Constipation with a sinking feeling in stomach. Constipation from sluggish state of bowels. Raw smarting in the rectum during stools, remaining long afterwards. Constipation with hemorrhoids. Proctitis. Fistula of anus. Prolapsed, anus fissured. Fissures and excoriations of anus. Prolapse of rectum. Hemorrhoids, even slight bleeding exhausts. Fetid flatus. Noisy discharge of flatus. Exhaustion and fainting after stool. Ulceration of rectum, after bad cases of dysentery.

Male - Gonorrhea, in second stage, discharge thick and yellow. Gleet, debility, copious, painless discharge. Debility after spermatorrhea. Hydrocele. Dragging in right groin to testicle, then to left testicle, then to left groin. Long lasting gonorrhea, with great moral and physical depression.

Female - Endometritis. Profuse menses, flowing ten days or more. Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia with fibroids. Congestive dysmenorrhea. Leucorrhea, worse after menses (Bov., Calc.). Thick, acrid, yellow, ropy leucorrhea. Pruritus vulvae with profuse leucorrhea (Calc., Kreos., Sep.). Hot, watery, discharge from uterus. Fibroid tumors at menopause. Uterine hemorrhage. Uterine complaints better recumbent position. Removes the tendency to habitual adherent placenta. Erosion and excoriation of cervix. Inflammation of cervix, with heat and itching of vagina. Vagina sore during sex, bleeding afterwards. Food - Poor appetite with constipation. Irritability after dinner. Indigestion from atony of the stomach, especially in elderly people. Bread or vegetables cause acidity, weakness, indigestion. i/Vorse by excessive use of alcohol.

Chest - Chest raw, sore, burning. Pain from chest to left shoulde with numbness of arm, and palpitations. Thoracic or intercostal myalgia. Axillary glands tender and swollen. Excessive offensive sweat of axilla. Constitutions - It produces atonic cachectic, degenerative conditions, hence suitable in old, easily tired, weak persons with great debility and emaciation. Emaciated, broken-down constitutions. Cancer and pre- cancerous states. Cancerous diathesis. Coughs - Dry, harsh cough. Loose cough, bloody or thick, yellow tenacious sputum. Loose cough, raises much mucus. Dry, harsh, rattling cough from tickling in larynx. Catarrhal cough of long standing. Cough with febrile symptoms in evening and night. Cough with debility in children. Cough with rawness of larynx. Cough with tingling and smarting in throat.

Heart - Heavy beating of heart with dyspnea. Intermittent heartbeats. Heart agitated. Palpitations from a slowly progressing weakness. Palpitations with faintness. Palpitation; irregular, and at times laboured action of heart. Violent long-continued palpitation in morning. Pulse slow during the chill.

Back - Dull, heavy, dragging pain and stiffness, particularly across lumbar region, must use arms in raising himself from seat. Neuralgia of neck. Muscles of neck feel sore. Tired aching across small of back and in limbs, knees ache, better by walking about. Chronic suppuration and swelling of cervical glands with great weakness. Debility and weakness in back and lower limbs better walking about. Excoriation in folds of skin of neck. Breasts - Cracked and sore nipples of nursing women. Pain in breast (right) on sneezing. Pain in right breast and down arm. Breast cancer, pains like knives thrust into part. Nipple retracted. Hard, irregular tumor of left breast, glands in axilla enlarged and painful, cachectic appearance.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains. Limbs tired, ache, feel weak, with coryza. Sharp, shifting pain, in right arm and leg, then left leg. Pain from right hip to knee while walking. Aching in sole of left foot, no relief from change of position. Irritable, indolent, atonic or scrofulous ulcers on the legs.

Sleep - Awakened by backache and dull pains in navel and hypogastric region. Restless sleep. Difficulty in awaking. Dreams wearisome.

Skin - Jaundice, dark greenish-yellow color. Cancerous ulcers. Atonic ulcers, following removal of tumors. Lupus. Hot, dry skin, with fever. Burning heat and itching in skin. Erysipelatous rash on face, neck, palms, joints of fingers and wrist, with maddening, burning heat, later skin exfoliates. Nettle rash, hives, worse from scratching, worse at night. Scarlet raised nodular eruption. Infantile intertrigo. Eruptions like smallpox. Smallpox, all stages, itching tingling of the eruption. Smallpox with great redness, swelling and itching. Obstinate excoriations of skin. Yellowish looking vesicles, filled with a limpid fluid.

Modalities - Better dry weather. Better warm covering. Better from pressure. Better rest. Worse from inhaling air. Worse cold air. Worse dry winds. Worse open air. Worse at night. Worse slight bleeding. Worse washing. Worse touch. Worse old age. Worse motion. Skin symptoms are worse from warmth, washing. Catarrhal symptoms are worse from harsh, dry winds, out of doors. Worse abuse of wine. Worse abuse of drugs.

Tongue - Tongue raw, with dark red appearance and raised papillae. Tongue yellow, dirty. Tongue white, swollen, large, flabby, slimy. Tongue coated with thick white fur. Tongue coated with a yellow stripe. Tongue shows imprint of teeth (Merc.). Ulceration of tongue, fissures toward the edges. Tongue as if burned or scalded, later a vesicle forms on the tip. Tongue cancer. Tongue and lips parched, red and dry. Vertigo - Feeling as if intoxicated. Vision - Lack of accommodative power of eyes. Asthenopia. Sparks and light spots on closing eyes. COMMENTS - Grimmer noted that Hydr. has been proven highly effective in liver cancer. Even in advanced cases it has been of great assistance in the relief of pain, permitting the patient to retain consciousness Hydrastis canadensis to the end without the need of narcotics or analgesics. Affinity for stomach, liver and colon cancer (Cadm.). Skin adheres to the tumor, mottled, bluish. Burning pains, knife-like pains at the site of tumors, especially rectal tumors. Colon cancer with severe constipation and lumpy mucus in the stools. Blood and yellow, stringy mucus in the stool with a knife-like cutting pain in the rectum every time they have a bowel movement. Cancer at the emaciation stage, the last stages of cancer. Loss of appetite with severe constipation. Tonic can revive appetite (AIL). Cachexia, emaciation associated with chronic disease with yellowish tinge to the skin and sunken features. Weakness and faintness spells with sudden attacks of loss of energy and weakness. Cold sweats. Excessive sweat, especially of the armpits or genitals. Offensive ulcers, chancroids, fissures. Ulcerations of the mucus membranes, especially the stomach. Malignant ulcers, with vomiting of ropy, sticky mucus. Useful in pre-cancerous stage, a period of undefined ill- health without any discernible new growth. Never well since cancer, emaciated and weak. Used in both potency and tincture for cancer treatment, commonly used as a supportive remedy in addition to primary treatment. Yellow or white, tough and stringy catarrh of almost all mucous surfaces, nasal catarrh, pharyngeal, bronchial, gastric, duodenal intestinal, urethral (gonorrhea, gleet), vaginal. Sinusitis with yellow, thick, stringy, lumpy mucus. Chronic lung disease, coughing up thick, yellow globs. Asthmatic states. Chronic dry, harsh, rattling coughs. Chronic weakness and obstruction. Dull, heavy, sodden-looking facial expression, yellow-white in color. Large, flabby and slimy-looking tongue, bluish-white under the fur, which is yellow, slimy and sticky. Tongue is indented by the teeth. Little appetite. Weak digestion of bread and vegetables. Sour, putrid belchings. Fullness and weight at stomach. Characteristic empty, aching “gone” feeling, worse after a meal. Jaundice and liver enlargement. Gallbladder attacks. Bitter taste in the mouth. Bowel movements are either infrequent and constipated or frequent with loose, soft, light-colored stools. Torpor of the bowels, stools lumpy, covered with yellowish, tough mucus. Continual pain in the head and a bad taste in the mouth with constipation. Severe backache, wakes in the night, worse damp weather. Hard, indurated cancer of the breast or cervix (Con.), with yellow, stringy mucus. Scirrhus of uterus or breasts. Breast abscesses, or abscessed glands. Sore mouth nursing-women, sore nipples. Vaginitis with yellow, stringy discharge. Metrorrhagia, leucorrhea. Pruritus vulva. Retained placentas. Garth Wilkinson found it an excellent remedy for smallpox taken externally and topically. Eczema, drying into crusts and burning like fire, has been cured with an application of one part Hydr. tincture to nine parts of glycerine. The burning was removed. Clarke once saw a woman, 60, who had been given Hydr., 5 drops of tincture in water three times a day. After a week she developed a scarlet rash, raised and nodular, exceedingly irritable, especially at night. It was on every part of the body except the face and was worse on her buttocks and elbows. It remained a week. At the same time, the patient became very ill with sickness and general digestive disorder. Weiss gave a woman, 31, who had adherent placenta in several confinements in succession, Hydr. 3x three drops daily from the fourth month during her last three pregnancies. Each terminated without adherent placenta. Four other cases of habitual adherent placenta were successfully treated in the same way. Clifton noted that the dyspepsia occurred frequently in tubercular families and in cases of actual tuberculosis, the loss of appetite and “goneness” being especially prominent. He found that the tincture and lower potencies worked best in dyspepsia, while the higher potencies were better in catarrh of nose and fauces. RELATIONS - Antidote: Sulph. Useful after too much Chlorate of Potash for sore throat. Compare: ( 1 ) Hydr- m., Xanrhi.. Kali-bi., Con., Ars-i., Phyt., Aster., Stann., Puls. (2) Gali. - cancer of the tongue. (3) Manz. - diarrhea, gonorrhea, gleet, leucorrhea, catarrhal conditions. (4) Hydrastine sulphate 1 x - hemorrhage of bowels in typhoid. (5) Marr. - a stimulant to mucous membranes, especially laryngeal and bronchial, chronic bronchitis, dyspepsia and hepatic disorders, colds and coughs. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Cutting pain from liver to right scapula, worse lying on back or right side. Jaundice, with catarrh of stomach and duodenum. Jaundice from structural disease of liver. Liver cancer. Atrophy of liver. Torpor of the liver, with pale, scanty stools. Gallstones. Catarrhal inflammation of mucous lining of gall bladder and biliary ducts. Lungs - Asthma and edema of lungs. Cancer of right lung. Laryngeal and bronchial catarrh, later stages. Bronchitis in old, exhausted persons with thick, yellow, tenacious, stringy expectoration. Breathing difficult, worse lying on left side. Frequent fainting spells with cold sweat all over. Feels suffocating when lying on left side. Tuberculosis with emptiness in stomach, emaciation, loss of appetite. Bloody, or thick, yellow, tenacious.

Kidneys - Dull aching in region of kidneys. Gleety discharge, thick, yellow. Mucus in urine. Difficult, painful urination. Suppression of urine. Incontinence. Catarrh of bladder, with thick, ropy mucous sediment in urine. Urine smells decomposed, putrid. Chronic cystitis. Symptoms of ulceration of bladder. Urine increased and of neutral reaction. High colored urine which deposits a cloudy sediment when standing. Constant desire to urinate.

Perspiration - Profuse, offensive sweat on genitals. Profuse cold sweat all over. Sweats during frequent sudden attacks of fainty spells. Tendency to profuse perspiration and unhealthy skin (Hep.).

Temperature - Chills at night. Chill morning or evening. Chilliness, especially in back or thighs, with aching, pulse slow. Heat in flushes. Great heat of whole body. Constant dull burning pains all the evening. Gastric, bilious or typhoid forms of fever, with gastric disturbances, jaundice and great debility following. Heat alternating with chill. Influenza in cold, weak, debilitated persons.

name: Hydrazinum Sulphuricum
author: Murphy
constitution: Anorexia. Arrhythmias. Cachexia. Cancer. Emaciation. Hodgkin's, disease. Hypoglycemia. Hypotension. Liver, disorders. Lymphoma. Melanoma. Nausea. Neuritis.,Vumfiness. Tumors. Vertigo. Vomit- ing. Weakness. Weight, loss.
keynote:
PHARMACY - hydr-s. Hydrazinum sulphuricum. Hydrazine sulphate. Historicar dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anorexia. Arrhythmias. Cachexia. Cancer. Emaciation. Hodgkin's, disease. Hypoglycemia. Hypotension. Liver, disorders. Lymphoma. Melanoma. Nausea.…
full:
PHARMACY - hydr-s. Hydrazinum sulphuricum. Hydrazine sulphate. Historicar dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anorexia. Arrhythmias. Cachexia. Cancer. Emaciation. Hodgkin's, disease. Hypoglycemia. Hypotension. Liver, disorders. Lymphoma. Melanoma. Nausea. Neuritis.,Vumfiness. Tumors. Vertigo. Vomit- ing. Weakness. Weight, loss.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Joseph Gold, in 1968, wrote a paperforthe Oncology Journal called “A proposed treatment of cancer by inhibition of gluconeogenesis” in which he noted that Hydr-s„ dramatically reverses cachexia, the wasting-away process that kills many cancer patients. “This inexpensive chemical, with little or no side effects, also has a clinically documented anti-tumor action. It causes malignant tumors to stop growing, to reduce in size, and, in some cases, to disappear. “A number of cancer patients diagnosed as terminal have experienced tumor stabilization and remission through hydrazine sulfate therapy. About half of all patients who take hydrazine sulfate experience weight gain, restored appetite, extended survival time, and a significant reduction in pain and suffering. “Many patients report an increase in vigor and strength and the disappearance of symptoms of the disease, along with feelings of well-being and optimism. “The common types of cancer most frequently reported to benefit from hydrazine sulfate therapy are recto- colon cancer, ovarian cancer, prostatic cancer, lung cancer, Hodgkin's disease and other lymphomas, thyroid cancer, melanoma, and breast cancer. Some rare types of cancer also benefit. “Hydrazine sulfate is known to produce excitement, lethargy, convulsions, hypotension, arrhythmias, fatty changes in the liver, hypoglycemia and weight loss. “Toxicity. If inappropriately high doses of hydrazine sulphate are taken, numbness, nausea, vomiting, drowsiness and nerve inflammation may occur. Side effects may include nausea, some pruritus, dizziness due to low blood sugar, or peripheral neuritis. “The following toxic symptoms have been reported: nausea, vomiting, anorexia, abnormal sensations affecting both upper and lower limbs, impaired fine motor functions (writing), confusion, abnormal electromyograms. ” COMMENTS - In one case, a sixty-two-year- old woman with widely disseminated cancer of the cervix, in a very debilitated condition, was put on Hydr-s. After one week, a secondary tumor the size of an orange had completely disappeared, much to the amazement of the woman's doctors, and her neck nodes had become markedly smaller. After three weeks on the therapy, the patient had gained weight and was active and in good spirits. The woman was discharged from the hospital a short time later. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cachexia - Alf., Cadm-s., Ars., Hydr. REFERENCES - Gold. Murphy.

CLINICAL - Tinnitus. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Seems to have a specific effect on the inferior cervical ganglion increasing the action of the sympathetic nerves, promoting…
full:
PHARMACY - hydrobr-ac. Hydrobromicum acidum. Hydrobromic acid. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Tinnitus. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Seems to have a specific effect on the inferior cervical ganglion increasing the action of the sympathetic nerves, promoting vaso-constriction. Relieves headache, tinnitus and vertigo, especially in vaso- motor stomach disturbance. Dry and puckering throat. Constriction in pharynx and chest. Waves of heat over face and neck. Pulsating tinnitus with great nervous irritability. Vertigo with palpitations, arms heavy, seemed as if parts did not belong to him. REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Hydrocotyle Asiatica
author: Murphy
constitution: Acne rosacea. Constipation. Elephantiasis, arabum. Favus. Gangrene, amputation. Gonorrhea. Gout. Ichthyosis. Leprosy. Leucorrhea. Liver, contraction. Lupus. Neuralgia orbitalis. Skin disorders. Syphilis. Uterus, follicular inflammation. Vagina, pruritus.
keynote:
PHARMACY - hydre. Hydrocotyle asiatica. Gotu kola. Indian pennywort. Centella asiatica. N. O. Umbelliferae. India and South Africa. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Constipation. Elephantiasis, arabum. Favus.…
full:
PHARMACY - hydre. Hydrocotyle asiatica. Gotu kola. Indian pennywort. Centella asiatica. N. O. Umbelliferae. India and South Africa. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Constipation. Elephantiasis, arabum. Favus. Gangrene, amputation. Gonorrhea. Gout. Ichthyosis. Leprosy. Leucorrhea. Liver, contraction. Lupus. Neuralgia orbitalis. Skin disorders. Syphilis. Uterus, follicular inflammation. Vagina, pruritus.

HERBAL - Hydre, has been long known as an Indian remedy. Gotu Kola is known as Indian Pennywort. It produces hypertrophy and induration of connective tissue. Curative in disorders that exhibit interstitial inflam- mation and cellular proliferation in any part. Hypertrophy and induration of connective tissue. Boileau was the first to use it as a remedy in leprosy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hydre. has a considerable reputation in leprosy and lupus, when there is no ulceration. Elephantiasis. Excessive thickening of skin and marked exfoliation of skin. Copper colored eruptions in various places. Intolerable itching especially of soles, vagina. Very copious perspiration. Ulceration of the womb. Pains of cervical cancer. Difficulty in maintaining an upright posture. MEND - Weak concentration. Forgetful. Poor memory. Indifference. Gloomy thoughts, inclination for solitude. Misanthropy. Gaiety, loquacity.

Head - Headache with general lassitude and prostration. Congestion of blood to the head, heaviness. Painful drawing in almost all cranial nerves. Neuralgic pain in external frontal nerve. Intense pain with some swelling in posterior part of skull. Occiput acutely sensitive to touch. Constriction of back part of skull and scalp. Tinea favosa.

Eyes - Eyes look unsteady. Injection of palpebral conjunctiva. Pricking in eyes. Vision dim, dazzling. Tumours of eyelids. Epithelioma.

Ears - Pain in left internal meatus. Throbbing in right ear, ringing in left with stoppage. Confused noise in left, blowing sound.

Nose - Dry coryza. Stoppage of nose. Swelling of nose. Tickling, worse left nostril. Feeling as before bleeding. Bleeding. Lupus excedens of nose.

Face - Intoxicated expression. Intermittent pain in left cheekbone and about orbits. Neuralgic affections of supra and infraorbital nerves. Ulcer irregular and livid. Papular eruption. Copper colored eruption on face. Large tubercle on right alae nasi. Tubercles, as large as lentils, near root of nose at both sides and painless.

Mouth - Stomatitis aphthosa. Syphilitic patches in mouth. Whitish spots on left upper and under sides of tongue. Impediment in speech. Redness of velum palati with pain on swallowing, worse by food. Hyperemia of mucus membrane. Saliva increased. Insipid or bitter taste, unpleasant in morning.

Throat - Voiceweak.Tonsilsred. Esophagus is dry and rough. Burning and pricking in esophagus and pharynx. Disorder of constrictor muscles of pharynx. Vertigo - Vertigo with torpor. Vertigo with congestion and heaviness. COMMENTS - The skin and the female generative organs are the chief seats of the drug's action, though the liver, the nerves and the mucus membranes are also powerfully acted upon. Skin disorders including acne, eczema, pemphigus, lupus, copper-colored eruptions, papular eruptions on face and intolerable itching in various places. Granular ulceration. Gouty and rheumatic disorders. Bruised feeling in all the muscles. Affections of the trigeminus nerve. Aphthous and syphilitic stomatitis. Irritation of the neck of the bladder increased secretion of urine. Heat and itching in vagina. Weight in uterus. Weight in the “male uterus," the prostate gland. A patient who was taking Hydre, for eczema with advantage complained of persistent dreaming all the time he was asleep and an unpleasant mouth on waking in the morning. Auduit cured the case of a girl, 20, weak and sickly-looking, who was troubled with glandular swellings since childhood, and for eight years had lupus excedens of nose. Her mother had a coppery eruption on her face. On the right of her nose was a button the size of a sixpence covered with a thick crust covering yellow pus mixed with blood. Margins were irregular and livid. Five other buttons the size of lentils were near the root of the nose on both sides. Hydre, was given in 6c, 3c, tincture and the 18c potencies in succession with intermissions and completely cured in five months. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Elaesis - South American Palm - scleroderma, elephantiasis, leprosy, skin thickened, itching and hardened. Anesthesia. (2) Hura, orTrychnos Gaultheriana - bites of serpents, ulcers and cutaneous disorders generally. Hoang-na. (3) Chaulomoogra oil, Hydr., Ars., Aur., Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Anxiety in region of stomach. Belchings frequent, acid. Swelling of stomach. Cramping pain in stomach, without nausea. Contraction, cramp like pain. Sensation as if gases collected into a ball. Heat in stomach region spreading out like a bar. Nausea.

Abdomen - Borborygmi in different parts. Flatus. Heat in hypogastrium. Wind colic. Rumbling in different parts. Violent contractions of intestines. Pain, every five minutes, worse transverse colon. Constriction. Sensation as if all the organs were in motion.

Rectum - Weight in rectum. Constipation. Burning, itching in anus. Ineffectual desire for stool. Stools dry, dark, increased, easier.

Male - Drawing in spermatic cords, worse left. Feeling of weight in prostate gland. Acute and secondary gonorrhea. Suppressed gonorrhea. Scrotum relaxed. Indifference to intercourse. Impotence.

Female - Menses too early. Profuse leucorrhea. Pruritus of vagina. Shooting and itching in vagina. Vulva, vagina and cervix red. Heat and redness of vagina and vulva. Dull pain in ovarian region. Uterus feels heavy. Pain in whole uterus, left side. Severe labor-like pain in uterus and appendages. Granular ulceration of womb. Partly fungus, partly granular ulcer on upper lip of neck of uterus, with profuse leucorrhea. Food - Loathing of food. Anorexia, then strong appetite. Aversion to tobacco smoking.

Chest - Pustules on chest.

Heart - Cardiac spasm. Stenosis of aorta. Constriction of heart with quiet and regular pulse or with a few separate beats in certain arteries or with hot flushes in different parts of the face. Irregular beating of heart. Pulse stronger and fuller.

Back - Renewal of old rheumatic pains in left rhomboid, worse pressure. Bruised pain in loins. Obstruction in region of kidneys with heaviness. Swelling of cervical glands.

Limbs - Bruised feeling in the muscles. Rheumatic disorders. Gout with very severe paroxysms. Contractions of forearms and legs. Irresistible inclination to stretch. Pain in all joints, muscles, worse left. Sensations as if hot water ran through marrow of bones. Y ellowish spots on legs. Insupportable itching of soles of feet. Back of right foot was covered with small indurations, having a large thick crust.

Sleep - Yawing and stretching. Sleepiness in the daytime. Heavy, dreamless sleep. Persistent dreaming.

Skin - Dry eruptions. Erysipelatous redness. Pemphigus benignus. Eczema. Copper-colored eruptions in various places. Great thickening of epidermoid layer and exfoliation of scales. Psoriasis on trunk and limbs, palms and soles. Intolerable itching. Syphilitic disorders. Acne. Leprosy. Elephantiasis (Ars.). Lupus non-exedens. Pustules. Circular spots with dry scaly edges. Yellowish spots. Pricking on different parts.

Liver - Cirrhosis of liver. Pain in upper part of liver. Obstruction in hepatic region. Lungs - Pricking in vicinity of glottis. Dryness of windpipe of ventricles of larynx. Oppression of chest, which suddenly ceases and then returns at longeror shorter intervals. Breath short. Speaking soon fatigues. Irritation of air-passages. Difficult expectoration of bronchial mucus.

Kidneys - Slight formication in kidney. Constriction of bladder. Inflammation, irritation of neck of bladder. Irritation of urethra. Frequent desire to urinate, urine increased. Urine becomes brown on cooling. Urine turbid without sediment.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat.

Temperature - Shivering in afternoon. Cold hands and feet with general condition resembling precursory stage of fever without alteration of pulse. Febrile movements. Heat of skin.

name: Hydrocyanicum Acidum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from full moon. Worse suppressions. Worse storms. Indigestion, which is worse after eating. Headache is worse at night. Vertigo worse open air..
constitution: Angina pectoris. Anorexia. Asthma. Catalepsy. Cholera, asiatica. Colic. Collapse. Coma. Convulsions. Cyanosis. Delirium. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Hemiplegia. Hiccoughs. Labor, pains. Narcolepsy. Nausea. Paralysis. Stings. Stomach, catarrh. Strokes. Sun-stroke. Tetanus. Uremic, convulsions. Vomiting. Whooping cough.
keynote:
PHARMACY - hydr-ac. Hydrocyanicum acidum. Prussic acid. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anorexia. Asthma. Catalepsy. Cholera, asiatica. Colic. Collapse. Coma. Convulsions. Cyanosis. Delirium. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Hemiplegia. Hiccoughs.…
full:
PHARMACY - hydr-ac. Hydrocyanicum acidum. Prussic acid. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anorexia. Asthma. Catalepsy. Cholera, asiatica. Colic. Collapse. Coma. Convulsions. Cyanosis. Delirium. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Hemiplegia. Hiccoughs. Labor, pains. Narcolepsy. Nausea. Paralysis. Stings. Stomach, catarrh. Strokes. Sun-stroke. Tetanus. Uremic, convulsions. Vomiting. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - The pathogenesis of Hydr-ac. is mainly composed of symptoms observed in poisoning cases and those clinically verified, but it has also been proved by Joerg and his pupils. Hydr-ac. is one of the deadliest and most rapidly acting of poisons. Hence its applicability in cases of critical intensity, such as the collapse stage of cholera, when it supervenes on sudden cessation of all discharges, convulsions during severe attacks of illness. Convulsions and paralysis are the leading keynotes of the medicine's action. In the convulsions, the body is stiffened and thrown back, cramp in nape of neck. Paroxysmal breathingjaws set, foaming at mouth, face flushed, bluish tint. Lightning like jerks from head to feet. Coldness is a strong feature with the remedy, marble coldness within and without. Blue tinge of the skin is also characteristic. Sudden effects, spasms, strokes. Collapse (Ars., Verat.), due to a pulmonary condition. Spasmodic constriction in larynx, feeling of suffocation, pain and tightness in chest, palpitation, pulse weak, irregular. Cyanosis. Hysterical and epileptic convulsions. Epileptic attacks preceded by nausea and vomiting or water brash. Sinking sensation at the epigastrium. Evacuations cease suddenly, sinks down unconscious. Cholera. Intestinal cramps and colics. Tetanus, narcolepsy. Prolonged faints. Catalepsy. Lack of reaction. Hydrocyanicum acidum MIND - Concentration difficult. Confusion, better open air. Senses acute. Speech incoherent. Inability to think. Anxious feeling and fretfulness. She asks no questions and returns no answers. Fear of imaginary troubles. Feat oí death. Fear of house falling. Fear of horses, cars. Fear of crossing the street, even when the vehicle is at a considerable distance. Gestures, involuntary motions of hands. Insanity from excessive excitement. Loud involuntary screams, just before the convulsions. Ar times is forced to scream out suddenly, she knows not why. Wild delirium. Laughing, loudly. Frequently rises in bed, gazes vacantly about for a minute, then throws herself forcibly upon pillow, or flings herself from one side to the other. Seems to notice no person, unless they interfere with her plans. Unconscious.

Head - Headaches with blindness. Headaches with protruded, half open eyes. Violent stupefying headache. Confusion of head. Intense cerebral congestion, preceded by vertigo, weight and great pain in back of head. Brain feels on fire. As if a cloud were going over his brain in a case of sunstroke. Supra-orbital neuralgia with flushing on same side of face. Sudden and desperate cases of cerebrospinal meningitis. Violent pressure in occiput and forehead, worse right side.

Eyes - Distorted and half open eyes. Protrusion of eyes. Paralysis of lids. Eyes turned towards right and upwards, followed by general spasms. Eyeballs fixed. Pupils motionless or dilated. Dim vision gauze before eyes.

Ears - Roaring and deafness in ears.

Nose - Dryness of nose. Discharge of greenish brown looking fetid pieces of hardened mucus, with stinging high up in nose. Enlarged, bluish wings of nose. Increased secretion of saliva.

Face - Pale or bluish, looks old. Sallow and gray complexion. Lips pale or bluish. Jaws clenched in rigid spasm. Frightful contortion of muscles. Froths at mouth. Distorted, bloated and bluish face. Food - Loss of appetite from nervous exhaustion, the result of overwork and anxiety. Anorexia. Drinks rumble through throat and stomach. Absence of thirst, with heat of whole body, or violent thirst. Can drink during epileptiform attacks, but can't eat.

Mouth - Froth at mouth, forming large bubbles. Salivation. Loss of speech. Dry mouth. Distortion of corners of mouth. Pus, metallic, astringent taste. Taste acrid, sweet or fetid. Grinding of teeth during convulsions.

Throat - Noisy swallowing drink rumbles through throat and stomach. Spasms or paralysis of esophagus. Scraping sensation in throat, followed by secretion of mucus in bronchia. Swollen sensation. Burning and scraping. Tickling and scraping in larynx and bronchial tubes with expectoration of yellowish or whitish mucus.

Stomach - Acidity and heartburn. Stomach pain, worse when stomach is empty. Drinks, rumbles through throat and stomach. Burning from navel to esophagus, chronic dyspepsia. Great sinking at pit of stomach. Pulsative pain in precordial region. Intense pain in stomach and intestines, with much flatulence. Dyspepsia from chronic inflammation of stomach and bowels. Vomiting of a black fluid.

Abdomen - Coldness of abdomen alternating with burning. Cold feeling in abdomen with sharp pains. Burning from navel to esophagus. Enteralgia with distension of abdomen. Region of navel sensitive to touch, and upon deep pressure a sensation as from a resistant body. Abdominal muscles firmly contracted and hard as a board. Yellow or brownish spots on abdomen.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Torturing pain in chest. Tightness in chest, sensation of suffocation. Brownish spots on chest and abdomen.

Heart - Cardiac asthma. Angina pectoris with feeling of suffocation and torturing pains in chest. Angina pectoris, severe pain (Ox-ac., Spig.). Clutches at the heart as if in distress. Irregular, feeble beating of heart. Violent palpitations. Heart failure, compression at heart. Blood vessels distended, writhing in them. Occasion- ally utters a groan or a sigh, and presses hand forcibly over region of heart, as if suffering pain there. Pulse, failing, weak, irregular. Pulse unequal with occasional strong beats.

Back - Muscles of the dorsal region are contracted.

Limbs - Cold limbs. Hands icy cold. Languor and weakness of limbs. Loss of sensation in limbs, with stiffness of limbs. Paralysis first of lower, then of upper limbs. Varicose ulcers. Staggering and trembling. Lungs -Asphyxia. Breathing slow, rattling, irregular, gasping. Noisy and agitated breathing. Asphyxia. Dry, spasmodic, suffocative cough. Asthma with choking, Hydrocyanicum acidum contraction of throat. Asthma, with with puffy face and feeble action of heart, or heart's action may be violent. Convulsions with whooping cough. Paralysis of lungs (Queb.). Arrest of breathing from stitches in larynx. Hurried and labored breathing, during severe spasms of all muscles, worse at night, on falling asleep. Feeling of suffocation during torturing pains in chest. Marked cyanosis, venously congested lung. Threatened pulmonary apoplexy.

Sleep - Drowsiness. Yawning with shivering. Coma vigil. Irresistible drowsiness. Lies like one dead. Lies with head fixed and thrown backwards, and legs fixed and rigid. Lies in an apparently unconscious state, limbs and jaws rigid, forearms fixed on arms, which are firmly pressed on side. Prolonged sleeplessness or very heavy sleep. Vivid incoherent dreams.

Skin - Bluish eruptions. Bad cases of smallpox. Scarlet fever, the eruption is dark colored and soon becomes livid. Paleness with a bluish tinge. Dryness. Itching. Formication. Erythema.

Modalities - Worse from full moon. Worse suppressions. Worse storms. Indigestion, which is worse after eating. Headache is worse at night. Vertigo worse open air.

Tongue - Tongue cold. Tongue paralyzed and protruded. Tongue coated white. Tongue feels cold and burns at tip. Tongue lame, stiff. Vertigo - Vertigo with feeling of intoxication. Vertigo with frequent headaches, stupefaction and falling down. Sudden feeling as if everything about him moved slowly. Dizzy without reeling. Vertigo during headache. Cloudiness of senses, objects seem to move. Vertigo from insufficiency of arterial contraction. COMMENTS - A. H. Croucher cured a boy, 3 1/2, of convulsions with Hydr-ac. The first attack occurred six months previously. His father's sister had died of epilepsy. Before the fits came on he could walk well, but could not afterwards. The fits occurred at intervals of about three weeks when a succession of them occurred, each lasting about five minutes during two or three days. During the intervals between the fits he would generally scream. In the morning on awaking, the patient cried out, then convulsions occurred, body and limbs convulsed, eyelids twitched but remained open, eyeballs turned up and to right. Seemed quite unconscious. Hydr-ac. 2x, one drop three times a day increased afterwards to two drops and continued for a fortnight. No more convulsions, but three months later a rash developed all over him. The characteristic blue tint of Hydr-ac. is apparent after death in some poisoning cases. Livid spots on limbs, nails violet. In one case there was a brilliant violent hue all over. The heat is greatly disturbed, blueness and coldness of surface. Marble coldness within and without. It acts on the medulla and through the vagus nerve on heart and respiration. Irregular and gasping breathing. Dry tearing cough, worse at night. Cough in tuberculosis. The pulse is feeble, imperceptible. The patient clutches at the heart as if in distress. Profound prostration. Persistent and tonic tetanic spasm, without any reflex excitability (unlike Nux-v.). Paralysis attacks first the lower, then the upper limbs. Acts powerfully on the muscles of face, jaws and back. Pronounced risus sardonicus. Lividity, frothing. Disturbed digestion, worse after eating. Drinks roll audibly into the stomach. It cured a boy, 4, of a fever with the symptom: “when swallowing a teaspoonful of liquid it sounds like water rolling into an empty barrel.” Headache, worse at night and vertigo, worse in the open air. In a case of sunstroke, Cash removed the symptom “Feels as if a cloud were going over his brain.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Coff., Ip., Nux-v., Op., Verat. Compare: ( 1 ) Camph. - cholera, coldness, Helod. - coldness. (2) Cic. - spinal cord, cramp in nape. (3) Con. - paralysis spreading from below upward. (4) Oena. - epilepsy. (5) Lauro. - dry tickling cough, Lauro, has also a cough with jelly-like sputa dotted with bloody points. (6) Lach., Tab. (asphyxia), Hell. (7) Solania - paralysis of lungs and heart. (8) Nux-v. - tetanus, but of different type. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Retention of urine. Uremia with diminished action of heart. Copious emission of watery urine. Involuntary urination.

Cough - Dry, spasmodic, suffocative cough. Dry tickling cough at night. Dry, tickling cough in consumptives. Whooping cough with convulsions. Violent paroxysms, or frequent cough excited by a pricking sensation, which begins in larynx. Coughing with much rattling of mucus.

Perspiration - Body covered with sweat. Rectum - Cholera. Involuntary stools with hiccough and great prostration. Involuntary stool in bed. Sudden cessation of all discharges. Last stage of Asiatic cholera, when diarrhea has ceased and vomiting has decreased, when there is anguish with pressure on chest, and the patient becomes cold, with gradual extinction of pulse.

Temperature - Icy coldness, especially hands. General coldness with heat in head. Coldness within and without, like marble. Frequent hot flushes at menopause. Heat in bed with coldness of limbs. Heat and sweat over whole body.

name: Hydrogen
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better open air. Worse becoming cold and tendency to take cold. Worse night. Worse sleep. Worse morning on waking. Worse daytime. Worse from 9 p.m. to 9 a.m..
constitution: Acidosis. Alkalosis. Aphthae. Backaches. Congenital deformities. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fistula. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Insomnia. Nevi. Rash. Sprains. Stomach, pains. Ulcers. Weakness.
keynote:
PHARMACY - hydrog. Hydrogen. The element. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidosis. Alkalosis. Aphthae. Backaches. Congenital deformities. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fistula. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Insomnia. Nevi. Rash. Sprains. Stomach, pains. Ulcers.…
full:
PHARMACY - hydrog. Hydrogen. The element. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidosis. Alkalosis. Aphthae. Backaches. Congenital deformities. Cystitis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fistula. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Insomnia. Nevi. Rash. Sprains. Stomach, pains. Ulcers. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hydrogen was the first element to be formed. This primordial element begins Mendeleev's Periodic Table. It has a positively-charged proton as its nucleus and a negatively-charged electron-cloud around it. Hydrogen was proved by Jeremy Sherr and his team of provers in England. They used modern hydrogen with its increased tritium content as it is now. Symptoms included sudden manifestations. Sensation of heat on waking. Excessive weakness, fainting weakness, with nausea. Tremulous weakness. Headache with sensation of heat. Burning, cutting, stinging, stitching pains. Fever with thirst. Aphthae andprofuse saliva; dry mouth and throat. Desire and inclination to lie down. Lassitude after eating. Ulcers, fistula, nevi. Accidents and sprains. Symptoms on one side, better left side. Annual periodicity. MIND - Difficult concentration. Mistakes in speaking, spelling, writing. Mistakes the left and right sides. Trouble explaining the mental state. Absent-minded in morning, evening. Confused. Disjointed andjumbled thoughts. Tendency to lose things, accident prone. Hurry, industrious. Interested in esoteric subjects. Averse to studying. Ailments during full moon. Ailments from quarrels. Causeless anger. Indisposed to talk when angry. Throws things away when angry. Feels grubby. Difficulty coping with stress. Tendency to panic, nervous apprehension. Anxiety about money and fear of poverty. Desire to be alone. Aversion to being touched. Bites fingers. Ennui. Irresolution about what to do with life. Blames self. Confusion about identity, especially sexual. Emotional confusion. Strong alternation of moods. Vulnerable, weepy. Love, lovesick, overflowing love for humanity. Sighing. Sympathetic. Everything seems ludicrous. Laughed at serious things. Loquacious. Talking to self. Singing. Suspicion, paranoia. Angry, irritable. Causeless anger, tendency to throw things, to not talk. Ailments from quarrels. Depression, especially during full moon. Silent, morose, introverted. Self-pity. Insecurity. Thoughts of death. Thoughts of dead bodies. Suicidal tendency. Despair, hopelessness. Apathetic, bored. Resignation. Distant and detached, indifferent to loved ones, emotionally numb. Religious tendency. Near-death experiences. Altered perception. Sense of unreality, of separation from the world, detached (Granit- m.). Spacey feeling. Sensation of universal consciousness and enlightenment. Delusion body is enlarged. Delusion he is diminished, smaller than normal. Delusion he is dirty. Delusion he is despised. Delusion he is detached (Granit.). Delusion there is a division between himself and others. Delu- sion as if being pulled downward. Delusion has insects on back of head. Delusion that he is persecuted. Delusion fancied body was too small for soul or that it was separated from soul.

Head - Head feels hazy, unpleasant, too heavy for the neck. Band around the skull. Tenderness at the base of the skull. Dull ache in vertex and behind eyes. Attack like a stroke, worse moving head. Slight humming in head. Tingly sensation over head and face with vertigo. Formication, crawling like insects. Formication which moves about on the scalp. Sensation as if something is crawling on head, on the back of the head. Sweating on forehead. Profuse perspiration in bed at night, soaking the pillow. Hair sticky after washing. Headaches - Headache better talking, better writing. Headache, worse sudden movement, reading, traveling in a car. Frontal headache. Aching deep in brain. Pain in small spot. Throbbing headache extending to root of nose. Constant piercing pain in the center of the skull. Skull bones aching. Headache with a feeling of a line across the top of the head from side to side. Pain in spots that can be covered by a finger. Burning, throbbing pain, left side of head and face. Sharp, piercing pains. Headache over right eyebrow. Headache all day before period, left side. Headache prevents work, better from a short nap.

Eyes - Lachrymation, pain in nose. Stinging pain. Pain, as from sand. Bloodshot and watery. Watery eyes during cough, after yawning. Sensation as if grit in left eye at night. Prickly and tired. Eyes feel heavy. Green- yellow crust around left eye on waking. Blinking a lot. Left eye twitches. Desire to close eyes with headache. Swelling of upper eyelids. Bright red pustule on rim of right upper lid with sticking, pricking pain, worse by blinking. Sharp pain above left eye. Ecchymosis. Eyesight deteriorated. Photophobia.

Ears - Blocked sensation in ears, worse swallowing. Eustachian tube blocked, like in an airplane. Aching in right ear, with a cold sensation as if blowing on it. Deep aching pain in right ear. Sharp inward stabbing pains in left ear, followed by ringing in ear. Sharp pain in left ear after waking. Left sided earache coming in waves. Pulsing in ears. Ringing noise, with headache. Very conscious of sounds and noises. Right ear feels cold. Ears felt rough and itchy. Formication sensation. Itching behind ears and in left external meatus on waking.

Nose - Dryness in morning on waking. Sneezing on waking, during daytime. Coryza worse eating. Sneezing during daytime. Sneezing in cold air. Sneezing during chill. Sneezing and feeling cold, followed by a warm feeling. Sneezing with acrid, itchy sensation. Sneezing and thin coryza. Tingling in nose, as if about to sneeze. Sharp peppery sensation behind left nostril. Pain root of nose, with obstruction. Raw pain from constantly blowing the nose. Nose stuffy with clear, fluid coryza, worse eating. Nose running Hydrogen white, clear fluid like a tap, while eating. Slight catarrh and much sneezing in the evening. Thick green mucus congestion in nose, difficult to swallow. Mucus streaked with blood on blowing the nose. Mucus of an egg-white consistency. Flakey yellow-green catarrh with bits of blood. Pale green crusts from nose. Itching inside nose. Tip and wings of nose throbbing during headache. Sensation of movement, “as though worms moving.” Sensation of large bump at the end of the left nostril. Acute sense of smell.

Face - Face looks pale and drawn with black circles under eyes and chin down. Looks older. Flushed, hot face with red cheeks, weakness. Flushed face with headache after anger. Red spots on cheeks. Dry, scaly skin under chin. Very rough, chapped lips. Crack appeared in corner of mouth, left side. Skin flaking on waking. Pimples right side of chin. Aching facial bones with a cold. Twinge in jaw joint, worse motion and opening mouth. Aching, morning on waking, especially the teeth. Stiffness and pain right jaw. Left side tender and aches. Sensation of coldness. Numbness of lips. Numbness, tingling lips, worse on left, as if anesthetized. Tingling in left side. Growth of hair on upper lip.

Mouth - Bitter taste in mouth. Food tastes dry, like sawdust. Water tastes metallic. Sensation of dryness on mouth and lips. Dry mouth with thirst. Swelling mouth and lips. Small ulcer behind the teeth, bottom left side. Ulcer right side of lower jaw under lip. Gums bleeding. Salivation at night, with toothache. Metallic taste in mouth. Burning peppery sensation in the mouth, throat, extending into ears and nose, with watery eyes.

Throat - Throat painful and dry, not better by drinking. Rawness of throat and roof of mouth. Right side of throat painful on swallowing. Sore throat with blocked nose, worse sneezing. Sore throat on Hydrogen waking in morning, and inspiring cold air. Sore throat better warm drinks. Pain moved from the left to the right. Burning sensation on roof of mouth, at back of throat. Post-nasal catarrh, worse from swallowing. Mucus drawn from posterior nares. Phlegm in throat. Sensation of mucus (Rhod.). Catarrhal feeling, back of throat. Sensation of a film over the throat, with difficulty in breathing. Throat feels furry with a furry taste. Sensation of a hair on the right side of the throat. Sensation of a lump in the throat. Tickle, deep in throat causing coughs. Frequent swallowing. Choked on a piece of food.

Stomach - Anxious, queasy feeling, with apprehension. Wobbly feeling in stomach, constant feeling of nausea, worse bending over, better breathing deeply and standing still. Stomach feels distended and bloated one hour before evening meal. Sensation of wind in stomach with belching. Retching after bending over. Retching after tea. Retching while preparing food. Retching from the thought or smell of food. Nausea in epigastrium and umbilical region. Nausea with weakness, headache, flushing and trembling. Nausea better movement, walking about, and eating. Nausea from the smell of food, garlic. Nausea coming on while lying in bed. Nausea in the morning on waking. Nausea on driving the car. Nausea worse bending forwards, better breathing deeply.

Abdomen - Sunken feeling. Achy pain in the right iliac in the late morning. Sharp pain, left lower abdomen, feels like movement of gas. Stabbing pain in right, lower abdomen, groin. Pain in the abdomen after stool, better bending double. Aversion to tight clothing around waist with nausea.

Rectum - Diarrhea after headache. Sensation of a ball in the rectum. Feeling of fullness in rectum. Pain in rectum when sitting, as if forcing back a stool. Urging to stool absent all day. Urgent desire for stool in the morning. Constipated, strains to pass a stool, with hard stool. Fast expulsion of diarrhea-like stool. Flatulence smelling of putrid eggs. Anus sore during and after stool. Bleeding hemorrhoids and fissures around anus. Moisture with fishy odor (Sanie.).

Stool - Diarrhea from fermentation, with sour, acrid, watery stools. Diarrhea after headache. Forcible, sudden, gushing stool. Spurting out with much flatus. Claycolored, pale, yellowish soft stool, in the morning. Stool slender, small and loose, long and soft. Small, hard stool which felt large. Small, lumpy stool. Light- colored stool. Stool with lots of mucus. Flatus with discharge of gray, white mucus. Fishy odor.

Male - Crack, split on the foreskin and a red rash on the end of the penis. Burning, aching sensation at the base of the penis on the left.

Female - Menses, three days earlier. Menses up to two weeks late with slow onset of intermittent bleeding. Menses, clotted, copious. Menses, intermittent, commence on waking. Black blood to begin with, later in the day it became more red with dark clots. Menses, heavier or lighter than usual, starts and stops with more clotting. Pain between ovaries, extending to just above the pubic bone. High sexual energy. Itching of genitalia, better scratching. Brown vaginal discharge. Food - Appetite increased. Hungry as if nothing will fill the emptiness in stomach, better eating bread. Appetite diminished, with weight loss. Complete loss of appetite with weeping. Very thirstyfor cold drinks. Thirstlessness during headache. Aversion to spices, highly seasoned food. Aversion to coffee, tea. Aversion to tobacco. Aversion to hot drinks and hot food. Craving for spicy foods. Desires cold drinks. Desires carbonated drinks. Desires pineapple, sweets, alcohol. Desires to smoke tobacco. Better from warm drinks. Nauseous after a cup of tea. Worse smell of garlic, causes nausea. Worse tea. Worse smell of vinegar. Hands - Hands feel icy cold to touch. Cold sweat on palms with apprehension. Warm, glowing hands on waking. Fingers of left hand feel cold and numb. Fingernails swollen, hot, very sensitive to touch, suppurating yellow water or pus under the skin.

Chest - Constriction on waking, with wheezing. Tickling in chest. Feeling of anxiety in chest. Hard pain in the chest like someone was squeezing it. Tickling behind sternum. Short, sharp pains lower end of sternum. Sensation of dryness. Coughs - Coughs on waking. Cough worse in morning, better through the day and worse at night. Middle of the night, cough with catarrh at back of throat, better after a drink. Deep barking cough, with no expectoration, compelled by tickling in throat. Barking cough with lachrymation and nose running with clear fluid. Cough with wheezing, has to lean forward. Dry tickling cough from behind the sternum, aggravated by smoking and drinking. Cough from swollen sensation in throat. Cough relieves diarrhea, swallowing. Dreams - Confused, unremembered dreams. Frightening dreams. Dreams of death. Dreams of dead people. Dreams of crimes. Dreams of murder. Dreams of suffering animals. Dreams of children. Dreams of being busy. Dreams of high places. Dreams of journey by car. Dreams of escape. Amorous dreams. Dreams of loved ones dying. Dreams of their children. Dreams that she was pregnant. Headache in the dream and woke up with a headache.

Heart - Conscious of heartbeat. Feeling of anxiety. Single thump in the heart. Palpitations, pounding. Palpitations while lying on left side, with a sensation of buzzing as if nerves firing in the heart. Thudding palpitations, frightened him, thought he was having a heart attack. On climbing the stairs, three or four heavy beats of the heart with stiffness of the legs.

Back - Coldness in back. Sensation of dry, radiating heat at the sacrum through the night. Itching on back below scapula on coughing. Tiredness in back with aching. Weakness in back. Twinges of pain across back. Stabbing pains. Sharp neuralgic pain shooting from left shoulder near neck, like an electric shock. Aching and weakness in lower and mid-back. Aching pain in sacrum making him want to rock backwards and forwards. Lumbar pain, better hot bath. Aching pain, right lower inside angle of scapula. Deep, bruised Hydrogen pain between left scapula and vertebral column. Back pain on motion. Backache, better lying on the painful side. Tension of cervical region during headache. Breasts - Breasts enlarged. Shooting pain in the right nipple.

Neck - Stiffness in neck. Neck feels enlarged, numb. Feeling as if tendons in back of neck too short. Neck feels as if been struck a blow. Pain in right side, on swallowing cold liquids. Tension in neck with headache. Gland in neck on right side swollen, painful and hard to touch. Sensitive to cold, wanted a scarf. Red spots on left side.

Limbs - Heaviness of legs at night (Caust.). Heaviness of lower limbs asfromfatigue. Clumsy. Muscles in right buttock very sore. Pain in back of right knee. Aching in shin bones. Soreness and tenderness in soles of feet. Burning sensation of soles of the feet. Shooting pain in right heel. Throbbing pain in the big toe of right foot. Broken skin and redness between toes. Sharp neuralgic pain shooting from left shoulder like an electric shock. Splinterlike pain, right elbow. Numbness and tingling in arms. Aching shoulders and arms extending to fingers. Left arm aches. Pain in wrist after writing. Hands shaking while trying to write or after anger. Feeling cold, especially hands and lower legs. Coldness of right leg, right foot. Nails brittle. Piercing pain as if stuck with apiece of wood. Feels as if the skin is trying to burst out from swelling. Restlessness of legs at night. Cuts become slightly septic, tender to touch and swollen. Hydrogen Lungs - Breathing difficult on inhalation. Sighing, needing air. Wheezing on waking with itching in the back. Cough with difficult expectoration of very small amounts of thick, yellow mucus. Clear, white and bubbly expectoration hawked up from throat. Coughs, bringing up egg-white mucus, or a dark phlegm. Mucus difficult to cough up.

Sleep - Sudden sleepiness. Unable to get to sleep. Couldn't sleep with irritability. Insomnia. Sleepless from thoughts at night. Sleep deep and refreshing. Wants to sleep propped up on pillow because of sore throat and stuffy head. Painful to move from one position to another. Restless at night. Waking several times in the night. Woke in the night with a terrible fright, shaky, about to scream. Very warm in bed at night on waking. Perspiration all over. Uncovers limbs to cool down. Waking early. Very sleepy in morning, needed frequent short naps during the day. Attacks of yawning. Sleepy at noon could not stop yuwning, much better after lunch.

Skin - Herpetic eruptions. Sunburned mainly on the left side of the back, although the whole of him was in the sun.

Modalities - Better open air. Worse becoming cold and tendency to take cold. Worse night. Worse sleep. Worse morning on waking. Worse daytime. Worse from 9 p.m. to 9 a.m.

Larynx - Voice deep, with roughness and lots of phlegm in the throat. Weak and rough voice. Voice lower as if getting a cold, as if something stuck at the bottom of larynx. Tickling between larynx and sternum with dryness. Legs - Heaviness and restlessness of legs at night (Caust.). Legs feel weak, wobbly when walking. Calves feel heavy and tired. Stiffness of legs on climbing stairs. Tingling in legs, feet. Formication on the inside of the lower right leg. Hot thighs with cold feet. Lower legs feeling numb and cold as if dead. Coldness of right leg, right foot. Feet cold with hot flushes, while walking outside. Soles of feet felt numb when walking. Felt as though shoes too tight. Athlete's foot.

Teeth - Severe stabbing tooth pain throughout whole mouth. Pains unbearable. Pressing pain in lower incisors. Aching pain in teeth on right side, extending to right ear and top of right eye. Toothache on upper right side. Severe toothache, left lower side, with left sided earache, worse eating. Toothache at night. Woke with severe toothache, better drinking cold water.

Tongue - Tongue white, more in center. Small white spot to the left of the middle of the tongue, feels sharp, worse touch and eating. Tongue feels numb and smooth. Numbness of tip of tongue. Spot on the right side of the tongue with sharp pain, worse moving tongue. Feels like tongue has been cut. Vertigo - Dizzy on getting out of bed in morning. Lost balance slightly towards the right. Vertigo in waves, all day. Vertigo, worse on rising from sitting, moving head. Vertigo during headache. Nausea and vertigo. Vision - Specks of light, black spots floating across the vision. Lights in front of eyes when jumping up quickly. After looking away from a picture on the wall, retained white image on the vision. COMMENTS - Other remarks from the provers of Hydrog. include: Time sense seems warped. Time is different on this level, its moving very quickly. A lifetime is a very short space of time. Confused about what happened when and where, about what happened in the past. Problems assimilating the notion of time. Felt stuck in time. Relaxed attitude to work (curative). Concentration improved (curative). More efficient than usual. Ready to fill in odd spaces of time with odd jobs (curative). Felt alert and mentally active in the evening and night. Memory improved. Have given up my normal planning and making lists. I used to organize all the time (curative). Hydrogen Confidence is improved before and during teaching (curative). Less procrastination than usual (curative). Less nervous with strangers (curative). Usual tendency to bite and tear thumbs much better (curative). Mood better in the evening more cheerful and positive. Although feeling very tired, not feeling irritable or snappy as usually would when tired (curative). Felt emotionally ‘stretched out', but calm. Irritations don't make me so cross. The ‘stretchiness' absorbed the daily irritations, they didn't peak up enough to a point where I felt irritated and cross (curative). Dreams were vivid. Revolting dreams. Dream of a girl at school who committed suicide. Dream of participating in a play about death. Dream of my dead grandmother in the afternoon. Several erotic dreams. Difficult to pass stool. Usual diarrhea after headache oreating gone (curative). Expected diarrhea from anticipation and eating a full tea cake did not materialize (curative). Menses started again during the menopause after an absence of six months. Noticed mustache seemed less and hair was finer in a woman, observers agreed. Mustache in a woman (disappeared). Scalp less dry, less dandruff, less itchy (curative). Spot on hairline at the base of the neck, very itchy. Sore pimple on the back of the head. Usual itching of scalp has been absent (curative). Usual flatulence is improved (curative). Less stiffness and aching in the back on waking that usual (curative). Back much less strained on physical work than usual (curative). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i., Phos., Sulphur., Lyc. Calc. Kali-s., Ferr-ar. Nat-ar. Nat-phos. REFERENCES - Sherr.

Kidneys - Bladder feels full, but little passes. After just one cup of tea at breakfast, urination three times in twenty minutes. Urinate frequently due to nerves. Woke at midnight to pass urinate. Bladder fuller than usual on waking. Urine escaped with cough. Urine smelled strong. Stinging, burning pain along the urethra at the end of and after urination.

Perspiration - Cold sweat with paranoid anxiety. Clammy sweat in bed at night during sleep, with fever feeling. Waking from frightening dream in a cold sweat. Perspiration with heat and odor on waking. Cold sweat on waking from nightmare. Perspiration during chills (Verat.).

Temperature - Shivery feeling. Chilly with the influenza. Chill followed by heat. Fever during the night with vivid nightmares, with perspiration. Felt hot internally and externally with red cheeks. Slight fever on waking.

PHARMACY - hydro-c. Hydrophis cyanocinc- tus. Sea serpent. Pacific Islands, Australia, India and China. The tincture is made from the venom of the sea serpent. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blepharitis. Cervicitis. Conjunctivitis. Depression. Earache. Enterocolitis. Headache. Polyneuritis. Poliomyelitis. Menorrhagia. Myopathy. Styes. Vaginitis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hydrophis cyanocinctus is a venom of a sea serpent whose habitat is along the coasts of the Pacific islands, Australia, India and China. J. R. Reside carried out a double blind homeopathic proving from January to June 1958, on ten provers, eight men and two women using the potencies 6c and 30c. Hydro-c., from a toxicological point of view, attacks the peripheral nerves, giving a symptom table similar to that of poliomyelitis. Paresis, paralysis without sensory disorders. Stinging pains in the limbs and thorax. Dry throat. MIND - Depressive, clouded mental state, weepy, especially during menopause. Disgust for life. State of euphoria, followed by a period of sadness with tears, ameliorated by consolation. Irritable. Lethargic, sleepy, lacks initiative. Forgetful and unable to concentrate. Anxiety with clairvoyance.

Head - Headache with beating in the temples and sensation of a tight band. Headache with heavy head, worse on the left, at the front. Headache worse in the morning, from heat, better in fresh air. Pruritus of the scalp.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Burning, especially on the left side. Troubled vision. Blepharitis. Pruritus of the eyelids. Eyelids heavy. Styes, especially on the left.

Ears - Earache. Pains in the left earlobe. Deafness in the left ear.

Nose - Burning catarrh, ameliorated in the fresh air. Coryza.

Mouth - Dry, worse in the morning. Left maxillary pain, which prevents mastication. Toothache in the molars, on the left side.

Throat - Dry, burning. Tonsils sore. Tonsillitis. Pharyngitis. Hoarseness worse in the morning and after speaking. Laryngitis. Tickling cough and dryness in the larynx. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lach. - worse after sleep and when lying down with localization on the left side and pain in the precordial region with constriction. (2) Lath. - paresis of the limbs. REFERENCES - Julian.

Stomach - Nausea, thirsty for cold drinks. Epigastric pains and pain in the right hypochondrium, worse after meals.

Abdomen - Enterocolitis. Rectocolitis. Violent, sharp, stinging pains with feeling of tension along the colon, worse in the morning and on the left side.

Rectum - Constipation and acute pains after going to stool. Painful, swollen hemorrhoids. Anal pruritus.

Female - Menses abundant. Menorrhagia. Blood-streaked vaginal discharge. Vaginitis. Cervicitis. Salpingo- ovaritis. Pre-neoplastic conditions.

Heart - Pain in the precordial region, spreading to the left hemi-thorax, worse when lying flat. Feeling of dryness and burning in the thorax. Extra systole. Arrhythmia. Valvular disease. Coronary arthritis. Angina pectoris. Septicemia.

Limbs - Paretic and paralytic syndromes of the lower limbs. Painful paresthesia. Numbness, heavy feeling in the limbs. Stinging pains in the limbs and the left hip. Pain in the thumbs and arms, especially the left. Feet cold. Lungs - Dyspnea. Tracheitis and bronchitis.

Sleep - Sleep disturbed, woken by nightmares between 2.30 and 4.30 a.m. with feeling of anguish, heat and feels very ill. Wakes with a feeling of thoracic oppression. Calls out in his sleep. Worse at night and after nightmares.

Skin - Spots on the face and nape of the neck. Skin dry with chapped hands. Skin itching at different parts of the body.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse after nightmares. Worse on waking. Worse in the morning. Worse lying flat. Worse on the left side. Worse before menses. Worse from heat. Worse speaking.

Temperature - Profuse sweating without a temperature. Fever with shivering, inflammation of the throat.

full:
PHARMACY - hydro-v. Hydrophyllum vir- ginicum. Virginian waterleaf. N. O. Hydro- phyllaceae. Tincture of fresh plant in flower. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Eyelids, swollen. Eyes, inflammation. Rhus, poisoning.

HERBAL - The Hydrophyllaceae are nearly allied to the Borages. They grow among moist, shady rocks and derive their name from the small quantity of water held in the cavity of each leaf in spring. Hydro-v. should prove to be a good adjunct to Euphrasia. The older writers speak of it as an antidote to rhus poisoning. Eye inflammation.

HOMEOPATHIC - The only homeopathic experience on record is that of Dr. Hoyt of Indiana, recorded by Hale. Ten minutes after gathering a cluster of the blue flowers, Hoyt noticed his eyes began to water and burn with slight itching. By the time he reached home he was suffering severely, eyelids swollen, fiery red, some sensitiveness to light. The symptoms continued through afternoon and evening and kept him awake some time. In the morning, the lids were agglutinated and eyes sensitive to light. The burning and smarting were less, but lachrymation remained and it was a week before the eyes were quite right. Dr. Hoyt tested the remedy in one case of catarrhal inflammation of the eyes, which it cured. REFERENCES - Clarke. Hale.

Acute nervous exhaustion. Mania and chorea. Insomnia. Nervous agitation. Paralysis agitans. Tremors of disseminated sclerosis. Dry cough in tuberculosis. Uremia. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
