PHARMACY - lach. Lachesis muta. Bushmaster. Surukuku. Trigonocephalous lachesis. N. O. Ophidia. Crotalida. South America. Dilution of the venom. Trituration. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Amblyopia. Aneurysm. Appendicitis. Asthenopia. Asthma. Atheroma. Bedsores. Boils. Bubo. Bubonic plague. Cancer. Carbuncles. Catalepsy. Cecum, inflammation. Cellulitis. Chancre. Chilblains. Ciliary neuralgia. Cough. Cyanosis. Delirium tremens. Delusions. Diphtheria. Dog, bite. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Ears, disorders. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Eyes, disorders. Fainting. Fistula lachrymalis. Flatulence. Gallstones. Gangrene. Glanders. Gums, bleeding. Hay fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heartbum. Hemiplegia. Hemophilia. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Herpes. High blood pressure. Hoarseness. Hot, flushes. Hysteria. Injuries. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Labor, pains. Laryngismus. Laryngitis. Leprosy. Liver disorders. Locomotor, ataxia. Malignant, pustule. Mania. Manic depression. Measles. Meniere'sdisease. Menopause. Mercury, effects. Morvan's disease. Mumps. Neuralgias. Nymphomania. Otorrhea. Ovary, disorders. Paralysis. Perspiration. Phlegmasia albadolens. Plague. Pneumonia. Premenstrual syndrome. Puerperal fever. Puimdnary, edema. Purpura. Pyemia. Quinsy. Rabies. Scarlatina. Schizophrenia. Sciatica. Stings. Strokes. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Trachea, disorders. Traumatic, fever. Tumors. Ulcers. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Vicarious, menstruation. Warts. Whitlow. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lachesis was first introduced to homeopathy by Dr. Hering. His first experiments were made when he was studying the botany and zoology of the Upper Amazon forthe German government. With the exception of his wife, all those around him were natives, who told him so much about the dreaded Surukuku that he offered a good reward for a live specimen. One was brought in a bamboo box. Those who brought it immediately fled, along with his native servants. Hering stunned the snake with a blow on the head as the box opened, then, holding its head in a forked stick, he pressed its venom out of the poison bag upon milk sugar. Handling the venom and preparing the lower potencies threw Hering into a fever with tossing delirium and mania, much to his wife's dismay. He slept through the night and woke with a clear mind. He drank a little water to moisten his throat and asked his wife “What did I do and say?” His wife remembered and the symptoms were written down as the first installment of the proving. The natives crept back one by one next day and were astonished to find Hering and his wife alive. The snake grows up to seven feet in length. It has fangs nearly an inch long, with a reddish brown skin marked along the back with black brown rhomboidal spots. Nearly all the provings of Lachesis were made with the 30c and higher potencies. Like other snake venoms, it decomposes the blood, rendering it more fluid. It has a marked hemorrhagic tendency. Hemorrhages are thin, containing dark particles like charred straw. Vicarious hemorrhages, nosebleed, bloody urine etc. Small wounds bleed a great deal. Hemophilia. High blood pressure. Flushes of heat, rushes of blood. Useful during menopause and for those of a melancholic disposition. Malignant or septic states, gangrene, diabetic, traumatic, cancer, carbuncle, diphtheria, erysipelas. Purpura, diphtheria and other low forms of disease, when the system is thoroughly poisoned with profound prostration. Cellulitis with burning and blue color of the skin. Dropsy from liver and spleen diseases after scarlatina. Discharges are acrid and offensive. The ill effects of suppressed discharges. Intensively rapid onset of the disease with great prostration. Intense nervous irritability with restless tossing and moving about. Hysteria. Manic-depression. Hard throbbing or hammering pains. Neuralgic pains change locality with palpitations. As of thread drawing the part or spreading over. Epilepsy, comes on during sleep from jealousy, onanism, loss of fluids. Chorea from piercing the ears. Delirium tremens with much trembling and confusion. Trembling of the whole body of hands, tongue, etc. Catalepsy. Diphtheria paralysis and other disorders (Botul.). Diphtheria carriers. Great physical and mental tension. Nerves become very sensitive, especially the cutaneous and vasomotor ones. Excessive sensitiveness of the surface with intolerance of touch or constriction. Cannot bear anything tight anywhere. Sensation of constriction or tension, in the throat, abdomen, head. Sensation as if a skullcap. Ascending sensations in throat, from hot flashes, chills. Sensation of a lump in throat, abdomen, liver, rectum, etc. As if a lump rolls about in bladder. Blueness of the affected parts of hands. Excessive painfulness of throat, ulcers, spots on body. Drawing sensations in vertex, jaws, in the rectum. Symptoms appear on left side, then go to the right, especially in the throat and ovaries. Left sided paralysis after a stroke or cerebral exhaustion. Awkward gait, left side weak. Symptoms can develop in sleep and the patient wakes up from symptoms, at any time, day and night. MIND - Profoundly disturbed mind. Mental symptoms worse after sleep. Ill effects of grief, fright, vexation, anger, jealousy, disappointed love, masturbation. Ailments from night watching, over-fatigue, loss of fluids, over-study. Rapidly alternating states, exalted mind, rapid succession of ideas. Mental confusion. Weak memory. Frequent mistakes are made in writing and speaking. Very imaginative. Nervous, excitable. Restless, uneasy, does not want to attend to business, wants to be off somewhere all the time. Undertakes many things, perseveres in nothing. Great loquacity, rambling, with mocking, jealousy, mistrust, haughtiness, satire and ridiculous ideas. Frequently jumping from one subject to another, then sadness. Repeats the same thing over and over. One word often leads into another story. Irritable, irascible, peevish. Mischievous. Disposed to be morose or to quarrel. Complains of trifles. Irritability alternating with loquacious delirium. Malicious, wants to get revenge. Passion, leading to anger. Hateful. Malice. Violent anger and behavior. Selfishness, possessive, jealousy, suspicion and violence. Insane jealousy and suspiciousness (Hyos.). Quarrelsome from jealousy. Jealousy, as foolish as it is irresistible. Chronic depression from long-lasting grief or sorrow. Intense sadness and anxiety. Weeps from anecdotes. Grief andjealousy. Forsaken feeling in the morning. Sadness in girls before puberty. Depression worse before menses, better during menses. Depression since menopause. Aversion to company during pregnancy. Weary of life, suicidal depression. Manic depression. Mania. Great mental activity, ideas crowd rapidly. Desire for mental work in evening. Mania from over study. Mania for work, shopping, spending money. Necessity to do everything rapidly. Schizophrenia. Paranoid schizophrenia. Persecuted feeling, thinks herself pursued, hated and despised. Delusion of being followed by enemies who are trying to harm him. Mental confusion or alienation. Feels as if he had two wills. Derangement of sense of time. Hysteria after suppression of discharges. Memory active from suppressing sexual desire. Persistent erotic ideas without ability. Superstitious. Fear of snakes. Hydrophobia. Fear of being poisoned, refuses medicine. Fear of suffocation (Puls.), that heart will stop, of death, of going insane. Fears going to sleep, lying down. Delirium. Delirium and convulsions from night watching, over fatigue and anxiety. Visions and delirious talk as soon as he shuts eyes. Ecstasy. Talks, sings or whistles constantly, makes odd motions with arms. Incoherent speech, talks as it were in a strange language. Crawls on the floor, spits often, hides, laughs or is angry during spasms. Delusions and hallucinations. Feels full of poison. Nightly delusion of fire. Delusions of floating in the air. Thinks there are robbers in the house and wants to jump out of window. Religious insanity (Verat., Stram.). or mania. Religious affections in children. Continually moaning that she was lost. Fear of being possessed. Thinks herself under super-human control. Persistent thoughts of evil. Prophetic perceptions, predicts the future correctly. Thinks she is dead and preparations are being made for her funeral. Alcoholism. Violent alcoholism. Intoxicated state with fear, violence and mistrust. Intoxicated with jealousy, accusations. Delirium tremens.

Head - Headache, heavy, bursting pain, down to nose. Congestive headaches, rush of blood to head. Bursting or throbbing, in temples. Headaches with flickerings, dim vision, very pale face. Pain through head on waking. Pain at root of nose. Weight, pressure or burning of the vertex. Waves of pain, worse after moving. One-sided headaches. Migraine, pain extending to neck and shoulders. Sun headaches. Sick headache, worse left side. Headaches before menses. Headaches during menopause. Burning of vertex with menopause. Left-sided stroke, after abuse of alcohol. Perforating tumor of the skull. Does not want hair touched. Sensitiveness of scalp. Falling of hair, especially during pregnancy.

Eyes - Eyes watery from pain. Feels as if eyes were forced out on pressing the throat. Sensation as if eyes were drawn together by cords which were tied in a knot at root of nose. Lntra-ocular hemorrhages. Detached retina. Retinal bleeding. green or dry. hard, crumbling, white clay, putty like. Bloody mucus stools. Burning at anus after stool. Milk passes undigested in nursing children. Worms. Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if hair was pulled. As if white of egg had dried on face. As if teeth too long. As if rectum pricked with needles. Back as if broken.

Ears - Earache with sore throat. Tearing pain from zygoma into ear, with sore throat. Pulsations in ear. Ears sensitive to wind. Numbness about ear and cheek. Polyps. Earwax too hard, dry. Earwax like chewed paper. Hardness of hearing with lack of earwax. Blockage of Eustachian tube (Kali-m.). Sensitivity to sounds. Roaring and singing, better putting finger in ear and shaking it. Whizzing noise, as from insects. Cracking, whizzing, drumming, with reverberation.

Nose - Pain at root of nose. Cannot bear anything before nose. Hay asthma, paroxysms of sneezing (Sil., Sabad.). Stopped up coryza, preceded by headache. Complaints after suppressed coryza. Postnasal discharge of mucus. Discharge with every cough. Offensive, bloody discharges, corroding nostrils and lips. Blood and pus from nose. Nosebleed on blowing the nose. Nosebleed, blood thick, black. Nosebleeds with amenorrhea. Nostrils sensitive. Vesicular eruption about nose. Red pimples on nose of alcoholics.

Face - Blue circles around eyes. Purple, mottled, puffed, looks swollen, bloated. Jaundiced, chlorotic during heat. Pale. One cheek flushed, the other pale. Flushes of heat. Pain in facial bones. Trigeminal neuralgia, left side, heat running up into head (Phos.). Tearing pain in jaw bones (Amph.. Phos.). Lower jaw drops during coma. Itching of face. Enormous swelling of lips. Septic mumps. Submaxillary and cervical glands swollen.

Mouth - Copious, tenacious, thick, pasty saliva. Peppery, sour, coppery, nauseous taste. Bad odor from mouth. Cannot bear anything before mouth. Burning, in mouth with swelling of lips and gums. Gums, bluish, swollen, spongy, bleed easily. Aphthous and denuded spots with burning and rawness. Nursing sore mouth with swelling of tongue and lips. Stammering. Thick, blundering speech, cannot open mouth wide. Speechless after having a stroke.

Throat - Throat very painful, worse slightest pressure, touch. Sore throats, worse left side, swallowing liquids. Chronic sore throat with much hawking, mucus sticks. Throat pain extends to ear. Collar and neckband must be very loose. Constriction, better eating. Throat pit feels swollen or sore spot back of pit. Feeling as if something was swollen which must be swallowed. As if a lump in throat, ascending and is swallowed back again. As if hot lump or soft body or crumb of bread. Worse from swallowing saliva or liquids. Cannot swallow sweet or acrid things. Choking. Tonsillitis. Tonsils purplish. Quinsy. Purple, livid color of throat. Diphtheria, dusky, black membrane,pain aggravated by hot drinks. Septic parotiditis. Upper part of windpipe very sensitive to touch. Laryngismus stridulus. Larynx painful to touch. Loss of voice from paralysis of vocal cords or edema.

Stomach - Can bear nothing tight over stomach, must loosen clothes. Pit of stomach painful to touch. Soreness orcramp in epigastrium. Trembling movement in the epigastric region. Nausea from anything tight on throat. Nausea after drinking ice water, after going to bed. Nausea with great flow of saliva. Any food causes distress. Gnawing pressure, better by eating, but returning in few hours, especially with cancer. Belchings, before epilepsy, at menses. Vomiting of food, bile, greenish matter, mucus, pus, blood. Vomits during menses with headache. Stools - Stool lies close to anus without passing and without urging. Thin, offensive stools. Stools watery, light yellow, dark, chocolate-colored, grayish, like potter's clay. Stools hard like sheep dung, scanty and insufficient. Cadaverous-smelling stool of decomposed blood. Stools mixed with blood and slime, worse at night, after acid fruits.

Abdomen - Abdomen hot, sensitive, painfully stiff front loin down thighs. Cannot bear anything around waist. Tympanitic, sensitive, painful (Bell.). Cutting pain in right side of abdomen causing fainting. Burning like fire in hypogastric and lumbar region. Shooting pain in region of spleen, worse walking. Acute cutting, stinging, radiating from navel. Intussusception, threatening sloughing. Swelling in cecal region, must lie on back with knees drawn up, appendicitis. Pain from anus to navel. Strangulated umbilical hernia. Appendicitis. Peritonitis. Spasmodic colic, better bending forward. Incarceration of flatus.

Rectum - Constipation, offensive stool. Constipation, very hard stools, between menses. Constipation of pregnancy. Diarrhea alternating with constipation. Diarrhea in hot weather, from fruits and acids. Diarrhea after menses, during menopause. Diarrhea with frothy urine. Constant urging in rectum, not for stool. Hemorrhage from bowels like charred straw, black particles. Anus feels tight, as if nothing could go through it. Spasmodic pains in anus before and after stool. Burning in anus during and after stools. Burning, cutting, in rectum worse standing. Darting pain up rectum every time he sneezes or coughs. Itching at anus, worse after sleep. Discharge of blood or mucus from anus, during menses. Beating in the anus as from hammers with menses. As if a ball rolling when turning over. Fistula in anus. Hemorrhoids protrude, become constricted, purplish. Hemorrhoids with sharp pains on sneezing or coughing. Hemorrhoids with scanty menses, in menopause. Sensations - As if frightened by visions behind him. Feeling as if knives were being thrust into brow, as if tongue bound or tied up, as if a part of right side of head cut away. As if neck constricted with a cord. As if heart hanging by a thread and every beat would tear it off, as though heart turned over and ceased beating for a moment, as if heart hadn't room to beat.

Male - Sore pain in urethra, in forepart of penis. Prepuce thickened. Scrotum swollen to enormous size. Buboes suppurating a long time. Sycotic ulcers, with bluish areolae. Gangrene of glans. Strong sexual desire, ideas, without physical power. During sex, the emission is tardy or does not occur at all. Semen with pungent odor. Cheerful after night emission. Ill effects of masturbation.

Female - Acts especially well at beginning and close of menstruation. Premenstrual syndrome. Menses too short, too feeble. Menses, black, scanty, lumpy, acrid, vicarious from nose. The less flow, the more pain. Dysmenorrhea, on first day. Dysmenorrhea with pain in left ovary. Labor-like pains during menses. Uterine and ovarian pains, all relieved by the flow (Eupi.). Menorrhagia with chills at night, flushes of heat by day. Leucorrhea before menses. Leucorrhea, copious, smarting, staining and stiffening the linen greenish. Leucorrhea thick yellow, milky. Ovarian tumors. Left ovary, swollen indurated, painful. Violent pain in left ovary. Uterus feels as if the os is open. Sexual desire excited. Nymphomania. Menopausal troubles, like palpitations, hot flashes, hemorrhages, headaches, fainting spells. Prolapsed uterus during menopause. Food - Hungry, cannot wait for food, or loss of hunger alternately. Better after eating, after fruit. Craving for coffee, which agrees. Desires alcohol, wine, oysters, farinaceous food, pickles, sour foods. Worse tobacco, wine, alcoholic drinks, acids and sour drinks. Throat symptoms are worse by hot drinks. Thirsty but fears to drink.

Chest - Burning, stinging, like coals of fire from chest through to scapulae. Chest feels constricted. Oppression of chest during sleep. Sensation as if a plug (Anae.), which moves up and down, with short cough. Blueness of skin of outer chest. Scarlet, shining, herpetic eruption under breasts, worse scratching. Swollen glands in axilla. Garlic odor of sweat in axilla. Constitutions - Especially suited to alcoholics.

Heart - Anxiety about heart. Visible palpitations of heart. Palpitations with pain. Palpitations with fainting spells, during menopause. Palpitations, worse warm room. Palpitations after sudden excitement. Palpitations in morning on waking. Constricted feeling causing palpitations with anxiety. Heart seems to stand still and then starts with a tremendous bound. Irregular heartbeats. Pulse, weak intermittent, slow, irregular. Restless, trembling. Weak heart, turns over or too big. High blood pressure. Carditis. Pericarditis. Senile arteriosclerosis. As if heart were hanging by a thread.

Back - Backache with great restlessness. Small of back as if lame and weak, or as if sprained. Backache with abdominal cramps and throbbing headache before menses. Neck sensitive to the least pressure. Neck stiff, moves jaws with difficulty. Stiffness in sacrum. Neuralgia of coccyx, worse rising from sitting. Feels as if sitting on something sharp, must sit perfectly still. Myelitis. Sensation of threads stretched from back to arms, legs, eyes, etc. Breasts - Swelling of breasts. Breasts inflamed, bluish with blackish streaks. Fungus hematodes on right breasts. Nipples swollen, erect, painful to touch. Extreme sensitiveness of nipples. Child doesn’t want to nurse. Milk, thin, blue. Causations - Ill effects of suppressed discharges, injuries, sprains, puncture wounds, bites. Ailments from night watching, over-fatigue, loss of fluids, over-study. Ill effects of grief, fright, vexation, anger, jealousy, disappointed love, masturbation. Never well since menopause. Alcohol, delirium, tremens.

Limbs - Paralysis after stroke. Joints as if sprained, in morning on awaking. Bluish swelling of joints, after sprains. Erratic pains in joints. Pain in tibia after sore throat. Shortening of tendons. Sciatica, right side, better lying down. Sciatica, must lie still, worse by least motion. Rheumatism, with swelling of wrists and ankles. Knees cold or as if hot air is going through. Cramps in calves from fear. Toes feel broken. Foot sweat, foul or cold. Nightly burning in palms and soles. Tingling, pricking in left hand. Trembling of hands in alcoholics. Cracks in skin at the corners of nails. Felon, bluish swelling. Left arm numb, fingertips numb. Boils on thighs and fingers. Phlegmasia alba dolens.

Sleep - Afraid to go to sleep for fear he will die before he wakes. Sleepiness, yet cannot sleep (Bell., Op.). Wide awake in evening. Sleeplessness from cerebral irritation, burning soles, anxiety. Sleeplessness of alcoholics. Sudden starting when falling asleep. Children toss about moaning in sleep. Waking in fright at a trifle. Short naps disturbed by frightful dreams. Restless sleep, with many dreams and frequent waking, in morning is heavy and out of sorts. Frightful dreams of snakes. Amorous dreams. Sleeps into aggravation.

Skin - Dilated capillaries. Bluish, purplish appearance. Blue-black swellings. Cellulitis. Miliary eruptions. Purpura with intense prostration. Senile erysipelas. Black measles. Scarlet fever and scarlet eruptions. Pustular eruptions become black. Boils, carbuncles, ulcers with bluish, purple surroundings. Burning in ulcers at night. Varicose ulcers. Fungoid ulcers. Ulcers sensitive to touch. Dark blisters. Bedsores with black edges. Wens. Small wounds bleed much. Pyemia, dissecting wounds. Scars, redden, hurt, break open and bleed.

Modalities - Better with the appearance of discharges, warm applications, bathing affected part, open air. Better hard pressure, sitting bent, loosening clothes. Better cold drinks, eating, especially fruits, belchings. Worse spring, summer, sun, cloudy weather, extremes of weather, heat of room. Worse from empty swallowing, liquids, hot drinks, alcohol. Worse morning, after sleep. Worse from motion, standing or stooping, closing eyes, slight touch, pressure of clothes, around neck, waist. Worse from suppressed discharges, at start and close of menses, menopause.

Teeth - Teeth as if wedged. Chattering of teeth. Crumbling of teeth. Teeth feel too long in hollow teeth. Toothache, pain extends to ears. Toothache from getting wet. Toothache during menses. Gums swollen, spongy,bleed. Gums dark purples during dentition. Periodontitis with swelling of cheek.

Tongue - Tongue red, dry and cracked at tip. Tip red, center brown. Tongue mapped, dry, black and stiff. Dry stripe in middle of tongue. Anterior half of tongue red, smooth and shining. Ulcers on sides of tongue. Blisters on tip of tongue. As if tongue was going to peel. Tongue swollen, burns. Tongue trembles when protruded. Tongue catches on teeth. Sudden forcible protrusion and retraction of tongue. Tongue as if bound or tied up. Sharp, in root of tongue, when yawning. Vertigo - Fainting with pain in heart, nausea, pale face, vertigo. Vertigo on closing eyes, from walking in open air, before menses, and at menopause. Vertigo looking at the one and same object. Vertigo, relieved by onset of a discharge (menses or nasal catarrh). Vertigo, worse turning to right. Vision - Paralysis of accommodation, causes asthenopia. Flickering vision, as from threads, or rays of sun. Dim vision with black flickering, often makes • reading difficult. Blue ring about lights, with fiery rays. Glimmering vision, in sun, with headache. Sees zigzag figures during headache. Flickering vision with congestion of head. Defective vision, after diphtheria, extrinsic muscles too weak to maintain focus. Blindness with lung or heart affections. COMMENTS - Characteristic aggravation from sleep. Nash noted the case of an old, syphilitic patient who suffered from obstinate constipation and was taken with severe attacks of colic. The pains seemed to extend all through the abdomen and always came on at night. The man was not making any progress when, one day, he remarked to Nash, “Doctor, if I could only keep awake I would never have another attack.” And in response to an inquiring look from the doctor, he added, “I mean that I sleep into the attack and waken in it.” One dose of Lach. 200c cured the colic and the constipation too. High blood pressure. Hemorrhages contain flakes of decomposed blood, looks like charred wheat straw. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Hemophiliacs, bleeding easily (Sabin., Phos.). Nosebleeds or heavy menses. The heart feels too large, cramp-like pain in précordia. Constriction. Palpitations with numbness down the arm. Cyanosis. Varicose veins. Dark red eruptions, purplish swellings, black and blue spots. Small ulcers, sensitive to least touch. Buboes, plague (Naja.). Snakebites and infected wounds. Rabies, with thirst, spasms, sensitiveness and nervous prostration. Excessive sensitiveness of the skin with intolerance to touch or constriction. Sensitive because of uneasiness from pain. Pain as if burnt or scalded on different parts. Pain in the shinbones. W. J. Guernsey pointed out that such pains often occur concomitantly with throat affections, worse or began on the left. Sun-headaches. Headache with very pale face. Rush of blood to head. Throbbing headaches in temple with heat of head. Headache extending into nose, better when nasal catarrh comes on. Headaches, feels like the head will explode with blood. Fainting fits and vertigo on closing eyes, on looking intently at any object in morning on waking. Fainting accompanying other complaints, with pain at heart, with nausea, with vertigo and pale face. Catalepsy. Awkward gait, weak left side. Gressus gallinaceus. Low, muttering delirium. Intermittent fevers. Torpid state with cold limbs, tremor ofbody andhands, tremor of tongue. Tongue trembles, catches in the teeth or lower lip when the patient attempts to put it out. Numerous disturbances of sight and hearing. Clarke cured noises in the ears when worse after sleep. Tickling, irritating cough. Diphtheria, mercurial and syphilitic sore throat. Sore throats, worse after sleep, from touch. Dark, bluish, purple color, with burning pains that are worse heat. Worse drinking liquids and better eating solids. Sensation of a lump in the throat (Ign.). Touching the throat can cause suffocative spasms, cannot bear any pressure about neck. Pain from empty swallowing, liquids slightly easier, solid foods swallowed without pain. Prostration out of proportion to the appearance of the throat. Symptoms are worse on the left side or proceeding from the left to right. Threatened paralysis of lungs. Asthma aggravated by sleep, can wake up choking. The least thing coming near mouth or nose interferes with breathing. Hay fever with a headache extending into nose, worse on sup- pression of the discharge. Sore nostrils and lips. Pus and blood from the nose. Red nose of alcoholics. Sensitiveness of the respiratory parts to touch, constriction and worse by anything tight around the neck. Sinking feeling in the stomach, cannot go long without food. Symptoms are better after eating, especially after fruit. Unquenchable . thirst, but nausea after drinking, worse by hot drinks. Desires oysters, wine, and coffee. Alcohol aggravates. Everything sours, heartburn. Fetid breath. Acute pain in liver extending towards stomach. Appendicitis. Stitches in kidneys. Pain in the bladder and rectum. Desire to lift clothes up to prevent contact with the lower abdomen. Sensation as if a ball were rolling loose in the bladder or abdomen on turning over. H. N. Martin noted that the urine has little black spots or flakes like soot floating in it. Urine is almost black, frequent, foaming, dark. Urge to urinate after lying down, day or night, especially after sleep, more frequent in the night. Constipation. Atony of the rectum. Painful constriction of anus followed by collapse. Visible spasmodic tenesmus in paroxysms from two to five minutes, extorting cries, passes blood and mucus. Diarrhea is fetid, cadaverous. Tugging upward sensation. Full feeling in rectum and sensation as of little hammers beating. Burning in rectum. Stitch in rectum (upwards) when coughing or sneezing. Painful hemorrhoids, with scanty menses. Severe premenstrual syndrome, energy before menses. Water retention and weight gain. Very sensitive, to light and noises, cries easily and becomes irritable. All symptoms ameliorated from menses. Violent menstrual problems (Sep., Med.). Severe menstrual bleeding, dark blood with clots. Become weak and worn out from menses. Menses regular but scanty, pains better when flow is established. Symptoms occurring in connection with menses. In a case of Clarke's, Lach. 12c postponed the menses for a week. Lochia are thin, ichorous insufficient. Swelling, induration of the ovaries, especially on the left. Tumors. Menopause, sensation of pulsating energy. Hot flashes. Varicose veins, the whole leg is swollen and aches, sore and burning. High sex drive, or suppressed drive. Breast cancer, with a bluish appearance. Obstinate and distressing eruptions on the nipples and areola. Milk is thin and blue, nipples extremely sensitive to touch. Better from the onset of a discharge or blood, worse from non-appearance of an expected discharge, as in menopause. Suppressions, particularly suppressed discharges. Sensation as if a ball, lump or plug. Dislikes pressure or touch around the abdomen (Lyc., Chin.), or neck. Warm-blooded, worse heat. Symptoms begin on the left side and either remain there or proceed to the right. Particularly suited to persons who have peculiar sensitiveness of the surface of the body. Debilitated, weakened persons. Children and elderly people. Thin rather than fat persons, persons who have been changed both mentally and physically by their illness. Women who have never been well since menopause. Sufferers from effects of masturbation. Alcoholics. Persons who have been overdosed with mercury and for syphilitic disorders. Persons who cannot stand the sun and who are worse in summer weather. RELATIONS -Antidote to venom: Ars., Merc., Radiate heat outwardly, alcohol inwardly, salt on the effects of bite. Antidotes to potencies: Alum., Bell., Cocc., Coff., Hep., Merc., Nit- ac., Nux-v., Ph-ac., to the visible spasmodic tenesmus of rectum, Sep. According to Teste the chief antidote is Cedrón. It antidotes: Bufo, Crot- h., Rhus. Compare: (1) Puls. - menstrual cough, menses scanty, but pain worse as flow increases. (2) Con., Graph. - scanty menses. (3) Anthr. - carbuncles, boils. (4) Terebe., Kali-bi. - tongue glazed and shining, Apis, Lach. (5) Phos., Sulph. and Mur-ac. - piles during menses. (6) Bell, and Dulc. - paralysis of lungs. (7) Iris-t. - appendicitis. (8) Ph-ac. - disappointed love. (9) Lyss., Sabad. - throat affected left to right, S abad., more chronic.( 10) Cot. - menopausal troubles. Nat-m., Nit-ac., Crot-h. (11) Amph., snake lizard - right jaw swollen and painful, sharp pains, headaches, sharp pains. Eruption of vesicles and pimples. (12) Naja, Elaps., Crot- h., Lepi. (13) Nux-m. - cough of pregnancy, Lach, has a cough at menstrual period when it is going off. (14) Staph. - on swallowing, pain runs externally along parotid gland to the ears, perspiration impossible. (15) Sil., Caul., Sul., Ust. and Vib. - left ovarian and left inffamammary pain. Complementary: Crot-c. often completes curative workofLach. Also Lyc.,Hep., Salam. Incompatible: Acet-ac., Am-c., Carb-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.Phatak.

Liver - Liver region sensitive, can't bear anything around waist. Sore, festering, throbbing deep in liver. Acute, in liver extending to stomach. Inflammation of liver with abscess. Hepatitis and abscess. Septic gallbladder. Liver complaints of alcoholics. Cirrhosis. Nutmeg liver. Liver complaints at menopause or after ague. Lungs - Sensation of suffocation and strangulation on lying down, worse when anything is around throat, compels patient to spring from bed and rush for open window. Wants to be fanned. Feels he must take a deep breath. Cramp-like distress in precordial region. Breathing almost stops on falling asleep (Grind.). Can only breathe in upright position. Sensation as of a plug (Anae.), that moves up and down with a short cough. Large quantities of ropy mucus. Difficult expectoration, frothy, purulent, bloody with excessive perspiration. Watery, salty mucus, which has to be swallowed again. Hay asthma. Asthma, suffocating dyspnea. Asthma after scabies, if the itching ceases. Pneumonia. Hepatization, of left lung. Last stage of pneumonia. Bronchial attacks with cyanosis and cardiac disease. Cyanosis. Cyanosis neonatorum. Dropsy of lungs after scarlatina. Abscess of the lungs.

Kidneys - Sharp pains from kidneys through ureters. Small tumor in urethra causing retention. As if a ball rolling in the bladder when turning over. Pressure in bladder, with frequent urging. Inefficient urging. Violent burning during urination. No urine, no stool. Black, scanty urine with edema. Urine, frequent, foamy, dark, strong odor. Dark urine, with brown, gravelly sediment, like coffee grounds. Bloody urine. Albuminuria with hydrothorax. Dribbling after urination.

Cough - Tickling, dry cough, suffocative fits. Cough causes stitching pains in affected parts. Cough during sleep without being conscious of it. Very exhausting cough, sometimes causing vomiting. Cough as if some fluid has gone the wrong way. Cough after rising from lying position. Cough from smoking.

Perspiration - Hotflushes and hot perspiration. Bloody, sweat staining blackish, yellow. Garlicky odor of sweat. Profuse sweats with most complaints. Copious sweats at night, about neck, wakes him from sleep. Sweats in axilla.

Temperature - Chills begin in small of back, runs up back. Chills worse drinking. Chills with sweat. Numbing coldness. Feet icy cold. Chills at night, flushes of heat by day. Internal heat, with cold feet. Shivering without coldness. Shivering during fever. Heatflushes with menopause, on vertex, on waking, on falling to sleep. Fever with violent headache, great loquacity. Intermittent fever every spring. Paroxysm returns after acids.

name: Lachnanthes Tinctoria
author: Murphy
constitution: Chilliness. Cough. Delirium. Diphtheria. Headaches. Heart, pains. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia, typhoid. Rheumatism. Sore, throat. Stiff-neck. Torticollis. Tuberculosis. Typhoid fever. Wry neck.
keynote:
PHARMACY - Lachn. Lachnanthes tinctoria. Spirit-weed. N. O. Hemodoracae. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chilliness. Cough. Delirium. Diphtheria. Headaches. Heart, pains. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia, typhoid. Rheumatism. Sore, throat.…
full:
PHARMACY - Lachn. Lachnanthes tinctoria. Spirit-weed. N. O. Hemodoracae. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chilliness. Cough. Delirium. Diphtheria. Headaches. Heart, pains. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia, typhoid. Rheumatism. Sore, throat. Stiff-neck. Torticollis. Tuberculosis. Typhoid fever. Wry neck.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lachnantes grows in sandy swamps near the coast. The root is red and fibrous, sword- shaped leaves, hairy stem, and yellow, woolly flowers. It belongs to the same order as Aletris and is allied to the irises. A curious observation is that the white pigs and sheep of Virginia lose their hooves if they feed on Lachnantes, while the black varieties eat it without inconvenience. A remedy for rheumatic symptoms about neck. Spasmodic torticollis, painful torticollis (Caust., Mag-p., Rhus-t). Wry neck. Stiffness of neck, drawn over to one side in sore throat. Pain in nape as if dislocated, when turning the neck or bending the head back. Body icy cold, face yellow, tendency to sweat. Bubbling and boiling about the heart, rising to head. Bridge of nose feels pinched. Feeling of icy coldness in mid scapular region. Successfully used for diphtheria, typhoid fever, and typhoid pneumonia. Tuberculosis. Affinity for the head, chest and circulation. Very restless, throws herself about, feels weak. MIND - Restlessness, tosses about, with perspiration. Tossing about and whining. Ill-humored and sleepy. Despondent, bitter crying spells during headache. Sees images, while dozing through day. Great loquacity, afterwards stupid and irritable. Loquacious delirium with brilliant eyes and circumscribed red cheeks, at night between 1 a.m. to 2 a.m.. Great hilarity, especially in the evening. Excited over a trifles.

Head - Head feels heavy. Head feels enlarged, worse least noise. Circumscribed red cheeks, scalp feels sore, as if hair was standing on end, burning in palms and soles. Bridge of nose feels as if pinched. Right-sided pain, extending down to jaw. Scalp painful.

Eyes - Looks with fixed eyes. Bright, sparkling eyes with delirium. Pressing in eyes as from dust. Secretion of white mucus from eyes. Violent lachrymation and burning of eyes, sensation of dryness. Obscuration of sight, as if a cloud were before the eyes. Yellow spots before eyes. Eyes feel heavy, as if they could not be kept open. Sensation of twitching in upper eyelids.

Ears - Singing in ear when walking in open air. Tearing in ears. Crawling and itching in ears, better by boring with the finger, but immediately returning and feeling as if something had closed the ear. Almost complete deafness during fever.

Nose - Profuse nosebleeds, pale blood. Bridge of nose feels pinched.

Face - Swelling with redness and blueness under eyes. Pale, sickly countenance, face and lips bluish, eyes dull, feel thick and cold. Circumscribed redness of face with violent delirium and brilliant eyes. Yellow face. Sensation as if something were crawling over face.

Mouth - Saliva of tough mucus. Sensation if the mouth were sore and thick. Swelling and tension of the lips. Lips red.

Throat - Great dryness in throat, especially on waking in the night with much coughing. Sore throat with short cough. Itching when swallowing. Sensation of swelling in pharynx with stiffness of neck and head drawn to one side (diphtheria). Vertigo - Giddiness in the head with sensation of heat in chest and around heart and perspiration. Vertigo with icy coldness of the forehead. COMMENTS - Hering said the Nati ve Americans chewed the plant when they met the “white man” to give them a flow of language. Remarkable loquacity. Produces a desire to talk a flow of language and the courage to make a speech. Strong affinity for the head, chest and circulation. Sharp stitches in quick succession in the right side of the chest below mamma. Sensation of heat, bubbling and boiling in chest and region of heart, rising to head, giddy, breaks out into perspiration. Trembling of the heart. Tuberculosis when the neck is drawn over to one side. Rheumatism of the neck and stiffness of the neck. Stiffness of the neck with the head twisted to one (right) side, especially when occurring with a sore throat. Much dryness of throat, worse on waking in the night with coughing. Headaches of great intensity, generally right-sided. Sensation as if the head is split open with a wedge, with icy coldness of the body, crying spells, worse by vomiting. Toothache, worse eating and drinking warm things. Continued chilliness. Sensation as if a piece of ice was lying on back between shoulders, then a shock followed by coldness over the whole body with goose bumps. Cold attacks occur on moving, better after going to bed. During the cold sensation, the skin is damp and clammy. Fever with loquacious delirium, brilliant eyes and circumscribed red cheeks. Blueness about face, under eyes, and lips. Burning of palms and soles, under nail of left toe. Arthur Dalzell reported the case of Mrs. B., 43, who had fibroid tuberculosis of both lungs, collapse of right lower lobe. Great prostration and night-sweats. The bowels were alternately relaxed and confined. Pain and stiffness in the back, bruised all over, dry cough, roughness of throat, weak heartsounds. Bad sleep owing to a cough. Lachn. tincture, three drops every four hours, was given. In three days the prostration was diminished and the cough was much better, night-sweats and bruised feeling gone. From this time an emulsion containing cod- liver oil, liquor pancreaticus, eggs, cream, hypophosphites and eucalyptus oil were given in addition. The case went on to recovery. Dalzell also recorded the case of Mrs. R., 45, who was in the last stage of tuberculosis. Right lung consolidated, left in cavities. This patient had circumscribed flush on face, brilliant eyes, throat felt rough, overall bruised feeling. Remittent fever. Skin dry, except at night, when she had profuse perspiration. Constant dry cough. Muco-purulent expectoration. Lachn. tincture, five drops every three hours, relieved all the symptoms and procured euthanasia, the patient dying quite easily twelve days later. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dulc., Bry., Puls. (2) Fei. - nape of neck pains and great tension there. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sensation of qualmishness above navel, when walking in open air. Fullness in pit of stomach, beating as from a pulse, as if a hammer were beating on an ulcerated spot.

Abdomen - Rolling of wind in abdomen and discharge of flatulency. Sensation of heat through abdomen.

Rectum - Continuous stitch in rectum. Frequent unsuccessful desire to evacuate. Frequent stool, passes much wind. Sensations - As if head or vertex enlarged, as if split open with a wedge, as if hair standing on end. As if a cloud before eyes, pressing as from dust in eyes. As if something had closed ear. Bridge of nose as if pinched. As of something crawling over face.

Male - Violent burning in left half of the scrotum, drawing toward right side. Tingling and itching of scrotum. Perspiration of scrotum and penis.

Female - Menses too early, viscid blood mixed with mucus. Profuse, bright red menstrual blood. During menses, sensation of distention of abdomen, it feels as if it were boiling. Food - Aversion to meat. Much thirst.

Chest - Sensation of fullness in chest. Stitches on left side of chest, under right breast and under clavicle. Compelled to inhale deeply.

Heart - Stitches in heart with anxiety. Frequent violent pulsations of heart, each beat is double, one hard and full, the other soft and small. Trembling of heart with great debility. Sensation of heat, bubbling and boiling around heart region, rising to head.

Back - Burning in right scapula, in spine above sacrum. Burning in region of left kidney, extending towards right side. Pain and stiffness in back. Chilliness between the shoulder blades. Sensation between the shoulder blades as if wet with cold perspiration. Pain in nape, as if dislocated. Spasmodic torticollis. Rheumatism of the neck. Drawn over to one side in sore throat. Stiff neck, the head is drawn to one side. Wry neck.

Limbs - Tearing from the shoulder, extending to finger joints. Tearing in elbow joints. Tearing in knuckles of the middle fingers of the right hand. Thumb and index finger feel as if sprained. Burning of palms and soles. Cramps in the feet during night. Lungs - Cough worse in bed and after sleeping. Dry cough, as if it came from larynx with sore throat. Expectoration streaked with blood with severe pain in chest. Pneumonia.

Sleep - Sleepiness with yawning, eyes feel so heavy that she cannot keep them open. Cannot go to sleep easily. Sleepless or restless sleep with distressing dreams. After waking and stretching, a shock followed by chilliness and goose bumps all over.

Skin - Sensation in skin as if an eruption would appear. Pimples appear here and there, containing a watery fluid. Itching and burning in the skin all night, worse after scratching. Stinging, itching and tingling on thighs, legs, feet, arms.

Teeth - Pain in all the teeth when eating or drinking warm things. All the teeth feel loose and too long, worse in bed.

Bladder - Pressure on bladder while urinating.

Perspiration - Sensation the skin is moist and sticky. Perspires freely after midnight. Sweats during cold. Sweats with dizziness. Sweats in morning.

Temperature - Continuous chilliness. Icy coldness of body, perspiration, principally on forehead. The skin is cold, damp and clammy during the chills. Feels hot, but the chills run all over before the heat can develop itself. Flashes of heat alternating with chilliness. Fever with violent delirium and brilliant eyes. Fever with somnolency.

name: Lacticum Acidum
author: Murphy
constitution: Acidity. Aching, pain. Aphonia. Belchings. Bones, swelling. Breasts, disorders. Canker, sores. Coryza. Cough. Debility. Diabetes. Foot sweat. Gastroenteritis. Glands, enlarged. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Morning, sickness. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pregnancy, sickness. Rheumatic, pains. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Throat, constricted. Throat, sore. Trembling. Vomiting. Water brash. Weakness.
relationships: Compare: (1) Sarcol-ac. (2) Lith., Ph-ac. Lac-c., Lac-v-c., Lac-d., Sac-1. (3) In nausea of pregnancy, Nux-v., Puls., Ph-ac., Colch., Lyc., Lac-d. (4) Ip. - excessive hawking with or without nausea. (5) Caust. - phlegm in throat, cannot be hawked up, causing nausea. (6) Diabetes, Ph-ac., Acet-ac., Lac-d., Uran-n. (7) Flying rheumatism, Puls., Rhus-t. (8) Great discouragement, Psor. Incompatible: Coffee worse symptoms. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak..
keynote:
PHARMACY - lac-ac. Lacticum acidum. Lactic acid. Milk acid. Lactis acidum. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Aching, pain. Aphonia. Belchings. Bones, swelling. Breasts, disorders. Canker, sores. Coryza. Cough. Debility. Diabetes. Foot sweat.…
full:
PHARMACY - lac-ac. Lacticum acidum. Lactic acid. Milk acid. Lactis acidum. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Aching, pain. Aphonia. Belchings. Bones, swelling. Breasts, disorders. Canker, sores. Coryza. Cough. Debility. Diabetes. Foot sweat. Gastroenteritis. Glands, enlarged. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Morning, sickness. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pregnancy, sickness. Rheumatic, pains. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Throat, constricted. Throat, sore. Trembling. Vomiting. Water brash. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering noted that lactic acid was discovered by Scheele in sour milk, the result of the spontaneous fermentation of sugar of milk under the influence of casein. It is also met with in many vegetable products which have turned sour. Reisig first introduced it into homeopathy. Lactic acid has been proved in both the lower and higher potencies, but many valuable observations have been made on patients taking substantial doses for diabetes as it was often given for diabetes in the past. In these cases, the symptoms of rheumatic fever were directly traced to the acid. Pain, swelling, stiffness and tenderness of joints, worse by motion (as with Bry., which antidotes Lac-ac.). Flying pains about limbs. One pro ver had pain along the right sciatic nerve. The well-known effects of milk that has soured on the stomach and remained undigested were produced. Nausea, vomiting, burning and sense of weight. Weakness, as if from exercise, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic affections. Rheumatic pains in joints, knees, worse by motion. Trembling of whole body, while walking. Debility, weariness of the limbs. Acidity. Hot acrid belchings, worse smoking. Salivation, water brash. Morning sickness. Fullness or lump like puff ball in throat. Frequent passing of large quantities of saccharine urine. Diabetes. Sweaty feet. Breast troubles. MIND - Confusion. Forgetful, can’t remember a thing an hour after it has happened. Dislikes to read or think. Lazy. Aversion to business or what formerly was pleasant to do. Contemptuous. Sarcastic. Finds fault, very exacting. Believes all she says is a lie. Great discouragement during pregnancy.

Head - Congestion of head, painless with strong pulsation of vessels of neck. Head feels very large. Headache with sensation of fullness in vertex. Dull pain in forehead, just over eyes and extending into eyes. Pain in head and back all night. Pain in occiput and alternating between there and forehead. Head sore to touch. Fine miliary eruption on scalp.

Eyes - Sensation of fullness in eyes with headache. Eyes feel tired. Eyes feel as if they would burst. Marked protrusion of eyes. Hyperesthesia of retina, steady aching in and behind eyeball. Pupils dilated. Photophobia, direct light painful. Jerking of left upper lid.

Ears - Disturbed and troubled by noise. Roaring in left ear on rising, in afternoon. Singing, snapping in left ear. Pain from parotids into ear, stiff feeling in parotids.

Nose - Great sensitiveness of smell. Severe coryza. Stopped nose. Sneezing. Thick, yellow mucus from head to throat. Dryness of posterior nares, with hawking of mucus. Nosebleed every morning.

Face - Face flushed or congested from headache. Erysipelatous redness on left cheek and side of nose. Small vesicles on nose in morning. Parotids feel stiff. Pains from parotids into ear.

Mouth - Mouth and fauces very dry and hot. Much saliva in mouth, tasting salty. Copious salivation and water brash, especially during pregnancy. Acrid taste with nausea. Sour, coppery taste. Very sore mouth. Roof of mouth dry, feels burnt. Canker sores.

Throat - Dryness of throat with hoarseness. Dryness and rawness, extending to larynx. Sensation of aplug in the throat. Excessive hawking with or without nausea. Keeps swallowing. Difficulty of swallowing solids, liquids more easily. Fullness or lump like a puffball. Sense of constriction low down in throat, rough and dry. Intense burning in throat, fauces and esophagus worse by eructation. Fauces hot, dry and swollen. Aphonia. Hoarseness.

Stomach - Burning and weight in stomach. Burning, hot gas from stomach to throat, causing profuse secretion of tenacious mucus, worse smoking. Hot, acridbelchings. Food sours. Uneasiness in stomach after food and drink. Nausea with water brash or vomiting, better from eating. Nausea, morning sickness, especially in pale, anemic women. Nausea on rising in morning. Nausea after breakfast, not severe, but very persistent. Nausea like seasickness. Constant nausea, persisting for days.

Abdomen - Pains across bowels and lower right side. Bearing down pain in upper part of abdomen. Sharp pain across lower abdomen before stool. Left hypochondrium sensitive to touch. Sharp cutting pains and jerking in muscle. Dull pain in left groin over hip bone.

Rectum - Aching pain in anus. Soft, mushy stool, diarrhea. Greenish yellow stools with tenesmus. Very costive, stool once a week, hard, black.

Male - Annoying erections in morning, but loins ache too much to attempt sex. Seminal emissions three successive nights.

Female - Menses scanty, more profuse than usual. Itching of vulva during flow. Leucorrhea, staining linen yellow, when checked, nasal catarrh ensues. Pain as if menstruating, sitting with feet high lessens uterine soreness. Pain in small of back and lower abdomen. Aching pain in region of right ovary, worse by rapid walking or exercise. Morning sickness with salivation, nausea and vomiting, water brash better by breakfast. Food- Appetite impaired. Voracious appetite and great thirst. Eating generally improves symptoms. Nausea on waking, better by eating in diabetes or pregnancy.

Chest - Left side of chest sore and painful. Cutting or sticking pain in upper third of right side. Constitutions - Suited to anemic, pale women. Large doses disagreed with melancholic, choleric constitution, dark hair and eyes.

Heart - Sharp pains around heart, causes palpitations.

Back - Pain in small of back, extending into shoulders. Sore aching in lower part of back, worse when walking. Stiff neck. Stiff down between scapulae and across shoulders. Breasts - Pain in breasts with enlargement of axillary glands.

Limbs - Limbs feel chilly. Debility, weariness of the limbs. Weakness as if from exercise with rheumatic pains in the bones, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic pain in joints and shoulders, wrists, knees, with much weakness. Joints swollen, not tender, stiff. Severe, sharp pains in joints, stiffness. All pains worse by movement. Trembling of whole body while walking. Lungs - Saw-like rasping sound. Frequent deep sighing inspirations and expirations. Spasmodic, ringing cough, caused by irritation in throat.

Sleep - Stupid, drowsy all day, restless all night. Sleeplessness from vertigo, from backache. Dreams of sexual intercourse, with erections, no emission. Horrible dreams, of abysses.

Skin - Skin harsh and dry, no sweat. Itching and burning, worse by cold. Red spots or blotches on various parts of the body, particularly thighs and lower limbs.

Modalities - Smoking aggravates all symptoms.

Compare - (1) Sarcol-ac. (2) Lith., Ph-ac. Lac-c., Lac-v-c., Lac-d., Sac-1. (3) In nausea of pregnancy, Nux-v., Puls., Ph-ac., Colch., Lyc., Lac-d. (4) Ip. - excessive hawking with or without nausea. (5) Caust. - phlegm in throat, cannot be hawked up, causing nausea. (6) Diabetes, Ph-ac., Acet-ac., Lac-d., Uran-n. (7) Flying rheumatism, Puls., Rhus-t. (8) Great discouragement, Psor. Incompatible: Coffee worse symptoms. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Tongue - Tongue dry, parched, red and raw. Thick yellow coating on tongue with bad taste in morning. Tongue sticky, coated thick white. Tongue sore on left side. Vertigo - Vertigo when turning head suddenly, on stooping, on rising. Vertigo at night. Vertigo worse with heat. Vertigo as if tossed on a rough sea. with nausea like seasickness. COMMENTS - Cartier noted its use for acute gastroenteritis, six to ten drops in a small glass of water. It was used locally in the tuberculous ulceration of vocal cords. Nash regarded the concomitance of rheumatic pains as the chief guiding symptom here. He recorded a case of diabetes with rheumatic fever supervening, cured with Lac-ac. 200c. Constant nausea, nausea on awaking, before rising. Nausea in diabetes, pregnancy, or rheumatism. Nausea, better from eating, belchings, worse from smoking. Smoking • aggravates the belchings. Diabetes. Severe pains in muscles and joints after exertion. Chronic fatigue with flu-like symptoms since physical over- exertion. Chronic fatigue with muscle aches. Inoffensive, copious foot-sweat (Sil.). RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bry. (relieved sharp pains upper third right side, but soreness remained).

Kidneys - Frequent pain in kidneys. Frequent desire to urinate large quantities. Urinates day and night, the attempt to retain it causes pain. Copious urine, deep brownish red, with much reddish sediment. Sugar in urine. Morning urine contained a large amount of salt, in evening a large excess of sugar.

Cough - Hoarse, hard, dry cough with dryness of glottis. Spasmodic, ringing cough from irritation in throat. Cough from hot eructations. Cough with nausea and constricted feeling in throat. Constant cough worse spring and fall, with foot sweat. Cough worse from smoking.

Perspiration - Copious perspiration. Unusual perspiration of feet.

Temperature - Cold and chilly at times, mostly on limbs. Flushes of heat with headaches.

name: Lactuca Virosa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air, bending, sitting up. Worse from touch, crossing legs, sneezing, in a warm room. Yawning and stretching helps pressure in chest..
constitution: Angina pectoris. Anus, disorders. Ascites. Asthma. Breast-feeding, disorders. Constipation. Cough. Cramps. Diarrhea. Globus, hystericus. Gonorrhea. Headache. Heartburn. Hemiopia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Levitation. Liver, disorders. Musca, volitantes. Noises, eats. Pylorus, pain. Sleep, excessive. Smell, illusions. Spinal cord, pains. Spleen, disorders. Whooping cough. Yawning.
keynote: PHARMACY - lact. Lactuca virosa. Acrid lettuce. Poison lettuce. Opium lettuce. “Lactucarium” or Lettuce opium. N. O. Compositae. Genus, Cicoracee. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Specimens of both Lactuca vir. and Lactuca sat. might be included in the tincture. Tincture of…
full:
PHARMACY - lact. Lactuca virosa. Acrid lettuce. Poison lettuce. Opium lettuce. “Lactucarium” or Lettuce opium. N. O. Compositae. Genus, Cicoracee. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Specimens of both Lactuca vir. and Lactuca sat. might be included in the tincture. Tincture of impissated juice. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anus, disorders. Ascites. Asthma. Breast-feeding, disorders. Constipation. Cough. Cramps. Diarrhea. Globus, hystericus. Gonorrhea. Headache. Heartburn. Hemiopia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Levitation. Liver, disorders. Musca, volitantes. Noises, eats. Pylorus, pain. Sleep, excessive. Smell, illusions. Spinal cord, pains. Spleen, disorders. Whooping cough. Yawning.

HERBAL - The leaves of garden lettuce, Lactuca sativa, when too old and going to seed, have a bitter taste and the stalk contains a milky juice which is intensely bitter. This juice contains Lactucin and is common to all lettuces, but is especially virulent in Lact. vir. from which (as well as well as from Lact. sat.) Lactucarium or “Lettuce Opium,” is prepared.

HOMEOPATHIC - Brunton noted that Lact. has a soporific action and is used “instead of Opium to allay cough, quiet nervousness and induce sleep in cases where from idiosyncrasy, Opium is not borne.” This use of lettuces has been known from very remote times and has not been added to by old-school observers. The sleep-provoking power of Lact. is recognizable in sensitive persons who eat ordinary garden lettuce in salad. Boericke specified Lact. as a “true galact- agogue,” as it increases the milk in breasts. This remedy also acts upon the brain and circulatory system. Delirium tremens with sleeplessness, coldness and tremor. Hydrothorax and ascites. Impotence. Sense of lightness and tightness affecting whole body, especially chest. Marked action on limbs. MIND - Stupefaction of sense. Difficulty in thinking. Loss of memory. Anxiety and disturbed sleep. Great restlessness. Fear driving him from place to place. Negative thinking. Contrary. Excessive ill humor, provoked by slightest contradiction. Repulsive mood. Prolonged emotional suffering, resulting in emotional deadness orcoldness. Forsaken feeling. Disposition melancholy, fretful. Sadness with extravagant and exaggerated notions. Headache after grief. Foolish behavior. Plays antics. Jumping. Singing or sighing. Delusions, sees soldiers on his bed. Delusions, that he would be murdered. Vivid, exaggerated fancies.

Head - Empty sensation. Sensation of looseness of brain. Dull, heavy, confused, dizzy. Heat of face and headache with general coldness. Pain, stupefying headache, after grief. Headache with disorders of respira- tory organs.

Eyes - Biting in the eyes. Burning in eyes, especially in the lids. Redness of conjunctiva with increased mucus secretion in elderly persons. Pupils dilated. Cloudiness of vision, weakness of sight. Hemiopia. Flying insects before eyes, on stooping after a meal. Itching above the eyebrows.

Ears - Drawing pains in ears, shootings followed by tension in left ear. Buzzing in ears, ringing sound before ears, in evening, in bed.

Nose - Sensation as though end of nose were distended. Peculiar smell before nose and a similar taste in mouth. Coryza, followed by excoriation and dryness in nose. Frequent sneezing.

Face - Pale. Heat of face with trembling and sensation of swelling of lips. Quivering in lips. Tingling with a feeling of tightness on face. Lancinations in chin at extremity of sub-maxillary nerve. Swelling of the lymphatic glands.

Mouth - Dry mouth, without thirst. White coating on tongue, thick mucus, sore, as if burned at tip. Contraction under tongue. Sharp pain in molars on left side of lower jaw, as if they were being twisted. Soreness of gums, on an empty socket on masticating.

Throat - Slight burning in throat. Difficult swallowing with sensation as if uvula were raw with burning. Sensation of coldness in esophagus from eructations. Accumulation of mucus in throat, viscid mucus in throat in morning. Vertigo - Vertigo with heaviness of head and lower limbs. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo with sensation as if head were too large and expanded. COMMENTS - There are several recorded instances of poisoning. A man, 25, ate Lact. in a salad, 7 p.m. and went to bed at 9. He woke at 11 with sharp, colicky pains, soon followed by nausea and vomiting that lasted all night. He fell asleep at 5 a.m., but in the morning was astonished to find himself unable to distinguish objects clearly. A boy of 10 who ate the same meal became affected with lively delirium at midnight that lasted until morning. He jumped about on the bed, played all sorts of pranks and nobody could quiet him. He had no colic or vomiting. His pupils were dilated until the iris was a mere rim. Trying to read he mistook M for P and O for V. In his delirium, he had hallucinations, saw on his bed a soldier, an inkstand, etc. Both these patients as well as another had liquid stools. The dilated pupils persisted some time. Keynote indescribable sensation of tightness, affecting the whole body, but especially the chest. Intolerance to touch and pressure. Pain in spinal marrow even to cauda equina, streaming along coccyx. Right arm is much affected. Much yawning and stretching to relieve the squeezing of the lower chest. Squeezing in left breast. Feeling as if a hundredweight on chest. Feeling of relaxation in the chest. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Spasmodic cough in frequent paroxysms with feeling of suffocation. Attacks come suddenly without any apparent cause, induced by a violent tickling in pharynx and roof of mouth. Whooping cough, paroxysms preceded by anxiety. Antispasmodic. Chest symptoms are better sitting up. Lactuca virosa Tightness in the liver region. Enlargements of the liver with tightness. Stomach pain, better bending. Pinching in umbilical region, better crossing the legs. Constipation and diarrhea with many concomitant anal symptoms. Sensation as of a drop continually passing along the urethra when seated. Urine smells like violets. Hering noted “painful gonorrhea in females.” Used as a galactagogue (Aven.. Alf.). Extraordinary lightness of body, more pronounced in open air. Feels as if swimming in bed. Dreams of swimming in the air or of walking above the ground. The head feels light, empty. Sensation as if head too large, as if brain loose. Sensation as if looking through gauze. Mild sedative. Cured a case of hypertrophy of the ovaries in a woman of fifty as a consequence of a miscarriage twenty-five years before. The tumor was excessively large and the patient could get no rest because of the pain from the pressure. The rectum was contracted and feces evacuated with great pain. “Fatigue during stool,” and also “sleepiness during stool” were peculiar and may prove characteristic. Ebullitions rising up from abdomen suggest globus hystericus. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Vegetable acids and coffee. (In a proving of Lact., Acet-ac., aether and hoch. were more effectual than coffee). Compare: (1) Drowsiness, dryness and constipation - Op., Nux-m. (2) levitation, Stict. Puls., Ph-ac., Lac-c., Asar., Thuj., etc. (3) intolerance of anything tight around neck, Lach. (4) gonorrhea, urine smells of violets, Terebe. (5) squeezing in left breast, Bor. (6) Bor. has empty feeling. Coldness. (7) Helo., pain in soles as if he had jumped on a stone. (8) Bor., heart symptoms, Kali-c. and Kali- i., cough Dros. (9) Nabal. (10) Lach., Kali-c., (11) Spira. - galactagogue. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sensation of icy coldness in stomach. Sensation of retraction. Pains in stomach with contraction of pit of stomach, worse by pressure. After a meal, sensation of fullness in stomach with pressure downwards. Pain better passing flatus. Loathing, nausea, vomiting, sometimes with uneasiness at pit of stomach.

Abdomen - Sensation of weight, fullness. Movements in abdomen. Borborygmi, abundant emission of wind. Colic in early morning, tense abdomen, relieved somewhat by evacuation and passing of wind. Cramping pain, better passing flatus. Dull shocks or else lancinations in right hypochondrium. Contusive pain in liver region, in morning.

Rectum - Constipation, no stool the first day or else a tardy and hard evacuation (habitual constipation diminishes). Stool only after urgent calls and griping. Sensations - As if chest would fly to pieces. As if circulation in legs was suspended. Coldness of stomach, throat, chest, feet.

Male - Drawing pains at root of penis, in right spermatic cord and along internal surface of thigh. Diminished sexual appetite, chases away lasciviousness and voluptuous fancies. Painful erections during morning sleep. Swelling of a lym- phatic vessel in penis, following morning erections.

Female - Promotes menses. Menses too early. Bearing down and weak feeling about pelvic organs and general relaxed feeling. Painful gonorrhea. Food - Want of appetite, food is repugnant, no appetite for bread and meat. Food tastes sickly, bitter. Appetite and thirst increased. Desires milk, pickles, sour. Aversion to bread, meat, wine. Better from bread, coffee, vegetable acids, worse from milk.

Chest - Constriction. Sense of oppression of chest. Squeezing sensation in lower chest. Sensation of warmth. Pain on bending forward. Shaking of chest during cough.

Back - Tension in muscles of neck or right side, sometimes spasmodic. Lancinations under right armpit. Pains in spinal marrow, as far as the cauda equina and extending to sacrum. Contusive pain in lumbar region. Drawing pains in loins towards the groins. Breasts - Milk absent. Increase of milk in breasts (Asaf.).

Limbs - Cramp-like pains. Rush of blood to lower limbs. Sensation as if circulation in legs were suspended. Numbness while sitting. Coldness and numbness of feet and legs. Lame hip down left side, worse walking. Cramps in shin bones, extending to toes and side of leg involving calves. Tension in hollow of knee on rising from a seat, while walking. Tremor of hands and arms. Lungs - Difficult breathing. Suffocative breathing from dropsy of the chest. Irritating, suffocating cough. Constant tickling cough. Incessant, spasmodic cough, as if chest would fly to pieces.

Sleep - Irresistible drowsiness in daytime. Frequent yawning and stretching of limbs. Restless, impossible to get to sleep. Insomnia. Disturbed sleep from anxiety, cough. Position, lying on back impossible. Sound, refreshing sleep. Deep, comatose sleep.

Skin - Subcutaneous lancinating and pinching in various places. Inflammation and eruptions.

Modalities - Better in open air, bending, sitting up. Worse from touch, crossing legs, sneezing, in a warm room. Yawning and stretching helps pressure in chest.

Kidneys - Dragging pressure in region of bladder, as from urgency to urinate. Burning in urethra. Urine smells of violets. Urine clear as water, copious. Sensation as of a drop continuously passing along the urethra when seated.

Cough - Cough as from dust. Must hold chest with both hands.

Temperature - Slight shivering chill. Frequent coldness over back and head, with heat in face. Chilliness in a warm room with coldness of hands and feet. Dry heat of upper part of body, with icy coldness of feet.

name: Laetrile
author: Murphy
constitution: Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Tumors. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - laetr. Laetrile. Amygdalin. Pangamic acid. Vitamin B-17. Anti-cancer drug. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism.…
full:
PHARMACY - laetr. Laetrile. Amygdalin. Pangamic acid. Vitamin B-17. Anti-cancer drug. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Tumors. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Laetrile formula is laevo- D-mandelonitrile-B-glucoronide. Laetrile is a decomposition product resulting from the hydrolysis of amygdalin. This compound is chemically related to amygdalin, a substance found naturally in the pits of apricots and various other fruits. The term “laetrile” was first proposed by Ernest T. Krebs, Jr. in 1949. Most proponents of laetrile for the treatment of cancer use the terms “laetrile” and “amygdalin” interchangeably. Amygdalin is one of the first and best known cyanogenic glycosides. Neither amygdalin nor laetrile contain free cyanide. Amygdalin is a herbal constituent derived from the kernels of various fruits of the Genus Prunus (synonym amygdalus), which includes the plum, prune, cherry, peach and apricot. It is among the most ancient herbal remedies used against cancer. Apricot kernels have been in medical use since the days of Pen T'sao (an herbalist), in 2800 B.C., in China. The great Persian master of pharmacy, medicine and natural sciences. Avicenna (980-1037), recommended the use of apricot bitter oil in the treatment of tumors of the spleen, uterus, stomach and liver. Some doctors believe that laetrile relieves the pain of cancer. Experimental results show effects of amygdalin on breast tumors. Adenocarcinomas. Stoppage of growth of small tumors. Prevents the development of lung cancer metastases. Other reported uses have been in the treatment of high blood pressure and rheumatism. Toxicities are generally mild when patients adhered to treatment schedules. The side effects associated with treatment mirror the symptoms of cyanide poisoning, including nausea, vomiting, and headache. Fatigue, muscular weakness, pain. Respiratory difficulties. Decreased blood cell counts. Hair loss and mouth sores. More severe side effects are experienced when laetrile is given by mouth than when it is given by injection, including mental confusion, dizziness. Cyanosis, anemia, hypotension. Liver damage. Ptosis. Ataxic neuropathies, difficulty walking due to damaged nerves. Coma. RELATIONS - Compare: Ars., Cadm-s., Hydr. REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Lamium Album
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better on rising, sitting. Worse while lying down in bed, in morning, rising from stooping. Worse in open air, drinking, eating. COMMENTS - Farrington said, “Lamium has been recommended for external hemorrhoids. ‘Hardstool with blood' is the nearest symptom bearing on this.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls., All-c. (2) Members of the Mint tribe - Hedeo., Oci., Orig., Menth. (3) “Deep- in” headache, Bac. (4) Head moves backwards and forwards - Am., Cham., Lyc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke..
constitution: Blisters. Chills. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hemoptysis. Hernia. Leucor- rhea. Menstruation, early. Ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - lam. Lamium album. White nettle. Lamium levigatum. Lamium macula- turn. Dead Nettle. N. 0. Labiatae. Tincture of entire fresh plant while in flower and seed. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Chills. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hemoptysis.…
full:
PHARMACY - lam. Lamium album. White nettle. Lamium levigatum. Lamium macula- turn. Dead Nettle. N. 0. Labiatae. Tincture of entire fresh plant while in flower and seed. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Chills. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hemoptysis. Hernia. Leucor- rhea. Menstruation, early. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lamium was proved by Hahnemann and others, including Stapf. Affinity for female and urinary organs. Sensation in urethra as though a drop of water were flowing through it. Hemoptysis. Hemor- rhoids and hard stool with blood. Menses appeared too early and were scanty. Much leucorrhea with biting sensation or without sensation, white mucus. “Deep-in”headache (Bac.), tightness of scalp and a backward and forward motion of the head. Headache with backward and forward motion of head. Much uneasiness of mind and body, trembling of limbs, weakness during the chill. Tearing and drawing in the limbs. Blisters on heel from slight rubbing. Ulcers on heel (All-c.). MIND - Whining mood, inclination to weep, feels as if abandoned (Puls.). Great sadness with lachrymose humor. Great agitation and anxiety, which permit no rest.

Modalities - Better on rising, sitting. Worse while lying down in bed, in morning, rising from stooping. Worse in open air, drinking, eating. COMMENTS - Farrington said, “Lamium has been recommended for external hemorrhoids. ‘Hardstool with blood' is the nearest symptom bearing on this.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls., All-c. (2) Members of the Mint tribe - Hedeo., Oci., Orig., Menth. (3) “Deep- in” headache, Bac. (4) Head moves backwards and forwards - Am., Cham., Lyc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.
