PHARMACY - león. Leonurus cardiaca. Motherwort. N. O. Labiate. Tincture or infusion of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Dysentery. Hemorrhages. Miscarriages. Suppressed, lochia. Suppressed, menses. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The popular name of…
full:
PHARMACY - león. Leonurus cardiaca. Motherwort. N. O. Labiate. Tincture or infusion of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Dysentery. Hemorrhages. Miscarriages. Suppressed, lochia. Suppressed, menses. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The popular name of this plant sufficiently indicates its traditional virtues. The only experience with it is an involuntary proving recorded by Clarence Bartlett. A married woman, 40 took an infusion to produce miscarriage. Twenty-four hours later Bartlett saw her and found her vomiting and retching, passing bloody stools, suffering severe abdominal pains. The pains were provoked by drinking anything more than a small quantity of water, which she did to allay her great thirst. Dry conjunctive, and a dry, cracked tongue were noted. The bowels symptoms were worse midnight to 3 a.m. Ars. 3x relieved all symptoms. She did not miscarry. Influences pelvic organs, allays spasm and nervous irritability. Promotes secretions and reduces febrile excitement. Suppressed lochia and menses. Dysentery, with vomiting, frightful pains in abdomen and violent thirst. Tongue dry and cracked.

Eyes - Conjunctive looked as if wiped dry.

Mouth - Tongue dry, coated or brownish white, covered with cracks in arborescent arrangement, main crack down center.

Stomach - Vomiting and retching. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars. Compare: Hedeo. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Very severe abdominal pains with soreness to touch. When lying on side, better drawing up legs; when on back, better with legs out straight.

Rectum - During the night, frequent calls to stool. Stools dark brown, then bloody.

Female - Suppressed lochia and menses. Tends to miscarriages. Food - Intense thirst, yet drinking more than a very slight quantity of water, warm or cold, provokes epigastric pains.

name: Lepidium Bonariense
author: Murphy
constitution: Breasts disorders. Cough. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Indigestion. Rheumatism.
keynote:
PHARMACY - lepi. Lepidium bonariense. Brazilian cress. Lepidium mastruco. Senebiera pinnatifida. N. O. Crucifere or Brassicacee. Tincture and trituration of fresh leaves. Historical dose: Tincture, trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Breasts disorders. Cough. Headaches.…
full:
PHARMACY - lepi. Lepidium bonariense. Brazilian cress. Lepidium mastruco. Senebiera pinnatifida. N. O. Crucifere or Brassicacee. Tincture and trituration of fresh leaves. Historical dose: Tincture, trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Breasts disorders. Cough. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Indigestion. Rheumatism.

HERBAL - Lepidium is a Brazilian cress. Mure noted that “It is very common in the neighborhood of Rio, where it is found along the roads and in stony regions.” It is a great remedy in domestic practice in Brazil and is used for purposes similar to those for which Am. is used. All the Lepidium are anti-scorbutic and Lepidium oleraceum, the New Zealand variety, was eagerly sought after as a remedy for scurvy by the early voyagers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Disorders of breasts, heart. Heart symptoms with numbness and pain in left arm, sensation of sinking in pit of stomach. Sensation of a tight girdle around chest, as of a knife piercing the heart. Sharp pain in left side of head, face, chest, hip to knee. Pain in neck, back and limbs. A streak of pain from the temple to the chin, as if the face were cut with a razor. Burning in the throat, roaring in ears. MIND - Sad and quarrelsome. Inability to think. Imagined the floor sinking under her. Imagines herself pursued by a phantom in a churchyard, cries with loss of voice next morning. COMMENTS - Mure's proving of Lepi. brought out some distinctive symptoms on the left side of the head, in the limbs, and especially in the heart. Heart symptoms with numbness and pain in the left arm. Sinking feeling in the pit of the stomach indicating an action in the solar plexus. Darting pains. Sharp, throbbing pains. Worse from stooping, turning head to the right, when covered. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Am., Lach. (2) Brass., Cheir.. Thlaspi., Armor, sat., Raph., Sinap. (3) Spig., Kalm., Lycps. - heart problems. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Leprominium
author: Murphy
constitution: Acne, vulgaris. Alopecia. Aphonia. Dermatitis. Edema. Erythema multiforme. Flatulence. Gingivitis. Glaucoma. Immune, disorders. Iritis. Kaposi's, sarcoma. Leprosy. Leucoderma. Leukemia. Lichen, planus. Lipoma. Lupus, erythematosus. Lupus, vulgaris. Lymphoma. Molluscum, contagiosum. Neuritis. Neurofibromatosis. Numbness. Osteoarthritis. Pityriasis. Psora. Psoriasis. Rhinitis. Ringworm. Sarcoidosis.
keynote:
PHARMACY - lepro. Leprominium. Leprosy nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne, vulgaris. Alopecia. Aphonia. Dermatitis. Edema. Erythema multiforme. Flatulence. Gingivitis. Glaucoma. Immune, disorders. Iritis. Kaposi's, sarcoma. Leprosy. Leucoderma. Leukemia.…
full:
PHARMACY - lepro. Leprominium. Leprosy nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne, vulgaris. Alopecia. Aphonia. Dermatitis. Edema. Erythema multiforme. Flatulence. Gingivitis. Glaucoma. Immune, disorders. Iritis. Kaposi's, sarcoma. Leprosy. Leucoderma. Leukemia. Lichen, planus. Lipoma. Lupus, erythematosus. Lupus, vulgaris. Lymphoma. Molluscum, contagiosum. Neuritis. Neurofibromatosis. Numbness. Osteoarthritis. Pityriasis. Psora. Psoriasis. Rhinitis. Ringworm. Sarcoidosis. Scleroderma. Skin, disorders. Tinea versicolor. Urticaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - Leprosy is a disfiguring, crippling disease prevalent in tropical countries. Dr. Vakil introduced Leprominium, using signs and symptoms collected from 100 patients suffering from various types of leprosy. There are two preparations. The first, Leprominium H, was prepared from a leprous nodule from the ear of a patient where the presence of lepra bacilli was microscopically demonstrated. The second, Leprominium A, is used for ascertaining the reactivity of the patient, and was prepared from the lepra bacilli cultured on the foot web of an armadillo. MIND - Meticulous. Mild or irritable. Brooding. Weeping. Attributes disease to fate. Hopeful of recovery. Fearless. Aversion to begging. Feels rejected. Likes company. Desires sympathy, yet secludes self to hide early stages of disease. Religious melancholy. Desire to put on white colored clothes, aversion to black colored clothes. Loathes life, but not suicidal.

Head - Alopecia areata. Hair loss on hy- popigmented patches. Hair turns gray prematurely. Hemicrania.

Eyes - Swelling, puffy, baggy under eyes. Ectropion. Cannot close the eyes completely, sleeps with eyes half open. Eyelashes drop off. Red, painless discoloration. Sensation of heat. Xerophthalmia. Dryness, with bland or acrid lachrymation, worse from light, sun. Itching and agglutination. Photophobia. Squints. Conjunctivitis. Scleritis. Interstitial keratitis. Iritis, iridocyclitis. Trachoma. Corneal opacity. Herpes simplex on cornea. Glaucoma. Cataract formation, left to right. Blindness.

Ears - Chronic otorrhea. Thickening and nodulation of the ear. Appearance as if had rat-bite.

Nose - Nasal obstruction. Clinkers and scabs. Offensive scabs from nose but patient cannot smell. Waxy nose. Flattened tip. Collapse of the nose. Depressed nose. Atrophic rhinitis. Atrophy of the anterior and inferior turbinate. Perforation of septum. Nosebleeds, worse cold, wet on head, washing face, or sneezing.

Face - Anesthesia of the face, anesthetic patches. Numbness and cobweb sensation. Deformed, leonine, prematurely old appearance. Thickened skin of the face with permanent wrinkling. Nodules on the face, nodulation and ulceration of nose and lips. Edema, angioneurotic. Palsy. Paralysis. Trigeminal neuralgia. Waxy or oily look. Outer one third of eyebrows lost. Eyelashes lost. Mustache hair lost in the middle.

Mouth - Swelling lips. Flat-topped nodules on tongue, lips. Deep fissure in tongue. Glossitis. Adherent uvula to soft palate. Uvula ulceration. Infiltration and nodules on uvula and soft palate. Small ulcers. Gums bleed easily. Gingivitis. Turgid and swollen gums, shiny purplish in color.

Throat - Cicatrices, laryngeal and pharyngeal constriction. Sensation of something stuck in throat. Hoarseness of voice. Loss of voice, complete aphonia. Vertigo - Weak feeling, blackout. Vertigo with nausea, worse opening eyes, sun. COMMENTS - Vakil concluded that Lepro. should prove to be a useful nosode on the basis of symptom similarity and also as an intercurrent remedy to clear the miasmatic background. He noted that leprosy resembles many skin conditions, including leucoderma, nutritional discolouration of the skin, macular syphilides, tinea versiclour, lupus erythematosus, and lupus vulgaris. Neurofibromatosis, cutaneous sarcoidosis, leukaemia cutis, Kaposi's sarcoma, subcutaneous phycomycosis, lymphoma. Seborrheic dermatitis, erythema multiforme, alopecia areata. Ringworm of the skin, psoriasis, lichen planus, pityriasis rosea, urticaria, scleroderma. Lipoma, acne vulgaris, molluscum contagiosum etc. Leprosy can resemble progressive muscular atrophy, ainhum, gangrene, mango-toe, peripheral neuritis, Bell's palsy, Dupuytren's contracture, nasal deformities, maralaga paresthetica, carpal tunnel syndrome, syringomyelia, tabes dorsalis, and spina bifida. Leprosy also resembles syphilis to a great extent. Leprosy affects the reticuloendothelial and immune system. The disease traumatizes the mind of the individual, and gives rise to symptoms resembling anxiety neurosis, depression and melancholia. As it resembles many diseases, some of them chronic and intractable, and as this disease was widespread in many countries, “lepra” can be considered as a separate miasm. For complaints that develop slowly but give rise to irreversible pathological changes. Vakil suggested that as Bac. andTub. have separate spheres of action, Leprominium H and Leprominium A should have separate spheres of action. Leprominum Vakil noted the case of a female child, 6, came to the out-patient department of the Government Homeopathic Hospital with a rough patch of skin just near the right cubital fossa since she was 2. It was roughly 2 inches by 4 inches and itched slightly. There was thick scab formation with a raw surface underneath. Mez. 30c was prescribed on the symptoms chilliness, possible bad effects of vaccination, and itching from touch. A small scab came off within a week, but there was no further improvement. Vakil waited for 2 months, and was considering repeating the Mez. in a higher potency when he noticed an anesthetic patch on the back of the woman who accompanied her, who turned out to be the girl’s neighbor. Additional symptoms included a religious feeling, desire for white clothes, sympathetic and desiring sympathy for herself, tendency to catch cold, desire for green chilies and an obstinate skin condition. Vakil prescribed Lepro. A 30x, single dose. To the surprise of all, the scabs started coming off within a week. By the end of the month she was 80% better. It was noticed that immediately after the administration of the nosode she had semi-solid stools with mucus and running of the nose for a week. RELATIONS - Compare: Psor., Sulph. Mez. REFERENCES - Vakil.

Abdomen - Flatulence in lower part of abdomen. Passing flatus ameliorates.

Rectum - Constipation. Semi-solid stools with mucous, without pain in abdomen.

Male - Gynecomastia. Sexual desire absent. Desire increase, with nocturnal emissions. Enlarged testes. Impotency. Aspermatogenesis. Oligospermia.

Female - Menopause early. Sexual desire absent.

Limbs - Anesthesia of hands, feet. Heat in palms, soles. Ascending coldness. Hands andfeet icy cold. Sensation of ice in limbs, better warm clothes. Numbness and tingling. Ascending numbness. Peripheral neuritis. Paralysis, paraplegia. Edema of the feet, worse evening, walking, hanging feet down. Wrist drop, foot drop. Pain in limbs, massaging ameliorates. Pain in knee joints, worse initial motion, better continued motion. Osteoarthritis. Nodules like neurofibromatosis. Deformities of limbs. Patches hypopigmented, well defined, thickened, raised. Sensation loss on hypopigmented patches. Non-healing ulcers. Gangrene. Maggots. Lungs - Tendency to catch cold. Pulmonary tuberculosis. Difficulty breathing.

Sleep - Eyes remain half open during sleep. Dreams frightful, unremembered. Dreams of dead people, dead relatives. Refreshed on waking.

Skin - Lupus vulgaris. Anesthesia, hy- poesthesia or thickened erythematous anesthetic patches. Neurofibromatosis. Discoloration, dark pigmentation. Dryness of whole body, in many patients with scanty perspiration. Cracks deep in palms and soles. Erythema multiforme, ulcerous lesions. Nodules, small, pe- dunculated. Eruptions bullous, macules, flat, hypopigmented or erythematous. Pemphigoid scabs, dark brown small, scaling, resembling exfoliative dermatitis. Ichthyosis. Psoriasis, itching all over. Ringworm. Urticaria. Scabies. Pellagra. Skin sticking to the bones giving a shiny appearance like scleroderma.

Fever - Scanty perspiration. Rigors with fever. Remittent or intermittent fever with infections. Malaria giving rise to lepra reaction. Food - Thirst increased. Desires green chilies, meat, fish, spicy, sour, ice cold water. Aversion to milk, sweets, worse from sour food.

Teeth - Loose teeth, because of changes in the bones which secure the teeth. Upper Leprominum central and lateral incisor dropping out.

Kidneys - Glomerulonephritis. Nephritic syndrome. Urination frequency increased in some patients. Intermittent flow. Urination painful, from walking in sun.

Cough - Chronic cough in some smokers with emphysematous changes.

name: Leptandra Virginica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from lying on abdomen, on side. Worse fromcolddrinks, exposure to wet weather, motion, periodically..
constitution: Ascites. Bilious, attack. Bilious, fever. Black, stools. Constipation. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Headaches. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Remittent fever infantile. Typhoid, fevers. Yellow fever.
keynote: PHARMACY - lept. Leptandra virginica. Culver's root. Veronica virginica. Black root. Culver'sphysic. Tall speedwell. N. O. Scrophu- lariaceae. Tincture of resinoid Leptandrin. Tincture of fresh root of second year. Trituration of dried root. A fresh plant tincture should also be…
full:
PHARMACY - lept. Leptandra virginica. Culver's root. Veronica virginica. Black root. Culver'sphysic. Tall speedwell. N. O. Scrophu- lariaceae. Tincture of resinoid Leptandrin. Tincture of fresh root of second year. Trituration of dried root. A fresh plant tincture should also be made and tested. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascites. Bilious, attack. Bilious, fever. Black, stools. Constipation. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Headaches. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Remittent fever infantile. Typhoid, fevers. Yellow fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Leptandra, in the form of the resinoid Leptandrin, was proved by Burt. As one of the grand characteristics of it relative Digitalis is white stools, so the grand characteristic of Leptandra is black stools. Great varieties of stool, in the later stages of the proving it became dysenteric and mixed with shreds. Constipation with hard black stool, followed by softer stools. Liver symptoms, with adull, heavy, frontal headache. These symptoms confirm the use of the drug by eclectics as a kind of “vegetable calomel.” Sensation as if something was passing out of rectum. Farrington noted the dull aching in the right hypochondrium, gallbladder and back of liver, accompanied by soreness. Burning distress in and about liver after spreading to stomach and bowels, with drowsiness and despondency. Bilious and typhoid fevers with black, tarry stools. Eye symptoms (Euphr.). Generally rightside. Chilly sensation along the spine and down right arm. Pains in right shoulder and arm. Symptoms are worse by motion, rising causes nausea and faintness. Weakness, so great he is hardly able to stand. MIND - Hopeless, despondent and drowsy. Sadness with liver troubles. Irritable. Anxiety in abdomen after stool. Sensitive to penetrating noises. Weary, can hardly walk.

Head - Dull pain, vertigo, drowsiness and depression. Dull frontal headache, with aching in navel. Smarting and aching in eyes.

Eyes - Smarting and aching in eyes with dull pain in eyeballs. Profuse lachrymation. Lids agglutinated.

Mouth - Tongue, yellow or black down center. Flat taste.

Stomach - Craving for cold drinks, which aggravate burning and aching in stomach. Sinking at the pit of stomach. Great distress in stomach and small intestines with immediate desire for stool. Nausea and deathly faintness on rising. Bilious vomiting. Vomiting of bile, yellow tongue, shooting pains about liver, black stools. Stools - Jaundice with clay-colored stools. Stools, muddy, watery, worse in morning. Stools, tarry or black, foul with pain at umbilicus. Typhoid stools turn black and look like tar. Stingy, waxy or spurting stool in the morning with pain at navel.

Abdomen - Sore or dull, burning ache over liver or near gall bladder, extending down over bowels to navel or towards left scapula or along spine, which feels chilly. Constant dull aching in umbilical region. Great distress in stomach and intestines with desire for stool.

Rectum - Prolapse of rectum with hemorrhoids. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Rectal hemorrhage.

Female - Menses, suppressed or retarded with liver affection. Warm, watery leucorrhea, runs down the limbs, from ulceration of the os. Food - Canine hunger. Craving for cold food and drinks, raw food, salads. Worse fats, rich foods, meat and vegetables.

Heart - Soreness in heart. Pulse slow and full.

Back - Chilly sensation in shoulders and down back. Sore, lame feeling in small of back. Constant distress with very sharp pains by spells in lumbar region.

Limbs - Pain in sciatic nerve (left), worse on sitting. Nails very thin, soft and splitting.

Sleep - Sleepiness with liver troubles. Sound sleep. Sleep restless after midnight, feels very ill next day.

Skin - Jaundice. Dry, hot skin.

Modalities - Better from lying on abdomen, on side. Worse fromcolddrinks, exposure to wet weather, motion, periodically.

Liver - Acute liver conditions. Dull, burning aching in liver, worse near gallbladder. Sore or dull pain, worse from touch or pressure. Burning distress in back part of liver and spine. Liver swollen transversely. Periodical liver derangement, every two or three months. Bilious states. Gallstones. Jaundice. Hepatitis. Portal vein congestion.

Kidneys - Red or orange colored urine with dull aching in lumbar region.

Temperature - Chilly along the spine and down the arm. Shivering or dry, hot skin, limbs cold and numb tongue black down center. Bilious typhoid fever. COMMENTS - Affects the right side and liver. Bilious states. Enfeebled portal circulation. Hemorrhages due to liver disorders. Jaundice and black, tarry stools. Conditions with black, tarry stools. Melanotic stools. Hepatitis. History of cirrhosis, hepatitisjaundice or colon cancer with dried blood in the stools. Colon cancer. Weakness, hardly able to stand or walk. Typhoid. Malarial conditions. Useful as an herbal tonic for the liver. Hale noted the order of the different kinds of stools in the proving. First there are black, thick, tar-like, fetid stools. This is followed by thinner, brownish, often fetid stools. Then stools of mixed mucus, flocculent and watery matter with yellow bile or blood. Finally, there is mucous, bloody stool mixed with shred-like substances, often pure blood. Hale said it is only in cases of dysentery that have developed in this way that Lept. is curative, not in cases primarily dysenteric. Cases due to sudden climatic changes have been cured by it. Neidhard observed a periodicity in cases cured by him. Periodical, occurring every two or three months, yellow- coated tongue, constant nausea with vomiting of bile. Shooting or aching pains in region of liver, loss of appetite, urine brownish or very dark, often pain in transverse colon, giddiness. Characteristic very dark, almost black stools. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Podo.. Iris, Bry., Merc., Ptel., Myric. (2) Like Dig. and Tab. it has sinking at the pit of the stomach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Levico has a high reputation among health resorts for nervous and skin cases, favoring assimilation and increasing nutrition. Burnett is the only homeopathic authority. He said “Levico in 5 to 10 drop doses is a valuable intercurrent to help in grave cases where there is much debility. Notably after the searching remedies such as Bacillinum.” Lev. is supplied in two strengths, the strong and the weak. Either may be used in the doses indicated by Burnett, which is much smaller than that usually prescribed. Chronic skin diseases. Chorea minor, spasms in scrofulous and anemic children. Debility. Favors assimilation and increases nutrition. REFERENCES - Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - levo. Levomepromazine. Allopathic drug. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Agoraphobia. Alcoholism. Allergies. Anorexia. Athetosis. Chorea. Epilepsy. Hypotension. Hypothyroidism. Mental, disorders. Myoclonia. Parkinson's disease. Tachycardia. Wilson's Disease.

HOMEOPATHIC - Symptoms of the toxicologic iatrogenic effects of the drug. The salt, used therapeutically, is the maleate. Depressive action, anti-convulsive, sedative, anti-emetic, anti-histaminic. It is used in psychiatry for maniacal cases, conditions of agitation, delirium and hallucination in the form of tablets of 5 mg and 25 mg. Symptoms result from the toxicology of the product, the clinical case of a female patient in Brussels, from self- observation by a pharmacist, and from the proving by O. A. Julian, on a group of sixteen provers, nine men and seven women during the winter of 1968-69, using the 3x, 7c, 9c, 15c, 30c potencies and placebo. Mental complaints of a depressive and schizophrenic nature. General apathy with nausea. Mental laziness with agitation. Morning lassitude. Fatigue, sleepiness around 5 p.m. with slow heartbeat. Clear diminution in attention and ability to concentrate. Hypotension and tachycardia. Multiple allergic sensitivities. Intestinal, hepatic and gastric malfunctioning. Increase in weight. MIND - Disinterested state. Anxiety from anticipation. Premonition of an indefinable imminent event. State of panic with desire to cry out for help. Anguish, aggravated in a room with light and people. Neurosis from anguish. Instability. Desire to weep. Fear of going mad, nervy, on edge. Agoraphobia. Desire to harm someone. Anorexia. Schizophrenia. Hallucinations in chronic alcoholics.

Head - Diffuse, dull headache.

Eyes - Feeling of eyes enlarged. Food - Anorexia, alternating with bulimia and desire to eat anything. Progressive loss of appetite. Desire for alcoholic drinks which are badly tolerated. Cannot digest milk, milk products, Crustacea.

Ears - Diminished hearing.

Nose - Diminished sense of smell.

Mouth - Dryness in the mouth. Bitterness and bad breath. Tongue whitish-gray with absence of thirst.

Stomach - Gastric and intestinal dyspepsia. Vertigo - Feeling of faintness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sep. - Apathy, sadness, headache with pressing pains. Feeling of emptiness in the stomach. Yellowish mark across the nose. Desire to be alone. (2) Tub. - Weakness with constant need to change place. Headache from mental exertion. Anxious, glum, melancholic. Morning diarrhea. (3) Chlorpr. - Disorders of the body of the endocrine system and the thalamus of an introverted psychopathic nature. Halluci- nation, genetic troubles. Thermal and hepatic disorders. General slowing down and dumbness. Catatonic syndrome. Vesicular, bullous rashes and pigmentation disorders. REFERENCES-Julian.

Abdomen - Distention after eating starchy food. Hypertrophic cirrhosis of the liver. Entero-hepatic syndrome. Gastric and intestinal dyspepsia.

Rectum - Diarrhea with liquid stools around 8 p.m. with 4-5 successive stools. Constipation.

Male - Urinary retention. Diminished libido. Neurotic impotence.

Chest - Oppression of chest. Constitutions - Suited to phospho-fluoric or tubercular types with psychomotor depression, hypotension and disinterest in the environment, listless with morning fatigue.

Heart - Acrocyanosis. Tachycardia neurosis, on exertion in anxious types. Postural hypotension. Heart constricted with anguish in the morning. Palpitations at the slightest effort.

Back - Pains in the shoulder.

Limbs - Twisting spasms. Cramps, in the toes. Arthritis of the scapula and humerus. Clumsiness, drops things. Circulatory disorders at the periphery, the limbs of the limbs take on a purple color with mauve or white patches. Lungs - Tachycardia with asthma. Dyspnea on effort. Dyspnea from anguish. Nervous asthma.

Sleep - Y awning with sleepiness after meals. Unpleasant, anguished dreams, about the death of dear people.

Skin - Pruritus sometimes accompanied by small urticaria patches. Prurigo strophulus. Painful skin hardening without suppuration, following intra-muscular injections of Levomepromazine.

Modalities - Better from gentle heat, coffee, tobacco. Worse from light, a crowd.

Kidneys - Oliguria.

Blood - Rise in the sedimentation rate.

full:
PHARMACY - liatr. Liatris spicata. Colic root. Liatris serratula. Dense button-snakeroot. Gay feather. Devil's bit. N. O. Composite, tribe Cicoracee. Tincture of powdered fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anasarca. Colic. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Headache. Indigestion. Kidney, dropsy. Ulcers.

HERBAL - Liatris is an old herbal remedy for indigestion and colic. T. C. Duncan explained Liatris spicata that it is called “Devil's bit” as a piece is missing from each tube, as if it had been bitten out. Liatris has the reputation of being “aromatic, stimulant, diaphoretic, diuretic, anodyne and carminative,” particularly useful in colic, headache and flatulency.

HOMEOPATHIC - Generalanasarca due to heart and kidney disease. Colic. Diarrhea with violent urging and pain in lower part of back. Suppressed urine. Dropsy from liver or spleen diseases. Kidney dropsy. Applied locally to ulcers and unhealthy wounds. A prompt diuretic. Vascular stimulant. Increases functional activity of the skin, mucus membranes. COMMENTS - Liatr. was introduced to homeopathic medicine because of its action in two cases of dropsy under eclectic treatment. The first was a case of dropsy from material enlargement of liver and spleen, the second was a case of dropsy with almost total suppression of urine. After other remedies had failed. Liatr. was given and, on the second day. the patient passed a gallon and a half of urine. A. E. White wrote that it has a popular repute as specific in chronic diarrhea following exposure in camp life, and also as an application to non-granulating ulcers. For this purpose the root is to be chewed and then applied. White was invited to chew a piece, which he did. In six or eight hours he had three successive calls to stool, very urgent, a little griping in lower back and some straining at stool. He has confirmed its use in camp diarrhea, but says it acts better if Sulph. or Merc-c. is given first. White reported the case of Mr. X, 56, who had chronic diarrhea since the war. He had tried treatment of all kinds, homeopathic included. He had twelve to sixteen stools a day and had loss much weight. He was run down and had made up his mind he had only a short time to live. He was given Sulph. 30x two doses, one each night, then Merc-c. 3x, a dose each night for five nights, then Liatr. lx, four pellets each night for five weeks, by which time he was completely cured. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Worse from warmth of room, sunset, evening, night, afternoon, from 5 p.m. to 8 a.m.. Worse from motion, walking, standing, jarring, lying on left side, pressure of bed clothes, rubbing. Worse after miscarriage. Worse from consolation. Diarrhea worse early morning..

full:
PHARMACY - lil-t. Lilium tigrinum. Tiger lily. N. O. Liliaceae. Tincture of fresh stalk, leaves and flowers. Some of the provings were made with tincture of the pollen alone. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Arthritis. Asthenopia. Astigmatism. Dementia. Depression. Diarrhea, Dysentery. Eyes disorders. Fibroma. Heart,disorders. Hysteria. Ovarian disorders. Pruritus vulva. Sexual, disorders. Spinal irritation. Urination, frequent. Uterus, disorders. Uterus, prolapsed.

HOMEOPATHIC - The tiger lily, which was introduced into the West from China and Japan, was first suggested as a remedy by W. E. Payne. Carrol Dunham urged Payne to have it proved and assisted by having it proved on a woman under his supervision. The account of this case is given in Dunham's Science of Therapeutics. Some of the provings were made with the tincture of the pollen alone. The provings showed symptoms of increased activity, things went more easily. Ill humor, drowsiness, sleep but with unpleasant dreams. Sweetish nausea without inclination to vomit. Abnormal fullness worse after eating ever so little. Bloating more pronounced and chiefly across hips, in uterine region. Darting pains in head and lower abdomen, from ovaries down thighs. Knees ache. Pressure in vagina, pain at of sacrum extending to hips. Increased sexual instinct. Crazy feeling with thoughts of suicide, head grows wild after being quiet for a short time. Increased depressing weight, worse evening. During the provings, Lil-t. was given for 10 days, then stopped, but the symptoms continued to develop and increase in intensity for eight weeks longer, when it had to be put an end to by an antidote. Lil-t. manifests its chief action upon the venous circulation, the heart and female organs, ovaries and uterus. Useful for reflex conditions dependent on pathological conditions of these organs. Lilium tigrinum Uterine reflex states, dependent on pathology of uterus or ovaries. Utero-ovarian sagging. Symptoms of sexual overexcitement. Women exhausted by sexual excess. Often indicated in unmarried women. Pain in small spots (Ox-ac.). Rheumatic arthritis. Burning palms and soles accompany complaints. Full, heavy orforced outfeeling in uterus, ovaries, heart etc. Wandering, flying, shooting pains or opening and shutting pains, radiating from ovary to heart, to left breast, down the legs etc. Backward pains, about eyes to occiput, from nipples through chest, from heart to left scapula. Affects the bladder and rectum. Pulsations, ebullitions, gurglings and burnings. Nervous tremors in hypogastrium in spine, knees etc. Venous congestion. Acrid discharges. Nervous, hysterical. Faints in warm room or after standing for a long time. Rheumatism. MIND - Mental and physical symptoms alternate. Mental and uterine symptoms alternate. Mental and heart symptoms alternate. Hurried, wants to do several things at once, walks fast, does not know why. Restlessness and nervousness. Must keep busy. Haughty and proud. Capriciousnessi Abrupt. Snappish. Censorious, critical. Irritability and sensitivity. Indifferent to anything done for her. Apathy, indifference to love ones. Averse to amusement. Very timid. Prefers company. Anxiety with palpitations. Anxious, fears some organic and incurable disease. Delusions that she has an incurable disease. Anxiety about business, the future, health. Dementia from business worries. Fear of going insane, impending disease and suffering, being incurable. Fear of falling, from faintness, worse close warm room. Fear of evil. Discontented. Dissatisfied, envious of others. Sentimental. Sits alone and broods over imaginary troubles, dwells on past. Grief, sighing. Constant inclination to weep. Grief, hunting for something to grieve oneself. Profounddepression, worse consolation. Post-partum depression. Desires death. Suicidal disposition by poison. Disposed to curse, strike, think obscene things. Cursing, swearing, blasphemy, and profanity. Feels as if she must scream out. Desire to pull the hair out. Hysteria. Wild, crazy feeling. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Religious affections and sadness. Tormented about salvation. Delusions that she is doomed. Strong sexual desire, lessened by keeping busy. Confusion of mind from sexual excitement. Sexual excitement, alternating with apprehension of religious ideas, or despair. Nymphomania. Erotic, sexual fantasies. Dementia from sexual excesses, uterine problems.

Head - Hot, dull, heavy, with morning diarrhea. Faint in warm room. Wild feeling in head, as though she would be crazy- Headache burning, dependent on uterine disorders, worse before and after menses, better at sunset. Headache over left eye to vertex with vertigo and visual effects. Sick headache every few days, much worse at menses. Drawing hot pain through head and eyes, better frequent sneezing. Sharp neuralgic pains over eyes, worse motion and evening. Stinging, burning pains in forehead.

Eyes - Wild look in eyes. Biting and burning sensation, worse reading. Pain, extending back into head, lachrymation and impaired vision. Sensitive to light. Photophobia during pain in forehead. Hyperesthesia of retina. Weakened ciliary muscle ( Arg-n.). Feel sprained.

Ears - Neuralgia in right ear. Rushing sounds in ears after going to bed.

Nose - Sneezing, better pain in head andeyes. Discharge thin, clear, yellow mucus. Nose stopped up. Stoppage of right nostril with pain in right side of face. Rubbed her nose violently. Constant desire to pick nose.

Face - Heat and bloated feeling of face and head. Chilly feeling in face in afternoon.

Mouth - Sweet taste in back of mouth. Foul taste, better eating. Taste of blood, during congestion to chest. Saliva abundant. Mouth and throat feel coated on waking in the night. Tongue, coated yellowish, white in patches. Darting pain from teeth to ear.

Throat - Soreness and dryness. Hawking of mucus with constant nausea. Enlargement of right tonsil, with exudation. Feeling of lump, with pulsations when lying. Vertigo - Vertigo feeling as if intoxicated, head confused and heavy. Vertigo when walking, staggering forward. Vertigo better in fresh open air, worse in close room. Vision - Myopic astigmatism, has to turn head sideways to see clearly, with frontal headache. Farsightedness. Presbyopia. Blurred vision with heat in eyes and lids. Blurred vision with prolapsed uterus. Dim vision after seminal emissions. Muscae volitantes. COMMENTS - Characteristic downward dragging from shoulders, from thorax, from left breast, from epigastrium down to pelvis and out at the vagina as if everything would be forced through. Downward pressure in the rectum, bladder and loins. General pel vic distress, affecting the bladder, rectum and back. Increased sexual instinct, more intense affect on female organs. High Lilium tigrinum sex drive with bearing down pains (Sep., Murx.), and sharp, stabbing pains in the uterus. Consciousness of the ovaries as distinct, painful, burning spots with pains radiating from them down the thighs. Pains in the uterus and ovaries as if they were squeezed. Premenstrual syndrome, worse consolation, very irritable before menses. Hurried and restless before menses (Arg-n., Sep.). Fatigue. Can have palpitations of tightness in the chest associated with menses or premenstrual syndrome. Severe menstrual cramps (Sep.), as if squeezed with sharp, stabbing pains. Regular menses, flows only as long as she moves. Menses too soon, leucorrhea after menses. Intermittent, thin, brown leucorrhea, leaving a brown stain. C. Sigmund Raue observed excellent results from Lil-t. 3x and 30c in cases of uterine fibroid presenting the characteristic symptoms of the remedy. Another prover, a woman, 53, who had ceased to menstruate took a drop of Lil-t. 30c. She had a feeling of exhaustion as if the blood were pushed outward and later a blinding headache “as if all the blood were pressing outward through every aperture.” Felt hurried and driven, without knowing why. Sudden fluttering sensation in the heart, better if busy, with faintness, as though she could make no exertion but must sit still. Contractive pain in the heart, intermittent pressure. Alternate spasm and relaxation. Sharp pain in apex of heart. Pain and numbness in the right arm along with the heart pain. Alternation of heart pain with uterine or ovarian pains. Intermittent action of the heart, every intermission is followed by a violent throb, causing an involuntary catching of the breath. At the same time, the blood rushes up through the carotids to the head, producing great heat and crowded feeling of head and face. Fever and sweat during the night. Wandering pain, flying, shooting, squeezing and relaxing, opening and shutting, burning and radiating. Lilium tigrinum Pain radiates from ovary to heart, to left breast, down legs (especially left), across to opposite ovary, through left breast, to back from ilium, across sacrum. Pulling up sensation from the tip of the coccyx. Convulsive contractions of the muscles of the body. Backache. Generally left sided. Intense restlessness, irritable nervous system, weak, trembling, aimless hurry, walks to and fro. Obscene thoughts. Disposition to strike and swear. Feeling as if she would be crazy if she did not hold tightly upon herself, feeling as if she must scream. Fear of dying. One prover, who was astigmatic, had much suffering in the eyes during the proving, and found her astigmatism gone when the proving was over. S. Lilienthal had among his symptoms “a sensation as if a rubber band were stretched tightly from temple to temple, as if a skullcap were crushing the head, as if the brain was being pushed through eyes and ears.” A patient to whom Clarke gave Lil-t. 30c said it caused a sensation in the abdomen as if the contents were “tied up in knots.” H. C. Allen noted the symptom “cannot walk on uneven ground.” Berridge cured a woman, 50, of heart pain, with a sensation as if the heart was grasped with a hand, with a cold feeling from apex of heart to under left scapula, excited by worry, worse lying on right side, better lying on left side and when busy at work. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Plat., Helon. (ante-version), Nux-v. (colic), Puls. Compare: (1) Cact., Helon., Murx., Sep., Plat.. Pall. (2) Sep. - very like in most respects, but Lil-t. better by diverting mind and busying about, Sep. better by violent exertion, leucorrhea of Lil-t. is more excoriating, Lil-t. worse afternoon, Sep. better afternoon, Lil-t. pressure in anus, Sep. weight like a heavy ball. (3) Puls. - worse in warm room, venous stasis with taste of blood in mouth, weeping mood, Puls, quiet weeping. (4) Nat-m. - heart, uterus, coldness about heart. (5) Helon. - profound melancholy with consciousness of womb. (6) Cact. - heart constricted by iron band, constriction continuous, Lil-t. intermittent, uterine and ovarian pains. (7) Sulph. - early morning diarrhea, burning palms and soles. (8) Zinc - heart symptoms better by lying on left side. (9) Pall, over-sensitive Plat., hauteur. (10) Aur. - prolapse, Aur. from weight of organ, Lil-t. from relaxation of ligaments. (11) Rhus-t. - pain and numbness of left arm with heart disease, Lil-t. more characteristic, right. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Hollow, empty sensation in stomach and bowels. As if a hard body rolling around, during day only. Hunger, as if from spine. Flatulence. Nausea with sensation of lump in stomach. Nausea with pressure in vagina and pain at top of sacrum. Nausea with morning diarrhea. Morning sickness with frequent, copious urination. Retching, but no vomiting. Feels like vomiting when touching epigastrium. Vomiting from displacement of uterus.

Abdomen - Abdomen sore, distended, can't bear weight or covers. Skin of abdomen feels stretched and stiff. Abdomen sensitive to pressure or jarring. Trembling sensation in abdomen. Heavy dragging downfeeling of whole abdominal contents with dysuria. Bearing down pain in lower part of abdomen, worse walking. Sharp pains, better gentle rubbing with warm hand, doubling up.

Rectum - Constant desire to defecate from pressure in rectum, worse standing. Pressure downwards and backwards against rectum and anus. Weak, tremulous feeling extending to anus. Diarrhea, directly after dinner, sudden and peremptory. Early morning diarrhea after rising, urgent, cannot wait a moment. Sensation as if diarrhea would come on, passing off by urinating. Dysentery, mucus and blood with tenesmus, especially in plethoric and nervous women at menopause. Stool preceded by griping pains or great urging, with pressure on rectum. Stools, small, frequent with tenesmus. Tenesmus of the rectum and bladder. Hemorrhoids after childbirth. Sensations - With nausea, a lump in center of chest which could be moved down by empty swallowing. As if an electric current in fingers and hands. As if cool wind blowing on lower limbs.

Male - Increased sexual desire. Lascivious dreams and emissions, followed by irritability, difficulty in fixing one's mind, selecting wrong words.

Female - Amenorrhea with cardiac distress or burning stinging ovarian pains. Menses, early, scanty, dark, clotted offensive. Flow only when moving about. Menses cease when resting (Bell., Lac-c., Sep.). Dys- menorrhea with sensation of constriction from back around hips, ending in pubes. Offensive leucorrhea and great weakness during menses. Acrid, brown, thin leucorrhea, stains brown, worse after menses. Smarting in labia, worse after menses. Ovarian pains with palpitations, mental symptoms. Ovarian pain down thighs or up below the left breast. Sharp pain in region of ovaries and in back. Pains in left ovary and left breast. Stinging pain in left ovarian region. Bloated feeling in uterine region. Neuralgic pains in uterus, cannot bear pressure of clothes. Bearingdown pains with urgent desire for stool. Sub-involution. Congestion of uterus. Prolapse uterus. Anteversion and retroversion of uterus. Sensation as though all organs would escape (Sep., Lac-c., Bell-p.), especially uterus. Constant desire to support parts externally, afraid to move. Nymphomania. Sexual desire increased, obscene, must keep herself busy. Sexual excitement, ending in orgasm. Voluptuous itching in vagina. Pruritus pudendi. Slow recovery after labor. Food - Hungry, craving for meat, sour or sweet dainties. Aversion to coffee to bread. Thirsty, drinks often and much, before severe symptoms.

Chest - Constricted feeling in left side of chest. Oppressive load on chest. Tight, hot, congested feeling. Sharp, quick pains in left side of chest, with fluttering of heart. Chest feels as if too full of blood. As if a lump in the center of chest moving up and down on empty swallowing.

Heart - Sensation as if heart were grasped in a vise (Cact.). Heart as if alternately grasped and relaxed. As if heart is hanging by a thread. Heart feels full to bursting. Cold feeling about heart. Heaviness in region of heart. Sensation as if heart stopped, followed by rush of blood to heart and palpitations. Palpitation from excitement, worse lying on either side. Palpitations during pregnancy. Pain in cardiac region with feeling of a load on chest. Angina pectoris with pain in right arm. Pulse irregular, very rapid. Pulsations all over the body.

Back - Neck pain and aches, worse if tired. Glands on left side of neck swollen and painful. Broken feeling between scapula. Sensation of pulling upward from tip of coccyx. Spine sore, with stiffness, worse in loins. Dull pain in sacrum. Cold feeling across loins and sacrum. Back as if drawn backwards, after heart attack. Breasts - Cutting pain in left breast, with sighing and shortness of breath. Pains in left breast and left ovary. Cramp like pain, in left breast, shoulder and fingers. Sensation as if a rivet or ball under left breast. Causations - Ailments from being alone, celibacy, being unmarried. Ailments from sexual excesses, childbirth, menopause.

Limbs - Pain in back and spine with trembling, often of a pressing-down character. Limbs feel cold, clammy, worse when excited or nervous. As if acool wind blowing on legs. Staggering gait, cannot walk straight, or on uneven ground. Pain from hip to hip. Joints feel dry. Trembling of knees. Legs ache, cannot keep them still. Pain in right arm, hip, ankle joint. Burning in palms and soles. Paralytic stiffness of fingers. Pricking in fingers. Lungs - Air hunger, takes long, deep breath. Suffocates in a warm or crowded room, theater or church. Shortness of breath. Oppressed breathing with sighing. Sharp pain through right lung, worse in open air.

Sleep - Yawning, stretching, drowsy. Unable to sleep on account of wild feeling in head. Slept soundly, but suddenly waked by desire to evacuate bladder. Restless sleep, wild feeling in head, everything seems too hot. Unrefreshing sleep with bad dreams, half-awaking, labored. Frightful, unpleasant dreams. Amorous, lewd, voluptuous dreams.

Skin - Tingling, formication, burning in various parts. Irritation of upper chest and arms and a fine rash about forehead and around borders of the hair with much itching. Skin of abdomen feels stiff and stretched.

Modalities - Better from pressure, support, rubbing, lying on left side, crossing legs. Better from cool, open, fresh air, during the day, when busy. Worse from warmth of room, sunset, evening, night, afternoon, from 5 p.m. to 8 a.m.. Worse from motion, walking, standing, jarring, lying on left side, pressure of bed clothes, rubbing. Worse after miscarriage. Worse from consolation. Diarrhea worse early morning.

Kidneys - Frequent urging. Constant pressure on bladder with constant desire to urinate, with a sensation as of a ball in rectum. Frequent urination, almost every fifteen minutes, with scanty discharges, followed by irritation and smarting in urethra. Urine, milky and scanty, hot like boiling oil. If desire is not attended to, feeling of congestion in chest.

Temperature - Chilly in cool open air, otherwise better. Chilly sensation running down face, head and back. Chills with violent beating of heart and constriction. Great heat and lassitude in afternoon with throbbing throughout body.

name: Limulus Cyclops
author: Murphy
constitution: Cholera. Colic. Constipation. Coryza. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Sea-bathing, effects. Skin, affection. Strokes. Vesicles.
keynote: PHARMACY - lim. Limulus cyclops. King crab. Limulus polyphemus. Polyphemus occidentalis. Xiphosura. Horse foot. Saucepan. N. O. Merostomata or the pecilopoda of the Crustacea. Coast of North America. Triturations of the dried blood. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - lim. Limulus cyclops. King crab. Limulus polyphemus. Polyphemus occidentalis. Xiphosura. Horse foot. Saucepan. N. O. Merostomata or the pecilopoda of the Crustacea. Coast of North America. Triturations of the dried blood. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cholera. Colic. Constipation. Coryza. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Fever. Hemorrhoids. Sea-bathing, effects. Skin, affection. Strokes. Vesicles.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lim. was introduced by Hering, and partially proved by him and Lippe. Hering was surprised to see that the blood of the King crab he dissected was blue, and on investigation was found to contain copper. He thought it would prove to be another medicine for cholera. The most notable symptoms include a rush of blood to the face with heat of the face and over whole body (Aster.). Bodily and mental exhaustion. Painful fullness of whole right side of body. Gastro enteric symptoms. Drowsiness after sea bathing. MIND - Mental depression. Weak memory. Forgetful, difficult to remember names. Confusion with heat of face, rush of blood to face, worse when meditating.

Head - Headache from straining at stool.

Eyes - Pain behind left eyeball.

Nose - Fluent coryza. Constant nasal dripping. Sneezing, worse drinking water. Pressure above nose and behind eyes.

Face - Flushing of face, worse in afternoon. Rush of blood to face. Heat in face alternating with confusion in head.

Throat - Husky voice. COMMENTS-Theonly italicized Lim. symptoms in Allen are “Frequent rush of blood to the face and painful fullness of the whole right half of the body, especially here and there and in the lower limbs” and “heat, burning and constriction in abdomen.” Gastrointestinal disturbance, a choleric condition. Headache caused by straining at stool. Dyspnea, worse drinking. Coryza worse drinking cold water. Flushing of the face, worse in afternoon. Heat in face alternated with confusion in head. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aster., Hom., Cupr. (2) Fenr. - flushing. Ind. - pains in head from straining at stool. Ars. - ill-effects of sea-bathing. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Abdomen hot and constricted. Colic with heat. Cramp-like pain with watery stools.

Rectum - Hemorrhoids, constriction of anus.

Chest - Oppression of chest.

Limbs - Crural neuralgia. Pain in right hip joint. Soles of feet ache, feel numb. Heels sore. Burning in palms. Lungs - Husky voice. Dyspnea after drinking water. Oppression of chest.

Skin - Itching spots and vesicles on face and hands.

full:
PHARMACY - lina. Linaria vulgaris. Snap dragon. Toad-flax. N. O. Scrophulariaceae. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Apathy. Bedwetting. Diarrhea. Fainting. Hemorrhoids. Ophthalmia. Tongue, roughness. Tongue, prickling.

HOMEOPATHIC - In domestic practice, Linaria has long been used as a lotion for inflamed eyes and as an application for painful hemorrhoids. It is said to be purgative and diuretic. Lina, was proved by Muller, Raidi and others. Farrington commended it for cardiac fainting, “faints dead away without apparent cause” ; and also in bedwetting, “bedwetting with frequent painful urging to urinate causing patient to rise at night.” Carleton saw it produce “Fainting feeling three or four times a day, fainted away completely once.” Marked enteric symptoms. Pressure on stomach. Jaundice, splenic and hepatic hypertrophy. Salivation. Constriction of the throat. Thirst with rough tongue. Belchings. Nausea, vomiting. Bedwetting. Rectal symptoms. Diarrhea, with profuse urination. Better by taking tea with milk. Great tiredness. General prostration. Irresistible sleepiness. Fainting from heart weakness. Confusion in the head. Coldness. Oppression of the breathing and stitches in the chest. Symptoms worse walking in open air. MIND - Peevish mind. Indifferent. Confusion, stupid feeling in the head.. Ill-humor with dull pain in forehead, with fever, after the sleep, lasting until midnight. RELATIONS-Antidotedby:Tea in milk. Compare: ( 1 ) Dig. - fainting and other Scrophularia. (2) Caust., Eup- per., Equis. - bedwetting. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Proved by Stokes and Gaston, Linu-c.…

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Bronchitis. Cough. Diarrhea. Hemorrhoids. Laryngitis. Rheumatism.

HOMEOPATHIC - Proved by Stokes and Gaston, Linu-c. has marked colic and diarrhea of loose, bright yellow stools and also of slender stools. Nasal and respiratory catarrh, stuffed-up condition of nose and chest. Troublesome cough and difficult expectoration of frothy, yellow mucus. Menses omitted or delayed. Depressed sexual functions in men, absence of desire in women. MIND - Dullness and depression. Irritable.

Modalities - Cough, worse walking in open air. Headache, better in open air and from eating. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Sulph. (headache). Compare: Linu-u. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Linum Usitatissimum
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma. Convulsions. Hay fever. Headaches. Tongue, paralysis. Trismus. Urticaria.
keynote:
PHARMACY - linu-u. Linum usitatissimum. Flax-seed. Linseed. Common flax. Source of Linseed or Flax-seed. N. O. Linacee. Trituration and tincture of seed, meal, oil or freshly made poultice. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Convulsions. Hay fever.…
full:
PHARMACY - linu-u. Linum usitatissimum. Flax-seed. Linseed. Common flax. Source of Linseed or Flax-seed. N. O. Linacee. Trituration and tincture of seed, meal, oil or freshly made poultice. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Convulsions. Hay fever. Headaches. Tongue, paralysis. Trismus. Urticaria.

HERBAL - Linseed-tea and linseed poultices are among the most innocent of domestic remedies, but occasionally the application of a linseed poultice has produced severe respiratory disturbances such as asthma, hives, etc. It has been found to contain a small quantity of hydrocyanic acid, which may account for this intensity. The “soothing” effects of linseed-tea and linseed poultices are really of a specific and homeopathic nature. A teaspoonful of whole linseed, steeped in warm water for half an hour and then taken, acts as a laxative.

HOMEOPATHIC - Linu-u. is marked by intense irritation. The decoction is of service in inflammation of the urinary passages, cystitis, strangury, etc. Diseases of the intestinal tract. Trismus and paralysis of the tongue. Asthma, hay fever and urticaria. MIND - Perfectly conscious, but only able to express herself by signs.

Head - Heavy frontal headache. Violent pain in cheeks and temples. Rigid and prominent temporal muscles, jerk rapidly. Head shakes spasmodically in measured time.

Eyes - Unpleasant heat, burning, dryness. Intense conjunctivitis. Chemosis. Swelling of lids, completely closes eye in one hour, edema persisted three days.

Nose - Irritation rapidly extended through lachrymal duct to nose. Heat, burning dryness with indescribably scraping. Itching sensation, nearly driving him wild. Nasal passage completely closed, compelled to breathe through mouth.

Face - Face red and slightly moist. Violent, dull pain in cheeks and temples. Jaws immovably clenched.

Mouth - Tip of the tongue turned upwards and backwards so as to touch the velum palati. Tongue drawn down into her throat. Complete paralysis of tongue. Could not articulate a syllable.

Throat - Irritation continued from eyes and nose down into throat. Throat filled with large white blisters. COMMENTS - Clarke quoted the case of a woman in which the application of a linseed poultice to an ulcer over the right shin-bone produced an attack of asthma which nearly proved fatal. It was not the first time this had happened to her and she protested, but in vain, against the doctor's order. If a linseed poultice even come near her she felt constriction of the chest. The doctor who ordered the poultice and reported the case, was speedily summoned to witness the worst attack of asthma he had ever seen. The patient was livid and struggling for breath. When the poultice was removed the symptoms gradually subsided. A crop of herpes appeared where the poultice had been and an eruption of urticaria over back, chest and arms. Dr. A. G. Towner related his own experiences, noting that when he lived in New York state he could handle linseed in all forms freely, but after moving to Illinois, it affected him powerfully. Once he rubbed his eye while preparing a poultice; intense conjunctivitis came on at once, chemosis, and in an hour the eye was closed and did not come right again for three days. The irritation passed along the lachrymal duct and the same burning and irritation took place in the nose, nearly driving him wild. The swelling closed the nostrils and he had to breathe through his mouth. The irritation still spread, affecting the throat, which was covered with large white blisters and a desperate attack of bronchial asthma supervened, slightly relieved by large doses of Ip. In two hours, the skin became affected with an attack of “hives” (urticaria). “I was one complete blotch from the crown of my head to the end of my toes, a complete bodily eruption, smart, sting, burn.” He had five of these attacks. The steam of a poultice would cause coryza, the dust would occasion a complete attack. One was caused by inadvertently eating a lozenge containing linseed. An entirely different set of symptoms was recorded by Allen in which a girl, 19, drank a cupful of milk into which she had poured by mistake some spoonfuls of linseed oil. Immediately she felt a fullness in her stomach and precordial uneasiness. She vomited profusely and had copious stools. She went to bed, where she was seized with spasms. Head shook spasmodically in measured time, the eyes and prominent temporal muscles jerked rapidly. Jaws clenched. Tongue paralyzed and drawn down into throat. All the time the brain was quite clear. A clyster of Asaf, gave temporary relief, but the symptoms recurred for a time with renewed violence. On the third day she was quite recovered, but her health was not good for some time. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Ip., Asaf. Compare: ( 1 ) Linu-c. - in asthma and skin disorders. (2) Ars., Chloral., Apis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Great weight in stomach. Fullnessin stomach and precordial uneasiness, followed by convulsions. Severe colic. Vomiting with copious stools.

Limbs - Upper limbs shaken by spasms, but pliable and uncontracted. Lungs - Bronchial asthma. Livid, struggles for breath.

Skin - Herpes. Urticaria. One complete blotch from crown to toes, smarting, stinging, burning.

CLINICAL - Cerebral congestion. Epilepsy. Insomnia. Speech, thick. Strokes. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Weir Mitchell gave thirty grains to a man (who had a previous attack…
full:
PHARMACY - lith-br. Lithium bromatum. Lithium bromide. Trituration. Tincture. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Cerebral congestion. Epilepsy. Insomnia. Speech, thick. Strokes. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Weir Mitchell gave thirty grains to a man (who had a previous attack of stroke and was hemiplegic) for numbness, vertigo, headache and thickness of speech. The one dose removed them in half an hour. Mitchell gave Lith-br. in epilepsy when other bromides were not borne. Hale mentioned that it removed flushed face, insomnia and intense pain between the shoulder after any prolonged mental exertion. Cerebral congestion, threatened strokes, insomnia and epilepsy. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Lithium Carbonicum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from rest, eating, urinating. Better motion, rising and moving about outside. Worse in morning, at night, motion, on right side. Worse during menses, after menses suppressed..

Hemiopia. Hernia. Kidney, disorders. Manic, depression. Menstruation, disorders. Nose disorders. Obesity. Ossification of arteries. Prostatitis. Retina, anemia. Rheumatism. Spleen disorders. Stomach pain. Syphilis. Uret
keynote:

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Barber's itch. Bubo. Coryza. Cystitis. Depression. Dyspepsia. Eye disorders. Gallstones. Glands, swelling.…
full:
PHARMACY - lith-c. Lithium carbonicum. Lithium carbonate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Barber's itch. Bubo. Coryza. Cystitis. Depression. Dyspepsia. Eye disorders. Gallstones. Glands, swelling. Gout. Headaches. Heart disorders. Hemiopia. Hernia. Kidney, disorders. Manic, depression. Menstruation, disorders. Nose disorders. Obesity. Ossification of arteries. Prostatitis. Retina, anemia. Rheumatism. Spleen disorders. Stomach pain. Syphilis. Urethritis. Uric acid diathesis. Urinary disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering introduced and made the first provings of Lith-c. It affects the entire organism, but notably the head and eyes, urinary organs, heart andjoints. Uric acid diathesis. Gout and tophi. Acidity. Chronic rheumatism connected with heart lesions and asthenopia. Rheumatism connected with heart or eye lesions. Rheumatic nodes. Arthritic complaints accompanied with heart or eye symptoms. Recurring attacks of acute inflammation of the small joints. Whole body feels sore and heavy. Pressing from within outward in head, abdominal ring, perineum, chest. Pain as of adull point. Violent sharp pains, as from red hot needles. Paralytic stiffness of the whole body. Prostration. Increase of bulk and weight. Dry and harsh skin. Hot water aggravates the itching. Effects of bruises and falls. Bruised spots from falls and blows. Open air causes post-nasal dripping from nose and constriction of chest. Inspired air feels cold even into lungs. MIND - Absent-minded. Slow, confused mind. Concentration difficult. Difficulty in remembering names. Makes mistakes while talking, omitting words, mispronounces, words. Want of self confidence. Timidity, bashful. Restless, nervous. Anxiety and hopelessness at night, about future. Startled easily. Oversensitive. Easily irritable. Impatient. Quarrelsome, scolding. Averse to being spoken to, to being touched. Wants to be left alone. Depression. Sadness, despondency. Disposed to weep about his lonesome condition. Staring, thoughtless. Manic depression. Obsessive compulsive disorders. Claustrophobia. Fear in narrow places.

Head - Tension, as if bound, better sitting and going out. Constriction of forehead. Pains over the eyes. Headache, better while eating, but returns and remains until food is again taken. Headache from sudden suppression of menses. Head feels too large. Externally sensitive. Trembling and throbbing. Head pain, better rubbing.

Eyes - Pain over eyes. Photophobia. Eyes sensitive after using them by candlelight. Eyes pain after reading. Dry lids.

Ears - Pain behind left ear, extending to neck.

Nose - Swollen and red nose, especially right side. Nose internally sore and dry. Soreness of tip of nose. Nose obstructed, worse morning and forenoon. Coryza, dripping from nose in open air. Mucus discharge in evening.

Face - Prosopalgia. Both cheeks are covered with dry, bran-like scales. Glandular swellings on left side of face, throat and neck, some suppurating.

Mouth - Teeth feel numb, dull and loose, can't bite on them.

Throat - Soreness of throat, extending to ear. Lumps of mucus drip into throat. Hawking up mucus in large quantities. Vertigo - Vertigo with ringing in the ears. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo as if floating. Dizzy states. Vision - Asthenopia. Hemiopia with pain over eyes, invisible right half, worse during menses. Black motes. Sunlight blinds him. Sensation as if a veil before eyes. COMMENTS - Keynote soreness. Bones, joints, muscles, whole body sore as if beaten. Prostration of whole body, especially knee joints and sacrum. Paralytic stiffness of whole body. Pressing from within outward, in head, abdominal ring, perineum, chest. Bruised spots from falls or blows. Rheumatic soreness in heart region. Heart symptoms, worse bending forward and better after urinating, though worse on rising to urinate. Heart pain before and during menses. Menses cease suddenly and headache comes on. Heaviness, better while eating, worse after. Confusion in the head. Eyes pain as if sore. Red and inflamed nose, dropping of solid lumps down the back of the nose. Acidity of the stomach. According to Allen, lithium lactate has been found valuable for sub-acute rheumatism of the shoulder joint. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lyc., Am-p., Benz-ac., Calc. (2) Lithium benzoicum, Lithiumbromatum, Lithium lacticum, Lithium chlor. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Acidity of stomach. Sticking, burning pains. Gnawingpain in stomach, better by eating (Anae.). Nausea with gnawing in stomach.

Abdomen - Feels swollen as if distended with wind. Cannot endure slightest pressure of clothes from fullness in epigastrium (Lach., Lyc.). Pressure, pain in hepatic region. Pain in left abdominal ring like a pressing from within outward. Indurated inguinal glands. Syphilitic bubo in left groin.

Rectum - Violent, painful, dull stitch in perineum near anus, from above downward, from within outward. Emission of much offensive flatus on awaking from sleep. Diarrhea, stools light-yellow, offensive, worse from fruits or chocolates. Sensations - Temples as if bound. Head too large. Eyes dry. As if veil before eyes. Lancination as from red- hot needles in bubo. Arm as if paralyzed. Border of foot and soles as if gouty, itching.

Male - Pain in testes. Sharp pain in penis when sitting. Erections after copious urination at night. Erections disturbing sleep, better urinating. Gonorrhea with hemorrhage, alternating with thick, profuse discharge.

Female - Menses late, scanty. Menses cease suddenly and headache comes on. Food - Appetite diminished. Appetite satisfied on beginning to eat. Worse after fruit Lithium carbonicum or chocolate.

Chest - Constriction of chest when walking in open air, after breakfast. Pressure in middle of chest from within outward, towards sides. Constitutions - Gouty constitutions. Uric acid diathesis.

Heart - Trembling and fluttering of the heart, extending to back, worse vexation. Throbbing, dull stitch in cardiac region. Sudden shock in heart. Rheumatic soreness in heart region. Heart pain, extends to head. Sore pain in heart, with eye symptoms. Heart pain associated with bladder pains, better after urinating. Heart symptoms, worse bending forward and better after urinating. Pressure in heart while urinating. Heart pain before menses.

Back - Pressure as from a dull point, here and there. Sticking pain in sacral region. Soreness in right side, extending to sacrum. Prostration in sacrum at night.

Limbs - Paralytic stiffness all over. Uric acid diathesis. Arthritis and gout. Gout with pains in joints. Rheumatic pains throughout shoulder joint, arms, fingers and small joints. Pain in joints, relieved by very hot water. Nodular swellings in joints. Ankle joint pains while walking. Pain in hollow of foot, extending to the knee. Swelling and tenderness of finger and toe joints, better hot water. Itching about joints, feet and hands. Soreness of fingers, better grasping. Lungs - Air feels cold on inspiring, even into lungs. Violent cough when lying down. Cough from irritation in throat. Expectoration of much mucus.

Sleep - Sleepless the whole night with anxiety and feeling of helplessness. Restless sleep. Sleep disturbed by pains in joints, sacrum and feet. Sleep disturbed from copious urination, followed by erections. Voluptuous dreams, disturbing sleep.

Skin - Dry, harsh skin. Rough rash all over body, much loose epithelium tough, dry, itchy skin. Dull stitch, ending in itching. Eczema. Scabby, tettery eruption on hands, head and cheeks, preceded by red, raw skin. Barber's itch.

Modalities - Better from rest, eating, urinating. Better motion, rising and moving about outside. Worse in morning, at night, motion, on right side. Worse during menses, after menses suppressed.

Kidneys - Pain in right kidney and ureter. Uric acid diathesis. Frequent, copious urination disturbing sleep. While urinating, pressure in heart. Urine scanty with much thirst. Urine with red brown sediment. Urine less in spite of taking normal drinks. Urine, free and colorless. Turbid urine with mucus. Urine scanty and dark, acrid, sandy deposits.

Bladder - Tenesmus of bladder, while and after urinating. Soreness of bladder with frequent urination. Pain in bladder extending to spermatic cord after urination. Flashes of pain in region of bladder, more towards right, before urination. Burning in urethra. Sub-acute and chronic cystitis. Breasts - Pain in breast glands, which extends into the arms and fingers.

Perspiration - Copious sweats.

Temperature - General feeling of heat in body. Fever with sweat on back of hands. Shuddering starting from chest.

HOMEOPATHIC - A chemist, while preparing a combination of lactic acid and lithium carbonate, experienced rheumatic pains in the small joints. On this hint, Berghaus used Lith-lac. in local sub-acute rheumatism with good effect. Allen said it especially affects the shoulder. Rheumatism of the shoulder and small joints, relieved by moving about, worse resting. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - lith-m. Lithium muriaticum. Lithium muriate. Dilute muriatic acid was saturated with the caustic and carbonate of lithium and evaporated. Solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blurred, vision. Heartbum. Heart, pains. Nose, sore. Tongue, numb. Vertigo. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering, who proved Lith- c., also proved this salt. He put one drop on his tongue, it had a fatty-salt taste. The tongue became numb as if fat were on it. Pains in the head, back teeth and heart. Gohrwisch, who took the third dilution, had pains in the heart region and a hot, burning uprising in the throat and pit of stomach like heartbum. He also had pains in his teeth. The tip of the nose was red, sore and somewhat swollen. Lith-m. has the symptoms of quinine poisoning. General weakness, marked muscular and general prostration, no gastrointestinal effects. Nose sore, heartbum, pain in teeth. Dizziness. Head feels full. Blurring of the vision. Ringing in ears, marked tremors. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lith-c. REFERENCES-Clarke.
