constitution: Backache. Catarrh. Coryza. Deltoid rheumatism. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Eyes disorders. Gout. Headache. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Metrorrhagia. Obesity. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Throat sore.
keynote:
PHARMACY - lycpr. Lycopersicum esculentum. Tomato. Solanum lycopersicum. Love apple. N. O. Solanaceae. Tincture of ripe fruit. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Backache. Catarrh. Coryza. Deltoid rheumatism. Diabetes.…
full:
PHARMACY - lycpr. Lycopersicum esculentum. Tomato. Solanum lycopersicum. Love apple. N. O. Solanaceae. Tincture of ripe fruit. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Backache. Catarrh. Coryza. Deltoid rheumatism. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Eyes disorders. Gout. Headache. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Metrorrhagia. Obesity. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Throat sore.

HOMEOPATHIC - Clarke knew of one instance in which the slightest indulgence in tomatoes brings on an attack of gout. Cooper commended the use of tomatoes in cases of obesity. Cooper gave Lycpr. in a case of rodent ulcer and caused sharp pain and temporary spread of the disease. Coryza, worse out of doors (All-c., better out of doors). Polyuria, with great thirst. Diabetes. Marked action on deltoid and pectoral muscles, pain is better lifting arm upward and outward. Pains leave after influenza. Right side principally affected, symptoms proceed from right to left. MIND - Peevish about trifles. Very irritable, noises greatly annoy. Unusually mentally active for short periods, followed by longer periods of mental dullness. Weak memory, forgetful. Thoughts disappear, worse when leaning head against anything. Cannot keep mind fixed on work.

Head - Intense throbbing, bursting headache. Bursting pain in head, especially vertex and when coughing. Dull, heavy pain in occiput. Headache in the occiput, spreads all over the head and settles with great violence in temples, worse tobacco smoke.

Eyes - Dull, heavy, ache. Sore and burning. Pupils minutely contracted. Twitching in left inner canthus. Eyes water on close work. Letters run together when reading. Keeps wiping eyes to see clearly. Light painful. Lids feel heavy and swollen.

Nose - Stopped catarrh. Profuse watery coryza excoriating ale, drops down posterior sinuses, salty taste, markedly worse out of doors.

Face - Face flushed, pale. Pressure in right or left zygoma.

Mouth - Itching and tickling in roof of mouth. Tongue coated thick, yellow, white, more in center. Foul breath, taste.

Throat - The throat slightly sore on swallowing. Mucus membrane of pharynx pale, tip of uvula and arches of pharynx red and inflamed. Burning raw feeling right side of throat, changing to left. Swelling of left tonsil. Constant desire to clear throat. Husky voice. Hoarseness with constant tickling in pit of throat. Hoarseness towards night. Vertigo - Giddiness, with inclination to faint on attempting to walk. COMMENTS - Gross made a proving of Ly- cpr., noting peevishness and loss of memory, sticking and pressing pains, a sense of paralysis, pressing and boring pains in head, and stopped catarrh. Some women cannot eat tomatoes without getting backache, leucorrhea or metrorrhagia. In Gross's proving, the headache was worse in evening, she was obliged to rise in the night to urinate. The mind symptoms were worse and the headache better by leaning the head against something. Dr. Herbert H. Roberts of Derby, Conn., published provings made by himself, two with the 3x and two with the 30x tinctures. “The original tincture was made from the thoroughly ripened fruit, great pains being taken to thoroughly macerate the seeds as well as the pulp.” The rheumatic and congestive symptoms were mostly produced by the 3x, the nervous symptoms mostly by the 30x. Roberts remarked that the natives of Mexico and California eat quantities of the ripe fruit to prevent rheumatism. The right deltoid was very markedly affected and should make Lycpr. a companion to Sang, in shoulder pains. Headaches were intense and characteristic in some, great soreness remained after the pain had gone. Dark-complexioned people seem to be suited to its action from two cases recorded by Roberts. The first case concerned a widow, 50, dark complexion, large, stout, gray eyes. Sudden attack of grip. Very severe aching pains all over, up and down back, limbs, head. Beating, throbbing in head, beginning in occiput, spreading all over head, settling with great violence in temples. Excruciating pain back of eyes and in balls as if they would burst with the pressure. Light causes pain. Delirium. Severe, deep, racking cough. Thirst for large quantities. Pupils contracted. Lycpr. 3x every hour cleared away the fever and acute symptoms by the following morning and rapidly cured the remaining cough. The second case was a man, 40, dark complexion, black hair and eyes, tall, thick-set. Severe bursting, throbbing pain beginning in occiput and settling with great force in temporal and frontal regions, eyes painful, worse from light, pupils contracted. Thirst for large quantities. Temperature 104° F. Pulse full flowing. Lycpr. 3x every hour given in evening removed the headache before midnight. The next day, the right tonsil was swollen and inflamed, sore on swallowing, feeling of a lump there. Temperature 101°. He recovered rapidly. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Tobacco smoke. Compare: (1) Bell., Hyos., Dulc., Caps., Sol-t., Sol-n. (2) Ant- t. - weakness of cervical muscles. (3) In coryza, All-c. but All-c. has better open air, Lycpr. worse open air. (4) Contracted pupils. Op. (5)Deltoidrheumatism, Sang. (6) Diabetes. Uran-n. (7) Headache, sore throat, right side. Bell. (8) Headache worse on coughing, worse in open air, Caps. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Thirst for large quantities of water. Violent belchings of gas with taste of food. Great flatulency between 10 a.m. and 11:30. Burning sensation in stomach towards evening and during evening.

Abdomen - Great flatulency of abdomen. Back - Cannot get into a comfortable position. Backache in lumbar region, making them gloomy and depressed. Rheumatic pain near attachment of trapezius muscle to spine. Heavy dragging in right scapula. Breasts - Sore and tender scirrhous breast.

Stool - Brownish, watery diarrhea, yellow, frothy, no urging, painless.

Female - Profuse leucorrheal discharge. Too frequent menstruation, brought on by free use of canned tomatoes, the flow would return whenever this food was eaten for a few meals.

Chest - Slight sticking beneath left side of sternum, without difficulty of respiration. Oppression in chest in lower lobe of right lung.

Heart - Fine, stitching pains at base of heart. Lame pain in region of heart. Pulse 100, full and flowing.

Limbs - Intense aching, rheumatic pain in muscles of all limbs. Lame, tired feeling in all limbs with great exhaustion. Intense aching pain in lower limbs. Sharp sticking pain along course of right crural nerve. Painful sticking behind articulation of left hip. Sharp pain in right deltoid and pectoral muscles, worse lifting arm upward and outward. Lameness of left wrist, hand and fingers, where it is painful even when not moving it. Lungs - Coughs are deep, harsh, starting from irritation in lower chest. Explosive cough. Dry, hacking cough coming on at night and keeping him awake. Expectoration white and in lumps, early in morning.

Sleep - Unable to fall asleep in evening tosses about, every position uncomfortable. Very restless sleep. Frequent waking and tossing, limbs when pressed feel paralyzed. Confused, disagreeable dreams. Wakened by insignificant dreams.

Skin - Erythematous lupus much relieved (Cooper).

Modalities - Better in warm room, from external heat. The headache in one instance was completely better by tobacco smoke. Worse by noise, motion.

Kidneys - Increase of watery constituents of urine, not of total solids. Must rise at night to urinate. Constant debility when in open air, not at all in warm room.

Temperature - Chilliness towards night, preceded by thirst for large quantities of water. Chilliness and sweat. Sweat on awaking confined to a strip about four inches wide along whole length of back. Temperature from 100.5° to 101 °F.

name: Lycopodium Clavatum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better by motion, belchings, urinating, after midnight. Better from warm food and drink, on getting cold, being uncovered, cold applications. Worse right side, from right to left, from above downward. Worse warm room, hot air, bed, warm applications, except throat and stomach which are better from warm drinks. Worse from pressure of clothes, eating, oysters, milk, vegetables, cabbage, beans, bread, pastry. Worse wind, wet, stormy weather, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m., awakening. Worse before or from suppressed menses..
constitution: Abdomen, weak. Acidity. Albuminuria. Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Aphasia. Asthma. Axilla, perspiration. Belching. Biliousness. Borborygmi. Bright's, disease. Bloating. Cachexia. Cancer. Cataract. Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coms. Coughs. Cramps. Cystitis. Day-blindness. Debility. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyslexia. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, eczema. Eczema. Emaciation.
keynote: PHARMACY - lyc. Lycopodium clavatum. Club moss. Muscus terrestris repens. Pes ursinus. Wolfs claw. Lycopodii pollen. N. O. Lycopodiacee. Hilly pastures and heaths in Central and Northern Europe. Russian Asia and North America. Common in Great Britain, especially the North. Its…
full:
PHARMACY - lyc. Lycopodium clavatum. Club moss. Muscus terrestris repens. Pes ursinus. Wolfs claw. Lycopodii pollen. N. O. Lycopodiacee. Hilly pastures and heaths in Central and Northern Europe. Russian Asia and North America. Common in Great Britain, especially the North. Its medicinal properties are disclosed by trituration and succussion of the spores. Tincture of fresh plant. Etherial tincture of spores (ether dissolves the spore cases). Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, weak. Acidity. Albuminuria. Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Aphasia. Asthma. Axilla, perspiration. Belching. Biliousness. Borborygmi. Bright's, disease. Bloating. Cachexia. Cancer. Cataract. Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coms. Coughs. Cramps. Cystitis. Day-blindness. Debility. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyslexia. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, eczema. Eczema. Emaciation. Epithelioma. Excoriation. Eye, inflammation. Face, eruptions. Feet, perspiring. Fibroma. Flatulence. Food, allergies. Gallstones. Glands, swelling. Goiter. Gout. Gravel. Hematuria. Hair, loss. Hands, chapped. Heartbum. Heart, diseases. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Hypochondriasis. Hypoglycemia. Hysteria. Impotence. Indigestion. Influenza. Intermittents. Intertrigo. Jaundice. Labor-pains, abnormal. Lip, cancer. Liver, derangement. Liver-spots. Locomotor, ataxia. Lumbago. Lungs disorders. Malnutrition. Menstmation, disorders. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriages. Nosebleeds. Nymphomania. Otorrhea. Panaritium. Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Peritonitis. Phlegmasia, dolens. Plica polonica. Pneumonia. Polyps. Pre-senility. Proctalgia. Prostatitis. Pylorus, disorders. Quinsy. Kidney colic. Kidney, disorders. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Skin, cracks. Sleep, abnormal. Speech, disordered. Stage-fright. Strains. Sunstroke. Taste, abnormal. Throat, sore. Tongue, coated, cramps. Tuberculosis. Typhoid, fever. Urine, abnormal. Varicose, veins. Warts. Water brash. Whooping cough. Worms. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Lycopodiums stand between the mosses and the fems. Fossils show that in past eras they occupied an important place in the world's vegetation. This remedy is inert until the spores are crushed. The spores from which the potencies are made have been called “vegetable sulphur” (probably on account of their use forproducing stage-lightning at theaters). In the old school the function of Lyc. has dwindled into its use as an “inert” coating for pills and an “inert” powder dusting on excoriated surfaces. Earlier practitioners did not consider it by any means inert. Lyc. ranks with Sulph. and Calc, in the central trio around which all the rest of the Materia Medica can be grouped. Teste puts Lyc. at the head of a group containing Nairn., Viol. trie, and Ant-c. Lycopodium is adapted more especially to gradually developing ailments, functional power weakening with failures of the digestive powers, where the function of the liver is seriously disturbed. Deep seated, progressive chronic diseases. Pre-senility. Cancer. Erectile tumors. Boils, recurring periodically. Malnutrition, due to weakness of digestion. Affinity for the urinary organs, throat, chest, and ovaries. Symptoms characteristically run from right to left. It acts especially on right side of body and are worse from about 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Descending symptoms. Primary action on digestive organs and adjoining glands, on liver and larger intestines rather than stomach. Aversion to bread, worse from eating bread, fermented foods and fermentable dough. Frequent and painful belchings. Sour belchings, vomiting, distention. Alternate diarrhea and constipation. Pains come and go suddenly. Oversensitive to pain, patient is beside himself. Sense of internal paralysis. One side of the body hypertrophied at menopause. Atrophy of infants. The patient is thin, withered and full of gas and bloating. Acidity, sour, taste, belchings. Dropsy, ascites in liver diseases. Lithic acid diathesis. Kidney affections, with red sand in urine. backache in kidney region, worse before Lycopodium clavatum urination. Stones, gallstones, gravel. Emaciation and debility from loss of fluids, in morning. Marked regulating influence upon the glandular (sebaceous) secretions. Hemorrhages, dark blood. Poor circulation, cold limbs. Lacks vital heat, intolerant of cold drinks, craves everything warm. Sensitive to noise and odors. MIND - Failing brain-power (Anae., Bar-c., Kali-p.). Weak memory, confused thoughts. Dyslexia. Weakness of memory for names of letters. Spells or writes wrong words and syllables. Cannot read what he writes. Brain fag after influenza. Concentration difficult during conversation. Confusion in warm room, better walking in open air. Confused thoughts. Confused about common words. Hears wrong words and syllables. Speech indistinct, stammers the last word. Lack of aptitude for finance and math. Indecision. Timidity. Loss of self confidence. Loss of confidence in physician and remedies. Poor self- esteem. Anticipation. Averse to undertaking new things, yet goes through with ease. Great anxiety, in pit of stomach. Anxiety, as if about to die. Anxiety in house, with company, during stormy weather, while walking in open air. Conscientious about trifles. Apt to worry about the future. Hurried when eating. Panic attacks (Ars., Phos., Kali-ar., Med.). Constant fear of breaking down under stress, fear of failure, public speaking, stagefright. Fear of men, strangers, to be alone. Fear of the dark, ghosts. Agoraphobia. Fear of being unable to reach his destination. Frightened of everything. Melancholy. Resignation. Sadness in morning. Ill-humor and disposition to weep before menses. Extremely sensitive. Weeps all day, when thanked or meeting a friend. Sad, or cheerful, on hearing distant music. Excessively merry and laughs at simplest things, alternating with melancholy and low-spirited. Awakes, irritable, angry, sad and anxious. Defiant, arbitrary. Headstrong and haughty when sick. Domineering. Reproaches others. Love for power. Hateful. Miserly. Easily aroused to anger. Quarrelsome. Fault finding. Suspicious. Distrustful. Hates being watched when at work. Misanthropic, flees even from his children. Religious aversion to opposite sex. Aversion to company, yet dreads solitude. Childish fantasies. Delusions that he has neglected his duty. Delusion of being in two places at the same time. Delusion hears music in evening that was heard in the day. Baby cries all day, sleeps all night. Cranky. Kicks, screams and very cross, on awaking from short, restless naps. Indisposition to play in children. Child desires to be carried. Oversensitive to pain. Feels as if she would die from weakness, when lying in bed. Ailments from domineering parents or siblings. Ailments from abuse, mortification, anger or vexation. Ailments from fright. Looks older than he is.

Head - Right-sidedheadaches. Pain begins on one side goes to other where it is worse. Headaches over eyes in severe colds. Headache with ravenous hunger, better eating. Frontal headache after breakfast. Headache, worse if not eating regularly, lying down, stooping, better uncovering. Pulsating pain in occiput, at night, worse when hot. Pain in temples as if screwed together, worse menses. Catarrhal headache, worse when discharge from nose is slacked up. Hydrocephalus. Meningitis, tubercular. Incipient paralysis of the brain. Shakes head without any apparent cause or involuntarily, slow first, then rapid. Deep furrows on forehead. Eczema, moist oozing behind ears. Dandruff. Hair becomes gray early. Hair loss, premature baldness after abdominal affections, childbirth. Hearing - Humming and roaring with hardness of hearing, every noise causes peculiar echo in ear. Oversensitive hearing, to musical sounds and noise. Ringing, during stool. Singing noises as from boiling water. Noise is intolerable after distension of abdomen. Impaired of lost hearing, with otorrhea, with or without tinnitus. Deafness after scarlatina. Tearing pain in right or left meatus.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, blue rings. Eyes feel cold, hot, seem too large. Eyes painful as if bruised, and dazed by light. Stinging and smarting, worse evening, in light. Photophobia. Sparks before the eyes in the dark. Dilated pupils before menses. Cataract with suppressed menses. Inflammatory affections of eyes. Ophthalmia neonatorum during suppurative stage. Lachrymal fistula. Nocturnal agglutination and lachrymation by day. Ulceration and redness of lids. Smarting and burning of eyelids. Polyps on external canthi. Recurring styes. Styes on lids near internal canthus. Eyes half open during sleep.

Ears - Sensation as if hot blood rushed into ears. Itching in ear. Polyps. Thick, yellow, offensive discharge with deafness. Otorrhea and deafness with or without tinnitus. Otorrhea after scarlatina. External meatus excoriated by offensive discharge. Eczema, humid scurfs about and behind ears.

Nose - Nasal troubles from childhood. Nose stopped up, snuffles, breathes through mouth, child starts from sleep rubbing the nose. Fan like motion of alae nasi in brain, lung and abdominal troubles. Feeling of dryness. Sore pimples on tip of nose. Crusts and elastic plugs (Kali-bi.). Ulcerated nostrils. Acrid ozaena. Violent catarrh, with swelling of nose. Catarrh of nose and frontal sinuses. Discharge yellow and thick. Thick yellow discharge, copious and fatty. Fluent coryza. Chronic coryza, blows nose often. Scanty excoriating, discharge. Obstruction of nose during influenza. Sense of smell very acute.

Face - Freckles. Silly expression. Face withered, shriveled and emaciated. Yellowish, pale, gray with blue circles around the eyes. Grayish-yellow color of face with blue circles around eyes. Flushes of heat. Edema of face. Itching, scaly eruptions. Herpes on face and corner of mouth. Small, white, pedunculated warts Lycopodium clavatum on chin. Submaxillary glands swollen. Tearing pain in bones of face. Drawing or lacerating pain in lower jaw. Dropping of lower jaw, in typhoid fever (Lach., Op.). Twitchings. Twists face and mouth.

Mouth - Mouth hangs open. Sore lips. Bad odor from mouth. Dryness of mouth and tongue without thirst. Speech indistinct, stammers the last word. Saliva dries on palate and lips. Dropping of lower jaw in typhoid fever (Lach., Op.). Mouth waters. Gums bleed when touched or cleaning teeth. Taste too acute, sour, bitter, moldy. Blue lips. Ulcers on lips. Small tumors in mouth in various places.

Throat - Sore throat, better warm drinks, worse cold drinks, after sleep. Stitching pain in throat. Throat feels cold. Dryness of throat without thirst. Inflammation of throat with sharp pain on swallowing and coughing, begins on right side. As if a hard body in esophagus. Sensation as if a ball rose up in throat. Chronic enlargement of the tonsils. Swelling and suppuration of tonsils. Tonsils covered with lardaceous ulcers. Ulceration of tonsils, beginning on right side. Ulceration of vocal bands. Diphtheria, deposits spread from right to left, worse cold drinks. Tubercular laryngitis, especially when ulceration commences. Food and drink regurgitates through nose.

Stomach - Sensation as if fasting after meals, but without hunger. Pressure in stomach with difficult breathing. Churning sensation. Coldness in stomach. Wakes at night feeling hungry. Nausea in morning before eating, with salivation. Hunger, but quick satiety. Eating ever so little creates fullness. Gastralgia and chronic gastritis. Great weakness of digestion with much bloating. Dyspepsia due to farinaceous and fermentable food, cabbage, beans, onions. Derangement of stomach from sweets and pastry. Cramps in stomach from eating fruit. Constrictive pains. Burning pain. Gnawing pain in stomach, better drinking hot water. Stomach pains better rubbing abdomen. Rumbling of flatulence (Carb-v., Chin.). Hiccoughs. Sour eructations, belchings. Belchings rise only to pharynx. Vomiting of dark greenish masses, after eating and drinking. Vomits, food and bile, coagulated blood, dark greenish masses after eating and drinking. Stomach cancer. Perforating ulcer. Stools - Diarrhea from cold drinks, cold food, beer, milk, fruit, vegetables. Stool hard, difficult, small incomplete. Stools, first part is hard is difficult to expel, last part is soft or thin and gushing. Stools pale, putrid, thin, brown. Stools mixed with hard lumps, sand. Stools thin, yellow, or reddish yellow fluid. Stools shaggy, reddish mucus, green, stringy, odorless mucus. Discharge of blood during stool.

Abdomen - Bloated abdomen. Tympanitic distension with cold feet. Ascites. Brown spots on abdomen. Food allergies. Gastroenteritis from fright. Epigastric anxiety, pressure. Sensation as if a band about waist. Sensation of something moving up and down or as of a hard body rolling, when turning to the right side. Shooting pain across lower abdomen from right to left. Tension and pain in abdomen from incarcerated flatus. Hot pains flash across bowels. Bursting pain in abdomen, during stool. Fermentation in intestines like yeast. Much noisy flatulence, pressing out, worse lower abdomen. Immediately after eating, abdomen is bloated andfull. Flatulence before and after stool. Colic in babies with gas and bloating, worse evening. Diabetes. Inactive intestinal tract. Hernia, right side. Colon cancer.

Rectum - Sharp pains and cramps in rectum. Aching and pressure in rectum, worse at night. Itching and tension at anus. Chilliness in rectum before stools. Biting and burning pain in rectum during and after stool. Rawness, great excoriations about anus, bleed easily, itching and moist. Hemorrhoids, aching, painful to touch (Mur-ac.). Hemorrhoids, painful when Lycopodium clavatum sitting, better hot bathing. Inactivity of bowels. Ineffectual urging from contraction of sphincters. Cramps in rectum and small of back, like labor pains. Feeling as if much remained unpassed after stools. Alternating diarrhea and constipation. Constipation, when away from home or traveling. Constipation of children, since puberty, since childbirth. Constipation or diarrhea during pregnancy. Diarrhea after suppression of skin eruptions. Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if brain vacillating to and fro. As if temples being screwed together. As if head would burst. As if head opened. Pain in head as if caused by wrong position. As if esophagus was being clutched and twisted. As if steam rising from stomach to head. As if something were moving up and down in stomach. Asif stomach would fall down. As if suspensory ligament of liver would tear. As if drops of water were falling down. As if heart hung by a thread. Tension as from a cord in diaphragm. As if chest constricted with tight waistcoat. As if gimlets were running into spine. As if dogs with sharp teeth were gnawing her.

Urine - Urine, scanty, cries before urinating, must strain. Urine, milky, turbid, pale and clear, burning hot. Heavy red sediment in urine, thick, purulent, nauseating smell. Hematuria from gravel or chronic catarrh. Vertigo - Vertigo when looking at anything turning. Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo reels back and forth. Vertigo in hot room. Gets hot during vertigo, face reddens, eyes water and become dim. Vision - Day-blindness (Both.). Black, floating spots before eyes. Hemiopia, sees only one-half of an object. Must wipe mucus from eyes in order to see clearly. Letters run together or become indistinct while reading or writing, must vary distance of page. Impaired vision seems as if one was looking through fine lattice. Flickering and dim vision after a nap in afternoon. Nightblindness. In artificial light all objects tremble. Sees sparks in the dark. COMMENTS - Lyc. was praised by Wedel, Lantilius, Gesner and others in cardialgía and flatulent colic of children and young girls, diseases of children, and nephritic colic and stones. Merat and de Lens spoke of its internal use in rheumatism, retention of urine, nephritis, epilepsy and pulmonary diseases. Diabetes, arthritis, hypoglycemia, depression, and dyslexia. Useful for early stage alcoholics. Teste mentioned that it is recorded that a decoction of the plant caused vomiting. The use of the powder in intertrigo was not regarded as a physical one but as medicinal. In Poland it was used for powdering the hair in “plica polonica,” a decoction being used internally and also externally at the same time. Apprehensiveness. Anxiety about performance, particularly sexual. Fear of public speaking, failure, success, new situations, commitments and responsibility. Fear of being alone, of men, of his own shadow. Agoraphobia. Hypochondriacs. Panic attacks (Ars., Phos., Kali-ar., Med.). Susceptible to causes of fear that make a profound effect on bodily organs. Profound sadness and inclination to weep. Poor confidence and low self-esteem. Forgetfulness. Peevish. Avaricious. Imperiousness. Miserliness. Overly concerned with image. Love of power. Dictatorial tendencies. Attracted to politics (Ign., Nairn., Calc., Lyc., Nux-v.), for the power and the stature, the ego, the class, society. Can be domineering, aggressive. Headaches, worse from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m.. eating, warmth of bed, becoming heated during a walk, heat in general, mental exertion, better in open air, in cool place, by uncovering. Rush of blood to the head. Falling of hair with crusty scalp eruption. Face is pale and yellow, deeply furrowed, looks elongated. Inflammation of eyes and lids. Ophthalmia, conjunctiva looks like red flesh. Sordes in teeth. Facial neuralgias. Nodding and side to side movement of the head. Spasmodic movements of facial muscles, angles of mouth alternately drawn up and relaxed and spasmodic movements of tongue. The tongue cannot be protruded, rolls from side to side like a pendulum. Cramp in the tongue when speaking, cutting off the end of every sentence. Rapid, fan-like movement of ale nasi occurring in cerebral, pulmonary and abdominal complaints, not synchronous with breathing. Sciatica, cannot bear to lie on painful side it is so sensitive, especially if on right side. Paralysis and paralytic weakness of limbs, of brain. Heaviness of the arm. Contraction of the tendons, especially hamstrings. Right foot hot, left foot cold. Cutting pains shooting from right to left in any part (opposite of Lach.). Burning pains better by heat, burning like hot coals between scapula. Burning stinging in breasts. Dryness of parts, of mucus membranes, of vagina, of skin, especially palms. Suppurative conditions, even gangrene. Characteristic suddenness, sudden flashes of heat, lightning-like pains, sudden satiety. Pains and symptoms come and go suddenly (Bell.). Sensation as if a hand were in the body clutching the entrails (Bell.). Restless- ness, better by motion (Rhus-t.). Keynote worse from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. In one case cured by Lyc. it was “bad from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.. better at 8 p.m., gone at 9 p.m.” Characteristic right to left movement. Better from uncovering, particularly headaches (opposite Sil.). Better from loosening garments. Better from warm drinks, worse from cold food and drinks. Desires fresh air (Puls.). Excessive sensitiveness, worse touch and pressure. All soft parts are sensitive, gums, epigastrium, abdomen, right side of chest, eruption around anus. Cannot bear any strong smells. Cannot endure noise. In the evening she continues to hear the music she has heard during the day. Deficiency of vital heat. Puerperal fever with sensation as though hot balls dropped from each breast through to back, rolling down back, along each leg and dropping off heels, this alternates with a sensation as it balls of ice followed same course. Phlegmasia dolens. Respiratory disorders. Salt sputa, milky, greenish yellow, thick yellow mucus, pus. Dry burning catarrh of nose, larynx, throat, chest. “Dry teasing cough in emaciated boys.” Cough provoked by irritation from deep breathing, stretching out throat and by empty swallowing. Cough worse on waking. Affects the blood vessels from the heart to the capillaries. Nevus, aneurysm, disordered heart. Varicose veins. Weak digestive tract. Easy satiety. Sleepy after meals. Diabetes and hypoglycemia. Sinking sensation at epigastrium, worse in the night, waking up the patient or worse in afternoon. Cord-like tension across hypochondria. Great sensitiveness in liver region. Borborygmi under left ribs in front. Sour stomach, sour taste, sour vomiting. Often thirsty, for small amounts, but drinking cold water causes nausea. Great weakness with the vomiting. Craves sugar and starch (Kali-c, Chin., Nat-c.). Aggravated by or averse to onions and garlic (Thuj.). Worse from flatulence foods, cabbage, broccoli, and beans. Kidney colic with stinging, tearing, digging pain in right ureter to bladder, as if some small calculus was tearing its way to the bladder. Aching in back, kidneys, before urination, better after urinating. Pale, whitish, cloudy mucus, urine often fetid. Child cries before urinating, red sand is found in diaper. Gas and bloating. Incarcerated flatulence, more in intestines than in stomach, painful with better by belchings. Flatulence pressing outward, on rectum and bladder, sensation as if something moving up and down in the bowels. Pushing out in right inguinal ring. Right inguinal hernia, especially in children. Spasmodic constriction of rectum. For constipation where purgatives have been abused. Constipation of infants. Extreme sadness and irritability before menses, ceasing with the flow. Menses are too early and too profuse. Ill-humor. Bearing-down pains and headache. Intolerance of tight clothing. Left ovarian pain, dull aching, worse on raising the limb or turning in bed. Nausea, varicose veins and excessive fetal movements during pregnancy. Unsatisfactory labor pains. Impotence, from masturbation, sexual excess, or age. Desire is strong but the power is absent, penis small, cold, relaxed. There was an involuntary proving of Lyc. from inhalation of the fumes in the course of a chemical experiment, Lyc. powder being added to a boiling mass. The writer (apparently a medical man) had at times, while engaged in the experiments, frightful headaches (occiput, vertex and through right eye). S. A. Jones called attention to the irritability of Lyc. and noted the cure of a boy with typhoid with excessive tympanites when the case seemed almost hopeless. The guiding symptoms were “when awake exceedingly cross, irritable, scolding, screaming, behaving disagreeably,” which was quite different from his usual nature. Lyc. 30c was given. The “fan-like movement” of the ale nasi led Halbert to the cure of a case of nervous asthma. Mrs. S., 28, had periodic attacks of spasmodic asthma, always ushered in by unusual excitement and attended by peculiar mental depression. The attack for which Halbert saw her was induced by a violent fit of anger and persisted longer than usual. Extreme despondency and melancholy, would have nothing to do with her friends. Constriction of throat like globus, but always induced by regurgitation of food. Excessive appetite easily satisfied. Fullness of abdomen with flatulence. Constipation, dry, hard stools. Dyspnea. Slight cough with chest constriction, better in open air. All symptoms worse 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Lyc. 6x cured. A patient of Clarke's took Lye. 30c and developed a “pain under sternum as if food lodged there and she could not breathe through it.” Loosvelt found that “half-open condition of the eyes during sleep” is a strong indication for Lyc. and led him to make cures in cases of bronchitis, pneumonia and typhoid when other remedies have failed. Majumdar recorded the case of a boy, 14, who had general dropsy and anasarca consequent on the subsidence of an enlarged spleen under allopathic medication. There was afternoon fever (worse 4 to 8 p.m.), slight chilliness, but no thirst, difficult breathing on lying down, urine scanty and high colored, bowels constipated, heart's action weak but regular. Apis caused the urine to be more free, but a troublesome diarrhea set in. Apoc. 6x removed the diarrhea, but had no effect on the dropsy. Lyc. 30c was then given purely on the symptoms and quickly cleared up the case. H. Goullon cured a case of cystitis in a man, 55, subject to attacks of enteralgia. He was seized two days after such an attack with a severe cystitis with fever and palpitation of the heart. The calls to urinate were increased and he could hardly reach the vessel quick enough to prevent premature escape of the urine, so severe and sudden was the urging. During, and sometimes after the passage, there was intense burning pain, “as if molten lead were flowing through the urethra.” During the height of the pain he grasped his penis to obtain relief. The urine, which was discharged in very scanty quantities, looked turbid, almost loamy, had a dirty brownish- red color and a peculiar odor of malt. Lyc. 12c was given, six drops in half a wine glassful of water, a teaspoonful every three hours. Cured in twenty-four hours. Drysdale recorded the cure of a young woman whose hands were covered with warts. One 2 grains tablet of Lyc. 6c trituration was given at bedtime. The warts soon began to shrivel and in less than six weeks were all gone. Clarke gave Miss E. Lyc. 30c for constipation. Soon after taking it she had pains in upper abdomen in all directions, urging to stool without ability to pass it, much flatus which could neither be got up nor down. Lyc. 1,000c. was now given, afew globules dissolved in water, a teaspoonful at bedtime. All symptoms vanished. On rising, a second teaspoonful was taken and after this the bowels were well relieved. On another occasion she took Lyc. 1,000c. in the evening and immediately felt her throat tight and uncomfortable, but this passed, and she went to bed. At 5 a.m. she woke with choking and had the greatest difficulty in getting her breath. She managed to reach a bottle of Bell. 3c and a dose of this relieved her at once. A patient for whom Lyc. 5c had, to her great delight, reduced the gouty swellings about her finger joints. Now she could get rings on she had not been able to wear for years, but she was obliged to discontinue it on account of the distressing headaches it caused. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Puls., Caust. Compare: (1) Alum. - Lyc. is the only vegetable that takes up aluminum (Allen). (2) Ant-c., Nat-m., Bry., Nux-v., (3) Both. - day- blindness, can scarcely see after sunrise, pain in right great toe. (4) Plumbg. - a Brazilian plant. Costive with red urine, pain in kidneys and joints and body generally, milky saliva, ulcerated mouth. (5) Kali-c., Nat-c.. Calc-c., China, Sulph. Complementary: Lyc. acts with special benefit after calc, and Sulph., lod.. Graph, Lach., Chel., Hydr. follows Lyc. in indigestion. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Cutting pain in glans penis on urinating. Soreness between scrotum and thigh. Discharge of prostatic fluid without an erection. Chronic orchitis. Enlarged prostate. Tumor behind corona glandis. Condylomata. Sexual desire too strong. Performance anxiety. Premature seminal emission (Agn., Calad., Sel.). Exhausting pollutions. Falls asleep during sex. Sexual exhaustion, weakness. Impotence. No erectile power, penis small, cold, relaxed. Loss of sexual desire after gonorrhea or cystitis.

Female - Delayed menses with undeveloped breasts at puberty. Depressed mood and indigestion before menses. Menses too late, with sadness. Menses protracted, too profuse. Menses partly black, partly bright red. Menses of clots and serum. Menses suppressed for months, from fright. Chronic suppression of menses from tuberculosis or cancer. Dysmenorrhea, violent with fainting. Labor-like pains during menses with fainting. Discharge of blood from genitals during stools. Leucorrhea, acrid, with burning in vagina. Leucorrhea, periodical, milky, worse before full moon. Pains in right ovary, from right to left. Ovarian tumors. Ovarian dropsy. Dropsy of uterus. Cramps in uterus after stool. Flatus from vagina. Vaginitis. Serous cysts in vagina. Vagina, dry, burning, worse during and after sex. Aversion to sex. Sex painful. Nymphomania. Fetus seems to be turning somersaults. Disposition to miscarriage, moles. Food - Malnutrition. Excessive hunger, canine hunger. Hurried when eating. Hypoglycemia, headache when not eating regularly. Loss of appetite. Bulimia, with much bloating. Diabetes. Likes to take drink and food hot. Desire for sweets, delicacies, pastries, alcohol. Food tastes sour. Food allergies, wheat. Worse from breads, fermentedfoods and fermentable dough. Aggravated from alcohol, wine. tobacco, flatulent food, cabbage, beans, oysters and onions. Aversion to sweets, bread, fermented foods, soup, meat, coffee. Averse to boiled food, warm food, cold drinks or food.

Chest - Tensive, constrictive, burning pain in chest. Feeling of tightness in chest with burning. Itching on chest. Tension as of a hoop on chest. Constriction from right side all around short ribs. Difficult respiration due to hydrothorax and hydropericardium. Stitches in left side with inflammation of lungs. Dilatation of air tubes. Tearing and tension under clavicles. Foul, viscid sweat in axilla like onions. Swelling of axillary glands. Axillary abscess. Hydrothorax. Boils. Brown yellow spots on chest. Constitutions - Grauvogle's carbo-ni- trogenoid constitutions. Suited to persons of keen intellect, but feebler muscular development, upper part of body wasted, lower semi-dropsical, lean and predisposed to lung and hepatic conditions, herpetic and scrofulous constitutions. Weak muscular power, lack vital heat, circulation poor, it seems to stand still with cold, numb limbs or numbness may appear in spots. Hypochondriacs subject to skin diseases, lithic acid diathesis, much red sediment in urine, urine itself transparent, sallow people with cold limbs, haughty disposition, when sick, mistrustful, low of comprehension, weak memory. Weak children with well-developed heads but puny, sickly bodies, irritable, nervous and unmanageable when sick after sleep cross, pushing every one away angrily. Old women and children. Persons of dry temperament and dark complexion. Undernourished states. Old persons or who become old early, where the skin shows yellowish spots, or to precocious weakly children.

Heart - Aortic disease. Aneurysm (Bar-c.). Angina pectoris. Hypertrophy. Hydropericardium. Sensations as if circulation stood still. Pulsating tearing in region of heart. Ebullitions of blood. Accelerated pulse with cold face and feet. Pulse, fast, worse after eating, evening. Palpitations from overeating. Palpitations on turning over in bed at night. Cannot lie on left side.

Back - Pain and stiffness in back. Bubbling sensation. Throbbing and pulsating in back. Rising of warmth along spine. Lumbago, worse slightest motion, worse sitting erect, better urinating. Tensive pain in nape. One side of the neck stiff and swollen. Emaciation about the neck. Burning, as from hot coals between the scapulae. Pain in the back and right side from congestion of liver. Back as if broken during stool. Stitches in small of back. Darting in right cervical muscles from below upward. Swelling of cervical glands.

Limbs - Limbs go to sleep. Numbness, drawing and tearing in limbs. Twitching and jerking. Cannot lie on painful side. Rheumatism. Stiffness of all joints. Chronic gout with chalky deposits in joints. Pain in bones at night. Curvature and decay of bones. Sciatica, worse right side. Varicose veins on legs. Cramps in calves and toes at night in bed. Emaciation of one hand or Lycopodium clavatum one leg. Painful callosities on soles, toes and fingers contracted. Pain in heel on treading as from a pebble. Profuse sweat of the feet. One foot hot, the other cold. Corns. Chilblains. Hands and feet numb. Heaviness of arms. Tearing in shoulder and elbow joints. Axillary abscess.

Sleep - Drowsy during day. Irresistible drowsiness after eating. Child sleeps all day and cries all night. Starting up on falling asleep. Restless sleep. Laughs and weeps in sleep. Soporous sleep in typhoid and exanthematous fevers. Confused, anxious, vivid dreams. Horrid dreams, of sickness, of fatal accidents. Frightful dreams frequently awaking him. Wakes at night feeling hungry. On waking, the child starts, becomes cross kicks, scolds or holds his mother. Awakes terrified. Unrefreshed in morning.

Skin - Dry skin, shrunken, especially palms. Skin becomes thick and indurated. Dropsy. Rawness in folds. Ulcerates. Ulcers fistulous. Fissured eruptions. Offensive secretions. Scabs do not separate. Abscesses beneath skin. Skin hot. burning, itching when warm. Eczema associated with urinary, gastric, hepatic disorders. Chronic eczema. Psoriasis. Hives, worse warmth. Acne. Blood boils, remain blue. Varicose veins. Brown spots, freckles worse on left side of face and nose. Nevi, erectile tumors. Lice, itching violently.

Modalities - Better by motion, belchings, urinating, after midnight. Better from warm food and drink, on getting cold, being uncovered, cold applications. Worse right side, from right to left, from above downward. Worse warm room, hot air, bed, warm applications, except throat and stomach which are better from warm drinks. Worse from pressure of clothes, eating, oysters, milk, vegetables, cabbage, beans, bread, pastry. Worse wind, wet, stormy weather, 4 p.m. to 8 p.m., awakening. Worse before or from suppressed menses.

Teeth - Teeth yellow. Front teeth feel loose. Teeth excessively painful to touch. Sensations as if teeth too long. Grinding of teeth during heavy stupor, as when fully awake. Toothache when chewing. Toothache with swelling of cheek, better warm application, warm drinks. Toothache at night, keeps her awake at night. Swelling of gum above front teeth, with swelling of upper lip. Gumboils. Gums and soft palate covered with a lardaceous coating. Gums bleed when touched or cleaning teeth. Fistula dentalis.

Tongue - Tongue dry, black, cracked, swollen. stiff and heavy. White coated tongue with a dry line down center. Dryness of tongue, without thirst. Blisters on tongue. Tongue burning and thick, as after much smoking. Tongue feels scalded and raw. Vesicles on tip of tongue, ulcers on and under tongue. Convulsions of tongue. Tongue oscillates to and fro, trembles.

Liver - Weak liver and poor digestion. Atrophic, nutmeg liver. Sensitive, congested liver. Sore, pressive, bruised, in region of liver, on breathing, worse touch. Liver painful to pressure in spots. Liver complaints after mortification. Chronic hepatitis. Hepatitis with pneumonia. Hepatitis of children. Jaundice with flatulence, retarded stool, weariness and drowsiness. Violent gallstone colic. Dropsy, due to hepatic disease, after abuse of alcohol. Ascites from liver diseases. Lungs - Dull aching all over lungs. Craves air but is chilled by it. Shortness of breath. Difficult breathing due to hydrothorax. Dyspnea, worse lying on back, during sleep. Short, rattling breathing, worse lying on back. Neglected or unresolved pneumonia with great dyspnea. Catarrh of the chest in infants, seems full of mucus rattling. Senile catarrh. Bronchocele on right side. Flying of ala nasi and presence of mucus rales. Expectorations gray, thick, bloody, purulent, salty. Expectoration greenish-yellow, lumpy orfoul expectoration. Abscess of the lungs, tuberculosis. Wheezing and asthma.

Kidneys - Aching in kidney, worse before and better after urinating. Kidney colic in ureter (right) to bladder. Renal colic in ureter. Pain in back before urinating, ceases after flow, slow in coming, must strain. Retention. Hot urine. Heavy red sediment. Disposition to calculi. Hematuria. Urine bloody with paraplegia or sometimes with constipation. Child cries before urinating (Bor.). Polyuria during the night. Involuntary urination in fever or from fright during sex.

Bladder - Involuntary urination. Frequent urging to urinate, after taking cold, better riding in cars. Bearing down over bladder. Stitches in neck of bladder. Urging to urinate, must wait long before it will pass. Urine frequent and copious at night, scanty by day. Urine suppressed, retained. Breasts - Stitches and burning pains in nipples, with discharge of blood and water. Hard burning nodosities in breasts with stitching, aching pains and soreness. Rawness of nipples, sore, fissured, bleed easily. Delayed menses with undeveloped breasts at puberty. Milk in breast without being pregnant. Child vomits blood after sucking bleeding nipples. Causations - Ill effects of fear, fright, abuse, anger, anxiety, embarrassment. Ailments from sugar, sweets, tobacco chewing, wine. Ailments from fevers, overlifting, masturbation, riding in a carriage.

Cough - Cough is deep, hollow. Tickling cough. Dry cough in puny boys with emaciation. Cough, worse eating and drinking cold things, worse going down hill. Loose cough in daytime and suffocative fits at night. Night cough, tickling as from sulphur fumes.

Perspiration - Viscid and offensive perspiration. Cold, sour sweats. Foul sweat, smelling like onions, of axillary, feet. Sweats from least exertion. Clammy sweats at night with coldness of face. Perspiration on chest and trunk, face, about scalp and temples.

Temperature - Chill between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m., followed by sweat. Icy coldness, feels as if lying on ice. One chill followed by another (Calc., Sil., Hep.). Body becomes cold during cough. Chill alternating with heat. Periodic recurrence of chill. Fever, continuous, remittent intermittent. Fever and sweat every afternoon from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Old. broken down cases of malaria. Typhoid fever. Febrile attacks during tuberculosis.

name: Lycopus Virginicus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse motion, exercise, walking, ascending. Worse at sunset, evening, morning, with aching down spine, better after rising..
constitution: Aneurysm. Bright's disease. Cough. Diabetes. Exophthalmos, //eruoptysis. Headache. Heart, diseases. Hemorrhoids. Malaria. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pericarditis. Reptile, bites. Snakebites. Tarantula bites. Tuberculosis. Typho-malarial fever.
keynote: PHARMACY - lycps. Lycopus virginicus. Bugle-weed. Virginia horehound. N. O. Labiate. Shady and wet places in North America. Tincture of fresh plant in flower. Tincture of the whole plant by macerating one part by weight of the fresh plant in two parts by weight of alcohol.…
full:
PHARMACY - lycps. Lycopus virginicus. Bugle-weed. Virginia horehound. N. O. Labiate. Shady and wet places in North America. Tincture of fresh plant in flower. Tincture of the whole plant by macerating one part by weight of the fresh plant in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Bright's disease. Cough. Diabetes. Exophthalmos, //eruoptysis. Headache. Heart, diseases. Hemorrhoids. Malaria. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pericarditis. Reptile, bites. Snakebites. Tarantula bites. Tuberculosis. Typho-malarial fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to Hale, Lycps. is mentioned by Rafinesque as “partaking of the properties of Digitalis, Sang., Cimic. and Spig.” and as being “one of the mildest and best narcotics in existence.” Hale commended Lycps. as a substitute for Dig., having the advantage over it of being non-poisonous, as useful in hemoptysis and “wherever it is required to quell inordinate motions of the blood.” Briggs of Fort Lovell, related the cure of a patient of tarantula bite by application of a liquid made of Lycps. He said the Cherokee Indians allow themselves to be bitten by rattlesnakes, centipedes and tarantula, chewing as an antidote large quantities of lycopus and swallowing the juice. H. W. Felter, an eclectic, is quoted as commending Lycps. in passive lung hemorrhage, wild, tumultuous beating of heart, which often precedes the lung hemorrhage, cough of tuberculosis. Lycps. does not disorder the stomach, he says, but acts a tonic and appetizer. Morrisson made an extensive proving of Lycps. and developed unmistakable heart symptoms. Lowers the blood pressure, reduces the rate of the heart and increases the length of systole to a great degree (Adren.). Diseases with tumultuous action of the heart and more or less pain. Feeble heart, with distress and weak pulse. Cardiac irritability with depressed force, with or without organic disease. Hemoptysis due to valvular heart disease. Passive hemorrhages. Pulmonary complaints associated with loose stools. Hemorrhoidal bleeding. Characteristic cough with hemoptysis associated with feeble heart action. Violent cough at night. Lying down causes cardiac depression and lying on right side aggravates constriction of thorax. Pains shift generally right to left. Exophthalmic goiter. Beneficial in toxic goiter used in the pre-operative stage. History of suppressed discharges. MIND - Increased mental and physical activity in evening. Nervous, hurried and tremulous. General wakefulness and morbid vigilance. Instability. Irritability, unless spoken to very softly. Mind wanders from one thing to another. Slow comprehension. Slight dullness of intellect with headache. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated, during menses.

Head - Frontal headache, worse frontal eminences, often succeeded by labored heart. Pressure in forehead, worse left portion. Noise and throbbing in head preventing sleep after suppressed hemorrhoids.

Eyes - Protrusion, pressing outward, with tumultuous action of heart. Eyes feel weak, as if fatigued. Neuralgic pain in right supra orbital region. Supra-orbital pain with aching in testicles.

Ears - Burning in right ear.

Nose - Nosebleed. Sneezing and slight nasal catarrh.

Mouth - Toothache in lower molars.

Throat - Rawness at back of right palate, extending to left. Burning in spot on soft palate, following headache. Vertigo - Vertigo, tends to stagger to right. COMMENTS - The association of Lycps. with Dig., Cimic. and Spig. particularly shows a very clear insight into the action of the remedy, which an experience of Clarke's seems to confirm. Miss S., 25, came to him in October, 1899. About three years ago she had the first symptoms of exophthalmos, which was ascribed by her mother to a prescription of Macrin. in low potency, taken for pains in the eyes and continued for a long period. The first symptoms were sore throat with ulcerations, then the goiter appeared and the heart became painful, its action intermittent with breathlessness and inability to take exertion. After a course of Thyr. and later of Thuj. 30c (she had been vaccinated), Lycps. 12c was given and this took away all the heart pains. Attacks of influenza complicated the case and other remedies had to be given. The patient then did well under Spig. 30c, as far as the heart is concerned, though no impression was made on the goiter, which was small. The heart sounds were normal. Characteristic shifting symptoms. Pains shift from heart to eyes, from head to heart, from heart to left wrist and right calf, and back to wrist and heart. Proell noted two of his cases in which there was a shift from rectum to heart and head. Proell's two cases concerned suppression of hemorrhoidal flux. The patients were each 60 years of age, a man and a woman, both fair with light eyes, tall, very irritable with weak innervation of the heart without decided organic disease. Both had, years before, hemorrhoidal flux which stopped suddenly. Both were hypochondriacal and had noise in their left ear. This last symptom was the chief thing the man complained of, along with throbbing in the head preventing sleep. Neither Cact., Kalm., nor Gels, helped radically. The night after taking Lycps. lx, the man was a little better and in the forenoon bled from the rectum (about three table spoonfuls after defecation) with great general relief. The woman had glycosuria, cataract of left eye and every third night was restless. Lycps. lx, one drop in the evening. The following night she was excellent, and in the morning came an abundant bleeding from the rectum with great relief. Morrison noted a case cured with Lycps. in which the sufferings were associated with the menstrual period, which was exactly regular but intermittent in flow. The first symptoms appeared within three or four hours of the onset of the flow and was a deep-seated pain with heat in occiput. Then followed a train of symptoms, among them nausea, and when the nausea came on the occipital pain was better. Stanley Wilde cured a desperate case of pericarditis associated with bronchitis with Lycps. tincture, as well as a case of palpitation with darting pain in the heart in a young woman, following an attack of acute rheumatism two years before. RELATIONS - Antidote to: Cimic. Compare: (1) Lam. - hemorrhoids, Oci. (2) Iber., Kalm., Spig., Crat., Cact., Dig., Hydr-ac., Laur., Prun., Spig. (heart). (3) Sang. (4) EphedraTeamster's Tea - in exophthalmic goiter, eyes feel pushed out with tumultuous action of heart. (5) Fuc., Spartein, Crat., Adren. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Circumscribed pain and compression in region of stomach. Indigestion with pain and distress in gastric region. Gastritis, enteritis. Nausea with faintness. Diarrhea, dysentery.

Abdomen - Tugging pain in spleen. Tenderness in left hypochondrium. Aching in inguinal canal, bearing down as from hernia. Flatulence and rumbling. Severe colic followed by profuse, forcible diarrhea.

Rectum - Constipation. Diarrhea in jaundice from weakened heart. Diarrhea with griping and rumbling. Bleeding from rectum. Hemorrhoids.

Male - Pain in testicles. Neuralgic pain in testicle with supra-orbital pain.

Female - Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia. Menses intermit for ten or twelve days. Vagina very hot, os uterus engorged and swollen. Puffing of parts on and around pubes and vulva, dilated condition of vagina.

Chest - Constriction across lower half of thorax. Pulmonary disease associated with looseness of bowels.

Heart - Precordial pain, constriction, tenderness. Rheumatoid, flying pains, associated with heart disease. Cyanosis. Heart's action is tumultuous and forcible. Pulse, weak, irregular intermittent, tremulous, rapid. Palpitation from nervous irritation with oppression around heart. Cardiac asthma (Sumb.). Rapid heart action of smokers.

Back - Severe aching down spine. Acute pain at seventh cervical vertebra. Slight rheumatoid pain in left supra- scapular muscles.

Limbs - Muscular rheumatoid pains. Rheumatoid pains in forearm and wrists with trembling of hands. Hands unsteady, writing difficult. Rheumatoid pains in knees, legs, thighs, wandering to back. Slight lameness, unsteady gait. Lungs - Asthma. Wheezing. Breathing oppressed. Cough with hemoptysis. Needing small but frequent. Cough and irritation of lungs with irregular action of heart.

Sleep - Wakeful on retiring, though fatigued. Sleep restless, full of troublesome dreams.

Skin - Prickings as if bitten by insects. Troublesome urticaria on left forearm and right leg, before retiring.

Modalities - Worse motion, exercise, walking, ascending. Worse at sunset, evening, morning, with aching down spine, better after rising.

Kidneys - Profuse flow of liquid, watery urine, especially when the heart is most irritable, also scanty urine. Urine is scanty, thick, muddy. Diabetes mellitus, great thirst and emaciation.

Bladder - Tenderness in bladder. Bladder feels distended when empty. Causations - Suppressed hemorrhoidal flow.

HOMEOPATHIC - Clifford Mitchel gave the 50 percent solution in ten-drop doses well diluted in aerated water, thrice daily in two cases of oxaluria. One case was in a young man, recent, and one in an old man, long standing. In the second case, the distressing lumbar pain was removed by a few doses though it had persisted for a number of days. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Nit-m-ac., Ox-ac., Sars., Urotrop. REFERENCES-Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - lyss. Lyssinum. Rabies nosode. Lyssin. Hydrophobinum. Trituration of sugar of milk saturated with the saliva of a rabid dog. Triturations might also be made of the cultured microorganisms. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anxiety. Bubo. Clairvoyance. Convulsions. Corns, painful. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Esophagus, stricture. Fever. Hair, oily. Headaches. Hydrophobia. Hypersensitiveness. Hysteria. Insanity. Leucorrhea. Lys- sophobia. Mania. Nervousness. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Pregnancy, convulsions. Rabies. Respiratory, paralysis. Salivation. Sciatica. Sunstroke. Tetanus. Toothache. Ulcers. Uterus, prolapse. Vaginismus. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering, in 1833, was the first to prove and to suggest the employment of this nosode in medicine. Later, it became notorious from the experiments of Pasteur. The pathogenesis of Lyss, is made up partly of symptoms observed in rabid animals and human patients, but chiefly of symptoms developed in the provings. The remedy has been extensively used in practice, not only in cases of hydrophobia, but in many disorders in which the keynote symptoms have been present. The effects of bites of non-rabid dogs have been removed by this nosode. Dysentery with pain and tenesmus on hearing water running from a tap. Copious viscid saliva. Thirst with inability to swallow. Suffocating feelings. Sighing and sighing respiration. Trembling or quivering sensation throughout the whole body. Sensitiveness to breath of air, to bright objects, especially the surface of water, to sounds, and, most of all, to the sound of running water. Convulsions brought on by dazzling light or sight of running water. Thought of light or water is enough to bring on an aggravation or a convulsion. Aching in bones. Bluish discoloration of wounds. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Senses become over-acute. Noticeable rapid speech and impatience. Irritable, violent temper. Cannot bear the heat of the sun. Symptoms are better from sweating. A number of cures of hydrophobia have been reported from forced perspirations, especially from prolonged and repeated use of the Turkish bath. This is known as the Buisson treatment from Dr. Buisson who originated it. MIND - Hyperactivity of the mind. Hypersensitiveness of all senses. Heightened awareness. Empathetic to others pain. Clairvoyance. Emotions and bad news aggravate. History of physical or sexual abuse. Feelings of isolation and of being ridiculed or tormented. Anxiety, restlessness, with great prostration. Rapid speech. Roams about. Anxiety from hearing church bells. Indecision even in small matters. Thoughts of something terrible going to happen come into his mind against his will. Fear something bad will happen. Feels he cannot physically endure his fears much longer. Lyssophobia, fear of insanity. Fear of driving, airplanes, injury, suffocation, choking, being bitten by dogs. Fear of being alone. Claustrophobia. Agoraphobia. Hydrophobia. Fear of mirrors in room. Fear during pregnancy. Strange notions and apprehensions during pregnancy. Worse thinking of water, fluids, brings on convulsions. Irritability on hearing or seeing water. The sight of water is intolerable. Wants water but can't drink it. Worse shining objects, mirrors. Copper metal, if in his room, makes him restless and full of pains. Never well since having a dog bite. Weary and incapable of mental exertion. Dullness and stupidity, at night restlessness. Depressed, as if something would happen. Felt as if she was going to die, as if she was going to sink away. Loss of consciousness. Ill-humor. Irritable and critical. Impatient. Violent temper, impelled to do reckless things. Rude, abusive, bites and strikes, bites or stabs himself. Growls. Cursing. Insane ideas enter his head. Thinks he is insulted, has suffered a wrong, that he is tormented. Anger followed by remorse. Compulsive disorders. Ritualistic behavior. Excitement from hearing conversation. Can't bear to hear others sing, or eat apples. Does not hear or see persons around him. Doesn't answer questions. Clairvoyance.

Head - Headache from bite of dog, whether rabid or not, worse by noise of running water, bright light. Chronic headaches from mental emotion or exertion. Sharp pain above eyebrows. Boring pain in forehead. Maddening outward pressing pain in forehead, sensation as if head would burst. Severe pressing in left side of head. Headaches with general weariness. Headaches with salivation. Headaches alternating with hot flushes in face. Rush of blood to head, while lying down. Throws the head back when sneezing. Very sensitive scalp. Dry hair becomes oily.

Eyes - Eyes are wild, rolling, staring and livid. Dilatation of pupils. Eyes bloodshot. Eyes congested and painful. Itching heat in eyes. Burning of eyeballs. Stinging pain in left eye. Great weakness in eyes, without pain. Sensitive to light. Eyelids feel paralyzed on awaking. Pain in small in spot over right eye brow, worse writing.

Ears - Ears feel stiff. Itching of ear. Itching in a small spot in upper part of both ears, better scratching. Sharp pains passing into in ears. Buzzing in right ear. Conversation in vicinity of patient may throw him into a most violent agitation. Hearing water poured out in next room makes him very irritable and nervous. Clairaudient.

Nose - Nose stiff. Nose feels bruised. Itching in nose all day. Sneezing from tickling in nasal cavity. Frequent sneezing, as if a coryza would begin and from every little dust. Coryza with tickling in roof of mouth. Fluid nasal discharge. Great sensibility to smell of tobacco. Strong odors may start spasms.

Face - Face pale and yellowish. Bluish pimples on face. Heat and redness of face. Face sweats with sensation of heat with flushes. Countenance changes its aspect frequently. Quivering in face. Facial muscles become contorted. Spasms with froth before mouth. Gnawing and crawling sensation in zygoma. Lower jaw stiff and painful with inclination to yawn. Jawbones feel stiff, sore, aching in lower jaw.

Mouth - Bitter taste in morning on awaking. Sore mouth, feels as if there were lumps in it. Feeling of coldness in mouth like essence of peppermint. Saliva tough, ropy, viscid, frothy. Constant spitting. Froths at mouth. Speech impeded from spasms of throat. Feeling of general malaise.

Throat - Sore pain, constant desire to swallow. Difficult swallowing, gagging when swallowing water from spasms. Burning and stinging pain when swallowing water. Slight redness of palate and throat with spasm of esophagus and difficult speech. Sensation as if uvula were too long. Cooling sensation in esophagus. Voice altered in tone tones much suppressed. Hoarse, rough, harsh and weak voice.

Stomach - Aching pain with coldness in stomach. Hiccough. Gagging when he forcibly attempts to swallow water. Nausea with giddiness, headache and pale face after diarrhea. Nausea and vomiting, after diarrhea. Nausea and vomiting of a foamy, mucus, dark-colored substance resembling coffee grounds. Vomiting of food or fluid while drinking. Vomiting at night in sleep.

Abdomen - Distension of abdomen, every evening. Rigidity of muscles of abdomen. Swelling of inguinal glands. Soreness in whole of lower abdomen. Pressing pain in right side, near last ribs with breathing in hypochondria after quick walking. Throbbing pains. Tearing pain from left hypochondriac region to right. Shooting pains in right side of abdomen. Drawing pain below navel. Colicky pain in abdomen.

Rectum - Darting pain into anus causes contraction. Difficult passage of flatus as if anus resisted expulsion. Desire for stool on hearing or seeing running water. Tenesmus during and after stool. Straining to evacuate, causes violent pain in small of back and in rectum. Constipation, stools Lyssinum very dark. Difficult stool, hemorrhoids protrude. Passage of bright red blood, with terrible burning and pricking in anus. Passes blood from anus during menses. Diarrhea worse hearing running water. Profuse, watery stools with pain in bowels, worse evening.

Stool - Tenesmus during and after stool. Dysenteric stools with tenesmus, renewed as soon as he hears or sees water run. Diarrhea with much pain, followed by nausea as if she would have to vomit. Stools of bloody mucus. Involuntary stools.

Male - Burning and itching on corona glandis. Strong erections, without sexual excitement or thoughts. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire. Painful erection of penis and frequent seminal emissions. Semen is discharged too late or not at all during sex. Pain in testicles after sex. Atrophy of testicles. Scrotum tightly drawn up. Hydrocele. Discharge of prostatic fluid, smelling salty and musty.

Female - Menses frequent, protracted, dark, and at times fetid. Menses with hemorrhoids, pulsations in anus and weakness of back. Menses with prolapsed uterus. Severe leucorrhea with pains in back and lower part of bowels, sore vagina. Slimy leucorrhea, profuse, running down the legs. White discharge like leucorrhea, weakening. Uterine sensitiveness, conscious of womb (Helon.). Uterus prolapsed. Uterine displacements. Any change of position that would tilt or rotate os uterus would cause much pain. Sharp pain in uterus, shooting down to labia. Pain in left ovarian region. Vagina sensitive, rendering sex painful (Berb.). Since childbirth, more pain with sex and a dislike to it. Food - Voracious appetite, swallowed wheat without chewing. Inability to take solid food or it is consumed with greatest difficulty. Excessive desire for salt. Craves chocolate. Strange notions, desires or cravings during pregnancy. Wants water but can't drink it, aversion to water. Warm drinks, such as milk, soups and wine, are more easily taken than water. Aversion to apples, fat food. Worse after mutton. Excessive sensibility to smell of tobacco.

Chest - Burning, surging through chest. Burning, stinging in left side of chest, with palpitations. Chest and abdomen feel expanded. Chest as if beaten, in evening. Rheumatic pains across chest when drawing in a breath. Weakness of chest. Lump in right axilla.

Heart - Heat and burning in heart. Violent pain in heart, as if it would burst or had needles running into it. Sharp pains in heart while walking. Dull pain in heart all day. Heart pains with sighing. Feels beating of pulse through whole body. Heart palpitated violently and felt as if it was coming up into throat. Palpitations causes anxiety.

Back - Great weakness in back, as if it would split andfall apart. Back extremely sore, as if beaten. Severe backache with numbness of hands. Shooting pains through small of back. Weakness in back, during copious menses. Considerable pain in lower part of back with soreness felt through to pubic region. Stiffness in joints of back. Hyperesthesia of skin along vertebral column. Pressing in neck and up back of head. Backaches with headaches. Pain in neck better bending head backwards. Stiff neck with shooting pains. Muscles of neck contract spasmodically. Sternocleidomastoid muscle on each side stands out like a thick cord. Breasts - Both breasts swollen when waking in morning. Causations - Ill effects of dog bites, rabies vaccinations.

Limbs - All muscles feel bruised in morning. Drawing in back and limbs. Severe twitching in arms and legs, resembling chorea. Weight and heaviness of legs and shoulders. Weakness in arms. Cramp in arms. Left hip aches in bone. Along left sciatic nerve a dull pain. Weakness in legs when going up stairs. Lungs - Spasmodic contraction of respiratory muscles. Difficult breathing and spasmodic sensation in trachea. Dyspnea with flatulency, cough and rattling in chest. Breathing held for a time. Oppression in breathing. Breathing, gasping, irregular and quite rapid. Barking cough with gagging. Sighing, groaning respira- tion from cardiac pain. Frequent sighing and sobbing. Voice altered in its tone.

Sleep - Inclination to yawn and stretch, with stiffness of lower jaw. Yawns frequently without sleepiness, especially when listening to others. Insomnia, sleepless in spite of narcotics. Sleeplessness from excitement or despair. Starting in sleep. Dreams of dogs, of high places, of insane asylums, churches. On waking, is morose and inclined to be angry.

Skin - Biting, itching in various parts of body, worse by scratching. Itching as soon as beginning to get warm in bed. Malignant ulcersfrom bite of a dog. Bluish discoloration of bitten place (Lach.). Dark, livid-marks where inoculations were made. Pustules. Cancerous sores.

Modalities - Better gentle rubbing, bending backwards, steam or hot water bathing. Worse glistening objects, dazzling or reflected light, mirrors. Worse from sight or sound of running water, thinking of fluids, pouring water. Worse from heat of sun, wind, drafts. Worse stooping, riding in a carriage, mental exertion, bed news.

Teeth - Grinding of teeth. Teeth as if on edge. Painful sensation of coldness shooting into teeth. Frequent shooting pains in teeth. Toothache during pregnancy. Drawing pains in gums. Aching in swollen gums.

Tongue - Tongue large, pale and flabby. Tongue coated with foam, with thin layer of yellowish white fur, in center. Tongue dark red on sides. Pricking sensation under tongue. Cool feeling on tongue like after peppermint. Pain or tickling in root of tongue. Root of tongue as if swollen. Vertigo - Vertigo as if something was drawing around in a circle. Vertigo as if she could not hold her head straight. Vertigo with inclination to fall to right when stooping. Vertigo with dim sight while walking and sitting. Vertigo with chill and intolerable snappish headache. Vertigo with nausea, cramps in abdomen. Violent vertigo during morning. Vertigo temporarily better by return of diarrhea. Vision - Sees sparks. Something moves to and fro before eyes while sewing. Vanishing of sight. Impaired vision with dilatation of pupils. Couldn't read longer than a few minutes at a time, when she would see letters double. COMMENTS - Lyss, is a close analog of many of the animal poisons, especially Lach. Rabies (Bell., Stram., Canth.). It has been used as a prophylactic to prevent the development of rabies. Also, for the side effects of rabies shots. For the effects of bites from non-rabid dogs, especially headaches. Bluish discoloration of wounds (Lach). Hydrophobia. Gagging, panic attacks at the sound or thought of water. Aggravated by shiny objects. Photophobia. Mania, delusions, hallucinations. Hyperesthesia. Violent agitation and severe convulsions from air currents, approaching people, slightest touch, over hearing conversation. Convulsions from the thought of fluids, drinking, swallowing. Convulsions from dazzling or reflected light from water or mirror (Stram.). Cannot bear heat of sun (Gels., Glon., Lach., Nat.). Profuse salivation. Saliva tough, ropy, viscid, frothy in mouth and throat, with constant spitting (Hydr.). Sore throat, constant desire to swallow (Lac-c., Mer.). Difficulty in swallowing. Spasm of esophagus from swallowing liquids, gagging when swallowing water. Constant desire to urinate on seeing running water (Canth., Sulph.). Urine scanty, cloudy, contains sugar. Prolapsed uterus, many cases of years standing have been ctired. Leucorrhea, profuse, running down the legs (Alum., Syph., Tub.). Sensitiveness of vagina, rendering coition painful. Complaints resulting from abnormal sexual desire (from abstinence, Con.). Mental emotion or mortifying news always makes him worse (Gels). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Canth., Bell., Hyos. Stram., Lach., Nat-m. (2) Xanth. - said to be specific for hydrophobia and is recommended for chronic cystitis in women. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Dull pressure in region of left kidney. Flying pains in urinary organs, causes difficulty and heat in urination. Desire to urinate on seeing running water, cannot urinate unless he hears water run. Urine too scanty and high-colored. Urine dark, brownish, with whitish sediment. Profuse watery urine, in evening.

Temperature - Paroxysms of intense coldness, with pain in spine. Chilly feeling. Chills mixed and followed by heat and cold sweat. Cannot bear heat of sun. Intermittent fever. Fever every evening commencing at dusk and lasting until bedtime. Fever during headache.

CLINICAL - Backache. Dysmenorrhea. Eye, disorders. Fears. Headaches. Irritable. Lumbago. Melancholy. Menses, disorders. Muscle, pain. Muscle, weakness. Neuralgic, pains. Rheumatism. Uterine, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Muscular system exhausted after the least exertion. Muscular weakness. Excessive restlessness, better by moving about in spite of the weakness. Melancholic and irritable. Dullness of intellect. Symptoms generally improved by onset of menses. Symptoms of the mind, eyes and breasts are worse before menses and better as soon as flow sets in (Cimic., mental symptoms worse during menses). Backache, better after menses. MIND - Great restlessness. Fear of impending danger or having an incurable disease. Melancholic, irritable, better when menses come on. Dullness of mind. Sits for a long time thoughtless, moving hands and feet, frequent sighing. COMMENTS - C. A. Howell noted the case of a woman, 63, who after an interval of eleven year began again to menstruate at 60, slightly but regularly. Symptoms appeared suddenly at the time the flow was due, but failed to come on, including intense pain at the occiput, worse at every throb of heart. Retraction of head and neck. Neuralgic pains in limbs. Pulse 96. temperature 99. Howell gave her Macrin. 2x, every two hours. The pain was relieved in a few hours and the menses came on. REFERENCES-Clarke.

name: Magnesia Carbonica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better motion. Better walking in open air. Better warm air. Cold water improves toothache for a short time, then aggravates. Worse rest, warmth of bed, uncovering. Worse every second day, every third week. Worse cold, wind. Worse change of weather. Worse drafts, night. Draft aggravates facial neuralgia. Pains are worse by rest insupportable, must get up and walk about..
