PHARMACY - mag-c. Magnesia carbónica. Magnesiumcarbonate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Alcoholism. Antrum, disorders. Ascarides. Belching. Boils. Cataract. Catarrh. Constipation. Colic. Coma. Cornea, opacities. Cough. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eyes, inflammation. Heartburn. Hernia. Hysteria. Indigestion. Insomnia. Leucorrhea. Malnutrition. Marasmus. Menopausal, disorders. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, delayed. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Nervousness. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostration. Regurgitation. Spasms. Spleen, pain. Stomach, disorders. Taste, disordered. Tinnitus. Toothache. Tumors. Unconsciousness. Uterine, disorders. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nervous irritations and sleeplessness (Gels., Cham., Ars.), nerve exhaustion. Nervous systems that demand a permanently soothing and sustaining influence. Nerve prostration. Numbness and distention in various parts. Intense neuralgic pains. Spasms. Epileptic attacks, while walking or standing he frequently falls down suddenly with consciousness. Sensitive to least touch, noise or start. Effects of shock, blows, mental distress. Ailments from excess of care and worry with constipation and heaviness. Broken- down, “worn-out” women with uterine and menopausal disorders. Dryness of mucus membranes, skin. Tendency to boils, especially in children. Enlarged glands. Affections of the antrum of Highmore. Malnutrition. Emaciation. Marasmus, children do not thrive in spite of feeding and medicines. Sour smell from the body (Rob.), especially in children, with vomiting, regurgitation, stools etc. Catarrhal condition of stomach and bowels with marked acidity. Tendency to constipation after nervous strain. Walking fatigues, causes involuntary urination, prickings in rectum, smarting leu- corrhea. Symptoms worse from cold winds or weather. Cannot bear hands covered, yet chilled by uncovering. MIND - Mental exhaustion. Worse from mental exertion. Brain fag. Concentration difficult while writing. Absent- mindedness. Industrious, mania for work. Indolence, aversion to work. Confusion of mind, as if intoxicated. Dazed feeling, packs and unpacks her clothes without consciousness of having done so. Automatic behavior. Aphasia. Slow learning to talk. Trembling, anguish and fear as if some accident would happen, all day, better when going to bed. Anxious with perspiration all day. Anxiety on waking from frightful dreams. Anxiety about the future. Anticipation. Restlessness, nervousness in children. Insecurity and fear with trembling and heat. Frightened easily. Fear of death, of misfortune, of robbers, of evil. Fear something bad will happen. Hypochondriasis. Least touch causes starting. Moods changeable, variable. Capriciousness with toothaches. Sad mood with indisposition to talk. Morose, sulky, cross. Fretful, peevish. Ill-humor, in evening. Irritability during toothache. Censorious, critical. Abusive, insulting. Angry, violent. Discontented, disgust with everything. Sensitive, oversensitive, mentally and physically. Startled, as from a fright. Shrieking, screaming, shouting in children, worse when touched (Cham.). Cannot bear to be looked at. Hysteria. Weeping, tearful mood during pregnancy. Despair with the pains. Despair of recovery. Moaning, groaning during sleep. Forsaken feeling. Feels unloved. Homesickness, nostalgia. Desire to travel Alcoholism, dipsomania. Loquacity during drunkenness. Unconsciousness, coma.

Head - Dullness of head from mental exertion. Brain heavy. Pulsation in forehead. Pressure, pain in forehead. Pain above margin of right orbit. Pain in the head, as if the hair were pulled, worse stooping. Sinking of occipital bone in marasmic children. Rush of blood to head when smoking. Hair falls out. Scalp is scaly, itching in wet weather.

Eyes - Inflammation of eyes with redness, shooting pain. Sensation of burning and confused sight. Eyeballs sensitive to pressure. Eyeballs feel enlarged. Opacity of cornea. Cataract, lenticular. Dryness of eyes. Profuse lachrymation. Lids agglutinated in morning. Black motes before the eyes. Dimness of sight.

Ears - Inflammation of the ears with external redness and sensation of great soreness. Numbness of outer ear. Feeling of distention of middle ear. Subdued tinnitus. Whizzing, buzzing, fluttering in right ear. Diminished hearing. Deafness, comes suddenly and varies, on taking cold, cutting wisdom tooth.

Nose - Vesicular eruption in nose with pressive pain. Chronic affections of nose. Dry coryza, breathes through mouth. Coryza and nasal stoppage, before menses. Nosebleed in morning.

Face - Waxy pallor. Slovenly expression. Tension, as of white of an egg, dried on it. Tearing, digging, boring pain on one side, must move about. Swelling of malar bone with pulsating pain, worse exposure to cold wind, during rest and at night.

Mouth - Bitter, sour taste. Dry, at night. Sticking pain in throat, hawking up fetid, pea-colored particles. Vesicular eruption, bloody saliva. Frequent, sudden stammering speech. Teeth feel too long. Toothache, especially during pregnancy, worse at night, cold and quiet, better cold drinks. Ailments from cutting wisdom teeth (Cheir.).

Throat - Sore throat with shooting pain when speaking and swallowing. Sore throat, worse before menses. Sticking pain in throat, worse talking and swallowing. Burning pain in throat and palate. Frequent rising of mucus in throat. Soft, fetid tubercles of color of peas are hawked up. Hawks up cheesy masses from throat. Vertigo - Vertigo, worse when kneeling. Vertigo in evening with swooning. Continual giddiness, can hardly stand, with numbness of left arm. Vertigo, staggers in the street and fears to go out, lest people should strike against her. COMMENTS - Cooper said that water containing magnesia, and that coming from magnesia limestone districts, is peculiarly soft feeling. It is often found that the physical characteristics of substances correspond with their dynamic influences, so there is reason for supposing that this softness has a soothing effect upon the nervous system when used in baths. Mag-c. is to exhausted nerves what Chin, is to exhaustion from loss of fluids. Worn-out condition, often produced during pregnancy or menses as these are an additional tax on a women's strength. Characteristic sensitiveness, mental and bodily, sensitivity to touch, to cold air. The least touch causes starting. Sensitiveness passes into neuralgic pains of the highest intensity. Lightening-like neuralgia, worse on the left side, insupportable during repose, must get up and walk about. Tired and painful feeling, especially the legs and feet, aching, restless. Head injuries from shock, blows, mental distress. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired on waking than on going to bed. Periodic symptoms, every second day, every three weeks, “all symptoms worse every third week.” Worse from touch and pressure, but pressure in abdomen is better during the menstrual flow. Pain is worse on the side lain on. Smoking aggravates the headache. Spasmodic disorders of stomach and intestines. Sour taste, breath, belchings, vomiting. Incarcerated gas causing severe abdominal pains. Colic with gas and bloating, cutting and stabbing pains in the abdomen (Cham.), with irritability. Diarrhea, green stools like the scum of a frog pond, jelly-like lumps, aphthae. Stool like chopped spinach, green flakes in stool (Cham.). Stool smells sour (Rheum.). Puny and sickly children, who refuse their milk and get pain in the stomach if they take it. Food passes undigested in nursing children. Neonatal jaundice with gas, bloating and colic, light-colored stools and failure to thrive (Aeth.). Marasmus. Inordinate craving for meat in children of tubercular parentage, averse to vegetables. Teething (Cham.), with colic. Cooper mentioned it as a possible remedy in pyorrhea alveolaris. Menses preceded by labor-like pain, cutting colic, backache, weakness, chilliness. Menses late and scanty, flow only at night or when lying down, cease when walking. Flow acrid, dark, pitch-like, difficult to wash off. Vomiting and toothache during pregnancy. Cooper gave the indication as a “worn-out women,” that is, the state of nervousness induced by excess of cares and worries of life. Mag-c. 200c, repeated three or four times a day, has given untold relief to many a patient of this kind. When constipation and heaviness are present these will be removed at the same time. Two cases of neuralgia, related by A. I. Harvey, are quoted in Amer. Hom. The first case is that of a carpenter. 50, who had a light complexion, spare. He had facial neuralgia for two years coming in attacks, lasting from three to seven days, at intervals of two or three weeks. Sharp pain, shooting from left side of face and head, worse at night, from pressure, from jar. Mag-c. cured promptly after the failure of Spig. The second case was that of a blacksmith, 22, who had a light complexion, full figure. For several years he had attacks of facial neuralgia coming on after taking cold. Very severe pain in the left orbital region, shooting down into the eye and face and back to occipital region. Begins in morning, grows worse until noon, then subsides. No pain at night, rests well. Spig. and Kali-bi. failed. Mag-c., cured promptly. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars. and Cham, (neuralgia), Merc., Nux-v., Puls, and Rheum, (abdominal troubles). It antidotes: Acet- ac. Compare: (1) Cham., Rheum., Kreos., Aloe. (2) Cheir. - deafness, otorrhea, nose stopped up at night from irritation of cutting wisdom-teeth. (3) Mag-m., Mag-p., Aloe. (4) Ant-c. - headache from smoking. (5) Calc, and Rheum. - sour stools. Nux-v. - sour breath. (6) Cocc. and Sep. - worse from kneeling. (7) Ip. - nausea and grass-green stools. (8) Coloc. - griping pains with drawing up of legs, Coloc. has not the green slimy stools of Mag-c. (9) Cham. - neuralgia, better moving about, anxiety, restlessness, griping before stools, stools of Cham, more yellowish green like chopped eggs. (10) Calc. - sour stools, intolerance of milk, imperfect nourishment: Calc, has head-sweat, cold, damp feet, enlarged abdomen. (11) Lyc., Nit-ac., Sil., Lac-c., Lac- ri. - intolerance of milk. Compatible: Caust., Phos., Puls., Sep., Sulph. Complementary: Cham. Planets: Jupiter, Saturn. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sensation of emptiness in stomach. Constrictive pain in stomach. Pains, as from ulceration. Sour eructations and heartburn after cabbage, potatoes, greasy food, or milk. Acidrisings. Sour belching and vomiting of bitter water. Eructations tasting of rotten eggs during pregnancy. Nausea and vertigo during a meal, followed by retching, and vomiting of bitter or salty serum. Nausea and sour vomiting during pregnancy, during colic. Vomiting of undigested milk.

Abdomen - Great heaviness in bloated abdomen. Rumbling, gurgling. Dragging pain towards pelvis. Much flatus in bowels, with diarrhea. Cutting about navel better Magnesia carbónica passing flatus. Very heavy, contractive, pinching pain in right iliac region. Colic better bending double. Cutting, gripping, pressing colic, followed by thin green stools, which aggravates. Colic followed by leucorrhea.

Rectum - Constipation after mental shock or nervous strain. Frequent ineffectual urging, with small stools or only flatus. Piercing pain in rectum, as from needles. Sharp pain in anus and rectum, with difficult stool. Stool preceded by griping, colicky pain. Sour stools with tenesmus (Rheum.). Stools, frothy, greenish like water like scum of frog pond. Stools, li- enteric with gelatinous fatty masses, grass green or dry, hard, crumbling, white clay, putty like. Bloody mucus stools. Burning at anus after stool. Milkpasses undigested in nursing children. Worms. Sensations - As if everything was turning around. As if hair was pulled. As if white of egg had dried on face. As if teeth too long. As if rectum pricked with needles. Back as if broken.

Male - Inguinal and scrotal hernia. Discharge of prostatic fluid when passing flatus. Diminished sexual desire. Absence of erections. Frequent pollutions.

Female - Coryza and nasal stoppage before menses. Sore throat before menses appear. Menses preceded by labor-like pains. Menses like thick dark molasses, tarry, viscid. Menses too late and scanty, with dragging pains. Menses flow only in sleep, more profuse at night (Am-m.). Falls down in a faint at each menses. Mucus leucorrhea, white acrid, preceded by colic, regularly after the menses. Smarting pain when walking or sitting, with leucorrhea. Food - Nibbling appetite. Aversion to vegetables, green food, green fruit. Craving for meat, fruits, acids, vegetables, bread and butter. Milk is refused, passes undigested in nursing children. Worse from milk. Worse starchy food, potatoes, cabbages. Violent thirst for water, at night.

Chest - Oppression of chest, with sensation of constrictions. Constrictive pains in chest with dyspnea. Shooting pains in chest. Soreness in chest during motion. Constitutions - Suited to ailing, worn out, nervous, flatulent and flabby persons, especially women, children, nurslings. Persons of lax tissue and sour smell. Hering noted it for “persons, especially children or irritable disposition, nervous temperament, lax tissue, sour smell.” Cooper indicated it for “worn-out women and dark- haired, sensitive people, spare and thin.”

Heart - Sharp pain from within outward in precordial region.

Back - Pain in back and small of back at night, as if broken. Violent bruised pain in back at night. Stiffness in neck. Tearing and pullings in nape of neck. Pain as if dislocated on raising arm. Shootings pain in loins. Sudden piercing in coccyx. Contusive pains in sacrum and back, at night. Causations - Ailments from injuries, accidents. Ailments from emotional excitement, mental distress. Ailments from anger, fit of passion, vexation, fright or fear. Ailments from grief, sorrow, worry, care. Ailments from pregnancy. Ailments from dentition, cutting wisdom teeth. Poor nutrition, milk.

Limbs - Heavy, tired and painful legs and feet. Swelling in bend of knee. Cannot put left foot on ground when walking. Tearing in shoulders as if dislocated. Right shoulder painful, cannot raise it (Sang.). Cannot bear hands covered, yet chilled by uncovering.

Sleep - Frequent and violent yawing. Inclination to go to sleep during day. Sleeplessness from flatus, from cutting wisdom-teeth, exhaustion. Many anxious dreams, with talking, cries, and starting fromfright. Dreams of fire, flood, robbers, quarrels. Dreams of money, pleasures, misfortunes. Dreams of dead persons. Awakes at 2 a.m. or 3 a.m. and cannot fall to sleep. Unrefreshing sleep, more tired in the morning than on retiring.

Skin - Hair and nails unhealthy. Earthy, sallow and parchment-like, emaciation. Sore, dry, sensitive to cold. Violent itching and great dryness of skin. Itching vesicles on hands and fingers. Large nodosities between the skin and the flesh with shooting pains. Nettle-rash with much swelling. Small painless, red tetters, which exfoliate. Spreading blisters. Small blood boils. Corroding vesicles.

Modalities - Better motion. Better walking in open air. Better warm air. Cold water improves toothache for a short time, then aggravates. Worse rest, warmth of bed, uncovering. Worse every second day, every third week. Worse cold, wind. Worse change of weather. Worse drafts, night. Draft aggravates facial neuralgia. Pains are worse by rest insupportable, must get up and walk about.

Liver - Hardness and sharp pains in liver region. Lungs - Craves open air. Tickling cough with salty, bloody expectoration. Cough from tickling in the larynx, worse in evening till after midnight. Cramp-like cough at night. Expectoration of tubercles as big as a pea, very offensive in smell. Expectoration of blood.

Kidneys - Involuntary urination while walking or rising from a seat. Frequent emission of urine, even at night. Sensation of burning and excoriation when urinating. Bladder and rectum become irritable. Urine, increased, pale, watery, or green. White sediment in urine.

Perspiration - Sour, greasy perspiration, difficult to wash off. Sweat stains yellow. Sweats with thirst after 12 p.m. until morning.

Temperature - Chilly in evening. Chilly, takes cold, before menses. Chill running down back. Chill, better out- door exercise. Fever at night, with night sweats and aversion to uncovering. Fever with dread of exposure, restlessness, sweat on head, redness and burning.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from movement, in fresh air. Worse at 3 a.m., in the early morning, from sleep, especially after lunch. Worse a few days before menses. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sulph. - Autointoxication with fatigue. Itching emption, a alternating with other complaints, redness of the natural orifices, weakness at 11 a. m., sudden diarrhea. The need for fresh air. (2) Hep. - Tendency to suppuration. Hypersensitive, especially to the cold. Pain like that of a splinter. Skin unhealthy. Scrofulous lymphatic constitution. CLINICAL - Auto-toxins. Goiter. Chronic suppurations. Fatigue. Hyperthyroidism. Infections. Influenza. Metabolic complaints. Neuralgia. Post-infectious conditions. Sinusitis. Staphylococcus. Streptococcus. Thrombosis. Tonsillitis.

HOMEOPATHIC - There is no homeopathic proving for Mag-f., but Mezger established symptomatology based on clinical usage and the characteristics of magnesium and fluorine. Localized infections from bacteria. Streptococcus, enterococcus, staphylococcus. Nasal and pharyngeal infections of the maxillary sinus of the nose and tonsils. Postinfection conditions following influenza, sinusitis, tonsillitis, with fatigue, asthenia, nervous irritability, lack of appetite, muscu- lar and neuralgic pains, pains in the ligaments and tendons and joint pains. Metabolic complaints of senescence with cholesterol disorders. Action on the liver, pancreas, digestive passage. Capillary and venous stasis. Venous thrombosis. Goiter. Thyroid problems with the tendency to hyperthyroidism. Mag-f. is useful after the failure of Sulph. and Hep.

name: Magnesia Muriatica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Most symptoms, except headache, are better in cool, open air. Better from hard pressure. Better lying bent. Better hanging down affected part. Better gentle motion. Nausea and trembling better by belchings. Worse from sea bathing. Worse lying on right side. Worse touch, noise. Worse at night, mental exertion. Worse immediately after eating. Worse salt, milk. Fainting worse at meals..

PHARMACY - mag-m. Magnesia muriatica. Magnesium chloride. Magnesiachloride. Solution. Trituration. Historiealdose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Biliousness. Bladder, paresis. Cardialgía. Chronic, fatigue. Cirrhosis. Cold. Colic. Constipation. Coryza. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Dyspnea. Fainting. Fatigue. Flatuence. Foot-sweat. Globus, hystericus. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heartbum. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Hernia. Homesickness. Hysteria. Influenza. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Metrorrhagia. Milk, allergy. Nausea. Nerve, disorders. Nocturnal, emissions. Ozaena. Palpitations. Pregnancy, nausea. Rickets. Smell, disordered. Spleen, enlarged. Stomach, disorders. Taste, disordered. Tinea, ciliaris. Urine, straining. Uterus, pain. Water brash. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - WhileMag-c. andMag-s. are recognized old-school remedies, there is no mention of Mag- m. or Mag-p. in allopathic text-books. Mag-m. first appeared in Hahnemann's book Chronic Diseases. The general features of Mag-c. appears in many Mag-m. symptoms, notably those of nervous disturbance and hysteria. Guernsey noted that Mag-m. is found in many mineral waters and in seawater. It has a very bitter taste and in decomposed by heat. Mag-m. is similar to Nat-m. and Aq-mar. in their relation to seaside effects. Constipation, “biliousness ” and generally disordered health, when conditions appear as soon as the patient goes to the seaside. Ill effects of sea bathing. Excessive weakness after a sea bath. General action on the liver and nerves, uterus and rectum. Cirrhosis. Chronic liver disorders with tenderness and pain, extending to spine and epigastrium, worse after food. Constipation. Fainting, fits, dyspnea, nausea and trembling occur after dinner, better by belchings. Spasmodic, hysterical complaints. Globus. Soreness and sensitiveness to noises. Pains are boring, spasmodic, contractive, crampy, darting. Burnings. Shocks through the body like electric shocks when wide awake. Perversions of taste or smell. Especially adapted to diseases of women with a long history of indigestion and uterine disease. Children who cannot digest milk. MIND - Difficult concentration. Confusion of mind. Mental exertion aggravates. Aversion to conversation, prefers solitude. Reserved. Dislikes confrontations. Peevishness and chagrin. Obstinate, headstrong. Morose and sulky. Irritability, worse in morning. Moaning, groaning during sleep. Grief. Homesickness. Nostalgia. Forsaken feeling. Sadness and depression. Manic depression. Capriciousness. Excited, unhappy, fitful, emotional. Restlessness, worse in evening. Uneasiness, nervous excitability with ten- dency to weep readily. Weeping, tearful moods with liver disease. Feels on the verge of a nervous breakdown. Overwhelming anxiety. Anxiety and worrying at night. Anxiety during fever. Anxiousness in room, better in open air. Fears associated with liver disease. Fear of animals, spiders. Fear of robbers.

Head - Bursting headache, worse motion, open air, better pressure and wrapping up warmly (Sil., Stront.). Sensitive to noise with headache. Squeezing pain in both temples in evening after lying down. Beating in forehead when pressing upon it. Tightness and pressure in forehead. Much sweating of head (Calc., Sil.). Thirst, belching during headache. Headache better lemons. As if boiling water on the side lain on. As if hair were pulled. Nodosities on occiput, tearing, painful to touch.

Eyes - Yellow sclera. Lachrymation and burning of the eyes when looking at anything in broad daylight. Nocturnal agglutination of eyelids. Tinea ciliaris with pimples on face.

Ears - Pulsations in ears. Itching of old herpes behind ears. Sensitive to noise. Deafness, as if something were lying before ear.

Nose - Red, swollen. Nostrils ulcerated. Sore and burning, in nostrils, worse deep breathing, sneezing or touch. Acrid, crusty ozaena. Loss of smell and taste, following catarrh. Sneezing with watery discharge. Discharge of yellow, fetid mucus. Coryza, with stoppage of nose, hoarseness. Nocturnal obstruction of nose, must breathe through the mouth. Cannot lie down.

Face - Pale, yellow. Eruptions on face, itching, burning vesicles. Pimples on the face and forehead itching worse night, warm room and before menses. Chapped lips. Blisters on lips. Prosopalgia. Facial neuralgia pains, dull, aching, worse damp weather, slightest draft, better pressure heat. Severe cramps in face.

Mouth - Mouth dry. without thirst. Loss of taste. Bitter, sour taste at night. Continued rising of white froth into the mouth. Blisters on lips. Gums swollen, bleed easily. Toothache, worse if food touches the tooth.

Throat - Throat dry with hoarseness. As if a ball rising into the throat, better by eructation. Hawking of clammy, thick mucus, often mixed with blood.

Stomach - Coldness and weakness in stomach. Pressing pain in stomach, disappear while eating and reappear about an hour afterwards. Throbbing pain in stomach. Stomach pain as from ulceration, or from a bruise. Regurgitation while walking. Continued rising of white froth into mouth. Hiccough, during and after dinner, causes vomiting. Belchings like rotten eggs, like onions. Nausea and faintness, better eructations. Nausea in morning after rising, with salivation, faintness, weakness in stomach.

Abdomen - Cramps in abdomen. Distended abdomen with constipation. Flatulence with distension. Great flatulence, often incarcerated, causing numerous pains. Hysterical colic followed by leucorrhea. Colic, can't endure covering. Dragging sensation when lying on left side. Tearing, sharp pains in loins. Tingling, stinging in abdominal muscles.

Rectum - Diarrhea after milk. Constipation of infants during dentition. Absence of desire for stools. Only passing small quantity. Stools are knotty like sheep's dung. gray. Stools crumbling at verge of anus. Painful smarting hemorrhoids. Tape-worms. Sensations - As if some one was running after her. As if boiling water was on side of head. As if hair pulled. As if tongue burnt, mouth scalded. Stools as if burnt.

Male - Pain in testes and cords worse after sex. Itching on genitals and scrotum. Congenital hernia of scrotum. Scrotum relaxed and often covered with perspiration. Pain in testes and cords, worse after sex or after unrequited sexual excitement. Burning in back after sex. Frequent erections, early in morning, with burning in penis.

Female - Menses, profuse, dark, lumpy like pitch, with cramps. Menses black, clotted, more copious when sitting than walking. Great excitement at every period. Dysmenorrhea, better by pressure on the back or lying on a hard pillo w. Headache at menstrual period. Gushes of leucorrhea, after abdominal colic. Leucorrhea after exercise. Leucorrhea with stool. Leucorrhea followed by metrorrhagia. Metrorrhagia, worse at night. Uterine cramps, extending to thighs. Ovary enlarged and tender. Bearing down pain in right ovarian region. Pain in back and thighs. Labor pains interrupted by hysterical spasms. Tinea ciliaris, eruptions in face and forehead worse before menses. Food - Appetite poor, bad taste in mouth. Ravenous hunger followed by nausea. Hunger butknows not for what. Inclination to nibble. Craves sweets, dainties. Better from lemons. Violent thirst. Worse from milk, salty food, fat food. Cannot digest milk (Nat-c.), especially children, causes pain in stomach and passes undigested during dentition.

Chest - Constrictive pain and tension in chest and scapulae. Congestion and soreness of chest, after sea bathing. Sudden heaviness of chest, with oppressed breathing, at dinner. Constitutions - Suited to diseases of women, spasmodic and hysterical complaints complicated with uterine diseases. Women after suffering months or years from attacks of indigestion or biliousness. Puny, rickety children during dentition. Liver disorders in children who are puny and rickety and have eruptions about the eyes. Enlargement and congestion of liver. Men with disordered livers and sexual problems.

Heart - Sharp pain in heart, arresting breath. Palpitations, worse while sitting, lying on left side, better by moving about (Gels.). Pulse accelerated, with ebullitions while sitting. Heart disorders with liver enlargement.

Back - Bruised or burning pain in back after sex. Bruised pain in small of back and hips, during menses, better pressure. Cramps in back worse walking. Contractive, spasmodic pain in lumbar region. Sharp, tearing and burning pains in small of back. Throbbing below left scapula. Swelling of cervical glands. Causations - Ill effects of sea bathing, especially weakness. Ailments from anger, vexation, sexual excesses.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains in limbs, better motion and pressure. Pain in back and hips, in arms and legs. Cramps in thighs, worse sitting. Thighs and calves tense, must move limbs. Ankles cold or nervous worse night. Cutting pain in heels. Feet sweaty. Arms “go to sleep” when waking in morning. Fingertips numb.

Sleep - Sleepiness during day with yawning and sluggishness. Anxiety and restlessness of the body as soon as she closes the eyes. Restless at night on account of heat and shock. Sleeplessness from spasms. Anxious dreams with talking and crying out during sleep. Dreams of robbers in the house, on awaking will not believe to the contrary until a search is made. Sleep unrefreshing, tired in morning.

Skin - Formication all over the body. Sweat on head and feet. Blood boils. Abscess with yellow, thin, foul pus. Jaundice.

Modalities - Most symptoms, except headache, are better in cool, open air. Better from hard pressure. Better lying bent. Better hanging down affected part. Better gentle motion. Nausea and trembling better by belchings. Worse from sea bathing. Worse lying on right side. Worse touch, noise. Worse at night, mental exertion. Worse immediately after eating. Worse salt, milk. Fainting worse at meals.

Tongue - Tongue feels burnt, mouth feels scalded. Cracks in tongue with violent burning. Broad, yellow, scalloped tongue. Tongue large, flabby, white, tip and edges clean. Tongue coated white in early morning. Vertigo - Vertigo during dinner, in morning on rising. Vertigo, better from open air. COMMENTS - Liver conditions (Chel., Nat- s., Lyc., Ars., Nux-v., Phos.). Symptoms of liver deficiency or weakness. Li ver disorders with enlargement and sensitiveness, worse from touch and lying on right side. Cirrhosis, with a sluggish feeling. Hepatitis with total exhaustion. Liver rheumatism, arthritic symptoms associated with liver weakness. Severe chronic fatigue since hepatitis. Chronic neurasthenia (Sil., Phos.). Liver stasis, toxic feeling. Symptoms are worse in the morning, stiff, sore, achy, better with motion or as the day goes on (Rhus-t.). Unrefreshed sleep. Generally sleeps on the left side, to avoid sleeping on the liver. Worse lying down, closing the eyes. Difficultly getting comfortable, desire to keep moving. May constantly wake in the night. Miserable in the morning, feel irritable and sluggish. Bitter taste in the mouth on waking. Sluggishness comes from the liver, not from the joints (as in Rhus-t.). Drag themselves around, as if hung- over (Gels.). Heavy feeling, as if all their weight and energy are in the legs. Difficulty concentrating. Better open air and motion. Anxious, restless, always better by mental exertion. Aversion to work, apathetic (Gels.), but a desire to move and keep busy. Bitter. Bilious, irritable temperament, dissatisfied look on their face. Passive, will avoid con- frontation, complaining to others. Suffers when they see people arguing. Influenza and mononucleosis with aching, malaise, sluggish, wiped out feeling, but also stiff, desire to move and stretch (Rhus-t. and Gels.). Viral infections with a sluggish, toxic feeling. Palpitations, worse when quiet, better moving about. Boring and spasmodic contractive pains, dragging down. Marked hysterical symptoms, spasms, fainting, globus. Hysterical headaches. Burning and heat. Numbness and heaviness of the extremities, with weakness. Burning in soles in the evening, must put feet out of bed. Chilly, but with warm feet. Sweaty feet. Aggravated by salt, salty foods, air or sea bathing. Can get headaches, red lips, and cracked corners of the mouth from salt. Sweat about the head. Ozaena. Redness, swelling and scaliness of nose. Yellow tongue, imprinted with teeth. Tongue is large, coated and indurated. Perversions of taste and smell. Weak digestion, exhaustion. Nausea and belchings during or after dinner. Trembling and faint spells are better by belching. Better from a light diet, generally vegetables, and fruits, aggravated from heavy, fried, fatty foods and meat. Aggravated from milk. Intestinal atony. Constipation, stools break off or crumble at the anus. Stool is knotty, conglomerate. Painful urging before stool, burning in anus after. Tape worms. Bladder atony, urine can only be passed by bearing down with abdominal muscles. Bearing down in uterine region, uterine spasms. Menses black or pitch-like, accompanied by pains in back when walking, pains in thighs when sitting. Leucorrhea after every stool or following uterine spasms. Clarke frequently restored the loss of taste and smell after influenza with Mag-m. Teste, who placed Mag-m. in his Ferrum group, noted that Mag-m. and Mag-c. “have been used for the cure of cachexia occasioned by long and painful diseases.” He said he saw Mag-m. produce great improvement in a case of “hydrarthrosis of left knee with emaciation of left thigh, consequent on a wandering neuralgia, which after having commenced in the form of cystitis with (non-venereal) discharge from urethra, had successively invaded the shoulder, left elbow, eyes and lastly, knees, where it had become seated.” R. M. Skinner reported a case in which a farmer had been treated allopathically for three months for chills, which were checked, but the man did not feel well. Spleen was very large, sensitive, felt heavy when he walked or rode. He sought advice for his constipation, went three or four days without a stool. His abdomen was distended and hard, especially in ileo-cecal region. Cold on the left side and a crawling feeling like a cold snake. Beating in umbilical region as if his heart beat there. Skinner gave him Mag-m. 200c, one dose on the tongue. At 8 p.m., the bowels began to act and went on acting with the exception of one hour until 3 a.m. He complained the next morning that the medicine had “almost killed him,” and he looked thin and tired. No further medicine was given and in ten days he had no complaint, the spleen was normal in size and without tenderness. RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Cham., Camph., Ars., Nux-v.Itantidotes: Merc, (metrorrhagia). Compare: (1) Chel., Mag-c., Nat-m., Puls., Sep., Am-m. (2) Nast. (3) Hysteria, Mosch., Asaf., Valer., and Cast-eq. (4) Uterine spasms, Ign., Caust. and Sec. - both have continuous spasm. (5) Erections and burning in penis, Pic-ac., Nat- m. (6) Enlarged liver, worse by touch and lying on right side, Merc. (7) Foot-sweat and head-sweat, Sil. is offensive., scrofulous and rickety children, headache better wrapping, Sil. (8) Congestion of liver, enlargement, feeling of weight and pressure, Ptel. is better lying right side. (9) Enlarged liver of children, Calc-ar. (10) Sensitiveness to noise. Ign., Nux- v.,Ther. Compatible: Bell., Sulph., Nat-m., Puls., Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Jaundice. Hepatitis. Cirrhosis of the liver with a sluggish feeling. Liver sore, enlarged with bloating of abdomen, yellow tongue. Burning, tensive sticking in hepatic region. Pressing pain in liver, worse lying on right side. Hyperemia of liver with constipation. Liver affections with tendency to hemorrhage from various organs. Cramp in the gallbladder, better by eating. Pain from liver to spine or epigastrium, can only lie on back or affected side. Lungs - Oppressed breathing, globus hystericus. Bloody sputum or congestion and soreness of chest after sea bathing. Purulent sputum, of fatty taste and offensive odor. Watery expectoration during day. Tough, yellowish mucus.

Kidneys - Numbness of urethra. In the dark one cannot tell whether one is passing urine or not. Urine can only be passed by bearing down with the abdominal muscles, straining and pressure. Stricture after dilatation. Urine passes in drops, some always seem to remain. Pale yellow urine, followed by burning in urethra.

Cough - Cough, worse eating, fatty food, fruit. Spasmodic, dry cough at night, with tickling in throat, burning and sore chest. Spasmodic cough, worse rest, sitting, lying in bed, deep breathing, air of room, ascending steps, or speaking. Whooping cough.

Perspiration - Sweats on head or feet. Sweats from 12 p.m. until morning. Thirsty with sweats.

Temperature - Chill even near a stove, better open air. Chilliness, during and after loose stool, in morning. Sensitive to cold air, great disposition to take cold. Fever in evening, with aversion to uncovering.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better by heat, warmth. Better hot water, bathing. Better from pressure. Better rubbing. Better bending double. Better standing up. Worse from cold air. Worse drafts. Worse uncovering. Worse cold water. Worse periodicity. Worse night. Worse exhaustion. Worse milk. Worse right side. Worse lying on right side. Worse touch..

PHARMACY - mag-p. Magnesia phosphorica. Magnesium phosphate. Magnesia phosphate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Catheterism. Chorea. Colic. Convulsions. Cough. Cracks. Cramps. Dentition. Dysmenorrhea. Facial neuralgia. Goiter. Headaches. Hiccoughs. Intercostal, neuralgia. Locomotor, ataxia. Membranous, dysmenorrhea. Meningitis. Menses, painful. Neuralgias. Pains. Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Rectum, prolapsed. School, headache. Sciatica. Stomach, cancer. Spasms. Tic douloureux. Toothaches. Twitching. Vaginismus. Whooping cough. Writer's cramp.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mag-p. is one of the most important of Schiissler's additions to the Materia Medica. It has had a very fine proving in the potencies, conducted by H. C. Allen. Schiissler's picture of the remedy is confirmed in every point by Allen's proving and by the clinical use of Mag-p. in the highest potencies. Moreover, there is a very strong family resemblance between these features and those of Mag-c. and Mag-m. But it is only right to say that Schiissler arrived at them by a way of his own, which shows that there are other means besides provings of finding the keynote symptoms of remedies. Schiissler stated that Mag-p. is contained in the blood corpuscles, muscles, brain, spinal marrow, nerves, teeth. Disturbance of its molecules results in pains, cramps, and paralysis. Useful for cramps, convulsions, neuralgic pains and spasmodic effects, showing its influence on nerves and muscles. Spasmodic effects. Cramping of muscles with radiating pains. The pains are shifting, better by rest, worse at night. Pains sometimes tense in paroxysms. Neuralgic pains relieved by warmth. Parts are tender to pressure and numb. Allen noted that the pains rapidly change place, that cramping is the most characteristic type of pain. Hiccough, yawning, chorea and hand cramps. Nervous, tense, sudden violent paroxysms of neuralgic pains. Sharp, shooting like lightning pains, that suddenly changing places. Radiating, boring, constricting pains, extorting cries, causing restlessness and prostration. Twitchings. Tics. Palsy. Parkinson's disease. Goiter. Chorea better during sleep, worse at stool and emotions. Genet al symptoms are worse by motion, cold air, draft of air, cold wind, cold washing, touch, uncovering, lying on the back stretched out, when eating. Dread of touching the affected part, of moving. MIND - Very forgetful. Indisposition to study, to mental work. Mental dullness and inability to think clearly. Learning is difficult.. Ailments from mental work. Drowsiness on every attempt to study. Capriciousness. Irritability. Ailments from suppressed anger, vexation. Mental depression and anxiety. Discontented, dissatisfied. Sadness, despondency. Weeping, tearful mood, during convulsions. Sobbing, crying. Oversensitive to pain, noise, excitement. Restlessness and nervousness. Anxiety, depressed vitality. Fear of others approaching. Fear of being touched, motion. Excitable during convulsions. Anxiety from the pains. Despair with the pains. Startled from the pains. Screaming, shouting from pains, cramps in abdomen. Hypersensitive to pain (Cham., Mag-s.). Complaining. Lamenting about pain in affected parts. Always talking about the pains. Talks to himself constantly. Sits in moody silence. Carries things from one place to another and back again. Delusions, that he is about to die.Delusions, that another person is in the room. Illusions of the senses.

Head - Headaches after mental labor with chilliness, better warmth (Sil.). Headaches of students. Sensation as if contents were liquid, as if parts of brain were changing places, as if a cap on head. Neuralgic or rheumatic pains, better external application of warmth. As if an electric shock in the head extending to all parts of the body. Boring pain over right eye, spreading over whole right side of head. Supraorbital pain worse right side, better external heat.

Eyes - Eyes, hot, aching, tired. Increased lachrymation. Twitching of eyelids. Photophobia. Nystagmus, strabismus, spasmodic, ptosis, worse right side. Itching and heat in lower eyelid. Supraorbital pains, worse right side, relieved by the warmth.

Ears - Nervous otalgia, intermittent and spasmodic, better by heat. Severe neuralgic pain, worse washing face and neck with cold water. Neuralgic pain worse behind right ear, worse by going into cold air.

Nose - Alternate stuffing and profuse gushing discharge. Discharge of a white, thin substance, worse from left nostril. Smarting and raw feeling in left nostril. Loss or perversion of sense of smell.

Face - Cracks in corners of mouth. Face blue and swollen from violent spasmodic attacks of cough. Face distorted from pains and weakness. Lock-jaw, tetanus. Painful contraction of jaw joint with backward jerking. Spasmodic twitching of facial muscles. Trigeminal neuralgia worse slightest touch. Facial neuralgia, worse when body gets cold from washing or standing in cold water, better from warmth. Neuralgia on opening mouth to eat or drink. Neuralgia on right side of face alternating with toothache, rushing about like lightning.

Mouth - Bitter taste. Taste of bananas. Food does not taste right. Swelling of tongue. Tongue, clean with colic. Cracks in angles of lips. Painful contraction of jaw joint. Spasms without febrile symptoms. Spasmodic stammering.

Throat - Soreness and stiffness, especially right side, parts seem puffy with chilliness and aching all over. Spasmodic constriction of throat on attempting to swallow liquids. Sensation of choking, of a corn-husk lodged in upper part of throat. Voice harsh, larynx sore and raw. Nervous angina. Vertigo - Vertigo on moving. Vertigo falls forward on closing eyes, better walking in open air. Vision - Vision blurred. Dark spots before eyes on attempting to read. Colored lights before eyes. Sees rainbow colors. Double vision during headache. COMMENTS - Acute or chronic cramps and spasms. Writer's or musician's cramps, Charley horses. Acute leg cramps in the elderly or in athletes. Lower leg cramps (Cupr., Calc-c.). Paralysis, or cramping pains followed by paralysis. Cramps and spasms are better with heat, will often place a hot water bottle on the site (Cham, will want cold), better from pressure. Generally right sided (Coloc. is left sided). Facial neuralgias (Kalm.) and sciatica, worse on the right side, better heat. Headache, better from applied heat. Chorea, respiratory spasms. Spasms of the glottis, whooping cough. Hiccoughs (Nux-v.). Lockjaw, tetanus. For teething children or toothache, better drinking something warm or from warm applications. Useful for cracks at the corners of the lips. Allen's proving brought out canker sores in mouth, sore lips and cracked lips. Stomach cramps. Abdominal cramps radiated from umbilical region, better by bending double, heat, sometimes with watery diarrhea. Colic in babies (Cham.), without irritability, better heat. Spasmodic retention of the urine. Inguinal hernia. Nondescript menstrual cramps. Labor pains. Cramping, burning pain, better from heat (Ars.). Pains are shooting like lightning or boring, often combined with or alternating with a sense of constriction, at times wandering, better by warmth, pressure, worse by light touch. Attacks of pain, often with great prostration or profuse sweat, leaving the patient “languid, tired, exhausted, unable to sit up.” More often called for in men than Mag-c, but the indication “worn-out women” applies to both. Disorders are often periodic. Useful for complaints from standing in cold water, complaints of dentition, headaches of school children, professional neuroses, after effects of catheter. Clarke cured a very severe attack of chorea in a girl of six with Mag-p. 6x. The spasms were general, but they affected the speech to such an extent that she could not make herself intelligible. Rappaz ofMontevideo cured with Mag- p. a young man, 17, of cerebral meningitis which began with violent pain and inflammation in his left eye with terrific pains in his head, delirium and intense fever. He was first treated allopathically, without success. When Rappaz first saw him, he was hemiplegic with frequent and alarming convulsions, violent crying out, involuntary passage of feces and urine, dilated pupils, dropped jaw, escape of saliva, with difficult speech and comprehension. Under Mag-p. 6x in water, general improvement set in. Later the 12x was given and in two months he was well. W. T. Ord cured Miss G., 48, of back pain extending down right sciatic nerve and up the back, following influenza with Mag-p. 3x, 5 grain doses. Skinner has cured with Mag-p. a case of prolapsed of rectum with feeling as if rectum were torn, the symptoms being better by heat. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Bell., Gels., Lach. Compare: ( 1 ) Kali-p., Coloc., Sil., Zinc., Dios. (2) Cham. - vegetable analog, but Cham, has worse from heat. (3) Shifting pains, Puls., Lac-c. (4) Neuralgia recurring violently every night. (5) better warmth, Ars. (6) Dysmenorrhea, Caul., Cimic., Xan., Cact., Lil-t., Coloc. (7) Colic better bending double, Coloc. (8) better from hot drinks. Lyc. (9) Meteorism, Lyc., cracks on lips, Nat-m. (10) Headache from occiput to eye better warmth, Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomach cramps. Intense cutting, shooting, cramping pains in region of stomach. Colic, better eructation. Colic in babies (Cham.). Obstinate hiccough, causes long-lasting soreness. Hiccough with retching day and night. Burning pain, vomiting and hiccough, better hot drinks. Constant nausea. Persistent vomiting. Bilious vomiting, at times streaked with blood. Cancer of stomach.

Abdomen - Abdomen contracted. Bloated, full sensation in abdomen, must loosen clothing, walk about and constantly pass flatus. Severe, griping colic, at times shooting up towards stomach, better by hot applications. Flatulent colic, forcing patient to bend double. Colic accompanied with belching of gas, which gives no relief. Colic relieved by rubbing, warmth, pressure. Colic in babies (Cham.). Cutting pain into thighs.

Rectum - Constipation in rheumatic subjects due to flatulence and indigestion. Constipation in infants. Torpid stool. Stool expelled with force. Dysentery with cramp-like pains, better by pressure or bending double. Dysentery with spasmodic retention of urine. Watery diarrhea with vomiting and cramps in calves. Stools loose, watery, with urging. Diarrhea ceases, spasms or other brain troubles set in. Cutting, darting, lightning- like pains in hemorrhoids. Itching and scratching feeling in anus.

Female - Menstrual colic, pain precedes flow. Menstrual cramps, better heat, bending over and by flow. Menses too early, dark, stringy, fibrinous, tarry. Menses flowing at night leaving a stain. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Swelling of labia, at times extremely painful. Vaginismus. Ovarian neuralgia, pain shooting and darting like lightning. Puerperal convulsions. Spasmodic labor pains, with cramps in legs. Food - Appetite remains good. Thirst for very cold drinks. Food doesn't taste right. Acids taste stronger than usual. Aversion to coffee. Craves sugar.

Chest - Darting pains in chest, worse right side, which radiate from pain in bowels. Intercostal neuralgia, must sit upright. Oppression of chest, with desire to take deep breath, worse on first entering warm room, worse walking. Constitutions - Hering thought it suited to young and very strong persons, teething children. Allen said that, though it is best adapted to emaciated persons, it acts promptly in stout, fleshy persons when well indicated. Suited to tired, languid, exhausted subjects.

Heart - Anginapectoris. Constricting pains around heart. Pulse irritable. Nervous spasmodic palpitations.

Back - Stiffness of neck and back. Cramps in back. One vertebra seems absent. Sore pain in neck and lower part of back. Very sharp, shooting, boring, shifting and remittent pains in nape. Aching pain in small of back. Dorsal spine, very painful and sensitive to touch. Causations - Ailments from suppressed anger, vexation, mental work, study. Complaints of teething children (Cham.). Ill effects of overuse of muscles, standing in cold water, cold bathing, working in cold clay, catheterism.

Limbs - General muscular weakness. Violent pains in acute rheumatism of joints. Pains in lower limbs, alternating sides. Sciatica with tender feet. Twitchings. Parkinson's disease. Involuntary shaking of hands. Chorea. Tetanic spasms. Spasmodic convulsions with stiffness of limbs, clenched fingers and thumbs drawn in. Cramps worse at night, in bed. Cramps from prolonged exertion. Cramps after prolonged use of tools. Crampy contraction of fingers. Skin of fingers tight. Writers ' and players ' cramps. Cramps in calves and feet. Runner's cramps. Cramps in limbs during pregnancy. Lungs - Spasmodic nervous asthma. Asthmatic oppression of chest. Oppressed breathing, with desire to take deep breath, worse on entering warm room, worse walking. Difficult breathing with intercostal neuralgia.

Sleep - Sleepy when attempting to study. Spasmodic yawning as if it would dislocate the jaw with tears. Sleepless on account of indigestion or toothache. Insomnia from exhaustion. Wakes at night with leg and foot cramps. Sleep disturbed by troublesome dreams. Drowsy in morning.

Skin - Barber's itch. Herpetic eruptions with white scales. Rash on arms, legs and face, like insect bites. Rash red when scratched. Pricking sensation all over.

Modalities - Better by heat, warmth. Better hot water, bathing. Better from pressure. Better rubbing. Better bending double. Better standing up. Worse from cold air. Worse drafts. Worse uncovering. Worse cold water. Worse periodicity. Worse night. Worse exhaustion. Worse milk. Worse right side. Worse lying on right side. Worse touch.

Teeth - Toothache, better by heat and hot liquids. Toothache, worse eating or drinking, cold things. Teeth sensitive to touch or cold air. Severe pain in decayed or filled teeth. Neuralgic pain in a filled tooth. Ulceration of teeth with swelling of glands of face, throat and neck. Complaints of teething children, spasms during dentition without fever symptoms.

Kidneys - Bladder neuralgic pains after use of catheter. Spasm of bladder of neck of bladder, spasmodic retention, tenesmus with constant and painful urging. Cutting pain in bladder before urinating. Nocturnal bedwetting from nervous irritation.

Cough - Dry, tickling cough. Spasmodic cough, worse lying down, better cool air. Spasmodic cough during intervals of convulsions with contraction of fingers and staring, open eyes. Spasmodic, whooping cough (Dros., Cor-r.), better cool air.

Temperature - Chilliness after dinner in evening. Chills run up and down the back. Chills with shivering, followed by a suffocating sensation.

name: Magnesia Sulphurica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from movement in the fresh air. Better from washing in cool water. Better from rubbing. Better walking. Worse morning. Worse on awaking. Worse from traveling on a train. Worse in a closed vehicle..

Miliary, eruptions. Neura
