keynote:
PHARMACY - mang. Manganum aceticum. Manganese acetate. Manganous acetate. Manganum carbonicum. Manganese carbonate. Triturations of the carbonate. Solutions of the acetate, according to Hahnemann. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Albuminuria.…
full:
PHARMACY - mang. Manganum aceticum. Manganese acetate. Manganous acetate. Manganum carbonicum. Manganese carbonate. Triturations of the carbonate. Solutions of the acetate, according to Hahnemann. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Albuminuria. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Ankles, weak. Arthritis. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bones, pain. Brain, concussion. Cellulitis. Coughs. Deafness. Dysmenorrhea. Ear, infection. Gallstones. Growing, pains. Gout. Headaches. Heel, pain. Hoarseness. Jaundice. Laryngitis. Lichen. Menopausal, flushings. Myopia. Nephritis. Palate, disorders. Paraplegia. Parkinson's, disease. Parotiditis. Periostitis. Pityriasis. Psoriasis. Reflexes, exaggerated. Rheumatism. Scabies. Tongue disorders. Tuberculosis. Wilson's disease. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Manganese was isolated in 1774 and was introduced into the Materia Medica by Hahnemann, who made provings of the acetate and carbonate. The symptoms of the two have not been kept separate. Manganese is a metal having a remarkable affinity for and in some respects a close resemblance to iron, of which it is an extremely frequent associate. Its medicinal as well as its physical relationship with iron is very close. Symptoms of chronic manganese poisoning, according to Professor von Jaksch, were involuntary laughter, weeping and walking backwards. Exaggerated reflexes and physical disturbances, evidenced by men making fun of each other's gait. Paraplegia progressive, wasting, feeble and staggering gait. Anemia with destruction of red blood corpuscles. Affinity for the inner ear, larynx, trachea, periosteum of shinbone, joints, ankles and lower limbs. Pain extends to ear from other parts. Everything affects the ear. Yellowgreen lumpy or bloody discharges. Great accumulation of mucus. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow. Bones are very sensitive, Painful, deep soreness of the whole body, every part of the body feels sore when touched, ears, joints, skin. Weak joints. Chronic arthritis with infiltrated, glistening joints. Growing pains. Diagonal pains. Wants to lie down in bed which improves all the troubles. Cellulitis, sub-acute stage, promotes suppuration and hastens regeneration. Suppuration of skin around joints. Necrosis and decay of bones. Malignant ulcers with blue border, following slight injury. Inflammation of bones or joints with nightly digging pains. Progressive muscular atrophy. Motor paralysis, ascending paralysis. Parkinson's disease, paraplegia. Festinating, walks backwards. Jaundice, nephritis with albuminuria. Fatty degeneration of liver. Gout. Typhoid fever, cases that are badly treated with prolonged convalescence. Syphilitic and chlorotic patients with general anemia and paralytic symptoms. For speakers and singers. Valuable for boys and girls whose voices are changing. MIND-Anxiety andfear. Anxiety as if something bad is going to happen, when moving in the room, better lying down. Fretful. Weak and nervous. Peevish. Irritability in morning, during music, while talking. Hatred of persons who had offended him. Silent, reserved. Sad, weeping, silent. Depression, better sad music. Constant moaning or groaning. Confusion while sitting. Involuntary laughing and weeping, better open air. Mental conditions are better when lying down.

Head - Congestion to head, with throbbing, feels large and heavy, better open air. Frequent rush of blood to head, with thirst. Headache with stupefaction and confusion of senses while walking. Headaches worse, breathing, talking or laughing. Pains from above downwards, worse straining at stools, jarring, stepping. Sharp pains like needles, worse jarring or stepping. Cold feeling at a small spot on vertex.

Eyes - Burning in eyes during day. Pupils much dilated or contracted. Field of vision contracted. Dim vision during day. Eyestrain, with aching and pressure. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Eyelids swollen and painful to touch.

Ears - Everything affects the ears. Pain extends to ear from other parts. Swelling of the parotid glands in fevers. Sharp pains in the ears from talking, laughing, swallowing. Feel stopped, cracking on blowing nose. Whistling tinnitus. Deafness in damp weather. Blowing the nose helps deafness.

Nose - Crampy pain at the root of the nose. Dry, obstructed. Obstruction of nose and fluent coryza alternately. Chronic catarrh with bleeding, worse in cold damp weather. Blowing is painful.

Face - Pale, sickly. Stolidly mask-like. Ulcerated at corners of mouth. Twitching, jerking pain from lower jaw to temples worse laughing. Cramp pain in upper and lowerjaw aftereating. Swelling of parotid glands, in fevers.

Mouth - Dry, parched lips, with shriveling of skin, without thirst. Clear vesicles on upper lip. Nodes on palate and tongue. Tongue sore and irritable with ulcers or warts. Flow of saliva, while speaking with colic, paralysis etc. Oily taste. Toothache, worse anything cold, worse sucking, pain going up in the ears.

Throat - Chronic sore throat, with cutting pain, as from excoriation, when not swallowing. Throat as if excoriated. Throat dry, scratching. Laryngitis. Larynx dry, rough, constricted. Tuberculosis of the larynx. Sharp pain in larynx when swallowing. Chronic disease of larynx, with Eustachian deafness. Chronic hoarseness. Hemming and hawking all the time and annoying everybody. Low, monotonous voice. Rough voice better smoking. Vertigo - Vertigo when sitting or standing, nearly falling forward. COMMENTS - F. H. Pritchard, in an article on Mang., cited the action of the metal, noting that the mucus membranes are congested and secretions are increased or decreased. A powerful cholagogue, it induces inflammation and fatty degeneration of the liver. Destroys red corpuscles and causes anemia. Sensitive bones and periosteum, with periostitis. Paralysis and progressive muscular atrophy of the cerebrospinal system. Fissures, excoriation, and suppuration of the skin. Lippe noted the indication “Suppuration of skin round joints.” Pritchard quoted observations of Grille that workmen in manganese mines do not get itch and those who come to the work with itch get cured of it. The manganese waters of Cransac cause “Ill-humor, weeping, despondency, sudden palpitation.” Guernsey noted that “The bones are very sensitive, red spots on the skin, which are elevated, owing to bone disorders. Ankles are particularly affected, children may have this trouble and be unable to walk. - “Typhus fever when the parotid gland is swollen and the bones are very sensitive to touch, disorders of the internal ear, upper part of chest. Hoarse voice, drawing sensation of the muscles.” Laryngeal tuberculosis, tuberculosis. Cough better by lying down. Deep cough, worse in damp weather. Single nodes on the palate. Chlorosis, if gastric symptoms and loss of appetite predominate. Skin will not heal, slight scratches ulcerate. Anemia. Menses too frequent and too scanty in anemic girls. Boring, pressing headaches, proceed from above downwards. Headache like a concussion at every step or movement. Inflammation of bones and joints with insupportable nightly digging pains. Every part of the body feels extremely sore when touched. Rheumatic patients cannot beat any weight on their heels. Rheumatic symptoms with dark, almost blue spots on skin. Paralysis with inclination to run forward if he tried to walk. Paralysis which begins below, extending upward. Paraplegia. Paralysis from degeneration of anterior portion of cord. Clarke has frequently verified the “cough better from lying down,” and also this sensitiveness of the bones. Where these occur in connection with any other condition indicating Mang, it is sure to do good. Clarke cured in an elderly woman a flat growth on the center of her palate with Mang. 30c. Bluish nodes on the skin, malignant ulcers with blue borders following slight injury. Hansen cured with Mang. 6c a case of neuralgia of the tongue following the healing of a little ulcer on surface near left border after an application with lunar caustic. Shortly after the healing, the patient (a man, 60) had severe stinging burning at the left edge of his tongue and the inner side of his left cheek when touching the tongue. In this state he came to Hansen after allopathic treatment. Several medicines were given without result, then Mang, was chosen and made a rapid and permanent cure. A. W. Palmer reported a case of catarrhal deafness cured with Mang. 6c. Miss H., 38, had dull hearing, dry throat with hoarseness, itching in ears, loud rumbling, worse night, right ear, crackling on blowing nose, and deafness in damp weather. The last was the guiding symptom. Cooper gave several ear-cases in which Mang, proved curative. The first concerned a nodule appearance of malleus handle, thickened irregularly, with history of bilious headaches and of previous discharges from the ears. The ear drum membrane had a granular appearance. Purple glazed appearance of the malleus handles, which were thickened and very prominent, upper segment of membrane also purple and glazed. The second concerned a case of chronic periostitis of the meatus and middle ear with otorrhea, left ear. Cooper also noted a case of otorrhea with earache, pain shot up from teeth to ear, the earache was worse after early dinner, up until 8 or 9 p.m. Pains extended to and concentrated in the ears from other parts. The fourth case concerned sensitive ears, took cold and got a headache, history of gallstones and jaundice, sleepy and headache in afternoon, bitter taste in morning, lips glued together, whistling tinnitus worse in a cold, (explosions, Mag-carb., rasping, shrill tinnitus as well as cardiac tinnitus, pumping, Kali-i.). The final case Cooper recorded was deafness in a woman, 36, which dated from when she was 14 from over- strain in singing, when she lost her voice and hearing for six months. Her left hearing returned, right remained deaf, worse after a cold or if over-excited or worried. Subject all life to bilious attacks which lasted twenty-four hours and left suddenly. Head throbbed, couldn't put it down on a pillow. Headache came on in morning on awaking and reached a height at 3 or 4 p.m. and kept on until next morning. Bilious headaches went away and the hearing of right ear improved under Mang. 200c. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Coff., Merc. Compare: (1) Mang-coll. - Boils and other staphylococcal infections. (2) Mang-m. - painful ankles, bone-pains. (3) Mang-s. - liver disorders, excess of bile, a powerful intestinal stimulant. (4) Arg-n., Rhus-t., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

Abdomen - Pressing in stomach and abdomen while eating, worse cold food. Rumbling in abdomen, from cold food. Abdominal colic, better eating. As if intestines were loose and shaking when walking about. Pain and constriction at the navel. Cutting in umbilical region worse on taking deep breath. Flatulence.

Rectum - Cramps in the anus while sitting, better lying down. Pain in rectum after dinner. Bowels are irregular, with constipation or diarrhea. Constipation with difficult, dry, knotty evacuations. Stool yellow, granular, with tenesmus and constriction of anus. Passes much flatus with stools. Sensations - Head as if larger. Ears as if stopped. Throat as if excoriated. Trachea as if closed with a film. As if pit of stomach enlarged. As if bowels drawn together. As if tendons shortened.

Female - Amenorrhea. First menses delayed. Menses, early, scanty, pale in anemic patients. Discharge of blood between periods with pressing in genitals. Flushes of heat at menopause. Food - Aversion to food from a feeling of satiety. Loss of appetite, in chlorosis. No thirst.

Chest - Heat, beating in chest. Sharp pains in chest and sternum running up and down. Bruised pain in upper chest when stooping, better raising head.

Heart - Sudden shocks at heart and in left side of chest, from above downward. Palpitations of heart, strong, irregular, trembling. Pulse irregular, sometimes rapid, sometimes slow, but constantly weak and soft.

Back - Tearing pain in whole spinal column, from above downward. Pain in small of back on bending backward. Stiffness of nape. Red, swollen streak on left side of neck.

Limbs - Muscular twitching. Parkinson's disease. Inflammation of bones and joints with nightly digging pains. Bones very sensitive. Every part of body feels sore when touched. Shiny red swelling of joints. Periosteal inflammation. Burning spots about joints. Suppuration of skin around joints. Knee pain and itching. Intolerable pain in skin of lower limbs. Legs feel numb. Stiffness in muscles of legs. Cramps in calves. Rheumatism of feet. Ankles painful. Children are unable to walk because of ankles are weak. Peculiar slapping gait,-walks on metacarpo-pha- langeal joint, walks backwards. Tending to fall forward, walks stooping forward. Cannot walk backwards without falling.

Sleep - Languor and sleepiness. Much yawning. Sleepy very early in evening. Many vivid dreams which are well remembered.

Skin - Red, elevated spots. Itching, better scratching. Itching of diabetes. Chronic eczema with amenorrhea, worse during menses or menopause. Psoriasis and pityriasis. Dry hard ulcers. Burning around ulcers. Suppuration of skin around joints. Rough, cracked (flexures), bluish. Deep cracks in bends of elbows, knees.

Modalities - Better from open air, sad music, eating, swallowing, lying down. Better or worse by change of weather. Worse cold, wet weather, damp, touching with cold things, touch. Worse at night, speaking, laughing, motion, bending backwards. Lying on the feather bed aggravates asthma.

Liver - Chronic enlargement of liver. Jaundice. Lungs - Every cold becomes bronchitis (Dulc.). Mucus difficult to loosen after long hawking. Difficult expectoration of lumps of tough mucus in evening. Scanty mucus. Lumpy, yellow, adhesive mucus. Greenish masses. Expectoration of yellowish greenish lumps, even with- Manganum aceticum out coughing in morning. Bloody, reddish phlegm. Hemoptysis with stitching pains through right lung and dry cough. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow.

Kidneys - Darting in urethra on passing flatus. Cutting pain in middle of urethra between urination. Frequent desire to urinate during day. Urine profuse, sediment violet, earthy. Addison's disease.

Cough - Dry cough, incessant, from irritation about middle of sternum. Cough with aphonia. Cough better lying down, worse evening, damp weather, loud reading, laughing, walking, or deep inspiration. Inclination to cough in morning.

Temperature - Shaking chills in evening, with shooting pains in head, without thirst. Chills with icy cold hands and feet. Sudden flushes of heat in face in chest and over the back. Burning over whole body, in evening when rising from bed.

PHARMACY - mang-m. Manganum muriaticum. Manganese chloride. Solution in water. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bulbar paralysis. Nervous disorders. Paralysis agitans. Parkinson's disease.

HOMEOPATHIC - Workers in Manganese binoxide are frequently affected with bulbar paralysis. Mang-o. has some symptoms similar to Parkinson's disease, progressive lenticular degenerations and pseudo- sclerosis. Peculiar slapping gait. Muscular twitching, cramps in calves, stiff leg muscles. Pain in tibia. Dysmenorrhea. Colic and diarrhea. Easily fatigued and heated, sleepy. Stolid, mask-like face. Low monotonous voice, “economical speech.” Occasional uncontrollable laughter. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Head - Boring in right cranial bones, tearing in right occipital bone.

Face - Pressive pain in right jaw joint.

Stomach - Sour belchings of air. Pressure in stomach, worse by external pressure. Vertigo - Vertigo and reeling when walking in open air, worse looking down, on descending or stooping. REFERENCES Clarke. ***MANGANUM OXYDATUM NATIVUM (Manganese Oxydatum) PHARMACY - mang-o. Manganum oxydatum nativum. Manganese oxydatum. Pyrolusite. Native Black Oxide of Manganese. Historical dose: All potencies.

Abdomen - Frequent rumbling.

Rectum - Stool harder and scantier.

Limbs - Pain in articulation of left thumb. Drawing pain with weary feeling in right thigh while sitting. Pressure in right knee extending into leg, a bruised sensation remains in ankles, afterwards same pain in left ankle. Pressure and drawing in ankle and ankle bones. Pressure in left foot.

Modalities - Stomach pains were worse by external pressure.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper said, “This Salt of Manganese deserves more attention than seems to be at present…
full:
PHARMACY - mang-s. Manganum sulphuri- cum. Manganese sulphate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bile, excess. Gastritis. Liver, disorders. Toothaches.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper said, “This Salt of Manganese deserves more attention than seems to be at present given to it. It has been proved to cause vomiting, paralysis without convulsions and inflammation of the stomach and small intestines. As well as of the liver, spleen and heart.” C. G. Gmelin, who experimented with it, recorded its property of causing such an extraordinary secretion of bile that nearly all the intestines were colored yellow by it and the large intestines had a wax-yellow color communicated to them. According to Rutherford, Mang-s. is a powerful intestinal, but a feeble hepatic stimulant. Toothache in a bad tooth, on right side, upperjaw. Shooting, darting extending up the whole side of face and head. Painful parts tender to touch. Ure found Mang-s. to act on man as a purgative and cholagogue in doses of one to two drachms in half a pint of water. It has, however, caused vomiting and sweating as well as purgation and is uncertain in its action from an allopathic point of view. Mang-s. lx cured in one case of hepatic derangement where the stools were composed of large quantities of bile. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Mangifera Indica
author: Murphy

HERBAL - A valuable herbal remedy in coughs, colds and lung infections. Sold as “Horehound ale,” a pleasant tasting beverage. An infusion of one ounce to one pint of boiling water, taken in hot wineglass doses as needed induces sweating. Horehoundcandies and cough drops are popular. Marrubium is a bitter digestive tonic, expectorant and diuretic herb. It has a bitter, aromatic taste and odor. Culpepper used it to repel the afterbirth, as an antidote to poisons, snakebites and to help indurated livers. It calms the nervous heart. Irregular heartbeats. Reduces fevers. Malaria. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Black Horehound - Stimulant, anti-spasmodic and vermifuge. Dioscorides said, “The leaves beaten with salt and applied the wound, cure the bite of mad dogs.” REFERENCES Potter.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Cancer. Neuralgia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper studied Matth., and considered a leading indication for it “concentrated juices,” which should be compared with the action of its relative cru- cifere, Thlaspi., which has cured obstruction of bile duct from inspissated bile. He cured with it abscesses in neck glands that had been discharging for twenty-five years, abscesses in hollow viscera, and one case of stomach cancer. Neuralgia of the left arm with numbness and paralysis. COMMENTS - Cooper related a case which seems to indicate that morphine causes neuralgia and that Matth. antidotes morphine. A man had neuralgia of his right arm from working in a damp house. Morphine was given. Then neuralgia of the left arm came on with numbness and paralysis. Lob. gave some relief. One dose of Matth. tincture completely cured. When the man came under Cooper's care, he was spending ten shillings a week on morphine. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cheir., Thlaspi. and crucifère generally. REFERENCES - Clarke. Cooper.

HOMEOPATHIC - MDMA produces intense activity, physically, mentally, psychically. Restlessness, trembling. Exhaustion. Chronic fatigue. Chronic, influenza-like symptoms. Malaise. Analgesia. Extreme sensitivity of the whole nervous system. Overstimulated mental states. All senses are enhanced, especially those of touch and sound. Heightened sense of balance and physical agility. Oversensitivity to environmental influences. Tranquility. Reduces physical and emotional stress. Release of “body armor.” It has been used clinically, with much success, with patients undergoing periods of great psychic change. MDMA MIND - Calmness. Pronounced feeling of personal well-being, at peace with the world. Acceptance. Deep sense of forgiveness and unconditional love. Feelings of bliss, ecstasy, euphoria, fearlessness. Empathy. Emotional warmth. Ease of communication. Desire to touch and be touched. Introversion or extroversion. Easy release of psychological trauma and deeply buried emotions. Mood swings. Clarity of mind. Excessive loquacity. Inappropriate bonding. Racing thoughts. Difficulty in holding concentration. Nervous irritability. Restlessness. Low-grade anxiety without obvious cause. Paranoia. COMMENTS - Ecstasy produces intensely pleasurable effects, including an enhanced sense of self- confidence and energy. Loss of inhibitions. Transfixion on sights and sounds. Feelings of closeness with others and a desire to touch others. Sense of peacefulness, acceptance and empathy. Involuntary teeth clenching. Nausea, blurred vision, chills and sweating. Dehydration. Increases in heart rate and blood pressure. Seizures. Muscular breakdown. Kidney, liver and cardiovascular failure. Sleep problems. Anxiety, depression. Memory loss or weakness. Disruption of serotonin levels, affecting mood, sense of pain, appetite, learning and memory. RELATIONS - Compare: Agar., Anh. Hydrog., Nux-m., Salv-d., Sulph-ac., Tar- ent-h. REFERENCES - Hammond. Murphy.

Nasal, congestion. Nephritis. Neuralgic pains. Ovaries, pains. Pains. Pelvic, problems. Polyps. Polyuria. Priapism. Psoriasis, palmaris. Ptosis. Rape, victims. Rheumatism. Sexual, abuse. Sexual, excesses. Schizophrenia. Sciatica. Shoulder, pains. Sinusitis. Stage-fright. Sterility. Stricture. Sycosis. Tenesmus. Trembling. Tuberculosis. Urethritis. Vaginitis. Venereal, diseases. Urethritis. Urticaria. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Medorrhinum, one of the most important of the nosodes, is prepared from gonorrheal discharge. The nosodes may be used according to their indication in exactly the same way as other homeopathic remedies and also for manifestations of the disease from which they are derived. At the same time, a knowledge of the origin of obscure disorders, especially if hereditary, will often give the clue to the remedy required. Medorrhinum is a powerful, deep acting medicine indicated for chronic ailments due to suppressed gonorrhea. History of gonorrhea, often restores a gonorrheal discharge. Poor reaction to remedies due to gonorrhea history. It affects the mind, nerves, and mucus membranes. Great disturbance and irritability of nervous system. Intolerable pains, tensive, nerves quiver and tingle. Intensity of all the sensations. State of collapse and trembling all over. Wants to be fanned all the time. Arthritic, rheumatic pains. Chronic rheumatism. Diseases of the spinal cord, even organic lesions ending in paralysis. Loss of power in the joints, joints feel loose. Many different kinds of pain, stiffness, aching, soreness, edema of limbs, dropsy of serous sacs. Disseminated sclerosis. Numbness, internal formication. Burning. Small, very sore aphthae, blisters. Enlargement of the lymphatic glands all over the body with heat and soreness. Tumors, cancer, scirrhous etc. with history of sycosis. Profuse acrid discharges, causing itching. Fishy odors of the secretions. Nose dirty, tonsils enlarged, thick yellow mucus from nostrils, lips thickened from mouth breathing. Chronic catarrhal conditions in children. Chronic pelvic disorders of women. Offensive, sour odor of the body especially children and women, cannot wash. Dwarfed and stunted children. MIND - Sensitive, nervous, restless. Everything startles her. Hurried, anxious and irritable. Wild feeling in head. Lack of self-control. Exhilaration at night. Cross through the day, merry at night. Apprehensive, anticipates events. Anxiety if a time is set. Frighten, easily. Panic attacks. Stage-fright. Fears going insane (Calc., Mane.). Fear in the dark and of someone behind her, of being alone at night. Claustrophobia. Fear of animals. Fear of venereal diseases, cancer, misfortune, poverty. Persistent ideas. Dwells on the past. Desperate. Sad, tearful and fearful. Melancholy with suicidal thoughts. Sad, dismal outlook, better after weeping. Cannot speak without weeping, tells it over and over again. Cries when telling her story. Great difficulty in stating her symptoms. Despair, hopeless of recovery. Suicidal thoughts, tendency. Difficult concentration. Weakness of memory. Loses the thread of conversation. Forgets names, word, errands. Makes mistakes, reading, writings. Confusion of mind as to his identity. Dread of saying wrong thing. Poor self confidence. Shuns responsibilities. Aversion to being touched. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Mentally retarded, children. Alternating or erratic states. Severe mood changes. Happiness alternating with gloominess. Contrasting extremes in one person. Manic depression. Schizophrenia, paranoid. Abusive to others. Impulsive, abrupt, rude, mean, cruel. Irritability, impatience over trifles. Censorious, critical. Jealousy. Morbid impulses. Alcoholism and drug abuse. Fastidious. Bites nails. Cursing, swearing. Dictatorial, domineering, dogmatic, despotic. Cruelty, brutality, inhumanity to animals. Sexual excesses. Wild, strong, high sex drive. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Ailments from sexual abuse, rape. Sensibility exalted. Sensitive to nature, animals, beauty, flowers. Feels life unreal, everything seems unreal like a dream. Things seem strange. Time passes too slowly (Cann-i., Arg-n.). Feels far off, as if things done today occurred a week ago. Sees faces peer at her from behind bed and furniture. Clairvoyance. Feeling of having committed the unpardonable sin and will be going to hell. Continually praying. Sensation of impending death.

Head - Head is heavy and drawn backward. Sensation as if tight band across forehead, worse bending head forward. Burning pain in brain, worse occiput. Weight and pressure in vertex. Tensive pains in head as if she would go crazy, can't read or use mind. Sharp pains, comes and goes suddenly, worse light and coughing. Severe pain in back of head. Dull, aching pains. Aching, in base of brain with swelling of cords of neck. Burning in brain. Intense burning in cerebellum. Headache over eyes and in temples, on waking, worse sunlight. Headache from jarring, exhaustion or hard work. Headache during menses. Hair dry, crispy. Itching of scalp, dandruff.

Eyes - Eyeballs ache. Feels as if sticks in eyes. Neuralgic pain in eyeballs. Objects look double or small. Sees imaginary objects. Feels as if she stared at everything. Swelling under eyes. Lids irritated. Ptosis of lids. Upper lid hard as if it had cartilage. Swelling of upper lids. Eyelashes fall out.

Ears - Opening of ear is sore and tight. Quick darting pains, in right ear. Pain passes up Eustachian tube. Aching in cartilage of ear. Aching or boring pain in left ear. Itching in left ear. Partial deafness, pulsation in ears. Hears voices. Frying and hissing noises in ears, mastoid.

Nose - Soreness and crawling in left nostril. Numbness. Burning pain in both nostrils when breathing through them. Coldness of tip. Intense itching of the tip. Obstruction at root of nose as if mucus membrane was hypertrophied. Hay fever and allergies. Coryza, better sea bathing, with loss of smell and taste. Nasal catarrh running down throat. Chronic nasal and pharyngeal catarrhs. Chronic sinusitis. Thick yellow-green discharges. Posterior nares obstructed. Post-nasal discharge, thick yellow. Snuffles in children. Nose dirty in children. Nosebleeds.

Face - Freckles. Pallor. Grayish, greasy, greenish, yellow at the edges of hair. Flushes of heat in face and neck. Sweat on face. Blotches of red color. Acne, worse after menses. Small boils break out during menses. Red spiderlets on face. Risus sardonicus. Rigidity of muscles of face. Lips thickened from mouth breathing. Stiffness in jaws and tongue. Swelling of submaxillary glands. Warts.

Mouth - Taste in mouth coppery, bad taste and foul breath in morning. Breath hot, feels so even when breathing through nose. Exhalation hot. Mouth feels burnt. Dryness of mouth. Water tastes like perfume. Copious salivation. Stringy mucus from mouth during sleep. Small very sore aphthae. Canker sores. Blisters on inner surface of the lips and cheeks.

Throat - Great dryness of throat with swollen glands. Throat sore and swollen. Larynx feels sore as if ulcerated. Pains on swallowing. Swallowing of liquids and solids impossible. Choking. Spasm of glottis. Throat constantlyfilled with thick, gray or bloody mucus from posterior nares. Tenacious mucus in larynx. Sore throat and cold in head better salt water bathing. Hoarse while reading.

Stomach - Intense pain in stomach and upper abdomen, with sensation of tightness. Clawing pain in stomach worse drawing up knees. Cramps in stomach as from wind. Burning, trembling in pit. Throbbing in sides of stomach. Agonizing pains in solar plexus. Ravenous hunger soon after eating. Sick or gnawing feeling, not better eating or drinking. Coppery taste and belchings of sulphuretted hydrogen. Nausea in morning, before eating, during pregnancy. Vomiting of thick mucus and black bile, without nausea.

Abdomen - Heaviness in lower abdomen. Rests more comfortably lying on abdomen. Grasping pain in liver and spleen. Burning in epigastrium. Agonizing pain in solar plexus, applies his hands to stomach and to lumbar region. Left inguinal glands sensitive and slightly swollen. Grinding colic better bracing feet, lying on abdomen. Bilious colic with frequent vomiting and nausea. Flatulence with numbness.

Rectum - Anus is red, moist. Fiery, red rash about anus in babies. Intense itching of anus. Painful lump sensation on posterior surface of sphincter. Heaviness in perineum. Sharp, needle-like pains in rectum. Sensation of prolapsus of rectum. Dark fetid oozing moisture from anus of fish brine odor. Profuse bloody discharges from rectum. Inertia of bowels, with ball-like stools. White diarrhea. Stools tenacious, claylike, sluggish, can't be forced out. Can pass stools only by leaning very far back, then shivering. Cholera infantum with opisthotonus. Diarrhea, and headache, from motion of cars. Sensations - As if sticks in eyes, lids and inner canthi, as if cold wind blowing in eyes, as if upper lid had a cartilage in it. As if something crawling in ear and nose. As if a lump in stomach. As if tumor in right side of abdomen. As if left lung collapsed or paralyzed. As if an abscess between left pectoralis major and minor muscles. As if the blood was boiling hot in veins. As if all bones were out of joint.

Male - Urethritis. Whole urethra feels sore. Heaviness of prostate, painful. Prostate enlarged with frequent and painful urination. Gonorrhea infection. Gonorrheal flow thin, transparent, mixed with opaque, whitish mucus, stains linen yellow. Gonorrhea, suppressed. Gleet, persistent, yellow discharge. Heaviness in perineum. Sharp, cutting pains transversely across root of penis. High sex drive. Intense and frequent erections day and night. Amorous behavior. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Sexual excesses. Impotence. Prostration after seminal emission. Nocturnal emissions, followed by great weakness. Ailments from sexual abuse, rape.

Female - Dysmenorrhea. Intense menstrual colic, better pressing feet against support. Menstrual colic with drawing up of knees. Menses offensive, profuse, dark, clotted. Menses stains difficult to wash out. Metrorrhagia. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea thick, acrid, excoriating, fishy odor. Intense itching, vagina better rubbing and by bathing with tepid water. Urethritis. Neuralgic pains. Sensitive spot near os uterus. Os uterus, ulcerated. Ovarian pain, worse left side. Pain from ovary to ovary. Drawing in ovaries, betterpressure. Infertility, sterility. Sycotic infertility. Sycotic warts on genitals. Gonorrhea, suppressed. Passionate, wild, strong sex drive. Sexual perversions, fantasies and masturbation. Sexual excesses. Ailments from sexual abuse, rape. Food - Ravenous hunger soon after eating. Craving for ice, salt, sweets, sour things, refreshing things, green fruits, oranges. Desires fat, fish, tobacco, ale. Craving for liquors, which she used to dislike. Excessive thirst, dreams of drinking water. Water tastes like perfume. Nausea after drinking water. Cough, worse sweet things.

Chest - Chest as if painfully contracted, when coughing. Sharp, along right edge of sternum. Pain and soreness through chest and breasts. Chest sore to touch. As if a cavity in chest. Coldness in chest. Pain, heat and soreness through chest. Constitutions - Sycotic, rheumatoid and hydrogenoid constitution. Coughs - Dry, hacking cough with weak, sinking sensation under sternum. Incessant, dry cough at night. Deep and hollow cough. Cough, better, lying on stomach, worse from sweet things. Cough on entering warm room. Cough and retching, at night.

Heart - Sensation of cavity where heart ought to be. Oppression of heart with difficult breathing. Heart as if hot and large. Heart with bursting sensation. Soreness in heart. Fluttering about heart. Heart beats very fast. Palpitations after slight exertion.

Back - Spine sore and tender. Backache with burning heat in spine. Intense burning heat, commencing in neck and extending gradually down spine. Chills up and down back. Cutting, burning, crawling above left scapula. Drawing pain in cords of neck, causes desire to throw head back. Spasms of neck muscles, notably sterno-mastoid. Pain from left to right shoulder. Lumbar vertebrae sensitive to touch. Tenderness of spinal column when stretching. Pain in sacrum and coccyx. Lumbago from lifting.

Limbs - Stiffness throughout body and limbs. Gouty concretions. Rheumatism. Edema of the limbs. Coldness of legs, hands, and forearms. Legs heavy, ache all night. Legs, cannot keep them still (Zinc.). Cramps in legs better stretching them. Ankles easily turn when walking. Heels and balls of feet tender (Thuj.), and itching, cannot walk on them, had to walk on knees. Edema of feet followed and better by diarrhea. Soreness of soles. Burning of hands and feet wants them uncovered and fanned. Restless, better clutching hands. Finger joints enlarged, puffy. Fingertips cracked and burn. Bites nails. Nails depressed, as if they were bent.

Sleep - Dreads night to come. Insomnia. Sleepless from intolerable pains. Sleep prevented by aching in lower limbs. Spasmodic yawning, can't suppress it. Sleeplessness, falls asleep towards morning. Short sleep seems like a long one, which is better. Sleeps in knee-chest position. Sleeps more comfortably lying on abdomen. Can only sleep on back with hands over head. Asleep, but hears everything, answers questions as if she was awake. Dreams of drinking (Ars., Phos.), walking. Nightmares, of ghosts and dead people. Exhausting dreams. Wakes gasping for breath.

Skin - Pricking sensation all over body. Intense itching, sore, worse night and when thinking of it. Continuous itching. Skin cold, but feels as if the blood is hot, throws off covers. Yellow skin. Yellow, copper colored spots, remaining after eruptions. Sycotic red nodes. Deep red Medorrhinum spots. Boils. Condylomatas and warts. Small, pedunculated warts. Tumors and growths.

Modalities - Better at the seashore, damp weather (Caust.). Better being fanned, fresh air, at sunset. Better bending backward, stretching out, hard rubbing, lying on abdomen. Chronic rheumatism of joints is worse inland, better near sea. Worse from damp, cold weather, before storm, heat, covering, closed room, slight touch, after urinating. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m., during daytime, from sunrise to sunset, when thinking of ailments. Early morning aggravation. Salt-water bathing aggravates sore throat and colds in the head.

Teeth - Pale gums. Teeth yellow, easily decay. Teeth serrated, soft, crumbling. Eyeteeth sore, feel soft. Teeth sensitive while chewing.

Tongue - Tongue coated brown and thick. Tongue white, with papillae showing through. Base of tongue white and foul. Tongue coated thickly in morning. Blistered tongue, canker sores. Skin peeling off in patches. Small, very sore aphthae. Bites tip of tongue in sleep. Vertigo - Intense vertigo from sensation of tightening in head. Vertigo, worse in vertex and on stooping. Vertigo with sensation and fear of falling. Vertigo as if intoxicated, on waking. Walks zigzag. Vision - Blurred vision. Objects look double or small. Many black, sometimes brown spots dancing over her book. COMMENTS - An often prescribed poly crest remedy, especially if there is a history of a gonorrhea infection. Never well since suppressed gonorrhea. Symptoms are similar to Thuj. and Ars., but they work on different levels and can interrelate. Generally, Ars is a less serious Med., and where Med. is given for an acute, Thuj. would work for the chronic. Confusion. Slow answering questions. Developmental problems. Difficulty concentrating. Restlessness. Hyperactivity, wildness. Temper tantrums and fits. Intense nervous sensibility, especially to touch of garment or a lock of hair by any one not en rapport. Sensibility is very exalted almost to clairvoyance. Over excited. Starting at slightest sound. Spacey. Unpredictable, unstable, fitful and changeable. A disintegrated person, unharnessed. Lack of purpose or function in their life, concerned with fulfilling passions, particularly sexual passion. Full of extremes. Can become obsessive, violent. Schizophrenia, manic-depression, depression with uncontrolled nature. Often violent, paranoid, can have persecution complexes. Anticipation or panic attacks. Fear of losing control, about their mind not functioning correctly, of going insane (Cann-i., Calc-c.). Fear that something bad will happen, anticipates that something will go wrong, especially with their health. Think themselves incurable. Children can have severe nightmares and deep fears about monsters or people getting them. Delusion that someone is in their bedroom. Exaggerated sexual development. Generally precocious children, may begin masturbating at an early age. Chronic masturbation. Preoccupation with sex, sexual fantasies. History of sexual diseases such as vaginitis, bladder infections, herpes, gonorrhea. Often a history of promiscuity, history of gonorrhea. Attracted to the culture of sex, drugs, and wild behavior. Alcoholism. May be helpful for AIDS, stimulates the immune function and lessons recurring infections. Tremor, spasms. State of collapse, with a desire to be fanned. The pains seem to tighten the whole body, especially the thighs. There is scarcely a spot on the body that is not full of pain. Acute arthritis with painful, swollen joints. Obstinate rheumatism. Sequela of acute rheumatism. Insomnia from too much energy. Blood pressure or heart conditions. Chronic, recurring infections. Discharges, sensitivity. Conjunctivitis. Vaginitis, urethritis, uterine fibroids. Fishy odor to the vaginal discharge. Multiple allergies, especially allergies with discharges since gonorrhea. Sore throats, earaches, sinus problems. Severe asthma. Great sensitiveness to draft of air, takes cold easily. Cough is better lying on face or stomach. Generally worse motion, better rest. Worse stretching out, leaning head forward. Constipation is better leaning far back, can only pass stool so. Worse storms and damp weather. Better by the sea. Worse from sunrise to sunset, always brighter in evening, worse in early morning hours (Syph. is worse from sunset to sunrise). Craves oranges and orange juice, particularly in children. Craves unripe fruit, alcohol and marijuana. Craves tobacco (Staph, Thuj, Ars.), often as a nervous habit. Many cases of stunted growth and arrested development in children are due to latent gonorrhea and syphilis. On this hypothesis, Clarke cured extremely offensive body odors in children with Med. Negerath of New York and Angus Macdonald in England have pointed out a causal connection between post- partum pelvic cellulitis and latent gonorrhea in the husband. Macdonald published several fatal cases. The effects of the poison, constitutional or acute, may be taken as data for homeopathic prescriptions, but the virus also has had an extensive proving in the potencies and symptoms have been largely verified in practice. Burnett noted several cures with Med. 1,000c, including fits at every menstrual period, coming on in the early morning. Clonic spasms, the legs suddenly shoot up from the bed. Rheumatism of the right wrist. Sycotic asthma, worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Psoriasis palmaris. Polyps having their origin in a chronic suppurating discharge. Albuminuria where the urine contains some mucus as well. Masturbation in children. Burnett regarded Med. as “a remedy of pus and catarrhs.” Clarke cured with Med. 200c a most aggravated case of constipation on learning that the patient was obliged to lean far back on the seat or he could not get rid of the stool. He was passing urine containing long white mucus shreds. He had gonorrhea many years before. Deschere published a Med. case in which Miss S., 23, had chronic blepharitis since eleven. Her suffering was intense. Light, especially gaslight, was intolerable and this prevented her from going into society. She could not read in the evening, and in the morning the lids would be closed and she suffered much on getting them separated. There was much discharge. Before coming under Deschere she had been under strict homeopathic treatment all the time. Deschere remembered treating her father for gonorrhea before his marriage Medorrhinum and he suspected the taint had reappeared in this form. Med. was given in high potency, single doses repeated as the effect of each wore off and she was entirely cured. Skinner traced a case of favus to the same hereditary cause. It had resisted all the external applications that allopaths could devise and which had such an appalling odor that the patient, a little boy, had to be isolated from the family. It was cured with Med. 1,000c. McLaren related in Hahn. Advoc. acase in which a young French Canadian of delicate constitution, after working in a factory all winter, began coughing in spring and running down in health. He returned home and came under McLaren's care in May. The cough persisted and prostration increased in spite of carefully selected remedies and the patient took to his bed. It was then observed by McLaren that the cough and general condition was better from lying on the face. This, coupled with a knowledge of there being a syphilitic taint in the boy's parentage, suggested Med., which was given. The next day a profuse gonorrheal discharge appeared and the cough and all the threatening symptoms promptly disappeared. Exposure to contagion had occurred several weeks before, but from lack of vitality the disease could not find its usual expression and was endangering the patient's life. Ernest Nyssens quoted some important observations by old-school authorities on constitutional gonorrhea. Wertheim, in a case of gonorrheal cystitis, watched the entrance of the gonococcus into the blood stream. With the gonococcus taken from the blood of this patient he made cultures to the fifth generation. A youth who had never had a venereal disease volunteered for inoculation with this. The sub-acute urethritis which resulted was so grave and in spite of all, became complicated so cruelly with cystitis, epididymitis, prostatitis, synovitis andpleuro-pneumonia, that Wertheim asked whether the gonococcus did not redouble its virulence by passing into the blood. Jullien and Sibut witnessed a case in Saint Lazare Hospital in which Louisa M., 17, entered the hospital June 8th with urethravaginitis and was treated with tampons of Ichtyhol dissolved in glycerine (1 to 5). The urethritis ran a normal course until July 6, when the patient complained of sufferings in the abdomen. She had them for the previous week, but had made no complaint until the pain became so acute that an injection of morphine was needed. Rectal temperature 100.2. Tongue coated. Right side abdominal pain. In spite of rigid contraction of the rectal muscles there seemed to be a swelling deep down, but the observers were not certain it was not a swelling of the muscles themselves. Intestinal functions were normal, rectum empty. An eruption of roseola spots appeared on the body, abdomen and chest, so exactly like those of typhoid that the possibility of this was discussed. There was also acute pain in muscle of right calf. This pain persisted the following day when the abdominal pains had disappeared. July 9, the right knee was painful, swollen. At the same time, synovitis of left wrist, dorsal aspect. Temperature normal. July 10, very few and slight traces of the eruption. Right arm the seat of acute sharp pain, especially at the level of the deltoid “V,” deep down near the bone at the insertion of the tendon, (probably a hygroma). On examining the Achilles tendon, there was pain at the level of the left ankle, nothing to the right at the same level, but the pain was, above all, acute along the inner border of the right tibia to five or six centimeters from the flat surface. This part was edematous and painfully sensitive. Another painful spot in the abdomen was behind the right anterior superior iliac spine and beside the navel (probably muscular). The urethral discharge contained abundant bacilli beside only gonococci. Treatment by daily injection of one centigram of Merc-c. was commenced. The next day there was sharp fever, coated tongue. The abdominal pains were muscular. Trace of albumen in the urine. The next night there was delirium and nosebleed in the morning. This case went on to recover. Another case, also in a girl of seventeen of tubercular history, complicated with syphilis, presented the same order of symptoms, along with the nosebleed, hemoptysis, albuminuria, endocarditis with suffocative attacks and violent palpitations, ending in permanent disablement. These cases may be regarded as provings of Med. from the homeopathic standpoint. The rheumatic symptoms are of extreme intensity and Med. will cure many cases where the symptoms correspond. Following Burnett, there have been cures of many cases of dysmenorrhea using it. Gilbert traced rickets to hereditary gonorrhea. In these cases, there are often glandular enlargements and the patient is better at seaside. In such cases he gave Med. When there was syphilitic paresis and the patient was better in the mountains, he gave Syph. In acute bowel troubles in rickety children he found Med. of great value. Thomas Wildes considered that favus, scald-head and ophthalmia tarsi simplex (margins scaly, scurfy, often angry red, falling of lashes) were due to suppressed gonorrhea in one or both parents. The red, angry condition of skin may extend from face or scalp, down neck and back to perineum and genitals. A girl, 11, had been treated by many physicians with salves and ointments to the general impairment of her health. Her face was mottled with a profusion of red scurfy sores, eyelids involved and nearly denuded of lashes. Hairy scalp was one diffuse mass of thick yellow scabs from beneath which oozed a highly offensive mixture of ichor and sebum. Passing down neck, back, perineum and involving genitals and pubes was a fiery red band as broad as the child's hand, oozing a pale yellow serum that caused the clothing to stick to the body. Wildes told the mother he could cure the case, but it would certainly get worse the first three months. This was not objected to. Med. 100,000c was given, one dose on the tongue. The external appearance grew rapidly worse, but appetite, sleep and general health steadily improved and in nine months she was completely well. In another case, a child, 6, was, since infancy, horribly disfigured with tinea capitis. The scalp was a mass of dense scabs exuding fetid ichor, the only semblance of hair being a few distorted stumps ending in withered roots. One dose cured in a few months and, when Wildes was writing, the patient was a healthy and extremely talented young lady and the possessor of a luxuriant head of chestnut hair. Wildes thinks that suppression of favus, when derived from gonorrhea in the father, leads to hydrocephalus, capillary bronchitis, severe teething diarrhea, cholera infantum, etc. If derived from the grandfather, sup- pression leads to tuberculosis and lingering diseases. A fiery red rash develops about the anus in babies a few days old, constipation with hard, dry stools. “Baby's water scalds it terribly.” Wildes regarded the latent gonorrheal miasm as the true explanation of many of the disease manifestations included by Hahnemann under Psora. Burnett, in a way, confirmed this, as he traced gout to a sycotic origin. Wildes regarded Med. too strong a remedy to give in acute cases whether of gonorrhea, rheumatism or scarlatina, on account of the intensity of the aggravation it is liable to cause, though single doses are often useful when there is a tendency to sinking in dangerous cases of cholera infantum. Wildes traced to the same source vascular meningitis in infants and cerebrospinal meningitis. In the former, the efficacy of Med. is doubtful, but in the latter it is very efficacious after Cimic. has allayed the first acute symptoms. In the convalescent stage, Lyc. was his chief remedy. Wildes quoted from old-school authorities the following conditions traceable to latent gonorrhea communicated from husband to wife: ovarian tumors, endometritis, oophoritis, metritis, parametritis, salpingitis, and even peritonitis. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ip. (dry cough). Compare: (1) Thuj., Nat-s., Puls. (2) Pic-ac. - inability to walk right, priapism. (3) Camph. and Sec. - collapse, skin cold yet throws off all covering. (4) Verat. - collapse with cold sweat. (5) Syph. - reverse aggravation, sunset to sunrise. (6) as if in a dream, Ambr., Anae., Calc., Cann- i., Con., Cupr.. Rheum., Stram., Valer., Verat., Ziz. (7) better by leaning back, Lac-c. (8) Fish-brine odor, Sanie. (9) Breast-feeding - Galeg., Lact., Sulph., Zinc. Compatible: Sulph. (especially when stool drives out of bed). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Hepatitis. Abscess of liver. Violent, grasping pain in liver and spleen. Lungs - Desire to breathe deep. Air hunger, cannot exhale. Dyspnea, cannot exhale (Samb.). Wakes gasping for breath. Much oppression of breathing. Asthma, only better lying on abdomen and protruding tongue. Asthma, sycotic infantile. Rattling, wheezing or whistling on coughing when lying on back or either side. Lungs feel stuffed up with cotton. Heat in lungs. Left lung very painful, feels drawn towards right side. Aching in left lung under scapula. As if left lung were collapsed and paralyzed, after talking. Darting pain through lung, causes startling. Painful shock at base of each lung on coughing. Bronchial catarrh. Ropy mucus, difficult to raise. Incipient tuberculosis.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Deathly feeling in kidneys. Creeping chills in region of right kidney. Kidney colic (Berb., Oci., Pareir. ). When stooping can’t rise again without violent pain in region of kidneys. Pain in kidney region, better by profuse urination, with craving for ice. Bubbling in kidney region. Urine flows very slowly. Urine watery, colorless, intensely yellow, covered with a thick greasy pellicle. Scalding, ammoniacal urine. Urine stains clothes a dirty brown. Urinates frequently at time of menses. Passes an enormous quantity of high colored, strong smelling urine in bed every night.

Bladder - Cystitis with burning pains. Urethritis. Polyuria. Can't retain urine more than an hour. Nocturnal bedwetting. Incontinence of urine on getting cold. Painful tenesmus when urinating. Urine flows very slowly. Debility after prolonged or complete urination. Breasts - Breasts sore and swollen between periods. Breast sensitive, cold, icy, the rest of the body warm. Breasts and nipples sore and sensitive to touch. Sore, oozing or icy nipples during menses. Soreness of nipples, a gummy secretion drying on orifice, when picked off, nipple bleeds freely. Causations - Ailments from suppressed gonorrhea. Ailments from verbal, sexual abuse. Ailments from anticipation, foreboding, bad news, rudeness of others.

Perspiration - Great tendency to perspire on exertion. When asleep, day or night, no matter how short a time, profuse sweat on face and neck. Night-sweats and hectic fever. Sweat easy towards morning.

Temperature - Creeping chills running down back and all over body in a zigzag course. Shivering chills with boring pains in chest. Chills after urinating, great coldness and shivering. Chilliness when bladder is too full, better urination. Cold skin but blood feels hot. Burning heat with sweat, wants to uncover, but is chilled. Flushes of heat, alternating with chills. Great internal heat after dinner and after slight exertion, as if blood was boiling hot in veins. Flashes of heat in face and neck. Wants to be fanned all the time (Carb-v.).

full:
PHARMACY - medus. Medusa. Common jelly-fish. Arelia aurita. Sea-nettles. N. O. Radiata, class, Acalephe. Tincture of living animal taken in summer. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Breast-feeding, disorders. Desquamation. Edema. Leucorrhea. Nettle, rash. Urine, suppression. Urticaria. Vesicular, eruptions.

HOMEOPATHIC - The effects of encountering jelly-fish while bathing are well known and have been studied experimentally. The effects of drinking two cupfuls of a decoction, warm, by a woman affected with stomach disease and leucorrhea was recorded. There was rapidly produced edema, anxiety and difficult speech. Secretion of urine, which had been suspended for days, returned. Secretion of milk re-established in the woman's breasts three years after birth of her last child, she had twelve children and had not suckled any of them, having had no milk. Pricking heat and numbness of skin of face, arms, breasts and vesicular eruption, followed later by desquamation. Whole face puffed and edematous, eyes, nose, ears, lips. MIND - Extreme anxiety, difficult speech. Aversion to change. Do not like a lot of changes and prefer pleasant routine. Easily offended. Taciturn. Coldness, hatred of others who are enjoy ing life. Difficult sexual relations. Love of music and dance (Sep.). Breasts - Action on milk glands. Lack of milk production in breasts.

Eyes - Eyes puffed and edematous.

Ears - Eczema of ear.

Face - Face, eyes, ears, nose are puffed and edematous. Food - Very thin, doesn't like to eat very much. Craving for salt, fish. Intolerance of fish.

Sleep - Better after sleep. Need a lot of sleep otherwise they feel useless. COMMENTS - Blackie wrote, “In looking at Medusa one must consider the two types of Sepia: [1] rather bright patients who go off at the deep end at the slightest provocation and are exceedingly irritable, and [2] rather stupid and tired out. “Medusa is neither of these but fits somewhere in between. They can be silent and do not want to talk, they never finish their history in one go and do not want to answer questions. They always think of something else to add to their history.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Murx., Sep., Urt-u., Apis. (2) Pyrar., Physala-p. (urticaria), Hom. (3) Astac., Hom., Bomb-pr. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Skin - Numbness, burning, pricking heat. Pricking heat, numbness and burning of skin of face, arms, shoulders and breasts. Burning sensation very soon after contact. Burning more than itching. Vesicular eruption, especially on face, arms, shoulders and breasts. Nettle rash (Apis., Chlor., Dulc.). Urticaria and vesicles. Desquamation.

Modalities - Better from sleep, movement and food.

Kidneys - Retention of urine.

PHARMACY - mel. Mel. Honey. Historical dose: Topically and internally taken as a food or medicine. All potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Athlete's foot. Asthma. Bites. Burns. Cough. Cuts. Diarrhea. Eczema. Fungal, infections. Hiccups. Mouth, ulcers. Nausea. Psoriasis. Rash. Skin, disorders. Stings. Sore throat. Stomach, ulcers. Sunburn. Surgery, effects. Ulcers. Vomiting. Worms. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Honey is a by-product of bees concentrating plant nectars. The medicinal quality, taste, texture, color, aroma of honey differs according to the geographical area and the species of plants from which it has been collected. The characteristic flowery taste of raw honey comes from the pollen it contains. It contains a variety of sugars and minerals and has been shown to be low in calories and useful as a sweetener for diabetics, people with heart disease or those who are overweight. It was widely used in ancient Egypt as a food and as a remedy for many skin problems. Ancient Egyptians used honey as an application for emergencies including burns, bites, stings, cuts, sores and ulcers. Useful for many acute and chronic skin disorders including eczema and psoriasis. To heal wounds and treat infections, most commonly used as an anti-microbial agent for dressing wounds, burns and skin ulcers. A natural antiseptic, tonic and cleanser, it also is known for its antioxidant, antibiotic and antiviral capabilities. Effective in the treatment of various wounds and infections because of its anti-microbial (antibacterial, antiviral and antifungal) properties. The use of honey reduces odors, reduces swelling, and reduces scarring, it also prevents the dressing from sticking to the healing wound. Postoperative wounds. Burns. Modern research shows that honey blocks the growth of oral bacteria. Coats the throat and reduces throat irritation. Effective when used in the treatment of gastric or peptic stomach ulcers. Allows the blood to circulate better and provide more oxygen to areas of the body such as the brain. Acts as a sedative and is very useful in bedwetting disorders. Itching of anus and worms. Allergies. COMMENTS - Honey is used to cleanse wounds. It initiates growth of healthy granulation tissue. Helps in quick healing of deep wounds. Reduces the effects of poison. Honey is very good for the eyes and eyesight. Bronchial asthma, cough. Hiccoughs, nausea and vomiting. Urinary tract disorders, worm infestations, diarrhea. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aloe-v., Calen., Mel-c-s. (2) Ric., castor oil, tea tree oil. (3) Urin. REFERENCES - Murphy.

full:
PHARMACY - mel-c-s. Mel cum sale. Honey with salt. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Itching. Metritis. Uterus, prolapsed. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mel-c-s. has been used for prolapsed uterus and chronic metritis, when associated with subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. Uterinedisplace- ments and in the commencement of metritis. Soreness across the hypogastrium from ileum to ileum. Sensation as if bladder were too full. Pain from sacrum towards pubes. Pain as if in ureters. COMMENTS - Dr. Farrington wrote, “Now there is a combination of honey with salt, known as Mel cum sale. This was for years a popular remedy in Germany for bladder troubles and for diseases peculiar to women. “I have used this remedy in prolapsus uteri and even in chronic metritis, especially when associated with subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. The special symptom which leads to the selection of the remedy is a feeling of soreness across the hypogastrium from ilium to ilium.” Dr. Jeanes used a preparation of honey with salt, in the third or sixth potency, for a feeling of soreness in the uterus. Keynote feeling of soreness in the hypogastric region extending from ilium to ilium, especially in uterine displacements and in the commencement of metritis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Farrington.

HERBAL - The tea tree grows in the swampy areas of New South Wales, Australia. The oil contains terpenes and terpineol which gives it a nutmeg-like odor. It contains viridflorene. Tea tree oil is has been used as an non-irritant anti-septic, fungicide and disinfectant of great repute. When applied to pus filled infections, will clean and dissolve the pus without irritating the tissues. Dental treatment for pyorrhea and gingivitis. As a mouthwash or gargle for sore throats. In a vaporizer for congestions and colds. As a shampoo for head lice, ticks, scabies and cradle cap. Skin emollient. Creams for dry and cracked skin. Hand and body lotions.

HOMEOPATHIC - Skin fungus. Fungus of fingernails or toenails. Dermatitis. Poison oak or ivy. Tinea versicolor. Bad breath. Diabetic gangrene. Yeast infections and vaginitis. Sprains and muscle aches. COMMENTS - Combine one part tea tree oil to ten parts olive oil (also almond or avocado oil). Add ten drops to an % oz. Votóle of Sham poo, to a bath, humidifier or vaporizer. Avoid eye contact. RELATIONS - Compare: (l)Caj., Cajuputoil made from Melaleuca leucadendron, White Tea Tree. (2) Ric., castor oil use topically for many problems. Calen. (3) Echi., Plan. REFERENCES - Olsen.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mure described this plant and made a proving of the leaves. On the second day of the proving, the prover lost an inveterate diarrhea with colic. The most notable Mela, symptoms were a pain in the perineum and testicles and shuddering followed by heat without sweat. Prostration. Pains in perineum. Diarrhea. Prostatic disorders.

Head - Headache with sensitiveness of the scalp. Lancination and prickings at the vertex.

Ears - Roaring in the left ear.

Face - Pale face.

Mouth - Looseness of the teeth. Digging pain in the teeth. White coated tongue. Copious flow of saliva. Bitter mouth.

Abdomen - Borborygmi. Pain in the abdomen.

Rectum - Pain at the perineum. Fearful pain and pulling from the perineum to the anus, when sitting, not ceasing in any position, lasting six hours. Lancinations in the perineum, urethra, and testicles. Heat and pricking at the anus. Tenesmus, with constriction of the sphincter. Inveterate diarrhea and colic.

Male - Hardness of the penis, without erection

Chest - Pain in the sternal region, in the morning.

Heart - Palpitations of the heart.

Limbs - Edema of the legs. Pain in the loins. Weakness of the thighs.

Sleep - Drowsiness in the daytime. Stomach - Sour stomach.

Skin - Eruption on the lips, especially the upper. Itching and heat at night. Pricking over the feet, ankles, and wrists.

Kidneys - Pricking in the urethra. Profuse light-colored and foaming urine. Urine more cloudy and less foaming. Urine deposits a white sediment. Red, odorless urine, with bloody clots. Fetid urine. Albuminuria.

Temperature - Chills, followed by sweat. Violent chills for four hours, followed by heat without sweat. General heat. Internal heat. Vertigo - Vertigo and dizziness. REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Melatonin is a hormone made by the pineal gland. Melatonin has been used as a treatment for a number of conditions, including jet-lag, seasonal affective disorder (SAD), depression and cancer. Jet-lag, the desynchronization of the biological clock, drastic changes in the sleep-wake cycle. Night terrors. Fatigue, early awakening or insomnia. Daytime drowsiness. Ailments from loss of sleep. Chronic fatigue. Headache, fuzzy thinking, irritability. Dizziness. Mild depression. Low sex drive. Reduced immunity. Low blood pressure. Nausea. Vomiting. Abdominal cramps. Constipation. Side effects from melatonin are not uncommon, even at doses that are significantly less than the recommended amount. When side effects from melatonin do occur, they may include an increase in blood pressure, fatigue, depression and problems with fertility. MIND-Confusion. Dullness of mind. Memory weakness. Hyperactivity. Irritability. Depression. Seasonal Affected Disorder. Ailments from nursing loved ones. Breasts - Breast cancer in women who sleep irregular hours, sleep with lights on, or work late hours, night shifts. Causations - Sleep deprivation. Ailments from nursing loved ones.

Stomach - Nausea. Vomiting. RELATIONS - Compare: Cocc., Care., Luna., Coff., Nux-v., Sep. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Rectum - Constipation.

Female - Infertility.

Heart - High or low blood pressure. Stroke.

Sleep - Daytime drowsiness. Insomnia. Severe sleepdisorders. Sleep deprivation. Altered sleep patterns. Sleep with lights on or work late hours, night shifts. Vivid dreams. Nightmares.

full:
PHARMACY - meli. Melilotus officinalis. Sweet clover. Yellow clover. Melilotus alba. White and yellow varieties. N. O. Leguminose. Papilionoideae. Tincture of whole fresh plant in flower. It would be well to include a specimen of both plants in the tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blushing. Congestion. Coughs. Debility. Delusions. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Fears. Hemoptysis. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Insanity. Leucorrhea. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Ovaries, neuralgia. Pneumonia. Rheumatic pain. Shyness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Meli, was first proved by Bowen in 1851. A second proving was made by him fifteen years later. He used both the yellow and the white varieties. H. C. Allen published a further proving of Meli, alba, using the entire plant. His proving entirely confirmed Bowen's and added many symptoms. According to Allen the action of Meli, lasted about thirty days, the indolence and prostration being the first symptom to appear and the last to disappear. Congestions especially to the head, and profuse, bright red, hemorrhage which gives relief. Engorgements of any part or organ. Violent congestive and nervous headaches. Pain and debility. Coldness, but also increase of temperature, tenderness and pain. Muscular system depressed. Spasms, eclampsia, convulsions. Epilepsy, from blow on head. Infantile spasms. Tired, bruised, ■ listless, sleepy, chilly. Feeling of rawness. Dreams and emissions. MIND - Irritable, impatient, discontented, faultfinding. Indolent. Unable to fix mind, stupid indifferent. Total inability to study, memory will not retain anything. Omits words and letters in writing. Shyness and blushing. Attacks of weeping without much depression. Religious melancholy with intensely red face. Wants to kill himself or threatens to kill who approach. Furious, had to lock him in room. Loss of consciousness. Panic and fear. Fear of talking loudly, she whispers. Fear of danger. Fear of being arrested. Wants to go home. Wants to run away and hide. Suspicious. Delusions, thinks everyone is looking at her, fears to talk loud.

Head - Rushes of blood to head. Fullness all over head. Violent, throbbing, nervous and periodical headaches. Congestive headaches. Headaches are better nosebleed, menstrual flow, application of vinegar. Sick headache, relieved by nosebleed or menstrual flow. Headache with retching, vomiting, black spots before eyes. Neuralgia around and over right side of head and neck. Scalp sore and tender to touch. Headache alternating with backache.

Eyes - Hot, heavy, blurred sight, wants to close them tightly for relief. As if they were too large. Eyes as if pressed outward. Eyelids very heavy. Vision dim, blurred, rubs eyes. Unable to focus. Floating bodies before eyes when studying.

Ears - Sensation of puffing of wind from ears. Each act of swallowing caused the wind to puff from both ears.

Nose - Profuse and frequent nosebleeds, bright red blood with general relief. Nosebleed with high fever and violent congestion of head and face. Stopped up, dry, must breathe through mouth. Excessive dryness of nose, obstructed. Dry, hard clinkers in nose.

Face - Intensely red and flushed with throbbing carotids and headache (Bell.). Very red before hemorrhages from nose, lungs, uterus. Face hot, flushed, all day, feverish.

Throat - Throat sore, left side, swallowing difficult, painful. Tickling in throat with cough. Vertigo - Vertigo worse on moving. COMMENTS - Characteristic engorgement. Blood engorgement. Tending to hemorrhages, profuse, bright red, which give relief. Intensely red or even purple face attending any disorder. Headaches with blushing and nosebleed. Headaches better by lying down, profuse urination, application of vinegar. Headaches more often in hot weather, worse after exposure or getting feet wet, on approach of storm, in rainy, changeable weather. Sensation of waving in the brain. Alternation of pains, from right temple to right knee, pains in head alternating with pains in back. Marked periodicity. Generally better sitting, worse from walking, but pain in sacral region is opposite. Symptoms appear in the forenoon and wear off during the day. Relieved by discharges. Bowen used Meli, successfully in all kinds of congestive or nervous headaches, nasal and pulmonary hemorrhages, congestion of spinal cord, pleura, lungs, ovaries, menstrual colic, palpitation and nervousness, cramps in stomach, spasms, convulsions and for relieving brain-pressure and irritation in insanity. He always gave it in pellets medicated with the 1c dilution. In different cases, Bowen removed symptoms including a desire to run away, to hide, insists that everyone is looking at them. Mania to escape and kill himself, with insomnia. Nervous and timid. Dares not talk loudly, whispers. Vicious, threatens to kill those who approach. Thinks there is a devil in his stomach contradicting all he says. H. C. Allen relieved with Meli, a fear of danger, fear of being arrested in mental cases. In a schoolboy, Clarke cured with Meli. 30c a very distressing recurrent headache, accompanied by an intensely red face while the pain was on and with the same potency. Clarke gave great relief in a case of melancholia in a young woman. C. F. Barker recorded the case of Miss X, 19, tall, blonde, for several years had severe, nervous and congestive headaches. The attacks recurred two to four times a month and were so severe that they compelled her to keep to her bed twenty-four hours. The pain, mostly in temples and forehead, was a congested, full sensation with flushed face, drowsy, stupid feeling and sometimes much nausea. Trivial things seemed to provoke the attacks. Spectacles had been supplied by oculists and teeth freshly stopped by dentists, diet, rest from study and outdoor exercise had all failed to relieve. Meli. 4x was given and she had only two attacks in six months and those very slight. A writer in Hom. News tells of a Frenchman who came to him complaining of an incessant headache so bad that he thought he would die. A dose of Meli, was given on the spot and the doctor, thinking Nux-v. indicated, went into the next room to get it. He returned in five minutes and found the patient on his hands and knees shaking his head. The doctor, thinking him crazy, asked what he was doing. He replied that the pain was entirely gone and he was only trying various attitudes and motions to make sure. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Meli-a„ the white clover - has practically the same action. Hemorrhages, congestive headaches,engorged blood vessels. (2) spasms: Bell., Amyl, Glon. and Sang, in congestive headaches (but Bell, has worse lying down and worse from ap- plication of vinegar cloths). (3) In nosebleed after headache, Ant-c. (but with Ant-c. the nosebleed does not necessarily relieve). (4) Waving in brain, Cimic. (5) Rheumatic pains better moving, Rhus-t. (6) Hemoptysis, bright blood, Ip., Mill. (7) Discomfort from constipa- tion, Op. (8) Congested head and nosebleed, Erig. (9) Red face with throbbing carotids, Bell. (10) Trif-r. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Bowen. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Gastric discomfort, flatulence, fullness and other symptoms appear when constipated. Acid belchings all day, causing burning and smarting.

Abdomen - Much distention, flatulent, worse during menses.

Rectum - Difficult, painful, constipated. Severe shooting cutting in rectum while walking, better sitting down. Anus feels constricted, full, throbs. No desire until there is alarge accumulation (Bry., Alum.). Very difficult, painful stool with constriction in rectum. Discharge of stringy, glassy, milk-white mucus. Heavy throbbing and fullness in rectum from internal hemorrhoids.

Female - Leucorrhea, pain and soreness in back and pelvic region, excited by walking. Menses scanty, intermittent, with nausea and bearing down pains. Menses thin, watery, pale offensive. Dysmenorrhea. During menses, headache, bearing-down pain in pelvis. Recurring, sharp, darting pain in vagina and vulva at close of menses. Severe stitches or cutting pains through uterus. Ovarian neuralgia. Sticking pain in external parts. Food - Ravenous about 10 a.m. with onset of frontal headache. Appetite capricious, especially in morning, impaired.

Chest - Weight on chest causing difficult breathing, sensation of smothering, frequently examined clothes to see if they were not too tight.

Back - Broken sensation in lumbo-sacral joint, on sitting and especially sitting upright. Constantly changes position to get relief, wants to strike the part or press it, better standing or walking.

Limbs - Skin and limbs cold. Joints sore. Stiff and sore on rising, better by careful movement. Rheumatic pains in joints on approach of rain-storm or in rainy, changeable weather. Uneasy sensation in large joints. Numbness and aching in knee joints, right then left. Gnawing, throbbing in right knee joint, wants to stretch leg, but does not relieve. Arms heavy, too much prostrated to lift them without effort. Lungs - Smothering sensations, cannot get air enough, from rapid walking. Cough harsh, dry, spasmodic, horribly distressing. Cough from fullness of chest better by nosebleed. Hemoptysis, blood bright red.

Sleep - Drowsy, sleepy, stupid. Alternate sleep and wakefulness through night. Awakes regularly a few minutes before 3 a.m. Insomnia, cannot sleep after 3 a.m. Head seemed too high (although he had no pillow). Sleep prevented by unpleasant thoughts coursing through brain. Unpleasant dreams, of bickering.

Skin - Dry skin. Tendency to bruise and bleed easily.

Modalities - Better from bleeding, profuse urination, vinegar application. Worse rainy, changeable weather, approach of storm. Worse motion, walking, 4 p.m., menopause.

Kidneys - Frequent and profuse urination. Urine profuse, watery and relieving the dull, congestive headache.

Temperature - Chilly 10 a.m., begins in back, loins or occiput, passing in waves up to vertex. Chilly 12 p.m. to 1 p.m. with sharp pains in cardiac region of stomach and much flatulence. Chilly all forenoon. Uncomfortably chilly, feet and hands colds.

Melissa oil helps with all kinds of allergies. Cold sores and herpes. Hot infusions have been used for treating colds and flus by inducing sweating. Depression, headaches and indigestion. Headaches and restlessness. REFERENCES - Potter.

PHARMACY - menis. Menispermum canadense. Moonseed. Yellow parilla. N. O. Menispermacae. Tincture of root. Trituration ofMenisperminum. Historicaldose: Tincture, trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Backache. Dryness? Headaches. Itching. Spine, pain. Tongue, swelling.

HOMEOPATHIC - Menis, is botanically related to Cocc. and the backache recalls the spinal action of the latter, but the Cocc. vertigo and intoxication were not elicited. Very considerable doses were taken in the proving of Menis. The most notable symptom was an intense headache combined with aching all down the back. Megrim, associated with restlessness and dreams. Yawning and stretching were also a marked and frequent concomitant of headache and backache. Dryness, itching all over (Cocc.). Dry mouth and throat. Pain in spine. Legs sore as if bruised with pain in bones. The pains were like those caused by large doses of quinine and were better by Chin. Restless, troubled and confused dreams, sudden starting from sleep. MIND - Laziness, absent minded. Low-spirited, but attends to business rapidly. Quicktempered.

Head - Headaches. Sick headache, pain in forehead and temples, moving to occiput. Pressure from within outward, with stretching, yawning and pain down back.

Eyes - Eyes feel dry and swollen during the night.

Nose - Much sneezing. Discharge of nasal mucus, excoriating. Nostrils dry, especially the left, itch painfully, are sore.

Face - Face hot. Pimples on face, bleed easily.

Mouth - Tongue coated yellow, thicker at back with raised papilla, dry and parched, swollen, as if burnt. Much saliva. Mouth and throat dry during night.

Throat - Throat dry and parched without soreness. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bry., Chin. Compare: (1) Cocc., Bry. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Appetite and thirst increased. Some nausea on waking.

Abdomen - Pain in umbilical region.

Rectum - Tenesmus with regular stool.

Back - Pain in whole length of back, with intense headache, yawning and stretching.

Limbs - Pain in back, thighs, elbows, shoulders. Legs sore, as if bruised. Aching in thighs, elbows and shoulders in external muscles of thigh and upper arm, also under left scapula. Lungs - Hurried respiration during the night. Morning expectoration less and of lighter color.

Sleep - Yawning and stretching with backache and headache. Starting from sleep. Dreams of innumerable rats which creep under clothes, of cannonading. Sleeps late and heavy in morning, disinclined to rise.

Skin - Chilly. Skin cold and dry with some itching. Itching all over body, especially buttocks, worse warmth of bed.

Modalities - Better walking in open air. Worse at night, warmth of bed.

Kidneys - Urine is high-colored and scanty, yellow, white thready clouds floating through.
