full:
PHARMACY - menth. Mentha piperita. Peppermint. N. O. Labiate. Brandy mint. Curled mint. Balm mint. Tincture of whole plant. Dilutions of the essence. Essential oil. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphonia. Colds. Coughs. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Headaches. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Influenza. Itching. Stomach, pains. Throat, sore. Voice, weakness.

HERBAL - Demeures gave it to singers a short time before singing and it greatly helped them to hold the voice.

HOMEOPATHIC - A remarkable proving of Menth. was made by Demeures, who took a single drop of the tincture, the effects of which lasted into the third month. After the proving, Demeures found that he could rise earlier than usual and yet feel bright and fresh, whereas before it he could not. Marked action on respiratory organs and skin. Stimulates the cold perceiving nerves so just after taking it a current of air at the ordinary temperature seems cold. Herpes zoster. Broncho-tracheal catarrh and diseases of the skin. Dry cough, excited by air entering larynx, exposure to cold, reading aloud, shocks of any kind. Irritation in the suprasternal fossa. Dry, spasmodic cough which is worse in cold weather, and following the influenza. Stomach pain, flatulence, flatulent colic and hysteria, with nausea and vomiting. Deranged digestion. Vaginal pruritus. MIND - Mental dullness, which follows early morning rising. Insensible. Confusion of mind. Eager for work, dispatches it quickly.

Head - Headache with tension toward both ears, worse on rising, better returning to bed. Acute lancinations from ear to head, on stooping or turning head. Frontal headache from one temple to the other. Hair ceases to fall out.

Eyes - Flashes before eyes when writing.

Ears - All day when walking, shooting from one ear to the other, as if abscesses were forming, worse left. When writing, sharp lancinations extend from left ear to left teeth.

Nose - Tip of nose sore to touch, swollen but not painful.

Mouth - Very severe toothache in lower molars when chewing a bit of sugar.

Throat - Entire trachea from larynx to pit of throat painful to touch. Throat dry and painful on swallowing, as if a pin stuck crosswise in pharynx. Momentary lancinations in parotids, better during breakfast and dinner. Throat externally painfully sensitive to touch. Husky voice from reading aloud. COMMENTS - A case of fatal poisoning with the essence is on record. The patient, a boy of six took between 1 and 2 ounces and died in two hours. When seen, he was insensible, eyes fixed, pupils were fixed, stertorous breathing, cold skin and the lips were livid. Demeures said he cured with Menth. every case of influenza that came under his care in the winter of 1847- 8. “It is to dry cough, however caused, what Arn. is to injuries and Aeon, to inflammatory complaints. It relieves even the cough of tuberculosis patients.” A single globule of the 30c sufficed. Gibson Millerrelated the case of a teacher, 43, who had a dry, spasmodic cough, worse in cold weather since whooping cough in boyhood. The inhalation of the smallest quantity of smoke, either of coal, wood or tobacco, at once induced a most distressing paroxysm. Worse by the least breath of air or any fog. Scarcely any expectoration. Husky on attempting to sing. Menth. 30c completely removed the cough and enabled him to sit in a room full of tobacco smoke and sing with clearness. Hansen commended it in bilious colic with great accumulation of gas, severe pain of shingles and as an external remedy in itching of the vagina. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The labiates. (2) worse from smoke, Ign. (3) worse fog, Hyper. (4) worse rising, better lying down, Bry. (5) worse from cold air, Rumx. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Indigestion. In evening, two hours after dinner, weight in stomach which seems to extend to ears.

Back - Muscles around neck are painful to touch.

Limbs - Sensation under right foot at extremity of metatarsus, as if shoe sole was too tight there. Lungs - Frequent coughs and colds. Dry cough, excited by merely speaking, expectoration every morning of thick mucus like the core of a boil. Dry cough continues, not caused by titillation or mucus accumulations in the bronchi, but merely by the passage of air into the larynx. Cough excited from least feeling of cold, reading aloud, and smoke of all kinds.

Sleep - Sleep good, refreshing. Waking early.

Skin - Every scratch becomes a sore. Pimples with much itching near left ear with heat in part. Frequent itching behind right ear. Formication in arm and hand when writing.

Modalities - Better lying down in bed, while eating. Worse early rising, cold air, smoke. Worse stooping, turning head, reading aloud, writing.

PHARMACY - menth-pu. Mentha pulegium. English pennyroyal. European pennyroyal. N. O. Labiate. Tincture of plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Faintness. Headaches. Itching. Rheumatic, pains. Salivation, nocturnal.

HERBAL - Pennyroyal is a common herbal remedy used for menstrual disorders. It is a popular herb for the uterus and acts painlessly and without much irritation or forcing down. Cooper noted that it often causes faintness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Berridge's provings with the 40th potency were all made on men, so its properties in the female sexual sphere remain untested. His proving brought out an affinity for the right side of the head, right eye and left kidney, shoulder and hand. Jerkings of whole body directly after waking. Rheumatic pains flying about, chiefly on the right side. Sensation as of blood circulating quicker than usual. The symptoms were all worse when thinking of them.

Head - Aching in bones of forehead and sides of head, worse right after sunset. Headache in right forehead, forcing tears from right eye. Headache in right temple with pressing behind eyes, first right then both, worse towards evening and in night. Empty feeling in right side of head. Itching all around base of skull and roots of hair.

Mouth - Flow of saliva from left (side lain on) corner of mouth in night, waking him.

Throat - Stitches down left eustachian tube into left side of throat, better pressing under left ear. Vertigo - Faintness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Hedeo., Menth. (2) In worse by thinking of symptoms, Pip- m., Ox-ac. REFERENCES-Clarke.

Abdomen - Severe cutting pains in left groin and side while sitting. Sharp pains in the right hypochondrium, sometimes in middle of sternal region.

Female - Popular for the uterus, acts painlessly and without much irritation or forcing down.

Chest - Woke on right side and as soon as he had turned to left, sharp cutting pain in right chest for two minutes.

Back - Bruised, stiff feeling in small spot, upper part of right scapula with aching and empty feeling in right side of head. Sharp, cutting pains in region of left kidney, shooting up left side to left chest, better getting up.

Limbs - Pinching pain in bones of legs and arms, chiefly right, better by a night's rest. Two sudden successive jerks upward of left shoulder and upper arm while lying on left side. Unable to hold a jug with left hand when pouring out water, hand trembles.

Sleep - Veins swollen at night, troublesome dreams.

Temperature - General creeping chilliness over back and half-way down front of left thigh.

Use the infusion freely. This herb is added to many compounds on account of its carminative properties and its pleasant taste. COMMENTS - Parkinson commended a decoction of spearmint to wash the hands of children when suffering from scabs and blotches. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The labiates. (2) Menth-p., Menth. REFERENCES - Blackwood. Potter.

HERBAL - Menthol is anti-neuralgic, antispasmodic, sedative and a local anesthetic. Locally used for facial neuralgia and migraine. Cardialgía. Gastric and intestinal catarrh. Abdominal fermentation occurring in the stomach or intestines. Colicky pains and vomiting. Toothache. Pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus.

HOMEOPATHIC - Menthol, has proved curative in acute nasal catarrh, in acute Eustachian catarrh, pharyngitis, laryngitis and neuralgias. Affects the mucus membrane of the naso-pharynx and spinal nerve plexus. Neurotic pains and paresthesia. Itching, especially pruritus vulvae. MIND - Mental confusion.

Head - Migraine. Headaches. Frontal headache, pain over frontal sinus, descends to eyeballs. Lungs - Short, dry cough, worse smoking. Asthmatic breathing with congestive headache.

Eyes - Pain in eyeballs. Supra orbital pain over left eye.

Ears - Eustachian tubes feel blocked and some deafness.

Nose - Coryza with post-nasal dripping. Cold sensation in nose.

Face - Neuralgia. Pain in face above zygoma with numbness.

Mouth - Toothache.

Throat - Aphonia. Laryngitis. Tickling in the fauces. Pharyngitis. COMMENTS - Externally for itching, use a 1 percent solution or ointment. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Kali-bi., Spig. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Stomach - Gastric catarrh. Fermentation occurring in the stomach. Colicky pains and vomiting.

Abdomen - Intestinal catarrh. Abdominal fermentation occurring in the intestines. Colicky pains and vomiting.

Female - Pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus.

Chest - Cardialgía. Stabbing pains in the précordia, radiating over entire chest.

Back - Muscular pain in cervical region. Soreness of lumbar muscles.

full:
PHARMACY - meny. Menyanthes trifoliata. Buckbean. Bitterklee. Bog bean. N. O. Gen- tianacee. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Chest, disorders. Chilly. Cold. Cramps. Diabetes. Dyspnea. Fidgets. Headache. Heart, pains. Intermittent, fever. Jerkings. Malaria. Paralysis. Tinnitus.

HERBAL - The Buck-bean, or “Bog-bean” as it is also called in Ireland and Lincolnshire, is a water plant and abounds in the fen districts, where it is in great local repute as a remedy for malaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann proved it and well defined its sphere of action. The major features of Meny. are chill, sensations and pains of tension and compression, and spasmodic jerkings and visible twitchings, worse during rest and may be associated with neuralgia. Tensive and compressive pains. Tension in skin, as if it was several sizes too small and he was crowded into it. Shooting pains and pinching in limbs and joints, in arthritic disorders. Jerking pain in outer parts, also pinching pain in outer parts. Spasmodic jerking and visible twitchings with neuralgia. Jumpy, fidgety women with urinary troubles. Diabetes. Great general debility, on walking often accompanied by shivering. Icy coldness of single or affected parts, nose, ears, fingers, knees, abdomen etc. Intermittent fever, coldness predominates, felt most acutely in abdomen and legs and tip of nose. Certain headaches. MIND - Hurried. Anxiety and apprehension. Anxiety as if something evil were going to happen. Fear about the heart, driving him from place to place. Buffoonery and excessive gaiety. Confusion, better open air. Dullness of mind. Indifference to everything, alternating with great joy. Aversion to amusement. Discontented with everything, with self. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences. Taciturn and self-reflecting. Tearful sadness.

Head - Bursting headache, pain ascends from nape, better stooping, sitting bent. Heavy, pressing pain in vertex, better hard pressure with hand. Sensation as of weight in nape. Weight pressing on brain with every step on ascending. As if cold wind blowing on it.

Eyes - Frequent spasmodic stiffness of eyelids. Pressing in eyes. Mist and flick- erings before eyes. Cloudiness of eyes, when reading.

Ears - Tinnitus, when chewing. Tinkling in ears. Cracking in ear, when chewing. Shootings in ears. Feeling of coldness in ear. Discharge from ears (after exanthemata).

Nose - Cold. Tension in root of nose. Nauseous smell before nose like that of rotten eggs.

Face - Redness and heat of face during sleep. Heat in face with coldness of feet. Visible twitching of the facial muscles, worse rest. Pain and cracking in the articulation of jaw when chewing. Food - Ravenous hunger, passing away after eating a little. Troublesome confusion in head after a meal. Desire for meat. Aversion to bread and butter. No thirst at any time.

Mouth - Sweetish bitterness in mouth. Sensation of paralysis on left side of palate, when yawning and coughing.

Throat - Dryness of palate, stinging when swallowing. Dryness and roughness in throat, which impede swallowing of saliva, without thirst. When speaking hoarse and rough voice with obstruction of ears, as if something had been introduced into them. COMMENTS - Teste, who also proved it, found it very similar to Dros. Both these drugs caused in him, as one of the first symptoms, obscuration of sight, a sort of white mist or vibrations, worse in open air or during a walk. This was so intense that he did not dare to cross a street. The pains of Dros. and Meny. were the same in character, but those of Dros. were more intense. This analogy has not proved as close in other respects as Teste imagined it would. “Jumps,” “fidgets,” and “urinary difficulties in women” are Burnett's leading indications. “ When sitting, the outstretched thigh and leg are four times spasmodically jerked up, but when standing or in drawing up the knees towards him, this is not perceptible.” Twitching in any part. Legs jerk and twitch, cannot rest when lying down. Stitches, numbness, tension. Tension sensation, as if the skin were several sizes too small. Cramp-like and paralyzing pains. Severe pressure in the head. Pressing in vertex from above downwards, better during hard pressure with the hand, when ascending stairs, as of a heavy weight pressing on the head and brain at every step. Icy coldness of the hands and feet with the headache. R. Farley reported the case of Miss D. W., long a sufferer from spinal irritation, had terrible attacks of bursting headache, a terrible tension in membranes of brain in paroxysms, which caused her to scream. Began in right side of nape, ascended to forehead and then spread over whole brain. Terrible sensation of loneliness with the pain, begged her mother to stay with her. Worse from light, noise, jar, even if one walked lightly across the room. Better from sitting bent and by hard pressure on nape and vertex. Meny. 30c every ten minutes relieved immediately and completely removed everything in two hours. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph. It antidotes: Effects of quinine and Chin. Compare: (l)Caps.. Puls., Calc., Ph-ac., Sang. (2) worse ascending, Calc. (3) Headache better hard pressure, Verat. (4) Weight on vertex at every step, Cact., Glon., Lach. (5) Intermittent fever with cold limbs, Lach, (but Lach, has livid skin, great prostration andfiliformpulse). (6) Icy coldfeet and legs, Calc., Gels. (7) Bursting headache pushing skull open, Sil. (Sil. better warmth, Meny. better pressure). (8) Pressive headache, Puls., Par., Mag-m. (9) Fidgets, Psor., Caust., Zinc. (10) the gentians. Compatible after: Cupr., Lach., Lyc., Puls., Rhus-t., Verat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Sensation of coldness extending up esophagus with great nausea, following pressure in stomach. Heat in stomach, followed by excessive hunger. Contractive cramps in stomach. Continual rumbling in stomach, as if it were empty. Frequent empty belchings.

Abdomen - Distended and full, increased by smoking tobacco. Distention of abdomen by abundant flatus. Coldness, worse pressing upon it with hand. Pinchings in abdomen. Pain, as from excoriation in abdominal tissues.

Rectum - Constipation. Hard feces with pinchings in the abdomen. Bleeding, hemorrhoids.

Male - Increase of sexual desire without excitement or erection. Both testicles drawn up, right more than left. Spermatic cord painful to touch.

Chest - Shooting compression on both sides of chest. Stitches in chest, worse during motion and when breathing. Aching in chest after dinner.

Heart - Stitches in region of heart. Slightest exertion causes irregular action. Drawing pain in précordia, worse after eating. Anxiety about, as if some evil was going to happen.

Back - Rigidity and heaviness in muscles of neck, throat and nape. Extremely painful tearing between the scapula, extending downwards. Boring at scapula (left). Bruised pain in sacrum, worse stooping, walking. Causations - Injuries to nerves (tooth broken in). Quinine.

Limbs - Cramp-like pains in limbs. Cramps in posterior thighs worse sitting. Cramps from ankles to calf (right). Legs jerk and twitch, worse lying down. Shocks and convulsive movements in thighs. Paralytic tearing and spasmodic drawings in arms, hands and fingers. Icy coldness of hands and feet. Lungs - Stitch in anterior regions of larynx, impeding swallowing. Dyspnea. Spasmodic contraction of larynx with excitation to cough, when drawing breath.

Sleep - Agitated sleep with vivid dreams. Doesn't remembered dreams.

Skin - Feels tight.

Modalities - Better hard pressure on affected part, laying on hand, stooping, motion, twilight. Worse light, noise, during rest, walking, ascending, jar.

Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate with scanty urine.

Perspiration - Perspiration in evening as soon as he lies down, continuing all night.

Temperature - Predominance of cold. Icy coldness of hands and feet. Shivering with yawning. Chill, which is better by heat of stove and only remains in back. Intermittent fever with coldness in abdomen. Pulse slow during cold stage and accelerated during fever. Heat in evening, mostly on head with cold feet. Quartan malaria.

full:
PHARMACY - meph. Mephitis putorius. Skunk secretion. Mephitis mephitica. Mus- tela foetida. Mustelina. N. O. Mustelide. Alcoholic dilution of the liquid contained in the anal glands. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Blindness. Choking. Coldness. Convulsions. Coughs. Debility. Exhaustion. Eyes, disorders. Laryngismus. Otalgia. Rheumatic, pains. Spasms. Trembling. Vertigo. Vision, weak. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - The dilutions of this medicine are prepared from the Equid contained in the anal glands of skunk. Meph. was proved by Hering in the 30c. Should be given in the lower dilutions. Meph. produced a suffocative feeling and spasmodic cough. Cough so violent, seems as if each spell would terminate life. Whooping cough. Child must be raised up, gets blue in face, cannot exhale. Mucus rales through upper part of chest. Asthmatic attacks. Spasmodic effects. Trembling and choking with exophthalmos. Convulsions. Sensation of paralysis during the pains. Rheumatic pains. Shifting pains with want to urinate. Fine vibrations causing great uneasiness. Internal agitation of whole body with sensation of uneasiness. Nervous exhaustion. Debility after severe illness. Great dejection and lassitude during which the muscles are painful when touched or exercised. Indolence with desire to stretch and stretching. Wants to bathe in ice cold water. MIND - Excitement with heat in head. Talkative. Can neither sleep nor work. Unfit for intellectual labor, caused by too lively an imagination. Full of fancies. Excessive loquacity, as from drinking too much. Disinclination to work with inclination to stretch. Dejection with painful muscles. Ill-humor about trifles or imaginary troubles.

Head - Violent pain in head as if a fullness were pressing upwards. Violent headache with sensation of fullness, as if caused by a weight or by pressure, especially in the occiput. Pain above eyes. Headache from motion of carriage.

Eyes - Heat, burning and aching in eyes, morning and evening. As if fire in eyes. Conjunctiva red, eyes hot and painful. Injection of veins in sclerotica. Lancination in eyes like the pricking of needles. Pain from overexertion, blur, unable to distinguish letters. Inability to read fine print. Myopia. Nocturnal blindness.

Ears - Otalgia. Itching heat, redness, blisters and erysipelas in the external part of the (right) ear. Tearing in the ears or in the jaw and teeth.

Nose - Dryness of the nose. Nosebleeds. Fluent coryza with pain, as from excoriation in the chest. Prolonged inclination to sneeze.

Face - Bloated. Child gets blue in face and can't exhale with spasmodic cough.

Mouth - Metallic, coppery taste, as after eating onions. Foul breath. Painful jerks in root of teeth. Bloated face.

Throat - Tendency to choke when drinking and speaking. Food goes the wrong way. Nausea with scraping in throat. Vertigo - Violent vertigo, worse sitting, turning in bed. Vertigo on stooping suddenly, when moving the head, when seated. COMMENTS - Rush of warmth to various parts. Enables patients to endure extreme cold, makes them less chilly in cold weather. Washing in ice water is pleasant. Awakens at night with congestion of legs. Legs uneasy, as if they would become insensible. Fidgety feet. Short sleep seems to refresh. Choking while eating or drinking. Cough on reading aloud, while talking and after drinking, caused by choking. Lower ribs painful to touch or pressure, especially worse on coughing or sneezing. Neidhard gave Meph. to “a young man affected with symptoms of tuberculosis,” in whom it produced “a spasmodic cough with a crowing sound, lasting all night and returning several times.” This homeopathic aggravation suggested to Neidhard to use Meph. in whooping cough and his conclusion, quoted by Hering, notes that “If the facts collected since 1851, which are numerous, do not prove that Meph. will supersede all other remedies in whooping cough, it certainly may be considered a valuable specific. In order to ensure its full success, it should be exhibited in the lower dilutions from one to three, at least in severe cases.” Guernsey gave it as: “Whooping or any other kind of cough which is very violent, coming on spasmodically and seeming as though each spell would terminate life.” Farrington said the note of Meph. is nervous exhaustion. In whooping cough the catarrh is slight, whoop decided, worse at night and after lying down. Suffocative feeling, cannot exhale, vomits food sometimes hours after eating. Asthma of alcoholics of tuberculosis patients (after Dros.). T. M. Stewart reported the case of a man, 47, who had a constant hacking cough coming on during conversation. For this the uvula was amputated. When he recovered from the operation he had “Coughs after reading aloud or drinking any fluid, cough spasmodic, hollow, hoarse, worse at night and on lying down, loose in mornings.” Amb., Cham., Kali-bi., Rumx., Phos., failed to relieve, Meph. 1,000c. cured promptly. A. M. Cushing called attention to the possibilities of the remedy in weak sight and told of a friend of his who had a dose directly from the skunk injected into his eyes “It was as though fire had entered his eyes.” For a time he was totally blind, but when his sight returned it was so keen that he could count the panes in a window said to be two miles distant. In another case after getting the poison out of the eye, there was for weeks after a sensation on opening the lids as of breaking glass. On Farrington's advice it was antidoted by Crot-h. RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Camph., but only temporarily. Crot-h. relieved eye symptoms. Compare: (l)Dros., Cor-r., Stict. (2) Whooping cough, Cor-r. has smothering before the cough and great exhaustion after. (3) Dros. has frequent spells of barking cough, worse after twelve midnight, holds sides, vomits if cannot raise sputa. (4) Cough worse from reading or writing, Aur., Nux-v., Plat. (5) Rumx. - cough at night, worse 2 a.m., Stict. with splitting headache. Aur. - awakes at night with congestion to legs. (6) Short sleep seems to refresh, Fl-ac., Menth. (7) Night blindness, Bell. (8) Aversion to tobacco smoke, Ign. (9) Easy choking, Lach. ( 10)Fidgety feet, Tarent., Meny ..Zinc., Caust., Ars., Asaf., Asar., Cimic., Aur. (11) Loquacity, Agar., Lach. (12) Nervous symptoms generally, Cast-eq., Mosch. Follows well: Dros. (in cough of tuberculosis patients). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Pressure in stomach, with colic. Belchings, better by discharge of flatus. Sensation of emptiness in stomach and nausea. Vomits food hours after eating.

Abdomen - Pains in hypochondria. Aching and movements in abdomen, as if caused by a chill. Pains in abdomen in evening. Pains as from flatulency in left side. Aching in region of liver in with colic. Colic, as from diarrhea, but without evacuation.

Rectum - Evacuations infrequent, but liquid. Diarrhea.

Male - Itching in scrotum. Heat in genital organs.

Female - Burning leucorrhea. Excoriation of genital organs and swelling of labia majora. Soreness of genitals. Swelling of labia and uterus. Food - Hunger, alternating with absence of appetite. Absence of appetite in morning and repugnance to tobacco-smoke. Painful weariness and desire to sleep after a meal. Desire for salted food.

Chest - Pains in chest when touching it. Chest pains when coughing and sneezing.

Back - Pain and a sort of paralysis in back and in all limbs. Lancination in spine during motion. Pains in right side of neck. Tension in muscles of nape. Contusive pains in loins in morning.

Limbs - Drawing and rheumatic pains in thighs, hip and foot, but chiefly in leg. Contusive pains in knee. Rheumatic pains in arms with paralytic drawings, better by movement. Uneasiness in arm, as it were insensible. Trembling in arm on resting upon it. Jerking in hand. Lungs - Dyspnea and cannot exhale. False croup and cannot exhale. Sudden contraction of glottis, when drinking or talking. Asthma, as if inhaling sulphur. Asthma, has to sit up in bed, worse ice water. Asthma of consumptives or alcoholics. Foul expectoration.

Sleep - Short nap, seems to refresh. Awakes at night with rush of blood to lower legs. Vivid dream of water, fire.

Skin - Pimples on thighs, forehead, face, neck and nates.

Modalities - Better from cold, icy, weather. Better bathing, sitting up, motion. Worse night, daybreak, morning, lying down , rest, touch, after menses, ice water.

Teeth - Drawing and tearing in teeth. Sudden shocks in roots of teeth. Pains in carious teeth, molars, in lower jaw.

Kidneys - Frequent want to make water, especially at night, with emission of clear urine. The urine becomes turbid in morning, and deposits a sediment in evening after an attack of fever.

Cough - Spasmodic coughs or whooping cough. Cough, violent suffocative, spasmodic, nervous, worse at night, talking, loud reading, or drinking. Cough hollow, deep with rawness, hoarseness and pains through chest. Whooping or any kind of cough which is very violent, coming on spasmodically, and seeming as if each spell would terminate life. Cough with vomiting after eating. Loose cough, in morning, with some expectoration.

Temperature - Coldness predominates. Less chilly in cold air, cold water is agreeable. Evening chilliness with desire to urinate. Increased heat in morning. Mephitis putorius

full:
PHARMACY - merl. Mercurialis perennis. Dog mercury. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Tincture of whole fresh plant in flower. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Amenorrhea. Asthenopia. Belching. Breast disorders. Colic. Coma. Conjunctivitis. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Epiphora. Flatulence. Menses, late. Numbness. Palpitations. Pannus. Ptosis. Rheu natic disorders. Spleen disorders. Tension. Tongue, paralysis. Trachoma. Vertigo.

HERBAL - Dog's mercury is a common plant with poisonous properties, on account of which it is avoided by cattle.

HOMEOPATHIC - Meri, wasprovedby Hesse. Like other Euphorbians it has exceedingly acrid properties and many of its symptoms resemble closely those of the more corrosive salts of mercury. Meri, has disorders of the muscular tissues, stomach, intestines, and bladder. Great exhaustion and drowsiness. Feeling of emptiness and weariness in the whole body. Persistent pains in muscles on motion. Prevalence of burning symptoms, irritation of eyes and nose, tenesmus after stool. Tumor at ensiform appendix, very sensitive. Tension. Pain as if a band tied tightly across the forehead. Dragging, especially dragging down in small of back with rectal pains in groins and thigh as if a hernia might appear. Amenorrhea. Scanty and delayed menses. Dysmenorrhea, accompanied with orgasm, pains and swelling of breasts. MIND - Hurry in movements. Excited mood like intoxication. Morose, quarrelsome. Fretful, ill-humored. Fear of insanity. Indifference to everything. Indifference to external things. Difficulty in collecting his senses. Coma.

Head - Head confused as if inflated. Tension and heaviness of head with sensation of heat. Burning on vertex. Aching in forehead better by cold and pressure. Shooting in left forehead and temple, worse coming indoors. Numbness of occiput and vertex after a blow on head. Scalp feels tense and numb, is moved with difficulty.

Eyes - Pain, burning, forcing-out sensation in eyes. Watery eyes. Dilated pupils with great sensitiveness of eyes to light. Asthenopia, as of a cloud, veil or cobweb before sight. Eyelids feel heavy and dry, difficult to move them. Weakness of upper lids. Trembling and twitching of upper lids. Blinking of eyes.

Nose - Crawling andburning of nose. Sensation of heat rising from stomach into nose. The breath from nose is cold. Conscious of having a nose, nostrils feel sore. Feels as if she had two noses.

Face - Feeling of coldness, tension in face and head. Great redness of cheeks. Lips dry and parched with increased thirst.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth, difficult to move tongue, impedes chewing. Burning in mouth and tongue.

Throat - Burning dryness in throat. Ulcers on palate, tonsils and back of pharynx.

Stomach - Chilly feeling or burning in stomach. Belching relieves. Vomits food as soon as eaten. Tumor inside pit of stomach size of hen's egg, worse pressure, cannot bear clothing.

Abdomen - Abdominal pulsation. Violent twanging in left hypochondrium. Warmth, gnawing, and pressure in spleen, worse lying down. Gnawing from pit of stomach to gallbladder. Rumbling, movings and workings in abdomen, emission of much flatus.

Rectum - Dragging, pressing in rectum, with pressure and tension in small of back. Dragging, burning, crawling, itching, smarting in anus. Diarrhea with constant colic. Thin stools. Profuse, soft stool followed by some straining. Sensations - Heaviness in head as if pressed on pillow with a weight.

Male - Dragging in inguinal region, at times sticking pain, worse walking, at times extending down into spermatic cord, sometimes one, sometimes both.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses scanty and delayed. Menses shorter with abdominal cramp too late. Menses profuse, violent orgasm of blood, great anxiety so that she nearly fainted, oppressed breathing, heat over whole body, especially head and face, anxious sweat. Dysmenorrhea, accompanied with orgasm, pains and swelling of breasts. Food - Increased thirst with dry lips and mouth. Great dryness in mouth while eating. After eating, biting, burning on tongue, nausea, vomiting.

Chest - Sticking in left, throbbing in right chest. Pressure and painfulness on chest in forepart and in stomach with dyspnea.

Heart - Orgasm in the heart region. Constriction. Whirling and rushing, throbbing in heart, stomach and upper abdomen. Palpitations with oppression, as if chest would be constricted after stooping.

Back - Flushes of heat in back. Aching in nape. Drawing tearing along right scapula, extending into upper arm. Tensive dragging and dragging tearing in small of back, with anal symptoms. Causations - Blow on the head.

Limbs - Tired and weary. Weakness of arms and legs as if she would fall to left without vertigo. Tearing, stitching, burning and smarting pains in limbs, almost in the skin, especially of hands and feet. Jerking, sticking, drawing tearings throughout upper limbs. Pressive tearing pain in tibia. Jerking tearing in left patella. Painful ache in knees.

Sleep - Frequent yawning and weariness. Dizzy sleepiness. Sleep unrefreshing, full of dreams, of animals.

Skin - Pimples on chin with biting, itching. Burning, itching, tearing on skin.

Modalities - Better by cold. Touch aggravates. Headache worse indoors. Sunlight aggravates the eyes. Open air causes blinking.

Tongue - Tongue feels heavy and dry, numb, insensible, with loss of taste. Burning blisters on tongue, inside of lips and cheeks, forming very painful spreading ulcers. Tongue painful if it touches palate as if there were blisters on it. Vertigo - Giddiness. Vertigo by going downstairs. Whirling vertigo. Vertigo as if intoxicated, following headache. Feeling as if body would fall towards left side, when sitting, standing or even lying. COMMENTS - Cooper said, “Compared with other Euphorbians, it dries up the mucus surfaces, causing burning locally and a general drowsiness, while the other Euphorbians set up violent irritation and diarrhea from the first. Moreover, its action is not expended on the skin so soon as that of the others.” Remarkable dryness of the mouth and throat, even sugar refuses to melt in the mouth. Eating aggravates the dryness. The breath from the mouth is hot and dries the lips. Hot or cold breath in the nose. Conscious of having a nose, “she feels as if she has two noses.” Head confused as if inflated. Numbness of head and dullness of mind. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Vertigo by going downstairs. Rolling, throbbing, trembling and orgasm in all the veins. The liver and spleen are influenced, warmth in spleen. Tension in rectum and back. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon., Bell. Compare: (1) Euph., Croto-t., Acai. (2) In worse descending stairs, Bor. (3) Straining after stool, Merc. (4) Dragging pains, Lil-t. (5) Numbness of head, Graph, (feels like wood). (6) Asaf., Caust., Kali-bi., Kreos., Lach., Led., Mag-m., Nat-m., Nat-ac., Nux-v., Nux-m., Rhod., Sulph., Thuj. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Liver - Pressure in liver region extending to spleen. Sticking pain in liver. Lungs - Breath hot, almost burning, lips almost made sore by it. stertorous, difficult breathing, especially right side.

Kidneys - Burning, prickling, crawling in urethra and prepuce, with crawling in anus and tearing and dragging in small of back. Frequent urging with burning, urination somewhat increased.

Temperature - Cold over the whole body with hot flush in face. Goosebumps on the cold right arm, extending over whole body. Chill on going to bed in evening. Heat with intense thirst, perspiration in morning.

Hahnemann noted a symptom referring to the menses which came on at the new moon, four days before their proper time. The medicines whose action is influenced by the moon's phases are not numerous and thus worth remembering. Congestion with stiffness, dryness and heat of parts affected. Lack of moisture. Throat dry, talking difficult. Throat lancinations, worse by coughing rather than by swallowing. Eyes inflamed, burn and itch. Tinea capitis favosa, margin of ulcers painful. Chancre in urethra. Inflammation of the penis, worse cold water, better bathing with tepid water. Pressure in lower sternum and dyspnea on standing erect. COMMENTS-Hansen said that burning in the urethra during urination and at other times has been confirmed in practice. He commended it in tinea favosa on a syphilitic base and for sharp pains in tabes syphilitica. Donner of Stuttgart cured with Merc-a. a very painful syphilitic ulcer in the urethra. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Merc., Luna. REFERENCES - Clarke. Hansen.

PHARMACY - merc-c. Mercurius corrosivus. Corrosive sublimate. Mercuric chloride. Mercurius sublimatus. Triturations. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Bladder, disorders. Bones, disorders. Bright's disease. Burning, pains. Cancrum oris. Chancres. Cystitis. Delirium. Dermatitis. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eczema. Edema. Esophagus, stricture. Eye, disorders. Fevers. Gonorrhea. Gums, disorders. Intestinal, fever. Intestines, ulcerated. Intussusception. Iritis. Jaundice. Kidney, disorders. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Measles. Miscarriage. Mouth, disorders. Mumps. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Paralysis. Paraphimosis. Pemphigus. Perimetritis. Peritonitis. Phagedenic, ulcers. Photophobia. Prosopalgia. Puerperal, fever. Pyorrhea. Retinitis. Rigg's disease. Syphilis. Tabes, mesenterica. Taste, disordered. Tenesmus. Throat, inflamed. Tongue, disorders. Ulcers. Urethritis. Uvula, elongated.

HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-c. is a powerful disinfectant and has a greater rapidity of action than Merc., causing violent effects. The chief effect of the chlorine element in this salt appears to be to intensify the mercurial action. The burning of Merc-c. is more intense than other mercury salts. Inflammation with swelling andfeelings of constriction. Internal burning in the throat, stomach rectum, neck of bladder and kidneys. Constriction of throat, rectum, bladder. Severe painful cystitis. Bright's disease. Albuminuria in early pregnancy, (Phos.). Destroys the secreting portions of the kidneys. Dysentery. Severe tenesmus of the rectum, which is incessant and is not relieved by the stool. Tenesmus often involves the bladder as well. Dysenteric straining is excessive, for this reason Merc-c. is more generally prescribed in dysentery than Merc. Syphilis. Gonorrhea, in the second stage with continuous tenesmus. Phagedenic ulcers. Chancres spread with great rapidity. Discharges acrid, tears, nasal discharge. Cracks on palms, soles, corners of mouth. Tibial pains. Lies on back with knees drawn up. MIND - Restlessness at night. Anxious and restless, rocks back and forth. Anxiety during fever. Anxiety during sleep after menses. Fear arising from heart. Fear of misfortune. Anguish with pain in abdomen. Ill- humor. Irritability in daytime. Absent-mindedness. Confusion of mind. Difficult thinking. Disturbed speech. Wandering thoughts while talking. Stupid. Imbecility. Mind sluggish with torpid digestion. Coma vigil. Stupor. Stares at persons who talk to him and does not understand them. Delirium, springs up suddenly from bed and escapes. Shouting, brain cry.

Head - Heaviness of head. Frontal pain, congestion of head with burning in cheeks. Drawing pain in periosteum of skull. Pain in temples, worse looking sideways. Profuse sweat on forehead. Falling out of hair.

Eyes - Burning, soreness of eyes. Pain severe at night, burning, shooting, tearing. Pain behind eyeballs, as if forced out. Iritis normal or syphilitic. Iris muddy in color, thick and neither contracts nor dilates. Retinitis, albuminuria. Deep ulcers on cornea. Acrid lachrymation. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Excessive photophobia. Objects appear smaller or double vision. Eyelids edematous red, excoriated.

Ears - Violent pulsation in ears. Stitches in ears with inflammation. Fetid pus.

Nose - Swollen, red nose. Rawness, smarting, burning and soreness of nostrils. Postnasal swelling, mucus membrane dry, red and covered with bloody mucus. Gluey nasal discharge. Stopped-up feeling with running of nose. Excessive coryza. Fluent, acrid coryza. Discharge excoriates upper lip. Ozaena with perforation of septum nasi (Kali-bi.). Frequent epistaxis.

Face - Red, puffy. Edematous swelling of the face. Yellow face. Face pale and anxious. Pale about mouth. Cracks in angles of the mouth. Lips, black, dark red, swollen, tender. Upper lip swollen and turned up. Jaws stiff. Necrosis of lower jaw. Darting pains along upper jaw, gums and roots of teeth. Swelling and tenderness of submaxillary glands. Facial neuralgia within the bones.

Mouth - Salivation with salty taste. Metallic taste. Taste, astringent, salty, bitter. Discharge of albuminous mucus from mouth. Burning, scalding sensation in mouth. Aphthae, ulcers. Pyorrhea. Gums, purple, swollen, spongy with toothache. Teeth loose, nightly toothache. Necrosis of lower jaw.

Throat - Burning, sore, red, painful swelling, worse heat. Dark red color. Uvula, red, swollen, elongated. Tonsils swollen, covered with ulcers. Glands about throat swollen. Swallowing difficult and painful. Spasmodic constriction of glottis, on attempting to swallow a drop of liquid. Pricking in throat as from needles. Postnasal discharge with sharp pains to ears, worse pressure. Pain in larynx as cut with knife. Hoarseness quickly alternating with normal voice. Aphonia.

Stomach - Burning gnawing, darting pains in stomach. Cramps in stomach and vomiting after eating rye bread. Cramp in epigastrium, worse least touch. Epigastrium very sensitive. Distention and soreness of the pit of stomach. Gastritis. Regurgitation, astringent. Spasmodic constriction of esophagus and stomach on attempting to swallow a drop of water. Spasmodic and very painful retching. Incessant, green, bilious vomiting. Vomiting of tenacious mucus with blood. Stools - Stools, hot, bloody, slimy offensive, with cutting pains and shreds of mucus membranes. Stools yellow, green, bilious. Stools pasty, dark green, blackish, offen- . sive. Oozing of corrosive ichor from anus, excoriating external parts. Passes pure blood or bloody water. Stools followed by slime and blood. Stools worse after midnight, worse autumn.

Abdomen - Bloated, very painful to least touch. Bruised sensation, cecal region and transverse colon painful. Stitches in hepatic region. Pain in liver and right shoulder with frequent nausea and obstinate chronic constipation. Cutting colic, below navel. Painful flatulence. Appendicitis.

Rectum - Violent burning in rectum. Burning in anus during stool. Continuous urging to stool and urine. Dysentery, tenesmus, not better stool. Most extreme tenesmus, with scanty evacuations of mucus and blood. Constipation, tenacious feces. Never get done feeling. Sweats before and after stool. Hemorrhoidal colic with congestion of liver and abdominal venous stasis. Spasms of rectum during sex.

Male - Penis and testes enormously swollen. Chronic balanitis. Paraphimosis. Chordee, worse sleep. Painful stinging in left testicle. Hard, phagedenic chancres. Greasy, fatty, offensive smelling discharge. Gonorrhea, discharge thick, greenish. Urethritis. Urethra orifice red, swollen, glans sore and hot. Violent erections during sleep.

Female - Menses too early and too profuse. Burning heat and pain in genitals. Vaginitis. Urethritis. Mucus discharge as thin as water. Leucorrhea, pale yellow with sweetish nauseous smell. Fibroid tumors with profuse, muco-purulent, excoriating leucorrhea. Aching pain succeeding pressing or touching os uteri during sex. Food - Attacks of violent hunger or no appetite. Great desire for cold food. Worse fat food. Unquenchable thirst, for cold drinks. Fluids return through nose.

Chest - Constriction of the chest. Stitches through side of chest. Frequent stitches shoot through thorax. All glands about thorax swollen.

Heart - Tremulous undulating motion of heart, precordial anxiety. Pains in precordial region. Pulse rapid and intermittent, small, irregular. Palpitations during sleep.

Back - Pott's disease, lies on back with knees drawn up. Cervical glands hard and swollen. Dorsal decubitus.

Limbs - Paralysis of limbs, trembling. Pains wandering from joint to joint, compelling him to stay in bed. Rheumatic pain after suppression of gonorrhea. Coldness in limbs, look purple. Feet icy cold. Cramps in calves in dysentery. Exostoses, on shin, sternum, ribs. As if legs had gone to sleep. Deltoid feels relaxed. Lungs - Very difficult breathing. Slow, interrupted breathing. Sighing with palpitations. Burning and stinging in trachea. Breathes as through a metallic tube. Breathes through pectoral muscles. Cutting pain in larynx. Cough with bloody expectoration. Greenish mucus, worse at night. Asthmatic coughs, worse talking.

Sleep - Frequent yawning and stretching. Sleepless at night. Starting from sleep. Sleeplessness from vertigo or anxiety. Wakeful after 3 a.m. Violent hiccough during sleep. Disturbed by toothache with anxious sensation. Frightful dreams.

Skin - Cold. Burning, stinging heat in skin. Burning and redness of skin with formation of small vesicles. Ulcers, perforating, spreading, serpiginous. Scorbutic spots over whole body, mingled with itchlike eruptions. Herpes and boils. Severe eczema from sweating parts of body. Condylomata. Nails gray colored.

Modalities - Better while at rest. Pain in hip joints better from motion. Worse after urination and stool, swallowing, acids, fat food. Worse from sex, motion. Worse night, cold, open air, autumn, hot days and cool nights. Dysentery and summer complaints from May to November.

Compare - ( 1 ) Ars., Lach. (2) Leon., Mons. - an African plant belonging to the Germaniacee used for dysentery in material doses. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Teeth - Toothache at night. Teeth loose. Gums red and detached from teeth. Gums purple, swollen with toothache and spongy. Gums bleed easily. Pyorrhea,

Tongue - Tongue coated and moist, with red edges. Tongue, patchy, swollen and inflamed. Papillae elevated, strawberrylike. Tongue very red, with blackish coat. Tongue covered with a grayish white crust. Tongue protruding from swollen lips. Tongue could not be protruded. Vertigo - Vertigo with deafness when stooping. Vertigo with coldness, cold sweat. COMMENTS - As with other ulcerating remedies, Merc-c. is a powerful antiseptic and disinfectant. Being much less irritating than carbolic acid, it took the place of the latter as the leading antiseptic. Before the proper degree of dilution had been ascertained many patients were poisoned by its external use. In some of the poisoning cases, the bladder was found after death firmly contracted into a small hard lump. Keynote intense tenesmus of bladder with intense burning in urethra and discharge of mucus and blood with the urine or after it. Intussusception. Tenesmus is worse or not relieved after the stdol. Tenesmus with dysentery. Diarrhea with a “never-get-done feeling.” Membranous threads in stool, blood, weakness, faintness, shuddering. Urine is albuminous, scanty, hot, bloody, may be retained or suppressed. Gonorrhea. Greenish-yellow or bloody and watery discharge with violent burning, urging and painful erections, dark purplish swelling. Glans has a dark red or gangrenous appearance. Phimosis or paraphimosis. Rapidly spreading chancres. Serpiginous ulcers, ulcers with ragged edges that will eat away half the penis in a few days. Skin disorders including syphilitic roseola, smallpox and condylomata. Tibial pains, particularly when present in cases of enteric fever or after enteric fever, with symptoms of intestinal ulceration. Rheumatism and rheumatic fever (Merc.). Raging thirst for cold things. Desire for cold food and intolerance of hot things. Sore throat characterized by the rapid spread of the infection and by the intensity of the burning pains. Constriction of the gullet, any attempt to swallow solids or liquids causes violent spasms and immediate ejection. Cutting pain, as from a knife in throat. Thick and glue-like nasal catarrh, acrid excoriating. Tearing pains in bones and around eyes. Scrofulous, syphilitic ophthalmias. Burning, agonizing pains with excessive photophobia, causing excoriation of cheeks. Clarke learned from Dr. McKechnie that long uvulas sometimes give rise to irritating coughs. If a low trituration of Merc-c. is applied to the uvula on a brush, it will in many cases immediately, and often permanently, relieve the trouble. A patient of Clarke's who was treated under allopathic treatment with a solution of Merc-c. injected into his urethra for gonorrhea, not only suffered intensely in the urethra at the time, but for years afterwards had a painful spasm of the rectum every time he had sex. Unna reported two cases of elderly women poisoned by sublimate lotion, lint and gauze after ablation of the breast. The dressings were removed on the second day in each case. The first symptoms were intense irritation of the skin and diffused redness of the part. The wounds failed to heal by first intention. Widespread dermatitis followed and in the course of a few days a diffuse erythema spread over the whole body, creeping onwards like “water on blotting paper.” Some fever, general malaise, nausea, restlessness. In one case, the eruption lasted three weeks and changed its type, “scattered urticarial and erythematous itching spots on all parts of the body suggested that there was at that period a poisoning of the more central nervous system.” R. C. Markham recorded a cure with Merc- c. after the failure of Merc, in a case of dysentery. The symptoms were stool with bloody mucus, tenesmus after the stool, cutting colic below umbilicus, nausea, and perspiration before and after stool, most pronounced on lower part of body and thigh. The symptoms of colic and perspiration were not found under Merc., but were under Merc-c. The patient felt better within ten minutes of receiving a dose of Merc-c. 1,000c. RELATIONS - Antidote: Calc-s. is antidotal to bichloride poisoning. Use intravenous injection of 7 grains in 7 oz's. boiled water.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Bleeding kidneys. Gonorrhea. Paraphimosis. Tenesmus of bladder, rectum. Frequent urine, pale, copious, dribbling, worse sitting. Urine hot, burning, scanty or suppressed. Albuminous urine. Urine bloody, greenish discharge. Urine brown, with brick dust sediment. Urine contains filaments, flecks or flesh-like pieces of mucus. Urine contains fibrin or fat globules. Urine passed drop by drop. Urethra bleeds after urinating. Sweats after urination.

Bladder - Severe, painful cystitis. Tenesmus of bladder. Intense burning in urethra. Stabbing pain up urethra into bladder. Urethritis. Burning and painful urination. Dribbling of urine, worse sitting. Albuminuria, during pregnancy, from abuse of alcohol. Urethra bleeds after urinating. Breasts - Glandular swellings about the nipples. Nipples crack and bleed, pain worse when nursing.

Perspiration - Perspiration after urinating. Sweats from every motion, partial worse forehead and lower parts, foul, at night. Profuse sweat surfaces cold. Perspiration after urinating. Perspiration before and after stool. Foul sweats. Perspiration at night. Offensive sweats, towards morning. Cold sweats, often only on forehead, also general with anxiety.

Temperature - Chilly from slightest exposure, exertion. Chills when rising. Chilly after stools. Profuse perspiration, surfaces cold. Heat, fever when stooping and coldness when rising. Heat of skin causes great restlessness at night. Fever with anxiety. Fever often temporarily better drinking cold water. External heat with yellow skin.

PHARMACY - merc-cy. Mercurius cyanatus. Mercury cyanide. Bicyanide of Mercury. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anorexia. Aphthae. Bilious. Coldness. Cyanosis. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Edema. Enteric fever. Hoarseness. Hemorrhages. Keratitis syphilitica. Nausea. Nephritis. Phlebitis. Pneumonia.Prostration. Salivation. Throat, sore. Twitching. Typhoid. Ulcers. Varicosis. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-cy. is a valuable remedy for toxemia of acute infections, diseases, especially diphtheria, when there is early rapid and extreme prostration with cyanosis, coldness and tremors. Its :ction is similar to that of toxins in infectious diseases. Acute infections. Great and rapid prostration. Livid states from great struggling, where suffocation is imminent and paralysis of lung threatening, great sweat. Rapid local destruction. Syphilitic ulcers when a perforation is threatening. Putridity. Hemorrhages of dark fluid blood. Twitching and jerking of muscles. Affects most prominently the mouth, throat and larynx. Typhoid pneumonia. Cyanosis, rapid respiration and heart action. Malignant diphtheria with prostration. Efficient prophylactic in diphtheria. Coldness and nausea. Nephritis. Albuminuria. MIND - Great excitement, fits of passion. Fury. Talkativeness. Frequent spells of unconsciousness.

Head - Atrocious headaches, worse night.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, fixed. Injected and staring eyes, with barking cough at night.

Nose - Profuse nosebleed, dark blood, several times a day.

Face - Face pale. Food - Thought of food causes retching. Anorexia. Solids are swallowed better than liquids, which escape through nose. Milk relieves in general. Excessive ill-humor, after eating a little too much.

Mouth - Astringent taste. Fetor of breath. Free salivation. Aphthae on tongue and lips, with a thick, yellowish white scab. Very painful, forming ulcers. Ulcerations of mouth with agray membrane. Pain and swelling of salivary glands. Edema of soft palate. Gums swollen and covered with a white, adherent layer, under which is found a violet border.

Throat - Intense redness of fauces. Feels raw and sore. Looks raw in spots, especially in public speakers. Hoarseness and talking is very painful. Swallowing very difficult, cutting pain on swallowing. Much thick grayish membrane in the throat. Mucus membranes broken down, ulcerated. Necrotic destruction of soft parts of palate andfauces. Septic diphtheria. Diphtheria of the larynx and nose (Kali-bi.). Tonsils enlarged. Dark blood from nose.

Stomach - Early and complete anorexia. Incessant hiccough. Thought of food causes retching. Nausea. Bilious, bloody vomiting.

Abdomen - Painful, tender to pressure. Back - Constricting, between scapula.

Rectum - Redness around anus. Intolerable pain. Frequent diarrhea preceded by severe colic. Stools are offensive, green, slimy, bloody and black. Discharge of fetid liquid with gangrenous odor. Frequent hemor- rhage. stools with tenesmus.

Heart - Weak.

Limbs - Varicose veins with great tenderness of leg (left). Cold limbs. Lungs - Cutting pain in larynx. Croupy cough, causes suffocation. Hoarseness, talking painful.

Skin - Moist and cold skin.

Modalities - Better milk. Worse from speaking. Worse swallowing. Worse after eating.

Tongue - Aphthae on tongue. Tongue pale with yellowish streak on base. Tongue swollen, edges red, tip dark red. Tongue dark red, almost black. COMMENTS - When Dr. Alexander Villers was an infant, he had diphtheria. Known remedies had failed to arrest the disease. His father, Dr. Dominic von Villers, was in despair. Taking counsel with his friend, Dr. Beck (of Monthly in Switzerland), the latter was struck with the likeness of the case to the effects of Merc-cy. in some poisoning cases, reports of which he had just been reading and he suggested the remedy. A small quantity of the salt was procured and a potency was rapidly made and administered. Improvement soon set in and recovered followed. Alexander Villers, saved by Merc-cy., lived to do brilliant work with the same remedy when practicing in St. Petersburg. Merc-cy. has taken a sure place at the head of remedies for diphtheria, and as an efficient prophylactic in diphtheria cases. Villers had better results with the 30c than with any lower potency. In the sensational New York poisoning case of February, 1899, Mr. Henry C. Barnett, the victim, was treated for diphtheria by his doctors before the cause of the illness was discovered. Nash reported as particularly indicating it a chronic sore throat of public speakers with rawness in spots and abroken-down appearance, as if about to ulcerate and the feeling that “it hurts the patient to speak.” Diphtheria membrane in throat, mouth and at anus. Swallowing is impossible or causes severe cutting pains. Thought of food causes retching. Beck noted the extreme feebleness, trembling, syncope. Profound prostration. Icy coldness, general coldness with nausea. Dark and persistent hemorrhage. Varicose veins with great tenderness on left leg. Cyanosis. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arum-t., Caust., Hep., Kali-bi., Phyt., Echi., Lach., Gels. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Nephritis with great debility and chilliness. Suppression of urine. Amber colored urine, very painful, albuminous, scanty.

Perspiration - Moisture, sweat with icy coldness of skin. Profuse, sticky sweat on upper half of body. Cold sweat on forehead and cheek.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cold drinks, worse from acids..
constitution: Aphthae. Blepharitis. Catarrh. Cirrhosis. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ear, disorders. Eustachian, catarrh. Gastro- malachia. Glue ear. Jaundice. Meningitis. Nausea. Otitis media. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Pleurisy. Prostatitis. Swimmer's ear. Throat, sore. Ulcers. Vomiting.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Blepharitis. Catarrh. Cirrhosis. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ear, disorders.…
full:
PHARMACY - merc-d. Mercurius dulcís. Calomel. Mercurous chloride. Subchloride of mercury. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Blepharitis. Catarrh. Cirrhosis. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ear, disorders. Eustachian, catarrh. Gastro- malachia. Glue ear. Jaundice. Meningitis. Nausea. Otitis media. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Pleurisy. Prostatitis. Swimmer's ear. Throat, sore. Ulcers. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-d. is responsible for a large amount of the mercury treatments of the past and for some of the present. As a comparatively mild and slow-aching form of mercurial, it has none of the corrosive effects Merc-c., but it has all the power of the metal in it, and it has had its own share of disasters. It was at one time almost the only recognized remedy for constipation and any affection that could be ascribed to the liver. Some homeopaths adopted a modification of this by prescribing Merc-d. lx in two-or three-grain doses as a direct purgative. As Merc-d. has caused both constipation and diarrhea, it is probable that the action is roughly homeopathic. Keynote pallor, “pale as a corpse.” A flabby, bloated appearance, ill nourished. Pale mucus membranes. Catarrhal inflammation of the ear. Eustachian catarrh and deafness (Kali-m.). Glue ear. Swimmer's ear infection. Diarrhea with soreness of anus. Prostatitis. Inflammation with peritonitis, meningitis, pleurisy. Flabby, bloated and turgid flac- cidity. Indicated in remittent bilious fevers in peritonitis and meningitis. Biliary stasis. For scrofulous children who are liable to remittent bilious attacks. Pale, scrofulous children who have swelling of cervical and other glands. MIND - Bilious temperament. Moody, gloomy and irritable. Nervous, restlessness and agitated. Apprehensive. Anxiety about health. Hypochondriasis. Fear of impending disease. Whimpering. Desire to be silent, taciturn.

Head - Painful scalp. Heaviness across forehead. Falling off of hair.

Eyes - Irido-choroiditis. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Ciliary blepharitis. Eyes, red, dry. Gummy secretion on edges of lids, later, smarting and indistinct vision. Closure of lachrymal duct. Rapid winking. Symptoms worse after exercise and when heated from exercise.

Ears - Otitis media. Scrofulous otitis. Ear troubles of scrofulous children. Sudden fluttering. Itching in externa) meatus. Closore of eustachian tubes. Eustachian catarrh (Kali-m.). Eardrum retracted, thickened and immovable. Glue ear. Swimmer's ear infection. Deafness, occasioned by a swelling, which compresses eustachian tube. Deafness from every cold of old age. Deafness of old age.

Nose - Blows lumps of mucus from nose. Dry, crusted nostrils. Sore right nostril. Violent nosebleed.

Face - Face flushed, pale as a corpse. Swelling of cheeks. Exfoliation of lower jaw and death.

Mouth - Offensive breath, salivation, sore gums. Constant flow of dark, fetid, putrid saliva, very offensive. Ulceration of throat with dysphagia. Granular pharyngitis. Aphthae on tongue. Tongue indented indurated, black. Ulcers in mouth, bleeding throughout night. Difficult to open mouth.

Throat - Excessive ulceration of throat. Difficulty of swallowing. COMMENTS - Blocked Eustachian tubes. Eustachian catarrh (Kali-m.) and deafness. Otitis media with closure of Eustachian tubes. Scrofulous inflammation in general, particularly of the eyes. Peritonitis. Soreness around the anus. Hale noted its use in dropsies due to combined kidney and cardiac diseases, especially with jaundice. Cirrhosisofthe liver, especially in the hypertrophic form. Calomel in old-school practice rapidly resolved and cured a violent meningitis with wild delirium in a girl of five. In this case there was probably plastic exudation on the membranes. Inflammation with plastic exudation. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Hep. Compare: (1) Kali-m., Hydr. (2) In stringy stools, Sul- ac. (3) Catarrhal inflammation of middle ear, eustachian tube closed, deafness of old age, Kali-m. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - No appetite. Urgent thirst. Weight and pain at epigastrium. Nausea and vomiting. Cyclic vomiting of infants (Cupr-ar., Iris.).

Abdomen - Violent pain in abdomen, griping, tenderness. Bloated, hot, painful abdomen.

Rectum - Obstinate constipation. Anus is sore and burning. Condylomata around anus. Tenesmus, constant disposition to stool. Dysentery, small stools of mucus and blood, covered with bile. Diarrhea with vomiting.

Stool - Dysentery, small stools of mucus and blood, covered with bile. Black stools with great epigastric oppression, sinking. Stools scanty, bloody mucus, with bile, and constant desire, without tenesmus. Stools coppery green, like chopped eggs. Dark green, watery stools, with griping. Acrid, grass-green diarrhea of infants, without tenesmus. Watery stools, colorless, or as if mixed with flocculent matter, or like washings of meat, occurring most often at night.

Male - Acute inflammation of prostate after suppressed gonorrhea. Burning, pressing pains. Stinging and itching just back of corona glandis. Intense dysuria, urine scanty.

Female - Broad, moist and burning condylomata around external genitals, perineum and anus of exceedingly offensive smell.

Chest - Great oppression in chest and heart. Constitutions - Pale, scrofulous children, who have swelling of cervical and other glands.

Back - Swelling of cervical glands.

Limbs - Rheumatic stiffness and catching pain in muscles of legs and knee joints. Cramps in calves at night. Trembling of hands and feet.

Skin - Flabby and ill nourished. Swollen glands. Desquamation of skin, especially of hands and feet. Copper- colored eruptions. Phagedenic ulcers with white bases and painful and inflamed margins in mouth, palate, face, genital and other parts.

Modalities - Better from cold drinks, worse from acids.

Teeth - Violent burning in teeth. Teeth become bare, shake and fall out. Gums swollen and bleeding when touched.

Temperature - Feverish heat, profuse nocturnal sweat, tearing pains in limbs, prostration of strength and trembling. Fever, sometimes hot, putrid.

name: Mercurius Iodatus Flavus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air. Tired feeling in all limbs better lying on right side. Worse cold and damp weather, spring. Worse night, before 1 a.m., on waking, rest, lying on left side, warmth of bed, warm room. Worse raising up, touch, pressure, odors, warm drinks. Faint feeling worse at church..
constitution: Blepharitis. Breast, tumors. Catarrh. Chancre. Crusta lactea. Diphtheria. Eyes, disorders. Goiter. Intra-ocular disorders. Leucorrhea. Ozaena. Pregnancy, vomiting. Scabies. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Toothache. Writer’s cramp.

PHARMACY - merc-i-f. Mercurius iodatus flavus. Mercury iodide. Mercurius protoio- datus. Green iodide of mercury. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Blepharitis. Breast, tumors. Catarrh. Chancre. Crusta lactea. Diphtheria. Eyes, disorders. Goiter. Intra-ocular disorders. Leucorrhea. Ozaena. Pregnancy, vomiting. Scabies. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Toothache. Writer’s cramp.

HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-i-f. has had a valuable proving that developed adistinct individuality based on the general Merc, characteristics. Some symptoms of Merc-i-f. are very similar to Lyc, and Lyc. relieved some of the symptoms of the proving. The right-to-left direction was manifested in the throat and chest symptoms, but, unlike those of Lyc., the throat symptoms were worse by warm drinks. Merc-i-f. has a strong affinity for glands of the throat, lymphatic and breasts. Throat disorders with greatly swollen glands and a characteristic coating of tongue. Sore throat, worse on the right side. Much accumulation of tenacious mucus in the throat. Characteristic thick yellow coat at the base of the tongue, anterior part clean and red. Chancre induration remains a long time. Cervical and parotid glands enormously swollen. Goiter. Swollen inguinal glands, large and hard. Breasts tumors with tendency to much warm perspiration and gastric disturbances. Pains in the eyes and orbits. Farrington mentioned “corneal ulcers looking as if they had been chipped out by finger-nail.” Deep bone pains especially at night. Syphilis. MIND - Capricious. Mood is changeable, variable. Moody and depressed. Anxiety. Full of cares and worries. Fear in narrow places, claustrophobia. Fear of suffocation. Confusion in warm room, better walking in open air. Confusion of mind, worse on waking. Indolence, aversion to work. Irritability during pain. Destructiveness, can scarcely resist temptation to throw lamp through window. Lively, merry, talkative. Elated. Loquacity.

Head - Catarrh of frontal sinuses, with offensive discharge. Dull frontal headache with pain at the root of nose. Throbbing, bursting sensation in temples. Shooting or sharp pains in temple. Soreness and stiffness in occiput. Headache better when mind and body actively engaged. Head pain follows heart pain. Itching of scalp, worse at night.

Eyes - Dark circles around the eyes. Keratitis, cornea looks scratched or chipped out by fingernail. Photophobia. Throbbing, aching pains at night. Pannus. Ptosis, alternating with dimness of sight of left eye. Granular lids. Swelling below right eye.

Ears - Sudden, sharp pain in ears, worse touch. Throbbing, boring pains from within outward, deep in left ear.

Nose - Mucus descends through posterior sinuses into the throat, causing hawking. Thick plugs of nasal secretion, with severe frontal headache. Chronic catarrh of posterior nares. Nostrils dilated with every inspiration. Shooting pain at root of nose, worse morning in waking.

Face - Dull aching and soreness in bones of face. Stinging pain in left cheek.

Mouth - Bad taste in mouth. Coppery smell from mouth. Mouth, lips and tongue dry and sticky. Fine bright red eruption on roof of mouth. Stiffness of jaws, with inability to open mouth.

Throat - Sore throat, goesfrom right to left. Swelling begins on right side. Tonsillitis. Tonsils swollen, better cold drinks. When only the superficial part of the tonsils is involved. Constant inclination to swallow. Sensation of a lump. Small ulcers on posterior pharynx. Easily detached patches on inflamed pharynx and fauces, worse on right tonsil, much tenacious mucus. Cheesy exudates with offensive breath. Goiter with suffocation.

Stomach - Weak empty feeling in stomach. Burning at stomach with pain as from a blow. Sharp pain worse pressure. Cutting pain with nausea and inclination to vomit. Nausea at the sight or odor of food. Persistent nausea. Nausea with dizziness and suffocation about heart. Morning sickness.

Abdomen - Pain in abdomen with pain in heart. Hardness of abdomen, as from flatulence. Faint sick feeling in hypogas- trium before stools. Burning at umbilicus as from a hot coal, worse when inspiring. Indolent buboes.

Rectum - Diarrhea or discharge of fetid flatus, preceded by cutting, colicky pains. Frequent urging to stool. Black discharges with or without stools. Stools tough, almost like putty, with much straining. Stools thin, light- yellowish brown, frothy, soft, copious, dark.

Male - Hard chancres, painless, with enlarged inguinal glands, not disposed to suppuration. Dreams of urination followed by seminal emission of which he knew nothing.

Female - Yellow leucorrhea of very young girls. Copious, muco-purulent discharge from vagina. Food - Appetite variable, worse sweets. Excessive thirst for cold water, sour drinks.

Heart - Pains in heart, preceded by headache. Suffocation about heart with nausea and dizziness. Palpitations with dyspnea, worse lying on back. Feeling as if heart had jumped out of its place. Pulse weak, irregular and labored.

Back - Sharp pain in back. Neck stiff. Bruised feeling over entire scapular region. Throbbing pain between scapula. Breasts - Breast tumors with knots in axilla, blueness of the part, warm perspiration and gastric disturbances. Causations - Cold draft when perspiring. Cold, damp weather, spring. Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous and syphilitic patients, to mucus surfaces covered with squamous epithelium, to effects of drafts while perspiring.

Limbs - Excessive tired feeling of all limbs. Heaviness of limbs with indolence and drowsiness. Knees numb. Laming pain in right arm worse writing. Pain in right forearm with pain in left hip.

Sleep - Sleeplessness without restlessness. Restless sleep from constant itching. Amorous dreams. Frightful dreams, nightmares. Dreams that he must urinate.

Skin - Troublesome itching over whole body, worse at night. Persistent itching spots over whole body. Bright red, fine eruption on chest and abdomen. Flat warts.

Modalities - Better from open air. Tired feeling in all limbs better lying on right side. Worse cold and damp weather, spring. Worse night, before 1 a.m., on waking, rest, lying on left side, warmth of bed, warm room. Worse raising up, touch, pressure, odors, warm drinks. Faint feeling worse at church.

Teeth - Desire to clench the teeth, jaw is stiff and tired from grinding, pain in teeth during sleep. Teeth sensitive, worse heat, cold and sweets. Teeth feel too long, cannot eat. Toothache after filling. Pyorrhea.

Tongue - Tongue coated moist filmy. Tongue coated thickly, yellow at the base. Tip and edges may be red and take imprint of teeth. Vertigo - Faint or dizzy on rising from a chair or when reading. Vision - Impaired vision with weakness of internal recti. Diplopia on holding eyes to left for some time. Distant objects look blurred. Black clouds float before eyes when lying on left side. COMMENTS - Merc-i-f. a right-sided (Merc- i-r. is left-sided). Conditions can move from right to left. Characteristic concomitants including a heart pain immediately followed by a head pain, simultaneous pain in right forearm and left hip, and pain in heart with pain in abdomen. Useful for abscessed tonsils, tonsillitis. Sore throats on one side with salivation and sweating (Merc-i-r.). Swollen glands and sores in the mouth (Phyt.). The teeth feel too long, worse by closing the jaws. Irresistible desire to clench the teeth. Jaw is stiff and muscles tired from clenching teeth in sleep. Faint, sick feeling in hypogastrium. Nausea at the sight of food. Black stools. A cough worse by laughing. For conditions from the removal of mercury amalgams, particularly severe fatigue or recurring infections. Kent mentioned the cure of “an ulcerated indurated lump in breast, as large as a goose's egg with knots in axilla, blueness of the part and no hope.” Merc-i-f. 100c, given as often as the pains were severe, cured. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Hep., palpitations, Lyc. Compare: (1) Plb-i. - in breast tumors. (2) Right to left, Lyc. (Merc-i-r. to right). (3) Nausea in hypogastrium, Puls. (4) Black stools, Lept. (5) Cough worse laughing, Arg-n. (6) Pains all around orbit, Cinnb. (7) Worse warm drinks and empty swallowing, Lach. Thick yellow coating at base of tongue, Kali-bi. (Nat-p. golden yellow, Nat-s. dirty or greenish gray). (8) Worse lying left side, Phos., Am., Spig. - opposite Merc., which has worse lying right side. Follows well: Lach, (scarlatina). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Urine, copious, dark red, scanty.

name: Mercurius Iodatus Ruber
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Open air ameliorates the head symptoms. Getting warm, walking ameliorates deafness. Worse empty swallowing, swallowing food, after dinner. Worse touch, pressure, after sleep, afternoon and evening. Worse weather changes, cold air, cold washing, getting wet, washing floor..

Parotiditis. Postnasal catarrh. Quinsy. Rheumatism. Spleen, enlarged. Syphilis. Testicles, enlargement. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Typhus fever.

CLINICAL - Adenitis. Antrum, pain. Asthma. Buboes. Chancres. Coryza. Diphtheria. Eczema. Eye, inflammation. Hemorrhoids.…
full:
PHARMACY - merc-i-r. Mercurius iodatus ruber. Mercury bin-iodide. Mercurius biniodatus. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies, third trituration.

CLINICAL - Adenitis. Antrum, pain. Asthma. Buboes. Chancres. Coryza. Diphtheria. Eczema. Eye, inflammation. Hemorrhoids. Laryngitis. Liver, syphilis. Malaria. Nose, polyps. Nose, diseased bones. Parotiditis. Postnasal catarrh. Quinsy. Rheumatism. Spleen, enlarged. Syphilis. Testicles, enlargement. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Typhus fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Merc-i-r. acts on cellular tissue. Affects the lymphatic glands, throat, but more on the left side (Merc-i-f., right side). Wandering rheumatic pains with weariness. Much hard glandular swelling. Chronic suppurating buboes. Hard chancres. Old cases of syphilis in scrofulous patients. Diphtheria and ulcerated sore throats, especially on left side with much glandular swelling. Early cases of cold, especially in children. Oppressed breathing. Cases have been recorded in which small doses of Merc-i-r. 3x or 2x have cut short an attack of asthma or, if taken at bed-time, have prevented an expected attack from developing during the night. MIND - Restlessness, nervousness. Better from occupation, diversion. Ill humor. Disposed tocry. Anxiety during sleep. Confusion of mind. Delirium during fever, scarlatina. Indifference, apathy.

Head - Heat and pulsation in vertex, worse evening. Painfully heavy occiput Frontal region as if bound by the cord. Small pustules on head. Syphilitic tumors in brain.

Eyes - Inflammation with burning. Stream of hot, acrid tears, mixed with yellowish flakes of fibrinous material. Bright light irritates. Granular eyelids. Trachoma. Blepharitis marginalis. Old cases of pannus.

Ears - Itching in both ears. Pain in right ear. Increased earwax. Closure of eustachian tube, opens with a pop. Dull hearing, better evening. Deafness, better after becoming warm on walking.

Nose - Coryza with right side of nose hot and swollen. Hawks mucus from posterior sinuses. Boggy mucus membrane of nose and throat, closure of Eustachian tube, opening with a pop. Turbinated bones swollen.

Face - Slimy, sticky lips on waking. Eczema on chin. Scabs on right side of face. Pain in jaws and temples. Aching sore malar bones. Swelling of parotid glands.

Mouth - Profuse saliva. Scalded feeling on tongue. Tongue, wrinkled stiff at base, pains when moving. Aphthae. Gums swollen. Toothache. Lips slimy and sticky on waking. Lips stick together during headache. Glands swollen.

Throat - Fauces dark red, swallowing painful. Diphtheria. Sore throat, goes from left to right side. Tonsils greatly swollen, worse on leftside. Submaxillary glands painfully engorged. Parenchymatous tonsillitis. Cough with sore throat. Phlegm in nose and throat. Disposition to hawk with sensation of a lump in throat. Hawks much mucus from posterior sinuses. Laryngeal troubles with aphonia. Uvula elongated. Stiffness of muscles of throat and neck. Vertigo - Vertigo, things seem to reel around her. Vertigo during influenza. COMMENTS-The liver, spleen and pancreas are affected and also the bladder and male sexual organs. Wandering rheumatism. Headaches, worse in open air. Eyes worse by bright light, psoric eye disorders. Right side of nose is inflamed. Troublesome dreams. Will often abort peri-tonsillitis if given frequently. It acts well in old cases of syphilis, particularly in persons of lax tissue, scrofulous and those who have taken much mercury. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Hep. Compare: (1) In syphilitic eruptions, Bad., Carb-an., Nit-ac. (2) Ophthalmia, Jeqol. (3) Wandering rheumatism, Kali-bi. (4) worse after sleep, left to right. Lach. (5) Dreams of water, Merc- i-f.. (6) In disorders of antrum, Mag-c., Merc-c. Compatible after: Bell. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Pain in pit on pressure. Sinking at stomach and pit, with general sick feeling. Loud and bitter belching. Nausea while passing diarrheic stool.

Abdomen - Distended abdomen about navel, with pain on pressure. Heavy, painful feeling in region of liver, pancreas and spleen. Sudden cutting, in region of liver. Sore feeling all over bowels. Enlarged malarial spleens and livers. Inflammation of inguinal glands.

Male - Sharp shooting, in end of penis through glans. Nocturnal emissions. Sensitiveness of right testicle and cord. Sarcocele of testicles. Threatened gangrene of glans in paraphimosis. Stubborn suppurating buboes. Hard chancres.

Female - Profuse, acrid, green, yellowish leucorrhea. Stony hard fibroids. Food - Desires food more salted.

Chest - Constriction across chest. Sharp cutting pain in chest. Sticking pain in muscles of ribs. Suppuration of axillary glands.

Back - Stiff neck. Cervical adenitis. Spine sore and painful. Causations - Exposure to wet, weather changes.

Limbs - Wandering rheumatic pains, especially muscular. Pain from calf up to sacrum. Middle humerus as if about to break. Lungs - Catching pain under right breast, oppressing breathing. Asthma. Cough from elongated uvula with sore throat. Small quantity of loose, whitish, slimy sputum, with cough. Profuse, yellow mucus. Hoarseness on getting a little wet.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from pain in ulcerated throat. Restless sleep from 12 p.m. until morning, with constriction in diaphragm. Lascivious, frightful dreams. Dreams of swimming, traveling.

Skin - Syphilitic chancre and ulcers. Bubo. Hard papules. Pustules, with inflamed base, sore to touch. Freckles, liver spots. Lupus. Sarcocele. Small fissures and cracks. Moist cracks on palms. Chilblains.

Modalities - Open air ameliorates the head symptoms. Getting warm, walking ameliorates deafness. Worse empty swallowing, swallowing food, after dinner. Worse touch, pressure, after sleep, afternoon and evening. Worse weather changes, cold air, cold washing, getting wet, washing floor.

Kidneys - Ulcers in bladder. Urethra indurated. Frequent desire, can't retain urine for a moment. Increased flow of urine. Urine red, thick and dark when passing.

Perspiration - Copious, hot sweat. Night sweats.

Temperature - Intense shivering followed by fever. Chilly at bedtime. Chilliness, followed by flush over face. Flush of heat and feeling of being tickled.

name: Mercurius Nitrosus
author: Murphy
constitution: Cachexia. Condylomata. Delirium. Eyes, disorders. Gonorrhea. Herpes. Impetigo. Leprosy. Malaria. Mucus, patches. Ophthalmia. Photophobia. Psoriasis. Ringworm. Stupor. Symptoms. Syphilis. Vegetations.
