PHARMACY - merc-ns. Mercurius nitrosus. Mercury nitrate. Mercurius nitricus oxydu- latus. Liquor Hydrargyria. Nitratis acidus. Unguentum hydrargyria nitratis. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Cachexia. Condylomata. Delirium. Eyes, disorders. Gonorrhea. Herpes. Impetigo. Leprosy. Malaria. Mucus, patches. Ophthalmia. Photophobia. Psoriasis. Ringworm. Stupor. Symptoms. Syphilis. Vegetations.

HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic authority for Merc-ns. is Hansen, who considered its special indication sticking pains and sticking itching. Hansen said Donner commended it in syphilis of the nerves and bones. The symptoms are compiled from poisoning cases, including cachexia, tremors, frequent fainting, pains so intolerable he calls for a knife to kill himself. Coldness predominates, but there is the nitric acid flush of the face. Merc-ns. has achieved a reputation as “a stimulating application” to indolent ulcers to the eyelids in ophthalmia and in a variety of skin diseases such as herpes, ringworm, impetigo, leprosy, psoriasis, and rupia. Vegetations. Eye disorders with burning, sticking pains, photophobia and epiphora. Mucus patches with sticking pains. Gonorrhea with frequent burning, sticking itch on corona glandis and in the sulcus coronarius. MIND - Memory poor. Extreme anxiety. Delirious. Rolled on the ground with excessive pain and called for a knife to kill himself. Stupor approaching a narcotic state. RELATIONS - Compare: (l)Merc-d. in stinging and itching behind corona glandis. REFERENCES - Clarke. Hansen.

name: Mercurius Praecipitatus Albus Albus
author: Murphy
constitution: Blisters. Collapse. Dwarfism. Eczema, facial. Lachrymation. Nausea. Vesicles. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - merc-pr-a. Mercurius prae- cipitatus albus. White precipitate of mercury. Mercuric ammonium chloride. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Collapse. Dwarfism. Eczema, facial. Lachrymation. Nausea. Vesicles. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The…
full:
PHARMACY - merc-pr-a. Mercurius prae- cipitatus albus. White precipitate of mercury. Mercuric ammonium chloride. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Collapse. Dwarfism. Eczema, facial. Lachrymation. Nausea. Vesicles. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Merc- pr-a. are taken entirely from poisonings. The most peculiar symptoms are a green tongue, bilious stools scalding anus. Slight subsultus. Collapse. A child who was poisoned with 20 grains underwent a remarkable change one night. In the morning the child has changed to the appearance of an old man. During the night the child shrieked as from great pain. Mossa related a case of chronic eczema of the face in an elderly man, a moistening eruption, worse in winter and from exposure to cold, vesicles on a reddened, swollen skin, dry into scales which exfoliate. Eyelids, especially the lower, edematous, the corners are reddened, lachrymation. Ears involved, itching and burning on head preventing sleep. Merc-pr-a. 3 grains every third day was given. First the burning itching ceased. Then formation of blisters abated. Exfoliation continued a long time, but the skin finally became normal. In another case, a girl, 2, had an eruption on face and large part of scalp, covered with thick yellow crust, matter exuding from cracks. Offensive odor, swollen cervical glands. Merc-pr-a. 3 grains once in three days cured in four weeks.

Face - Very flushed, greatly swollen.

Mouth - Tongue coated with thick greenish fur. Gums much swollen.

Stomach - Urgent thirst. Much pain at stomach. Nausea and vomiting. Vomits deeply blood-stained fluid. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dwarfish children, Bar-c., Care. Syph. (2) Eczema, Mez., Aethi-a. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Pain in epigastrium, gradually spreading over whole abdomen. Great pain in abdomen, continuing after taking any, even liquid, food. Constant griping. Whole abdomen painful to pressure.

Rectum - One copious stool with mucus shreds in some quantities, much dark blood. Numerous scanty stools with much blood. Almost pure bile causing great scalding of anus.

Sleep - Drowsy, semi-comatose.

Perspiration - Cold, clammy skin, much congestion of cutaneous vessels. General perspiration.

name: Mercurius Praecipitatatus Ruber
author: Murphy
constitution: Anus, burning. Barber's, itch. Blepharitis. Chancroid. Chemosis. Colic. Convulsions. Cramps. Diarrhea. Folliculitis. Gonorrhea. Mucus, patches. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Pemphigus, neonatorum. Phagedenic, ulcer. Salivation. Trembling. Ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - merc-pr-r. Mercurius praecipitatus ruber. Red precipitate of mercury. Red oxide of mercury. Mercuriusoxydatus. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anus, burning. Barber's, itch. Blepharitis. Chancroid. Chemosis. Colic. Convulsions. Cramps.…
full:
PHARMACY - merc-pr-r. Mercurius praecipitatus ruber. Red precipitate of mercury. Red oxide of mercury. Mercuriusoxydatus. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anus, burning. Barber's, itch. Blepharitis. Chancroid. Chemosis. Colic. Convulsions. Cramps. Diarrhea. Folliculitis. Gonorrhea. Mucus, patches. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Pemphigus, neonatorum. Phagedenic, ulcer. Salivation. Trembling. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - This intensely irritating mercurial was investigated by Hahnemann, all the usual mercurial symptoms were intensified. Merc-pr-r. has produced suffocative attacks at night on lying down at the point of falling asleep. Patient is obliged to jump up suddenly, which relieves. Convulsions. Spasmodic contraction of limbs. Cramps of internal organs and in legs. General trembling. Gonorrhea, urethra felt as a hard string. Chancroid, phagedenic ulcer and bubo. Pemphigus, mucus patches. Eczema with cracks and fissures. Barber's itch. Blepharitis internally and externally. Leaden heaviness in occiput with otorrhea. MIND - Apprehension.

Eyes - Fierce intent look. Chemosis. Blepharitis.

Face - Dropsical condition of face. Remarkable redness of face and eyes. Cheeks and lips enormously swollen.

Mouth - Strong mercurial odor. Profuse salivation. Blood and saliva of the most fetid odor flowed constantly from mouth. Inside of mouth coated with a substance like decayed cheese. Mouth very sore, flakes of epithelium separate. Burning in mouth and throat, pains prevent sleep. Itching over whole mouth without saliva- tion. Inflamed gums. Anterior portion of mucus membrane of cheeks, gums and under the tongue sloughed away and four teeth were lost in the process. As the parts healed the jaws became completely closed by contracting scars.

Throat - Throat inflamed. Burning like hot ashes on swallowing the powder.

Stomach - Unquenchable thirst. Pains in stomach and whole abdomen. Agonizing pain in stomach with burning heat and nausea. Nausea, vomiting. Vomiting, with cutting in abdomen, black blood, bloody mucus, followed by diarrhea.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended and painful to contact. Occasional pain in left hypochondrium. Agonizing colic.

Rectum - Constant urging, gradually became worse and spread over whole intestinal canal, with constant sensation in anus as of a glowing hot iron moving up and down. Most excessive tenesmus with scanty discharge of blood with cutting and burning pains. Diarrhea excessively violent with violent cramps. Stools mainly blood involuntary, greenish and offensive.

Heart - Violent palpitations that seemed as if it would burst the chest. Small, hard pulse. Lungs - Larynx inflamed and swollen, even outside. Paroxysms of suffocation at night on lying down and while falling asleep, obliged to jump up suddenly, when it disappeared. Oppression of chest.

Tongue - Tongue enormously swollen and protruding. Tongue was reduced and firmly adherent to floor of mouth and cheeks. Two holes in tongue. COMMENTS - Hansen used Merc-pr-r. in practice and gave as indications gonorrhea when the urethra is felt as a hard string. Phagedenic ulcer and bubo. Indurated ulcer, deep with red, hard edges and especially when spreading. Syphilitic iritis when the pains have ceased. Pemphigus neonatorum and intertrigo syphilitica. Sensation “as of a hot iron in anus moving up and down.” Mucus patches on scrotum and by anus with or without fissures. Eczema, acute or chronic, much sero-purulent or purulent exudation, also externally (in ointment 1 to 40 of prepared lard). Tinea tonsurans, circinata and sycosis. Folliculitis. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Merc-pr-a. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hansen.

Temperature - Cold, perspiring skin.

name: Mercurius Solublis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from moderate temperature, in morning. Better from sex, rest, scratching. Worse drafts, taking cold. touching anything cold, cloudy weather, damp, rainy weather, wet feet. Worse changing weather and temperature, heat, sweating, warmth of bed, warm days with damp, cool nights, Fall. Worse at night, lying on right side, bending forward, during and after urination, before stool..

full:
PHARMACY - mere. Mercurius solublis hahnemanni. Mercurius vivus. Quicksilver. Argentum vivum. Mercurius oxydulatus niger. Hydrargyrum. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Anemia. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Balanitis. Bone, disorders. Brain inflammation. Breath offensive. Bronchitis. Bubo. Cancrum oris. Catarrh. Chancre. Chickpox. Colds. Condylomata. Congestion. Coryza. Coughs. Dentition, abnormal Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Ecthyma. Ear, infections. Eczema. Emaciation. Excoriation. Eyes, disorders. Fainting. Fevers. Fissures. Glandular, swellings. Gout. Gum-boil. Gum, disorders. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Hydrophobia. Jaundice. Joints, disor ders. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Mania. Measles. Melancholy. Meningitis. Mucous, patches. Mumps. Odors, offensive. Osteomalacia. Otitis, media. Ovaries, disorders. Pancreatitis.ñwÁinson's disease. Parotiditis. Peritonitis.Perspiration. Phimosis. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostate, disorders. Purpura. Pyemia. Ranula. Rheumatism. Rickets. Rigg's, disease. Salivation. Scurvy. Sinusitis. Smallpox. Sores. Stomatitis. Suppurations. Surgical, fever. Syphilis. Taste, disordered. Teeth, disorders. Throat, sore. Tongue, affections. Tongue, mapped. Toothache. Tremors. Typhus fever. Ulcers. Vaccination. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - There was a fitness in naming this metal after the mutable planet Mercury. It provides us with weatherglasses and thermometers and likewise it turns those who are under its influence into weather- glasses and thermometers. Hahnemann invented Mercurius solublis in his pre-homeopathic days in response to a general desire for a mercurial preparation which should be at once soluble and noncorrosive and it at once took its place in the pharmacy, a place it has never lost. The method of developing the medicinal power of metallic mercury by graduated trituration was a later discovery, through there was a suggestion of it in the well-known Hydrargyrum cum cretâ. Although Hahnemann proved Mercurius solublis, he recommended the use of triturations of the pure metal in practice as being the simplest mercurial preparation and more easily obtained and equally available with Merc. The potencies are prepared from soluble black oxide of mercury, originally prepared by Hahnemann from pure metallic mercury. There is no difference between the symptoms of these preparations, but it seems that when Merc, solublis fails, when indicated, Merc, vivus acts. Hahnemann recommended Merc, vivus as a superior preparation for homeopathic prescribing in his preface to the proving. No pains have been taken to keep distinct Merc, solublis and Merc, vivus. Merc, is Hahnemann's typical antisyphilitic remedy, as Sulph. is the typical anti-psoric and Thuj. the typical anti-sycotic. Every organ and tissue of the body is more or less affected by this powerful drug. It transforms healthy cells into decrepit, inflamed and necrotic wrecks, decomposes the blood, producing a profound anemia. Lesions, similartothoseofsyphilis. Hereditary syphilis manifestations. Often indicated in the secondary stage of syphilis when there i s febrile anemia, rheumatoid pains and ulcerations. Ulcerations of the mucus membranes, especially of mouth and throat. Lymphatic glands are enlarged, glandular activity increase, especially of salivary and mucus glands. Livid congestions. Destructive inflammations of bones, cellular tissues, and joints. Strictures after inflammation. Indurations. Rheumatism. Sycosis, scrofula, bullae. Suppurations, tendency to formation of pus, which is thin, greening, putrid, streaked with blood. Breath, discharges smell foul. Secretions are watery, thin, slimy, acrid, burning, foul or thick greenish-yellow. Y ellowness of eyes, teeth, nasal discharges. Biliousness, jaundice. Tremors, convulsions. Tremblings, twitchings, disorderly motions of paralyzed parts. Cataleptic rigidity of the body. Parkinson's disease. Paraplegia. Contraction of joints. Burning, stinging pains. Painful exostoses. Softening of the bones. Weakness with ebullitions and tremblings from least exertion. Exhausted and ready to sink down, worse after stools. Restless and sweaty, complaints increase with sweat and rest, and are associated with a great deal of weariness, prostration and trembling. Everything seems too short. Redness. Swellings, edema, continued exudations. Parts are much swollen with raw, sore feeling. Profuse, oily perspiration does not relieve. Salt-lips, taste, expectoration etc. Stomatitis. Emaciation, marasmus. A human thermometer, extreme sensitivity to heat and cold. Worsefrom any change of temperature or weather. Catches colds easily. Hypersensitive to external impressions. Unstable and variable in mental and physical behavior, tremulous, weak and sweaty. MIND - Changes their mind constantly. Instability of ideas, which constantly drive away each other. Irresolution. Precocious. Restlessness, is constantly changing from place to place, especially at night. Uncontrollable desire to travel far away. Heedless. Weak memory, forgets everything. Hurried speech. Stammering, nervous with tremors. Slow in answering questions. Continuous moaning and groaning. Great anguish. Apprehensive. Mistrustful, suspicious. Thinks he is losing his reason. Anxiety, anguish, trembling and sweat. Senses impending evil. Thinks he will die. Fear with desire to escape. Fearof robbers. Involuntary weeping. Ailments from fright, leaving one in a state of great anxiety, worse at night. Moral dejection, with great listlessness, discouragement. Weary of life. Loss of will power. Poor self- confidence. Disgust. Dread of labor. Indifference to everything, does not even care to eat. Indifference to loved ones. Homesickness. Cheerful alternating with want of sympathy. Ill-humor, disposition to be angry and to fly into a passion. Complaining of relations and surroundings. Agitation with excessive internal torment, as if conscious of having committed some crime. Quarrelsome, mistrustful, and suspicious. Raving. Delirium, mental derangement of alcoholics. Confusion, loses his way in well-known streets. Weakness of memory for time. Time passes slowly. Delusions that he is a criminal, that everyone is an enemy. Confusion and vertigo in morning on waking. Loss of consciousness and of speech. Fury, with dread of liquids. Filthy in mind and body, does foolish, mischievous, disgusting actions. Inclination to catch passing strangers by the nose. Violent, horrid impulses, homicidal, suicidal. Suicidal thoughts during menses, better weeping. Desire to kill the person that contradicts her. Postpartum mania, wants to throw child on fire.

Head - Catarrhal headaches, much heat in head. Catarrhal affections of frontal and maxillary sinuses. Burning and pulsations in forehead. Tension about scalp, as if bandaged. One-sided, tearing pains. Headache with ear and toothache. Headache alternating with foot sweat. Headache caused by suppression of foot sweat. Headache with suicidal tendency. Child turns head from side to side and moans. External head painful to touch. Stinging, burning, fetid eruptions on scalp. Scalp tense, fetid, sour smelling, oily sweat on head. Itching of scalp day and night. Falling of hair from sides and temples. Exostosis with soreness. Anterior fontanels open. Cerebrospinal meningitis from suppressed otorrhea. Hydrocephalus, Cephalhematoma.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis from taking cold. Scanty or profuse, burning acrid discharge. Iritis with hypopion. Keratitis of syphilitic origin with burning pain. Retinitis when worse by firelight and at night. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Arcus senilis. Optic nerve and eye disorders in those who work in foundries. Pupils dilated. Burning in eyes. Stitches in eyes. Cutting, stinging or aching pains when exerting eyes. Eyes draw together. Lids, red, thick, swollen, scurfy and swollen. Agglutinated lids in morning. Lids spasmodically closed. Styes on upper lids. Twitching of lids. Photophobia, worse heat and glare of fire of foundry men. Eyes sensitive to extreme heat or cold.

Ears - Otitis media. Chronic ears infections. Soreness and excoriation of inner ears. Otorrhea, thick yellow discharge. Fetid and bloody discharges. Watery discharge and hemorrhage from ears. Very offensive pus from ear, worse at night. Swimmer's ear infection. Glue ear. Red, hot swelling of external ear. Pains, worse warmth of bed, at night. Sticking pains. Tearing and shooting pains. Pains extend to ear from teeth, throat etc. Sensation as if cold water running from the ear. Sensation of coldness in ears during pregnancy. Fungus excrescences. Polyps. Boils in external canal (Calc. pic.). Sounds vibrate in ears. Ringing and roaring. Whistling or running of trains. Deafness on becoming heated, better on swallowing and blowing nose.

Nose - Sinusitis and colds. Colds travel to eyes, ears or throat. Coryza profuse, fluent. Coryza, acrid discharge, but too thick to run down the lip, worse warm room. Coryza with sneezing, sore, raw, smarting sensation, worse damp weather. Copious discharge of corroding mucus. Yellow-green, fetid, pus-like discharge. Acrid nasal secretions having the odor of old cheese. Nostrils are raw, ulcerated. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Sneezing in sunshine. Pain and swelling of nasal bones and decay with greenish fetid ulceration. Nosebleed when coughing, blood hangs in dark coagulated strings. Nosebleed during sleep, at night.

Face - Pale, earthy, yellow, dirty looking. Puffy under eyes. Cheeks, swollen, red, hot. Syphilitic pustules on face. Mumps if suppuration threatens. Pimples on face. Corners of mouth ulcerated and painfully sore. Yellowish scabs around mouth. Swelling or cracking of upper lip. Lips, salty, dry, cracked in angles. Lips burn when touched. Swelling of cheeks during toothache. Aching in jaws. Spasms and immobility of jaws. Periostitis of jaw, progressing to necrosis. Masseter muscles contracted. Lockjaw from glandular swellings, with stinging pains. Aching in facial bones. Facial paralysis from cold. Trigeminal neuralgia from taking cold.

Mouth - Great thirst with moist mouth. Saliva increased, flows during sleep. Saliva yellow, bloody, bad tasting offensive. Salivation, with nausea, waking her from sleep. Sweetish taste. Metallic taste. Offensive,putridodor from mouth. Offensive breath during cough. Disagreeable, sweetish odor from mouth. Mucus membrane bluish-red and spongy. Sore pain on touch and from chewing. Itching palate. Ranula with salivation and sore gums. Confluent thrush. Aphthae. Stomatitis from chewing-gum. Painful ragged, swollen, bleeding gums. Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily. Gumboils. Speech difficult from trembling of tongue. Stammering. Loss of speech, replies by signs and grimaces.

Throat - Glands swell every time patient takes cold. Lymphatic glands of throat hard and large. Sore throats and colds. Sore, raw, smarting, burning throat. Putrid sore throat. Burning in throat, as from hot vapor ascending. Painful dryness of throat, with mouth full of saliva. Constant desire to swallow. Quinsy with difficult swallowing after pus has formed. Tonsillitis. Whitish, smeary concretions upon tonsils. Tonsils enlarged. Ulcers on tonsils, on pharynx. Bluish-red swelling. Stitches into ear on swallowing, fluids return through nose. Sensation as if a foreign object or something hanging in throat. Uvulaelongated, enlarged, greatly swollen. Ulcers and inflammation appearing at every change in weather. Hawks large lumps from throat. Complete loss of voice, from straining voice. Hoarse, rough voice, worse least current of air. Chronic hoarseness with tendency to sweat and profuse salivation. Aphonia from nervous paralysis.

Stomach - Stomach sensitive to touch. Feels constricted. Pit of stomach burns. Pressure in pit with deathly faintness. Heartburn all night. Heartburn during pregnancy. Frequenthiccoughs. Hiccough and regurgitation of water and food. Acrid, bitter, putrid or rancid eructations, worse at night. Nausea when coughing. Water collects in mouth, causes nausea and vomiting of a bitter substance. Inclination to vomit while coughing. Nausea and vomiting during stool. Vomiting of bile and food. Morning sickness with profuse salivation. Stools - Stools with pain and tenesmus. Never get done feeling. Stools, painful, scanty. Greenish, bloody and slimy stools, worse at night. Stools ashen white, gray, acrid, then tenesmus orchill. Mucus stools preceded by chilliness, and followed by tenesmus. Stools like stirred eggs, pea green, slimy. Stools watery and colorless, with greenish scum floating on surface of water. Stools acrid and excoriating, purulent. Stools undigested, sour smelling. Stools pitch-like, tenacious or crumbling. Stools small, knotty masses, small like sheep dung. Stools form a narrow ribbon.

Abdomen - Pressive pain in abdomen, as from a stone. Boring pain in right groin. External abdomen cold to touch. Stabbing pain with chilliness. Colic from cold. Violent colic, with cutting and stinging pains, better recumbent position. Flatulent distention with pain. Shaking sensation of bowels when walking. Bowels feel weak, holds them. Intestines feel bruised when lying on right side. Intestines as if they fall to side on which one is lying. Appendicitis, better lying on back. Catarrh of pancre- atic duct. Inguinal glands, pain on heavy pressure. Swelling of inguinal glands on taking cold. Inguinal glands swollen or suppurating. Buboes. Herpes zoster.

Rectum - Rectal tenesmus with tenesmus of bladder. Great pressure at stool, as if bowels would be forced out. Ineffectual urging to stool with protruding hemorrhoids, which are painfully sore. Rectal discharge accompanied by chilliness, sick stomach, cutting colic and tenesmus. Constipation. Dysentery. Purulent diar- rhea with chill between and hot flushes during stool. Long continued diarrhea. Diarrhea in children. Severe pain in anus, during stool. Never-get-done feeling. Rawness, burning and itching of anus and adjacent parts, after stool. Prolapse anus after stool. Constriction in rectum, causes faintness, after stool. Weakness after stool. Hemorrhage from rectum after urination. Discharge of ascarides and lumbrici. Sensations - Vibration in forehead. Head as if in a vice, as if growing large. Crackling in head as from metal plates. As if weight on forehead, as if weight hanging on to nose. As of sparks being emitted from eyes, as of a body underneath lids, as if feathers came from corners of eyes. As if a wedge driven in ear, as if ice in it, as if cold water running out of it. As if teeth were loose, were fixed in a mass of pap. As if hot vapors rising into throat of worm rising into throat, must swallow it down of apple core sticking in throat. As if everything in chest was dry. As if breasts would ulcerate.

Urine - Urine flows in a thin stream or only drop by drop. Urine hot, acrid, dark, scanty, albuminous. Urine thick, white sediment as if flour had been stirred in. Urine yellowish, staining diaper, smells sour and pungent. Urine, flesh-like lumps of mucus, pus. Painless hematuria. Urine remaining on parts after urinating cause intense itching, has to be washed off. Vertigo - Vertigo, worse lying on back, as if on a swing. Vertigo after stooping. Vertigo with headache and nausea. Vertigo with momentary loss of vision, everything turns black. Can't stand erect or even sit up in bed for fear of falling. Vision - Dim vision, with involuntary closing of eyes. Foggy vision. Black spots, flames, sparks before the eyes. Sees green colors. Constant flickering and floating black specks. Letters seem to move. Object as if small. Periodical loss of sight. Scotoma of right eye after a fall. COMMENTS - To the symptoms of Hahnemann's pathogenesis of Merc, solublis are added observed effects of mercury in those engaged in working with the metal, patients taking mercury, and the effects on those applying mercurial inunctions to patients. Many people have been severely affected by absorbing it through their hands. An electrician, who at one time was required to work with his hands frequently in a trough filled with quicksilver, thereafter could not bear the slightest shock of electricity, though before he could stand very strong ones. There is no difference between these effects and the symptoms of the proving so far as the general characteristics are concerned, but in the finer characteristics there must be differences. The symptoms of the proving are in general more particularly characterized than the effects of Merc, vivus. The symptoms of nosebleed and the more finely characterized throat symptoms were produced by Merc, solublis, as were the majority of the symptoms in the male and female sexual organs. Stitches on tonsils, stitches into ear on swallowing, something hot rises into throat. This is not to say that Merc, vivus will not answer equally well or even better for curing them. Hahnemann's typical anti-syphilitic remedy. Affects the bones, glands and skin. Inflammation leads to induration, then to ulceration. Merc, corresponds accurately to the true Hunterian chancre. Pronounced tremors, usually commence in the finger. Tremor of weakness and paralysis. B. Cooper noted that it may attack the heart and cause sudden death on the smallest effort. Great tendency to fainting. The tremors may become jerkings and even convulsions. Parkinson's disease. Shaking and trembling with exertion. Dissolves the living tissues by inducing emaciation. Offensive, rapidly decomposing ulcers. Ulcers, gray, ashy, lard or cheesy base, with burning or stinging pains. Obstinate varicose ulcers. Phagedenic ulcer that just gets bigger and spreads to other areas. General decomposition. Bone ulcers, pains are deep and boring, aching. Deteriorating bones. The bones soften so that they will bend. Bone pains at night in the legs. Wounds and sores that are slow to heal. Bruise easily. Injuries may open up, ulcerate and discharge. Scurfy, syphilitic, and pustular eruptions. Eruptions worse by warmth, at night, by cold. Moist, oozing, offensive eczema. Shingles. Suppurative stage of smallpox. Itching, voluptuous itching. Soreness and sensitiveness. Stabbing pains and stitches, burning, boring, digging, stinging and dragging pains. Tendency to the formation of pus. Bloody pus, pus forms in cavities or abscesses that burn and sting. Discharges are yellow-green in color. Discharges are acrid, excoriating, irritating, except for vaginal discharges. Abscesses, boils, and ulcers with pus or pus with discharges that are yellow, green and acrid. Chronic discharges from the lungs, nose and vagina, and colon. Gonorrhea. Vaginitis with yellow, green discharge, acrid over the whole vaginal area. Burning, itching, stinging, very offensive, the glands in the inguinal area can sweat. Enlargement of glands with pricking pains, inflammation, suppuration. Chronic swollen glands. History of infections. Weakness and exhaustion, shortness of breath. Emaciation, shaky and fragile (Gels., Sil.). Immune weakness, AIDS. Allergies. Suppressed measles or scarlet fever, causing acute problem with the brain, rolling the head back and forth, with severe head sweats. Profuse sweat accompanies nearly all complaints. Sweat does not relieve, may aggravate. Chronic night sweats. Nightmares and palpitations, wake up sweating. Chronic colds (Psor.). Mono. Sensitive to every draft and yet worse by warmth, the nasal secretion is acrid and the nose red and excoriated. Old, catarrhal smell in the nose, smarting and burning inside nostrils. Aching, tearing and pressing out in the bones. Recurring otitis media with foul, green discharge that is acrid and offensive. Tendency to eardrum rupture. Sharp, stabbing pain in the ear. Fetid ear discharge. Excessive saliva, bad taste in the mouth. Metallic taste in the mouth. Mercurial odor, offensive, breath excessively fetid, sweat offensive, mawkish, sweetish. Throat dry and forepart of tongue moist. Characteristic flabby, coated, teeth-indented tongue, foul breath and intense thirst. Mapped, cracked tongue. Sore and raw feeling in the back of the mouth. Sores in mouth and nose. Abscesses. Canker sores, bleeding gums. Ulcers, white patches like thrush. Acute boils (Hep., Sil.). Children who get sores in their mouth while breastfeeding. Acute sore throats with stinging, raw feeling. Aphthous stomatitis, severe pyorrhea. Teething with swollen gums, drooling. Loose teeth, receding gums, pockets of pus (Nit-ac., Hep.). Useful for the affects of dental work, especially if abscessed. Periodontal disease. Jaws crack and pop a lot (Ign., Rhus-t., Caust.). Congested, enlarged, inflamed liver. Stitches in the liver. Sensitiveness in the liver and inability to lie on right side. Hepatitis. Disordered stomach. Thirsty, even with a moist mouth. Craves bread and butter. Aversion to meat, wine, brandy, beer, coffee, greasy food, butter. Aggravated from milk, sweets, lying on the right side. Food allergies. Recurring bladder infections where indicated remedies don't work. During stool there is tenesmus, or tenesmus and no stool. Just before stool a sick, painful, faint feeling comes on. Slimy stools, acrid, knotty, containing pus, viscid. Diarrhea with slime. Dysentery with much straining, never- get-done feeling when there is no more to come. Extreme exhaustion after a stool. Not well since dysentery, with diarrhea, sweating and dehydration. Affects the generative organs of both sexes. Stinging, cutting pains in the ovaries (Apis.), cutting pains from left to right in lower abdomen. Burning and stinging in the ovaries with ovarian cysts. Breast cancer with ulceration and foul discharges (Ars.). Milk in the breast of non-pregnant women (Puls.). Characteristic sensitivity to temperature changes, worse from both heat and cold. Sensitivity to draft. Creeping chills, shivering, shaking, and shuddering. Drowsiness during the day, sleepless at night. Symptoms are worse at night, particularly the bone pains. Aggravated by odors, noise, lights, changes of weather, exertion, cold. Ameliorated by lying down. Extreme restlessness, overreacts, hurried (Med.). The mind is as weak and tremulous as the body, everything is done hastily. Lack of organized response. Speech and mind are slow. Slow comprehension. Time seems to pass slowly. Imbecility. Inefficient (lod.), workaholics. Desire to travel or change jobs because of instability. Homesick. Dreams of traveling, floods, delusions of water. Atrophy and deterioration of the brain. Memory loss. Problems with communication, stuttering, especially in children who have earaches (Caust.). Imbecility and senility in the elderly. Difficulty adjusting to their environment. Tend to be closed, over protective. Anxiety, discontent. Can get anxious and worried about their illness (Ars.). Laughing and weeping spells, break downs. Can be impulsive. Impulses to kill, run away, fears people are after them. Murderous. Suicidal. Guernsey noted it for “dirty-nosed children.” Also that “Merc, is rarely indicated in these troubles where there is no slime.” Kent noted that “Kali-i. is better for the same bursting in the face, running coryza and worse from heat and warmth of the bed.” Kent noted that it is useful “whenever cold settles in the eye in gouty and rheumatic patients.” Guided chiefly by the indications profuse sweat with no relief and worse at night, Clarke cured many cases of rheumatic fever with Merc, vivus 12c without any other remedy. Hirsch of Prague related some striking experiences with a preparation of Merc, vivus that he learned from an old allopath. Quicksilver is boiled in water for half an Mercurius solublis hour, two teaspoonfuls being given every two hours. Hirsch recorded cases of acute inflammation of the brain in which Bell, was indicated and in one of which Merc, had already been administered in vain. Hirsch noted a case in which a black-haired girl, age 9, had a malignant scarlatina, which commenced six days before Hirsch (who came as consultant) saw the case. There were signs of brain inflammation that had set in on the third day. Hirsch found her unconscious, sharply defined redness of cheeks, pulse 120, skin hot. Piercing screams were emitted from time to time, boring head in pillows, chewing motion of jaws, gnashing teeth. Lips brown and dry, not much thirst, water not accepted readily, but milk seemed to be relished. Reddened patches here and there, especially along neck. Under the “decoction,” which was given to the girl on Hirsch's suggestion, she slowly but steadily improved and in a week was convalescent. RELATIONS - Antidote: Hep., Aur., Mez. Compare: (1) Bell. - very close analog, often complementary, commencing of abscess, difficult swallowing fluids, sharp pain through tonsils, pains come suddenly. (2) Hep. - chilliness, something sticking in fauces. (3) Meny. - coldness in ears. (4) Puls. - thick yellow nasal discharge, but that of Puls., is bland, otitis. (5) Nux-v. - coryza and sore throat, Nux-v. has scraped feeling, Merc, is always smarting, raw, or sore. Dysentery with Nux-v. tenesmus ceases after stool, with Merc, not, there is the never- get-done feeling. (6) Aeon. - dysentery of hot days and cold nights. (7) Lept. - bilious troubles, horribly offensive stools, the griping of Lept. continues after stool but not tenesmus. (8) Ars. - Merc, worse by heat of, but better by rest in bed. Ars. better by heat of, but worse by rest in bed. (9) Ant-c. - dirty tongue, inflammation of eyes worse glare of fire or sunshine. ( 10) Kali-i. - stitching pains through lungs, Merc, right or left and shooting in different directions. ( 11 ) Bor. - sore mouth. (12) Cham. - diarrhea, dentition. (13) Syph. - syphilis, worse heat of stove or bed, worse night. (14) Apis - stinging pain, fetid breath, ovarian affections. (15) Psor.and Med. - foul body smell. (16) Mez. - decay of teeth, Merc, of crowns, Mez. of roots. (17) Chel. and Kali-c. - affect lower lobe right lung, stitches through to back. ( 18) Pic-ac. - boils in auditory meatus. Complementary: Bad. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Sweat on genitals with soreness between scrotum and thighs. Cold genitals. Swelling of lymphatic vessels along penis. Glans and prepuce inflamed and swollen, phimosis. Redness of meatus. Prepuce irritated, itches. Children or adults pull and scratch at the genitals from a kind of itching which makes them do so. Orchitis (Clem., Ham.. Puls.). Testicles, swollen, hard with shiny, red scrotum. Dragging pain in testes and spermatic cords. Sensations of coldness in testicles. Gonorrhea. Gleet yellowish green and purulent. Syphilis. Vesicles on forepart and sides of glans ofpenis. Vesicles and ulcers, soft chancre. Herpes preputialis. Condylomata. Lascivious excitement with painful nightly erections. Nocturnal emissions, stained with blood. Emissions followed by burning pain in back and icy cold hands. Sexual power decreased, total loss of sexual power.

Female - Amenorrhea with congestions and ebullitions. Menses suppressed. Collapse and fainting at start of menses. Menses irregular, or every two weeks. Menses too late and scanty. Profuse menses with abdominal pains. Menses of short duration. Abscesses appear anywhere on body during menses and disappear after menses. Leucorrhea, thick, white with itching, worse urinating and washing with cold water. Leucorrhea excoriating, greenish and bloody. Leucorrhea in small girls, causing prostration. Sensation of rawness in parts. Genitals feel raw. Vaginitis. Itching of vulva. Burning, throbbing and itching of vagina. Swelling of labia. Pressure in genitals, obliging her to urinate often. Stinging pain in ovaries (Apis). Stitching, aching or boring pains in uterus. Prolapse of uterus with vagina, better from sex. Cancer of uterus and breasts. Bleeding excrescences on os uteri. Expels moles. Pregnant women with swelling of genitals. Edema, pruritus of vulva during pregnancy. Morning sickness with a profuse salivation. Tendency to miscarriage from uterine weakness. Infertility with too profuse menses. Food - Intense thirst for cold drink and beer. Great thirst for ice water, though it aggravates cough. Much thirst day and night. Sweats when eating. Weak digestion with continuous hunger. Craving for lemons. Appetite only for bread and butter. Bread tastes sweet. Aversion to meat, coffee, butter, oily things, sweets, salt, strong cheese. Sweet things and milk disagree, though he craves them. Wine, spirituous liquors, coffee and cold drinks aggravate.

Chest - Burning or constriction in chest, worse night. Pain below breasts through to scapula, worse sneezing or coughing. Stitches from lower lobe of right lung to back. Feels as if everything in chest were dry. Sensations of bubbles or as of hot steam in chest. Sweating on chest with old people, from opium. Stabbing pain in left side under short ribs during every inspiration. Soreness from fauces to sternum. Cough with stitching pains in chest. Constitutions - Suited to light-haired persons with lax skin and muscle, women and children. Scrofulous children. Merc, has relation to psora and sycosis as well as syphilis.

Heart - Aching pain at apex and base of heart. Awakes with cardiac tremor. Weakness in heart as if dying. Palpitations on slight exertion. Palpitations with cough and bloody sputum. Palpitations with fear, worse at night. Pulse irregular, quick, strong and intermittent or soft and trembling. Pulse frequent at night, slower by day. Pulse irregular, generally full and fast. Pulse with violent beating in arteries. Pulse imperceptible, with warmth of body.

Back - Bruised pain in small of back, especially when sitting. Stinging pain in small of back with sensation of weakness. Violent pain in spine, worse motion and pressure. Burning pain in back, worse emission. Shooting pain in sacrum on breathing. Pain in sacrum, as if one had been lying on too hard a couch. Pricking itching in sacrum when walking. Tearing pain in coccyx, better pressing on abdomen. Pain forward from right scapula. Neck stiff, cervical glands enlarged. Cervical glands swollen and inflamed, with shooting pains. Psoriasis on nape. Herpes zoster.

Limbs - Weakness and weariness in all limbs. Pains in limbs, worse night. Bone pains, deep or near the surface, worse at night, must get up and walk about. Bones as if broken, joints as if sprained. Involuntary jerking in limbs. Convulsions in limbs. Trembling limbs, especially the hands. Parkinson's disease. Paralysis agitans. Stiffness and immobility of limbs. Osteoarthritis. Rheumatism of joints, with swelling and sensation of coldness. Lacerating pains in joints. Tendency to complete destruction of joints. Abscess in joints. Edematous swelling of hands, feet and face during menses, or with anemia. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Sensation as if knees were larger. Fingers numb. Icy cold hands after emission. Cold heels. Cold, clammy sweat on legs at night. Patient very sensitive to cold. Oily perspiration.

Sleep - Excessive sleepiness day and night. Great sleepiness during day, not better long sleep. Sleeplessness from nervous excitability. Sleepless at night from ebullitions of blood to chest and head. Sleeplessness from pain or other troubles. Profuse perspiration without relief during sleep, with pains. Just after falling asleep, pains become more violent. Dreams of water, animals, thieves, misfortune.

Skin - Constantly moist. Insensible skin. Itching, worse from warmth of bed, perspiration. Itching as from fleabites. Jaundice with itching on abdomen. Yellow skin, tender, excoriated like raw meat. Scurfy eruptions. Vesicular and pustular eruptions. Moist vesicles surrounded by dry scales, easily bleeding. Red spots covered with small vesicles. Pimples around the main eruption. Phagedenic blisters. Moist eczema. Crusta lactea. with yellowish-brown crusts, considerable suppuration. Herpes, burning when touched. Herpes zoster, burning pains. Measles, tardy development. Nettle-rash. Buboes. Boils and abscesses form at the time of menses. Ulcers, bleeding with cutting pains and proud flesh. Ulcers, irregular in shape, edges undefined. Desquamation. Erysipelas of newborn children of syphilitic or scrofulous nature. Exanthemata spreading from pit over abdomen and chest. Varicella, chickenpox, water blotches turn yellow and maturate. Variola in stage of maturation.

Modalities - Better from moderate temperature, in morning. Better from sex, rest, scratching. Worse drafts, taking cold. touching anything cold, cloudy weather, damp, rainy weather, wet feet. Worse changing weather and temperature, heat, sweating, warmth of bed, warm days with damp, cool nights, Fall. Worse at night, lying on right side, bending forward, during and after urination, before stool.

Teeth - Grinding of teeth. Looseness of teeth. Teeth feel tender and elongated. Alveolar abscess, worse at night. Inflammation of roots of teeth, which ulcerate and fall out. Toothache worse heat and cold, at night. Toothache at night, followed by general chilliness, with swelling of gums and salivary glands. Teeth, decayed, hollow, black. Crown of teeth decay. Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily. Gumboils. Large ulcers on protruding gums. Swelling of gums every night. Shooting pains into face and ears, better rubbing cheek.

Tongue - Tongue thickly coated in morning. Tongue heavy, thick, moist coating. Tongue, broad, flabby, yellow, indented. Gray patches on edges of tongue, dirty- yellow coat on upper surface. Needle pricks at tip. Pricking pain in tongue with swelling. Furrow in upper surface of tongue lengthwise, with pricking. Tongue feels as if burnt with ulcers. Ulcers behind the tongue. Severe pain on side of tongue from contact of teeth.

Liver - Liver enlarged, sore to touch, indurated. Jaundice from gallstones. Jaundice in newborn. Deficient bile secretion. Chronic atrophy of liver, with emaciation and desiccation of body. Lungs - Dyspnea, when coughing or sneezing. Desire to take deep breath from anxious oppression. Shortness of breath on going upstairs or walking quickly. Breathing difficult, worse lying on left side, but cough worse lying on right side. Catarrh with chilliness, dread of air. Salty or bitter tenacious mucus. Easy expectoration. Yellow muco-purulentexpectoration, with cough. Bloody expectoration on account of destroyed lung parenchyma. Asthma, worse change of weather, better tobacco smoke and cold air. Emphysema. Lungs as if heavy, in asthenic pneumonia. Pneumonia with cough and dyspnea. Pneumonia with jaundice. Suppuration of lungs after hemorrhages, or after pneumonia.

Kidneys - Dysuria. Greenish discharge from urethra, burning in urethra on beginning to urinate. Frequent urging to urinate day and night with copious or scanty urine. Urinates more than drinks. Stream of urine very small. Urine causes itching. Urine dark, scanty, bloody, albuminous. Hematuria, painless. Burning after urination.

Bladder - Great soreness in region of bladder when touching it. Frequent urging with copious or scanty urine. Must hurry, otherwise can't retain urine. Frequent urination at night, even involuntary. Sudden irresistible urging to urinate, passing large quantities. Burning in urethra on beginning to urinate, after urination, even when not urinating. Intolerable burning in forepart of urethra when passing last few drops. Cutting, during urination. Burning and stinging, with hemorrhage from urethra. Greenish discharge from urethra. Breasts - Breasts swollen, become hard with ulcerative pain during menses. Swelling of nipples. Breast cancer. Palliative in breast cancer. Breasts painful and full of milk at menses. Milk in breast instead of menses. Milk spoiled. Milk in breast of boys. Causations - Ill effects of fright, suppressed gonorrhea, foot sweat.

Cough - Whooping cough with nosebleed (Arn.). Cough causes pressing pains in head and chest. Cough in double bouts. Cough with hoarseness, salivation, vomiting, diarrhea. Cough with sensation as if head and chest would burst. Tickling cough before falling asleep. Dry cough at night, yellow-green sputum by day. Coughs only at night or only by day. Cough worse from tobacco smoke.

Perspiration - General tendency to easy perspiration, but patient is not relieved from it. Excessive odorous viscid perspiration, worse night. Oily sweat. Sweat, oily, foul, sour or with strong sweetish penetrating odor, on head, on chest, stains indelibly yellow. Stiffening linen. Foul, sour perspiration or with strong sweetish penetrating odor. Sweats immediately on drinking something warm. Profuse sweat without amelioration. Perspires while walking, eating. Day and night sweats, though more at night. Falls asleep while perspiring. Perspires easily during sleep, sweats through bedclothes. Profuse and very debilitating, at night. Sweats with pains. Clammy and cold sweats, driving out of bed with thirst and palpitation or nausea. Sweats on head, chest. Shriveling fingers.

Temperature - Patient very sensitive to cold. Easily chilled or overheated. Creeping chilliness, worse in the evening and into night. Constant cold hands and feet. Sense of coldness with tremors. Chilly within abscesses. Debility, chilly and weakness. Cold, clammy sweat on legs at night. Chill alternating with flushes of heat in single parts. Heat and shuddering alternately. Easily chilled or overheated. Catarrhal, gastric, bilious fevers. Fever alternating with shuddering. Fever after midnight with violent thirst for cold drinks. Fever with aversion to uncover. Fever in bed, chill when out of bed.

full:
PHARMACY - merc-s-cy. Mercurius sulpho- cyanatus. Pharaoh's serpents. Sulphocyanide of mercury. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Diphtheria. Esophagus, stricture.

HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known scientific toy called “Pharaoh's serpents” is composed of the sulphocyanide of mercury. A boy ate one “serpent, ” and a man took one in water. The symptoms were observed and included general prostration for some days. Heat and constriction in esophagus with difficulty in swallowing and burning in epigastric region and nausea. MIND - Excessive anxiety.

Face - Pallor, great weakness. Cold skin and frequent shivering.

Mouth - Constant salivation. Disgusting, metallic taste.

Throat - Extreme redness of throat with white membrane on tonsils. Violent burning in fauces. Vertigo - Vertigo on attempting to rise. REFERENCES-Clarke.

Stomach - Vomiting. Epigastrium painful to pressure.

Rectum - Bloody stools.

Limbs - Pain in shoulder joint. Lungs - Voice rough and hoarse. Tenacious expectoration.

Pulse - Pulse intermitting every three beats.

name: Mercurius Sulphuricus
author: Murphy
constitution: Cardiac, pain. Debility. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Edema. Hydrothorax. Rheumatic pains. Sneezing. Ulcers.
keynote:

CLINICAL - Cardiac, pain. Debility. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Edema.…
full:
PHARMACY - merc-s. Mercurius sulphuricus. Yellow precipitate of mercury. Hydrargyrum oxydatum sub-sulphuricum. Turpethum minerale. Turpeth mineral. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Cardiac, pain. Debility. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysuria. Edema. Hydrothorax. Rheumatic pains. Sneezing. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - There is some confusion about the identity of this drug in books. Turpeth is correctly given by Allen. Hering, who proved and introduced it, calls it Turpethum and Turpeth mineral. The Pharmacopeia of the American Institute of Homeopathy describes the white sulphate, HgSO4, under the heading Mercurius sulphuricus, but says it is mentioned in Allen's Encyclopedia, vol. 6., p. 325, whereas it is Turpeth, the yellow precipitate, which is there spoken. Merc-s. has intense dyspnea, must sit up. Respiration rapid, short, burning in chest. Cardiac pain and weakness. Hydrothorax (Ars.). Debility with sleepiness. Rheumatic pains. Most pains feel as if a dull stick pressed on the parts and were moving in diverse curved lines, feels as if this pain were in the bones. Edema of legs. Sneezing from direct rays of sun. Sore tip of tongue. Scanty, clear, scalding urine. Watery stools, burning in anus. Diarrhea early in the morning, stool bursts out in a hot stream of yellow matter. Intense evacuations like rice-water. MIND - Morose. Low-spirited with chilliness and yawning. Di-humor after eating.

Head - Fullness in head with occasional stitches. Soreness and heaviness through head, after breakfast and when walking about. Sensation of giddiness while standing after headache. Violent itching of hairy scalp.

Eyes - Oppression over eyes. Eyes worse from sunlight.

Ears - Burning in ears and in face after a chill.

Nose - Sneezing in sunshine with fluent coryza. Swelling and soreness of tip of nose. Itching of nose.

Face - Pale, anxious countenance. Swelling of parotid gland.

Mouth - Mouth clammy and full of mucus in morning. Salivation. Burning, smarting, stinging pain on tip of tongue, left side in evening. Lips, gums, fauces, mouth and tongue swollen, look dry and black. Gums and palate dark bluish (black), ulcerated margins.

Throat - Heat and sensation of constriction in throat. Burning in mouth and throat. Dryness of tongue and throat. Roughness in the throat and hoarseness.

Stomach - Pain, weight in stomach, tenderness. Stomach so irritated nothing would stay on it an instant. Violent yellow vomiting, diarrhea.

Abdomen - Coldness or burning in abdomen. Wakes at 1 a.m. with severe pains along duodenum to umbilical region. Soreness in inguinal glands.

Rectum - After drinking coffee, pain in abdomen as if diarrhea would set in. Sudden and violent pressing to stool while walking compelling him to stand still, with anxious perspiration. Stools forcibly gush out in a hot, burning stream of yellow water, followed by great debility, hiccough and belching. Violent purging, rice-water motions, some yellow. Stools soft and earlier in morning than usual. After stools, sensation of fullness as from congestion to legs, especially feet, feel numb when standing.

Male - Gonorrhea and syphilitic diseases with great congestions to the parts. Swelling of testicles. Involuntary emission and lascivious dreams.

Chest - Pain in right side of chest, extending to scapula, can scarcely breathe, worse from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. Pain in chest prevents him from breathing. Pressure on chest. Burning in chest. Hydrothorax from liver or heart disorders.

Limbs - Numbness in left forearm and hand, later numbness in right hand. Hands icy cold with blue nails. Stiffness in arms. Pain in knees and lameness, especially when walking. Foot-sweat with soreness at ends of the nails. Ulcers on ankles. Lungs - Dyspnea in children. Sensation of heat in larynx. Increased expectoration of mucus from larynx and trachea.

Sleep - Frequent yawning and great sleepiness in afternoon. Sleeplessness after midnight. Awakens with headache in morning.

Skin - Induration of the glands. Psoriasis, leprosy.

Tongue - Tongue, greenish yellow down middle, heavily coated white. Tongue yellowish at root. Enlarged papilla stand up like red points with flat taste in mouth and a reduced pulse. COMMENTS - Lippe is the chief clinical authority for Merc-s. He considered it as important as Ars. in dropsies of the chest. The symptoms on which it has been prescribed are clinical and have been well confirmed. Among them is “Pain in right chest extending to scapula, he can scarcely breathe, worse 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.” When Merc-s. acts well, said Lippe, “it produces a profuse watery diarrhea with great relief to the patient.” It is particularly suited to hydrothorax depending on liver or heart disorders. Other confirmed symptoms include soreness of tip of tongue. Edema of legs. Scanty and scalding urine, but clear. Worse in afternoon, 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. Better by profuse diarrhea (dyspnea). After diarrhea stools, there is numbness of legs. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Merc-acet. - cutting in urethra when last drop is flowing out. (2) Cinnb., Aethi- a. and other mercuries. (3) Hydrothorax, Ars. (4) Worse afternoon, Lyc. (5) Dropsy, Dig. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Lippe. Phatak.

Kidneys - Diminished secretion of urine, does not urinate frequently, but has constant pressure. Increased secretion of urine without a sediment. Urine dark, becoming turbid with a scum on it. Urine scanty and scalding, but clear.

Temperature - Chilliness running up back with yawning and depression of spirit, followed by dull pain in forehead, burning in face and ears and slight fever. Chilliness, restlessness and heaviness in upper part of abdomen, frequent yawning and diminished secretion of urine, in afternoon.

name: Mercurius Vivus
author: Murphy
constitution: Albuminuria. Arthritis. Cancer. Chorea. Coma. Cystitis. Epilepsy. Epithelioma. Gonorrhea. Hemicrania. Kidneys, disorders. Malaria. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia. Pleurisy. Rheumatism. Spasms. Spinal irritation. Suppuration. Tremors. Typhoid fever.
keynote:
METHYLENUM COERULEUM (Methylene blue)

PHARMACY - meth-b. methyl. Methylenum coeruleum. Methylene blue. Teleamethyl- thionine chloride. One of the aniline dyes. A diphenyl amine compound, also classed as an aniline color. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All…
full:
METHYLENUM COERULEUM (Methylene blue)

PHARMACY - meth-b. methyl. Methylenum coeruleum. Methylene blue. Teleamethyl- thionine chloride. One of the aniline dyes. A diphenyl amine compound, also classed as an aniline color. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Arthritis. Cancer. Chorea. Coma. Cystitis. Epilepsy. Epithelioma. Gonorrhea. Hemicrania. Kidneys, disorders. Malaria. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia. Pleurisy. Rheumatism. Spasms. Spinal irritation. Suppuration. Tremors. Typhoid fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Methylene blue consists of small, indigo-colored, scaly crystals with a bronze-like tinge, that are dark green in transverse fracture. Slightly soluble in water, forming a deep blue solution. It has been used in old-school practice in doses of about three grains in capsules or pills for rheumatism of joints and muscles and in rheumatoid arthritis. The dyes are carcinogenic. Mose tig treated a man, 50, who suffered from cancer of the femur. Mosetig injected into the groin a 1 percent solution of “Trichlorate of Aniline,” increasing the strength, until four grams were used at one injection. Almost an hour after the first injection the patient became dark blue, the next morning the discoloration was gone. After the four-gram doses, poisoning symptoms appeared including unconsciousness, stertorous breathing, feeble pulse, the whole body becoming dark blue. Artificial breathing and stimulants brought the patient around in four hours. Smaller doses were used after that. In eight weeks he went home, cured to follow his ordinary work. Methyl- violet 1 to 500 and 1 to 1,000 produced equally good results. Methyl, is a remedy for neuralgia, neurasthenia. Malaria. Typhoid fever, delirium and fever. Tendency to tremor, chorea and epilepsy. Later states of a stroke. Backache, sciatica. Gonorrheal rheumatism and cystitis. Pus infection. Nephritis (acute parenchymatous), scarlatinal nephritis. Urine acquires a green color. Bladder irritation from its use is antidoted by a little nutmeg. Surgical kidney with large amount of pus in urine. Tympanites. Cancerous ulcerations on the skin and mucus membrane and on internal organs such as uterus, lungs and the gastrointestinal tract. Hemorrhages are mostly bright red with few clots. Cough with blood-streaked expectoration and difficult breathing. MIND - Neurasthenia. Unconsciousness.

Head - Hemicrania. Habitual headache.

Chest - Causes absorption of pleural effusion.

Back - Backache with sciatica.

Limbs - Tremors. Spastic hysterical contractions. Lungs - Stertorous breathing.

Skin - Turns the patient dark blue. Pus infection.

Bladder - Irritation of the bladder. Cystitis. Urine greenish. Gonorrhea.

Temperature - Typhoid fever. Malarial fever. Fever from pus absorption. COMMENTS - The kidneys have a distinct attraction for Methyl., as it appears in the urine within half an hour of the dose and, if the kidneys have their normal permeability, the whole is eliminated in thirty-six hours. If there is delay beyond this it indicates that the urea is not being perfectly eliminated and that a tendency to uremia exists. The aniline products have been used as remedies for malignant growths. Mosetig of Moorhof published a case treated with Trichlorate of Aniline, “an aniline dye.” E. Thomson, stated that Methyl, in 1-5 grains doses, “with equal parts powdered nutmeg to prevent irritation of the bladder” (a useful item in view of the homeopathic employment) is valuable in habitual headache and hemicrania. Cardamantes of Athens gave 10 to 12 grs. ten hours before an expected malarial attack. He said it is useful in combination with quinine or when quinine had failed. Immunity from malaria seems to follow its continued use. Apt to cause cystitis. A gentleman who suffered excruciating pains from calculus in the kidney, giving rise to pyelitis and cystitis, derived no benefit from any treatment until his doctor gave him Methyl, with occasional doses of eucalyptus. L'Art Medical gave an account of the use of Methyl, injection in pleurisy with serous effusion. C. H. Lewis of New York, first drew off by aspiration 100 cubic centimeters of the liquid, dissolved in this one grain of Methyl, and reinjected it into the pleural cavity. The patient soon began to pass greenish urine and then the exudation quickly disappeared, partly from the diuretic effect of Methyl., partly from its stimulating action on the pleura. A watery solution is not borne, causing pain and irritation of the pleura. The most homeopathic experience is that of Halbert. Utilizing the affinity of Methyl, for nerve tissues and nerve cells, Halbert gave it in 3x trituration with success in neuralgias of neurasthenia, tremor in neurasthenia, spasticity of hysterical contraction, trophic disturbances, the result of nerveexhaustion, and spinal irritation. Halbert confirmed its anti-malarial powers and commended it in typhoid as an intestinal anti-septic. An apparently hopeless case of typhoid was signally benefited by it, the tympanites disappearing as if by magic. Wherever there is pus infection it is indicated and it has “made a record” with him in gonorrhea and cystitis. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anil., Pyrog.. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Mezereum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better open air, wrapping up, eating. Facial pains better radiated heat of stove. Head pains better wrapping up head. Headache better stooping. Worse at night, evening until midnight, touch, motion. Worse warmth of bed, fire, warm food, cold, air, drafts, damp. Worse during menses, suppressions, vaccinations, mercury..
