keynote: PHARMACY - mez. Mezereum. Spurge olive. Daphne mezereum. Chameleons germánica. Mezereon. N. O. Thymelaceae. Hilly woods over nearly whole of Europe and Russian Asia. Tincture of fresh bark gathered just before the plant flowers in February and March. Historical dose: All…
full:
PHARMACY - mez. Mezereum. Spurge olive. Daphne mezereum. Chameleons germánica. Mezereon. N. O. Thymelaceae. Hilly woods over nearly whole of Europe and Russian Asia. Tincture of fresh bark gathered just before the plant flowers in February and March. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Anus prolapsed. Bones disorders. Ciliary, neuralgia. Coccyx, pain. Constipation. Contraction, tendons. Convulsions. Crusta lactea. Ear, affections. Eczema. Eruptions. Erythema. Exostoses. Eyes, disorders. Glands, enlarged. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hematuria. Hernia. Herpes, zoster. Impetigo. Itching. Leucorrhea. Lice. Mercury, effects. Neuralgias. Osteoma. Periostitis. Pityriasis. Pruritus, senilis. Rheumatism. Scrofula. Skin, disorders. Syphilis. Teeth, affection. Testicles, enlarged. Tinea, capitis. Tinea, versicolor. Tongue, disorders. Twitch- ings. Ulcers. Vaccination.

HERBAL - The plant flowers in very early spring, even when snow is on the ground. Suited to complaints that come on in the earliest months of the year.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann recorded the history of a robust man who took mezereum bark for some ailment and continued it after the ailment disappeared. Soon, unbearable itching set in all over his body, and he could not sleep a moment. Thirty-six hours after discontinuing it, the itching was still increasing. A few grains of camphor removed it. Mez. is the vegetable analog of Merc., it and Mez. antidote one another. The mind, skin, eyes, mucus membranes and bones are affected in much the same way by both. They have the same sensitiveness to damp, cold and warmth and the same nightly aggravations. Mez. affects skin, bones, nerves and mucus membranes of the mouth and stomach. Affinity for skin symptoms and disorders of bones and neuralgias, especially about the teeth and face. Bruised, weary feeling in joints with drawing and stiffness. Pains of various kinds with chilliness and sensitiveness to cold air. Sudden pains of various kinds followed by chilliness, numbness and soreness. Pains shoot upward and seem to draw the patient up out of bed. Irritation, burning itching or burning smarting on the skin. Violent, burning, darting like fire in the muscles. Burning, darting sensation in the muscles, subsultus tendinum. Burning, boring pains in bones especially long bones, with neuralgia of the teeth and face or after shingles. Decay, exostosis of bones. Periostitis. Bones seem enlarged. Internal burning with external violent itching in small areas or in single parts.Ac- rid secretions, pus, leucorrhea, etc. Ulcers. Eruptions after vaccination. Cystic osteoma. Abscesses of fibrous parts or tendons. Body feels light. Twitchings in the eyelids, on the right side of the face etc. Convulsions better by tight grasping. Affected parts become cold or emaciate. One sided symptoms, whole or partial. Excessive sensitiveness to air, even of a fan. As if a cool breeze blowing on the part. Affections go from above downward, from within outward, and from right to left. Worse from cold, damp, cold winds, sudden changes of weather, heat, and warm food. Nash mentioned an exception to the worse by warmth modality. In a man whom he cured with Mez. of obstinate facial neuralgia, the pains were brought on or greatly worsened by eating, and the only relief the man could get was by holding the painful side close to a hot stove. Only radiated heat was of any use, hot cloths, wet or dry, gave no relief whatever. MIND - Forgetful. Vanishing of thoughts while speaking, unable to repeat what has been learned by heart. Indifference to everything and everybody, looks through a window for hours without being conscious of objects around. Dullness of mind after sound sleep. Apprehensive at the pit of the stomach when expecting some very unpleasant news or shock. Irresolution. Nervous, compelled to move and change positions. Aversion to talk, it seems to be hard work to utter a word. Hypochondriac and despondent. Sadness about trifles, when alone. Religious or financial melancholy. Despair of eternal salvation. Anger alternating with quick repentance. Vexed and angry at trifles. Censorious. Reproaches or quarrels with others. Irritability during headache.

Head - Violent headache on slightest touch, after vexation. Headache, worse from talking. Stupefying headache in right side. Numbness of one side of scalp or top of head. Pressing pains as if skull would split. Pains on slightest touch in temples and sides. Cranial bones painful. Boring pains in bones of occiput. Violent congestion to head during menopause. Affections of external head, scaly eruption, white scabs. Burning pain of scalp. Intolerable itching. Eczema capitis. Head covered with thick, leathery crusts, under which pus collects. Milk crusts. Exostosis. Sore boils. White scabs or scales. Hair falls in handfuls. Dandruff, white, dry.

Eyes - Eyes feel strained. Dryness of the eyes, they feel too large. Pains radiate and shoot downward with cold feeling and stiffness of bone. Pain outward along the brows. Smarting pain in eyes, with lachrymation. Lachrymation with any pains. Ciliary neuralgia after operations. especially after removal of eyeball. Inclination to wink, jerking of eyelids. Obstinate twitching of muscles of left upper lid. Eczema of lids.

Ears - Thickening of tympanum. Ears feel too open, as if tympanum was exposed to the cold air and it blew into the ear. Chronic diffuse otitis. Oozing eruption behind ear. Itching behind ears, scratching causes small elevations, when scratched off the spots feel sore. Desire to bore fingers into ears. Deafness after suppression of head eruptions.

Nose - Sneezing, coryza. Frequent sneezing with pain of excoriation in chest. Visible twitching at the root of nose. Interior of nose excoriated. Post nasal adenoids.

Face - Red. Facial muscles drawn tight. Face swollen, burning pains, confluent vesicles. Boils on face. Impetigo. Eruptions around the mouth with coryza. Cracks in corners of mouth. Scabs about mouth. Ulcers on upper lip. Lips swollen, dry, scaly externally, painful, sore and burning. Chin covered with elevated, white scabs. Violent neuralgia about face and teeth, running towards ear, at night, worse eating, better near hot stove. Neuralgic pains come and go quickly and leave part numb. Sudden pains, wakes from sleep. Left-sided prosopalgia. Twitching of muscles, right sided. Boring pains in bones of upper jaw. Violent itching of face and scalp.

Mouth - Salivation. Mouth waters. Taste bitter, sour, beer tastes bitter, which is vomited. Breath smells like rotten cheese. Burning in mouth and throat, sometimes better eating. Ranula, worse talking and chewing, ejects a watery fluid. Dry, dark red mouth. Flat, whitish ulcers on inner side of lips and corners of mouth.

Throat - Dark, red, burning, sore, worse winter. Burning in mouth and throat, sometimes better eating. Burning in pharynx and esophagus. Throat as if dry. Sensation as if posterior part of throat were full of mucus. Swallowing even of fluids difficult and painful, from severe burning and raw pain. Constriction of pharynx. Sensation of narrowing in throat. Nausea felt in throat, better eating.

Stomach - Chronic gastritis, burning, corroding pain. Constant, severe pain and pressure in stomach even after light foods. Induration of stomach. Stomach ulcer with much burning. Burning and corroding pain in stomach, better milk and eating. Constricting, pinching pain in stomach. Sensation of apprehension, fear, faintness and goneness at stomach as if something was going to happen. Sensation as if food remained for a long time undigested in stomach and caused pressure. Stomach pain culminates and ends with retching and vomiting of all food taken. Vomiting of chocolate colored substance with nausea. Vomit bitter, sour, slimy, oily or greasy. Water brash. Stools - Stools preceded and followed by shivering. Stools, hard, large, as if they would split the anus. Stool soft, brown, sour, fermented, undigested, offensive.

Abdomen - Burning and heat in abdomen. Swelling of glands with large abdomen in children. Contraction of diaphragm. Pressure in inguinal ring. Dull or severe pain in region of spleen. Stitches in left hypochondrium. Flatulent colic with shivering and difficult respiration.

Rectum - Itching in anus. Biting, sore pain in anus on walking. Constriction of anus, stitches and prolapse of rectum. Burning in rectum. Much painless straining. Painful tenesmus. Constipation with hepatic and uterine inertia. Constipation after confinement. Summer diarrhea of children. Diarrhea with small, white glistening particles. Green discharges. Constant passing of flatus, but in a short and interrupted manner. Sensations - Head as if drunk, as if everything in the head would press asunder. As if skull would split, as if top of head gone, as if head bruised, as if head was in an ants' nest. Eyes as if too large, as if drawn back into head. Throat as if narrowing. As if food remained long time in stomach. Stools feel as if they would split anus. Limbs feel shortened. As if fire darting through muscles. Sensation of lightness of body. Bones are very sore and feel distended. Diseased parts wither.

Male - Testicles enlarged. Painless swelling of the penis and scrotum. Heat and swelling of penis. Itching glans penis. Fine, pricking, stitches in penis and tip of glans. Urethra sore. Violent sexual desire. Gonorrhea with hematuria, discharge of watery mucus.

Female - Menses scanty with face ache. Menses too frequent, too soon, too profuse. Leucorrhea like albumen, very corroding. Ulceration of vagina and cervix. Food - Loss of appetite. Constant longing for food. Confusion after eating. Thirst during chill. Aversion to meat. Craving for bacon, ham, fat, coffee, wine. Desire for acid drinks. Beer tastes bitter and causes vomiting. Worse from wine. Itching temporarily better from wine and coffee.

Chest - Stitches in chest. Sore pain in right axilla. Soreness and burning in bones of thorax. Constriction across chest. Contraction of diaphragm. Painful tension in intercostal muscles. Chest feels too tight on stooping. Sensation as if ants were running over chest. Intercostal neuralgia following herpes zoster, worse at night and in warmth of bed. Red spots like fleabites on chest. Constitutions - Suited to light-haired persons, phlegmatic temperament, irresolute. Gouty, rheumatic, syphilitic miasm.

Heart - Pulse full, hard, accelerated evenings. Pulse at times intermittent. Pulse frequent mornings, slow evenings.

Back - Pain in muscles of back. Pain in neck and back, worse motion and at night intolerant of all touch. Violent itching rash on nape. Stiff pain in nape and muscles of sides, worse motion. Rheumatic pain in right scapula, in morning after rising. Shuddering over back and limbs, when itching is most severe. Coccyx painful after a fall. Causations - Ill effects of suppressed eczema capitis, vaccination and mercury.

Limbs - Trembling of limbs. Limbs feel cold, as if shortened. Joints feel bruised and weary, as if they would give way. Pain in hip and knee. Aching, itching in knee. Legs and feet go to sleep. Hands and feet cold, nails blue. One hand hot. Paralysis of flexors of fingers, cannot hold anything. Long bones inflamed and swollen, decay, exostosis. Pain, worse night touch, damp weather (Merc., Syph.). Burning in tibia and long bones. Lungs - Dyspnea, as if from adhesions or contraction of lungs. Desire to take a long breath. Snoring in children. Yellow, viscid, salty expectoration. Expectoration during day or tasting like an old catarrh.

Sleep - Much yawning and stretching. Irresistible sleepiness during day. Sleepiness from debility. Sleeplessness from itching. Sleeplessness from cramps in calves. Sleep disturbed by violent pain in face. Nightmare at night, awakening after midnight.

Skin - Skin wrinkled and in folds. Eruptions ulcerate and form thick scabs under which purulent matter exudes (Chry s-ac.). Eruptions, ooze, acrid, gluey moisture, form thick crusts, scabs with pus beneath or chalky white. Intolerable, itching, worse by warm bath, worse in bed. As if millions of insects were crawling on him. Crusty eruptions, white scabs, bleeding when touched. Skin cold on places where itching is most intense. Pruritus senilis. Itching changes place on scratching, coldness after. Itching without eruption. Itch-like eruption, after vaccination, depriving child of sleep. Eczema. Psoriasis. Herpes zoster with burning pain. Liver spots on chest and arms become dark and desquamate. Ulcers itch and burn, surrounded by vesicles and shining, fiery-red areola. Deep, hard, painful ulcers worse touch and warmth. Old ulcers burn and sting. Ulcers form over bony protuberances. Desquamation over whole body. Scurf like fish scales on back, thighs, chest and scalp.

Modalities - Better open air, wrapping up, eating. Facial pains better radiated heat of stove. Head pains better wrapping up head. Headache better stooping. Worse at night, evening until midnight, touch, motion. Worse warmth of bed, fire, warm food, cold, air, drafts, damp. Worse during menses, suppressions, vaccinations, mercury.

Teeth - Teeth feel dull and elongated. Teeth feel cold. Teeth painful on biting on them and from cold air. Roughness from tartar on teeth. Roots of teeth decay. Rapid decay of hollow teeth. Toothache into temples, better with mouth open and from drawing in air. Toothache in gums from cold air. Toothache from congestion to head. Sensation as if tooth was being lifted out of socket.

Tongue - Burning in tongue with salivation. Tongue coated along one side only. Middle of the tongue fissured. Thick, white coating on tongue with large, red, elevated papillae. Vertigo - Vertigo with contracted pupils, faintness. Vertigo and flickering before eyes, inclination to fall to left side. COMMENTS - A case reported in Allen's Appendix recorded the history of apale girl, 14, having been advised to use mezereum leaves to make her fat and rosy, went into the woods and used them freely on her cheeks and surrounding parts. Burning soon set in, the whole face swelled enormously, especially the nose, eyelids and hairy scalp. Severe and painful sneezing, delirium, dull, unbearable, pressing pains in forehead, a nauseous dryness in throat and constant irritation to dry cough. The face soon showed the appearance of erysipelas bullosum, nostrils closed, she could only breathe through her mouth, febrile pulse, burning urine. Oil and compresses were applied, and after the second day desquamation occurred in large areas. Health did not return. Debility followed, with loss of vitality, mental depression bordering on idiocy. Then typhoid fever, lasting fully for three months to which she finally succumbed. Poisoning has also been observed from the effects of the berries, causing dryness and burning of throat and stomach, intense thirst, a narcotic state, coma, and convulsions of eyes and upper limbs. In a child of four, poisoned with the berries, the lips swelled, the tongue was furred and swollen, protruding, with difficult swallowing. The tongue remained quite raw when other symptoms had passed away. Mez. is one of Hahnemann's anti-psoric remedies. Ulcers, with thick, yellowish, white scabs. Vesicles, itch and burn. Lint dressings stick to them and when they are torn away, bleeding occurs. Burning vesicles on the sides of the fingers and ulcers on finger joints. Canker sores with a scab, pus (Rhus-t., Nat-m.). Herpes zoster, shingles itch and burn and form scabs. Herpes zoster, during the eruption and for the neuralgia remaining after, especially if the pains are burning. Vaccination eczemas. Psoriasis and eczema, itching, worse in bed and from touch. Intolerable itching, migratory itching. Skin is scabby looking, with an itch underneath the scab that aggravates. Pimples on ankles and backs of feet, horrid taste and clamminess of mouth in morning. Pimples better by hard scratching. Dry crust on the scalp and falling out of hair, accompanied with short sight. Bone pains, particularly of the long bones. The least touch is intolerable. Affinity for the facial bones and teeth (Merc.). Decay attacks the roots or sides of the teeth, rather than the crowns (Merc.). Toothache is worse at night, from touch, even with the tongue. Better by holding the mouth open and drawing in air. Neuralgia about the eyes, the pains radiate and shoot downward. Sensation in the eye as if a cold wind were blowing in it. Hypersensitiveness of the ear to air. Feeling as if air went through the ear to the throat. Stitching, burning and itching in the rectum and anus. During stool, the rectum prolapsed and the sphincter closes upon the protruded part. Sluggish bowels. Constipation after confinement. Constricting tendency in the throat, stomach and tendons. Enlarged testicles (Clem.). The leg is shortened with pain in the hip. Tension in muscles of the chest. Pain and stiffness in muscles of neck. Cramp-like contraction over chest and back and across front of chest. Cooper noted that green discharges were particularly characteristic. Carroll Dunham recorded a notable case of deafness, due to suppressed psora. A youth, age 17, deaf since four and incapacitated thereby, secluded himself and brooded over his trouble. Membranes thickened. At the age of three, he had an eruption of thick, whitish scabs, hard, almost horny, covering the whole scalp. There were fissures through which exuded on pressure a thick, yellowish pus, often very offensive. There was much itching and disposition to tear off the scabs with the fingernails, worse at night. The allopathic treatment was vigorous, a tar cap was placed on the head and when firmly adherent to the scabs was violently torn off, scabs and all, leaving the whole scalp raw. This was painted with a saturated solution of Arg-n. The eruption did not reappear, but from that time the child was deaf. The eruption was the very counterpart of an eruption observed in a proving by Wehle. Mez. 30c, three globules in a powder of sugar of milk, was given on February 3, March 1, and September 28, 1857 and January 26, 1858. Improvement set in slowly after the first dose, which was only repeated when the effect of each preceding dose seemed to be exhausted. Finally, the hearing was for all practical purposes completely restored. The action of Mez. in catarrhal cases is illustrated in the case of Miss M. R., 39, a brunette, who had chronic catarrh. The left ear had long been deaf and the right had begun to fail. There were noises in the ears. Drum membranes retracted and scarred. The naso-pharynx mucus membrane was granular and irritable. There was excessive sensitiveness to the air, even of a fan and occasionally a sensation as if air went through to the throat. A dose of Mez. given before each meal entirely relieved the symptoms. T. S. Hoyne collected many cases illustrating the action of the remedy including a case of a woman treated by W. E. Payne. She had no rest when alone, wanted company. Ideas vanished while talking, could not repeat what had been learned by heart. Looked through the window for hours without being conscious of objects around. Did not know what she was doing, forgot what she was about to utter, looked ill-humored pale, wretched, fallen away. Apprehensiveness at pit of stomach, as when expecting some very unpleasant intelligence. All symptoms relieved in a single night by Mez. 20c. S. R. Geiser noted the case of a man, 28, who had a violent neuralgia, boring pain in left lower jaw bone, extending to temple and ear. Pain was worse at night, better from pressure. Mez. 3c relieved in two hours. J. W. Vance recorded the history of H. G., stout, healthy-looking, left supra-orbital neuralgia recurring daily at 9 a.m. increasing until noon, declining until 4 p.m., when it entirely departed leaving no soreness behind. Pain caused flow of tears. Mez. 1c cured permanently after other remedies had failed. Hempel noted the case of a toothache in the incisor of a woman. Tooth felt elongated, loose, excessively sensitive with sensation as if being raised out of its socket. Upper part of tooth was excessively painful. Mez. 200c cured in a few hours. Oehme noted the case of Mrs. X., who had pain in her right eye tooth, daily increasing. Felt too long. Pains much worse by pressure on crown and outside root. Mez. 2c cured. Oehme also recorded a case in which the fastenings of a hammock broke and a woman on it fell, striking her sacrum and coccyx on the stump of a tree. She suffered excruciating pain. Arn. was applied locally. In a few weeks she came home and the coccyx was still so tender she could not sit, only lie or stand. Arn. internally and externally for two weeks had no influence. Mez. 2c cured in five days. Cooper noted the case of a woman, 48, who had rheumatism which came on ten years before in her hands from wearing wet gloves and extended later to arms and knees. She had stiffness on walking with loss of muscular power, worse in hot weather, “pins and needles” in fingers on elevating arms. Could not grasp things, sometimes one hand burned when the other was cold, menopausal flushings. Great relief from Mez. tincture. Cooper also noted that Daphne laureola, the British representative of the genus, cured scald-head when Mez. failed to work. The symptoms in this case were worse by day, whereas Mez. has worse at night. The pains of D. laureola come on in the morning and affect the entire head or whole left side. Guai. pains are also worse by day and better by warmth. H. B. Esmond cured with Mez. 3x a youth, 17, who had been afflicted with “salt rheum” as long as he could remember. It was absent in summer, but every autumn, as soon as cold weather came, his face, neck, hands and forearms would break out and continue sore until warm weather returned. Mez. cured a girl, 18, getting thin with headache across forehead, temples and eyes, a throbbing with sickness of stomach and water brash, always worse by movement, bowels very confined, menses never appeared. H. Noah Martin noted a patient that said “my stools are as hard as stone and as large a my arm. I feel as if they would split me open. They come in sections like mouthfuls and I becomes much exhausted and tremble with weakness. Every stool is immediately preceded by chills and followed by long stitches up rectum.” Mez. 12c produced a natural stool in twelve hours. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Kali-hp., Merc. Compare: (1) Merc., Phyt., Rhus-t., Guai., Syph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Red flakes float on top of urine. Hematuria, hot, preceded by cramps in bladder. After urinating, a few drops of blood are passed. Biting, burning in forepart of urethra at the close of urination.

Cough - Irritation in throat causes hacking cough. Dry tickling cough, into vomiting. Cough, worse eating, on taking a warm drink. Cough from beer. Must cough till food is vomited.

Perspiration - During sleep, following chill. Skin drips with cold sweat.

Temperature - Chill of single parts as if dashed with cold water. Chill alternating with flushes of heat. General weakness. Great tendency to get remittent or typhoid fever. Ague.

author: Murphy

HERBAL - A California mint-like plant acting on stomach and bowels. It is a pleasant beverage and febrifuge, blood purifier and…
full:
PHARMACY - micr. Micromeria douglasii. Yerba buena. California. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Flatulence. Nausea.

HERBAL - A California mint-like plant acting on stomach and bowels. It is a pleasant beverage and febrifuge, blood purifier and tonic. Used as a tea for colic and to relieve flatulence. Nausea with pain in the stomach and bowels. REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Millefolium Achillea
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from bleeding, re-establishment of discharges. Better during the day, from wine, violent exercise. Violent exercise improves vertigo. Worse from violent exertion, injury, exertion, lifting, stooping, doubling the body, lying down. Worse evening and night, coffee, hemoptysis, suppression of discharges..
constitution: Anemia. Ascites. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bleeding. Blows. Bruises. Cancer. Chlorosis. Colic. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Fistula lachrymalis. Hematemesis. Hematuria. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Infertility. Injuries. Leucorrhea. Lochia, profuse. Lochia, suppressed. Milk, absence. Nipples, sore. Nosebleeds. Puerperal convulsions. Puerperal fever. Rodent ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - mill. Millefolium achillea. Y arrow. Achillea millefolium. N. O. Composite. Asteraceae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Ascites. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bleeding. Blows. Bruises. Cancer. Chlorosis. Colic.…
full:
PHARMACY - mill. Millefolium achillea. Y arrow. Achillea millefolium. N. O. Composite. Asteraceae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Ascites. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bleeding. Blows. Bruises. Cancer. Chlorosis. Colic. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Fistula lachrymalis. Hematemesis. Hematuria. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Infertility. Injuries. Leucorrhea. Lochia, profuse. Lochia, suppressed. Milk, absence. Nipples, sore. Nosebleeds. Puerperal convulsions. Puerperal fever. Rodent ulcers. Sycosis. Tetanus. Trauma. Tuberculosis. Varicose, veins. Urine, bloody. Wounds.

HERBAL - Yarrow was named Achillea by Linneus because the plant is mentioned in the Iliad as having been used by Achilles on the instruction of Chiron to heal the wounds of his soldiers. Millefolium received its popular name, “nosebleed,” because nosebleed comes on if the leaves are inserted into the nostrils. The other species of Achillea indigenous to Great Britain, Achillea ptarmic, is called “sneeze- wort” from its allergic properties.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mill, affects the capillaries of lungs, nose and uterus. Suited to all wounds which bleedprofusely, sprains and over-lifting. Profuse, painless, bright, red, fluid hemorrhages. Nosebleeds. Hemoptysis. Oozing of blood from the edges of closed wounds from over exertion. Spasms or convulsions especially after the suppression of hemorrhages, menses, lochia, milk etc. Varicose veins in pregnancy. Bruised soreness and congestions. Sprains and over-lifting. Bad effects from fall from a height. Profuse mucus discharges. Piercing thrusts of pain. Incarcerated hernia. Smallpox with great pain in pit of stomach. Continued high temperature. MIND - Forgetfulness. Loss of memory. Difficulty thinking and comprehending. Confusion and dullness in evening. Confusion after coffee, wine. Desires nothing. Does not know what he is doing or wants to do. Aversion to mental work. Moaning, sighing and groaning of children. Anxiety in chest, heart. Anxiety, excitement from pains. Anxiety better on rising from a seat. Very excited with pain in stomach. Sadness. Violent, irritable. Hysteria. Delusions, he has been poisoned. Hypochondriasis. Delirium. Knocking his head against wall.

Head - Confused, dull headache, in evening, worse after coffee. Head seems full of blood. Fullness in head after siesta. Headache with twitching of eyelids and frontal muscles. Piercing thrusts of pain. Beats the head against the wall. Headache worse stooping. Throbbing in arteries of head and face.

Eyes - Glistening, brilliant eyes. Piercing pain from eyes to root of nose. Sensation of too much blood in eyes. Lachrymation and discharges from eyes. Fistula lachrymalis. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Spots on eyes.

Ears - Darting pain in left ear. Sense of cool air passing through the ears. Noise in left ear causes starting with fright. Sensation of stoppage in ears, after dinner.

Nose - Nosebleed (Erech.), with congestions to head and chest. Piercing pain from eyes to root of nose. Stuffed nose.

Face - Sensation of heat, as if blood was rising to head. Redness of face without internal heat. Tearing pain in face to temples.

Mouth - Tongue swollen and coated. Thirst, mouth dry. Putrid sore mouth. Gumboils. Rheumatic pain with diseased gums. Toothache from eating things. Useful given before tooth extraction.

Throat - Rough feeling in throat. Rough voice. Elongation of palate. Uvularelaxed. Ulceration of throat, pain in left side when swallowing. Dull piercing pain, right then left. Throat catarrh. Vertigo - Vertigo when moving slowly. Vertigo, falls to right side and backward. Vertigo with nausea when stooping, not when lying down. Violent exercise improves vertigo. Vision - Vision nebulous with contortions of facial muscles. Clear, bright vision. Foggy vision, not near eyes, but at a distance. COMMENTS - Hemorrhages and wounds (Am.). Anti-convulsive. Convulsions occur, although not exclusively, as a result of suppressed hemorrhages, particularly the menses, or other discharges or secretions. Trauma (Am., Ham., and Phos.), with profuse bleeding. Hemorrhage with bright, red blood, florid hemorrhage. Tubercular hemorrhage. Bleeding hemorrhoids, bloody urine or stool. Useful for reabsorbing blood clots. Useful after surgeries (Phos.). Copious mucus discharges, especially due to atony. Pronounced relation to pregnancy and the puerperal state. Useful for varicose veins during pregnancy. Uterine tonic, particularly for profuse menses. C. W. related an interesting case in which a man had severe diarrhea, with profuse dark, chocolate-colored stools, verging on black and slightly tinged with blood. A club doctor had failed to relieve, but an old woman cured the man with “yarrow tea.” C. W. had a collie dog that, when excited, would pull up grass or weeds and swallow them. When it happened to swallow Mill., this invariably caused a rattling of fluid in the bowels, followed by dark chocolate diarrhea, changing to black, very offensive, finally blood-tinged. This lasted a day or two. It was found that Ars-i. 3x in solution was a complete antidote. Given every ten minutes, as soon as rattling came on, it effectually stopped it. The dog also had fissured pads. Ars-i. did nothing for these, but Ars. 30c cured. RELATIONS - Ant-t. relieves the vertigo to Mill., Ars-i. the diarrhea. Antidotes: Ars-i., Amm-m. Compare: (1) Composite group generally, Am., Bell-p., Calen. (2) Fic-v., Pakur. - hemorrhage from bowels and lungs. (3) Acai., Helix. - in hemoptysis, diseases of chest, tuberculosis. (4) Erech. - nosebleed and hemoptysis. (5) Senec. - hematuria. (6) Ham. and Ip. - hemorrhages. (7) Mill, red, clotted, Plat, dark, clotted. (8) Bry., Ust. and Ham. - hematemesis. (9) Aeon. - hemorrhages, profuse flow of bright red blood. (10) Aeon., anxiety, Mills., absence of anxiety. Incompatible: Coffee causes head congestion. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomachache. Painful gnawing and digging in stomach as from hunger. Burning pain in stomach, extending to chest. Sensation of fullness in stomach. Pressure like a plug in stomach. Cramps in stomach with sensation as of a liquid flowing in intestines to anus. Eructations. Hiccough. Vomiting when coughing. Nausea with vertigo. Hematemesis.

Abdomen - Ascites. Abdomen distended. Pain in region of the liver. Congestions to portal system. Wind colic. Frequent emission of fetid flatulence. Colic during the menstruation. Violent colic with bloody diarrhea during pregnancy. Dysentery. Hemorrhage from bowels. Incarcerated hernia.

Rectum - Fetid flatus. Diarrhea, preceded by rattling of fluids in abdomen. Mucus diarrhea. Bloody dysentery. Bloody diarrhea during pregnancy. Hemorrhages from bowels after much exertion. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Pains from blind hemorrhoids. Profuse flow of blood from condylomata. Ascarides. Sensations - As if he had forgotten something. As if all blood ascended to head. Right side of head as if screwed together. As if too much blood in eyes. As if cold air passing out of ear. As of a liquid moving from stomach to intestines. Pain as from a blow or sprain.

Male - Wounds and injuries of penis. Swelling of the penis and testicles. Semen is not discharged during sex. Spermatorrhea. Gonorrhea, gleet. Sycotic excrescences.

Female - Menses early, profuse, protracted. Menses suppressed, with colicky pain in abdomen. Convulsions and epilepsy from suppressed menses. Leucorrhea from atony of vaginal mucus membrane. Leucorrhea of children. Infertility with too profuse menstruation or tendency to miscarry. Cramps during pregnancy. Painful varicose veins during pregnancy. Uterine hemorrhages, bright red, fluid, after great exertion. Hemorrhage after labor, abortion or miscarriage. Prolonged bleeding during labor. Lochia too profuse. Suppressed lochia with violent fever. Curative of post- partum hemorrhage. Severe after-pains. Food - Want of appetite. Sluggish appetite from stagnation in liver. Thirst during fever. Mouth dry, with thirst. Confusion after coffee, wine. Dullness after wine. Congestion to head from coffee. Symptoms worse coffee, better wine.

Chest - Oppression of chest with bloody expectoration or palpitations. Bubbles in chest as if warm blood was ascending. Constitutions - Suited to the aged, atonic, anemic women and children.

Heart - Inflammation with tearing and piercing pains. Pains in heart with anxiety. Ebullitions from coughing blood. Violent palpitation with bloody sputum. Pulse accelerated and contracted.

Back - Piercing, drawing pains, under left scapula. Fine piercing pains in left scapula, when standing. Breasts - Sore nipples. Agalactorrhea. Suppressed secretion of milk. Causations - Ill effects from operations for kidney stones, gallstones. Bad ejfects from a fall or sprain, injuries, over-lifting, over-exertion. Suppressed lochia, menses, milk.

Limbs - Bad effects from falls and sprains. Convulsions, convulsive motion of all limbs and violent pain. Paralysis and contraction of limbs. Violent pains on a level with crest of left ilium. Pricking numbness. Left arm frequently feels as if going to sleep. Hot hands and feet. Right Achilles tendon pains as after a blow or sprain. Painful varicose veins during pregnancy. Painless or bleeding varices in pregnant women. Lungs - Shortness of breath. Very difficult breathing, with tetanic spasms. Asthmatic affections. Inflammation of lungs. Exces sive accumulation of mucus in bronchi. Hemoptysis with incipient tuberculosis. Hemoptysis after injury. Expectoration of bright red blood, without much coughing, sometimes in consequence of violent exertions. Cough with bloody sputum in suppressed menses or hemorrhoids. Lung disease with coughing blood.

Sleep - Violent yawning without being tired. Goes to sleep late and does not feel refreshed in morning.

Skin - Bruises and bleeding from wounds. Wounds after operation for stone in the bladder. Painless varicose veins of pregnant women. Exanthemata and delirium. Suppressed itch, causing fever. Fistulous ulcers. Gangrenous ulcers. Ulceration of internal organs. Cancerous ulcers. Condylomata.

Modalities - Better from bleeding, re-establishment of discharges. Better during the day, from wine, violent exercise. Violent exercise improves vertigo. Worse from violent exertion, injury, exertion, lifting, stooping, doubling the body, lying down. Worse evening and night, coffee, hemoptysis, suppression of discharges.

Teeth - Toothache from eating things. Gumboil. Ulcers on gums. Rheumatic pain with diseased gums.

Kidneys - Chilliness with pain in left kidney, followed by hematuria. Catarrh of bladder from atony. Stone in bladder with retention of urine. Pus-like discharge after surgery. Urine bloody (Senec.). Involuntary urination of children.

Perspiration - Profuse sweats. Colliquative perspirations.

Temperature - Chilliness with pain in left kidney. Heat in hands and feet. Fever heat with thirst. Continuous high fever. Fever from suppressed itch or suppressed lochia. Hectic fever with hemoptysis. Malignant fever with tetanus. Intermittent fever. Quartan, tertian, irregular fever.

name: Mimosa Humilis
author: Murphy
constitution: Ankle swelling. Borborygmi. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Flatulence. Goosebumps. Numbness. Rheumatism. Sneezing. Trembling. Twitching.
keynote:
PHARMACY - mim-h. Mimosa humilis. Sensitive plant. N. O. Leguminose. Mimosoideae. Tincture of leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ankle swelling. Borborygmi. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Flatulence. Goosebumps. Numbness. Rheumatism. Sneezing.…
full:
PHARMACY - mim-h. Mimosa humilis. Sensitive plant. N. O. Leguminose. Mimosoideae. Tincture of leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ankle swelling. Borborygmi. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Flatulence. Goosebumps. Numbness. Rheumatism. Sneezing. Trembling. Twitching.

HERBAL - Mimosa humilis is one of the remedies introduced and proved by Mure. The “sensitive plant” of the hothouses is M. púdica, but the leaves of M. humilis, said Mure, “close at the least contact.”

HOMEOPATHIC - The most notable Mim-h. symptoms were lancinations in the back and limbs andswellingand redness of left ankle with tension and lancination. Smarting pain in legs with paralysis of knee. Stiffness of bends of knees. Pressure in nape and right temple. Prostration. MIND - Indolent with indifference (Ph-ac.). Abdomen - Borborygmi. Flatulent colic. Back - Violent lancinations in back.

Head - Sensation of heat in head, as if enlarged.

Eyes - Inflammation of eyes of left eye. Itching. Vision dim, halo around candle.

Ears - Whizzing in ears.

Stomach - Stomach aches and pains. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Rectum - Diarrhea. Frequent stools, colic.

HERBAL - Mimosa Púdica is ligneous with regular flowers in clusters with reduced corolla, meristenous androecium and albuminous seeds. It is a tropical plant originating from Brazil and in the warm parts of India. The root contains 10% tannin, and its common usage suggests that it is an aphrodisiac.

HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic proving is the work of Sankaran (Mumbai), who experimented with it on six young provers, for three weeks, using the potencies 3x and 6x in 1968-69. Sensitiveness and headache above the eyes, aggravated by movement, ameliorated by closing the eyes. Irritation of the conjunctiva and nasal mucus membranes. Pains in the shoulders. Diarrhea with abdominal colic and irritating stools. Feeling that the body is too big. MIND - General irritability. Annoyed by the thought of taking medicine. Easily angered, it takes a long time to forgive. Sensitivity, impression that the body is too large.

Head - Headache above the eyes, especially at the left eyebrow. Headache aggravated by straining the eyes, or by quarreling. Headache, worse from movement, ameliorated by closing the eyes or by a tight bandage. Lungs - Dry cough.

Eyes - Burning in the eyes, worse from a draft of air. Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis. Photophobia with headaches, aggravated by the sun. Vision slightly blurred. Eyelids secrete a yellowish pus, which forms in the corner of the corner of the eye. Eyelids stuck together in the morning on waking.

Ears - Sudden, acute stinging pain, especially in the right ear. Pain coming in the evening, lasting through the night. Pain worse when lying on the right side with pressure and draft of air. Pain ameliorated by lightly covering the ear. Buzzing in the ears. Hears less well against a noisy background.

Nose - Irritation of the nasal mucus membranes. Coryza. Constant discharge of a watery secretion.

Mouth - Abundant ptyalism throughout the body. Nocturnal salivation when lying on the right side. Loss of sense of taste.

Throat - Pain and tickling in the throat, ameliorated by a hot drink, aggravated by speaking and by coughing. COMMENTS - Mim-p. has been used as a decoction of the root ( 1:10), to be prescribed for gravel and all urinary complaints. The infusion of the leaves has been used as a blood cleanser. Powder of the leaves and root is for fistulae and hemorrhoids. The juice can be used as an application for insect and scorpion bites, hemorrhoids and fistulae. A paste made from the leaves is an effective application for hydrocele. The leaves can be used in the bath for cases of lumbar and hip pains. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Euphr. - Inflammation of the nose and eyes. Aggravated by light and air, ameliorated in darkness when lying down. (2) Sabad. - Senses: irritation of the mucus membranes in the nose and the throat. Ameliorated by hot drinks. (3) Psor. - Periodic migraines, worse from the slightest draft, hypersensitive to the cold, sudden nocturnal diarrhea with a fetid odor. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Pain in the epigastric region, worse when coughing.

Rectum - Irritating stools with abdominal colic. Stools frequent, as often as ten times aday. Better after evacuation. Ameliorated by rubbing the abdomen.

Male - Increase of sexual desire.

Chest - Thoracic pain, especially around the lower part of the large pectoral muscle. Better by a hot bath and by abduction movement of the arm, worse fresh air. Constitutions - Allergic and psoric constitutions. Tubercular, nervous types, predominantly phosphoric.

Back - Backache. Dorsal pain. Sharp pain in both shoulders.

Modalities - Better by friction, tight bandage, hot bath. Worse from a draft, movement, bright light.

HERBAL - Mitchella is a small, trailing evergreen bearing a scarlet bean and is common throughout the United States. It belongs to the same order as Chin., Coff. and Ip. and shows its affinity with these in its power over hemorrhages. Indian women drink a decoction of it before confinements to make labor safe and easy. Herbalists use a concentrated decoction as an application to sore nipple.

HOMEOPATHIC - Duncan induced pains and burning in the kidneys in his proving and Hale, who observed the effect on a woman, recorded some characteristic symptoms in the urinary and uterine sphere. Congestion of the uterus with bladder irritation. Irritation at neck of bladder with urging to urinate (Eup-pur., Apis.). Engorged uterus, hemorrhage, bright with dysuria. Lassitude. All muscles feel sore. Whole digestive tract feels cold, transverse colon tender to pressure. MIND - Inability to concentrate mind. Depression, followed by buoyant spirits.

Head - Severe frontal headache on waking. Burning in vertex. Throbbing in occiput. Scalp sensitive to touch.

Eyes - Eyes dull and heavy.

Ears - Burning in left pinna. Dull aching in right ear.

Throat - Fauces dry. Pharynx feels constricted, impeding swallowing. Tonsils enlarged, painless, especially the left. Some enlargement of left submaxillary gland. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chim., Senec., Uva., Ger., Goss. (2) In congested cervix associated with irritation of neck of bladder, Sep. - Mitch has no general resemblance to Sep., (3) Eup-pur. - bladder irritation in women. (4) Hydre. has in addition heat and itching in vagina. (5) Apis, Vesp. - has ulcer around os. (6) Caul., Chim., Cimic., Helon., Puls., Senec. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Male - Pain, drawing in right testicle. Mouth - Burring and prickling on tongue. Rectum - Tenesmus, urging. Constipation, feces small, thin, difficult.

Heart - Burning pains, uneasy feeling as if its action was being interfered with. Beats irregular.

Back - Aching pains running down back. Dull pain between shoulders in kidney region.

Limbs - Aching and burning sensation in right upper limbs. Walk unsteady, inclines to fall to right. Aching in lower limbs in knee joint. Lungs - Much mucus in bronchi. Dry, backing cough in morning. Breathing difficult, 11 a.m.

Sleep - Yawning, drowsy. Woke in a fright, frightful dreams.

Kidneys - Heat in kidneys with dull pain. Dysuria, accompanying the uterine complaints. Increased quantity of urine, acid. Urine high-colored, white sediment.

Bladder - Uneasiness in neck of bladder, urging to urinate, burning, 11 a.m. Catarrh of bladder. Urethra and neck of bladder swollen and irritated, especially in females).

Temperature - Chill over whole body with flushes of heat, very sensitive to cold air.

HOMEOPATHIC - MSG is made by either a bacterial fermenting process, protein hydrolysis (a breaking of protein into its constituent amino acids), or by synthesis. When a product is 99% pure MSG, the product is called “monosodium glutamate” by the FDA and must be labeled as such. However, when a hydrolyzed protein contains less than 99% MSG, the FDA does not require that the MSG be identified. Many food products manufacturers advertise “No MSG” on their food packages, but MSG may be disguised as “hydrolyzed vegetable protein,” “glutamic acid,” “enzyme modified,” “natural flavor,” “yeast extract,” “maltodextrin,” or “autolyzed yeast.” There have been reports of allergies and/or sensitivities to MSG, sometimes attributed to the free glutamic acid component. It has been blamed for causing a wide variety of physical symptoms including migraines, nausea, stomach cramps, bloating, irritable bowel syndrome. Extreme dryness of the mouth, mouth lesions. Hives or rash. Numbness to the tongue and face, burning sensation in the neck, facial pressure or tightness. Drowsiness, insomnia, anxiety, panic attacks, mental confusion. Asthma, runny nose, sneezing. Flushing, heart palpitations, and anaphylactic shock. “Chinese restaurant syndrome” is often used as an example of the symptoms purported to be caused by MSG. MSG has been shown to cause lesions on the brain, especially in children. These lesions cause cognitive, endocrinological and emotional abnormalities. Monosodium glutamate In children, excess glutamate affects the growth cones on neurons. Growth cones are vital in laying down chemical pathways in the brain to enable the brain to operate effectively. MSG could affect human children's cognitive skills and cause learning difficulties. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HERBAL - The plant was used by some North American Indian tribes to treat eye problems, the stem was bruised and the clear fluid of the stems applied to the eyes. An infusion of the root is antispasmodic, hypnotic, nervine, sedative, tonic. The flowers have been chewed in order to bring relief from toothache. Water extracts of the plant are bactericidal. The crushed plant has been rubbed on bunions and warts in order to destroy them. A poultice of the plant has been applied to sores that are difficult to heal. The juice of the plant used alone or combined with water helps ophthalmic inflammation, ulcers, gonorrhea, and inflammation and ulceration of the bladder. The juice from the stems has also been used to treat nervous irritability, including fits and spasms. It is a good remedy for spasms, fainting spells and various nervous conditions. It has been given to children who suffer from fits, epilepsy and convulsions. Because of the salicylic acid, the base of asprin, Monotropa unifora is considered a pain reliever. It has been suggested in the past as a possible asprin or opium substitute. An infusion of the leaves has been used to treat colds and fevers. Monotropa uniflora An infusion has been used for sore, tired swollen eyes. A tea is made from equal parts juice of Indian pipe and fennel seed. The infusion of Indian pipe to douche to help ease vaginal irritations. Safety is undetermined and it is possibly toxic at high doses as it contains several glycosides. REFERENCES - Murphy.

CLINICAL - Adenitis. Catarrh. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Coughs. Ear, disorders. Erythematous, lupus. Exanthema. Eye, disorders. Lachrymation. Laryngitis. Measles. Optic neuritis. Otitis. Photophobia. Rash. Skin, disorders. Splenomegaly. Spontaneous, abortion. Tachycardia.

HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known symptoms which characterize an attack of measles may all be taken as guides for its homeopathic use. Its chief use has been as a prophylactic against infection and to clear up after- effects of an attack. Morbillinum is extremely useful for cases of debility, weak eyes, blepharitis, conjunctivitis, etc., left after severe measles. Treated in fever hospitals, children who simply will not put on weight, are anemic, weary, and often with some bronchitis, morbillinium will help to remove all these symptoms, prevent lung complications and help them to assimilate their food well and to put on weight rapidly. Affinity for the mucus passages, eyes, ears and the respiratory mucus membranes. Diffused bronchial rales. Nasal voice, rough cough, lachrymation. Fevers, nasal and eye catarrh. Koplik spots. Macular exanthema, begin- ing on the face and behind the ears. Fine scaly desquamation. Aggravation of a first infection of measles. Troubles of the perception. General convulsions. Grumbling children. Mind - Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty of thinking and comprehending. Moaning, groaning in children. Fear of the sea.

Eyes - Optic neuritis. Lachrymation. Photophobia.

Ears - Acute otitis.

Nose - Flapping of the nasal wings, snoring. Catarrh of the nose.

Mouth - Koplik spots. Small white patches, surrounded by a red areola, slightly raised seen on the internal walls of the cheeks and on the mucosa of the gums.

Throat - Hypertrophy of the superficial glands of the neck. Throat red, irritated. Striduous laryngitis. COMMENTS - This nosode was prepared by Gross, a contemporary of Hering. Gross used to soak some globules in the blood of the patient suffering from measles, dynamised and used via olfaction. According to another version, Gross gave some natural globules to the patient suffering from measles, who kept them in his hands firmly closed, and afterwards Gross made dilutions from these globules. Clarke would prescribe a dose of the Mor- bill. 30c 2 or 3 times daily as a prophylactic given to those who are or may be exposed to infection. For an attack of the disease, he found nothing better than Morbill. 30c, eight or ten globules in six ounces of water, a dessert spoonful every two hours. Clarke noted that the effect of this is heightened by alternately giving Bell. 30c in the same way. These two medicines will be sufficient to carry through any uncomplicated case and in his experience do even Morbillinum better than Puls. Dr. D. Sheppard case: Baby Jean, aged 13 months, who had done well on repeated doses of Silica, so that she weighed 22 lb. and had 7 teeth without any disturbance, developed measles at the beginning of June, 1941. When seen again on June 19th, she was not her usual bright self, very quiet and miserable, had lost about a pound in weight. Morbillinum 100 given at once. The next week she was extremely lively and happy as always, and had gained 6 oz. Morbillinum was repeated weekly until July 10th, when she weighed 22 lb. 3 oz., a gain of nearly 20 oz. in three weeks, plus the eruption of another tooth and four more nearly through; always cheerful and bright now. Dr. D. Sheppard writes: "Let me repeat once more: remember the measles serum, Morbillinum, in potency during the convalescence period after measles. There will be no need to send the child to the seaside or give innumerable doses of the nauseating cod - liver oil and malt mixture. This treatment is much simpler, less costly and more efficacious.” “And if in an older child or even an adult you find that the individual had one or more attacks of measles, and has not been doing too well since, interpose a dose or two of Morbillinum 30 or higher, and then go back to the other constitutional remedies as may be necessary; and you will be surprised how quickly various states of ill-health will clear up.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Puls., Hep., Merc., Sulph. Complementary: Bell. REFERENCES - Clarke. Julian.

Abdomen - Abdominal pain, localized at the appendix region. Acute mesenteric adenitis. Splenomegaly. Swollen lymph glands.

Female - Spontaneous abortion.

Heart - Tachycardia. Lungs - Cough. Paroxysmal respiratory dyspnea. Purulent pleurisy.

Skin - Rosy maculae, round and oval, of different shapes separated by healthy skin disappearing by pressure. Papulous eruption. Miliary, confluent, scarlatina-like eruptions. Ecchymotic spots.

HOMEOPATHIC - There are two sub-types of the nosode Morgan Pure, which is closest to Sulph. and particularly good in skin conditions, and Morgan Gaertner, which is like Lyc. and is helpful in cholecystitis, adrenal colic. It is often useful in hiatal hernia and diverticular disease. Keynote congestion. Broncho-pneumonia, where the indicated remedy fails to act even in the acute state or to clear up a residual infection. Selective on skin and liver in headaches with flushed face, aggravation from heat and raised blood pressure. Congestion of the stomach lining and the liver with dirty mouth, indigestion, and bilious vomiting. Gallbladder conditions, constipation and hemorrhoids. Pelvic congestion and dysmenorrhea. Hot flashes during menopause. Circulatory disturbances of the limbs, blueness, chilblains, varicose veins, edema and hot feet, etc. Congestion around the joints in arthritis. History of rheumatic fever. Hyperemia of the surface circulation (Sulph.), deep internal venous stasis (Ham., Graph., Petr, and Psor.). Skin ailments with heat and itching. Eczema, red raw with exudate, itching and bleeding. Giving the nosode in 30c potency, followed by Sulph. in 3x or 6x tablets twice daily, can help the acute itching in bad eczema or dermatitis. MIND - Tense, active. Excitable. Introspective and anxious. Apprehensive about state of health, fear of impending disease. Agoraphobia. Fears crowds but often shows mental anxiety if left alone. Fear of the unknown, of the dark, that something bad will happen. Claustrophobia. Irritable with a tendency to depression. Weeping, tearful mood. Sadness, despondency. Idiocy. Suicidal disposition. Mental depression often with suicidal tendency by jumping.

Head - Congestive headache with flushed face. Frontal, occipital headache, on vertex. Migraines. Weekly sick headache. Headaches worse from hot atmosphere, thunderstorm weather, excitement, traveling in bus or train. Scalp sensitive. Hair falling out. Complete alopecia.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Iritis, keratitis. Tarsal cysts. Styes. Lids granular. Spots before eyes.

Ears - Otorrhea. Boils on meatus. Noises in ears. Meniere's disease. Catarrhal deafness.

Nose - Catarrh. Post-nasal catarrh. Sinus and antrum infection. Dry mucus membrane. Cracks angle nose. Sense of smell lost. Nosebleeds.

Face - Acne rosacea. Eczema on chin and forehead, in ear passages. Cracks and eruption behind ears. Eruptionpustular, weeping, scalding and very itchy. Eruption on margins of scalp, pustular, itchy and scaling. Erysipelas. Hot, red, dry and fissured.

Mouth - Salivation. Bad taste in the mouth, taste deficient or lost. Mouth and lips dry, lips stiff in the morning. Angles of mouth cracked, lips very red. Ulcers. Jaw bones ache. Periostitis jaw.

Throat - Throat dry and burning. Throat parched, raw and granular. Apple core sensation, easy choking. Pharyngitis, laryngitis, tracheitis. Recurring tonsillitis, cheesy pieces come out. Thyroid enlarged.

Stomach - Burning in throat and stomach. Pain and acid, worse with food. Duodenal and peptic ulcer. Bilious attacks. Water brash, heartburn. Sour, acid, bitter, mouthfuls. Belching and heartburn. Nausea, vomiting, hematemesia.

Abdomen - Epigastric pain or discomfort. Tenderness in epigastrium. Pain right and left hypochondrium. Pain right and left iliac fossae. Flatus. Redness and moisture at umbilicus, bad odor.

Rectum - Constipation. Bowel motion without help, loose, urgent in the morning. Bowel motion immediately after food. Stool may be pasty, foul and contain blood and mucus. Hemorrhoids, bleeding itching or painful. Itching of anus. Anal fissures.

Female - Pruritus vulvae and vagina. Boils vulva. Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia. Fibroids of uterus. Leucorrhea, corrosive, offensive, brown, green, yellow. Urethral caruncle. Bartholinitis. Pain on sexual intercourse. Food - Desires fats, sweets, eggs and butter. Worse from fats and eggs, or avoids fats and eggs.

Chest - Pleurodynia. Fibrositis of chest wall. Angina. Pain since shingles. Constitutions - Red, coarse, blotchy appearance. Introspective, anxious about their health.

Back - Lumbago, acute or chronic. Arthritis spine, sacro-iliac joints. Pain generally better moving, worse on beginning to move, heat.

Neck - Adenitis neck. Fibrositis neck and shoulders.

Limbs - Osteoporosis. Rheumatic shoulders. Neuritis arms. Numbness and tingling arms. Rheumatoid arthritis of wrists, thumb. Hands puffy, stiff and grip poor. Nodules on fingers. Finger joints swollen and painful. Fingers stiff in morning. Lack of power in legs. Tingling legs. Growing pains in legs. Knee joints are large and stiff. Pain in soles, heels. Thick skin soles of feet with cracked heels. Pes planus. Feet too hot, offensive foot sweat. Chilblains.

Sleep - Insomnia, light and restless.

Skin - Eruptions dry, cracked, fissured, weepy, itchy and burning. Tremendous thickening and congestions of skin with deep cracks. Itching eruption, worse from heat. Raw, red eczema, exuding freely with itch and heat, bleeding from scratching. Callosities. Herpes zoster. Skin sensitive to sun, prickly heat. Cannot wear wool next to skin.

Tongue - Burning in tongue. Tongue raw and dry, coated, slimly, swollen. Tongue stiff in the morning. Warts on tongue. Pain in the root of tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo from high blood pressure. COMMENTS - Congestion of gastric mucosa and liver. Heartburn. Dirty tongue, bitter taste in mouth in the morning with accumulation of mucus causing gagging as soon as rises from bed. Appetite absent in the morning but, by 11 a.m., a sinking feeling relieved by eating. Recurrent bouts of indigestion, with vomiting of mucus and occasionally blood without ulceration. History of bilious attacks, especially occurring at menopause. A history of repeated attacks of congestion of the lungs or bronchi pneumonia in children is indicative for the use of the nosode Morg. or one of the subtypes: Morgan-Pure or Morgan-Gaertner. Dr. Sargunar, who used this nosode in 5300 cases, reported that Morg. relieved the attacks of bronchial asthma as quickly as Adren. Chest infection where the indicated remedy fails to act or in cleaning up residual infection after a bronchi pneumonia, especially in cases following Sulph. or Nat-s. Dr. William B. Griggs said that he used Morg. from 200c to the 100,000c in cases of asthmatic children where Nat-s., Ars. and various asthmatic remedies failed completely. Dr. Griggs said, “Morgan Bacillus has been one of my most successful remedies in eczema of young children. You take the moist type of eczema where the child scratches and has the exudate on its face and bleeds. Clarke has seen Morgan clear that up after failure of Graph., Psor. and Med.” RELATIONS - Miasmatic relation: Morgan has deep range of action covering the field of a number of anti- psoric remedies. Compare: (1) Sulph., Calc, and Lyc. and also many carbonates. REFERENCES - Bach. Paterson.

Liver - Pain in liver and gallbladder. Gallstones. Congestion of liver. Attacks of jaundice. Bilious attacks with severe headache, relieved by vomiting large quantities of bile-stained mucus. Lungs - Suffocative attacks. Shortness of breath. Morning cough, dry tickling cough, loose or sticky. Emphysema. Asthma. Congestion of nasal and bronchial membrane, especially in children, bronchi and lobar pneumonia. Infantile asthma. Bronchitis, each winter. History of pneumonia or bronchopneumonia and never well since.

Kidneys - Cystitis with frequency and pain. Urine of strong smell, corrosive, containing sugar.

Blood - High blood pressure. Varicose veins. Varicose ulcer. Cerebral thrombosis. Phlebitis. Sluggish circulation. Easy bruising. Tendency to hemorrhoids.

Perspiration - Profuse in axilla.

PHARMACY - morg-g. Morgan gaertner. A bowel nosode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alopecia aerata. Anal fissure. Anal pruritus. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bladder pain. Blepharitis. Catarrhal, rhinitis. Chalazions. Constipation. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Eczema. Furuncles. Gallbladder, pain. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Intercostal neuralgia. Kidney, stones. Leucorrhea. Mastoiditis. Myocarditis. Nasal polyps. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Otitis. Palpitations. Pleurodynia. Polyuria. Psoriasis. Pustules. Pyelo-nephritis. Rectal, prolapsed. Rheumatic, pains. Sinusitis. Styes. Urticaria. Vomiting. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pale, impatient, claustro- phobic persons. Subjects with fine brown hair. Polyarticular rheumatic pains of upper extremities specially of the right side. Vesiculous, squamous, papulo-squamous eruptions. Pyelo-vesical burning congestion. Dysmenorrhea. MIND - Impatient. Tense, with strong reaction. Full of apprehensions, gets excited in company. Chews nails. Irritable. Jealousy. Claustrophobia. Nocturnal fears cries out in sleep. Manic depressive psychoses.

Eyes - Chronic inflammation of the eyelids. Blepharitis. Styes. Chalazions. Ulcer of the cornea. Vitral opacity.

Ears - Otitis. Mastoiditis. Furuncles in the auditive conduit. Buzzing in the ears.

Nose - Sinusitis. Hypersecretion of nasal fossa and of maxillary sinus. Crusty coryza with ulceration in the nose. Catarrhal rhinitis. Nasal polyps. Nasal herpes. Nosebleed.

Face - Facial neuralgia, dominating left side. Sudden edema of the face. Herpetiform eruption on the left side of the face.

Mouth - Bad mouth, bitter taste. Thick saliva. Tongue burning, as if pricked by needles. Inflamed gums, pyorrhea. Cracks in corner of lips.

Throat - Inflammatory congestion of tonsils. Edema of the uvula. Sensation of burning in the base of the throat as if from acid. RELATIONS - Compare: Lyc., Puls., Sil., Kali-bi., Nat-m., Nux-v., Sulph., Sep., Graph., Calc. REFERENCES - Julian. Paterson.

Stomach - Fullness of the epigastrium without eating. Noisy eructations with bad smell. Vomiting of foods after meals, afternoon or night.

Abdomen - Gallbladder painful. Intestinal lethargy. Flatulent dyspepsia. Flatulence of the left and right hypochondrial region.

Rectum - Constipation. Hard, dry stools with mucus. Spontaneous expulsion of mucus through rectum even when the patient is not constipated. Rectal prolapsed. Anal fissure. Anal pruritus. Painful hemorrhoids, bleeding, pruriginous.

Female - Irritation at the approach of menstruation. Painful menses. Dysmenorrhea. Thick, brown, corrosive, bad smelling leucorrhea. Vulvar pruritus. Food - Desire for sweets, salted things, fatty foods, eggs, meat. Sometimes aversion to fat, eggs, meat.

Chest - Intercostal neuralgia. Thoracic pain. Angina pectoris. Constriction in the chest, painful irradiation to the left hand. Sensation of coldness in the chest.

Heart - Myocarditis. Precordial uneasiness. Angina pectoris. Nocturnal palpitations, wakes up the patient. Palpitations, better by eructations, better by emission of gas, better by movement.

Back - Cervical rigidity. Breasts - Warts on the breasts, nipples.

Limbs - Nocturnal pains of the arms. Rheumatoid pains in shoulders, arms, elbows, wrists, deltoid muscles (right). Painful swelling of the thumbs. Knees, numb and painful. Excessive heat of the feet at night. Lungs - Dyspnea. Shortness of breath. Pleurodynia. Asthma. Tickling cough morning and evening, while walking up, while lying down.

Skin - Skin sensitive. Sudden edema of the face. Herpetiform eruption on the left side of the face. Psoriasis. Eczema. Urticaria. Pustulous eruption on face, on brows, knees. Skin, oozing, crusty, desquamating with fissures. Giant urticaria on arms. Warts on hands, big flat or lacerated. Erythematous squamous eruptions in round plaques on elbows, knees, integument, sacral region, nails and heels. Herpetic eruption on soles. Alopecia aerata. Loss of hairs in bunches.

Modalities - Better by movement, passing flatus, eructation. Worse in company, after meals, before menses, at night, heat , of bed, right side.

Kidneys - Pain in the kidney region. Nephritis. Pyelo-nephritis. Pyelo-vesical pain, congestion. Kidney stones. Bladder pain with frequent urination. Polyuria. Burning urine. Bedwetting.

full:
PHARMACY - morph. Morphinum aceticum. Morphine. Opi um alkaloid. Morphinum muri- aticum. Morphinum sulphuricum. Morphia. N. O. Papaveraceae. Trituration. Solutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Amenorrhea. Bradycardia. Chorea. Colic. Coma. Constipation. Convulsions. Delirium. Delirium tremens. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes. Drug, addictions. Drug, overdose. Electric shock. Eyes, disorders. Headache. Herpes zoster. Hysteria. Impotency. Infertility. Itching. Jaws, clenched. Lightning-stroke. Nausea. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Numbness. Pains. Palpitations. Paralysis. Ptosis. Shock. Sleep, disordered. Strabismus, divergent. Strangury. Tachycardia. Trismus. Timpanitis. Uremia. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vision, illusions. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Morphine is the alkaloid of opium, which contains the most characteristic properties of the drug. The alkaloid, the acetate, the muriate and the sulphate have all been used as painkillers and sleep inducers. Morphine bears a similar relation to opium as atropine is to belladonna, that is, it represents its nervous side. It is less stimulating, less convulsive and more decidedly hypnotic. Constipates less and affects contractility of the bladder more. It is less diaphoretic and more itching. Restlessness, hyperesthesia, trembling, twitching, jerking, convulsions. Violent and sudden neuralgic pains and sudden fainting. Multiple neuritis. Neuralgias after herpes zoster (Mez.). Extremely susceptible to pain. Pain causes twitching and jerking of limbs. Sore feeling all over. Bed feels too hard. MIND - Mental exhaustion. Incapable of thinking or fixing mind. Concentration difficult. Memory weakness. Forgetfulness, hunting for words while speaking. Makes mistakes in writing. Makes gestures. Indifference, apathy. Great anxiety, thought she was going to die. Anxious, restless, ran about the room. Ailments from fright or fear. Frightened easily. Shock induced by terror. Terror, cried out in great alarm. Suspicious, mistrustful. Emotions very easily excited. Hysteria. Excitable during childbirth. Flow of ideas rapid and pleasant, but without control of the will. Lies, never speaks the truth, does not know what she is saying. Ill-humor. Irritable, wants to be alone. Censorious, critical. Fault-finding. Anger at trifles. Intolerant of contradiction. Deceitful, sly. Want of moral feelings. Delirium, melancholic in character. Delirium during fever, sleep. Delirium, springs up suddenly from bed and escapes. Howling. Delusions, sees faces, hears voices, perceives various odors. Sensation of death. Delirium tremens. Drug addictions, overdose. Profound depression. Sad, melancholy, despair. Despair with the pains. Could not describe symptoms because tears and sobs. Suicidal disposition. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Dream-like state. Confusion of mind. Unconsciousness, coma. Uremic coma.

Head - Head dull, heavy as lead, hot. Bursting pain, head drawn back. Brain feels tense as though wound up tightly. Headache with drowsiness. Congestions of head, palpitations of heart, starts in fright if approached, touch causes cramp and twitchings.

Eyes - Itching of eyes. Pupils unequally Morphinum aceticum contracted. Paresis of recti internal. Staring, injected, diverging strabismus. Look unsteady. Double vi si on with disturbed accommodation. Sight blurred, obscured by fogs. Delusion of vision on closing eyes. Eyes feel too small for sockets. Eyeballs protrude. Bluish, drooping eyelids. Ptosis. Nystagmus.

Ears - Left ear throbs painfully, better heat. Severe pain in left ear with pain at side of left eye all day. Seems to hear circulation all over body. Ringing, surfing, roaring, tinnitus.

Nose - Sneezing in paroxysms, coryza. Tickling in nose and larynx as before a sneeze. Intense itching, tingling, numb feeling on end of nose, rubs it constantly.

Face - Heavy, confused, wild, haggard expression. Intensely flushed face, puffed, livid, cyanotic. Dusky red or pale face, lips tongue, mouth or throat. Trismus, teeth clenched.

Mouth - Very dry mouth, with thirst, nausea, bitter, sticky vomiting. Discharge of watery saliva from mouth. Palate scarlet. Speech is hasty, stammering, embarrassed and feeble.

Throat - Dry and constricted. Burning back of fauces. Hoarseness. Pharynx paralyzed, swallowing almost impossible, better hot drinks, worse solids. Jugular veins swollen, carotid arteries pulsating.

Stomach - Pain in stomach, worse by eating. Constriction, pressure, cramps. Colic, crawling in stomach. Belchings, violent, with much acid mucus. Nausea incessant and deathly, faintness, constant Morphinum aceticum retching. Nausea and vomiting on rising up. Nausea with drowsiness. Vomiting of green matter, sour, bright green fluid, bitter, greenish water.

Abdomen - Distended. Acute pain in abdomen and along spinal column. Tympanitis. Pain in umbilical region. Colic better turning on back in morning.

Rectum - Stool retained. Constipation for a long time. Constipation, stools large, dry, knotty with tendency to bruise and fissure. Diarrhea watery, brown or black with horrible tenesmus. Sensations - Tight sensations in head, as if skull too small for the brain. As if brain wound up. Something shot to head like lightning the instant the injection look place. Sight as if obscured by a fog. Ticking of nose and tip of nose. Tongue as if thick. Teeth as if clenched. As if worms in legs.

Male - Pain in right spermatic cord (Ox- ac.). Impotency. The sexual excitement, voluptuous sensations and erections are incomplete or do not occur. Diminished desire.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses too profuse, and too early. Infertility. Sexual desire at first increased, afterwards abrogated. Food - Loss of appetite. Aversion to meat, pastry. Thirst, burning.

Chest - Chest tight. Pain in middle of sternum. Ill with an indescribable sensation, worse then any pain, behind lower half of sternum. Neuralgia after herpes zoster (Mez.). Constitutions - Nervous constitutions.

Heart - Cardiac muscular tissue is intact, even if severely exhausted. Violent throbbing in heart and carotids. Alternation of tachycardia and bradycardia. Palpitations. Pulse small, weak, dicrotic.

Back - Great pain in back. Pain extending along spine. Pain and twitchings all down spine. Aching across lumbo-sacral region, cannot walk erect (Cimic.). Weakness of the loins. Stiff-neck. Causations - Ailments from fright or fear. Drug addiction, overdose. Electric shock, lightning-stoke. Thunderstorms. Ailments from apoplexy, stroke.

Limbs - Tremors, twitchings, contractions, stiffness of limbs. Numbness. Cramps in several muscles. Violent pain in joints. Staggering gait. Legs swollen. Wandering, sharp pains in legs and feet. Stiffness and pain in arms after sleep. Icy coldness of left sole as if standing on oil-cloth. Lungs - Faint and struggling for breath. Breathing is stertorous, difficult, slow. Diaphragmatic paralysis, hiccough, dyspnea, paroxysmal, on first falling asleep (Lach., Grind.). Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Dry, hard, teasing, exhausting cough, worse at night. Strangling cough with viscid mucus sputum, thin, scanty, but sounds loose and abundant.

Sleep - Heaviness, drowsiness. Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Sleepless, restless sleep with frequent startings. Y awning, drowsy, prolonged, deep sleep. Muttering in sleep. Dreams are pleasant, frightful. Half waking, half stupid condition. Aggravation after sleep (Lach.).

Skin - Skin lost its elasticity. Skin deathly pale. Livid, purple spots. Eruption like herpes zoster, but without pain. Itching is constant, violent, all over, nose, neck, loins, inside thighs. Urticaria appearing at the menopause.

Modalities - Better by coffee. Worse by eating, vinegar. Worse after sleep, in morning, slightest movement, especially of the head.

Tongue - Tongue is dry, brown, red tip and margins. Tongue violet in middle, at times trembles on putting in out. Vertigo - Vertigo from the least movement of the head. Giddiness and drowsiness, everything turns around. COMMENTS - Extreme susceptibility to pain. Cannot describe symptoms for tears and sobs. Neuralgia where the pains are so violent as to threaten convulsions, pain causing twitching or jerking of limbs. Nervous spasms brought on by lightning-strike, worse by any exposure to heat, better by cold. Tremblings, twitching, jerking and convulsions, even tetanus. Marked clenching of the jaws. Restlessness and hyperesthesia. Restlessness of legs, wants them held, feels as if worms in them. Heavy and hot head. Intense drowsiness. Deep sleep, but also sleeplessness and restless sleep with starting up. Half sleeping state, “a half-waking, half-stupid state, but with perfect ability to think of different things, though at the same time he was busy with confused fantasies, limbs stiff.” Green vomit is a constant effect. Nausea during pregnancy (Lac-d., Ip.). Sudden fainting. Useful for the after affects of morphine, or morphine withdrawal. Both the muriate and the sulphate are able to cure symptoms produced by Morph. In Clarke's experience, the acetate has produced much more violent gastric symptoms than the muriate, but not different in kind. Rufus Thurston recorded a short but very important proving of Morph, on a patient who took a grain for sleeplessness. Among the symptoms he emphasized “vertigo from least movement of the head.” Not long after, Skinner had a case of vertigo with the tendency to fall forward and become unconscious. Symptoms were worse from movement of any kind, especially of the head, and by eating and drinking. Morph- m. 500c cured the case. Boger cured with Morph-s. 100,000c the case of Miss M., 22, who was dark and spare. She had a headache with the sensation of being wound up tight. Sleepiness and numbness of lower limbs. Intense vertigo on least motion of head. Thurston also had a case with the “woundup” headache. That case also had sudden faintness. That same symptom was produced by one-eight of a grain of the sulphate in a case reported by E. V. Ross. Spells of feeling faint came on suddenly with great anxiety, as though he was going to die. Visual delusions on closing eyes, “sees a man standing at foot of bed. The room seems full of white and colored babies.” RELATIONS - Compare: Apom., Herin., Op., Nux-v. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Kidneys - Suppression of stool and urine. Paresis of bladder. Prostate enlarged. Strangury. Uremia, acute and chronic. Slow anddifftcult urination. Urine is turbid and slimy. Albuminuria. Diabetes.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat. Cold, clammy sweat. Viscid, colliquative sweat.

Temperature - Icy coldness. Chills and rigors. Burning heat, profuse sweat. Heat, burning, itching, cheeks hot and flushed.

name: Moschus Moschiferous
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air. Better rubbing. Better smell of musk. Worse cold, open air, which is felt very cold. Worse from excitement. Worse suppressions. Worse after and during a meal. Worse menses. Worse from pressure. Worse motion, must lie down and lie still, but worse on side lain on. Vomiting worse after sex..
constitution: Alcoholism. Angina pectoris. Awkwardness. Backache. Catalepsy. Choking. Coldness. Coma. Convulsions. Coughs. Croup. Deafness. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Fainting. Flatulence. Globus, hystericus. Headache. Heart, failure. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Impotence. Laryngismus. Lungs, paralysis. Nymphomania. Palpitations. Pregnancy, complaints. Rage. Somnambulism. Sting
