full:
PHARMACY - neuro-1. Neurolaena lobata. Jackass bitters. Golden bitters. Alligator’s foot. Kayabim. N. O. Asteraceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amoebas. Candida. Diabetes. Giardia. Fungus. Hypoglycemia. Lice. Malaria. Parasites. Ringworm. Wounds

HERBAL - Neurolaena lobata is a member of the Asteraceae family and a common Central American plant. It has yellow flowers and bitter-tasting leaves which contain a potent anti-parasitic agent (sesquiterpene dialdehyde), that is active against amoebas, candida, giardia and intestinal parasites. A tea made from the root is used to cleanse the blood, and a leaf tea is used to treat intestinal parasites, malaria, fungus and ringworm. It is also topically to bate wounds to prevent infection, and to use as a hair wash for ridding the hair of head lice. Boiled and strained leaves have been used as an insecticide for house and garden plants. There is some preliminary research that indicates N. lobata helps regulate blood sugar levels, which can ultimately help Neurolaena lobata diabetics manage their condition. A subsequent animal study showed that a tincture of this plant lowered blood glucose levels in animals. RELATIONS - Compare: Chin. REFERENCES - Buttimer. Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nepet. is a children’s remedy for colic and indigestion (Cham, and Mag-p.). Colic and sleeplessness in babies (Cham.). Abdominal complaints, with pain, flexing of thighs, twisting of body, crying. Fretful and irritable children from indigestion. Nervous headache and hysteria. Nervous irritability and insomnia in adults. COMMENTS - Catnip is so named because of the general fondness of cats for this plant. It is said that when the plant starts to wither cats will roll themselves in it and chew it. There is an old belief that it makes cats “frolicsome, amorous and full of battle.” There is also an ancient belief that “if the root be chewed it will make the most quiet person fierce and quarrelsome.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cham., Coloc., Mag-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Collins. Mur- phy. *** NEUROLAENA LOBATA (Jackass Bitters)

name: Niccolum Carbonicum

full:
PHARMACY - nice. Niccolum carbonicum. Nickel metal. Niccolum metallicum. Nickel carbonate (Ni, At. Wt. 58.6). Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthenopia. Clavus. Coryza. Cough. Dysmenorrhea. Face, chapped. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hiccough. Migraines. Nasal, catarrh. Neck, cracking. Ophthalmia. Sneezing. Speech, impeded. Throat, sore. Tongue, stiff. Toothache. Vertigo. Vision, impaired. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nickel is found associated with cobalt. It is said to have received its name, the devil, from miners whoconsidered it “false ore” as they were mining for copper. Cobalt (Kobold) possibly has a similar derivation as nickel forms the chief ingredient in the alloy known as “German silver.” Nickel was proved by Nenning and the pathogenesis contains some striking symptoms, many of which have been confirmed. Sir James Y. Simpson used the sulphate of nickel in “periodic headaches of a very severe character,” and the provings show that the metal and the carbonate are equally appropriate in this connection. Periodic nervous headaches with asthenopia, weak digestion, constipation of debilitated literary persons. Cracking in cervical vertebra on moving the head. Catarrh. Violent hiccough with thirst. Hoarseness. “Must sit up and hold head with both hands with the cough.” The child must be held up when coughing or it will go into convulsions. Must sit up and hold the head with hands or has to put the arms on thighs when coughing, worse night. Great debility in evening. Restlessness, worse at night, from agitation. Tearing and shooting in the limbs and other parts. Compelled to change position continually with vomiting and colic after suppressed menstruation. Dysmenorrhea. MIND - Dullness of mind, does not comprehend the conversation and is unable to relate properly in conversation. Dislike to conversation. Taciturn, fretful. Low-spirited. Disposition to contradict. Vexed and very angry from least contradiction. Irritability during headache. Quarrelsome in evening. Anxious moroseness and inquietude. Anxiety on moving as if sweat would break out. Fears something evil will happen. Trembling and fright with desire for solitude. Restlessness, after midnight. Confusion, as after intoxication, in morning.

Head - Migraines, first on left side. Periodical headaches, every two weeks. Headache all day in forenoon with vomiting of bile. Pain on top as from a nail. Pressure on vertex in morning, worse until noon and in warm room. Stitches.

Eyes - Heat and redness of eyes with pressing in them. Violent twitching in eyes, with lachrymation and difficulty of vision. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Vision very much impaired, especially in the evening. Objects appear too large.

Ears - Stinging in ears. Shootings in ears. Sudden deafness with roaring and humming in ears, in evening.

Nose - Violent sneezing. Obstruction of nose, nose stopped up at night. Coryza, fluent during day and dry during night. Nasal catarrh with redness and swelling at tip of nose. Acute pain at root of nose, extending to vertex and through temples. Stinging, tearing and soreness at root of nose. Eruption on nose. Dryness of nose.

Face - Skin of face chapped. Right side of face red and hot. Redness of face with burning and itching like erysipelas. Swelling of right side of face with sore throat. Painful sensitiveness and cramp Niccolum carbonicum in maxillary joint, which hinders mouth from being easily opened. Twitching of upper lip. Itching tetters on cheeks. Eruption on lips.

Mouth - Breath is offensive, of which he himself is not aware. Bitter taste in mouth in morning. Abundant accumulation of sweetish saliva in mouth. Stiffness of the tongue, it is difficult to talk.

Throat - Hoarseness, every year at same time. Sore, right side with great tenderness, Soreness to touch externally. Sore throat, worse when speaking or yawning. Throat feels sore as if ulcerated on swallowing. Stitches in throat on swallowing. Spasmodic contractions and sensation of strangulation in throat. Roughness in throat better by coughing. Accumulation of thick mucus in throat with stinging pain. Swelling of tonsils on right side, as well as of face and neck, which are painful when touched. Vertigo - Vertigo with nausea and desire to vomit. Vertigo with dizziness and staggering, as from weakness, worse on getting in up in the morning. Vertigo in the morning, when rising after stooping in evening. COMMENTS - W. A. Clausen noted that, in the sore throat, the right side had exquisite tenderness, soreness to touch externally on affected side. Must sit up and hold the head with both hands when coughing, or has to put arms on thighs when coughing. Mahony cured with Nice. 200c a middle- aged woman who had “loose hacking cough day and evening and at 9 a.m., has to put arms on thighs when coughing.” H. Moser cured cases when the pain was worse at 10 a.m. to 11 a.m. and could be so intense as to cause the patient to cry out, appeared first left side, could jump to right, disappeared in evening. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cob., Plat. (2) In “objects appear large,” Hyos., Nat-m., Phos. (3) objects appear small, Hyos., Plat, Stram. (4) objects appear blue, Lyc., Stram., Zinc. (5) Diplopia, rainbow colors around light, Phos.,Gels. (6) Coryza, Nux-v., Sulph. (7) Red face, Ferr. (8) Chapped face Nat-c. (9) Toothache with tearing in ear, Mang. (10) Periodical headache, Gels. Sil., Sulph. (11) Emptiness in stomach, Carb-an., Ign., Sep. - Nice, has it without desire for food. (12) Cracking in neck and stiff jaw, Petr. (13) Headache, menses, chilliness, Puls. (14) Feels refreshed in morning without having slept. Fl-ac., Cob. (15) Annual hoarseness, Ars. ( 16) Literary men, Nux-v. ( 17) Sore throats, Lyc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Gone, empty feeling in epigastrium without desire for food. Acute stomach pains, extending to shoulder. Painful sensation of constriction of stomach. Fullness in stomach after eating. Thirst and intense hiccough, especially in evening. Bitter and sour belchings. Nausea. Diarrhea and tenesmus after milk.

Abdomen - Abdominal pains go from left to right. Violent stitches, as with knives in hypochondria. Pinching around navel. Painless rumbling in abdomen. Tension of abdomen and discharge of flatulence.

Rectum - Constipation, ineffectual urging to go to stool. Stool very hard and only discharged with great effort, has to press hard to discharge the stool. Diarrhea with yellow mucus, expulsion with great force and much flatulence. Diarrhea after drinking milk with tenesmus, preceded by cuttings or burning in anus. During stool, burning and stitches in rectum and anus. After stool, anal itching, burning and stitches. Sensations - As if sweat would break out. As if brain were cut to pieces. As if she had not slept enough. As if a nail was sticking in head. As if neck sprained.

Male - Itching on a small spot of scrotum, scratching does not relieve. Erections, worse after dinner.

Female - Menses premature, scanty and of too short duration. Menses late, scanty with great debility and burning in eyes. During menses, bloated abdomen, colic, pain in small of back, great debility, burning of eyes. Profuse leucorrhea, worse after menses, after urinating (Mag-m., Plat.), watery after urination. Food - Farinaceous taste in mouth on rising in morning. Risings with taste of roasted meat. Aversion to meat. Want of appetite. Thirst in evening. Violent thirst day and night.

Chest - Pressure and heaviness on chest. When coughing, dyspnea and pressure on chest. Stitches in chest when breathing. Shootings in chest, especially when laughing. Pain, as from excoriation in chest. Constitutions - Hering said it is suited to literary people who suffer from periodical nervous headaches, weak, asthénopie, weak digestion, constipation, worse morning on awaking.

Back - Cracking in cervical vertebrae when moving the head. Pain in neck, as from a sprain. Stitches in small of back, in afternoons. Pain in the small of back during a soft stool.

Limbs - Headache feels heavy, tremble, feel bruised. Pain in shoulders as if sprained. Rheumatic pains in elbows, extending to hands in fingers. Heaviness in the hands and feet, better by motion. Feet feel heavy, tremble and are weak. Stitches in left heel. Lungs - Hoarseness. Dry, hacking, regular cough with stitches in chest. Obliged to sit up and hold head, must put arms on thighs. Violent cough at night. Dry, scraping cough with sleeplessness. Cough from tickling in trachea. Expectoration of white mucus.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from midnight until 4 a.m. Wakefulness. Frequent awakening at night from agitation. Pain in swollen face wakens him at night, it is better by cold. Awakens after midnight with colic. Feels as if she had not slept sufficiently.

Skin - Itching over the whole body, but mostly on the neck, as from fleas, not better by scratching, but followed by small vesicles. Itching and pimples in small of back. Itching on shoulders, scratching does not relieve. Itching tetters.

Modalities - Better in open air, evening, after eating. Cold helps pain in face. Coughing helps roughness of throat. Worse periodically, every two weeks, yearly, forenoon. Worse from motion, pressure, after midnight. Talking and yawning aggravates sore throat.

Teeth - Swelling of gums. All teeth feel loose and elongated. Gnawing toothache in evening. Toothache with tearing in ears toothache with tearing in right ear. Sour, fetid secretions ooze from decayed molar teeth.

Kidneys - Increased secretion of urine, also at night. Burning at orifice of urethra during urination. Burning urine. After urination, discharge of thin leucorrhea.

Temperature - Chill is preceded or begins with yawning and sleepiness. Chill with chattering and shaking, followed by profuse general perspiration. Continuous chill with moist palms of hands. Heat with perspiration and thirst, followed by chill. Anxious heat with violent thirst. Fever, restlessness and vomiting at night. Morning sweat.

full:
PHARMACY - nicc-s. Niccolum sulphuricum. Nickel sulphate.Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Headaches. Hot flashes. Menopause. Migraines. Neuralgia, periodic. Spinal, pains.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nicc-s. is for weak, asthénopie literary persons with weak digestion and constipation, who are worse in morning and suffer from periodic headaches and hoarseness. Urine and saliva increased. Coppery taste in mouth. Periodic neuralgias of malarial origin. Menopausal disturbances. MIND - Nervous, uneasy. Restlessness, cannot settle down to any occupation. Desire to recline, tired.

Head - Periodic headaches, occipital pain, extending down to spine, worse lying on back, sore pain in eyes.

Female - Dull aching in ovaries with sensation as if menses appear. Hot flashes, followed by perspiration on parts touching each other, when separated become dry.

Back - Stiff, numb sensation, worse in neck. Spine sore. Spinal pains, legs and arms heavy and weak, cannot lie on back.

Limbs - Awakened in morning with burning soles. COMMENTS - J. Y. Simpson cured with Nicc-s. periodical headaches of very severe character. Hale used with success the Nicc-s. 2x trituration in periodic neuralgias of malarial origin. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - nicot-r. Nicotiana rustica. Tobacco. Nelson’s horsenettle. N. O. Solan- aceae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, pain. Absent-minded. Allergies. Asthma. Backache. Belching. Brain-fag. Bronchitis. Cancer. Canker, sores. Chills. Collapse. Convulsions. Coryza. Coughing. Delirium. Distension. Dyspnea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Fainting. Flatuence. Hay fever. Headaches. Insomnia. Itching. Lachrymation. Lung,disorders.Nausea. Palpitations. Photophobia. Rumbling. Salivation. Seasickness. Sinusitis. Spasms. Tetanus. Tobacco, effects. Ulcers. Unconsciousness. Vertigo. Vesicles. Vomiting. Weakness.

HERBAL - Tobacco refers to a genus of broad-leafed plants of the nightshade family indigenous to North and South America, or to the dried and cured leaves of such plants. Tobacco leaves are often smoked (see tobacco smoking) in the form of a cigar or cigarette, or in a smoking pipe, or in a water pipe or a hookah. This could damage the lungs and could also potentially cause lung disorders such as asthma. Tobacco is also chewed, “dipped” (placed between the cheek and gum), and sniffed into the nose as finely powdered snuff. Nicotiana rustica is a very potent variety of tobacco. The high concentration of nicotine in its leaves makes it useful for creating organic pesticides. It is also used for religious purposes by South American shamans. Growing in the rainforest it contains up to twenty times more nicotine than common North American varieties such as Nicotiana tabacum.

HOMEOPATHIC - Richard Pitt conducted a recent proving of Nicotiana rustica which was written up in his book called Tobacco. Tobacco contains the nicotine, a powerful neurotoxin that is particularly harmful to insects. All means of consuming tobacco result in the absorption of nicotine in varying amounts into the user’s bloodstream, and over time the development of tolerance and dependence. Nicotine is the key alkaloid found in tobacco. Extremely addictive and poisonous, one or two drops of pure nicotine can be lethal. In some varieties of Nicotiana rustica, the nicotine content of the leaves can be as high as 20 percent. Toxic effects of tobacco include perspiration, light-headedness, general weakness, tremors, convulsions and respiratory paralysis. Interestingly, one of the keynote symptoms of Tabacum is a sinking feeling, usually associated with nausea. This was confirmed in the Nicotiana rustica proving, but the feeling of sinking was also seen in its psychological sensations, making it a theme of the remedy. The sinking was explained in different ways, from a falling from a high place into the earth, a falling through space, a general sinking feeling in the body. The sinking feeling was confirmed in the stomach and abdomen region. The vertigo symptoms were confirmed and also elaborated on with Nicotiana rustica. This falling, sinking feeling was consistent throughout the remedy picture, and more modalities were confirmed than are currently found with Tabacum. Physically, there were strong vertigo symptoms, one prover experienced debilitating vertigo for over 4 weeks. There were characteristic headache symptoms, often described as being neuralgic in nature, and also eye and face symptoms which were neuralgic in nature. In the ear and nose symptoms, there was a particular feeling of “openness”, which could parallel some of the mental experiences, a sense of opening to other dimensions, or like the earth opening up, creating an abyss or chasm. The nose also had some itching and tickling and a delusion of smelling smoke or a herb. The mouth had symptoms of tingling, and also a feeling of numbness, showing the alternating state of the remedy. Deathly nausea is one of the well-known characteristics of Tabacum. The stomach and abdomen showed similarities to that of tabacum, with a sinking feeling, an emptiness and hollowness, along with the characteristic nausea. Along with the sinking feeling, there was a rising feeling, and feeling like a wave, revealing a similar state to the mental experiences of rising and sinking. In the respiratory system, there were some cough symptoms, often of a tickling nature, worse by any cold, air or water and in the chest some sharp, stitching pains, similar to heart symptoms. There were some characteristic symptoms in the back and limbs with aching, burning and stitching sensations. Also in the limbs, there were sensations of weakness, heaviness, fatigue, a sprained feeling, and jerking spasms. All the joints were affected, including the feet and hands. The shoulder and arm symptoms and general aching should be compared with Lycopersicum (tomato), another solanaceae remedy. There were some interesting sleep symptoms, especially waking suddenly from sleep, as if from a jolt or a feeling of being half awake and asleep. There was extreme tiredness, even a feeling of complete collapse. Similar to Tabaccum, there was an extreme feeling of chill, going through the whole body, including the bones. The coldness was felt both externally and internally. In general, there was a feeling of weariness, heaviness and exhaustion and also the opposite, a feeling of energy circulating the body, a feeling as if to take off, to fly, along with an up and down feeling, a rocking sensation and vibrations throughout the body, a nervous excitation and pulsating in the body. There was a desire for salty food, sweets and ice cream and an increased thirst. Faintness. Emaciation. MIND - The mental image of the proving also revealed a heightened sense of awareness, clarity and lightness. Full of ideas. Anxiety from smoking tobacco. Mental excitement. Joy and cheerful feelings. Increased mental dullness. Absentminded. Confusion of mind. Difficult concentration. Sadness. Depression about being away from loved ones. Hurried feelings. Nervousness andrestless. Impulsive. Fear of heights. Fear of falling. Fear to go to sleep. Awkwardness. Aversion to exertion. Delusion to be sinking. Delusion of being possessed. Mind and body are separated. Delusion of floating in air. Delusion that air is flowing through him. As if in a dream. Delusion of once being in an earthquake. The clarity and light seemed psychedelic in nature and was connected to the feelings of being between sleep and waking. The connections between life and death were also seen in the dreams, with themes of birth and death and also dreams of the past. Both the dreams and waking state revealed a sense of being in between both states.

Head - Itching of head. Congestion. Constriction sensation. Heaviness sensation, in morning, on waking. Headache from tobacco smoke. Headache from strong odors. Dull pain in forehead and temples. Fullness sensation. Pressing, pulsating pains. Pain on sides of head. Tingling, vibrations, wavelike sensations. Sinus headache. Opening sensation in frontal sinuses, in the morning, on waking.

Eyes - Itching of eyes. Dryness. Lachrymation. Eye pains. Burning pain. Stinging and stitching pains. Photophobia. Sensitive to sunlight, must close the eyes. Tired sensation, better from closing eyes. Eye tension and strain. Swelling.

Ears - Fullness sensation. Redness. Itching. Heat sensation in left ear. Pulsation of eardrum. Ear pains, in morning, on waking. Burning, pressing pains. Crackling noises in ears. Sensitive hearing to high pitched noises.

Nose - Nasal congestion, obstruction. Allergies. Hay fever. Coryza. Nasal discharge clear, watery or y Mow. Nasal discharge in morning on waking. Sinusitis. Sensitive to odors of flowers, food, mothballs, smoke. Burning in nostrils. Sneezing. Sensation of air flowing through bridge of nose.

Face - Eruptions. Red face, cheeks. Rash on Nicotiana rustica chin, forehead, cheeks. Pimples, tingling, painful to touch. Numbness. Jaw pains. Pressing, stitching pains. Clenched, stiff jaws. Crunching noise when closing jaws.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth, lips. Tingling of lips, mouth. Itching of the corners of mouth. Salivation. Vesicles, gums. Taste wanting. Canker sores. Ulcers.

Throat - Constriction. Dryness of throat. Itching. Sore throat, worse on swallowing. Burning pain. Sore throat on waking in morning. Scraping sensation, better cold drinks. Disposition to hawk. Swallowing difficult. Tickling in throat, better coughing. Larynx, cold sensation.

Stomach - Acidity. Burning pain. Cramping pain. Churning sensation. Indigestion. Belching, bending forward, agg. Stomach distension after eating. Flatus. Rumbling. Nausea. Nausea in morning. Deathly nausea. Nausea, better drinking. Nausea from smoking tobacco. Nausea, better urination. Wavelike sensation. Sinking, emptiness, sensation. Hollow sensation in stomach.

Abdomen - Coldness. Distension. Rumbling. Flatuence after eating. Flatuence from emotions. Fullness sensation. Itching. Abdomen pain, better from belching, passing flatus. Cramping pain in morning on waking. Cutting pain umbilicus region. Sinking sensation. Swelling of abdomen in morning on waking.

Rectum - Constipation. Ineffectual urging and straining. Flatus. Inactivity of rectum. Soft stool. Dark stool. Hard stool. Sensations - Pulsations. Rocking sensation and vibrations. Wavelike sensation. Sinking, emptiness, sensation. Hollow sensation. Sensation of air flowing.

Female - Menses bright red, copious. Menses, scanty. Itching of vagina. Increased sexual desire. Irregular menses, returns after having been ceased. Food - Thirst. Desires ice cream, sweets and salt.

Chest - Anxiety in chest. Chest pain. Constriction. Burning pains axilla. Coughing - Asthmatic coughs. Dry cough. Coughing with gagging. Painful, irritable coughs. Tickling cough. Sudden coughs. Paroxysmal coughs. Violent coughs with jerking of body. Coughing from eating, cold drinks.

Heart - Anxiety in heart region, worse when thinking of it. Palpitations. Sensation of pulse reverberating throughout the body.

Back - Bubbling sensation in spine. Buzzing sensation in lumbar region. Backache. Neck, sore, aching pains. Back pain between the scapulae. Aching pain. Burning pain in spine. Sharp pains dorsal region. Lumbar spasms. Stiffness of back, neck. Breasts - Aching pains. Burning pains above nipples. Nipple pains. Sharp pains in breasts, nipples.

Limbs - Icy cold foot. Burning pains. Convulsion on side not lain on. Dryness of hands. Eruptions, red spots. Itching of hands and feet. Heaviness sensation of lower limbs while walking. Paralysis sensation. Sensation as if shoulder is dislocated. Stiffness of lower limbs. Tin- glings. Pulsations in wrist and shoulders. Trembling and weakness. Sensation as if ankle is sprained. Lungs - Catching respiration. Bronchitis. Shortness of breath. Expectoration difficult. Tingling. Sensation as if lungs are expanding.

Sleep - Insomnia, protracted. Sleeplessness after waking. Wakes aftermidnight. Wakes 2:30 a.m. to 3:30 a.m. Wakes unrefreshed in the morning. Half awake while dreaming. Dreams of childbirth. Dreams of falling. Dreams of high places. Amorous dreams. Dreams of mortification, grief. Dreams of old friends, children. Dreams of animals, pets.

Skin - Cold skin. Eruptions, itching. Sensation of air flowing in and out of skin. Pimples. Stinging pain.

Modalities - Better open air. Worse in mornings, on waking.

Tongue - Tingling of tongue. Sensation as if tongue is enlarged, swollen. Tongue numbness. Vertigo - Vertigo with disorientation and weakness. Vertigo as if in an earthquake. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo with wavelike sensations. Vertigo as if floating. Vertigo worse exertion, morning. Vertigo better from sitting. Vertigo on rising. Vision - Blurred vision. Acute vision. Objects seem to approach then recede. Sensation that their vision was lost. Weakness of vision. COMMENTS - Tobacco smoking carries significant risks including the potential to develop various cancers as well as strokes, and severe cardiovascular and respiratory diseases. Significantly shorter life expectancies have been associated with tobacco smoking. Many jurisdictions have enacted smoking bans in an effort to minimize possible damage to public health caused by tobacco smoking. The substantially increased risk of developing cancer as a result of tobacco usage seems to be due to the plethora of nitro- samines and other carcinogenic compounds found in tobacco and its residue as a result of anaerobic heating, either due to smoking or to flue-curing or fire-curing. The word death is interesting in relation to this substance. The above facts of the use of tobacco are testament to the toxicity of tobacco and its impact on societies throughout the world. It is the most widely used drug known to man, having spread originally from the Americas to the rest of the world. Nicotiana plants were frequently seen in cemeteries, reinforcing the connection between tobacco and the other world. RELATIONS - Compare: Tab., Nicot. REFERENCES - Pitt.

Temperature - Chilliness. Icy coldness of body. Bones cold. Chill, morning, forenoon. Chills beginning in the feet, moving upward. Fever alternating with chills. Cold feeling upper body.

name: Nicotinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Aura of epilepsy. Brain-fag. Collapse. Delirium. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Fainting. Headache. Lachrymation. Lung, disorders. Nausea. Seasickness. Spasms. Tetanus. Tobacco, effects. Unconsciousness. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.
keynote:
PHARMACY - nicot. Nicotinum. Nicotine. An alkaloid from Nicotiana tabacum. N. O. Solanaceae. Solutions in distilled water or alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aura of epilepsy. Brain-fag. Collapse. Delirium. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Fainting. Headache. Lachrymation.…
full:
PHARMACY - nicot. Nicotinum. Nicotine. An alkaloid from Nicotiana tabacum. N. O. Solanaceae. Solutions in distilled water or alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aura of epilepsy. Brain-fag. Collapse. Delirium. Dyspnea. Epilepsy. Fainting. Headache. Lachrymation. Lung, disorders. Nausea. Seasickness. Spasms. Tetanus. Tobacco, effects. Unconsciousness. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nicot. had a very heroic proving by Flak, Wochenfeld, Wertheim, Schroff and Reil. Very violent tonic and clonic spasms were produced. Dullness of senses. Loss of consciousness. Alternate tonic and clonic spasms, followed by general relaxation and trembling, nausea, cold sweat and speedy collapse. Coldness extends from fingertips and toes over trunk. Jerking respiration. Breathing difficult and impeded, every respiratory effort consisting of a series of short jerks in quick succession. So weak could scarcely hold up head. Paroxysms of faintness beginning with a vanishing of senses and ending with loss of consciousness. Great aversion to tobacco and tobacco smoking. One prover, a smoker was unable to smoke more than a few whiffs, the other, a non-smoker, could not approach any one who was smoking. MIND - Excitement. Inability to think or fix attention on any subject. Delirium with frightful vision. Uneasiness. Brain-fag. Loss of consciousness.

Head - Dullness of head, heaviness, dizziness, stupefaction. Head drawn back with rigidity of muscles of neck and back.

Eyes - Pupils dilated. Indistinct vision with sensitiveness of eyes to light. Lachrymation. The eyelids feel too heavy.

Ears - Indistinct hearing, sensation as if ears filled with cotton.

Nose - Expired air had odor of alcohol.

Face - Face pale, features drawn. Sensation of an aura in upper jaw.

Mouth - Increased saliva. Scraping, burning taste, especially low down in throat, causing hiccough and hawking. Sharp, burning sensation in tongue.

Throat - Dryness and scraping in throat. Sensation as though a sharp brush drawn through esophagus to stomach. Sensation of dysphagia. Vertigo - Vertigo and headache. COMMENTS - Increasing clonic spasms, trembling limbs, extending over whole body, which violently shakes. Head drawn back, contraction of eyelids and masseter muscles, muscles of neck and back rigid, hissing respiration from spasm of laryngeal and bronchial muscles. RELATIONS - Antidotes: See under Tab. Compare: (1) Tab., Dig., Lob., Absinth. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Stomach - Loss of appetite. Emptiness and faintness in stomach and intestines. Disagreeable sensation extending from stomach upwards and downwards. Hiccough. Eructation with some vomiting which relieves.

Abdomen - Distended. Disagreeable sensation through whole intestinal canal.

Rectum - Excessive desire for stool, better by emission of flatus and urine. Stool retarded. Sensations - Great sensitiveness of eye to light, along with indistinct vision. Aura in upper jaw. As though a sharp brush had been drawn through esophagus to stomach,

Chest - Oppression, compelling deep breathing. Sensation of foreign body behind sternum.

Heart - Pulse and respiration very irregular, sometimes becoming very rapid, sometimes sinking. Constant sinking of pulse. Pulse increased in frequency in direct proportion to dose.

Limbs - Formication, beginning in fingertips, extending to the wrists and afterwards to elbows. Weakness of lower limbs, on going up stairs, Lungs - Breathing, very rapid and difficult.

Sleep - Sleepy. Restless night, sleepless, hot and excited.

Skin - Dryness of skin.

Kidneys - Urgent desire, urine copious, increased.

Temperature - Shaking chill. Limbs icy cold. Coldness beginning in fingertips and toes and extending to trunk. Cold sweat. Sensation of warmth commencing in stomach, rapidly extending over chest and to head and like a streaming into fingertips and toes, not followed by sweat.

PHARMACY - nig-s. Nigella sativa. Black cumin. Common Fennel flower. Blessed seed. N. O. Ranunculaceae. Tincture from rectangular black seeds. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Amenorrhea. Asthma. Belching. Bites. Bronchitis. Colic. Coughs. Dysmenorrhea. Gallstones. Gout. Fevers. Flatulence. Hemorrhoids. Indigestion. Jaundice. Leucoderma. Paralysis. Parasites. Ringworm. Salivation. Whooping cough. Worms.

HERBAL - Nigella sativa is the fennel flower of the buttercup family. It is sometimes confused with the fennel plant (Foeniculum vulgare). It has blue flowers and black seeds, which have been used in Egyptian and Arabic medicine. Avicenna maintained that it is an expectorant and tonic for low energy and apathy. Affects the digestive tract and the respiratory tract. It acts as a tonic for weak digestion, colic, gas and belching. Dry coughs, asthma, bronchitis and whooping cough. Leucoderma, skin allergies, periodic fevers, hemorrhoids. A special oil is extracted from Nigella which was used in herbal formulas as a digestive tonic and stimulant. Undiluted Nigella oil causes irritation to the stomach and intestines, increases the flow of breast milk, stimulates the menstrual flow and causes excessive salivation. It helps prevent gout if added to the diet. COMMENTS - Placing the powdered seeds in a cloth and inhaling them helps reduce the common cold. A decoction of the black seeds helps amenorrhea, dysmenorrhea, intestinal worms, fevers, paralysis and hemorrhoids. Adding the seeds to the diet will help prevent gout. Drinking a tea made from the crushed seeds with honey can help dissolve gallstones and kidney stones. The tea also increases the flow of the breast milk, the menses and urine. An ointment was used to stimulate the growth of the beard and helps prevents hair graying. Used externally forringworm. Dog bites and spider bites. The smoke of black seeds drives insects away. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lyc. REFERENCES - Al-Akili. Murphy.

Photophobia. Prosopalgia. Salt, abuse. Scarlet fever. Scurvy. Tibia, pains. Typhoidfever. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nit-s-d. was proved by Lembke. Poisonings give a perfect picture of the typhoid state. Hahnemann recommended it for hospital typhoid with apathy In fevers, Hahnemann advised that Nit-s-d. should be given a few drops dissolved in an ounce of water, a teaspoonful every three hours. typhoidfevers with symptoms of cerebral paralysis. Sensorial apathy in low fevers when there is stupor, difficulty of arousing patient is met by this remedy. Great fatigue, a recumbent position can alone mitigate and tranquilize it. Excessive emaciation. Swelling of veins. Very sensitive to cold. Catching cold in stormy weather causes prosopalgia. Ill effects of excessive salt intake (Phos.). Sore mouth of salt eaters. Salty taste. Dry skin, nausea, flatulence. Dropsy. Excellent diuretic. Acute nephritis following scarlet fever. Urine very scanty. Bloody diarrhea. Scurvy. Hands covered with warts. Ithasbeenusedasaremedyfor incarcerated gallstones, given beaten up with an egg yolk and applied outwardly in the same form. The symptoms of Nit-s-d. go from below upward, worse on passive motion, riding in carriage. Worse from cheese. Nit-s-d. has been found to be an antidote to several medicines. It increases the action of Digitalis. MIND - Excessive ill-humor. Irascibility, passion and quarrelsome disposition with tendency to weep. Complete apathy, without desire for anything. Lies indolently without sleeping or speaking. Dislike to labor and conversation. Delirious and incoherent in manner. Hears and desires nothing, unconscious. Dizzy as if intoxicated, when roused could answer questions, complained of headache and said he found it difficult to walk straight.

Head - Confusion, fullness, heaviness in forehead. Violent boring pain in forehead. Drawing, tearing pain, pressure and heaviness in head. Boring or pressure in temple. Pressure, heaviness and heat in occiput. Stitches in vertex. Drawing pain on scalp.

Eyes - Black spots and rings float before eyes. Pupils contracted. Pupils somewhat dilated, acting feebly. Stitches in eyes and lids, burning on margins. Twitching of eyelids.

Face - Prosopalgia with photophobia. Burning in cheeks. Very sensitive to cold. Boring in facial bones in angles of lower jaw. Twitching in middle of left upper lip. Chronic soreness in corners of mouth, patient eats much salt. Food - Want of appetite. Worse after eating, from cheese. Ill effects of excess salt (Nat-m., Phos.).

Mouth - Heat in mouth, sour taste. Salivation. Accumulation of water, mucus in mouth. Taste, salty on tip of tongue. Tongue dry. Cutting, burning and stitches in tongue. Tearing drawing pain in teeth. Canker sores after eating cheese.

Throat - Increased mucus, dryness in throat. Sensation of contraction in throat with pain. Stitches in larynx, constriction. Sensation as if a plug in gullet. Cramp from below upward in esophagus. Vertigo - Vertigo with dullness. Vertigo while sitting, upper part of body sways to and fro. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Calc., Carb., v., Caust., Con., Kali-c., Nat-c., Nat-m., Kali-nit., Op., Sep. Antidote to: Nat-m. (crude or in potencies), Nat-c., Phyt. Compare: ( 1 ) Ph-ac., I,yc. - worse afternoon, fullness after meals. (2) Coloc. - worse from cheese. (3) Hell., Ph-ac. - typhoid, sensorial apathy, stupor, Ph-ac. has apathy more pronounced than Nit-s-d., Hell, most of all. Incompatible with: Dig., Ran-b. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Empty eructations. Paroxysmal cutting deep in stomach, with flushes of heat and hot sweat. Contractive pain and aching in stomach with sensation of fullness, immediately after a meal, from eating too much salt. Continued nausea and loathing. After a meal, vomiting of sour matter and mucus, followed by headache. Vomiting, followed by lassitude. Vomiting and purging.

Abdomen - Shootings, cutting and burning pains in abdomen. Cutting in umbilical region. Stitches in left side below navel. Rumbling in abdomen. Colic. Incarcerated gallstones.

Rectum - Bloody diarrhea after purging from salt. Bloody diarrhea after purpura, caused by excessive use of salt. Epidemic dysentery with lethargy. Marked constipation.

Male - Violent cutting pain in tip of urethra.

Chest - Painful constriction behind sternum. Pressure and stitches in chest. Stitching in skin of left axilla.

Heart - Feeling of pressure in heart. Violent beating of heart.

Back - Backache. Violent pressure in nape and cervical vertebra. Pressure and stitches in region of spine. Drawing in scapulae. Sensation as hot water creeping through back from below upward. Causations - Salt, cheese. Stormy weather.

Limbs - Wandering pain in limbs. Pressure, boring and stitches in muscles and joints. Lungs - Short, dry cough. Dyspnea. Shortness of breath and wheezing, while eating, before attack of prosopalgia. Inhalations intermit. Very rapid breathing by going only a short walk.

Sleep - Lies in bed motionless.

Skin - Crawling in skin. Skin and tongue dry. Warts from having used too much salt. Shiverings and acute drawing pains in the bones.

Modalities - Worse from mental disturbance. Worse when cold, during winter and spring, afternoon. Walking aggravates breathing and heat.

Kidneys - Frequent desire. Increased urination, clear urine.

Perspiration - Inclination to perspire during fever.

Temperature - Internal chills with cold hands. Creeping chills under skin. Typhoid fever with sensorial apathy and semi-paralysis of brain, wild, staring eyes. Adynamic fevers with nervous symptoms such as shootings, jerkings, etc.

PHARMACY - nit-ac. Nitricum acidum. Nitric acid. Aqua fortis. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Actinomycosis. Allergies. Antibiotics. Anus, fissures. Arthritis. Axilla, perspiration. Blisters. Bladder, catarrh. Breath, offensive. Bright’s disease. Bronchitis. Bubo. Cachexia. Chancre. Chilblains. Choking, easy. Colds, easily taken. Condylomata. Constipation. Coms. Coughs. Diarrhea. Dysentery, Dyspepsia. Ear, disorders. Epilepsy. Esophagitis. Eyes, disorders. Feet, perspiring. Fistula. Freckles. Frostbite. Glandular, swellings. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gums, sore. Hay fever. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hem- orrhoids Hernia. Herpes. Herpes. Ingrown toenail. Iritis, syphilitic. Irritation. Jaundice. Jawjoint. Keloids. Leucorrhea. Mastoiditis. Menopause. Menses, profuse. Metrorrhagia. Mouth, sore. Mucous, patches, Muscae volitantes. Myopia. Nails, disorders. Ozaena. Palpitations. Paralysis. Perspiration, abnormal. Phimosis. Polyps. Proctitis. Prolapsed, anus. Prostate, suppuration. Ranula. Rectum. Rickets. Ringworm. Salivation. Spinal, injury. Syphilis. Taste, disordered. Tongue, ulceration. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Warts. Wens. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Aqua Fortis of the alchemists. Used in old-schools practice as an escharotic for warts and warty tumors, for phagedenic ulcers, chancres, poisoned bites. Had been used internally in fevers to quench thirst in bronchitis and tuberculosis to diminish the excessive secretions in some cases of syphilis in phosphaturia. Brunton noted that it has been injected into the bladder in a dilute form to dissolve stones. When strong nitric acid comes in contact with the skin it destroys the upper layers and turns them yellow, but as it coagulates their albumen it forms a barrier against its own further action, its action therein differing from that of Sulphuric acid. When swallowed it acts as an irritant poison. When its fumes are inhaled, it may cause suffocating spasms of the glottis or intense bronchitis. In the store of Mr. Harold Woolley, in Manchester, a two-gallon bottle of nitric acid fractured. Water was thrown upon the bottle and whiting placed about it to neutralize the fumes which issued from the fracture. Mr. Woolley supervised the process and was in contact with the fumes for two hours. This happened in the afternoon. The next day, Mr. Woolley complained of being unwell and although medical aid was promptly summoned, he died at 5 o’clock in the afternoon. Death was attributed to rapid congestion and inflammation of the lungs in consequence of inhaling the fumes. Nitric acid belongs almost equally to all three of Hahnemann’s miasms: psora, syphilis and sycosis. It is one of the chief antidotes of Merc., and is useful in cases of syphilis that have been overdosed with Merc. As the nitric acid patient begins to improve, skin symptoms may appear for a time, a favorable indication. Marked affinity for the margins of the outlets especially of the throat, anus and mouth. Orifices are red, swollen and cracked. Mucus membranes are dark, smooth. It affects glands, particularly the liver, prostate and salivary. Patients are greatly debilitated, trembling, shivery, sensitive and sore. Exces- sive physical irritability. Pains as from splinters. Sticking pains. Ulcerative grating. Pains as if flesh is torn from the bones. Slight pain affects him violently. Pains appear and disappear quickly (Bell.). Bones painfully sore. All discharges are very offensive, especially urine, feces and perspiration. Discharges are acrid, thin, dirty or brown, they cause redness or destroy hair. Stubborn suppuration. Malignancy. Decay and exostoses of bones. Ozaena, foot or night sweats on parts lain on. Hemorrhages, easy, bright or bloody water. Capillary bleeding after currettage. Blisters and ulcers in mouth tongue, genitals, bleed easily. Fissures with pain during stool, as if rectum were torn. Cachexia, due to syphilis, scrofula intermittent fever with liver involvement and anemia, etc. Phagedena. Fistula. Syphilis. Gravel. Arthritis. Sycosis. Cancer. Convulsions, epileptiform, at night and going to bed. Frequent vertigo during the day. Marked improvement of all symptoms while riding in a carriage. Sensitive to medicines given in high potency. MIND - Mind is weak. Weakness of memory. Confusion. Indifference. Thoughts vanish after mental exertion. No disposition to work to perform any serious business. Mind easily affected, inclined to weep. Weeps from discontent of himself. Sensitive to noise, pain touchjar. Impetuous during daytime. Anxiety from thinking about it. Anxiety about health. Fear of cholera, death. Easily frightened. Anxiety from night watching, loss of sleep. Anxiety during a thunderstorm. Anxiety on ascending steps. Restlessness after midnight. Discontented, with everything, with himself. Pessimism. Sadness. Taciturn. Despondency. Hopeless despair. Refuses consolation on one’s misfortune. Sadness before menses. Suicidal disposition with fear of death. Sympathetic. Holds grudges. Constantly thinks about past troubles. Unmoved by apologies. Estranged from family. Hatred of persons who had offended. Inveterate ill-will. Anger, over his mistakes. Irritable, hateful, vindictive, headstrong. Irritability when spoken to. Excitability, peevishness, quarrelsome. Violent anger. Fits of rage and cursing. Trembling from anger while quarrelling. Profane, cursing.using vulgar language. Quarrelsome delirium, talks to spirits in other tongue. Delusions, thought he was about to die, yet is not physically ill.

Head - Head feels hot. Sensation of a band around head. Crushing head pains. Headaches from pressure of hat, full feeling, worse from street noises. Painful tension within head with nausea. Headaches as if head were in a vice. Piercing pain in temples. Pulsating headache. Violent throbbing, hammering pains. Headaches, worse motion and jar, better riding in a carriage. Skull sore. Decay of mastoid bone. Scalp sensitive. Puffy swelling on scalp. Moist scabby, itching eruption on scalp. Falling of hair from vertex.

Eyes - Sharp, sticking pains. Gonorrheal ophthalmia, photophobia, constant lachrymation. Syphilitic iritis. Ulceration of cornea. Fistula lachrymalis. Double vision. Eyelashes, stiff, all point towards nose (right). Paralysis of upper eyelids.

Ears - Very sensitive to noise (Coff., Nux- v.). Cracking in ears when chewing. Decay of mastoid. One’s speech echoes in ears. Deafness from enlarged and indurated tonsils after measles, better noise in trains or riding in a carriage. Swelling of glands behind and beneath ears. Cystic tumors on lobes of ears.

Nose - Nosebleeds, dark, clotted with chest affections, worse crying. Allergies, hay fever. Nasal diphtheria with watery and excoriating discharge. Frequent sneezing, without coryza during sleep. Coryza with shortness of breath. Coryza with sore and bleeding nostrils. Chronic nasal catarrh with yellow offensive, corrosive discharge. Ozaena. Green casts from nose every morning. Stitches, as of a splinter in nose. Cutting pain in the nose, decay of bones. Red, scurfy tip.

Face - Yellow, sickly. Dark freckles. Pimples on face. Blood boils on chin. Comedones. Peeling of lips. Angles of lips raw, cracked or scabby. Corners of mouth raw, cracked or scabby. Stitches as from splinters in upper lip when touched. Submaxillary glands swollen and painful. Cracking in jaws when chewing.

Mouth - Putrid breath. Salivation. Bloody saliva with green coating on tongue. Sore palate. Ulcers in soft palate with sharp, splinter-like pains. Ranula. Bites J the tongue and cheek. Gums, swollen, 1 sore, flabby. Gums bleeding inner side. Margin of mouth covered with sores and blisters.

Throat - Dryness and heat in throat. Sharp, stinging pains, with rawness as if sore and ulcerated. Throat pain goes into ears. Sharp pains, as from splinters, on swallowing. Difficult swallowing. Cutting in the larynx. Diphtheritic patches on tonsils and fauces. Uvula and tonsils edematous. Tonsils, red, swollen, uneven with small ulcers. Hypertrophy of tonsils, after angina. Hawks out mucus from posterior sinuses. White patches. Hoarseness. Aphonia with dry, hacking cough from tickling in larynx and pit of stomach.

Stomach - Dyspepsia with excess of oxalic acid, uric acid and phosphates in urine and great mental depression. Dyspepsia from abuse of salt. Esophagitis. Pain in cardiac orifice. Eructations sour, empty. Eructations during menses. Indigestion and nausea. Nausea with sour belch- ings, cannot take food. Nausea with occasional vomiting, better riding in a carriage. Bitter and sour vomiting with much eructation. Vomiting of tenacious or bloody mucus. Vomiting of mucus and food, from cough.

Abdomen - As of a dry, hot cloth on abdomen. Colic relieved from tightening clothes. Inguinal hernia of children.

Rectum - Bowels constipated with fissures in rectum. Great straining, but little passes. Tearing pains during stools. Stools tear the anus, even though soft. Diarrhea, slimy and offensive. Diarrhea from antibiotics drugs, penicillin. After stools, irritable and exhausted. Violent cutting pains after stools, walks in agony (Rat.). Ulcerations after dysentery. Hemorrhages from bowels, profuse, bright. Hemorrhages from rectum after removal of hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids bleed easily. Anus, itching, eczematous or oozes moisture. Burning in rectum after urination. Prolapsed anus. Sensations - As if a mouse running up and down left side. Pain as from splinters in eruption. As if splinters in great toe, in carbuncles, etc. As if a band about or weight hanging to the part. As if head in a vice from ear to ear over vertex. As if someone were forcibly pressing head, head tightly bound, constricted by tape, contused. As if a gathering in left temple. As if warm water were flowing from and over eyes (first right, then left). As if teeth soft and spongy. As if abdomen would burst, as if a boiler working in bowels. As if a band around bones. As if dogs were gnawing flesh and bones and as if sinews were being pulled up. As if ball of great toe had been frozen.

Male - Itching, burning foreskin. Edema of prepuce. Phimosis. Strictures from gonorrhea or syphilis. Soreness and burning in glans and beneath prepuce. Ulcers, burn and sting, exude offensive matter. Red, scurfy spots on prepuce or on corona glandis. Phagedenic chancres.

Female - Menses early, profuse like muddy water with pain in back, hips and thighs. Leucorrhea, brown, flesh- colored, watery or stringy, stains yellow or leaves spots with black border. Bloody water from vagina or hemorrhages from overexertion. Uterine hemorrhages after childbirth or curetting. Vaginitis. Stitches through vagina. Voluptuous itching of vagina after sex. External parts sore with ulcers (Hep., Merc., Thuj.). Hair on genitals falls out (Nat-m., Zinc.). Food - Appetite variable or absent. Great hunger with sweetish taste. Great thirst. Aversion to cheese, bread, sight and smell of meat. Dislikes meat, things sweetened with sugar, bread. Longing for indigestible things, chalk, earth. Loves fat, herring and salt (Sulph.). Craving for cheese, fish, carbonated drinks, sweets. Worse milk and fatty food. Worse after eating. Bitter taste after eating.

Chest - Congestion in the chest with palpitations and fear. Sensation as if bound by an iron band. Catching at every attempt to breathe. Stitches in sides of chest. Soreness at lower end of sternum. Offensive sweat in axillae at night. Constitutions - Hydrogenoid constitution. Sycotic remedy. Persons who have chronic diseases and take cold easily, disposed to diarrhea. Acts best on the dark complex- ioned, middle age or older. Persons of dark, swarthy complexion with black hair and eyes, lean persons of rigid tissue. Brunette rather than blonde. Nervous temperament. Old people with great weakness.

Heart - Nervous palpitation caused by slightest mental excitement. Palpitations and anguish on going upstairs. Palpitation with heat, anxiety and trembling, during menses. Pulse rapid and small beats. Pulse intermits at fourth beat, irregular.

Back - Stitching pain in lumbar back when coughing. Pain in back at night, better lying on abdomen. Stitches in and between scapulae. Stiff neck. Breasts - Hard nodes or atrophy of breasts. Causations - Ill effects of loss of sleep from nursing the sick. Injury to spine. Antibiotics drugs, penicillin, mercury.

Limbs - Offensive foot sweat, causing soreness of toes with sticking pain, chilblains on toes. Offensive sweat in axilla at night. Sweating of palms, hands, cold. Warts on back of hands. Finger joints swollen. Herpes between fingers. Blue nails. Nails, distorted, discolored, yellow, curved. In- grown nails with ulceration and a feeling of splinter, worse touch. White spots on nails. Tibia painfully sore. Pain in patella, impeding walking. Weak ankles, cracking when walking.

Sleep - Sleepiness during day. Drowsy all day from debility with vertigo. Shocks on going to sleep. Pains come during sleep. Starts in fright on falling asleep. Frequent waking and inability to fall asleep again after a long time. Sleeplessness after 2 a.m. Sleeps badly latter part of night. Sobbing during sleep, with anxious dreams. Anxious, unrefreshing sleep with frightful dreams. Wakes too early in morning, or difficult waking.

Skin - Actinomycosis. Warts, large, jagged, bleed on touch or washing. Condylomata. Ulcers bleed easily, sensitive. Ulcers with splinter-like pains. Ulcers zigzag, irregular edges, base looks like raw flesh. Stubborn suppuration. Burrowing pus. Exuberant granulations. Crusts form and fall. Black pores on face, papules worse on forehead. Coppery spots, on shinbones. Dry skin, eroded, cracked in every angle. Skin itches on undressing. Old scars become painful in cold weather.

Modalities - Better from gliding motion, riding in a carriage. Better steady pressure and mild weather. Worsefrom touch jarring, rattling, motion, mental exertion or shock, noise. Worsecoldair, coldclimate, dampness, evening and night, changing weather, hot weather, heat of bed. Worse mercury, loss of sleep.

Teeth - Yellow teeth. Teeth feel elongated. Coldness in teeth. Teeth as if soft and spongy. As if teeth would fall out. Decay of teeth. Teeth become loose, gums soft and spongy. Toothache on taking anything cold or hot into mouth. Toothache and swelling of gums during menses. Pulsating, stinging in evening in bed and all night. Gums red and enlarged between teeth. Gums white, swollen. Itching on gums. Bleeding of gums.

Tongue - Tongue, clean, red with center furrow. Moist fissured or mapped tongue. Painful pimples on the sides of the tongue. Tongue sensitive, even to soft food, causes smarting. Vertigo - Vertigo with obscuration of sight. Vertigo with nausea followed by eructations. Vertigo with weakness, must sit down. Vertigo with pulsation in head and pressure in middle of brain. Vertigo when raising head after stooping. Vertigo in evening, after lying down. Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo during menopause. COMMENTS - Affinity for the mucocutaneous orifices and adjoining parts, particularly the intestines, throat, and mouth. The mouth, especially in the angles, and anus are prominent seats of syphilitic action and also of the action of the other miasms, the condylomata and fissures of sycosis, the fissures, fistula, hemorrhoids and sore mouth of psora. Salivation, sores in the mouth, sore throats. Mouth symptoms are often confused with Merc. Characteristic offensive discharges, thin, excoriating. If purulent, they are a dirty yellowish green, not laudable pus. Ulcers on the skin and in the mouth. Ulcers have profuse exuberant granulations and bleed easily. Suppuration. Painful scars. Characteristic sticking pain, as if from splinter, in any part of the body. Pain comes aftertouch or movement. Pains, even slight ones, affect him violently. Cramp-like pains, stinging, shooting, burning, pressure and soreness. Twitchings in various parts, frequent starts in upper part of body. Leftsided paralysis. Sensitiveness to touch runs through the entire symptomatology including the symptoms of the mind. The head is sensitive to the slightest jar, to the rattle of wagons in the street, or even to the step of one walking across the floor, to the pressure of a hat, sensitive to combing and on part lain on. Eruptions and ulcers bleed easily when touched. Eyes are sensitive to light. Sensitiveness of the head while out driving, stopping suddenly. The tongue is sensitive even to soft food. Chilly. Easily catches colds. Hyperallergic, multiple allergies. Excessive physical irritability, hysteria. Anxiety (Ars.), obsession about their health. Fixed ideas that they have a disease. Extremely pessimistic. Negative attitude, irritable, complaining. Arrogant. Hateful and vindictive. Prostration, sick feeling, faints from least motion. Deafness, epilepsy, better riding in carriage. Emaciated. Ailments from nursing loved ones (Cocc., Caust., Nux-v.). Night watching (Caust., Cocc., Nux-v., Care., Phos.). Exhausting sweats towards morning, chilly. Profuse, fetid sweats on feet, hands or in axilla. Flashes of heat in hands and feet. Sudden rush of blood to the chest. Hectic, frequent hemorrhages, bright, red, profuse. Hemorrhages occurring in cachectic women after confinement or abortion. Shatp stitches through right chest to scapula. Tuberculosis when the chest walls are extremely sore to touch. Great dyspnea, cannot talk for getting out of breath. Morning hoarseness. Tickling cough, seems to annoy all night, at times loose and rattling. Loud rales through chest, offensive sputa, bloody. Strong smelling urine, very offensive. Typhus when pneumonia supervenes, also when the bowels hemorrhage. Stools are green, slimy offensive, may be purulent, exhausting. Slimy stools from excess of mucus passed with much straining. Stools may be pale, pasty, sour, and offensive, especially in scrofulous children. The stool is putrid in children, may contain lumps of casein. Dysentery and colitis. Tendency to acute or chronic diarrhea. Diarrhea with every cold (Ars.). Diarrhea from diet, or since antibiotics. Rawness and soreness of the anus with diarrhea. Pain after stools, whether loose or constipated. As if anus and rectum were torn and pierced, violent pains after stool lasting for hours. Anal fissures with bloody stools and mucus. Anal warts. Burnett made a cure of actinomycosis with Nit-ac. 3x in a patient who had seen many London consultants and had doubtless taken much Kali-i. The localities in which the disease manifested itself, the region of the mouth and anus, gave Burnett his indication. H. N. Coons recorded the case of an anemic woman who, four weeks after miscarriage, had constant pelvic hemorrhages, at times coming with a gush, a constant heavy feeling, much worse standing or walking. Nit-ac. 2x, 20 drops in three ounces of water, a teaspoonful every two hours, quickly arrested bleeding and cured. W. M. James cured a case in which a girl had frequent attacks of petit mal, sometimes as many as fifty a day, between the periods. At the beginning of menses she had spasms so violent that they dislocated both humeri. Giving Nit-ac. 200c persistently gradually put an end to the attacks. The first few times after beginning treatment, there were spasms but no dislocation. D. C. Perkins related the case of a woman who said she was very ill, but could only describe her illness by saying that she “felt Nitricum acidum like a pulp-mill.” Nit-ac. has “borborygmus as if a boiler was working in the bowels,” and proved to be the remedy. Mohr gave Nit-ac. 3x to a man who suffered from liver cancer with bloody diarrhea, followed by constipation, and violent pains in the stomach and liver. He was unable to sleep or to take any food without much pain, vomiting. Nit-ac. removed the pain and relieved the constipation entirely, and the patient died without an hour’s suffering from the time he received treatment. J. H. Fulton cured M., 28. with one dose of Nit-ac. 200c. M. had bleeding hemorrhoids for eighteen mouths. He had frequent bloody and slimy stools, and bright red blood after stools ranging in quantity from a dessert spoonful to half a tea cupful. When the stools were hard there was much pain in passing them. Burning in the anus after stools. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Calc., Hep., Merc., Mez., Sulph. It antidotes: Calc., Dig., Merc. Compare: (1) Merc., Kali-c., Thuj., Hep., Calc. (2) Calad. (3) Ars. - morbid fear of cholera. (4) Med., Syph., Mur-ac., Nit-m- ac., Merc. (5) better riding in carriage. Graph. (6) Spinal injuries, Am., Rhus-t., Hyper., Calc. (7) Punctured wounds. Hyper., Led. (8) Worse on awaking. Lach., Nat-m. Sulph. (9) Ingrown toenail. Mag-aust. (10) Stringy leucorrhea, Kali- bi. ( 11 ) Pains appear and disappear suddenly, Lyc., Bell. (12) Pains affect violently, Aeon., Cham., Hep. (13) Strong odor of urine, Benz- ac. (14) Splinter pains, Arg-n„ Hep., Sul. (15) Sore, excoriated anus, Merc., Sul., Cham., Ars., Puls., Syph., Chin. (16) Ulcers threatening to perforate cornea, Sil., Calc. (17) Condylomata, enlarged tonsils, fissures, balanorrhea, greenish leucorrhea, Thuj. (18) Ulcers, Merc. Compat- ible before: Calc., Puls., Sulph., Am. -collapse in dysentery, Kreos. - diphtheria dysentery, Sec. - gangrene of mucus membrane, Sulph. (scrofulous ophthalmia). Compatible after: Calc., Nat-c., Puls., Sulph., Thuj., Carb- an. - bubo, Kali-c.- tuberculosis, etc., Aur. - abuse of Merc.. Mez. - secondary syphilis, Hep. - throat, etc. Incompatible: Lach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Jaundice, aching in liver. Lungs - Shortness of breath on going up stairs (Sil., Calc.). Panting breathing when reading or stooping. Short breath from uterine displacements. Cough in sleep without waking. Cough shattering from a dry spot in larynx, with stitching pain in lumbar region, worse cold, winter. Empyema. Expectoration, muco-purulent, yellow, bitter offensive, smeary, accompanied with sweat. Hemoptysis. Cavernous tuberculosis.

Kidneys - Infective nephritis. Contracted kidney. Cramps from kidney to blad der. Burning and stinging. Dyspepsia with excess of oxalic acid, uric acid and phosphates in urine and great mental depression. As of a hot tire in urethra. Painless retention or incontinence of urine. Stream thin, as from stricture. Urine, smells strong as horse’s or offensive. Urine feels cold when it passes, alternately profuse and scanty. Scanty, dark offensive urine. Urine bloody and albuminous. Alternation of cloudy, phosphatic urine with profuse urinary secretion in old prostatic cases. Hematuria with shuddering along the spine.

Perspiration - Sweats easily, then takes cold. Exhausting profuse sweats in morning. Sweats in axillae, on feet and hands (in spinal injuries). Night sweats on part lain on.

Temperature - Icy coldness of soles. Chilly, continuous. Chills after lying down. Chills from least exposure. Chills in room or at fire. Chills in waves up each side of spine and over chest. Chills with aversion to heat. Chills with internal heat. Dry heat, at night, with violent thirst. Heat flushes with sweat on hands. Heat flushes of single parts, or over entire body. Dry heat, internal, at night, wants to uncover. Blood seems hot at night, causes sleeplessness.

name: Nitrogenium Oxygenatum
author: Murphy
constitution: Anesthesia. Bedwetting. Convulsions. Drowsiness. Epilepsy. Faintness. Headache. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Lungs, congestion. Muscular, weakness. Opisthotonos. Unconsciousness. Vertigo. Weakness.
keynote:
