Eyes - Blue rings around eyes. Lusterless, glassy, staring, sunken, dull appearance. Yellow spots on conjunctiva. Pupils dilated. Eyeballs feel large. Pain as if eyeballs were forcibly pressed together and into head. Optic nerves seem torpid. Photophobia, averse to sunlight. Sees colors as if a rainbow. Loss of vision from masturbation. Lids inflamed and cold.

Ears - Earache after blowing the nose. Shrill sound in ears on blowing the nose. Intolerance of noise, especially music, which causes stitches, even while singing himself. Illusions of hearing, hears bell pealing. Every sound re-echoes loudly in the ear. Roaring with difficult hearing. Nervous deafness after typhoid-like fevers.

Nose - Bleeding. Nose swollen with red patches or pimples on tip of nose. Itching. Bores fingers into nose.

Face - Pale, earthy, sickly. Tense as if egg white had dried on it. Sensation of coldness of one side of face. Acne from onanism. Hairs of beard fall out.

Mouth - Lips dry, cracked. Mouth dry .Taste of rotten eggs. Tongue swollen, dry with viscid, frothy mucus, slimy. Red streak in middle of tongue. Bleeding, swollen gums, retract from teeth. Painful nodosities on the gums. Teeth become yellow and feel dull. Teeth feel cold. At night, bites tongue involuntarily.

Throat - Dry palate. Hoarseness. Hawks up tough mucus. Vertigo - Vertigo toward evening, when standing or walking. Vertigo, as if floating in the air, while lying in bed with ringing in the ears and glassy eyes. COMMENTS - Convalescent remedy. Chronic fatigue since a debilitating acute. Heavy limbs, droopy eyelids, drained feeling, chills and fever (Gels.). Mononucleosis and flu with extreme weakness. Draining, debilitating chronic illness. Emaciation with dark circles around their eyes, sunken faces and apathy. Spacey and empty eyes. Chronic fatigue with weight loss, especially after grief, emotional loss, loss of fluids, or fevers. Debilitated and tired since grief (Gels., Sil.). Grief, leading to falling of hair, premature senility and depression. The hair may turn gray or fall out in patches. Homesickness (Caps.), with weight loss, insomnia, and pining. Chronic mental exertion or worry. Lack of emotions (Aur., Sep.). Apathetic (Gels.). Aversion to loved ones (Sep.), with weakness. Feels indifferent about future. Listless. Decreased mental function. Lack of direction, empty (Ign.). Blank mind, spacey, cannot concentrate. May have a history of excessive sexual activity and loss of sexual fluids. Chronic seminal discharge, prostatorrhea. Weakness and apathy from masturbation or excessive sexual activity (Sei., Agn.). Effects of chronic masturbation. Severe impotence with a history of masturbation or too much sex. Lack of sexual desire or function. Used in some countries as a tonic for sexual debility. May have a history of drug use. Vertigo with the sensation as if the feet were rising until he stood on his head. This symptom occurred in a patient of Skinner's suffering from smallpox. The disease had been cut short by Vario., when the patient, a woman, complained that her feet were rising to the ceiling and begged her nurses to keep them down. Ph-ac. speedily put her straight. Illusions of the senses as well as of the sensorium, bells are heard, ciphers, sparks, etc., are seen. Exalted sensitiveness to light, sound and odors, “odors take away his breath.” Becher, one of Hahnemann's provers, noted that his right pupil became widely dilated while the left remained normal. The more he strained the eye, the wider the pupil became until the iris had almost disappeared. Great weakness, better by short sleep (Phos.). Legs tremble when walking, limbs are difficult to control. “Weak feeling in chest from talking, coughing or sitting too long, better by walking.” Hoarseness and nasal voice. Dyspnea, capillary bronchitis. Cough, as if a feather tickling from middle of chest to larynx, low down in chest. The cough is worse in evening, after lying down. Muco-purulent, salty, bloody, offensive expectoration. Cough causes headache, nausea and vomiting of food, spurting of urine. Every draft of air causes fresh cold. Dry mouth and throat. Involuntary biting of tongue in sleep. Thirsty for ice cold drinks, bubbly drinks and mineral waters, fresh fruit juice with ice, sparkling fruit juices. Diabetes, when there is a history of sexual excess or of severe mental or emotional over-strain. Emaciation with diabetes. Copious discharges appear in the sweat and urine. Polyuria. White, milky urine and also white stools. The urine may be clear as it is passed, but turns milky at once and is very offensive. Bedwetting, the child passes a great quantity of urine. Excessive flatulence. Distention and passing of flatus in large quantities, sometimes with the odor of garlic. Weakened sphincters, involuntary escape of feces and urine, especially on coughing or movement. Keynote “persistent, painless, watery diarrhea often containing undigested particles of food and which does not debilitate.” Diarrhea in children who are emaciated and dehydrated. Weight loss from severe diarrhea. Children feel better when they're having diarrhea (Calc., better constipated). Bloating of the uterus with gas. Menses are excessive and premature. Debility from breast-feeding. Dark, profuse, passive hemorrhages. H. Maandblad offered the case of a married woman, 36, mother of eight children, who had for some time been so melancholy and depressed as to be unable to fulfill her household duties. There was no discoverable mental cause, though her condition had been made worse by a sudden death in the family. The beginning of the illness was apparently a weakness of the stomach, small appetite, always pain and distention after eating, the food seemed to lie long in the stomach undigested. Ph-ac. 6x, ten drops three times a day, soon restored the patient. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Coff., Staph. Compare: (1) Care., Chin., Nux-v., Mur-ac., Pic-ac., Lac- ac., Phos. (2) Oeno., Evening primrose - effortless diarrhea with nervous exhaustion. Incipient hydrocephaloid. Whooping cough and spasmodic asthma. (3) Nect. - watery diarrhea, dry tongue, colic, bluish ring around sunken eyes, restless sleep. Compatible: Chin., before or after in colliquative sweats, diarrhea and debility after Nux-v. in fainting after a meal after Rhus-t. in typhoid. Followed well by: Ars., Bell., Caust., Lyc., Nux-v., Puls., Sep., Sulph., Calc-p., Ferr-p., Kali-p., Nat-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Symptoms following sour food and drink. Pressure as from a weight, with sleepiness aftereating (Fei.). Acidity. Sour risings. Nausea.

Abdomen - Aching in umbilical region. Enlarged spleen (Cean.). Coldness. Distention and fermentation in bowels. Loud rumbling. Offensive, garlicky flatus.

Rectum - Stools involuntary, escape with flatus. Profuse, painless, dirty white, watery or lienteric stools, odorless, with little debility. Diarrhea in weakly, delicate children with rickets. Sensations - As if intoxicated, as if head would burst. As if weight in head, as if brain crushed. Bones as if scraped with a knife. As if eyeballs too large. As if egg white had dried on face. As if lower jaw were going to break. Nausea as if in soft palate in throat. Heavy load in stomach. Uterus as if filled with wind. Tickling in chest as with a feather, as with down in larynx. Red-hot coal on arm and shoulder. As if ants crawling over body. As if feet going up.

Male - Sexual power deficient. Weak, relaxed genitals during sex, preventing emission (Nux-v.). Weakness and pollutions after sex. Nightly emissions with lascivious dreams. Seminal vesiculitis (Ox-ac.). Prostatorrhea, even when passing a soft stool. Tender and swollen testes. Edema of prepuce and swollen glans penis. Sycotic excrescences (Thuj.). Herpes. Eczema of scrotum.

Female - Menses too early and profuse, with pain in liver. Itching, yellow leucorrhea after menses. Uterus bloated, as if filled with wind. Dysuria during pregnancy. Food - Loss of appetite. Craves juicy things. Thirst for cold milk, sodas, carbonated drinks, mineral water, ice water. Sour food and drinks disagree.

Chest - Takes cold from drafts on chest. Chest troubles after brain-fag. Pressure or twisting behind the sternum, rendering breathing difficult. Weak feeling in chest from talking (Stann.). Dry cough from tickling in chest. Salty expectoration. Constitutions - Suited to persons of originally strong constitution weakened by loss of fluids, excesses, violent, acute diseases, chagrin or a long succession of moral emotions. Children and young people who have grown too rapidly, tall, slender and slim with pains in back and limbs as if beaten, growing pains. Persons of mild disposition.

Heart - Irregular, intermittent pulse. Palpitations after grief, after masturbation, in children and young persons who grow too fast.

Back - Pain in back and limbs, as if beaten. Lumbar region heavy, increases pain in legs. Boring pain between scapulae. Paralytic weakness along spine. Formication or burning along spine. Spondylitis of cervical vertebrae. Fine stitches in coccyx and sternum. Boils on buttock. Breasts - Sharp pressure in left breast. Milk scanty, health deteriorated from nursing. Infants vomit milk constantly. Causations - Ill effects of bad news, disappointed love, grief, chagrin, shock. Separation from home. Loss of fluids, sexual excesses. Over-lifting, over-study. Injuries, operations.

Limbs - Weak. Great debility. Pains at night as if bones were scraped. Tearing pains in joints, bones and periosteum. Numbness along radial nerve. Stumbles easily and makes missteps. Formication in limbs. Burning below the waist. Cramps in upper arms and wrists. Heavy forearms. Wens on hands between metacarpal bones. Itching, between fingers or in folds of joints.

Sleep - Weakness is better from short sleep. Sleepy by day, hot and wakeful at night. Deep sleep, but when aroused, fully conscious, during fevers. Lascivious dreams with emissions.

Skin - Clammy, wrinkled. Pimples, acne, blood boils. Burning red rash. Tendency to abscess after fevers. Painless ulcers with stinking pus. Formication in various parts. Falling out of the hair (Nat-m., Sei.).

Modalities - Better from warmth, after short sleep, stool. Worsefrom loss of vital fluids, sexual excess, fatigue, surgery, convalescence from fevers. Worse from emotions, grief, chagrin, mental shock, homesickness, unhappy love. Worse chronic fright (Care.). Worse from being talked to, talking, sitting, standing, lifting. Worse cold drafts, music.

Liver - Liver, seems to be too heavy, painful during menses. Lungs - Spasmodic tickling cough. Salty expectoration.

Kidneys - Burning in kidney region. Diabetes. Frequent urination at night. Bedwetting during first sleep. Urination preceded by anxiety and followed by burning. Urine is profuse, watery, milky. Phosphaturia. Whey- like urine shortly before menses.

Temperature - Low types of fever with dull comprehension and stupor. Sluggish, painless fevers. Fever with sweat. Profuse sweat during night and morning. Chilliness. Cold parts, one side of face, abdomen.

Worse from warm food or drink, salt. Worse lying on left side or painful side, on back. Worse from touch, physical exertion, ascending stairs, shaving, odors. Worse mental exertion, emotions, talking, puberty, sexual excess, loss of fluids..

full:
PHARMACY - phos. Phosphorus. The element (P., At. Wt. 30.96). Saturated solution in absolute alcohol. Trituration of red amorphous Phosphorus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alopecia areata. Amaurosis. Amblyopia. Anemia, pernicious. Anus, fissure. Arteries, disease. Asthma. Bone, diseases. Brain, disorders. Breast, abscess. Breastfeeding, disorders. Bronchitis. Bruises. Cancer. Catalepsy. Cataracts. Catarrh intestinal, nasal. Chilblains. Chlorosis. Chorea. Ciliary neuralgia. Coccyx, pain. Colds. Constipation. Corpulency. Coughs. Croup. Dandruff. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Esophagus, pain. Exophthalmos. Exostosis. Eye disorders. Fainting. Fatty, degeneration. Fistula. Flatulence. Fungus hematodes. Gastric, fevers. Gastritis. Glaucoma. Gleet. Gums, ulceration. Hemoglobinuria. Hemop/ri/ia. Hemorrhages. Headaches. Heart, degeneration. Hepatitis. Hydrocele. Hydrocephalus. Hypoglycemia. Hysteria. Impotence. Infertility. Injuries. Intussusception. Jaundice. Keratitis. Laryngitis. Lightning, effects. Liver, disorders. Locomotorataxia. Lung, disorders. Marasmus. Menor- rhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Morphinism. Musca volitantes. Muscular, atrophy. Nevus. Nails, disorders. Neuralgias. Nightmares. Nosebleeds. Osteomalacia. Osteomyelitis. Osteoporosis.Pancreas, disorders. Paralysis. Periostitis. Petit mal. Plague. Pneumonia. Polyps. Pregnancy, vomiting. Proctitis. Pruritus, ani. Psoriasis. Puerperal, convulsion. Purpura, hemorrhagia. Pylorus, thickened. Retinitis. Rheumatism, paralytic. Rickets. Scurvy. Sexual mania. Shiverings. Sleep, disorders. Sleepwalking. Spine, curvature. Spleen disorders. Sprains. Stammering. Syphilis. Syringomyelia. Throat, sore. Tobacco, effects. Trachea, tickling. Tuberculosis. Tumors, cancerous. Typhus fever. Ulcers. Urethra, stricture. Vaccinosis. Variola. Voice, loss. Whitlow. Wounds. Yellow fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phosphorus was discovered in 1673 by Brandt, an alchemist ofHamburgh, and shortly afterwards by Kunkel in Saxony. According to Teste, attempts were made to use it in medicine immediately after discovery. Kunkel made it into his “luminous pills,” and Kramer claimed to have cured with it diarrhea, epilepsy and malignant fevers. Teste offered a list of old-school cures, which included continuous, bilious and intermittent fevers, general edema, measles, two cases of pneumonia of the left lung with ataxic symptoms, chronic rheumatism of the legs, strokes, hydrocephalus, periodic headaches, catalepsy, epilepsy, and chronic lead poisoning. Hahnemann's provings have been added to by later provings, by numerous cases of poisoning and by the effects on workers in match factories, most notably, necrosis of the lower jaw. The vapor given off by unignited phosphorus is phosphorus oxide. The jaw affection, called “the phossy-jaw” by the workers, is accompanied by profound adynamia and frequently ends in death. The form of the disease differs according to whether the upper or lower jaw is attacked. In the former case, it generally pursues a chronic and mild course, ending in exfoliation, scars and cure. In the latter, the necrosis may be either acute or chronic, but is always severe and the patients usually die of “tuberculosis” fever. Phos. irritates, inflames and degenerates the mucus membranes. It inflames the serous membranes, the spinal cord and nerves. It causes paralysis and destroys bone, especially in the lower jaw and tibia. It disorganizes the blood, causing fatty degeneration of blood vessels and every tissue and organ of the body. It gives rise to hemorrhages and hematogenous jaundice. Phos. produces a picture of destructive metabolism. It causes yellow atrophy of the liver and sub-acute hepatitis. Ill effects of iodine and excessive use of salt. Great sensitivity to external impressions to light, sound, odors touch, electrical changes, thunderstorms. Human barometer (Merc.). Great susceptibility to external im- pressions, light, sound, odor touch, electrical changes, etc. Insidious onset, gradually increasing debility, ending in severe or rapid disease. Sudden symptoms, sudden prostration, faints, sweats, shooting pains, etc. Sudden prostration from a profound shock. The left side is more affected than the right, the venous more than the arterial system. Polycythemia. Blood extravasations. Hemophilia. Hemorrhages, recurrent, vicarious, small wounds bleed much. Blood streaked discharges. Purpura hemorrhagica. Easily bleeding polyps. Healed wounds break out again and bleed. Pyemia. Jaundice, as a concomitant, hematogenous. Internal, itching, tickling, throbbings here and there. Numbness. Burnings. Jerking, localized, subsultus. Joints, stiff with little pain, sprains, easily dislocated, weak spells in joints, worse exertion. Pain or soreness in spots. Decay of the bones, spine, upper jaw. Hard swelling here and there. Osteomyelitis. Bone fragility (Calc-p.). Exostoses. Fatty degenerations. Lipoma. Cancer. Erectile tumors. Tertiary syphilis, skin lesions and nervous debility. Muscular pseudo-hypertrophy, neuritis. General paralysis of the insane with mania of grandeur, in a stroke. Duchenne's pseudo- hypertrophic paralysis in locomotor ataxia and other paralyzes. Ataxia and adynamia. Uncertain, involuntary acts. Spasms on the paralyzed side. Epilepsy with consciousness. Petit mal. Symptoms due to heart and lung disorders. Inflammation of the respiratory system. Recurrent effects colds, croups etc. (Ferr-p.). Tightness in chest, cough etc. Emptiness or heaviness in the chest, stomach etc. Craves ice cold drinks and food. Acidosis (Nat-p.). Cirrhosis. Scurvy. Emaciation. Flabby muscles. Totters while walking. Ailments from losses of fluids, over-work of brain, sexual excesses and abuse. Worse lying on left side. MEND - Mentally and emotionally sensitive. Over-sensitive to external impressions, noise, odors and lights. Excitable, impressionable. Quickly prostrated by unpleasant impressions. Great tendency to be startled from noises. Can't endure sound of piano, from great weakness of head. Sensitive to bad news, horror stones. Sympathetic to others. Sensitive to others pain and sufferings. Nervous and restless in crowds. Anxious, restless, fidgety, can't sit still or stand for a moment, better while standing. Anxiety for others, about friends at home. Anxiety, when lying on left side, during thunderstorm. Anxiety as if he had committed murder. Frightened easily, better weeping. Fear arising from stomach. Fear of being alone, of death when alone. Fear at twilight, of the dark, of ghosts, monsters, of imaginary things. Fear of thunderstorms. Fear something bad will happen, when thinking of disagreeable things. Fear about future, of insanity. Timid and irresolute. Lacks willpower to undertake anything. Loss of memory. Brain feels tired. Spacey can't keep mind on any subject. Stupor, is aroused with difficulty and immediately relapses. Apathy is unwilling to talk and answers slowly. Indifferent even towards her own children (Sep.). Retarded development of speech in children. Melancholy, disinclined to work, study, converse. Sadness during headache. Sadness in darkness. Great lowness of spirits. Depression arising from belief that he has an incurable disease of heart. Weary of life. Prostration of mind from trifles. Suicidal disposition, better weeping. Weeps before menses. Weeping during palpitations. Wants sympathy. Betterfrom company and consolation. Weeping alternating with attacks of involuntary laughter. Laughs at serious things. Laughing when sad. Irritable and spacey when misses a meal. Offended and hurt easily. Easily angered and vehement, beside himself with angerand suffers physically from it. Rage when aroused. Hypocrisy. Insanity with exaggerated idea of one's own importance. Monomania in chronic alcoholism. Clairvoyant. Ecstasy. Desires to be magnetized. Confusion, better washing face. Paralysis of the insane. Amorous, will uncover his body and expose his genitals. Sexual thoughts intrude and crowd upon each other. Shamelessness. Accuses herself of obscene actions of which she had not been guilty. Delirium, loquacious, with difficult respiration. Delirium that he was in several pieces and could not collect them. Fearfulness, as if something were creeping out of every corner. Imagines he sees faces grinning at him from the corners of the room. Destroys everything, spits at nurse, kisses those who comes near her.

Head - Headaches, heavy, over one eye, with hunger. Sick headache, with pulsations and burning. Headaches with weakness and strained feeling of eyes. Pains preceded by dimness of sight. Headaches with increased sensitiveness to odors. Headaches before thunderstorm. Chronic congestion of head. Heat comes up from Phosphorus spine. Burning pains in temples. Shooting pains from one temple to other. Pulsating, pressing, boring and burning, in one or the other temple. Stupefying headache, in vertex. Vertex throbs, hot after grief. Chronic meningitis. Neuralgia, parts must be kept warm. Burning pains. Brain-fatigue with coldness of occiput. Softening of the brain with formication, numbness of limbs. Tendency to atrophy of brain in old age. Periostitis of skull. Feels as if pulled by hair. Skin of forehead feels too tight. Clammy sweat on head. Copious dandruff. Itching of scalp. Falling of hair in large bunches, in spots.

Eyes - Glaucoma. Cataract (Calc-f.). Vitreous opacities. Atrophy of optic nerve. Degenerative changes in retina. Thrombosis of retinal vessels. Retinal bleeding. Choroiditis. Yellow eyes. Frequent itching in eyes. Sensation of sand in left eye, better rubbing. Burning in eyes, with profuse lachrymation in wind. Photophobia. Aversion to light. Symptoms after an iridectomy. Eyes turned outwards. Eyeballs feel large, stiff. Fatigue of eyes and head even without much use of eyes. Paresis of extrinsic muscles. Edema of lids and about eyes. Pain in orbital bones. Hollow, with blue rings around eyes.

Ears - Otitis media. Mastoiditis (Caps.). Polyps in the ear. Tickling and itching in ears. As if foreign bodies were lodged. Something seems constantly in front of ears. Echoes and reverberations of sounds, especially music (Caust.). Ringing noises, with palpitations. Roaring, from rush of blood. Constant buzzing. Hearing difficult, especially human voice. Dull hearing after typhoid.

Nose - Nose swollen, red, shiny, painful to touch. Ulcers in the nose. Decay. Periostitis of nasal bones. Nervous fanlike motions of alae nasi (Lyc.). Polyps, bleeding easily (Calc., Sang.). Nosebleed instead of menses. Nosebleeds in children, youths. Nosebleed, then pneumonia with cough during stool. Chronic catarrh with hemorrhages, handkerchief is always bloody. Acute coryza, with dull headache. Coryza, alternately fluent and dry, on alternate sides. Sneezing, worse odors, smoke with dyspnea, causes pain in the throat. Sneezing and coryza on putting hands in water. Nose obstructed in morning. Oversensitivesmell (Carb-ac., Nux-v.). Faints from smell of flowers. Foul imaginary odors (Aur.). Loss of smell and taste.

Face - Pale, sickly complexion, blue rings under eyes. Puffiness under eyes. Color of face very changeable. Hippocratic countenance. Skin as if too tight. Skin burns on shaving. Burning heat and redness of one or both cheeks. Lips, blue, dry, cracked, sooty, scabby. Crack in middle of lower lip. Ulcerated corners of mouth. Facial neuralgia. Prosopalgia, worse opening mouth. Mouth drawn to left. Tearing pain in facial bones. Swelling and necrosis of lower jaw (Amph., Hecla.).

Mouth - Much watery saliva. Salty or sweetish salivation. Taste bitter of rotten eggs in morning. Sour taste after milk, bitter, sweetish, when coughing. Aphthous patches on roof of mouth and tongue. Itching of palate. Abscess of hard palate. Gums bleed easily, sore behind central incisors. Persistent bleeding after tooth extraction. Mouth drawn to the left. Speech difficult, stutters. Sore mouth from nursing.

Throat - Dryness in pharynx and fauces. Dry, glistening. Rawness, roughness and scraping in throat, worse toward evening. Tendency to get sore throats that go into the lungs. Larynx very painful, sore, painful on speaking. Feeling of rawness in larynx from passage of inspired air. Larynx feels as if lined with fur. Violent tickling in larynx while speaking. Burning in esophagus. Stricture of esophagus. Tonsils and uvula swollen. Uvula elongated. As of cotton or something hanging in throat. Pain in throat on coughing. Sweetish taste while coughing. Low, hoarse voice, worse morning and evening. Hoarseness, worse evenings. Can't talk on account of pain in larynx. Croupy voice, followed by bronchitis. Sudden aphonia. Aphonia, worse evenings, with rawness.

Stomach - Tremors, fluttering or something rolling over in stomach. Sore spot in pit. Stomach cold as if frozen. Empty, hollow feeling in stomach, as if hanging down, worse emotions. Gnawing pain. Pain in stomach, better cold drinks. Burning in stomach, worse eating. Burning in esophagus. Gastritis with heartburn. Water brash. Hiccough. Sour taste and sour belchings after every meal. Bitter, tasteless eructations. Nausea on putting hands in warm water. Constant nausea with confusion of head. Regurgitates ingesta. Throws up food by the mouthfuls. Water is thrown up as soon as it gets warm in the stomach. Vomiting of bile, blood, coffee grounds. Post-operative vomiting, after chloroform. Stomach ulcer.

Abdomen - Feels cold (Caps.). Abdomen distended and painful to touch. Rubs abdomen for relief. Sharp, cutting pains. Very weak, empty, gone sensation felt in whole abdominal cavity. Weakness in abdomen, before menses. Sore spot in pit of stomach. Pressure above epigastrium. Painful pulsation in right hypochondrium. Varicose veins all over abdomen. Boils. Large, yellow spots on abdomen. Pancreatic disease and diabetes. Pancreatic disease with fatty stools. Loud borborygmi. Incarcerated flatus. Flatulent colic, worse hot drinks. Frequent pinching pain in bowels as if diarrhea were about to come on. Inguinal hernia with relaxed abdomen.

Rectum - Urging for stool, on lying on left side. Stool difficult to expel. Stricture of rectum, stools flattened. Great weakness after stool. Dysentery. Exhausting diarrhea. Dianhea during pregnancy or confinement. Morning diarrhea of old people. Alternating diarrhea and constipation in old people. Nervous, involuntary stool after fright. Anus open, prolapsed. Painful cramps in rectum. Needlelike stitches in rectum. Tearing in anus, better warm cloth. Fissure of anus. Burning in rectum. Discharge of blood from rectum during stool. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids burn like fire. Polyps with proctitis. Sensations - As if about to die. As if immersed in hot water. As if chair were rising. As if he had been lying at night with head too low. As if everything had stopped in head. As if eyes would be pressed out or pressed down by weight about them. As if painful nodes under scalp. Anxiety as if below left breast. As if great weight lying on middle of sternum. Back as if broken. As if quicksilver moved up and down spinal cord. Coccyx as if ulcerated. Soles as if he had walked too much. Feet as if asleep. Ankles as if sprained.

Stool - Very fetid stools and flatus. Long, narrow, hard stool, like a dog's. White, hard stools. Green mucus with grains like sago. Stools hot, sour-smelling, corrosive. Painless stool, copious, gray, bluish, watery, pouring out. Stools scanty, semi-fluid. Stools green, yellow, watery, with flakes of mucus and clots of blood. Discharge of blood from rectum, during stool.

Urine - Constant discharge of thin, slimy, colorless fluid from urethra. Diabetes, sugar in urine. Turbid urine, brown, with red sediment. Profuse pale, watery urine, then weakness. Urine acrid, smelling offensive. Urine turbid, whitish, like curdled milk, with brick-dust sediment and variegated cuticle on surface. Pellicle on urine. Albuminuria, periodical. Sediment white, sandy or flocculent, albuminous, containing fatty casts. Urinates pure blood. Vertigo - Vertigo with faintness, nausea and headache. Vertigo, floating sensation, on Phosphorus waking. Vertigo after rising (Bry.), with weakness of legs. Vertigo on exertion of vision. Vertigo, worse looking up or down. Vertigo from smell of flowers, gas, ethereal oils, turpentine, with fainting. Vertigo of the elderly. Vision - Narrow field of vision. Partial loss of vision from abuse of tobacco, sexual excess, lightning. Diplopia. Amaurosis from sexual excess. Misty vision, with attacks of vanishing of sight. Retinal trouble with the lights and hallucination of vision. Colors before eyes followed by migraine. Green halo about the candlelight (Osm.). Muscae volitantes. Black points seem to float before the eyes. Letters appear red. Patient sees better by shading eyes with hand. Sensation as if everything were covered with a mist or veil or something pulled tightly over eyes. Blindness after lightning-stroke. COMMENTS - Profoundly affects the nutrition and function of all tissues, notably the hardest (bone) and the softest (nerve and blood). Causes irritation, weakness, exaltation of all the senses, and later a typhoid state and fatty degeneration. Pareira observed in phosphorus workers “a peculiar sallow, bloated complexion with dull expression of eye and gastric derangement,” when there was no affection of the jaws. Wagner found Phos. symptoms long before local disease appeared, e.g., cardialgía, anorexia, eructation of gas smelling of Phos., also dizziness, faintness and cachectic appearance. The first symptoms in the jaws are tearing pains, the teeth being sound, swelling and suppuration of the gums and lessening of the teeth follow, and the bone becomes denuded. Langenbeck objects to the term “necrosis,” stating that it is a periostatics in which bony deposit occurs, enclosing the jaws more or less as in a sheath. There is no exfoliation. This osteo-periostitis may arise from rheumatism. Painful burns and burning sensations. “Glowing sensation throughout the epigastrium and chest.” “A flame seemed passing through me.” “Warming sensation right side of heart and below left clavicle. This heat spread to apex of left scapula and to acromion, when it left the heart.” “From 11 a. m. until 4 p.m. remarkable numb feeling in left leg from knee to toes, sometimes sensation as if hot blood flowed into it.” Burning pains with inflammation. Burning between the scapula, burning in spots along the spine, feeling of intense heat running up the back. Flashes of heat beginning in hands and spreading to face. Burning palms, cannot bear to have the hands covered. Nervous or hectic fever. Low delirium, muttering, stupid or violent or there may be a state of ecstasy or odd ideas. In intermittents when there is heat at night beginning in the stomach, faint and hungry in night, heat in hands. Chilliness towards evening, icy coldness of hands, knees and feet, even in bed. Sweat is anxious, profuse, exhausting on slightest exertion, profuse at night, cold and clammy, smelling of sulphur or of garlic. Fibrillary twitching of individual bundles of tissues in muscles. Numbness and formication in paralyzed limbs. Spasms on paralyzed side. Uncertain gait, neuralgic pain and fuzzy feeling of the feet. Locomotor ataxia. Epilepsy from masturbation. Petit mal, epilepsy with consciousness. Sudden prostration from shock or malignant types of disease, either acute or chronic. Overly sensitive, impressionable. Excitable condition, exaltation of mental faculties, and the condition that follows over-exertion. Overextended feeling. Tendency to overreact in situations. Sense of immediacy, living in the present. Anxiety. Lack of focus, spaciness. Can have a lack of direction. Fears of death, solitude, darkness, thunderstorms. Better from company, extroverted. Sympathetic, tends to nurse others. Sensitive to effects of storms, especially thunderstorms. Headache with a thunderstorm. Blindness from lightning stroke. Sleep relieves most symptoms. Refreshed from naps. Exertion, physical or mental, aggravates complaints. Better from open air, warm wraps. Heart palpitations and irregularities of the heart. Palpitations aggravated by lying on the left side. Peripheral numbness, circulatory problems, Raynaud's disease. Stroke. Transient ischemic attacks. Panic attacks associated with blood sugar and the heart. Pulmonary hemorrhage and congestion. Nosebleeds, hemophiliacs. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Small wounds bleed profusely. Bright red blood. Blood-streaked discharges. Blood-streaked or rusty sputa, tasting salty. Acute pernicious anemia and bone cancer. Cancers that bleed profusely and persistently, bright-colored blood. Tendency to bruising. Ulcers, bleed easily at the slightest touch. Open cancers or fungus hematodes. “Large ulcers surrounded by smaller ones.” Ulcers affecting the nails. Ulcers, psoriasis, lichen, eczema, blood boils, purpura. Eruptions. Exanthema with pustules like smallpox. Inflammation and eruptions around joints, particularly the hip and knee. Fistulae with callous edges from glands. The left side of the lower jaw is more affected than the right. Decay and exostoses of spine (Calc-f.). Rheumatism with great stiffness of the joints, more stiffness than pain. Paralytic rheumatism from exposure to rain. Stiffness of old people. A drawing, tearing, tight feeling, in the girdle, pain of spinal affections, tightness of skin of face and forehead. “Splitting headache caused by cough.” Headache and other sufferings from grief. Hot vertex after grief. Shocks in occiput, coldness in cerebellum, congestion of brain seeming to rise from spine into head. Neuralgic pain. Impending paralysis. Attacks induced by mental exertion, worry, washing clothes and are worse by music, noises, strong odors. Cataract and glaucoma. Pustule on cornea. Burning pains. Retinal hemorrhage. Retinitis albuminuria from suppressed menses. Halo around candle. Colors appear black before the eyes. Sees green. Letters appear red while reading. As if a gray veil is over everything. Blindness after typhoid, sexual excess, loss of fluids, or lightning. Twitching of eyelids. Suffocative pains in upper part of chest with constriction of larynx and engorgement of lungs. Bronchial catarrh. Cough causes tearing pain under sternum as if something was being torn loose. Mucus rales, panting andlaboredbreathing. Emphysema. Asthma after the cough. Pneumonias. Indicated when the morbid action becomes localized in the right lung, particularly the lower lobe. Hard, dry cough, rusty sputa, worse at twilight and until midnight. Worse lying on left side, better lying on right side. Tendency tocolds and sore throats. Tuberculosis florida. “Stomach” or “liver” cough. Cough comes on after eating and starts from a tickling in pit of stomach. Cough worse when strangers enter the room, or from strong odors. Sinking, faint feeling in the abdominal cavity, head, chest and stomach. Violent tearing pains in esophagus, chest, stomach. Bloating of abdomen, distended, sore, sensitive to touch. Hemorrhages from all offices. Stomach ulceration with severe burning pains, hemorrhage, and persistent vomiting. Tenderness of the liver. Disorganization of the liver and blood with jaundice, hemorrhages. Hepatitis. Acute fatty degeneration of the liver and fatty degeneration of pancreas with gastric symptoms and oily stools. Fatty and amyloid degeneration of the kidneys. Degeneration with engorgement of the lungs, particularly the right lung. Hunger with great weakness and faintness. Hungry soon aftera meal,hungry during the night. Hypoglycemia. Ice cream ameliorates the gastric pains. Desires cold milk, which agrees. Wants to suck ice (Med.). Longing for acids and spicy things, desires salt things (Nat-m.). Antidotes the effects from excess of salt in diet. Desire for cold foods and preference for cold meat, may be vomited as soon as it becomes warm. Burning thirst for cold water, which relieves, but as soon as it becomes warm in the stomach it is vomited. Regurgitation of ingesta in mouthfuls. The sight of water causes vomiting during pregnancy. Nausea on putting hands into Phosphorus warm water. Sneezing and coryza from putting hands in water. Vomiting and diarrhea. Typhoid. Diabetes. Diabetic peripheral neuropathies. Rectal, bladder, and uterine tenesmus. Stool voided with great difficulty and straining. Stools are long, tough and hard, like a dog's. Stools offensive, involuntary, the anus appearing to remain open. Bloody stool, blood- streaked stool, stool like shreddy membranes. Diarrhea as soon as anything enters the rectum. Profuse diarrhea pouring away as from a hydrant. Watery diarrhea with sago-like particles. Painless, involuntary stool during cholera, in the morning, of old people. Burning in the anus, notably stitches shooting up rectum. Hemorrhoids. Menses are profuse and long lasting. Vicarious menstruation in the form of hemoptysis, nosebleed or hematuria. Leu- corrhea which causes blisters. Left ovarian pain (Thuj., Coloc.). Burning, shooting, and cramping pains in the breasts. Breast abscess and fistula. Erysipelatous appearance, red streaks starting from opening, thin, ichorous discharge. Morning sickness with nausea and burning. Aversion to sex. Nymphomania. Frequent erections in men and sexual thoughts entirely beyond the patient's control. Strong sexual desire, constant wish for sex. Erections in spite of efforts to control passion in young men. Impotence from over- indulgence or from celibacy. A man, 48 inhaled the vapor of burning Phos. Among his symptoms was a sensation as if something twitched under his skin or was creeping between skin and flesh. Twitching of single bundles of tissues at different times like playing on a piano. Tongue often refused to move when speaking so that he stammered. E. R. Heath had some decidedly “phosphorescent” symptoms. Darting, cutting pains, causing much distress, starting from different points and flashing over the whole abdomen. He imagined an aurora borealis and seemed to distinctly hear voices shouting “Beautiful, oh ! was not that splendid?” as the pains became more severe and lasting. He sprang from the bed and tried to collect his thoughts, had numbness all over with sensation of myriads of needles slightly pricking him. Throat dry and parched, a flame seemed to pass through him. Feet seemed glued to the floor. With great difficulty he reached the vessel and as soon as the bowels began to act the pains changed to cramps. Stools were like scrapings of intestines. They were almost constant, with tenesmus, for over two hours. He lay down in bed after, weak, sore, and almost helpless. Clarke reported a case of spinal decay with paralytic symptoms in a woman aged 67. She had a history of a strained back thirty-five years before, and of lumbago and sciatica five years before he saw her. Pains in the scapula and chest, she could not walk unless supported about the waist. She was cured with Phos. 1,000c, the curvature remained, although the decay and paralysis were removed. The Phos. caused dryness of her mouth, lips and throat. W. A. Nicholas reported the case of T. B., 51, whom he saw after a four months' illness. The case began with congestion of the brain on the sudden death of his wife and was followed by bronchitis. During all this time he was heavily drugged. A rather long walk brought on a severe attack of angina pectoris. Bell, lx gave much relief. Nicholas noticed the patient at times put his hand to the back of his neck. Phos. 1c relieved entirely. Hansen cured a case of purpura in a girl of 10. The disease began with loss of appetite and pains in the stomach, but as soon as the purpura spots appeared, the pains ceased and the appetite returned. The inner thighs were affected. Phos. 2c cured. Walker cured with Phos. 6c a large exostosis of the femur which had been pronounced as osteosarcoma by old-school authorities. In a case of rheumatism in an old woman who had a waxy pallor. Cooper gave Phos. and set free all the joints. Dr. Mills related a typical case of thunderstorm effect. Mrs. F., tall, thin, dark of mild and gentle disposition, was seen by the doctor during a thunderstorm. He found her sitting on the stairs, trembling, cold, and bathed in cold, clammy sweat, full of nervous dread and almost beside herself. One dose of Phos. 100,000c cured. Some weeks later she witnessed a storm with complete unconcern. RELATIONS - Antidote to: Phos. poisoning: Turpentine with which it forms an insoluble mass. Kali-perm.

Male - Constant discharge of thin, slimy, colorless fluid from urethra. Discharge of prostatic fluid during hard stool. Ulcers on prepuce. Testes sore, swollen, painful. Hydrocele after gonorrheal orchitis, with sexual weakness. Irresistible desire, but impotent. Erections feeble or none at all. Erection ineffectual during sex. Impotence from or preceded by overexcitement of sexual organs. Premature ejaculation. Involuntary emissions with lascivious dreams. Lascivious, strips himself, sexual mania.

Female - Chlorosis. Amenorrhea with vicarious menstruation, with blood spitting, bleeding from the anus or hematuria, or with milk in breast. Before menses, bearing down pains, nymphomania, weeping. Menses too early and scanty, not profuse. Menses too late but very copious. Menses last too long. Leucorrhea, profuse, smarting, corrosive instead of menses. Milky leucorrhea early in morning, when walking. Slight hemorrhage from uterus between periods. Frequent and profuse or short uterine bleeding in between the periods in nursing women. Metritis. Uterine polyps. Condylomata. Cauliflower cancers bleeding profusely. Cancer of the uterus with metrorrhagia. Edema of labia. Phlebitis. Aversion to sex. Vagina numb during sex in spite of sexual excitement. Violent sexual desire during pregnancy and breast-feeding. Infertility from excessive voluptuousness or with profuse or too late menses. Labor pains distressing, ineffectual. Food - Ravenous hunger during fever, nightly, before the attack of sickness. Hunger soon after eating. Hypoglycemia, low blood sugar. Loss of appetite alternating with bulimia. Headache from fasting. Craving for cold, iced drinks. Craves ice during chill. Craving for ice cream, cold milk, carbonated drinks, refreshing things. Desires salt, acids, spicy foods. Desires chocolate, candies, cheese, cucumbers, chicken, fish, wine. Aversion to warm drinks, warmfood. Aversion to coffee, tea, boiled milk, puddings, sweets. Aversion to fruit, garlic, onions, tomatoes, meat, salt fish, beer. Bad effects of eating too much salt. Unable to drink water during pregnancy, the sight of water makes her vomit, has to close her eyes when taking a bath.

Chest - Sharp stitches in chest, breathing quickened, oppressed. Stitches in left upper chest, rattling worse cold drinks. Full, heavy chest, pains into throat, right arm, or alternating sides. Oppression, as if a great weight on chest. Great pressure on middle of sternum, impossible to lie on back. Tightness across chest. Burning pains. Heat in the chest. Intense heat behind sternum. Dry, hot feeling in chest with cough, dry, then loose. Yellow spots on chest. Swelling of axillary glands. Violent itching in right axilla. Boils in left axilla. Constitutions - Suited to tall, slender persons of sanguine temperament, fair skin, blonde or red hair, quick, lively perceptions and sensitive nature. Young people who grow too rapidly and are inclined to stoop, chlorotic, anemic. Persons of waxy, translucent skin, half anemic, half jaundiced. Tall, slender, narrow-chested, tubercular patients, delicate eyelashes, soft hair. Tall, slim, dark-haired persons, especially women, disposed to stoop. Nervous, weak persons who like to be magnetized. Hemorrhagic patients, slight wounds bleed profusely.

Heart - Anxiety about heart with nausea and peculiar sensation of hunger, somewhat better eating. Pressure in middle of sternum and about heart. Pains go into right arm. Congestion of blood to heart, excited by sensual impressions. Dilatation of the heart from fatty degeneration or endocarditis. Endocarditis or myocarditis during course of acute inflammatory rheumatism or during pneumonia. Palpitations with anxiety while lying on left side. Palpitations from least excitement. Palpitations during menses. Palpitations with numbness, stiffness and coldness of left arm. Weak heart, pulse rapid, small andsoft. Blowing sounds in heart. Feeling of warmth in heart.

Back - Back pains as if broken, impeding all motion, especially during menses. Weak spine. Spinal irritation, worse heat. Burning in spots along spine. Spondylar- throcace. Weakness and paralytic feeling at junction of lumbar and sacral vertebrae. Spinous processes of dorsal vertebrae painful on pressure. Stiff neck. Lipoma on neck with hectic fever. Cramps, burning, between scapula. Heat between the shoulder blades. Pain forward from left scapula. Burning spot in lumbar region, better rubbing. Stitching pain from coccyx up the spine to occiput, worse during stool. Coccyx pain as if ulcerated. Sacrum pain as if broken, on coughing. Pain in sacrum after confinement.

Limbs - Limbs heavy as lead. Tingling and formication in limbs, better rubbing. Muscular rheumatism. Weakness and trembling from every exertion, can scarcely hold anything with his hands. Joints suddenly give way. Ascending sensory and motor paralysis from ends of fingers and toes. Post-diphtheria paralysis with formication of hands and feet. Hands and arms cold during diarrhea. Arms and hands become numb. Stitches in elbow and shoulder joints. Tearing left shoulder at night. Paralyzing stitches in hips, then up back. Pains in tibias, periostitis. Ankles, as if to break, easy dislocation. Burning of feet. Icy cold feet. Toes cramp. Suppressed foot sweat. Cold feet and hands during menses. Can lie only on right side.

Sleep - Great drowsiness, especially after meals. Short naps ameliorates, frequently waking. Sleepiness during coryza. Sleepy by day, sleepless before midnight. Sleepless, cannot close the eyes from internal heat. Difficulty falling asleep on account of excitement. Sleeplessness in elderly people. Vivid dreams of fire, of hemorrhage, ofbiting animals. Dreams of restless Phosphorus work and business which he could not finish. Lascivious dreams. Sleepwalking. Goes to sleep late and awakens weak. Feels in the morning as if he had not slept enough. Coma vigil.

Skin - Anesthesia of skin. Burning in skin with restlessness. Scurvy. Jaundice. Pete- chia. Purpura hemorrhagia. Ecchymosis. Wounds bleed very much, even if small. Woundswhich appear to have healed break out again and bleed. Little ulcer outside of large ones. Ulcers bleed during menses. Thin foul, bloody pus. Brownish or blood red spots. Red streaks after scratching. Psoriasis on knees, elbows, legs and eye- brows. Blood-boils. Fatty cysts. Fungus hematodes and excrescences. Chilblains. Skin burns on shaving.

Modalities - Better in dark, sleep, lying on right side, sitting. Better rubbing, massage, magnetism. Better eating, cold food, washing with cold water, cold, open air. Worse from the change of weather, windy, cold, thunderstorms, lightning. Worse putting hands in cold water, getting wet in hot weather. Worse twilight, evening, light. Worse from warm food or drink, salt. Worse lying on left side or painful side, on back. Worse from touch, physical exertion, ascending stairs, shaving, odors. Worse mental exertion, emotions, talking, puberty, sexual excess, loss of fluids.

Compare - (1) Tub. follows Phos. well and complements its action. (2) Phos-h. - crumbling of teeth, hyperesthesia, locomotor ataxia. (3) Amph. - right jaw swollen and painful. (4) Thymol - typical sexual neurasthenia, irritable stomach, aching throughout lumbar region, worse mental and physical exertion. (5) Calc., Chin., Ant-t., Sep., Lyc., Sulph. (6) For pneumonia. Pneu. Pneumonia and paralytic phenomena, pleuritic pain and pain in ilio-cecal region (Cartier). Complementary: Ars., All-c., Lyc., Sil., Nux- v. Phos. antidotes the nausea and vomiting of chloroform and ether. Sanguis. 30c - Leech - persistent hemorrhages, effects of use of leeches. Phos-pchl. - great soreness of mucus membrane of eyes and nose, throat and chest sore. Incompatible: Caust. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Teeth - Numb teeth. Rapid decay of teeth. Tearing and shooting pains in teeth, worse open air and warm food. Toothache in morning when shewing. Toothache from washing clothes, from having hands in cold or warm water. Persistent bleeding after tooth extraction. Inflammation of gums and gumboils in lower jaw. Gums sore behind central incisors. Boring pain sometimes passing into numbness, worse cold, heat and chewing, with soreness and swelling of gums. Swollen and easily bleeding gums. Gums ulcerated. Irregular formation of teeth of lower jaw of scrofulous children with mesenteric disease.

Tongue - Tongue dry, smooth, red or white, not thickly coated. Tongue coated white, yellow, grey, with brown center. Tongue coated only in middle. Tongue dry in middle, cracked, parched or glossy, with stinging in tip. Burning pain on tongue. Tip of tongue somewhat swollen, with enlargement of its papillae and feeling as if it had been burnt.

Liver - Acute and chronic hepatitis. Congested liver. Acute yellow atrophy of liver. Fatty degeneration of liver (Carb-tcl.,Ars., Chlor.). Cirrhosis. Jaundice with pneumonia or brain disease. Jaundice during pregnancy. Jaundice from nervous excitement, malignant, hematogenous. Liver weakness and sensitivity. Disordered liver in men from tropical climates. Lungs - Oppressive breathing, worse least motion. Tight suffocative breathing, worse cough. Congestion of lungs. Bronchitis. Pneumonia of left lower lung, with oppression, worse lying on left side. Pleuro-pneumonia. Lobular pneumonia. Threatened paralysis of lungs at an early stage of pneumonia in old people. Whole body trembles with cough. Hard, dry, tight, racking cough. Sputa rusty, blood-colored orpurulent. Repeated hemoptysis (Acai.). Easy sputum, frothy, rusty bluish, salty, sour, sweetish or cold. Nervous coughs provoked by strong odors, entrance of a stranger, worse in the presence of strangers, worse lying upon left side. Asthma after cough. Congestive asthma, worse lying on back or on falling asleep. Tuberculosis in tall, rapidly-growing young people (Calc-p.). Pulmonary edema. Typhoid pneumonia, with sensitiveness and gurgling in ileocaecal region and diarrhea.

Kidneys - Fatty or amyloid degeneration of kidneys. Dull pain in renal region. Burning pain in kidneys, can't lie on back. Bright's disease. Nephritis with hydrops and diarrhea. Hematuria in acute nephritis (Canth.). Hematuria with jaundice. Periodical albuminuria.

Bladder - Tension over region of bladder. Bladderis full without urging. Burning and twitching in urethra, with frequent desire to urinate. Frequent urination at night, with scanty discharge. Involuntary urination in children who grow too rapidly. Breasts - Stitching pain in breasts. Left infra-mammary pains. Nipples, hot and sore. Enlargement of mammary gland. Suppuration of breasts, burning, offensive watery discharge. Fistulous tracks after breast abscess. Breast cancer with sharp lancinating pains or bleeding easily. Amenorrhea with milk in breast. Increased secretion of milk, with great debility. Metrorrhagia in nursing women. Causations - Ill effects of anger, fear, grief, worry. Ill effects of exposure to drenching rains, washing clothes, having hair cut. Tobacco. Iodine. Excessive use of salt or sugar. Electrocution.

Cough - Cough with burning dryness in throat. Dry cough, with pain in head as if it would burst. Dry cough, waking from sleep. Hollow cough, mostly in morning in bed, also at night, prevents falling asleep. Cough in morning after rising with expectoration of transparent mucus. Cough from tickling in throat, worse cold air, reading, laughing, talking from going from warm room into cold air. Cough before thunderstorm. Nervous cough, provoked by strong odors. Whole body trembles during cough. Must sit up when coughing.

Perspiration - Cold, clammy sweats. Profuse sweat at night during sleep. Profuse sweat in morning. Early morning, sticky sweats, without relief. Perspires on slight exertion. Sweat smells of sulphur. Exhausting sweats. Perspires on head and hands, frequently alternating with coldness. Mostly sweats on head, hands and feet, with increased urine. Perspires only on forepart of body.

Temperature - Chilly every evening in warm room. Cold knees at night. Craves ice water during the chill. Chill alternating with heat, at night. Chill descends, heat ascends (up back). Burning heat, up back. Internal heat, with sensation of hot water in stomach. Flushes all over, beginning in hands. Profuse perspiration. Hectic fever with small, quick pulse, viscid nightsweats. Fever in warm room, heat down back. Fever with anxiety, burning in face and hands, flushed cheeks. Painless fevers. Fever on falling asleep. Fever at night, without thirst. Stupid delirium.

PHARMACY - phos-h. Phosphorus hydroge- nams. Phosphoretted hydrogen. Phosphine. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anus, weak. Diarrhea. Hyperesthesia. Locomotor ataxia. Paralysis. Stammering. Teeth, crumbling.

HOMEOPATHIC - Breunar related the effects of inhaling this gas, given off in the preparation of “hypophosphites.” Ahe symptoms began to appear after three months including vision disturbances, diarrhea, paralysis and a complete state of locomotor ataxia, worse on closing eyes. The teeth crumbled without pain. Speech and swallowing were difficult. Diarrhea, accompanied by weakness of the anus. RELATIONS- Electricity antidotedtheeffects. Compare: (1) Locomotor ataxia, Arg-n„ Alum., Helo. (2) Vision defects, Benz-d., Carb-s. REFERENCES - Clarke.

PHARMACY - phos-pchl. Phosphorus muri- aticus. Phosphorus pentachloride. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Coryza, Ophthalmia.

HOMEOPATHIC - J. Meredith recorded the effects observed on a science student from grinding up this salt and inhaling the fumes. The main symptoms were eye soreness, coryza, sore throat and chest with difficult breathing. The symptoms lasted fourteen days from the exposure and were cured by Bell. 3x internally and a one percent iodine lotion locally as a compress. REFERENCES - Clarke.

PHARMACY - physala-p. Physalia physalis. Portuguese man-of-war. Physalia pelágica. N. O. Physophoridae. Hydrozoa. Radiata. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Hives. Nettle, rash. Numbness. Stings. Urticaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - G. Bennett was stung by the animal on his second and ring fingers. The sensation was as if stung by a nettle, succeeded in a few minutes by violent aching, affecting the finger joints and spreading up the arm, involving the elbow joint. The pain spread to the shoulder joint and pectoral muscles causing oppression of breathing. After half an hour the symptoms began to abate, leaving a numbness of the limb and a blister at the spot which was stung. The pain was aggravated by application of water, worse by motion and worse when joints became affected. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Apis, Medus., Urt-u. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Physostigma Venenosum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in cool open air, exerting the will. Better closing eyes, sleep, warmth to feet, lying on right side, lying on abdomen or with head low. Hiccough better by sleep. Worse lying on left side, Physostigma venenosum on waking, in church. Worse motion, stepping, descending, misstep, jar, falls, blows. Worse pressure, bathing, heat and cold, cold water, cold bath, change of temperature at 4 p.m. (Lyc.)..
constitution: Astigmatism. Backache. Bathing, effects. Blepharospasm. Chorea. Ciliary spasm. Constipation. Coccyx, pain. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Eyes, disorders. Glaucoma. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemiplegia. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Hiccough. Hysteria. Iris, prolapsed. Leucor- rhea. Locomotorataxia. Meningeal, irritation. Menopausal. Muscular atrophy. Myopia. Navel, inflammation. Palpitations

full:
PHARMACY - phys. Physostigma venenosum. Calabar bean. Ordeal-bean. Esere. N. O. Le- guminosae.Papilionoideae. Trituration of the bean. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Astigmatism. Backache. Bathing, effects. Blepharospasm. Chorea. Ciliary spasm. Constipation. Coccyx, pain. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Eyes, disorders. Glaucoma. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemiplegia. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Hiccough. Hysteria. Iris, prolapsed. Leucor- rhea. Locomotorataxia. Meningeal, irritation. Menopausal. Muscular atrophy. Myopia. Navel, inflammation. Palpitations. Paralysis. Paraplegia. Parkinson's disease. Polymyelitis. Prostration. Sleeplessness. Spinal, irritation. Spinal sclerosis. Stiff neck. T remors. Tetanus. Throat, sore, fish-bone sensation. Water, effects. Wounds.

HERBAL - Calabar is the type of a genus of Leguminosae of the tribe Phaseoleae. It has flowers very like Phaseolus except that its bearded style is terminated by a great oblique hood, covering the blunt stigma. It is this hood that distinguishes the genus and gives it its name. It is a great twining climber and has purplish flowers. Physostigma is the “ordeal-bean” of old. The seeds are very poisonous and are used by the Calabari to determine guilt and innocence. When ingested, the person either vomits or dies, if they die they are considered guilty, if they vomit, they are innocent. Observed cases showed twitchings, especially in the back, and death in thirty minutes. In poisoning cases, the most notable feature was complete muscular prostration. A group of children in Liverpool ate beans that they found among the sweepings of a ship from Africa. Forty- six were admitted to a hospital with loss of muscular power, prostration, feeble, slow pulse. Cold, perspiring skin, cold limbs, vomiting in nearly all cases, diarrhea in one-third of them. At first there was colic, but later on remarkable freedom from pain. Pupils contracted in many, in one they contracted during sleep, dilated when aroused. Only one (a tubercular boy) succumbed. He staggered as he walked, then fell, kicking and rolling as if in pain, but afterwards became quiet, much purged, pulse hardly perceptible, skin cold, face livid, quite conscious and able to swallow water. Directly after drinking he died without a struggle, some froth issuing from nose and mouth. After death the blood was found to be fluid, the heart distended with it and its muscular substance very flaccid.

HOMEOPATHIC - Physostigma and its active principle, eserine, form a valuable addition to the Materia Medica. Stimulates heart, raises blood pressure and increases peristalsis. Causes contraction of the pupil and of the ciliary muscles. Induces a condition of near-sightedness. Eserine is used locally to produce contraction of pupil. Spinal irritation, loss of motility, prostration with very sensitive vertebrae. Depresses the motor and reflex activity of the cord and causes loss of sensibility to pain, muscular weakness. This is followed by complete paralysis, although muscular contractility is not impaired. Meningeal irritation with rigidity of muscles. Paralysis and tremors. Chorea. Fluttering tremors in the muscles, they do not respond to the will, or draw into knots, even the intestines are seen twisted in knots. Fibrillary tremors. Ataxic gait, shooting pains down the limbs. Tetanus. Trismus. Tremors. Polymyelitis anterior. Progressive muscular paralysis. General paralysis of the insane. Horror of cold water, drinks or bathing. Cold water feels too cold. Shuddering worse every draft. Floating sensation. Darting pain here and there. Flushes of heat, worse palms. Pain, beginning at any hour, continues to 12 o'clock following, either noon or midnight. MIND - The mind is active even during sleep. Nothing was right. Too many things in the room, continually counting them. Paralytic state of mind and body from grief.

Head - Headache unbearable, worse atnight. Constant pain on vertex. Pain over orbits. Headache, cannot bear to raise eyelids. Pain from forehead down nose. As of a band about the head, as of a tight cap on head. Heartbeats felt in head on lying down. Cerebro-spinal meningitis, general tetanic rigidity. Brain, falls to side lain on, wavering in. Tremors in head.

Eyes - Bloodshot eyes with burning. Muscae volitantes, flashes of light. Glaucoma, especially afterinjury. Contraction of pupils. Visiontiembhng. Increasing myopia. Accommodation affected, astigmatism. Night- blindness, photophobia. Profuse lachrymation. Exophthalmus. Spasm of ciliary muscle with irritability after using eyes. Post-diphtheria paralysis of eye and accommodation muscles. Twitching of eye muscles. Pain over orbits, cannot bear to raise eyelids. Eyelids tense, cannot close or open them.

Ears - Sharp, shooting pains in the ears. Sudden pain from throat to middle ear, worse eructation. Pain in the ear when writing. Painful pressure on tympani. Crawling in left ear. Sensitive to every sound. Hissing, buzzing, ringing in the ears. Fullness. Stopped feeling. Partial deafness.

Nose - Fluent coryza, burning and tingling of nostrils, nose stuffed and hot. Fever blisters around nostrils. Small boil inside right nostril. Nosebleed while at supper. Smarting at end of nose. Twitching of muscles of nose. Tension in skin of nose and forehead.

Face - Face pale, flushings of the face, heat. Lips numb, licks them. Lockjaw. Neuralgic pain in right side of face. Spastic conditions of the face muscles. Sensation of cramps or spasms in face.

Mouth - Bad taste in mouth. Profuse salivation, thick, leathery saliva. Tongue feels sore on tip. Tongue feels oily, scalded, swollen in chorea. Feeling of loose skin on roof of mouth. Teeth feel rough. Dentition stressful in nervous children.

Throat - Tonsils enlarged, swollen. Elongated uvula. Feeling as if a ball came up throat. Strong heartbeats felt in throat. Vertigo - Vertigo, stumbles on ascending or descending steps. Vertigo with constrictive feeling of head. COMMENTS - According to Brunton, the tetanus properties of the bean belong to the alkaloid calabarine. The paralysis, to eserine, or as it is now called, physostigmine. In cases of poisoning, people experience a speedy general paralysis. Death occurs from failure of respiration, although the heart may be poisoned both directly and through its nerves. The paralysis is seated in the spinal cord. The muscles are affected by fluttering tremors. Involuntary muscles are excited to active movements and expulsive efforts. The intestines are often twisted up in knots. All the secretions are somewhat increased. Many provings have been made with Phys., among which a proving made by Christison on himself is remarkable. Simpson and Douglas MacLagan were sent for to attend to him in his collapsed state. Simpson could only compare it to the state produced by severe flooding, though Christison's only sensation was one of “extreme but not unpleasant faintness.” MacLagan thought it a lot like aconite poisoning. Christison could not get his will into his muscles except by a tremendous effort. Warmth to Christison’s feet and a mustard plaster to his whole abdomen gave great relief and he was then able to turn on his left side, but only remained there a very short time on account of the tumultuous action of the heart it caused. He became drowsy and slept, but his mind was so active in sleep that on awaking he did not know that he had slept. The tumultuous Physostigma venenosum action of the heart continued on waking, but strong coffee quickly restored the whole condition and made the heart regular. Indigestion was observed by Christison and many other provers, “as if large pieces of food had been suddenly swallowed.” It began under the upper sternum, descending and increasing in intensity until it reached the epigastrium. Belchings then occurred and a reversal of direction followed, the sensation ending where it began. With other provers, there was a sensation of weight and hardness. Christison also experienced giddiness and dimness of vision. Phys., and its alkaloid eserine, are best known in old school practice for its action on the eye, especially of contracting the pupil. The effects are more definite when the drug (tincture, extract or solution of alkaloid) is applied to the eye directly, but one myopic prover had his myopia much diminished. Dudgeon related the case of A. E., 26, struck by the cork of a soda-water bottle on the inferior and outer part of the left eyeball. Intense burning pain and effusion into the eyeball followed. Under Arn., prescribed by Mr. Engall, the effusion disappeared and later the pain and inflammation subsided under Aeon, and Merc-c. The pupil was now egg-shaped, the long diameter perpendicular, smaller end downwards, vision extremely myopic. Bell, dilated the pupil, but it had no effect on the vision. Engall sent the patient to Dudgeon, who found the pupil was sluggish and a book had to be held within four inches of the eye to be read. Phys. 3x, every three hours, was given. After the first dose, objects could be seen at a considerable distance and the next day sight was nearly as good as ever. Dudgeon believed that the lens was tilted by the blow and that Phys, restored the over-stretched or paralyzed portion of the ciliary muscle. Woodyatt stated that Phys, produced corneal astigmatism in a young woman who found any attempt at close work caused redness of tarsal edges and a hot, sandy feeling in conjunctiva. Lil-t. 30c cured. For ocular tension, especially when glaucoma has been the result of injury. Eye injuries (Calen., Hyper.). Conjunctivitis with sharp, shooting pains. Pinpoint pupils (Op.). Paralysis of certain eye muscles. Astigmatism. Double vision, severe blurry vision, worse in the right eye. Holes in the field of vision. The eye feels full of fluid. Eye problems associated with extreme insomnia. Muscae volitantes. Paralysis and tremors predominate, but also cramps, twitchings, stiffness and tension. Tetanus. Paralysis and numbness is more apparent on the left side, especially in left arm. Nervous disease with extreme tremors or trembling. Paralysis of the spinal cord and respiratory failure. Parkinson's. Guillain-Barre syndrome. Muscular prostration. Polio, diaphragm paralysis (Con.). Labored respiration. Paralysis with an inability to get the will into the muscles. Paralytic state of mind and body from grief. Ataxic gait, shooting pains down limbs. Locomotor ataxia. Spinal, sacral and coccygeal pains, with numbness of the womb. One prover noted a feeling of levitation on stepping. Dread of cold water, aversion to bathing. Weakness on change of weather and on cold, bracing days. Sleeplessness. Nash cured with Phys. 12c and 30c persistent sleeplessness in a patient who had been in an insane asylum and feared she would have to go again. Her symptoms were “If we chanced to get a nap she awoke suddenly as if in a fright and felt no better from what she had slept.” H. L. Chase, another prover, had a “very severe pain in the right popliteal space,” and he afterwards cured a patient who came to him with pain in the same region two years later. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Great pain immediately after eating. Sensitive to pressure in epigastric region. Pain extends into chest and down arms. Gastralgia, chronic constipation. Hiccough with short break, better from sleep.

Abdomen - Navel, sore, bloated, red. Hy- pogastrium sore, bloated worse standing. Gripe in right hypochondrium. Groins pain alternately. Colicky pains, worse diarrhea, better extending legs.

Rectum - Constipation from atony. Tenesmus and burning with diarrhea. Stools are irregular and loose. Sphincter swollen and rigid, evacuation painful. Anus sore and inclined to protrude. Severe hemorrhoids, following childbirth. Sensations - Sensations of contraction and tension. Wavering in brain. As if she will lose her mind. Tongue as if burnt, swollen and paralyzed. As if a ball were coming up throat. As if stomach were full. Weak feeling in stomach. Back as if paralyzed. Lower limbs as if asleep.

Male - Frequent erections with but slight desire. Emissions without dreams or excitement. Strong-smelling sweat about genitals.

Female - Pain as if menses were coming on. Menses are irregular with palpitations. Leucorrhea worse during the day, when exercising. Sighing, worse when leucorrhea is worse. Metrorrhagia. Rigid muscles. Numbness of womb with pain in back. Food - Hunger but can find nothing to satisfy it. Food has a flat taste. No appetite, disgust for food, tobacco and coffee, and especially for cold drinks.

Chest - Stitches in the chest. Stitches under inferior angles of scapulae during expiration. Heavy weight at chest. Twitches across pectoral muscles.

Heart - Fatty degeneration of heart (Phos., Cupr-acet.). Fluttering of heart felt in throat. Heartbeats distinctly perceptible in chest and head. Feeble pulse. Palpitations, spasmodic action with feeling of pulsation through the whole body.

Back - Sensitive spine. Cramp-like stitches up and down the spine. Drawing on turning head. Creeping numbness from occiput down spine. Chilly, creeping sensations up back. Dull pain in back. Backache in kidney region. Back very weak, unable to stand erect. Breasts - Stitches in left breast, unable to draw in breath. Causations - III effects of emotions, grief. Injuries, falls, blows, and bathing.

Neck - Pain at base of brain. Inclination to stretch out neck. Stiffness in neck. Rheumatic pains in left neck.

Limbs - Limbs feel weary, as after great fatigue. Sudden jerking of limbs on going to sleep. Tetanic convulsions. Locomotor ataxia. Numbness in paralyzed parts, crampy pains in limbs. Pain in deltoid (right) better violent motion. Pain in right popliteal space. Burning and tingling in spine. Hands and feet numb. Flushes of heat in palms. Offensive odor from hands. Lungs - Labored, sighing respiration, yawning. Cannot fill left lung as inspiration causes dull pain at left apex, better by pressure. Cough from tickling in throat. Slight constant inclination to cough from filling lungs.

Sleep - Attacks of overpowering sleepiness with feeling as if to lose consciousness.

Modalities - Better in cool open air, exerting the will. Better closing eyes, sleep, warmth to feet, lying on right side, lying on abdomen or with head low. Hiccough better by sleep. Worse lying on left side, Physostigma venenosum on waking, in church. Worse motion, stepping, descending, misstep, jar, falls, blows. Worse pressure, bathing, heat and cold, cold water, cold bath, change of temperature at 4 p.m. (Lyc.).

Kidneys - Bruised, sore feeling in region of kidneys. Bladder feels distended. Frequent desire to urinate, often ineffectual. Urine is yellow, high colored, strong-smelling, clear, muddy, pale and copious.

Perspiration - Easy sweat with excitement. Copious, cold sweat in drops over whole body. Strong-smelling sweat around genitals.

Temperature - Cold, clammy skin. Hands and feet cold. Every movement and draft causes shuddering. Creeping, chilly sensation in back. Heat in head and face, flushed and hot. Dry burning in hands. Perspires very easily.
