full:
PHARMACY - zinc. Zincum metallicum. Zinc metal. An Element, (Zn, At. Wt. 64.9). Trituration of the metal. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Amblyopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Brain-fag. Brain, paralysis. Breasts, disorders. Breast-milk, disorders. Cataract. Chilblains. Chin, eruptions. Chlorosis. Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Chorea. Constipation. Convulsions. Cracks. Dentition. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Dysuria. Earaches. Ear, discharges. Eczema. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eruptions, suppressed. Esophagus, spasms. Eyes, affections. Eyelids granular. Fatigue. Foot sweat, suppressed. Gastralgia. Headaches. Head, injury. Heels, pains. Hernia, inguinal. Hiccoughs. Hydrocephalus. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Joints, cracking. Lips, disorders. Lochia, suppressed. Masturbation. Melancholy. Memory, weakness. Meningitis. Mental, weakness. Neuralgias. Nerve, weakness. Nipples, sore. Nymphomania. Paralysis. Paresis. Photopsia. Prostate, discharge. Ptosis. Restless, legs. Rheumatism. Sleepiness. Sleepwalking. Spermatorrhea. Spinal irritation. Spine disorders. Spleen, pain. Strabismus. Suppressions. Tarsal tumors. Throat, sore. Tibia, burning. Tympanitis. Typhoid, fever. Ulcers. Urinary, retention. Varicose veins. Whooping cough. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Zincum metallicum belongs to the magnesium group of metals, comprising also cadmium and calcium. It has long been known in the arts, especially in its combination with copper (Cupr.) in the manufacture of brass. Zinc was proved by Hahnemann and his associates, and it appears among the remedies in his book Chronic Diseases. Weyner related the poisoning of cows pasturing near a cadmium mine, near which zinc-smelting was carried on. Effects included general emaciation, skin clinging tightly to the body, eyes pale bluish, drawn back into the orbits, horns and ears unequally warm, mouth hot and shiny and hanging down, at times dry, appetite undisturbed, rumination slower, dung grass-green, thin-flowing and fetid, at times a cough. As the disease progressed, emaciation increased, the horns became rough, milk dried up and diarrhea increased until the animals could no longer rise and died of total prostration. Zinc corresponds to the poisoning of nerves and the brain. Brain and nerves are fatigued. Poisoning from suppressed eruptions or discharges. Tissues are worn out faster than they are repaired. Decreased number and destruction of red blood corpuscles. Defective vitality. Marked anemia with profound prostration, increasing weariness, worse eating, with restlessness. Difficulty developing discharges or exanthemata. Great relief from discharges. Bloody discharges. Suppressed eruptions. Chorea from fright or suppressed eruption. Neuralgia after shingles, better touch. Chronic diseases with brain and spinal symptoms, trembling, convulsive twitching andfidgety feet. Convulsions with paleface and no heat. Spinal disorders. Twitchings. Convulsive twitching or jerking, worse at night during sleep. Spasms from spinal injuries. Descending paralysis. Impending brain paralysis. Isolated effects, formication. One part numb another sensitive, one part hot, other part cold. Transverse pain, shooting pains. Pain in spots, between skin and flesh. Disabling bone pains. Internal trembling. Fidgety feet and other automatic motions of mouth, arms and hands. Feels nurtib, all over, on lying down. Chilblains, blueness of the surface. Intolerance of wine. Wine aggravates all symptoms. MIND - Muddled mind. Brain-fag. Weak memory. Forgets what has been accomplished during day. Lethargic, stupid, forgetful. Stupefaction after nosebleed. Averse to work, to talk. Excitement over trifles. Excitement after hearing horrible things. Ill effects of fright, grief, anger. Fretful, peevish, cries if vexed or moved during sleep (children). Child repeats everything said to it. Chorea from fright. Fear of robbers. Anxiety about thieves. Anxiety from horrible apparition. Desire for company from apprehension and boredom. Starting in fright. Stares as if frightened on waking and rolls head from side to side. Fears being arrested on account of an imagined crime. Confusion, dullness after wine. Great fear, as if persecuted by men or the devil on account of crimes which he has never done. Fears of becoming imprisoned or poisoned, or shot, or buried alive. Changeable moods. Alternately fretful, irritable, quarrelsome, despondent, depressed. Irritability in evening. Impetuous. Weeps when angry. Hypochondriacal mood with gastric symptoms. Melancholy. Cerebral depression. Paresis. Sadness when alone. Periods of depression with disease. Answers very slow and speaks as if in a bad temper. Thinks of death calmly. Religious affections. Hears voices speaking from within him in abusive and filthy language. Easily startled, excited or intoxicated. Very sensitive to noise. Sensitive to others, talking and noise. Easily offended. Weeping from vexation. Screams with pain. Torments everyone with his complaints. Loquacity. Hysteria better during menses. Kisses everyone before menses. Starting from sleep during menses. Nymphomania during pregnancy. Causeless weeping before menses.

Head - Brain-fag, headaches of overtaxed school children. Forehead cool, base of brain hot. Roaring in head. Dullness of head after meals. Headaches from drinkingsmall quantity of wine. Headache with dim vision worse heat. Pressive pain on vertex, at the root of the nose, extending to eyes with weak vision worse warmth, better hard pressure, open air. Heavy aching pain in temples, worse biting. Meningitis. Hydrocephalus after infantile cholera or diarrhea. Rolls head, bores in pillows and grinds teeth. Occipital pain with weight on vertex. Crashing in head, on falling to sleep. Feels as if he would fall to left side. Hair falls from vertex. Vertex bald with soreness of scalp. Hair brittle, bristle, sensitive. Brain paralysis. Automatic motion of head and hands.

Eyes - Intense burning after eye operation. Pterygium, smarting, lachrymation, itching. Smarting as from salt in eye. Eyes as if pressed inward. Pressure as if pressed into head. Itching and soreness of lids and inner canthi. Conjunctivitis. Red and inflamed conjunctiva, worse inner canthus. Pupils contracted during headache. Pupils dilated alternating with contracted. Blurring of one-half of vision, worse stimulants, with severe headache. Photophobia during headache. Dread of sunlight, with dim, watery eyes. Amaurosis Ptosis. Upper lids heavy, as if paralyzed. Rolling of eyes. Eyes feel drawn together. Squinting.

Ears - Earache with frequent acute sharp pains in children. Itching, better boring into it. Tearing, stitches and external swelling. Discharge of fetid pus. Offensive moisture from left ear. Neuralgia of middle ear. Cartilage of ear extremely sensitive. Ringing, whizzing in ear. Impaired, from increase of earwax.

Nose - Sore feeling high up, pressure upon root. Stoppage of nose. Obstruction of nose. Fluent coryza with hoarseness and burning sensation in chest. Coryza with hoarseness and burning in chest. Frequent sneezing. Sneezing after meals. Frequent blowing of blood from nose. Nosebleed followed by stupefaction. Swollen. Pain as from excoriation in interior of nose. Redness of nose, remaining after freezing, tip of nose easily frosted. Bores finger into nose or picks at dry lips.

Face - Face pale and cold, alternating with heat and redness of cheeks. Bluish, miserable. Paleness of face during convulsions. Waxy, white or yellow face. Lips, sticky, dry, cracked. Pale lips and cracked corners of mouth. Redness and itching eruptions on chin. Tearing pain in facial bones. Bones of face as if bruised. Swell- ing and itching of left cheek. Spasmodic twitching.

Mouth - Bitter or bloody taste. Copious secretion of saliva. Sour, bitter water in mouth. Fetid breath. Inflammation of palate. Ulcers on inner surface of cheek and in throat. Herpes in mouth from sea bathing. Grinds teeth. Gnashing of teeth. Teeth loose. Difficult dentition, child weak, cold and restless feet. Bleeding gums. Echoes speech.

Throat - Hoarseness with burning in trachea. Dry, constant inclination to hawk up tenacious mucus. Frequent acute tickling in region of larynx. Rawness and dryness in throat and larynx, better eating. Pain in muscles of throat externally while swallowing. Pain in fauces when yawning. Bitter taste in throat. Accumulation of mucus in larynx and posterior nares.

Stomach - Atonic dyspepsia, feeling as if stomach were collapsed. Empty feeling at stomach soon after eating. Burning in stomach. Heartburn from sweet things. Hiccough after breakfast. Bitter eructations after eating, followed by vomiting. Sour eructations, after milk. Sweetish rising into throat with sweet taste. Globus hystericus rising from pit of stomach. Sensation as if a worm crawling up to the throat from the pit of stomach, causing coughing. Nausea, vomiting of bitter mucus. Nausea and vomiting, worse wine. Nausea from taking even a small sip of wine. Nausea from sight of meat or anything fatty. Vomiting of almost all food or liquid immediately after swallowing it. Stools - Hard, small, constipated stool. Stools, large, dry, difficult, followed by involuntary urination. Offensive, diar- rheic stools alternating with constipation. Stool at first solid, then liquid. Very soft stool immediately after dinner, with and followed by vertigo and roaring in head. Green mucus discharges.

Abdomen - Griping in upper abdomen after soup. Violent cutting pain in abdomen after milk. Sensation as if a lump in liver region or at navel. Neuralgia of spleen. Jerking from groins to penis. Pain after a light meal with tympanitis. Gurgling and griping, distended. Flatulence and rumbling, worse alcohol. Hypogastric flatulence. Hot, putrid flatus. Flatulent colic with retraction of abdomen (Plb.). Reflex symptoms from floating kidney.

Rectum - Desire for stool after eating. Nervous diarrhea. Affections of brain from sudden stoppage of diarrhea. Cholera-like diarrhea in infants. Cholera infantum with tenesmus. Constipation of newborn infants. Ulceration of hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids prolapsed, better heat, worse walking. Crawling as from worms in anus. Soreness, drawing pain in rectum. Burning, sticking pain, itching in anus, during and after stool. Itching in anus with oozing of corrosive moisture. Sensations - Uneasy, as if he had committed a crime. As if he would have a stroke. As if hair bristled. As if scalp were drawn together. As if she had a large goiter which she could not see over. Pains as if between the skin and the flesh. Nauseating weakness as after smoking too strong tobacco. As if kidney would be twisted off. Wrist and foot as if sprained. As if soles swollen. As if tendons of right sole too short. As if ball of great toe frozen.

Urine - Urine turbid, loam-colored in morning. Urine very yellow, deposits white flakes on standing a long time. Emission of urine very slow and in a thin stream. Dribbling urine in evening. Vertigo - Vertigo in occiput. Violent vertigo with stupor. Vertigo deeply seated in brain. Vertigo as if he would have a stroke. Vertigo, as if the seat were undulating when sitting up in bed in morning. Vertigo while sitting up in bed, as if bed were constantly swaying back and forth. Vertigo as if looking through mist, after eating. Vertigo while smoking. Vision - Blurring of one-half of vision. Dim and misty vision in morning after waking. Dim vision during severe headache. Dim vision watery eyes in brain affections. Dim vision with itching and stitching pain in inner canthi. Impaired vision, as if a thick fog lay before eyes, during headache. Luminous bodies after eye operation. Objects appear elongated. Yellow, blue and green rings. Diplopia. Flickering vision. Fiery flakes floating in large circles, when looking at sky. Vanishing vision with lachrymation and burning. COMMENTS - Severe fatigue, nerve or brain-fatigue, muscle-fatigue. Brain-fatigue from over-study or from night watching (Cocc.). Restores suppressed eruptions. Can cure the consequences of suppressions and set free the reactive power in conditions of undeveloped disease. Symptoms worse from suppressed discharges, particularly foot sweat. “Too weak to develop exanthemata or menstrual function to expectorate or urinate to understand to remember.” “Relief to all suffering as soon as menses begin to flow” or discharge is restored. Nash noted that in asthma “the patient cannot expectorate, but as soon as he can he is relieved.” Sexual excitement in both genders. Seminal losses and prostatorrhea of the male. Nymphomania and masturbation in the female, can be associated with varicose veins or itching of the external genitals. Tendency to press on the pubes or apply the hand to the genitals. Severe boring pain in the left ovary. Backache with emission, temporarily better by the emission. Backache and spinal irritation in female sexual disorders as well. Dull aching in spine, worse when sitting. Burning pains all along the spine. Burning pains, tension and constriction. Facial neuralgias, trigeminal neuralgias. Facial twitches and tics (Agar., Spig.). Neuralgia in malar bones with pressive pains. Pressure at root of nose as if it would be pressed in. Grinds teeth, especially in children with worms. “Teeth fail to develop.” Constriction in the chest, connected with both respiration and the heart. “Sudden, spasmodic, bursting sensation about heart, it appears to be beating regularly, when it suddenly seems as if it would burst through the chest.” Varicose veins of the thighs and labia, with fidgety feet. Insatiable hunger and emptiness, notably at 11 a.m. Great thirst. Hasty eating and drinking. Averse to meat, especially veal, sweets, cooked or warm food. Pain is worse from eating or drinking wine. Tearing headache in side of head, worse from wine, after dinner. Intolerance of wine, wine aggravates all symptoms. Drunk easily. Vascular headaches aggravated by the least sip of wine or alcohol. Vertigo from the least alcohol. Numbness, tingling, formication and fainting spells. “Incessant and violent fidgety feeling in feet or lower limbs, must move them constantly, cannot keep them quiet.” These movements may continue during sleep. Insomnia with restless legs. Great restlessness in the legs and feet. Great urge to stretch the legs. Hyper reflex alternating with low reflex response. Hyperactivity with restlessness. Tendency toward spasms, leg cramps (Cupr.). Jerking and twitchings of the limbs, convulsions, epilepsy. Convulsions in children, with a history of cradle cap (Cupr.). Crawling, numbness, tingling sensation. Legs go to sleep easily, painful. Painful formication of the legs. Neuralgic shingles. Parkinson’s disease where the key trembling is of the legs and feet, as opposed to the arms, with pacing and restlessness. Multiple sclerosis. Spinal atrophy and deterioration of the spinal cord. Paralysis, but the legs shake or are restless and move. Paralysis after diphtheria (Lac-c.). Meningitis with sharp pains in the head, worse from the least stimulant. Encephalitis, with brain cry (cri cephalic) (Apis.). Hearing loss after meningitis (Hell.). Children with brain disorders have a characteristic “crossness in the evening.” On waking there is delirium as if frightened, knows no one, screaming. “Child repeats everything said to it.” Tendency to chilblains, which are swollen and painful and easily made worse by rubbing. Sensitiveness to frostbite, the tip of the nose is easily frostbitten and the nose remains red long after it has been frostbitten. The hands and feet are affected with inflammation, painful eruptions, cracks. There is also a “frost-bitten feeling” in the toes. Gerstel called attention to Zinc’s action in fevers with inflammation of the brain. In these cases the seat of the inflammation was the meninges. He referred to a case of a child suffering from scarlatina who was “Entirely motionless, limbs icy cold, body cold, skin all over body bluish red, except the parts about the eyes, forehead and chin, which were white.” Zinc was then given and the child gradually recovered. In a case of typhoid in a man in whom mental symptoms had set in, there was a “Muddled feeling in the head, an incapacity to relate anything and a sort of half-smiling loquacity.” Later on he had a “Staring look, almost hippocratic appearance, pale as wax, car- phologia, subsultus tendinum, constant trembling of the hands.” Zinc 2c saved the patient. General twitchings and trembling, according to Nash, are equally characteristic of Zinc. He recorded the case of Miss Smith.; 20, who had been ill for a week with headache, loss of appetite and especially prostration. Over- study was the cause. Under Gels., and later Bry., she was improving, when she threw off the bedclothes while sleeping and perspiring and took a chill. The bowels became enormously distended, profuse hemorrhage occurred (finally controlled byAlumn.),a low form of delirium came on and prostration increased in spite of the cessation of hemorrhage. Her head was retracted, with complete unconsciousness. Staring eyes rolled upward. Lying on back and sliding down in bed, twitching or rather “intense, violent trembling all over so that she shook the bed.” Her hands had to be held constantly night and day by nurses. Hippocratic face, limbs deathly cold to knees and elbows. The pulse was intermittent, uncountable, all signs in short of impending paralysis of the brain. Two drops of Zinc 200c were mixed in two teaspoonfuls of water. One teaspoonful was worked, a little at a time, between the set teeth and the rest half an hour later. About an hour after the latter dose the patient turned down her eyes and said “Milk.” Through a bent tube she swallowed half a glass of milk, the first nourishment she had taken for twenty-four hours. From that time she improved steadily and received no more medicine for four days. Afterwards she had a dose of Nux-v. Recovery was perfect. F. W. Payne reported a case of cataract in which the right eye was partially affected and the left was practically useless. There was a bruised, sore, smarting, burning, itching and stinging sensation. At intervals, a sudden sensation as if pepper had been thrown into the eye, causing scalding lachrymation and spasm of the lids. These spells were worse in the evening. Burning dryness as if a stick was under lid scratching eyeball. Flickering before left eye, blue and green rings, green halo around gas-jet at times. Slight irritation of conjunctiva and tendency of lids to adhere. Worse by warmth, PB warm days, by aniüáa] Jj$M Patient nervous, tremulous, impatient, worse by mental emotion. Chorea jerking of individual muscles. Zinc 200c, given occasionally, steadily improved the case. In six months, the right eye was quite clear and the left steadily gaining. Eleven years later, vision was practically perfect, though some small streaks could still be found in the left lens. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Hep., Ign., Camph. (Lob., Teste). Antidote to: Bar-c. Compare: (1) Agar., Ign., Plb., Arg-n., Puls., Hell., Tub. (2) Erratic temperature in fevers, Puls. (3) Colic, Puls., Lyc. (4) Abdominal symptoms, Plb., Podo. (5) Tremors, Arg- n. (6) Spinal pain, Cob., Sep. (7) Asthma with great constriction of chest, Cadm-s., Kali-c, Cact. (8) Boring fingers in nose, Cina, Verat., Arum-t. (9) Scarlatina, Bell. (Zinc follows well when rash fails to come out and child screams whenever moved). (10) Hydrocephalus, Calc-p. (11) Pain in back worse sitting than walking, Sep., Cob., Arg-n. Complementary: In hydrocephalus, Calc-p. Followed well by: Sep., Sulph., Puls., Ign. Follows well: Apis, Bell. Incompatible: Cham., Nux-v.-v. Inimical: Nux-v., Cham. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Drawing pain in testicles, spermatic cords. Penis painfully sensitive. Long-lasting and violent erections. Easy sexual excitement, emission too rapid or difficult during embrace. Emissions with hypochondriasis. Sadness after emission. Discharge of prostatic fluid without any cause. Atrophy of testes. Neuralgia of testes worse walking. Testicles swollen, drawn up. Shriveling of scrotum. Falling off of pubic hair. Grasps genitals with cough.

Female - Female symptoms are associated with restlessness, depression, coldness, spinal tenderness and restless feet. Downward pressure on uterus, bladder and rectum, compelling her to sit cross- legged. Stinging pain in pudendum when walking. Bloody leucorrhea, with burning an itching of pudenda, after menses. Menses too early, painful, with bloating of abdomen. Profuse lumpy menses when walking. Menses too late, suppressed, lochia suppressed (Puls.). Menses flow more at night (Bov.). Complaints all better during menstrual flow (Eupi., Lach.). Ovarian pain, better excessive flow. Ovarian pain, especially left, can’t keep still (Vib.). Sexual desire increased. Nymphomaniaof lying-in women. Desire for masturbation. Complete loss of sexual desire. Profuse falling of hair from genitals. Varicose veins of external genitals, with fidgety feet. Food - Loss of appetite, with clean tongue. Ravenous hunger about 11 a.m. (Sulph.). Great greediness when eating, cannot eat fast enough. Extreme thirst. Thirst, with heat in palms. Desire for beer. Aversion to meat, especially veal, during pregnancy. Aversion to sweets, cooked or warm food. Wine aggravates, cannot stand smallest quantity of wine.

Chest - Acute stitches in left clavicle. Dull stitches in right side of chest. Burning pressure beneath sternum. Constriction and cutting in chest. Tightness in chest on walking in open air. Chest as if constricted by aband transversely across it. Pressure in chest as from incarcerated flatus. Pressure under short ribs after eating. Left-sided intercostal neuralgia. Chest as if hollow and cold, after expectoration of tenacious mucus. Weak and burning feeling in sternum. Empty sensation behind sternum. Burning in left axilla. Pain in chest as if beaten. Violent stitches in chest when walking in open air. Constitutions - Nervous constitutions. Coughs - Cough, must sit up, with asthmatic breathing. Cough after wine. Debilitating, spasmodic cough, worse eating sweets. Dry cough, before and during menses. Short cough from tickling beneath sternum. Cough much relieved as soon as he brings up something. Child grasps genitals during cough.

Heart - Pressure, spasmodic tension and heaviness in heart. Sensations if a cap over the heart. Hard heartbeat, taking breath away. Irregular, spasmodic action of the heart, occasionally one violent thump. Tension and stitches in precordial region. Stitch at every beat of heart, with palpitations. Violent pulsations in blood vessels during fever. Pulse increased by wine.

Back - Pain in small of back. Backache better seminal emission. Spinal irritation. Spine sensitive, cannot bear it touched (Agar., Ther.). Burning along whole spine, worse sitting. Aching in spine, small of the back worse turning in bed, sitting and stooping. Dull aching about the last dorsal or first lumbar vertebrae, worse sitting. Cracking in lumbar region while walking. Lumbar region as if screwed in, on rising from seat. Weakness in lumbar region worse standing. Tension and stinging between sAoufoers. Tearing pain, burning in shoulder blades, between shoulder blades, better belchings. Small pimples like boils on and between scapulae.

Neck - Pinching feeling on both sides of neck. Nape of neck feels weary and tired from writing or any mental exertion. Neck feels lame, followed by stupor. Pain in cervical muscles at night.

Limbs - Restless feet in continued motion, cannot keep them still. Lameness, weakness, trembling and twitching of various muscles. Stumbling, spastic gait totters while walking especially in the dark and with closed eyes. Lightning-like pain of locomotor ataxia, sweaty feet with sore toes. Pains in limbs on becoming heated. Chilblains (Agar.). Large varicose veins on legs. Burning in tibia. Soles of feet sensitive. Steps with entire sole of foot on floor. Toes, feel swollen, sore, tips ache. Bones of the feet feel broken. Paralysis of feet. Ulcerative pain in heel worse walking. Formication of feet and legs as of insects crawling over the skin, prevents sleep, better rubbing and pressure. Transverse pains, especially in upper extremity. Hysterical contradictions, drawing the fingers out of shape. Weakness and trembling of the hands, when writing during menses. Eczema on hands. Sweaty. Pain in deltoid worse raising arm.

Sleep - Constant yawning. Overpowering sleepiness. Nervous insomnia with intolerable itching of skin at night. Broken, unrefreshing sleep. Sleep disturbed by violent headaches and painful cramps in calves. Jerks and starts on falling asleep. Cries out while sleeping, body jerks, wakes frightened, startled. Nervous motion of feet when asleep (Kali-p.). Loud screaming in sleep without being aware of it. Somnambulism (Kali-p.), after sup- pressed emotions. Awakens at night from coldness of feet.

Skin - Eczema. Eczema of the hands, in the anemic and neurotic. Sudden itching here and there. Itching of thighs. Itching in the hollow of knees. Formication of feet and legs as from a bug crawling over the skin, preventing sleep. Urticaria-like eruption after scratching. Retrocession of eruptions. Ulcers. Slight injury of skin bleeds very profusely. Varicose veins, especially of lower limbs (Puls.). Varicose veins of genital organs.

Modalities - Better while eating. Betterfree discharges and appearance of eruptions, menses. Better rubbing, scratching. Better motion, hard pressure. Better warm, open air. Worse from exhaustion, mental or physical. Worse after eating, after wine. Worse sweet things, milk. Worse from noise. Worse suppressed eruptions or discharges, menses. Worse between 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. Worse being heated, touching anything cold, being touched. Worse approach of storms which causes chills.

Teeth - Drawing, tearing, jerking pains. Throbbing in a hollow tooth. Grinding of teeth. Sensations as if teeth would be pulled out. Teeth as if long and loose, with swelling of submaxillary glands. Teeth as if sore. Teeth feel on edge. Difficult dentition. Bleeding gums on slightest touch. Retraction of gums. Gums painful while eating. Gums white, ulcerated.

Tongue - Tongue coated at root and dry, in brain affections. Tongue white, as from cheese, without taste. Tongue swollen on left side, hindering talking. Blisters on tongue. Tongue covered with vesicles or with white mucus. Stitches in tip of tongue with salivation.

Liver - Liver enlarged, indurated, hard and sore. Squeezing, pressure and shootings in the hepatic region. Sharp stitches in hepatic region after supper. Lungs - Dyspnea from flatulence after eating. Dyspnea, better as soon as expectoration appears, worse flatulence. Oppressed and difficult breathing. Very heavy and deep breathing. Breathing, impeded, with apprehension and oppression. Asthmatic bronchitis with constriction of chest. Easy expectoration, at night when lying down, with cough. Copious, expectoration of frothy mucus. Yellow, purulent expectoration. Blood- streaked expectoration. Tenacious, sweetish, putrid expectoration. Metallic tasting expectoration. Large amount of mucus of milky color.

Kidneys - Floating kidney. Reflex symptoms from floating kidneys. Pressive cutting about kidneys. Pressure in region of left kidney. Can only pass urine if sitting bent backwards. Hysterical retention of urine. Unable to retain the urine unless the feet are in constant motion. Stitches in kidneys. Sticking and bruised pain in left kidney while standing and walking. Left kidney sensitive to touch.

Bladder - Bladder symptoms better urination. Cramp in bladder, precededby colic. Bladder neuralgia. Pressure upon bladder, but not to urinate. Constant pressure downward in urethra if call to urinate is delayed. Frequent urging at night with scanty discharge. Involuntary urination when walking, coughing or sneezing. Burning urination during menses. Burning in urethra before, during and after urination. Cutting pain in orifice of urethra, in evening while sitting. Bleeding after urination. Vicarious bleeding from suppressed menses. Breasts - Breasts and genitals painful with suppressed menses (Kali-c.). Breasts swollen and sore to touch. Left breast as if swollen. Violent pressing in right breast. Itching about nipples. Nipples sore. Pressing, sore, about right nipple. Stitching pain, beneath breast. Causations - Ill effects of fright, grief, anger, surgery, night watching, excessive study. Ill effects from brain concussion, frostbite, suppressions of eruptions, otorrhea, menses, lochia, milk. Chorea from fright or from suppressed eruptions, worse during sleep, the feet especially affected.

Perspiration - Offensive, sour-smelling sweat. Can’t tolerate any covering during sweat. Profuse sweat all night, wants to uncover. Easy perspiration, during day from exercise. Sour sweat with itching over whole body. Sweats on head and hands. Sweats while walking in open air. Sweats at night, especially on lower limbs. Sweaty feet.

Temperature - Chills begin after dinner. Chilliness in the back, as if fever would appear. Cold limbs, especially hands and legs. Chills from touching anything cold. Chills on approach of a storm. Frequent, febrile shiverings down back, with flushes of heat, trembling of limbs, short breathing and pulsation throughout whole body. Chills followed by cold sweat. Chill alternating with heat. Fever at night, often with sweat. Febrile flushes, with sudden crying out to be fanned, and thirst.

HOMEOPATHIC - The bulk of the symptoms of Zinc-m. are derived from poisoning cases. Zinc chloride is an active poison and apowerful disinfectant and, being readily accessible in the form of “Sir Wm. Burnett’s Disinfectant Fluid,” has occasioned many poisonings, both accidental and suicidal. Most of the Zinc-m. symptoms are the usual effects of a corrosive poison, but some characteristic symptoms appear. One of them was the perversion of the senses of smell and taste. Things had a putrid smell and taste which were not putrid and feces had no odor at all. Quinine had no bitter taste and acids and alkalis had no acid or alkaline taste. Insipid things were most relished. Other Zinc-m. symptoms were “No natural appetite, but a morbid craving for something to allay the irritation at the stomach.” “Vomiting of all food except boiled milk.” “Occasional attacks of tetanic spasms of right forearm and hand.” “Emaciation, skin looked as if stretched tightly over bones of face and hands.” “Bluish and blue-mottled skin.” “Sleeps on right side with legs drawn up, grinds teeth.” Spasmodic twitchings of face and hands, sprains and convulsions were prominent features. De Noe Walkerused a dilution of Zinc-m. as an application to fresh wounds and found it very effectual in securing rapid healing. REFERENCES Clarice.

HOMEOPATHIC - An extensive proving of Zinc-o. was made by Wernek, Buchner and Michaelis. These symptoms have been included by Alien in the pathogenesis of Zinc, and some of them will be found in the schema of Zinc. Jahr kept a separate record of Zinc-o. and Clarke added to his account. Tne contracting, shriveling-up effect of Zinc-o. was marked in these provings. Among the more peculiar symptoms were an undulating movement in some muscles. Contraction of the risible muscles and constant impulse to laugh. Teeth blunted incisors feel soft and glued together. Hiccoughs, that are better after regurgitation of bile. Liquid stools which better all symptoms. In the Zinc-o. provings, the left lung was very markedly affected. Coryza, worse after a meal with difficulty to respiration and nasal secretion. Stoppage of the nose. Anorexia better after a meal. COMMENTS - Farrington said that Zinc-o. is very like Con. in hypochondriasis and melancholy from masturbation, the difference being that Zinc-o. is irritating as well as weakening and depressing. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Tremors, mercurial.Tuberculosis. Twitchings. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to Hale, Zinc-p. removes the mental depression and paralysis following cerebral congestion and strokes. Hale used it on a combination of the indications of the elements and especially in brain fatigue of business men. Brain fag, nervousness, and vertigo. Nervous vertigo, better lying. Formication all over body. Restless, repetitive movements, head rolling, head banging, nail biting, tapping, thumb sucking, movements of the mouth, worse talking. Restless legs, worse getting to sleep, grabs the bedclothes. Tics and twitchings. Chorea. Hands cold, feet perspire. Paralysis. Epilepsy. Burning pains. Hemorrhages of bright red blood. Cerebral hemorrhages. Petechia. Anemia. Neurological complaints. Meningitis. Hydrocephalus. Multiple sclerosis. Parkinson’s disease. Vertigo and fainting. Abuse of bromides. MIND - Moody. Changeable mood. Happy, open, enthusiastic, then gloomy, discontented, hurried. Complaining. Sentimental. Laughing, hysterical, screaming. Grumbling. Irritability, worse being woken, worse music. Mental depression. Loathing of life. Mental exhaustion. Fatigue. Brain fatigue of businessmen. Slow mind. Forgetful. Loss of memory. Indolent. Aversion to talking. Worse talking. Nervousness. Restlessness. Apprehension, worse afternoon and night. Anticipation and anxiety. Fear of failure, criticism. Fear of falling, heights. Fear of being alone. Fear of being pursued, thieves. Fear of being observed, touched. Fear of stroke, death. Fear of being buried, the dark. Fear of horror, ghosts. Fear of disease and death of family or friends. Fear of future. Fear of thunder. Superstitious. Strong sexual, desire. Nymphomania, kisses everyone. Sexual excitement and sleeplessness. Delirious, chaotic, confused. Dementia. Idiotic. Mad, manic. Tourette’s. Childish, very active, makes mistakes. Ailments from humiliation, insults, fright, sadness, homesickness. Coma.

Head - Migraine. Pressing pain in forehead, caused by schoolwork. Headache, especially in sides of head. Nervous headache. Neuralgia of head and face.

Eyes - Eye infections. Foggy vision. Strabismus.

Nose - Hay fever.

Face - Sickly and haggard expression.

Stomach - Diabetes, worse during pregnancy. Stomach complaints. Empty sensation in stomach. Nausea and vomiting. Vomiting, worse drinking.

Abdomen - Abdominal pains.

Rectum - Constipation. Diarrhea, worse wine.

Male - Enlarged prostate. Erections with unusual voluptuousness and desire. Emissions with voluptuous dreams and intense nervous thrill.

Female - Menses profuse. Generally better during menses. Food - Desires sweets, licorice, beer, meat, fruit, starch, cold, fish, anchovies. Aversion to fish, milk, warm foods, sprouts, mushrooms, cloves, salt, oysters. Worse red wine, sweets, coffee.

Chest - Neuralgic pains and skin symptoms like those of herpes zoster.

Heart - Palpitations.

Back - Backache, worse carrying heavy loads, worse when sitting.

Limbs - Bone problems. Growing pains. Rickets. Osteoporosis. Restlessness. Tingling fingertips. Lightning- like pains in locomotor ataxia. Lungs - Asthma. Hyperventilation. Gasping for breath. Sighing. Tuberculosis. Bronchitis. Lung problems.

Sleep - Sleeplessness aggravates. Sleepless after 3 a.m., wakes at three and feels as if under the influence of pleasant and quick music. Sexual excitement and sleeplessness. Nightmares, caused by lack of sleep. Somnambulism. Sleeps on right side. Better after short sleep. Erotic dreams. Dream of futile efforts. Dream of paralysis, exams. Dream of thieves, fleeing, of being pursued, abduction, ghosts, monsters. Dream of falling, heights. Dream of accidents, murder, quarrels.

Skin - Eczema. Herpes zoster. White spots on nails. Hair loss.

Modalities - Better open air, perspiration, discharges. Better sitting back, lying on left side. Better noise. Better movement. Worse touch, rubbing. Worse from suppressed discharges, vaccination. Worse noise, music, light. Worse walking. Worse cats, smells, wool. Worse 5 a.m. and 9 p.m. Worse right side. Worse cold weather, thunderstorms. Very sensitive to both wind and wine.

Teeth - Late teething. Worse during dentition. Vertigo - Fainting. Vertigo, better lying down. COMMENTS - Ashburton Thompson gave pills, each containing 2/3 grains of Zinc-p. to two patients and both experienced a severe frontal headache with frequent stabs of pain backward, deep in the head to occiput. Hammond cured with it nervousness and vertigo better lying down. In some patients the Zinc-p. 3c potency caused sexual excitement and sleeplessness after 3 a.m. J. E. Baldwin reported the case of a woman in perfect health prepared a long report and read it to a large audience without undue excitement. The next day, she had some pressure in occiput to cervical spine, lasting four days. Feeling of fatigue with disinclination to any mental exertion. Zinc-p. 2x cured in a few doses. Zinc-p. 6x has also cured an irritable kidney with loss of memory in an old man. RELATIONS-Compare: Phos.,Zinc., Staph., Thuj., Viol-o., Viol-t. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Kidneys - Irritable kidneys with loss of brain power even when calculus is present. Urine becomes cloudy on standing.

Bladder - Retention of urine, better when sitting back.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hale gave this indication of Zinc-pic., “Cerebrospinal troubles of the weakness of character.” Hugh Pitcairn noted brain-fag and nervous exhaustion from overworked brain or sexual excesses. Chronic occipital headaches, periodic. Headache occurring in Bright’s disease. Threatened cerebral paralysis, especially in children. Profound neurasthenia., when nervous exhaustion has passed beyond stage of weakness. Seminal emissions. Sexual mania. COMMENTS - Halbert reported the case of recent facial paralysis from cold cured by Zinc-pic. 3x and a case of Parkinson’s disease in a woman, 45, very greatly improved by the same. Hale gave the case of Mr. M., 36, a merchant. Above ordinary intelligence. Single, correct in his habits, but subject to seminal emissions since early manhood, occurring about 3 a.m. every third night, leaving him very weak and debilitated, worse every change of weather, especially in hot weather and before and during thunderstorms. Never masturbated. Complained oflossofmemory andenergy, dull, heavy feeling in head, sticky, pasty mouth, dry throat, poor appetite. Belches torrents of tasteless flatus after eating, followed by relief and diarrhea. At other times inclined to constipation. Languid, heavy feeling throughout body. Dull aching pain in back. Zinc-pic. 2x trituration, caused steady improvement, the emissions being reduced in frequency to one in six weeks. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Fatigue - Pic-ac., Ferr-pic. and picrates generally. REFERENCES Clarke.

PHARMACY - zinc-s. Zincum sulphuricum. Zinc sulphate. White Vitriol. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Convulsions. Cornea, opacity. Delirium. Dysentery. Esophagus, stricture. Granular, lids. Headache. Heartbum. Keratitis. Laughter, involuntary. Metrorrhagia. Prostration. Prurigo. Tongue, paralysis. Tremors.

HOMEOPATHIC - A large number of poisonings with Zinc-s. are on record and these have furnished the symptoms of the schema. The use of Zinc-s. in solution as an eye lotion is founded on a specific relationship, and in homeopathic potencies it has cured comeal opacities. Obstinate keratitis in right eye goes away from a 3x lotion. Zinc-s. has anemia, tremors and convulsions. Trembling and convulsions. Titillation all over body with irresistible inclination to laugh. Prostration. Heaviness. Feeling as though her blood could scarcely struggle through her being. MIND - Delirium. Great nervous anxiety and depression. Frightful visions during headache, saw her child with its head shattered (cured with the headache).

Head - Violent headache with thirst. Burning, acute pain in head. Immediately felt as if a painful electric shock had gone through his head, he expected his brains would have burst through his skull.

Eyes - Obstinate keratitis. Bluish rings around eyes. Eyes are heavy and dull, staring, fixed with peculiar bright luster, spasms with upper limbs. Pupils dilated. Lachrymation. Opacity of comea. Diffuse opacity of each cornea goes away on using a lotion around both orbits externally.

Ears - Roaring in ears.

Face - Pale, sunken with cold limbs and convulsed pulse, leaden tint, contracted features.

Mouth - Very sour taste. Tongue moist, a little blanched, partially paralyzed. Tongue, mouth and lips greatly swollen. Gums swollen and red on outer edge. Irritation of whole buccal membrane.

Throat - Inflammation, threatening suffocation. Tenderness in throat. Burning and constriction in fauces. Esophagus is so contracted he fears choking. Vertigo - Dizziness. COMMENTS - Severe gastric and dysenteric symptoms. Dysentery, Farrington said it is chiefly in sub-acute cases that it is indicated, when the pains are confined to the sides of the abdomen, probably to the colon. Abdomen contracted. Burning, acute pain in head. Immediately sensation as if a strong electric shock passed through head, he expected his brains would have burst through his skull. Titillation all over with an irresistible desire to laugh. Sensation as if the blood could scarcely struggle through the veins. A “milk-like pallor of the surface looks like a characteristic.” REFERENCES - Clarke.

Stomach - Thirst, intolerable and dry mouth. Burning heat in stomach with acute pain in epigastrium. Heartburn. Vomiting and purging with cramps, severe pain and burning in stomach and extreme prostration.

Abdomen - Inflammation of abdomen with retraction of umbilicus and terrible colic. Sharp, continuous colic. Pain in abdomen and especially in bladder region in groin.

Rectum - Rectal tenesmus. Constant desire for stool. Purging and vomiting. Bilious diarrhea. Stools infrequent. After three months stools became bloody with sticking and cutting pains in both sides of abdomen and along colon. Obstinate dysentery with emaciation, pale, bloody stools, painful tenesmus and desire for food that failed to nourish.

Female - Metrorrhagia.

Chest - Violent burning pains beneath chest. Sense of choking and constriction around chest. Pains in chest with vomiting.

Heart - Pulse fluttering indistinguishable, dicrotic, almost lost, as in cholera.

Limbs - Trembling and cramps. Convulsive movements of upper limbs and eyeballs. Lungs - Violent cough with bloody and purulent expectoration. Breathing weak, slow, difficult.

Sleep - Sleepy and stupid, wanted to sleep and die in peace.

Skin - Skin pale yellow. Deadly pallor, skin milky white. Herpes zoster. Blisters on neck discharge first bloody water, later thin, green, ill-smelling pus. Frightful prurigo of children affecting the back.

Temperature - Coldness. Shivering violently, slight quivering of lips. Skin and limbs cold and clammy. Hands covered with cold, clammy sweat, but to herself they felt hot and she tried to get hold of anything to cool them. Profuse sweat. Fever followed by profuse sweat. Constant heat, preventing sleep. Burning heat of limbs.

PHARMACY - zinc-val. Zincum valerianicum. Zinc valerinate. Zinc Isovalerate. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Asthma. Brain, fatigue. Colitis. Deltoids, pain. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Facial, neuralgia. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hiccoughs. Hypochondriasis. Hystero- epilepsy. Insomnia. Neuralgias. Ovarian, disorders. Priapism. Sciatica. Seminal, emissions. Stiff-neck.

HOMEOPATHIC - Zinc-val. is a favorite anti-hysteric medicine in old-school practice. One proving, done with substantial doses by C. B. Finney, brought out a strong action on the genital sphere, the usual starting-point of hysteria. Finney noted the brain-fatigue symptoms of Zinc, and the gastro-intestinal disturbance. The abdominal pains woke him from sleep and he had to rise at 6:30 a.m. for stool, which was partly fecal and partly fluid. Later he was constipated and had tenesmus. Zinc-val. affects the nerves, ovaries and spine. A remedy for neuralgias, hysteria, angina pectoris and other painful affections, notably in ovarian disorders. Facial neuralgia, violent in left temple and inferior maxillary. Painful nervous effects. Oversensitive, nervous and sleepless. Uncontrollable sleeplessness from pain in head with melancholy. Sleeplessness in children. Hysteria. Fidgety feet. Hypochondriasis, groundless fear. Hysterical heart-pain. Epilepsy without an aura. Obstinate hiccoughs. Finney had distinct heart pains and Hale mentioned angina pectoris as having been cured by Zinc-val. Other conditions named by him are prosopalgia, spinal neuralgia, sciatica, ovarian neuralgia, cerebrospinal meningitis and tubercular meningitis. MIND - Dullness of mind and headache with erections. Great fullness of head with difficult thinking. Distressed mentally, mind all mixed up. Excitable. Groundless fear.

Head - Violent, neuralgic intermittent headaches. Becomes almost insane with pain, which is piercing and stabbing.

Eyes - Tickling over left ear.

Face - Prosopalgia.

Mouth - Sour taste in morning. Smothers on attempting to eat.

Abdomen - Mucus colitis. Crampy pains from flatulence in hypogastrium.

Female - Dysmenorrhea, pains down the thighs. Ovarian pain that shoots down limbs, even to foot during and after menses.

Back - Aching up.

Limbs - Severe pain in neck and spine. Cannot sit still, must keep legs in constant motion. Sciatic neuralgia.

Modalities - Better from rubbing.

Temperature - Chills after mental excitement or exertion. Cold parts burn as they warm up. COMMENTS - Hansen gave “epilepsy without aura.” Finney had “Sensation as if a very heavy weight on chest,” and dull headache and stiffness of muscles of neck. Hale quoted C. Dradwick as saying that a considerable number of patients who had hemorrhoids, who were taking Zinc-val. for other troubles, had their hemorrhoids relieved by the remedy. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HERBAL - Ginger tea is a folk remedy for diarrhea from food poisoning. The herbal tincture (10 to 15 drops in 2 oz. water three times a day) is a preventive remedy for traveler’s diarrhea and food poisoning. Hot ginger tea has also been used for acute colds and respiratory infections.

HOMEOPATHIC - Zing, strongly affects the digestive, genito-urinary and respiratory systems. Like most spices, ginger has a specific action on the liver and digestive organs. Zing, was proved by Franz and others and their symptoms make a full remedy pathogenesis. Particularly useful forstatesof debility in the digestive tract, sexual system and respiratory troubles. Diarrhea or constipation and helps with irritation of the colon. Flatulence. Pressure in the stomach as from a stone. Worse from eating bread and especially from eating melons. Prolonged retention of urine or complete cessation of the function of the kidneys. MIND - Forgetful, weak memory. Cheerful, good-humored, a pleasing sensation in her system. Increased activity of brain. Nervous and fidgety. Irritable and chilly in evening and during menses. Feet very uncomfortable and did not know what to do.

Head - Headache and pressure in stomach after eating bread. Feels confused and empty in his head. Head feels too large. Frontal headaches. Pain over eyebrows. Pain encircling head. Hemicrania, sudden glimmering before eyes. Congestion of blood io head, especially temples. Itching on scalp, head and cheeks.

Eyes - Smarting and burning in eyes. Feeling as of sand in eyes. Sensitive to light with stinging pain in them. Pressure on eyes, worse on left. Weakness of sight, dimness of cornea.

Nose - Feels obstructed and dry. Insupportable itching, tingling in nostrils. Intolerable itching, red pimples. Coryza, watery, sneezing, more in open air. Dryness and obstruction in posterior sinuses with discharge of thick mucus. Ozaena.

Face - Hot, red face. Exhausted look, blue under eyes, before menses. Dry lips and mouth.

Mouth - Slimy, bad taste in mouth in morning. Mouth smells foul to herself, as from disordered stomach. Painful sensibility of teeth with pressive, drawing pain in their roots.

Throat - Hoarseness. Smarting below larynx, breathing difficult. Dryness of throat and difficulty of swallowing, as from an obstruction with dryness of posterior sinuses. Increased mucus secretion, no fever. Vertigo - Vertigo, limbs heavy. Motion sickness with nausea. COMMENTS - Motion sickness and morning sickness. Deltoid rheumatism, frozen shoulders (Sang., Ferr.). Farrington said ginger may aggravate kidney affections or Bright’s disease. In asthma, Farrington gave the indication: “Asthma of gastric origin, attacks come in the night towards morning. Patient must sit up to breathe, but despite the severity of the paroxysm, there is no anxiety. The nasal mucus membrane is affected as markedly as that of the lungs. Ozaena and post-nasal catarrh.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Nux-v. Compare: (1) Ars., Calad., Chin. (2) Abies-n. Weight in stomach. (3) Prepuce cold - Sulph. (4) Wakes at 3 a.m., Nux-v. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy-

Stomach - Weak digestion. Acidity of stomach (Calc., Rob.). Stomach feels heavy like from a stone (Nux-v.). Heaviness in stomach on waking with gas and rumbling, great thirst and emptiness. Pain from pit to under sternum, worse after eating. Belching and diarrhea. Nausea, vomiting of mucus in alcoholics.

Abdomen - Colic, diarrhea, extremely loose bowels. Chronic intestinal catarrh.

Rectum - Diarrhea from drinking bad water. Diarrhea with much flatulence, cutting pain and relaxation of the anal sphincter (Aloe.). Constipation. Hot, sore, painful anus during pregnancy. Hemorrhoids hot, painful and sore (Aloe.). Sensations - As if head too large. Confused and empty in head. As if there were an obstacle in throat to swallow over. Pain as from over-work in left deltoid. As of a stone in stomach. Empty feeling in stomach. A shock-like moving downward as from a dropping fluid in left loin. Pain as from weakness in sacral region. As from over-strung muscles in bend of knee. As if going to faint.

Male - Itching of prepuce. Sexual desire excited, painful erections. Emissions.

Female - Painful menses, cramps. Menstruation too early and too profuse, blood dark, clotted. Irritable with menses. Food - Much thirst, dry mouth. Taste of food remains long, especially of bread and toast. Food or water poisoning. Complaints from eating melons.

Chest - Stitches in chest, pleuritic pains. Causations - Food poisoning. Bad food or water. Complaints from eating melons. Worms, parasites.

Heart - Violent stinging, pressing pain in left side of chest in region of heart.

Back - Stiffness of back of neck with headache and nausea. Back lame. Backache as from weakness, feels stiff.

Limbs - Joints feel weak, stiff, lame. Dull, heavy feeling in limbs with numbness. Cramps in soles and palms. Rheumatic drawing pains. Painful swelling of feet. Soreness of heels after standing a long time.

Sleep - Sleepy and exhausted, coma. Sleepless, wakes at 3 a.m., falls asleep again late in morning.

Modalities - Better sitting, standing. Better uncovering. Worse by touch, motion. Worse evening and night, lying, rising. Worse in cold air, damp air. Worse from bread, melons. Laughing or talking aggravates headache.

Liver - Hepatitis(Chin.,Phos.). Liver pains, with weakness. Weak digestion. Lungs - Painful respiration. Asthma without anxiety, worse toward morning. Humid asthma. Scratching sensation in throat, stitches in chest. Cough dry and hacking, with copious morning sputa.

Kidneys - Dull aching in both kidneys with frequent desire to urinate. Increased secretion of urine. Stinging, burning in orifice. Urine thick, turbid, dark brown of strong smell. Yellow discharge from urethra. After urinating, continues to ooze in drops. Retention of urine after typhus. Complete suppression after typhoid.

Temperature - Chilliness beginning in lower limbs, going upwards. Chilliness and sensibility in open air. Chilly in evening. Hot and chilly at same time.

full:
PHARMACY - ziz. Zizia aurea. Meadow parsnip. Thaspium aureum. Carum aureum. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Brain, disorders. Catarrh. Chorea. Convulsions. Depression. Dropsy. Epilepsy. Headaches. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Influenza. Leucorrhea. Menses, suppression. Migraine. Ovarian, neuralgia. Pleurisy. Styes.

HOMEOPATHIC - The meadow parsnip is a common plant indigenous to the United States on the moist banks of streams and in open wet woods, where it flowers in June and July. Millspaugh noted that Rafinesque spoke of it as vulnerary, anti-syphilitic and sudorific. Marcy proved Ziz. on himself and some others, and symptoms of poisoning have been added. Marcy considered Ziz. especially suitable in brain affections, catarrhal, asthmatic and pleuritic diseases, and in ovarian neuralgia. Exhilaration with increased physical strength, but a slight amount of exercise caused fatigue. The spasms and convulsions of the Umbelliferae were elicited. The generative organs in both sexes were excited. Ziz. has spasmodic movements of the muscles of face and limbs. Chorea, twitching during sleep. Convulsions, epilepsy. Spasms of face and limbs. Spasms, swooning convulsions and fainting fits, ending in death in three hours. Surface of body sensitive to touch. Whole body white and puffy. Edema of face and ankles. Aspect of grave and chronic illness. Hypochondriasis, desire to commit suicide. Increased strength with inclination for exertion. MIND - Exhilaration like intoxication, followed by strong desire to sleep. Laughing and weeping alternately. Depression followed by exhilaration. Nervous irritability and a state of depression. Paroxysms of self- dissatisfaction with weeping. Low-spirited indifferent. Indolence with contentment. Behavior quiet with much apparent suffering and sadness.

Head - Rush of blood to head and face with feeling of fullness (Bell.). Sensation of tightness around head. Intensely painful, sharp headache over right eye (Sang.). Fully developed headache on seventh day, must lie still in dark room, worse evening. Headache associated with backache, worse by coughing. Severe pain in right temple with nausea. Pressure on top of brain. Dull pain in occipital region, extending down neck muscles.

Eyes - Redness of both eyes. Pain affects right eye most. Shooting pains through orbits. Sharp pain through right orbit, worse moving eyeballs, stooping or stepping. Eyelids agglutinated on rising by yellowish muco- purulent secretion. Styes, right lid. Styes middle of upper lid, very painful. Sensitive to light (Nat-m.).

Nose - Nasal catarrh with sneezing and coughing from first inhalation. Nasal discharge of thick mucus. Right nostril congested, sore with injection of pharynx and conjunctiva.

Face - Pale and puffy. One cheek red, other pale. Boring pains in cheekbones. Dull pains in jaws. Painful tenderness in lower jawbone, an inch below root of ear.

Mouth - Bitter, bilious taste. Dry mouth. Tongue red and unusually sensitive to cold and warm drinks. Tongue covered with whitish fur, yellow fur. Tongue is broad, furred in middle, red at tip and sides. Oppressed respiration.

Throat - Mucus increased. Slight redness of tonsils and palate with soreness. Inflamed pharynx. Vertigo - Giddiness, swimming, lightheadedness. COMMENTS - Ziz. is indicated in uterine disorders characterized by increased nervous and vascular excitement. The menses are profuse and followed by acrid leucorrhea. Uterine congestion with migraine, particularly affecting the region of the right eye. Rush of blood to the head. Flushed cheeks, hot head. One cheek red. Visible pulsations of carotid and temporal arteries (Bell.). Coldness of hands and feet, drowsiness and irritability. Surface of body paler than natural, white, puffy appearance of whole body. Laughs and weeps alternately. Craves acids and stimulants. Burning, smarting backache. Spasmodic movements of face and limbs. Mind first exhilarated, then depressed, finally indifferent. Restlessness, running into chorea, the movements continue or are even worse during sleep. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Puls. - migraine, Carb-an., Staph. - styes. Compare: (1) One cheek red, Cham. (2) Uterine congestion, backache indifference, Sep. (3) Chorea in sleep, Tarent. (4) As if in adream, Ambr., Anae., Calc., Cann-i., Con., Cupr., Med., Rheum., Valer., Verat. (5) Laughing alternately with weeping, Calc., Ign., Merc., Nux-m., Puls., Stram. REFERENCES - Clarke. ***

Stomach - Stomach sensitive to touch, pressure causes nausea and faintness. Nausea. Acid, bilious vomiting, immoderately.

Male - Excitement. Involuntary emissions at night. Lassitude and prostration after se.

Female - Increased vascular and nervous excitement. Sudden suppression of menses. Menses appeared in due time but ceased after twelve hours. Profuse menses one day, followed by acrid leucorrhea. Leucorrhea acrid at first, later copious and bland. Food - Appetite is diminished or lost. Thirst. Craving for acids and stimulants.

Chest - Severe pains in pleurae. Pleuritic stitches worse by coughing or deep breath. Bruised feeling in muscles of chest. Pressure causes pain in intercostal muscles. Pain and tenderness on and around xiphoid cartilage. Dull, aching pain under right scapula. Severe shooting from front of thorax to scapula. Sharp pains from sides and chest to both scapula. Severe stitching pains accompanied by feverish symptoms.

Back - Pain in posterior margin of scapula. Aching, smarting, stinging with aching in small of back when at their worst. Smarting burning in small of back. Dull pains in loins, worse by movement.

Limbs - Lameness in muscles of both arms from shoulder to elbow. Pricking sensation in right aim with steadily diminished sensibility of the part. Dragging sensation in both hips. Unusually tired feeling in legs after slightest exertion. Lungs - Trachea sensitive to touch. Roughness in upperpart of larynx when inspiring or coughing. Larynx raw from coughing. Dry cough with shooting pains in chest. Tight cough from deep breath from dryness of larynx. Short, dry cough with severe stitching in right side and sense of suffocation. Breathing oppressed, cannot keep lying down. Asthma.

Sleep - Drowsiness with sense of fatigue. Sleep prevented by pains. During sleep spasmodic twitches, talking, unpleasant dreams.

Skin - Itching pimples on forehead, wrists and legs.

Modalities - Pains fixed, worse by movement. Worse noise, light, evening. Worse contact, touch, motion. Worse lying, stooping, coughing. Pressure causes pain in intercostal muscles. Pressure on stomach causes nausea and faintness.

Temperature - Chilliness and heat alternating with faintness, nausea, pain in right temple, redness of eyeballs, dry and red tongue and thirst for cold water. Chilliness accompanied by spasmodic twitchings of muscles of face and upper limbs, followed by fever. Fever with headache, pain in back, thirst. Fever with stitching pain in chest. Some sense of heat and fullness in both cheeks. Redness and heat of cheeks. Hot flushes in face and head followed by perspiration.
